Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the garden with her mommy. One day, they were digging up some vegetables from their garden. Lily's mommy found a big red radish and said, "Look Lily, this is an important vegetable. We can use it to make a yummy salad."

Lily was so excited to help her mommy make the salad. But suddenly, the wind started to blow and it made Lily shiver. She said to her mommy, "Mommy, I'm cold. Can we go inside now?"

Her mommy replied, "Of course, let's go inside and warm up. We can make the salad together later." So they went inside and Lily snuggled up with a blanket while her mommy made some hot cocoa. They both enjoyed the warm drink and talked about how much they loved spending time together in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was a very special girl because she had a very special umbrella. It was an original umbrella with lots of pretty colors.

The girl wanted to show her umbrella to her friends, so one day she took it with her to the park. When she arrived, she could see all her friends playing. She waved her original umbrella and everyone said "Wow!"

Her friends wanted to try the umbrella too. So the girl shared it with them, and they all had fun spinning around with the umbrella. They were all laughing and having a great time.

When it was time to go, everyone said goodbye. The girl held her original umbrella tight and happily went home. She was very lucky to have such a special umbrella to share with her friends.

Sara was very happy today. She had a new toy. It was a delicate fairy doll with wings and a dress. She wanted to play with it all day.

She lifted the fairy doll and made it fly in the air. She said, "Hello, fairy. You are so pretty. Do you want to be my friend?"

The fairy doll smiled and nodded. She said, "Yes, Sara. I want to be your friend. You are very kind. Can you show me your room?"

Sara was surprised. She did not know the fairy doll could talk. She said, "Of course, fairy. Come with me. I have many things to show you."

She lifted the fairy doll again and ran to her room. She showed her the fairy doll her bed, her books, her toys, and her pictures. The fairy doll liked everything. She said, "You have a nice room, Sara. You are very lucky. Can I stay with you?"

Sara hugged the fairy doll and said, "Yes, fairy. You can stay with me. You are my new best friend. I love you."

The fairy doll said, "I love you too, Sara. You make me happy. Thank you for lifting me and playing with me today."

Once upon a time, there was a black cat. The cat liked to play with a sack. One day, the cat found a big sack in the yard. The cat was happy and wanted to touch the sack.

The cat went close to the sack and touched it. But, the sack moved! The cat was scared but wanted to play. So, the cat touched the sack again. This time, the sack opened.

Out came a big dog from the sack. The dog was not nice. The black cat was very scared. The dog chased the cat away. The cat could not play with the sack anymore. The cat was sad, and it was a bad day for the black cat.

Once upon a time, there was a little kid who loved to explore. Everyday, she would go to the woods and look for interesting things to find.

One day, the kid went out for a walk and came across a deep pond. Curious, she looked across the pond, but there seemed to be nothing there. She then said, "What's over there in the pond?".

Suddenly, a voice came from inside the pond, "Come in and look". The kid was surprised and scared, but then she thought, "Maybe I should look and see what's inside".

Without any hesitation, the kid jumped into the deep pond and looked around. She saw lots of colorful fish and playful frogs playing around. She laughed and giggled as she watched them.

That day, the little kid found a wonderful surprise in the deep pond.

Once upon a time there was a little 3 year old girl. She loved to explore her garden. One day, she was searching around the garden when she noticed something sour. She saw an ant biting a powder. She was very curious and so she touched it. It was very sour! She quickly pulled away and started to laugh at how sour it was.

After a few minutes she dared herself to taste the powder. She inched closer to the ant and made sure to close her eyes. Then she opened her mouth and stuck out her tongue. She let the powder fall onto her tongue and... it was even more sour than she imagined! She quickly pulled away and started to laugh again.

This time though, she couldn't help but feel sorry for the ant. She ran and got some honey and returned to the ant. She slowly poured it out and placed it next to the powder. She watched as the ant quickly made its way to the honey and began to enjoy its sweet taste!

The little girl was happy to have helped and smiled as the ant walked away. She definitely learned something that day - No matter how sour something might seem, sweet things might be nearby!

Once upon a time, there was a man who was very troubled. He had a pistol, and he wanted to spend his day with it.

The man went to the park and spent his day playing with the pistol. He shot it in the air and it made loud noises. Everyone around him was scared, so they all ran away.

The man felt sad, so he went to the beach. He stopped at a spot that was away from everyone else. There, he spent his time singing and shooting his pistol in the sky.

Soon, the sun started to go down, so the man decided to go home. When he got back, he was happy and no longer troubled. He put his pistol away and promised he would spend many more days like this in the future.

Once upon a time there was a boy. He loved to learn. Everyday he went to school and he learned lots of things. One day he went to the post office. He saw a white envelope in the mail. He was excited to see it and couldn't wait to open it. When he opened it, he learned that it was a big surprise for him! He was so happy. From then on, he kept learning and finding out new things. He was so glad that the white envelope had taught him something new.

Once there was a young girl named Maggie. She was three years old and very curious. One day when she was looking around the house, she found a strange item-- her dad's bathrobe. She was so curious that she wanted to measure it.

Maggie found a ruler and carefully measured the bathrobe. She was very pleased with the results and wanted to tell everyone. Maggie ran out to the kitchen and yelled out what she had just done.

Maggie's dad heard her and came in the room. He was embarrassed because he had not known that Maggie had taken his bathrobe. He gave Maggie a hug and thanked her for being so curious. Maggie was happy and went to show her mom her measurements.

Once there was a bear who was feeling very troubled. He decided to go for a walk and soon ended up at a fountain. As he approached, he noticed another animal standing there. It was a rabbit and he was hopping around, looking excited.

The bear called out, "Hello!" The rabbit stopped and replied cheerfully, "Hello!"

The bear asked, "What are you doing here?"

The rabbit replied, "I was looking to meet someone new!"

The bear smiled and said, "That's great! I'm feeling a bit troubled too, so I'm glad I met you."

The rabbit smiled back and said, "It's nice to meet you! Let's be friends."

The bear and the rabbit smiled at each other and from then on they were the best of friends.

Tom and Mia were playing with their blocks in the living room. They liked to build towers and houses and cars with the blocks. Sometimes they pretended to be giants and knocked down their buildings with their feet.

"Look, Mia, I made a big city!" Tom said, showing his sister his block creation.

"It's very nice, Tom. Can I play with you?" Mia asked.

"Sure, but be careful. Don't destroy my city!" Tom said.

They played together for a while, making noises and stories with their blocks. But then Mia got bored and wanted to do something else.

"I want to play with the doll," she said, grabbing a doll from the shelf.

"Okay, but leave my city alone," Tom said.

Mia nodded, but as she walked away, she accidentally kicked one of Tom's towers. It fell down and made a loud crash.

"Hey, you destroyed my city!" Tom shouted, angry and sad.

He ran after Mia and tried to take the doll from her. They started to fight and pull and push each other.

"Stop it, stop it!" a voice said.

It was Grandma, who was sitting on the couch. She was elderly and had white hair and glasses. She loved Tom and Mia, but she did not like when they fought.

"Tom, Mia, what are you doing?" she asked.

"They destroyed my city!" Tom said, pointing at Mia.

"She destroyed my doll!" Mia said, pointing at Tom.

Grandma sighed and shook her head. She put down her book and got up from the couch.

"Come here, both of you," she said.

She hugged them and kissed them and made them calm down.

"Listen, my dears, I know you are having fun, but you have to be careful and kind. You can't destroy each other's things. That's not nice. And you can't destroy your life by fighting. That's not good. You have to share and help and love each other. That's what makes life happy and beautiful. Do you understand?" she said.

Tom and Mia nodded, feeling sorry and ashamed.

"We're sorry, Grandma," they said.

They hugged her and said they loved her.

Grandma smiled and said she loved them too.

She helped them pick up the blocks and the doll and fix them.

Then she said, "Why don't we make a new city together? And we can put the doll in it too. How does that sound?"

Tom and Mia agreed and said it sounded fun.

They followed Grandma to the floor and started to build a new city with her.

They played and laughed and talked and had a good time.

They did not destroy anything anymore.

They made life happy and beautiful.

Once, there was a girl who loved to celebrate. Every day, she would throw parties with her family and friends and even sing songs. She loved it so much that she decided to build a special statue to celebrate all the things she loved.

She made the statue out of clay and painted it with bright colors. Everyone thought it was beautiful. But then, something sour happened. Someone came and broke the statue, and the girl was very sad.

But, with the help of her family and friends, the girl was able to celebrate again. They all worked together to create a new statue. This time, she painted it with sparkly colors and it was even better than the old one. She was so happy that she threw a big celebration and everyone danced and cheered.

The girl would always remember the special statue, and would always celebrate it in her heart.

Once upon a time, there was a big, old house with a tall chimney. The chimney was very ancient and had been there for a long time. One day, a bird flew into the chimney and got stuck inside. The bird was very scared and didn't know what to do.

Luckily, a kind man came to help the bird. He climbed up the roof and carefully released the bird from the chimney. The bird was very happy and flew away into the blue sky. The man felt proud of himself for helping the little bird and went back inside the house with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there were two twins. They were called Joe and Sally. Joe was tall and Sally was shorter. One day, Joe and Sally were out playing in the garden. Joe found an old carrot. It was starting to rot. So Joe decided to pull it up from the ground. But then, Sally wanted to help too! So the two of them pulled and pulled until the old carrot fell off the ground. It was a funny sight, because the rotting carrot was almost as tall as they were! Joe and Sally laughed and giggled. They decided it was a good idea to take the rotting carrot inside and put it into the compost bin. And so, Joe and Sally had a very fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to school because her teacher was very nice and her classmates were fun to play with. One day, Lily woke up early and saw that the sun was shining bright outside. She got very excited because she knew it was going to be a great day.

Lily's mom made her breakfast and asked her how she was feeling. "I'm feeling great, mom!" Lily said. "Today is going to be a fun day at school." Lily's mom smiled and said, "I'm sure it will be. Now, eat your breakfast so we can leave on time."

When they got to school, Lily saw that her teacher had raised the blinds and let the sunlight in. "Wow, it's so bright in here!" Lily exclaimed. Her teacher smiled and said, "Yes, it is. I wanted to let the sunshine in so we can all have a happy day today."

At the end of the day, Lily's mom picked her up from school and asked her how her day was. "It was great, mom!" Lily said. "My teacher raised the blinds and it was so bright in the classroom. I had so much fun playing with my friends." Lily's mom was happy to hear that and they went home together.

One cold day, a little girl was playing in the park. She saw a newspaper on the ground and picked it up. She decided to make a game out of it and started to clap her hands.

Suddenly, a big bird flew down from the sky and snatched the newspaper away from her. The little girl was upset and started to cry.

Just then, a kind old man saw what was happening and came towards them. He asked the bird to give the newspaper back to the little girl.

The bird looked at the old man and then gave the newspaper back to the little girl. She was happy and thanked him. Then, she started to clap her hands again in excitement. The old man smiled when he saw her.

One day, a little girl named Lucy was feeling very worried. She wanted to find something that would make her feel happy again.

Suddenly, she had an idea. She decided to go on an adventure! With excitement, she stepped outside of her house.

First, she stepped into the backyard. On the other side, she could see a huge tree. With a smile on her face, she stepped closer.

But then she heard a voice. It was coming from the tree's branches! The voice said, "Come here, Lucy. I have something for you!"

Lucy was a bit scared, so she took a deep breath and stepped even closer. It was a little bird! And the bird had some cocoa for her!

"You wanted to make a cup of cocoa, didn't you?" the bird said.

Lucy nodded with excitement. She thanked the bird and went back home, feeling much less worried.

Once there was an ugly duck. He was very unhappy and his life was hard. He decided he needed a change, so he went to the pond and bought a razor. With the razor he decided to shave all of his feathers off! He was so surprised that underneath his feathers he was actually a beautiful swan! He was so happy he decided to take a swim around the pond to show off. Everyone at the pond was amazed by the transformation and applauded him proudly. The ugly duck was so happy with his decision that he stayed at the pond forever and ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and her favorite toy was a clock. It was a tough clock that she got from her grandpa. She loved the sound it made when it tick-tocked.

One day, Lily's little brother came into her room and started to scatter all of her toys around. "Why did you do that?" asked Lily. "I wanted to play with your toys too," said her brother. "But you can't just scatter them around like that," said Lily. "That's not nice."

Lily's brother felt bad and helped her pick up all the toys. Lily was happy that her brother realized it was not nice to scatter her toys around. She picked up her tough clock and showed it to her brother. "Look, this is my favorite toy," she said. "It's tough and makes a nice sound." Her brother smiled and said, "Can I play with it too?" Lily nodded and said, "Of course, but please don't scatter it around."

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to collect rocks. They have a big box of rocks at home. They want to find more rocks. They go to the park with a bag.

At the park, they see many rocks. Some are big, some are small, some are shiny, some are dull. They run to the rocks and start to fill their bag. They are happy.

But Tim is clumsy. He trips over a rock and falls. He hurts his knee. He cries. Sam hears him and runs to him. He sees Tim's knee is bleeding. He says, "Are you okay, Tim?"

Tim says, "No, I'm not okay. I hurt my knee. It's bad. I want to go home."

Sam says, "Don't worry, Tim. I'll help you. Here, take my hand. We'll go home together. We can come back another day to collect more rocks."

Tim says, "Thank you, Sam. You are a good friend. I'm sorry I was clumsy."

Sam says, "It's okay, Tim. Everyone is clumsy sometimes. The important thing is to help each other when we are hurt. That's what friends do."

They walk home slowly, holding hands. They still have their bag of rocks. They are still happy.

The moral value of the story is: Friendship is more valuable than collecting things. Friends should help each other when they are in trouble. Being clumsy is not a bad thing, as long as you learn from your mistakes.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jamie. He had a box that was full of marbles and it was very heavy. Every day, Jamie would play with the marbles and have lots of fun.

One day, Jamie picked up an extra special marble. It was red, round and shiny. He wanted to play with it but he suddenly realized he had to share it with his friends.

Jamie went to find his best friend and handed her the marble. She was so happy and started to play with it. Jamie saw how much fun they were having and realized how special it is to share something with a friend.

Jamie still plays with his marbles, but he never forgets to share with his friends so they can have fun together.

Lily was a little girl who liked to eat toast for breakfast. She liked to put butter and jam on her toast and make it sweet and soft. She ate toast every day and was happy.

One day, she went to visit her grandma, who lived in a different house. Her grandma made toast for her, but it was not the same as her toast. It was thin and hard and had cheese and ham on it. Lily did not like it and made a face.

"What's wrong, Lily?" her grandma asked. "Don't you like your toast?"

Lily shook her head. "No, grandma, I don't. It's different from my toast. I like my toast better."

Her grandma smiled and said, "I understand, Lily. But you know, different is not bad. Different can be good. Different can be fun. Different can help you learn new things and meet new people. Do you want to try something different today?"

Lily thought for a moment. She loved her grandma and wanted to make her happy. She also wanted to learn new things and meet new people. She decided to give the toast a try. She took a bite and was surprised. It was not sweet and soft, but it was salty and crunchy. It was different, but it was good.

"Wow, grandma, this is good!" Lily said. "Thank you for making it for me. I like your toast too."

Her grandma hugged her and said, "You're welcome, Lily. I'm glad you like it. You're a brave and curious girl. I'm proud of you for trying something different. You never know what you might like until you try."

Lily smiled and ate her toast. She learned that different can be good. She also learned that she can meet new things and new people by being brave and curious. She was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, while playing hide and seek, Lily noticed a small bird with a broken wing. She felt sad for the bird and wanted to help it.

Lily carefully picked up the bird with her gentle hands and held it carefully in her handle. She was fearful that she might hurt the bird, but she tried to be brave and help it. She took the bird to her mommy, who knew just what to do.

Mommy took the bird to the vet, who fixed its wing. The bird was happy and healthy again, and Lily was very proud of herself for noticing the bird and helping it. From that day on, Lily made sure to always keep an eye out for animals in need.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He was very impatient. One day, he saw a kayak by the river. It made him very excite. He wanted to try it right away.

Tim went to his friend, Sam. "Sam, let's go on the kayak!" Tim said. Sam said, "Wait, we need to ask our moms first." But Tim did not want to wait.

Tim went on the kayak alone. The water was fast. He got scared. Sam saw Tim and ran to get help. Tim's mom and Sam's mom came and helped Tim out of the water.

Tim was sorry for not waiting. He learned that being impatient can be bad. From that day, Tim always listened to his friends and asked for help when he needed it.

Once there was a little boy called Colin. He was three years old and he loved to explore. One day, Colin was taking a walk and he stumbled upon a lonely hand. It was lying all alone on the forest floor. Colin was curious so he picked up the hand and he realised it felt warm. Suddenly, the hand started to move as if it was trying to say something to Colin!

Colin said, "What is it? Do you need help?"

The hand replied, "Yes, I am very lonely. Will you heal me and become my friend?"

Colin smiled and said, "Yes, I will be your friend!"

Colin took the hand home and all that day and night, he cared for the hand, giving it lots of love and healing. Soon enough, the hand was completely healed and now Colin had a new best friend! He was no longer alone, and he was filled with joy.

The two were inseparable ever since, playing together and exploring the world around them. Even if they were ever apart, they knew that they were still friends and that they would never forget each other.

One day, Tommy invited his friends to his birthday party. All his friends were excited - except for one. His friend George was sad because he didn't have any nice clothes to wear.

Tommy noticed and asked George, "Why are you so sad George? We can make you look special too!"

George shook his head and replied, "I can't come. I don't have anything as nice as the rest of you."

Tommy smiled and told him, "It doesn't matter. I have something for you. Come here!"

Tommy pulled out a rare blue jacket from his closet and said, "Take this! It's special like you."

George was so happy and thanked Tommy for making him feel included in the party.

The moral of the story is that it doesn't take fancy things to make someone feel special - a little kindness and thoughtfulness goes a long way.

Once upon a time there was a little three year old boy named Timmy. He loved to go on adventures with his best friend, his jeep. Timmy’s jeep was gray with yellow stripes and its tires were always good for bouncing.

Today, Timmy had a special plan. He wanted to take his jeep to the top of the mountain. He jumped in and started bouncing up the hill. He kept going until he reached the top.

When he got there, he saw something amazing. A secret path! He couldn’t wait to explore the new path. He walked along the path and noticed the trees and animals around him. After a little while, he came to a bridge.

Timmy was very brave. He started to bounce his jeep across the bridge when all of a sudden it started to crack. He tried to turn around, but it was too late. The bridge broke, and his jeep and Timmy both fell into the river below.

Timmy was so sad. He wanted to go back up the mountain, but he couldn’t. He had to stay in the water until help came.

The end.

Molly was walking in the park when she saw a big palm tree. She had never seen one before and she wanted to find out what kind of tree it was. She reached up and grabbed one of the leaves and it was soft and smelly. She sniffed it and decided to take it home and show her mom.

When she arrived home, her mom was not very happy. "Molly, that leaf is not for taking," her mom said sternly. Molly was really sad but she didn't want to stop exploring. She knew that if she wanted to yield knowledge, she would have to be brave.

Molly asked her mom why she couldn't take the leaf and her mom explained that the smelly leaf was the home of the small creatures who lived in the park. Molly listened to her mom and this time, she decided to leave the leaf be. She felt relieved that she was part of preserving nature.

Molly smiled at her mom and thanked her for teaching her. Molly had yielded knowledge today, and she decided that next time, she'd find something else to explore.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play together. Today they play cook in the garden. They have a big pot and some fake food. They put the food in the pot and stir with a spoon.

"Look, we cook soup!" Lily says. "It smells good!"

"Yes, it does!" Tom says. "Can we eat it?"

They pretend to eat the soup. They make yummy noises. They are happy.

Then they hear a loud noise. It is a bus. The bus stops near the garden. The bus is yellow and blue. It has many windows.

"Wow, a bus!" Tom says. "Let's go see!"

They run to the bus. They see a man in the bus. He is the driver. He smiles at them.

"Hello, kids!" he says. "Do you want to ride the bus?"

"Yes, please!" Lily and Tom say.

They climb on the bus. They find two seats. They look out the window. They see many things. They see houses, trees, cars, and people.

"This is fun!" Lily says. "We go fast!"

"Yes, it is!" Tom says. "We see a lot!"

They enjoy the bus ride. They forget about the soup. They have a new adventure.

Tim and Mia were playing with their dolls in the living room. They had a lot of toys and clothes for their dolls, because their mom and dad always gave them what they wanted. They were spoiled children.

"Look at my doll, she has a new dress with a zipper!" Mia said, showing off her doll to Tim. "She can zip and unzip it like this, see?"

Tim was not impressed. He wanted a zipper for his doll too. He looked around and saw a jacket on the couch. It had a zipper too. He had an idea.

"I have a zipper too!" he said, grabbing the jacket and running to his doll. He tried to put the jacket on his doll, but it was too big. He pulled the zipper hard, but it got stuck. He pulled harder, but it broke. He heard a loud rip.

"Hey, that's my jacket!" Mia shouted, seeing what Tim had done. "You broke it! You broke my zipper!"

She ran to Tim and tried to take the jacket from him. They both pulled and pushed, and the jacket tore more. They started to cry.

Their mom heard the noise and came to the living room. She saw the mess and the broken jacket. She was angry.

"What have you done?" she asked them. "You ruined Mia's jacket! That was a gift from grandma! How could you be so careless?"

She took the jacket from them and threw it in the trash. She looked at their dolls and their toys. She shook her head.

"You have too many things, and you don't appreciate them. You need to learn to share and to take care of your stuff. From now on, I will supply you with only one toy each, and you will have to play with it nicely. Do you understand?"

Tim and Mia nodded, feeling sorry and ashamed. They hugged each other and said they were sorry. They hoped their mom would forgive them and give them back their toys someday. They learned their lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to bake cakes with her mommy. One day, they made a big cake for Lily's daddy's birthday. They put all the ingredients on a scale to make sure they had the right amount.

When the cake was finished, they put it in a safe place so the dog wouldn't eat it. Later that day, Daddy came home and saw the cake. He was so happy and gave Lily a big hug. Lily felt so happy to receive a hug from her daddy.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little pupil named Tim. Tim loved the color purple. He had a purple hat, a purple shirt, and even purple shoes. His friends liked his purple clothes too.

One day, Tim's teacher told the class about a big race. The race was for all the kids in the town. The winner would get a big prize. Tim wanted to win the race, so he practiced running every day after school.

On the day of the race, Tim wore his purple hat, purple shirt, and purple shoes. He ran as fast as he could. All his friends cheered for him. At the end of the race, Tim crossed the finish line first. He won the race! Tim was so happy, and his friends were proud of him. They all celebrated together with a big party.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play golf with his dad. They would go to the golf course every weekend and have a lot of fun. One day, Timmy saw a big slide at the park and he wanted to go on it so badly.

"Dad, can we go on the slide?" Timmy asked.

"No, Timmy. We have to play golf today," his dad replied.

Timmy became very selfish and started to cry. He didn't want to play golf anymore. His dad was very disappointed and they went home without playing golf or going on the slide.

The next day, Timmy's dad went to play golf alone. While he was playing, he had a heart attack and passed away. Timmy was very sad and realized that he should have been grateful for the time he had with his dad, even if it meant missing out on the slide.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mom asked her to put the dishes in the dishwasher. Lily was very cheerful and happy to help her mom.

As she was putting the dishes away, Lily accidentally dropped a plate and it broke into many pieces. She started to cry because she was worried that her mom would be angry with her.

Lily's mom heard her crying and came into the kitchen. She saw the broken plate and asked Lily what happened. Lily told her what had happened and apologized for breaking the plate. Her mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, accidents happen. The most important thing is that you tried to help me."

From that day on, Lily learned that it's okay to make mistakes and that it's important to always try your best. She also learned that it's important to ask for help when you need it.

Lila and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. They run, jump, slide and swing. They are happy and healthy.

One day, they see a big dog in the park. The dog is brown and furry. It has a long tail and big ears. The dog runs to Lila and Tom. They are scared.

"Shut, shut, go away!" Lila says to the dog. She holds Tom's hand. Tom nods. He says, "Shut, shut, go away!"

The dog stops. It looks at Lila and Tom. It wags its tail. It winks at them. It does not want to hurt them. It wants to play.

Lila and Tom see the dog wink. They are not scared anymore. They smile. They say, "Hello, dog. Do you want to play with us?"

The dog barks. It nods. It wants to play with them. Lila and Tom pet the dog. They throw a ball for the dog. The dog fetches the ball. They have fun.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to the park and play on the swings. One day, she saw a boy who was sad because he lost his bag.

Lily asked the boy, "What's wrong?" The boy said, "I lost my bag. It had my delicious sandwich in it."

Lily wanted to help the boy, so she started to look for his bag. She pushed aside some leaves and found the bag. The boy was so happy and said, "Thank you, Lily! You are my hero!"

The moral of the story is that it's important to help others when they need it. Sometimes, a small act of kindness can make a big difference in someone's day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very tall for his age, and he loved to point at things he saw.

One day, Timmy went to the park and saw a big, red slide. He wanted to go down the slide, but he was scared. His friend, Billy, came over and asked, "Why are you not going down the slide, Timmy?"

Timmy said, "I am scared. The slide is too tall for me."

Billy said, "Don't lie, Timmy. You went down that slide last week and you loved it!"

Timmy thought about it and realized Billy was right. He wasn't scared, he just forgot how much fun he had on the slide. So, Timmy climbed up the tall slide and went down it with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Toby. He was very brave and liked to try new things. One day, Toby went to a special place near his house called the Dive Park.

At the Dive Park, he saw an incredible stack of wooden blocks. He was so excited that he wanted to dive right in them! Toby was so brave that he ran and leapt into the stack of blocks.

He had so much fun! He jumped and bounced and he tumbled and rolled around. The blocks felt so good and he had the best time ever!

When it was time to go, Toby told his mom that the Dive Park was the best place ever! He couldn't believe how much fun he had been able to have with the incredible stack of blocks.

Mica was a little girl who loved to give hugs. Everywhere she went, she gave hugs to her family. One day, when she was walking with her family, she saw a very weird pot. It was an odd shape and was decorated in a way that she had never seen before.

Mica was so curious. She reached out to hug the pot. Her family laughed and shook their heads, but Mica just smiled. She hugged the pot as if it was a friend.

Mica's family thought she was being silly, but her hug made the pot even more special. For the rest of the day, Mica and her family smiled every time they saw the pot.

Mica had made a weird pot into something special with a simple hug from her heart.

Jane and Robert were going to a festival. They put on hats and bracelets and were ready to go.

When they got to the festival, it was so noisy. Jane saw a girl and thought, "She looks like she can't hear."

The girl was deaf. Jane said "Hi" and waved. The girl smiled and waved back. The girl said she was having fun and Jane was happy to see her smiling.

They looked at all the things at the festival. They saw music, games, and horses too. Jane saw a circus and thought it was funny.

Robert said, "Let's get something to eat!", and the deaf girl said, "Yes, I do not know what". They laughed, and the girl smiled.

Soon the festival was over and they went back home. Jane said, "I had a really nice time with the deaf girl". Robert smiled and said, "Me too".

Once upon a time there was a clumsy boy. His name was Tommy. He loved to touch things.

One day, Tommy was playing in his room when he found a mysterious bottle. He picked it up and examined it closely. It was beautiful and he wanted to take it with him.

Suddenly, he heard his mum call from the kitchen: "Tommy, come here quickly!"

Tommy ran to the kitchen and tried to hide the bottle behind his back, but his mum noticed it.

"Tommy, what have you got there?" she asked.

Tommy was silent. His mum smiled and said: "Let me see that bottle. You can keep it, but you have to be careful - it's very fragile."

Tommy was so happy. He gave his mum a big hug and said: "Thank you!"

He was careful and gentle as he touched the bottle and thanked his mum again. From then on, he never stopped being careful and always touched things gently.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and have fun. One day, her mommy took her to the zoo to see the animals. Lily was so excited to see all the different animals.

They saw lions, tigers, and bears. They even saw a rare bird with colorful feathers. Lily loved watching the animals, but she started to get hungry. Her mommy took out a sandwich and fed it to her.

After she finished eating, they went to the playground where Lily had more fun. She went down the slide and played on the swings. She had such a great day at the zoo with her mommy.

Once upon a time, there was a very unusual hero named Max. Max was a big, strong dog with a shiny coat and a wagging tail. One day, Max's owner, a little girl named Lily, lost her favorite toy. She looked everywhere for it but couldn't find it.

Max insisted on helping Lily find her toy. He sniffed around the house and finally found the toy under the couch. Lily was so happy and gave Max lots of hugs and kisses. Max felt proud to be a hero and wagged his tail even more.

From that day on, Lily knew that Max was her hero and she loved him very much. Max was happy to help and insisted that he would always be there for Lily whenever she needed him.

One day, a girl named Mia and a boy named Leo went to the jungle with their dad. They wanted to see the animals and the plants. Dad told them to stay close and not to go too far.

Mia and Leo saw many things in the jungle. They saw monkeys, birds, snakes, and bugs. They heard noises and smells. They felt the sun and the wind. They were happy and curious.

But then, Mia saw something shiny in the bushes. She wanted to see what it was. She told Leo to come with her. Leo said no. He said they should listen to dad and not leave the path. Mia said it would be quick and fun. She said they would not get lost. She said they would find a treasure. Leo was not sure, but he followed Mia.

They went into the bushes and found a metal box. It had a lock and a key. Mia opened the box and saw many things inside. There were coins, jewels, toys, and books. Mia and Leo were amazed. They wanted to touch and play with everything. They spread the things on the ground and looked at them.

But they did not notice that they were not alone. A big, black, and furry animal was watching them from behind a tree. It had sharp teeth and claws. It was hungry and angry. It was a bear. An unknown bear. It did not like strangers in its home. It growled and ran towards Mia and Leo.

Mia and Leo heard the growl and saw the bear. They were scared and screamed. They dropped the things and ran back to the path. They hoped dad would hear them and help them. They hoped the bear would not catch them. They hoped they would be safe. They learned a lesson. They should not go to unknown places in the jungle. They should stay with dad.

Once there was a little girl called Ella. Every day Ella wanted to do something special, but no matter how hard she tried it never worked out.

One day Ella found a very special knob. It was golden and sparkled in the sun. Ella tried to turn it, but it wouldn't move. She was determined to turn it and struggled and struggled.

Finally she gave it one last push and it turned! A door opened and Ella stepped inside. Inside the door was a perfect room covered in candy. Ella could not believe it. She smiled, knowing that if she struggles she can always get a perfect surprise.

Once upon a time there was an adventurous boy named Jack. He had a magical box and one day he decided to explore it. He excitedly took out the box and began to unpack it. Inside, he found a mysterious fork! He was a curious boy so he decided to take the fork and explore the forest nearby.

On the way, Jack was careful and cautious, but he soon stopped in fear. Before him was a wild and dangerous animal! Jack didn't know what to do, so he slowly and carefully took out the fork. The animal was an angry lion, but he was so surprised by the fork that he didn't know how to react.

Jack said: "I'm sorry, I don't mean to be dangerous. Can I use this fork to help you?"

The lion smiled and said: "Yes, you may use this fork to help me. Thank you!"

Jack was amazed and bravely used the fork to help the lion. Now, Jack and the lion are good friends and go on many adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with colors and draw pictures. One day, she was drawing a beautiful rainbow with her crayons. Suddenly, she knocked over a cup of water and spilled it on her drawing.

"Oh no! I'm so clumsy," Lily said with a sad face.

Her mom came over and saw the mess. "It's okay, Lily. Don't regret it. We can fix your drawing and make it even better," her mom said with a smile.

Lily felt better and they worked together to fix the drawing. They added more colors and made the rainbow even brighter than before. Lily was happy and proud of her new creation. "Thank you, Mommy. I love it!" she said, giving her mom a big hug.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and run outside. One day, she found a pretty bracelet on the ground. It was shiny and had lots of colors. She put it on her wrist and danced around.

Lily's mom asked her to help print some papers for work. Lily pushed the button and the printer made a noisy sound. She giggled and covered her ears. When the papers were done, Lily's mom said thank you and gave her a hug.

Later that day, Lily showed her bracelet to her friends. They thought it was so pretty and asked where she got it. Lily told them she found it outside and it made her feel happy. They all smiled and played together until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. One day, he fell down and hurt his arm. His mom took him to the hospital to get an x-ray. The doctor looked at the x-ray and said Timmy had a broken bone.

Timmy was scared and his face turned pale. He didn't want to wear a cast because he thought it would hurt. His mom explained that the cast would help his arm feel better, but Timmy didn't want to listen.

Finally, the doctor said, "Timmy, if you don't wear the cast, your arm won't get better. You have to surrender to the cast." Timmy thought about it and decided to listen to the doctor. He wore the cast and his arm felt better in no time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom in the garden. One day, her mom said, "Lily, let's prepare the garden for new flowers." Lily was very excited.

They went to the garden and saw many dry spots. Lily's mom gave her a small bag. In the bag, there were bulbs. Lily asked, "What are these?" Her mom said, "These are bulbs. We will put them in the dry spots. They will grow into beautiful flowers."

Lily and her mom started to dig small holes in the dry spots. They put the bulbs in the holes and covered them with dirt. After they were done, Lily said, "I can't wait to see the flowers!" Her mom smiled and said, "Me too, Lily. We will have a beautiful garden soon."

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful tree. Every day, the tree wanted to look even more lovely, so it asked all of the animals in the forest to decorate it.

The rabbits cut some nice green leaves and put them carefully around the tree. Then some birds collected colourful feathers and arranged them into sparkly designs. Every morning, they added something new and beautiful until the tree was full of decorations.

When the creatures were finished, the tree looked so lovely, that it could hardly believe its eyes. It felt so special and thanked all of its friends for making it look so wonderful. The animals were all very happy and celebrated by singing and dancing together.

The animals, the birds and the tree all had so much fun decorating, and even after all these years, the tree still looks lovely.

Once upon a time there was a princess. She had long, soft hair and she always wore a beautiful dress. Her dress had a big skirt and it was amazing! Everyday she would go outside and visit her friends. They all lived in big, funny houses.

One day the princess decided to raise her skirt. Sheand her friends cheered and laughed when they saw it. The skirt was so high and it was amazing!

The princess felt so happy and she laughed and twirled around. Her friends tried to copy her and they started to raise their skirts too. They were having so much fun and they laughed and skipped around. It was very exciting!

When the princess finally went home, she was feeling so proud of herself. She had raised her skirt and it was amazing. She could hardly wait to show her mom!

Henry was going to test the hippo. He wanted to see how heavy it was. He reached out and gently touched the hippo. It felt heavy. Henry pushed the hippo to see if he could move it. But it was too heavy. He couldn't move it. He thought and thought about what he could do. Then he had an idea. He ran to the kitchen and grabbed his Mom's shopping bags. He filled the bags with books until they were heavy. Then he put them on the hippo. Henry looked at the bags, he could see they were heavy. Then he pushed the hippo. Now he could move it! Henry was so happy that he had an idea to test the hippo.

Once there was a girl named Jane. Jane was invited to a party. She was very excited to go to the party, it sounded like it was going to be very fun and full of games.

When Jane arrived to the party, it was so crazy! There were kids running around, the music was loud and there was a bouncy castle.

Suddenly, Jane's mom told her it was time to leave the party. Jane was very upset. She had just arrived and did not want to go home yet.

"Mom, I don't want to leave yet," said Jane. But her mother said it was time to go and Jane had to leave the party.

Jane was very sad as she left the party and went home. She was so disappointed that she had to leave the crazy party.

Once upon a time there was a tall uncle. He was very nice and everyone loved him. He took care of lots of little kids and was always making them smile and laugh. One night, all the kids wanted to sleep over at Uncle's house. So Uncle got lots of beds and blankets and made everyone comfortable. He sang them a soothing lullaby and tucked them all in. Soon, the kids all drifted off to sleep and Uncle watched over them the whole night. In the morning, they all woke up refreshed and happy to have their beloved tall uncle with them. The end.

Jake was walking in the park and he saw something on the ground. It was a pigeon. Jake wanted to see the pigeon so he slowly began to walk closer. He wanted to see it better, but the pigeon was scared. Jake moved closer and he reached out to push the pigeon.

The pigeon was so scared that it flew away quickly. Jake felt sad. He wanted to help the pigeon and he felt hurt that it was scared of him. He looked around and saw that there was a park keeper nearby. Jake went over to him and told him about the hurt pigeon.

The park keeper was very kind and told Jake that he would try his best to help the pigeon. He said he would find a nice home for the pigeon and help it to feel safe again. Jake was happy to hear this and he thanked the park keeper. They both looked out at the sky, hoping that the pigeon was okay.

Once upon a time, in a distant land, there was a big steel door. It was very strong and shiny. No one knew what was behind the door, but every day, a little boy named Tim would walk by and look at it.

One day, Tim met a new friend named Sue. Sue was very curious about the door too. They decided to play near the door and listen for any sounds. They heard a soft noise coming from behind the door. Tim and Sue knew something was going to happen soon.

The next day, Tim and Sue saw the door open. They were so excited and went to see what was inside. They found a room full of toys and games! It was like a dream come true. The soft noise they heard was a hint that the door would open. Tim and Sue played there every day and had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Tim. Tim loved candy very much. One day, he saw a big bag of candy in the kitchen. Tim wanted to eat all the candy, but his mom said, "Stay away from the candy, Tim."

Tim did not want to listen to his mom. He thought that staying away from the candy was dull. So, when his mom went to the store, Tim took the big bag of candy and started to eat it.

Tim ate and ate until there was no more candy left in the bag. When his mom came back from the store, she saw the empty bag and was very sad. Tim felt bad for not listening to his mom. Now, there was no more candy left for anyone.

Once upon a time there was a family. The family had a cow. Everyday the cow ate grass and made beef. The family was very happy.

One day, the dad had a great idea. He decided to give the cow some sweet things to eat. The dad gave the cow honey, apples and sugar.

Every day the cow ate the sweet things. Soon, the cow started to make more beef. The family was very pleased.

The more sweet things the cow ate, the more beef it made. The family was so happy! They had lots of beef to eat.

The end.

John was walking in the woods. He stumbed on a big rock and fell down. He looked up and saw a big white palm tree. He got up and walked to it. He wanted to touch the big white leaves but he was too small. He looked up to the top of the tree and saw a little bird. It smiled down at him. John smiled back and walked away.

He walked some more but then he stumbled again. He fell into some soft sand. He looked up and saw a white beach. He got up and ran to the shore. It was so beautiful. The white sand sparkled in the sun and the blue ocean looked so wide and inviting. But then he remembered his mom so he started walking back.

But then he stumbled again. He opened his eyes and saw a big white cloud in the sky. He smiled and jumped up and down. The white cloud looked like a big pillow in the sky. It was so beautiful.

John continued walking and soon he was back home. He learned that if he stumbled again, it was okay. He could always find something beautiful in his world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat oatmeal for breakfast every day. One morning, her mom made her oatmeal that was too hot, and it burned her tongue. Lily cried and said, "It's too hot, Mommy!" Her mom hugged her and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. Let's wait for it to cool down."

After a few minutes, Lily tried the oatmeal again. This time, it was just right! She ate it all up and said, "Yum, I love oatmeal!" Her mom smiled and said, "I'm glad you like it, Lily. Do you want me to make it for you again tomorrow?" Lily nodded and said, "Yes, please repeat it!"

From then on, Lily's mom made sure to make the oatmeal just the right temperature for her gentle little girl.

It was a sunny day and Tommy was happy. He loved to play in his room and always thought of ways to make playtime even better.

Today, Tommy had a great idea. He had decided to bring some of his toys into the kitchen to play with there. He thought it was a fun way to do something different.

But when Tommy walked into the kitchen, he noticed something unusual. On the kitchen table was a small box. Tommy was curious and walked closer to have a better look.

“Be careful Tommy,” his mum said. “That box might not be safe.”

Tommy was cautious and kept his distance. But soon his curious nature overcame him and he walked closer to the box. As he reached for it, his mum warned him again:

“Don't touch it Tommy!”

But it was too late. As soon as Tommy touched the box, a loud bang filled the kitchen.

Tommy was scared and flinched. His mum came to his side and said:

“It’s okay, everything is alright. That box was a surprise for you.”

Tommy was happy and opened the box. Inside was a set of drums.

“Now you can strike these drums and make some music!” his mum said.

Once there was a little girl who was having a great day. The sun was shining, the birds were singing and she was having a lot of fun.

Suddenly, it began to snow. The girl's eyes grew wide with wonder as snowflakes started to twirl around her. She started to spin and spin, trying to catch the snowflakes with her hands.

The snowflakes began to freeze in the air. The girl quickly ran to get an envelope to catch them. She managed to catch some of the snowflakes and quickly put them inside her envelope.

The girl kept her envelope in a warm place. She opened it every day to remind herself of the wonderful winter day she had that day. Every time she opened the envelope, a smile lit up on her face.

Once upon a time there was a quiet attic. Inside the attic were two sisters. The older sister, named Emma, was always in charge.

One day while they were in the attic, Emma said to her younger sister, Lily. "Let's paint the walls of the attic!" Lily grinned, she had never painted before.

Emma gave Lily a pot of bright green paint and a brush. "Paint the wall! Go on! Be brave!"

Lily held the brush and took a deep breath. She dipped the brush into the pot of paint and started painting. She painted little circles, big circles and even triangles until the whole wall was covered in bright green.

When she finished painting, Lily looked around the attic. It was so quiet and even more wonderful with the walls painted green.

Tom was a boy who liked to play with his toys. He had many toys, but he always wanted more. He did not like to share his toys with his friends or his sister. He was not happy.

One day, it was his birthday. He was very excited. He hoped to receive many new toys. He opened his presents one by one. He received a car, a ball, a book, a hat, and a bulb. He liked the car, the ball, the book, and the hat. But he did not like the bulb. He thought it was a silly present. He threw it away.

His mom saw him throw away the bulb. She was sad. She said, "Tom, do you know what this bulb is? It is a special bulb. It can grow into a beautiful flower. You just need to plant it in the soil, water it, and give it some sun. It is a gift from your grandma. She loves you very much. She wanted to give you something that can make you happy and teach you something."

Tom felt ashamed. He did not know that the bulb was a special bulb. He did not know that his grandma loved him so much. He said, "I'm sorry, mom. I'm sorry, grandma. I was not nice. I did not appreciate the bulb. Can I have it back?"

His mom smiled. She said, "Yes, you can have it back. But you have to take good care of it. It is not a toy. It is a living thing. It needs your love and attention. It may take some time, but it will grow and bloom. And when it does, you will see how beautiful it is. And you will feel happy and proud."

Tom nodded. He said, "I will, mom. I will, grandma. Thank you for the bulb. It is not a silly present. It is a wonderful present. I love you both."

He took the bulb from the trash. He felt that it was heavy. But it was not a heavy burden. It was a heavy blessing. He planted it in a pot. He watered it. He gave it some sun. He waited patiently. And one day, he saw a green sprout. And then, a colorful flower. He was amazed. He was happy. He learned to be grateful and caring. He learned to love the bulb. And the bulb loved him back.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat. The boat was very pretty and had a lot of colors. One day, the boat saw a big, shiny anchor. The boat stopped and looked at the anchor. The boat admired the anchor because it was so big and shiny.

The boat continued to sail and saw a yellow bird. The bird was flying in the sky and looked very happy. The boat liked the yellow bird because it was so pretty.

As the boat sailed further, it saw a big island with tall trees. The boat stopped near the island and looked at the trees. The boat admired the trees because they were so tall and green.

The boat continued to sail and saw many more pretty things. The boat was happy and enjoyed its journey.

Once upon a time, there was a mom and her daughter. The mom was very busy, so the daughter needed to wait. She was too small to help, so the mom asked her to sit down and sort the toys. The daughter carefully sorted her tiny dolls into piles.

Then, the mom cried out, "Oh no! I need to go get something really expensive!". She asked the daughter to stay and wait for her. So, the daughter waited and waited, but finally the mom came home with a big smile.

The daughter looked up and saw what the mom had bought. It was a wonderful new toy - it was brightly colored and sparkly. The daughter was so excited that she jumped up and down!

The mom told the daughter, "Now, why don't you sort the new toy with your dolls!". So the daughter happily sorted her new toy with the rest of her dolls.

The mom smiled, because she was happy to have helped her daughter. And they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty piece. It spun around and around so fast! The piece zoomed up in the blue sky and down on the green grass. Everyone in the land wanted to get their hands on the mighty piece and make it spin.

One day, a three year old spotted the piece, and reached out to grab it. He spun the mighty piece around and around, faster and faster. His friends cheered and laughed as they watched him make the piece come alive.

The three year old loved the piece and spun it every single day. He could spin it so well that he felt like a spinning master. He even forgot that it was actually a mighty piece, for it felt like part of him.

When the three year old grew older, he passed the piece to a younger child. The child eagerly spun the piece and thought that it was the most incredible thing ever! The mighty piece had been around for a long time, and it was now ready to spin with a new hand.

Mummy and Daddy were talking to the little girl. "We're going to the beach today," Mummy explained. The little girl smiled. She had never seen the beach before. When they arrived, Daddy pointed out to the ocean. "That's a sail," he explained. The little girl was amazed. But the beach was dirty. Mummy took her hand and said, "Let's go find shells by the rocks." The little girl happily agreed. They spent the whole day finding and collecting shells. By the time they left, the little girl's bag was filled with colourful treasures.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful comet that lived high in the sky. It shone brightly for all to see and gave off a beautiful light!

One day, the comet noticed something very strange was happening on Earth. Everyone was in trouble! So, it decided to grab its magic wand and help out.

Using its magic wand, the comet made a special rainbow that stretched across the sky. It sparkled and shone with all the colours of the rainbow! Everyone thought it was so beautiful and thanked the comet for being so helpful.

The rainbow brought lots of happiness and joy to everyone. Everyone finally had something to be happy about. The comet made sure the rainbow stayed in the sky forever, so that everyone could enjoy it!

Once upon a time, there was a powerful king. The king had a big telephone. He loved to ring it every day.

One day, the king wanted to ring his telephone. But, the telephone was lost. The king looked everywhere, but he could not find it. He was very sad.

At last, he found the telephone in a deep hole. But, the king fell into the hole too. He could not get out. No one heard the king's call for help. The king stayed in the hole and was very sad. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Michael and Sarah. They were always together, playing and laughing in the park.

One day, Michael and Sarah spotted a big copper coin lying in the sand near the swings.

Excited, Michael asked Sarah, "Can I have the copper?"

Sarah, not wanting to disappoint her best friend, made a promise. "Yes, you can have the copper," she said.

Sarah was feeling uncomfortable, because she wanted to keep the copper for herself. But she knew it was the right thing to do, so she picked it up and handed it to Michael.

Michael thanked Sarah and gave her a hug. "Thank you so much! That was incredibly kind of you," he said, smiling.

Sarah smiled back. Even though she felt uncomfortable, she was glad that she kept her promise.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Gianna. She was three years old and she loved to explore the world around her.

One day, Gianna was walking in the park when she saw an old man. He was bowing to a tall tree and had a bottle of oil in his hand. Gianna was surprised and curious, so she asked the man what he was doing.

The man smiled and said, “I’m being thoughtful and taking care of this tree. You see, I’m rubbing oil on the bark to make sure it will stay healthy and strong.”

Gianna thought this was a very special thing to do and thanked the man for his kind deed. She made a mental note to be more thoughtful in her own life and thanked the man before she left.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to talk and play with her friends. One day, Lily went to a new school where she met children who spoke a different language. She didn't understand them, but she wanted to be their friend.

Lily's teacher said that learning a new language can be hard, but if she practiced every day, she would get better. Lily tried her best and soon she could say "hello" and "thank you" in the new language. Her new friends were happy to hear her speak their language.

One day, Lily and her friends went to the park to play. It was a hot day and they were thirsty. Lily's friend said, "I wish we had something to drink." Lily remembered that her mom packed her a bottle of water. She got it out of her backpack and shared it with her friends. They were happy and said, "Lily, you are a good friend."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear her favorite pink skirt every day. One day, her mom said, "Lily, you must take off your skirt before you eat your spaghetti. You don't want to spoil it!"

Lily was sad, but she listened to her mom. After dinner, Lily's little brother spilled his juice on her skirt. Lily was upset and said, "Oh no! My skirt is spoiled!"

But her mom said, "Don't worry, Lily. You are a clever girl. We can wash it and make it clean again."

Lily learned that accidents happen, but with a little bit of clever thinking, things can be fixed. From then on, she made sure to take off her skirt before eating messy foods.

Once upon a time there was a young girl called Amy. She was very excited as it was her very first day of make-up school. As she entered the room, she saw all the different kinds of make-up she could use.

Amy eagerly said, "I want to try them all. I'm so excited!"

Amy's teacher smiled. "It is great that you are so excited," she said. "But makeup can change how you look. Remember to use it carefully!"

Amy nodded and began to experiment with the different kinds of make-up. She felt so grown-up, trying the make-up like a young adult.

Amy looked at herself in the mirror and she loved how she looked with the make-up. She realized that with just a few changes, she could really make a difference.

Amy smiled and said, "I love make-up!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat mint candy. One day, she saw a foolish rabbit hopping around in her garden.

"Hello Mr. Rabbit," said Lily. "What are you doing?"

"I am looking for my carrot," replied the rabbit. "But I can't find it. Can you help me?"

Lily smiled and said, "Sure, I can help you find it. Follow me, I will lead you to it."

Lily took the rabbit to a patch of mint plants and said, "Look, your carrot is hiding here. It looks just like a mint leaf."

The rabbit was so happy and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are very kind."

Lily smiled and said, "It's no problem. I love to help my friends."

One day, Mommy and Daddy took Sara the 3-year-old to the park. Mommy and Daddy were happy, but Sara was scared. She saw a cop. The cop looked dangerous. Mommy and Daddy talked to the cop. After that, they all walked away together.

Sara didn't know why they talked to the cop. She was too scared to ask. Daddy held her hand tight and told her everything was OK.

When they got home, Daddy told her that the cop was there to keep everyone safe. He said the cop was like a big friend who made sure no-one was in danger.

Sara felt better and knew the cop was there to help keep her safe. She was no longer scared.

Once there was a boy named Jack. He was three years old and he loved playing with his friends. One day, he was walking in the park when he saw a glove on the ground. He picked it up and asked himself, "Whose glove is this?"

He looked around but there was no one in sight. Then he came upon an old man and asked, "Excuse me, sir, can you answer me? Whose glove is this?"

The old man smiled and said "Ah, this glove belongs to me. I must have dropped it while I was walking. Thank you for finding it."

Jack was happy that he solved the mystery of the glove. But then he remembered something. He asked the old man, "Can I have your glove? It's so soft and looks very easy to use."

The old man thought for a moment and then said, "Yes, you may have the glove. I think it would make a wonderful present for you."

Jack smiled and thanked the old man. From then on, he kept the glove with him everywhere he went!

Once upon a time, there was a yellow potato. The potato was happy because it had a special task to do. Every day, it went to the garden and picked some flowers. It was very proud of the flowers it made.

One day, the potato felt a bit lonely. It wanted to find a friend. So it went off in search of one. It walked and walked until it found a little bug. The bug and potato became friends. They went to the garden every day and picked yellow flowers.

The friends stayed together for many days. They were very happy but then one day, something happened. The potato was so excited that it jumped up and down. It was so happy it fell into a basket and rolled away.

The little bug missed the potato but was very sad. But then the bug found another yellow potato and the two became new friends. They picked yellow flowers and played together until the sun went down.

The yellow potatoes were very happy with their new friendship. They stayed together forever, picking yellow flowers and playing in the garden.

Sammy was a happy little boy. He had a modern house with a big chimney. Every morning, the sun shone through his window, making Sammy smile.

One day, Sammy went outside to play. He ran around, played with the birds, and ran through the flowers. Sammy was having so much fun that he couldn't keep from smiling.

When he got tired, Sammy went into his house. He saw his chimney and it made him smile even more. He ran and touched the bricks, feeling how warm they were. He leaned up and peered inside the chimney and imagined all sorts of fun things.

Sammy was having the best day ever. Nothing made him as happy as playing and smiling. He waved to the chimney and went off to play some more, with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a modest little frog. The frog lived near a river. The river was very big and pretty. The frog loved to play near the river every day.

One day, the frog wanted to cross the river to see his friend. But the river was too big for the little frog. He needed to find a way to delay going across. So, the frog thought and thought.

The frog found a big leaf to help him. He sat on the leaf and let it float on the water. The leaf took him across the river slowly. The little frog was happy because he found a way to delay crossing the river. And he got to see his friend after all.

One day, a little girl named Lily and her big brother Max went for a walk in the valley. The valley was full of flowers, trees, and animals. Lily liked to look at everything and ask Max questions.

"Max, what is that big bird with a long neck?" Lily asked, pointing at a crane.

"That is a crane, Lily. It can fly very high and catch fish in the water," Max explained.

"Wow, it is so unique! Can I touch it?" Lily wondered.

"No, Lily, you can't touch it. It might be scared of you and fly away. Or it might peck you with its beak. You have to be gentle and quiet with the animals," Max said.

"OK, Max, I will be gentle and quiet. But can we come closer and watch it?" Lily asked.

"Sure, Lily, we can come closer and watch it. But we have to be careful and not make any noise. Come, follow me," Max said.

Lily and Max walked slowly and quietly towards the crane. They hid behind a bush and peeked at the bird. The crane was standing on one leg and looking around. It had a beautiful white and gray feather and a red spot on its head.

Lily and Max felt very lucky to see such a unique bird. They watched it for a long time, until it flew away with a loud cry. Then they smiled at each other and continued their walk in the valley. They saw many other wonderful things, but they never forgot the crane.

Lily was restless. She did not want to nap. She wanted to play. She saw a hammer on the floor. It was big and shiny. She picked it up and smiled.

She walked around the house. She saw a vase with flowers. She did not like the vase. She lifted the hammer and smashed the vase. It broke into pieces. She heard a loud noise. She liked the noise.

She saw a picture on the wall. It was of a dog. She did not like the dog. She lifted the hammer and hit the picture. It fell off the wall. She heard another loud noise. She liked the noise.

She saw a cake on the table. It was for her brother's birthday. She did not like her brother. She lifted the hammer and smashed the cake. It splattered everywhere. She heard a squishy noise. She liked the noise.

She heard footsteps. It was her mom. She saw what Lily had done. She was angry. She took the hammer from Lily and said, "No, no, no! You are a bad girl! You destroyed everything! Go to your room now!"

Lily cried. She did not like her mom. She did not like the hammer. She did not like anything. She wished she had napped.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to slide, swing and run. They saw a big tent with many colors. They wanted to see what was inside.

They walked to the tent and lifted a flap. They saw many people and animals. They saw a man with a funny hat and a long nose. He was making jokes and noises. They saw a lady with a big dress and many rings. She was throwing balls in the air. They saw a horse with stripes and a lion with a mane. They were jumping through hoops.

Tom and Lily were amazed. They wanted to join the fun. They stepped inside the tent. But they did not see a big dog with sharp teeth. The dog was guarding the tent. He saw Tom and Lily and growled.

Tom and Lily were frightened. They wanted to run away. But the dog was blocking the way. They did not know what to do.

"Help!" Tom whispered to Lily. "We need to find a way out!"

"Look!" Lily whispered back. "There is a triangle on the tent. Maybe we can cut it and make a hole!"

Tom and Lily saw a triangle of cloth on the tent. It was near the top. They saw a stick on the ground. They picked it up and threw it at the triangle. The stick made a hole in the cloth.

Tom and Lily climbed on a box and reached the hole. They crawled through the hole and escaped. The dog barked and chased them. But they were too fast. They ran to their mom and dad and hugged them.

"Mom, Dad, we saw a circus!" Tom and Lily said. "But there was a scary dog!"

"It's okay, sweeties," Mom and Dad said. "You are safe now. Next time, ask us before you go inside a tent. Some tents are not for children."

Tom and Lily nodded. They learned their lesson. They still liked the circus, but they did not like the dog. They liked their mom and dad more.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and design pretty pictures with her crayons. One day, she wanted to make a special napkin for her mommy's birthday dinner. She drew flowers and hearts on it with her favorite colors.

When it was time for dinner, Lily's mommy saw the napkin and was so happy. She said, "Wow, Lily! This is such a beautiful napkin you designed." Lily felt proud and happy to make her mommy smile.

After dinner, Lily went to bed like normal. She snuggled up with her favorite stuffed animal and fell asleep dreaming of all the pretty pictures she will design in the future.

Once upon a time there were two friends, a bear and a rabbit. They had been friends for a long time and spent many days playing together in the woods. One day, the bear introduced the rabbit to furniture. The furniture was light and the rabbit liked it very much. The rabbit invited the bear to sit down and the bear joined him.

The bear wanted to make the rabbit happy and he thought that the furniture would be a better way for them to play together, but when the rabbit began to lay down, the treasure chest behind the furniture shifted and fell on the floor.

The bear and the rabbit ran to the chest, which was filled with gold coins. They looked at each other and then knew that the furniture had been more than just a way to have fun. It had also been a way to discover the hidden treasures around them.

The moral of the story is that although furniture seems like a simple way to have fun and relax, it can also be a way to discover amazing things and experience life in a new way.

Tom and Lily are friends. They like to play in the house. The house is big and has many toys. Tom and Lily have fun with the toys.

One day, Tom and Lily find a new toy. It is a puzzle. The puzzle has many pieces. Tom and Lily want to make the puzzle. They remove the pieces from the box and put them on the floor.

"Look, Lily, this piece has a star!" Tom says. He shows Lily the piece.

"Wow, Tom, that is a pretty piece!" Lily says. She looks for another piece with a star.

They work on the puzzle for a long time. They find more pieces with stars, and other shapes. They try to fit the pieces together.

They are almost done with the puzzle. They only need one more piece. It is a piece with a heart.

"Where is the heart piece, Tom?" Lily asks. She looks around the floor.

"I don't know, Lily. Maybe it is under the sofa." Tom says. He moves the sofa and looks under it.

He sees the heart piece. He also sees something else. It is a shiny coin.

"Look, Lily, I found the heart piece!" Tom says. He picks up the piece and the coin.

"And I found a coin, too! We are lucky!" He says. He shows Lily the coin.

"Wow, Tom, you are right! We are lucky!" Lily says. She smiles and hugs Tom.

They finish the puzzle. It is a picture of a house. A house with stars and hearts.

They are happy. They put the coin in the box. They say thank you to the house. They say thank you to the puzzle. They say thank you to each other. They are friends. They like to play in the house. The house is big and has many toys. Tom and Lily have fun with the toys.

One day, Sophia and her Dad were walking around the park. All of a sudden, Sophia saw something that made her very excited. It was a bucket! She wanted it so badly and started running towards the bucket. Her Dad laughed as he watched her run.

When she finally got to the bucket, she was so happy! She picked it up and started running around with it, going in circles and getting dizzy. She laughed as she spun in circles. Suddenly she got so dizzy that she fell down, holding the bucket tightly.

But then Dad came over to give her a hug. He told her it was time to go home and gently took the bucket out of her hands. Sophia wanted to keep the bucket, so she kept begging Dad to let her take it home.

Finally, Dad said, "Okay, if you take care of the bucket, you can bring it home." Sophia was so happy she jumped up and down. She hugged the bucket tightly and never let go of it until she was back home.

One day, a little bird named Tim was flying in the gloomy sky. He saw his friend, the big tree, and went to say hi. The big tree looked sad.

"Hi, big tree. Why are you sad?" asked Tim.

"I am sad because my leaves are falling off and the sky is gloomy," said the big tree.

Tim wanted to help his friend. He thought and thought. Then, he had an idea. "I can sing a happy song to make you feel better," said Tim.

So, Tim sang a happy song. The big tree smiled and felt better. The sky became less gloomy and the sun came out. In the end, Tim and the big tree had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby boy. He loved watching TV. He usually watched it for a long time until it was dark outside. One night, he was watching TV when he heard a loud scary noise. He was so scared he jumped off his chair and hid behind the couch. The noise was coming from the TV! It was loud and scary, so he wasn't sure what to do. He sat there scared, until his mom walked in the room. She saw him, and quickly reached for the TV. She switched it off and told the chubby boy not to worry. All the scary noise was gone. He felt better and got back on his chair and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Fred. He was silly and liked to run around and have fun. One day, he was with his mom in their living room playing a game. Suddenly, a big curtain in the corner of the room started to tremble and shake.

Fred's mom smiled and said, "I have a surprise for you, Fred! Wanna know what it is?"

Fred was super excited. He couldn't wait to find out, so he hopped up and ran over to the curtain. He grabbed the fabric and whipped it back.

There, standing behind the curtain, was a huge clown! He was smiling and wearing a silly hat, and he had huge colorful balloons in his hands.

Fred couldn't believe his eyes. He burst into laughter and clapped his hands. He ran over to the clown and hugged him and said, "Thank you!"

This was the best surprise ever, and Fred was so glad he'd followed the shaking curtain. He had a lot of fun that day, running around and playing with his balloon-filled friend.

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play in the park every day. They had a lot of fun on the swings, the slide and the sandbox. They also liked to look for signs of animals, like birds, squirrels and bugs.

One day, they saw a big sign on the fence. It said: "No dogs allowed". Lily and Ben were sad. They loved dogs. They hoped to have a dog of their own someday. They wondered why the sign was there.

They decided to ask the park lady. She was nice and always gave them stickers. They walked up to her and said: "Hello, park lady. Why is there a sign that says no dogs?"

The park lady smiled and said: "Hello, Lily and Ben. The sign is there because some dogs are not nice. They bark and bite and make a mess. They scare the other animals and the children. We want the park to be safe and clean for everyone."

Lily and Ben nodded. They understood. But they still felt sad. They said: "But not all dogs are bad. Some dogs are friendly and cute and cuddly. We wish we could see some dogs in the park."

The park lady thought for a moment. Then she said: "You know what? You are right. Some dogs are very good. And I have a surprise for you. Follow me."

She led them to a corner of the park, where there was a big tent. Inside the tent, there were many dogs of different sizes, colors and shapes. They were all wagging their tails and looking happy. The park lady said: "These are the dogs from the shelter. They need new homes and families. You can pet them and play with them. Maybe you can even adopt one, if your parents agree."

Lily and Ben were amazed. They ran into the tent and hugged the dogs. They felt their soft fur and their warm tongues. They heard their happy barks and their gentle whimpers. They saw their bright eyes and their sweet smiles. They thought it was incredible.

They thanked the park lady and said: "This is the best day ever. We love these dogs. We hope we can have one someday."

The park lady smiled and said: "You are very welcome. I hope so too."

Tim and Sam were brothers who liked to fish. They had a big pole that their dad gave them. They went to the lake with their pole and a bucket. They hoped to catch many fish and sell them at the market.

They saw a man with a loud voice and a sign that said "Fish for sale". He had many fish in his cart. He shouted, "Come and buy my fresh fish! They are tasty and cheap!" Tim and Sam wanted to sell their fish like him. They thought he was very smart and rich.

They threw their pole in the water and waited. They waited for a long time, but no fish came. They felt sad and bored. They wondered why the man had so many fish and they had none. They decided to ask him for a tip.

They walked to the man and said, "Hello, sir. We are trying to catch fish and sell them, but we have no luck. Can you tell us your secret?"
