The man looked at them and smiled. He said, "Sure, boys. I'll tell you my secret. I don't catch fish. I buy them from the store and sell them here. It's easier and faster. Do you want to buy some?"

Tim and Sam were shocked and angry. They felt cheated and lied to. They said, "No, thank you. We don't want your fish. You are not smart and rich. You are sneaky and bad. We will catch our own fish with our pole. Goodbye!"

They ran back to their pole and bucket. They hoped to catch a big fish and show the man. They learned a lesson that day. They learned that not everyone is honest and that fishing is hard work. But they also learned that fishing is fun and rewarding. They enjoyed their time at the lake with their pole and their bucket.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went for a walk. She wanted to observe the world around her. She walked to the west, where the sun was going down. Lily was a thoughtful girl, always thinking about what she saw.

As Lily walked, she saw a big tree. Under the tree, there was a little squirrel. The squirrel looked at Lily and said, "Hello, Lily! What are you doing?" Lily smiled and said, "I am going to the west to observe the world."

The squirrel thought for a moment and said, "That sounds fun! Can I come with you?" Lily nodded and together, they walked to the west. They saw many things like birds, flowers, and bugs.

At the end of the day, Lily and the squirrel sat under a tree, watching the sun go down. They were happy and tired from their walk. They had learned a lot from their thoughtful adventure to the west.

Once there was a little human called Kate. She wanted to win something amazing. Every day she practised hard.

One day, Kate felt ready. She put on her special outfit and took a deep breath. She was ready to win something amazing!

Kate went to the big room where the competition was taking place. She was the only human. Everyone cheered for her.

Kate put in lots of effort and ran as fast as she could. In the end, she won! Everyone was so happy for her. She had won something amazing!

Kate was so excited. She went home and celebrated with her family. It was a magical day!

Ben and Mia are twins. They like to play in the living room. One day, they see a big bottle of wine on the table. It is red and shiny. Ben says, "Let's open it and drink it. It looks yummy." Mia says, "No, Ben. That is not for us. That is for Mom and Dad. They will be angry if we touch it." But Ben does not listen. He takes the bottle and tries to open it. He pulls hard and the cork pops out. The wine spills everywhere. It makes a big mess on the table, on the floor, on the couch, and on their clothes.

Mom and Dad hear the noise and come to the living room. They see the wine and the mess. They are very angry. They say, "Ben and Mia, what did you do? This is very bad. You are not supposed to touch the wine. It is not for children. It is for grown-ups. You could get sick or hurt. And you ruined the wine and the living room. How could you be so naughty?" Ben and Mia are scared. They start to cry. They say, "We are sorry, Mom and Dad. We are very sorry. We did not mean to do it. We were just curious. Please do not be mad at us. Please forgive us."

Mom and Dad sigh. They are still angry, but they love Ben and Mia. They say, "We are disappointed in you, Ben and Mia. You should know better. You should listen to each other and to us. You should not touch things that are not yours. You should be careful and respectful. You have to learn from your mistake. You have to help us clean up the mess. And you have to say sorry to each other and to us. Do you understand?" Ben and Mia nod. They say, "We understand, Mom and Dad. We will help you clean up. We will say sorry. We will not do it again. We love you, Mom and Dad." Mom and Dad hug them. They say, "We love you too, Ben and Mia. But please, do not touch the wine again."

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy who loved to play with his toy spears. He would pretend to be a brave warrior and fight off bad guys. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy wanted to play with Timmy's spears, but Timmy didn't want to share because he was afraid Billy would break them.

"I want to play with your spears, Timmy," said Billy.

"No, they're mine," replied Timmy.

Billy felt sad and left to go home. Timmy realized he was being selfish and wanted to make it up to his friend. He ran after Billy and said, "Here, you can play with my spears. I'm sorry I didn't share before."

Billy was happy and they played together successfully. They pretended to be warriors and fought off imaginary bad guys.

After playing for a while, they got thirsty and decided to drink some lemonade. They went to Timmy's house and his mom gave them each a glass. They drank the lemonade and felt refreshed.

From that day on, Timmy learned that sharing is important and it can lead to successful playtime with friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a hot dog stand. He would sell hot dogs to people who were hungry. Timmy loved to cook hot dogs on his grill. He would put ketchup and mustard on the hot dogs for his customers.

One day, it was very hot outside. The sun was shining harshly on Timmy's face. Timmy got very thirsty and needed a drink. He decided to take a break from his hot dog stand and go get a cold drink.

While Timmy was gone, a little girl came up to the hot dog stand. She wanted a hot dog, but Timmy wasn't there. The little girl waited for a while, but Timmy didn't come back. She decided to go find Timmy and tell him that she wanted a hot dog.

When Timmy came back, he saw that the little girl was waiting for him. She told him that she wanted a hot dog. Timmy was happy to sell her a hot dog. He cooked a hot dog for her and put ketchup and mustard on it. The little girl was very happy and ate her hot dog. From that day on, Timmy always made sure to have someone watch his hot dog stand when he needed a break.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and look at the pretty flowers. One day, she saw a charming butterfly fluttering around the garden. She wanted to catch it and keep it as her pet.

Lily chased after the butterfly, but it flew away. She tried again and again, but the butterfly always got away. She felt sad and frustrated. She wanted that butterfly so badly.

Then, she had an idea. She went inside and got a jar with a lid. She went back outside and waited patiently for the butterfly to come back. When it did, she quickly put the jar over it and caught it. She was so happy! She had finally caught the charming butterfly she wanted.

But then, she realized that the butterfly was not happy in the jar. It wanted to fly free in the garden. Lily felt bad for taking it away from its home. So, she opened the jar and let the butterfly go. She learned that sometimes, what we want may not be what is best for others.

Once upon a time, there was a happy reindeer named Rudolph. He had a red nose that shone bright in the dark. Every day, Rudolph would play with his friends in the snow. They would run and jump and have fun.

One day, Rudolph's mom said, "Rudolph, it's time to bathe!" Rudolph didn't want to bathe because he thought it was boring. But his mom said, "You need to be clean so you don't get sick."

So Rudolph went to the river and splashed in the water. He made a loud noise when he jumped in. But after he was done, he felt so fresh and clean. He was happy he listened to his mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine and pick flowers. But one day, Lily's mom told her that there was trouble in the garden. The bugs were eating all the plants and the flowers were starting to die.

Lily felt helpless because she didn't know how to stop the bugs. But then, her mom had an idea. They could get some ladybugs to come and eat the bad bugs. Lily thought that was a great idea!

So, they got some ladybugs and released them in the garden. And guess what? The ladybugs ate all the bad bugs and the plants started to increase in size and become healthy again. Lily was so happy that she could help the garden and make it pretty again.

Sam was very excited to go swimming. He had his swimming trunks on and his towel ready. He grabbed some bubbles and raced to the pool. He was ready to have fun and was hoping to score a lot of points.

But when he got there, the pool was all closed up. He tried the door, but it felt tight and wouldn't budge. Sam was very disappointed. All he wanted to do was to bathe and play.

He went home, feeling anxious about the next day. Would the pool stay closed, he wondered?

The next day, he rushed out of the house to the pool. He gasped in surprise when he saw that the door was open! He quickly ran to the pool and hopped in. He had the best time playing games and twisting and turning in the water. Lastly, he relaxed and enjoyed a nice, warm bubble bath.

He'd been so close to giving up on the pool before, but it was all worth it in the end!

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot was an obedient dog. He liked to play with his friends. One day, he went to play with his friend, the cat. The cat was not nice. The cat poked Spot with her sharp claws.

Spot was sad and hurt. His mom took him to the veterinarian. The veterinarian was a kind man. He looked at Spot and said, "I will make you feel better." Spot was scared but he was a brave dog.

The veterinarian tried to help Spot, but he could not make him feel all better. Spot was still hurt and sad. He went home and lay in his bed. Spot's mom was sad too. They all wished the cat had not poked Spot.

Ben and Mia were friends. They liked to play together in the park. One day, they saw a big pot of soup on a table. It smelled good.

"Can we have some soup?" Ben asked Mia.

"I don't know. Maybe we can borrow some," Mia said.

They looked around. They did not see anyone near the table. They tiptoed to the pot. Ben reached for a spoon. Mia reached for a bowl.

But they were clumsy. They knocked over the pot. The soup spilled everywhere. It was hot and sticky. They screamed.

A lady came running. She was angry. She was the cook. She had made the soup for a picnic.

"Who did this? Who ruined my soup?" she shouted.

Ben and Mia were scared. They ran away. They hid behind a tree.

They felt sorry. They had made a big mess. They had not borrowed the soup. They had stolen it.

They learned a lesson. They should not take things that are not theirs. They should ask first. They should be careful. They should say sorry.

Once upon a time there was an ostrich. His name was Joe. Joe was a very tall bird, but he was also very deaf. He stood at the edge of his barn, unaware of the world and what was going on around him.

One day a wolf came to Joe's barn. The wolf walked up to Joe, and said, "Mr. Ostrich, I heard you can't hear very well. Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?"

Joe shook his head. He was too deaf to hear the wolf, but he knew the wolf was asking something.

The wolf asked, "Do you know where I can find food? I am so very, very hungry." Joe shook his head again, not knowing how to answer.

The wolf became angry. He shouted at Joe, "Why don't you answer me? Can't you hear me? I am very hungry!"

Joe didn't understand what was happening, so he just stood still. Suddenly, a kind fox appeared. The fox smiled at Joe and the wolf, and told the wolf, "It's not very nice to be so loud when speaking to someone. It might make Joe feel scared. Why don't you try being kinder to him?"

The wolf sheepishly nodded, and said, "Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to scare you, Joe."

The fox and the wolf then walked

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Josh. He really loved animals and wanted to become a veterinarian when he grew up.

One day, Josh went to the park with his family. He saw a thick, black cat sitting underneath a tree and he knew he had to choose it! Josh asked his parents if he could take the cat home. His father said that the cat already belonged to someone else and he had to leave it be.

That night, Josh couldn’t get the cat out of his mind. He was worried about it and wanted to make sure it was ok. Josh decided to go back to the park the next day and take the cat to the veterinarian.

The next day, Josh and his parents went back to the park. Sure enough, the cat was still there underneath the tree. Josh’s dad said they couldn’t take the cat home with them, but they could take it to the veterinarian to make sure it was healthy.

With the help of his parents, Josh was able to find the cat a good home afterwards. The moral of the story is that when you choose to do something good and helpful, you can make a big difference in the world.

One day, a little girl named Lily found a big box in her room. The box was blue and had pretty pictures on it. Lily was very happy and wanted to see what was inside the box.

Lily opened the box and found a sweet, small cat inside. The cat was soft and had a long tail. The cat waved its tail and said, "Hello, my name is Kitty. Will you be my friend?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, I will be your friend, Kitty!"

Together, Lily and Kitty played all day. They waved at the birds outside the window and shared sweet treats from the box. When the sun went down, they were both very tired. Lily gave Kitty a big hug and they went to sleep, happy to have found a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to collect shiny things like rocks and beads. One day, she went to the store with her mom and saw a pretty gem in the toy section. It was very shiny and sparkly, but it cost a lot of money.

Lily's mom said it was too expensive, but Lily really wanted it. She asked her mom if there was a cheaper one, and her mom said they could look. They found another gem that was not as shiny, but it was a good number cheaper.

Lily was very happy and took the gem home. She added it to her collection and showed it to all her friends. They thought it was very pretty too. From that day on, Lily knew that sometimes, things can be just as good even if they are not the most expensive.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He loved to explore!

One day, he found a big, deep hole. He looked inside and saw lots of numbers. He got excited and looked around for something to lay in the hole.

He spotted a stick and layed it in the hole. Next, he found a stone and layed that in, too. He put in more and more things - all sorts of shapes and sizes.

When he was finished, he looked inside the deep hole and he was proud. He had made a number game! He was very excited and wanted to play right away. He rolled the dice and moved his pieces around the numbers.

It was so much fun! The little boy played and played until it was time to go home. He said goodbye to his deep, number hole and went inside to eat his dinner.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a boy. He was walking in a very dry jungle. All of a sudden he heard a noise. It was loud and sad. He followed the noise and he found a monkey. The monkey was sad and it was weeping.

The boy said, "Why are you sad?"

The monkey said sadly, "I cannot find water. Everything is so dry here and I am very thirsty. I'm so thirsty that I can't even stop weeping."

The boy was very sad to hear this and he ran and ran to find water for the monkey. Finally, he found some water in a tree and he brought it back to the monkey so it could drink.

The monkey was so happy to finally have some water. It stopped weeping and thanked the boy for helping it.

The boy was glad that he could help the monkey and he walked off happier than before, knowing that the monkey now had some water at last.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to wear her sunglasses everywhere she went. She thought they made her look cool. One day, Lily and her mom were going to the park. Her mom reminded her to bring her sunglasses so she wouldn't get a headache from the sun.

When they got to the park, Lily saw a boy playing with an interesting toy. She asked him if she could play with it too. The boy said yes and they played together for a while.

But then, Lily accidentally broke the toy. The boy got very upset and started crying. Lily felt bad and tried to say sorry, but the boy didn't want to be her friend anymore. Lily felt sad and wished she had never broken the toy.

Lily's mom reminded her that it's important to be careful with other people's things. Lily learned her lesson, but she still felt sad that she lost her new friend.

Mama was tired. She had been washing dishes by hand all day and her hands were getting sore. She wanted to find a better way to do it. Then one day, she saw a big blue box in the store. It was a dishwasher! She bought it and brought it home.

Mama was so excited. She put a bunch of dishes in it, filled it with soapy water, then pushed a button. The dishwasher started to hum and make bubbles. Mama smiled.

When the dishwasher was done, the dishes were very clean and dry. Mama had to put them away. She was so happy. No more washing dishes by hand! From now on, Mama would use the dishwasher to keep her dishes clean and dry.

Tim and Lily were playing in the park. They saw a big hill with a hole in it. They wanted to see what was inside.

"Let's go in the hole," Tim said.

"OK," Lily said.

They crawled into the hole. It was dark and cold. They used a flashlight to look around. They saw a lot of bones. They were scared.

"Are these bones from animals?" Lily asked.

"I don't know," Tim said.

They saw a big bone that looked like a head. It had two holes for eyes and a hole for a mouth. It was a skeleton.

"Ah!" Tim and Lily screamed.

They ran out of the hole. They saw a man sitting on a bench. He had a big hat and a long coat. He was reading a book.

"Help! Help!" Tim and Lily shouted.

The man did not look at them. He did not hear them. He was deaf.

Tim and Lily ran to their mom. She was waiting for them near the swings.

"Mom, mom, we saw a skeleton in the hole!" Tim and Lily said.

"A skeleton?" Mom asked.

"Yes, a skeleton! It was scary!" Tim and Lily said.

Mom hugged them. She smiled.

"Maybe it was a dinosaur skeleton," she said.

"A dinosaur?" Tim and Lily asked.

"Yes, a dinosaur. They lived a long time ago. They had big bones. Some of them were friendly and some of them were not," Mom said.

"Wow," Tim and Lily said.

They looked at the hole. They wondered if the skeleton was a friendly dinosaur or not.

They shrugged. They did not know.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Molly. She was happy and clever. Molly's mum asked her, "What do you want to be when you grow up?". Molly said, "I want to be a superhero!".

Molly's mum smiled and said, "That sounds great. Just remember to always help others and use your superpowers to save people!" Molly was so glad.

Now, there was a big quiz coming up at school soon and Molly wanted to do well. Every day, she practised and studied hard--memorizing the answers and trying to remember them.

Finally, the day of the quiz came. Molly was a little bit scared. But, when she answered the questions, she remembered the answers. She used her superhero strength and saved the quiz!

Molly felt so glad. She raised her hands in the air and said, "Yes, I did it! I saved the quiz and I'm a superhero!" Molly was so proud. From that day forward, she always remembered to use her powers for good.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside and explore the garden. One day, she found a beetle crawling on a leaf. The beetle was small and black, but Lily thought it was cute.

Lily picked up the beetle and brought it inside to show her mom. Her mom smiled and said, "That's a nice beetle, Lily. But remember, we should always let bugs stay outside where they belong."

Lily didn't listen to her mom and kept the beetle in a jar. She even gave it some tasty leaves to eat. But soon, the beetle started to frown and look sad. Lily didn't know why.

One day, Lily woke up and found the beetle had died. She felt very sad and realized that she should have listened to her mom. From that day on, Lily promised to always let bugs stay outside and not keep them as pets.

Today was a very special day for dad. His wonderful little daughter was turning three and he wanted to make it a really special day. So he decided to take her to the park and let her enjoy the sunshine.

“Isn’t it lovely here?” he asked his daughter.

“Yes!” she said, giving a happy smile and looking around.

So they spent the next hour exploring the park, letting her run and play. Dad kept a close eye on her, making sure she didn’t get too close to the pond or the river.

When it was time to go home, dad had a thoughtful idea. He picked some of the prettiest flowers and handed them to her.

“These are for you, my darling. Have a wonderful birthday!”

His daughter beamed with happiness and hugged him tight. “Thank you, daddy!” she said.

Dad was so glad he had been able to give his daughter such a thoughtful gift for her special day.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Joe and Sarah. Joe and Sarah loved to create things. One day, they decided to create a special space. They built walls with brightly coloured blocks and created a window shaped like a star. Then they filled the space with lovely things - bright cushions, sparkly fairy lights and even a friendly fish! It was a very lively space! Joe and Sarah both smiled with joy and danced around in their new space. Whenever they wanted to, they could go there and play together. They had created something so special and so much fun. It made their friendship even stronger. The end.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to help their mom in the garden. They had a big patch of corn that they watered and watched grow every day. They were very excited to eat the corn when it was ready.

One day, mom said, "The corn is ripe! We can pick some for dinner tonight. But we have to be careful and not pull too hard, or we might break the stalks."

Lily and Tom nodded and ran to the corn patch. They each chose a big ear of corn and tried to twist it off gently. Lily managed to get hers off, but Tom struggled. He pulled harder and harder, but the corn did not come off.

"Help me, Lily!" he cried. "I can't get my corn!"

Lily came over and saw that Tom had picked a corn that was still attached to another corn. She said, "You have to find a corn that is alone, Tom. This corn has a friend. See?"

She pointed to the other corn that was hiding behind the leaves. Tom saw it and felt silly. He said, "Oh, I didn't see that. Sorry, corn. I'll find another one."

He let go of the corn and looked for a new one. He found one that was alone and twisted it off easily. He smiled and said, "I did it, Lily! I got my corn!"

Lily smiled back and said, "Good job, Tom! You were patient and you found a good corn. Let's go show mom!"

They ran back to mom with their corn and gave them to her. Mom praised them and said, "You are such good helpers, Lily and Tom. I'm proud of you. Now let's go cook the corn and enjoy it!"

They followed mom to the kitchen and helped her wash and peel the corn. They put them in a big pot of water and waited for them to boil. They could smell the sweet corn and their mouths watered. They were happy and hungry. They couldn't wait to eat the corn they had grown.

Mommy and Daddy were worried. Their navy car was broken. Mommy and Daddy wanted to fix the car so they could drive again.

Mommy and Daddy sent the dark car to the mechanic. He gave it a look and knew just how to fix it. He worked on it all day and night.

Finally, the mechanic was done. He brought the navy car back to Mommy and Daddy. It was as good as new and sparkled in the sun.

Mommy and Daddy were so excited. They could go anywhere in the shiny, navy car. They thanked the mechanic and drove off. They never had to worry about car trouble again!

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy dragon named Dolly. Dolly lived in a big cave near the woods. She liked to take long naps and play with her friends, the birds and the squirrels.

One day, Dolly woke up from her nap and saw a little girl named Lily. Lily was lost in the woods and was looking for her way back home. Dolly wanted to help her new friend. "Lily, follow me. I will take you home," said Dolly.

Lily followed the sleepy dragon as they walked through the woods. They saw many pretty flowers and heard the birds singing. Soon, they found Lily's house. Lily was so happy to be home. She hugged Dolly and said, "Thank you, Dolly!" From that day on, Dolly and Lily were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the woods. One day, he saw a man with a bow and arrow. The man offered to teach Timmy how to shoot the arrow. Timmy was so excited!

The man showed Timmy how to hold the bow and arrow. Timmy pulled back the string and let go. The arrow flew through the air and hit a tree. Timmy was so proud!

After a while, Timmy's arms got tired. The man noticed and offered Timmy a comfortable place to sit. Timmy sat down and rested. He was grateful for the man's kindness.

From that day on, Timmy practiced shooting arrows every day. He became very good at it. And whenever he got tired, he remembered the man who offered him a comfortable place to rest.

Once there was a boy named John. He was three years old and loved to joke. He was always laughing and having fun.

One day it started to rain. The rain was cold and wet. John thought it would be funny to dance in it and he began to twirl and spin around.

His mother saw him and said, "John, the rain is useful. It helps make things grow." John listened and smiled.

The rain stopped soon after, and when it was over, John saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky. He laughed again and said, "Look, mom! A rainbow. We can joke about that."

His mother smiled and said, "Yes, we can! It's so special to see something so beautiful after the rain."

John smiled with joy and ran around the rainbow, laughing and joking again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She loved velvet, and so did her friend Amy. One day Lucy wanted to borrow Amy’s velvet, so she asked her: “Can I borrow your velvet, please?”

Amy said: “Yes! But be careful - it’s very rough.” Lucy was so happy she jumped up and down.

Lucy took the velvet and ran with it to the park. She wrapped the velvet around herself and twirled around and around. She felt so special! Everywhere she went, people stared at her beautiful velvet dress.

At the end of the day, Lucy took the velvet back to Amy. Even though the velvet was a bit rougher than before, Amy was thankful that nothing bad happened to the velvet.

And the friends laughed and hugged, happy that they had such a special day together.

Tom and Lily were playing with their toy cars and trucks in the garden. They liked to make roads and bridges with sticks and stones. They also liked to load and unload their trucks with sand and pebbles.

One day, they found a big white thing in the sand. It was hard and shiny and had a pointy end. "What is this?" Tom asked. "It looks like a tooth," Lily said. "Maybe it is from a dinosaur or a dragon." They decided to keep it and put it in their truck.

They were very happy with their new treasure. They showed it to their mom and dad, who said it was a cow's tooth. They did not believe them. They thought it was much more exciting to pretend it was from a scary animal.

The next day, they wanted to play with their tooth again. But when they looked in their truck, it was gone. They searched everywhere, but they could not find it. They were very sad and angry. "Who took our tooth?" Tom asked. "Maybe it was a thief or a monster," Lily said.

They heard a loud bark from behind the fence. It was their neighbor's dog, Rex. He was big and black and had sharp teeth. He liked to chase and bite things. Tom and Lily were afraid of him. They saw him holding something in his mouth. It was their tooth. He had jumped over the fence and stolen it.

Tom and Lily wanted their tooth back. But they did not know how to get it. They were too scared to go near Rex. They needed a plan. They thought hard. They had an idea. They took their truck and filled it with their favorite treats: cookies, crackers, and cheese. They pushed it slowly towards the fence. They hoped Rex would see it and drop their tooth.

Rex saw the truck and smelled the food. He was hungry and curious. He dropped the tooth and ran towards the truck. He started to eat the treats. Tom and Lily waited for their chance. They ran to the fence and grabbed their tooth. They were very brave. They ran back to their garden and put their tooth in a safe place. They were very happy. They had their tooth back. They had outsmarted Rex. They had a great story to tell.

Lily and Ben are playing in the park. They like to run and jump and slide. They see their shadows on the ground. Their shadows look like them, but they are black and flat.

"Look, Ben, my shadow can match your shadow!" Lily says. She moves her arms and legs to make her shadow look like Ben's shadow.

"That's funny, Lily, but can your shadow match this?" Ben says. He makes a funny face and sticks out his tongue. His shadow does the same.

Lily laughs and tries to match Ben's funny face. They make their shadows do silly things. They have a lot of fun.

Then they see a big dog running towards them. The dog has a lovely brown fur and a wagging tail. The dog also has a big shadow.

"Wow, look at that dog's shadow!" Lily says. "It's so big and long!"

"Let's match the dog's shadow!" Ben says. He gets on all fours and pretends to bark. Lily does the same.

The dog sees them and runs to them. He licks their faces and wags his tail. He likes to play with them.

Lily and Ben are happy. They have a new friend. They play with the dog and his shadow. They have a lovely day.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion who lived in the jungle. He had a loud roar that scared all the animals. One day, he met a little squirrel who was climbing an oak tree. "Hello, little squirrel. Why are you climbing that tree?" asked the lion. "I am looking for acorns to eat," replied the squirrel. "That's unusual. Most animals are afraid of me," said the lion.

The lion and the squirrel became friends and played together every day. But one day, the lion got very hungry and decided to eat the little squirrel. "I'm sorry, my friend. I'm so hungry," said the lion. The squirrel tried to run away, but the lion caught him and ate him for dinner. The other animals in the jungle were very sad and angry when they heard what happened. They all agreed to stay away from the lion and never play with him again. The lion was very lonely and sad because he lost all his friends.

Molly had a very special toy. It was her favourite in the world. But one day, she accidentally dropped it in the river. Molly started to cry.

Her mum saw Molly crying and said, “Don't worry, we'll get it back.”

Mom and Molly went to the riverbank and attached a long, heavy rope to a branch that overhanged the river. They threw the rope in and soon, it got stuck on something at the bottom of the river.

Mom and Molly started to pull on the rope and soon, Molly's special toy appeared! But when Molly took it out of the water, she realised it was too spoiled to play with.

Mom saw Molly's face and knew it was time for something special. She said, “Let's go buy a new one.”

Molly was so happy! She got a new, shiny toy and was ready to play.

Lily and Ben were playing with blocks in the living room. They liked to build towers and bridges and houses with the blocks. Sometimes they shared the blocks, and sometimes they fought over them.

One day, Lily wanted to use a blue block that Ben had in his hand. She asked him, "Can I have that block, please?" But Ben said, "No, it's mine. Go find another one."

Lily felt angry and sad. She wanted the blue block very much. She thought Ben was being mean and selfish. She decided to take the block from him. She reached out her hand and tried to grab the block. But Ben was faster. He moved his hand away and pinched Lily's arm hard.

"Ow!" Lily cried. "That hurts! Why did you pinch me?" She looked at her arm and saw a red mark. It was as big as an inch. She felt more angry and sad.

Ben felt sorry and scared. He did not mean to hurt Lily. He just wanted to keep his block. He thought Lily was being rude and greedy. He said, "I'm sorry, I pinched you because you tried to take my block. It's not nice to take things from others."

Lily and Ben stared at each other. They both felt weird. They did not like to fight. They liked to play. They realized they were both wrong. They said, "I'm sorry" and "It's okay" and hugged each other. Then they decided to share the blocks and build something together. They felt happy and proud. They learned to be kind and fair.

One day, a little boy named Jack was playing in his room. He decided to go and sit on his favourite chest. When he sat down, he noticed something unusual. The chest smelled smelly! Jack had never noticed a smelly smell before and he couldn't work out what it was.

Jack's Mum heard him say 'That chest smells smelly', so she came into his room to see what was happening. When she saw the chest, she knew what was wrong. Jack's little puppy had been using the chest as a bed! His Mum scooped the naughty puppy up in her arms and took him outside.

When the puppy was outside, the smelly smell went away. Jack was so relieved! He sat back down on the chest, and said 'Ahhh, much better!'

Once upon a time, there was a dry, sunny day in a big park. In the park, there was a small girl who was walking around, looking for something.

Suddenly, she noticed a zipper on the ground and smiled. She bent over to pick it up and realized it was heavier than she thought it would be. When she pulled the zipper open, she couldn't believe her eyes. Inside the zipper was a big pile of shiny pennies!

The small girl was so excited she started jumping up and down. A nearby old lady saw her and asked, "What did you find, my dear?" The girl nodded and showed her the zipper filled with pennies.

The old lady smiled at the little girl and said, "Smarts and brave, that is what you have been today. Now, put all these pennies back inside the zipper and you never know what you might find again."

The girl nodded and put all the pennies back in the zipper, zipping it shut. She looked around but couldn't see anything else.

Then, after a few seconds, the old lady nodded and said, "If you look around you, you might find that something dry and sunny is coming your way."

The girl looked around and, sure enough, there were two big ice cream cones with two big scoops of ice cream in them! The small girl smiled with delight and quickly picked up her prize.

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Fred and Jen. They liked to play together. Today, they decided to do something special.

Fred said to Jen,"Let us go and watch the train!" Jen was very excited and said, "Yes!"

So, off they went to the train station. When they got there, they saw a big and successful train arriving. They watched it from far away and it was so amazing.

Suddenly, Jen said, "Let's do something different. How about we go to the park and play hide and seek?"

Fred agreed, and they went to the park. Both of them had lots of fun. They ran around, laughed and had a successful time.

At the end of the day, Fred and Jen were really happy. That was their best day ever!

Tom and Lily like to write. They write with crayons on paper. They write their names, and draw pictures of animals and flowers. They write letters to their friends and family.

One day, they go to the park with their mom. They see a big hill with a hole in it. Mom says it is a cave. Tom and Lily want to see the cave. They ask mom if they can go inside. Mom says yes, but be careful.

Tom and Lily take their crayons and paper and go into the cave. It is dark and cold. They use a flashlight to see. They see rocks and dirt and bugs. They write on the walls of the cave. They write "Tom and Lily were here". They draw a sun and a moon and a star.

They hear a growl. They are scared. They see a big bear. The bear is hungry. The bear sees Tom and Lily. The bear wants to eat them.

Tom and Lily run out of the cave. They scream for mom. Mom hears them and comes to help. She sees the bear and scares it away. She hugs Tom and Lily and says they are brave. She says they should not go into caves without her.

Tom and Lily are sorry. They say they are sorry to mom and to the bear. They say they will not go into caves again. They go home and show mom what they wrote. Mom says they are good at writing. She says they can write more at home, but not on the walls. Tom and Lily agree. They write on paper and have fun. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a mom and her daughter. The daughter was very obedient and was always kind to everybody.

One day, the mom asked her daughter, "Would you like to go for a picnic today?"

The daughter was very excited, "Yes mommy!"

They spent the day together, playing games and laughing. When they were nearly done, the mom decided to spoil her daughter: "Let's have a victory picnic!"

The daughter was so happy. She said, "Yes please, mommy!"

So the mom packed their food and they ate until they were full. The daughter was so happy that her mom had spoiled her with a victory picnic. They both returned home with smiles on their faces.

The End.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play outside. But today it is raining. They are sad.

"Can we go out?" Anna asks her mom.

"No, it is wet and cold. You will get sick," mom says.

Anna and Ben look at the window. They see a big puddle. They want to jump in it.

"Look, mom, an umbrella!" Ben says. He points to a closet. He sees a colorful umbrella. It has red, yellow, blue and green stripes.

"Can we use it?" Anna asks.

Mom thinks. She smiles. "OK, but only for a little while. And stay close to the house," she says.

Anna and Ben are happy. They take the umbrella and run outside. They open it and hold it together. They feel cozy and dry.

They go to the puddle. They jump in it. They make a big splash. They laugh.

They see a worm. It is brown and slimy. It wriggles in the water.

"Hello, worm!" Anna says.

"Yuck, worm!" Ben says.

They hear a noise. It is a bird. It is black and white. It has a long beak. It flies to the puddle. It sees the worm.

"Uh-oh, worm!" Anna says.

"Run, worm!" Ben says.

The bird swoops down. It grabs the worm. It flies away.

Anna and Ben are shocked. They feel sorry for the worm.

They look at each other. They hug the umbrella. They go back to the house.

They tell mom what they saw. Mom hugs them. She says they are brave and kind.

They are warm and happy. They love the colorful umbrella. It is their friend.

Once upon a time, there was a blue bird who wanted to go on a big adventure. Each morning he got up early, facing the sunny sky and he was determined, he was going to be successful in his quest.

"Where should I go first?" he thought to himself. As he looked around, he noticed a rabbit hopping by.

The bird shouted, "Excuse me, dear rabbit, could you tell me where to go?"

The rabbit stopped and replied, "Yes! Why don't you go to the park?". The bird was so excited and happily shouted back, "Yes, I will go to the park!"

The blue bird flew over to the park, flapping his wings in the sunlight. As he landed in the park, he felt the grass beneath him and even saw a few other animals there. He had a wonderful time playing and exploring the park, learning about its hidden gems.

After a long day, the blue bird flew away feeling proud and successful. He had gone on an amazing adventure and he would never forget it.

Once there was a boy named Ben who was really excited because he had a new bicycle. He wanted to show everyone how much fun he could have with it. So Ben decided to go to the park with his bicycle.

When he arrived, there was a fat lady at the park. She asked him, "What do you have there?"

Ben smiled and said, "This is my new bicycle."

The fat lady said, "Oh, it looks like so much fun! Can I guess what color it is?"

Ben was so surprised by the lady's question. "Yes, you can. But it's not an easy one. What do you guess?" he asked.

The fat lady laughed and said, "I think it's blue."

Ben smiled, "You guessed it! It is blue! Would you like to go for a ride with me?"

The fat lady was thrilled and said yes. So, Ben and the fat lady went for a ride on his blue bicycle. They had a great time and laughed a lot along the way.

Once upon a time, there was a whale. He was happy and he liked to swim in the sea. One day, he wanted to go for a very long swim. He asked the other sea creatures if he could borrow a boat. They said yes and gave him a boat. The whale was so happy, he thanked the sea creatures and got in the boat. He sat in the boat and paddled away. He paddled so far and so fast, he ended up in a different ocean. It was so beautiful there. He was still happy and went for a long swim. He had lots of fun and when he was ready to go back home, he paddled back in the boat. When he got back home he thanked the sea creatures again and gave the boat back to them. The sea creatures were happy to have their boat back. Then everyone was happy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mommy in the kitchen. One day, they were making cookies together. Lily's mommy asked her to get a teaspoon from the drawer. Lily was so excited to help that she accidentally spilled all the teaspoons on the floor.

Lily's mommy didn't get mad, but she did order Lily to pick them all up. Lily knew it was her job to help clean up the mess. She picked up all the teaspoons and put them back in the drawer.

Later that day, Lily's mommy had some friends over for tea. Lily wanted to help pour the tea, but she was too little. She watched as her mommy poured the tea and handed out the cookies they had made earlier. Suddenly, Lily realized she forgot to wash her hands! She was so embarrassed that she ran to the bathroom to wash them.

From then on, Lily knew that it was important to listen to her mommy's orders and to always wash her hands before serving tea.

Once upon a time, there was a smart little fox. The fox lived in a big forest. One day, the fox saw a flame. The flame was near a small house.

The fox knew that the flame could burn the house. So, the fox ran to the house. He saw a little girl inside. The fox said, "Little girl, there is a flame outside. It can burn your house. We must put it out."

The little girl listened to the smart fox. They worked together to put out the flame. The house did not burn. The little girl said, "Thank you, smart fox. You saved my house."

From that day on, the smart fox and the little girl were best friends. They played and had fun in the big forest every day.

There was once a little girl named Susie who loved to play outside. One day, she decided to explore the garden in her backyard. She walked around and saw many things, including some radishes! Susie knew radishes were vegetables, but she had never seen one before. She was very curious and decided to try one.

Happily, Susie managed to pick a radish and bring it to her mom. Her mom said that radishes are actually quite tasty and encouraged Susie to try one. Susie agreed. She bit into the radish, and was surprised by how sweet it was! She finished the radish and was feeling lucky.

Unfortunately, her luck didn't last. Later that night, Susie suddenly felt very itchy. She told her mom, who then realized what had happened. Susie was allergic to radishes! Fortunately, they were able to manage Susie's allergies and she recovered quickly.

From then on, Susie was extra careful when exploring outside. She never ate anything without checking with her mom first! Though she was never able to eat radishes again, Susie became wiser and was very lucky to have managed the situation without major complications.

Tom and Mia were friends who liked to play near the lake. One day, they saw a boat on the water. It was big and white and had many windows. They wondered who was inside the boat.

"Let's go and see!" Tom said. He ran to the shore and waved at the boat. Mia followed him, but she was a little scared.

"Hello!" Tom shouted. "Can we come on your boat?"

A man came out of the boat. He had a long beard and a hat. He smiled at Tom and Mia.

"Hello, little ones!" he said. "Do you want to see my boat? It is very special. It can glow in the dark!"

Tom and Mia were curious. They nodded and climbed on the boat. The man showed them around. He had a kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom and a living room. He also had a lot of books and toys.

"Wow!" Tom said. "This is amazing! How does your boat glow?"

The man winked at him. He said, "It is a secret. But I will show you tonight. Do you want to stay for dinner? I have some delicious soup and bread."

Tom and Mia looked at each other. They were hungry and the soup smelled good. They said, "Yes, please!"

They ate the soup and bread with the man. He told them stories about his travels and adventures. He was very kind and funny. Tom and Mia liked him a lot.

When it was dark, the man said, "Now, watch this!" He pressed a button and the boat started to glow. It was blue and green and purple. It looked like a rainbow on the water.

Tom and Mia gasped. They said, "Wow! This is beautiful! How do you do that?"

The man said, "It is magic. I have a special machine that makes the boat glow. It is powered by the stars. Do you like it?"

Tom and Mia said, "We love it! Thank you for showing us your boat. You are the best!"

The man said, "You are very welcome. You are the best, too. Do you want to sleep on my boat tonight? I have a spare bed and a blanket."

Tom and Mia said, "Yes, please!"

They snuggled in the bed and watched the boat glow. They felt happy and safe. They said, "Good night, Mr. Boatman. Thank you for everything."

The man said, "Good night, Tom and Mia. Thank you for being my friends."

Once there was a 3 year old boy named Jack. Every day, Jack liked to help his Mom in the kitchen. Today, Jack wanted to bake something special for his Mom for her birthday.

In the kitchen, Jack found some flour and sugar and other ingredients he needed. He mixed them together in a big bowl. Then, he started to stir the mixture. He stirred it round and round until it was thick and creamy.

After he was done stirring the mixture, Jack put it in the oven. He set the oven to the right temperature and waited for it to finish baking.

When the baking was done, Jack could smell the delicious aroma coming from his cake. He carefully took Take it out of the oven, and saw that it was a perfect fit. He let it cool down.

Once it was finally cooled down, Jack added some decorations. He put a beautiful flower on the top of the cake. He also put some icing on the top and sides of the cake.

Finally, Jack put the cake on a comfortable chair next to his Mom's bed. He put his heel right next to the cake so she could see it when she woke up!

Jack was very proud of his special cake. He could not wait to see his Mom's reaction when she saw the cake.

Once upon a time, there was a clown named Bobo. Bobo lived in a small town. He was a poor clown, but he liked to make kids laugh. One day, Bobo saw a big circus in the town. He wanted to join the circus, but he knew he must behave well.

Bobo went to the circus boss and said, "Please let me join your circus. I am a good clown and I can behave." The circus boss looked at Bobo and said, "Okay, but you must listen and do what I say." Bobo was so happy and said, "Yes, I will behave well."

The next day, Bobo started to work in the circus. But he did not behave. He played tricks on the other clowns and made them fall. The kids laughed, but the other clowns and the circus boss were mad. The circus boss warned Bobo, "If you do not behave, you cannot stay in the circus."

Bobo did not listen. He thought his tricks were funny. One day, he played a trick on the circus boss. The boss fell and got hurt. The other clowns and the kids did not laugh. They were sad and scared.

The circus boss said, "Bobo, you did not behave. You must leave the circus now." Bobo was sad and had to leave. He walked away from the circus, still a poor clown.

Once upon a time there was a mighty giant. Every day, the giant used to make soup for all his friends. One day, as he was making the soup, he asked them if they wanted to try it. But everyone refused to try the soup. The giant was so sad and angry that he stomped his foot. The ground shook and soup spilled everywhere!

The giant yelled and asked them why they refused to try his soup. One of his friends said that it was too yucky. Disappointed, the giant said he would make a better soup the next day.

The next day, the giant made a mighty soup. He asked his friends if they would like to try it. This time, everyone agreed and tried the soup. They all enjoyed it. The giant was so happy that he made a big party for all his friends.

And that's how the giant learnt that even the mighty can be refused!

Tom and Lily were best friends. They liked to play in the park every day. One day, they saw a big hill in the park. They had never seen it before. They wanted to climb it and see what was on top.

"Let's go, Lily!" Tom said. "Maybe we can find a treasure or a castle!"

"OK, Tom!" Lily said. "But we have to be careful. Maybe there is a giant on the hill. He might be angry if we disturb him."

Tom and Lily did not think there was a giant on the hill. They thought Lily was being silly. They ran to the hill and started to climb. They had a lot of fun. They saw flowers and birds and rocks. They did not see any treasure or castle.

When they reached the top, they were very happy. They looked around and saw the whole park. They also saw something else. It was a huge foot. It was bigger than a car. It was attached to a leg. The leg was attached to a body. The body was attached to a head. The head had eyes and a mouth and a nose. It was a giant!

The giant was sleeping on the other side of the hill. He did not hear Tom and Lily. But he smelled them. He opened his eyes and saw them. He was not happy. He was hungry.

"Who are you?" the giant roared. "What are you doing on my hill?"

Tom and Lily were very scared. They did not know what to do. They wished they had listened to Lily. They wished they had not climbed the hill. They wished they had a plan.

Tom was an ordinary girl who loved walking near the lake. Every day, she would visit the lake and admire the beautiful surroundings. However, one day something was different. There was a thick fog that had settled over the lake. Tom hated the fog because it blocked her view of the lake. She tried her best to stay positive, but the fog would not clear.

Eventually, Tom got so frustrated with the fog that she decided to go home. As she walked away she could still hear the fog whispering in the trees. The fog was so thick and sticky that it felt like a large, dark cloud was following her home. Nothing she did could make the fog go away.

Tom felt angry and defeated. She wished the fog would go away and let her return to the lake. But it was all no use - the fog would never let her go. From then on, she decided to stay away from the lake and instead focus on ordinary things. She hated the fog and all the sadness it brought.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to parties with her friends. One night, she went to a party in a big, dark forest. She was scared, but her friends held her hand and they walked together. When they got to the party, they saw a big cake with lots of candles. Lily's friend asked her to kneel down and blow out the candles. She closed her eyes and made a wish. Suddenly, the forest lit up with bright lights and happy music. Lily had the best time ever at the party in the dark forest.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to joke and play. One day, they went with their mom and dad to the park. There was a big trail that went through the trees and flowers. Mom and dad said they could walk on the trail, but they had to stay close and not run away.

Tom and Lily nodded, but they were stubborn. They wanted to have fun and see new things. They saw a squirrel, a butterfly, and a pond. They ran after them, leaving the trail. They did not hear mom and dad calling them.

Soon, they were lost. They looked around and saw only bushes and rocks. They did not see the trail or their parents. They felt scared and sorry. They hugged each other and cried.

"Tom, Lily, where are you?" They heard a voice. It was dad. He had followed their footprints and found them. He was worried and angry, but also happy to see them. He picked them up and carried them back to the trail.

"Tom, Lily, you were very naughty. You did not listen to us. You could have been hurt or lost. You made us very sad and scared. Why did you do that?" Dad asked.

Tom and Lily sniffed and said, "We are sorry, dad. We wanted to joke and play. We did not mean to run away. We love you, dad. Please don't be mad."

Dad hugged them and said, "I love you too, Tom and Lily. But you have to be careful and obey us. Joking and playing are good, but not when they are dangerous or rude. Do you understand?"

Tom and Lily nodded and said, "Yes, dad. We understand. We will be good and stay on the trail. Can we still joke and play with you?"

Dad smiled and said, "Of course, you can. But only when it is safe and nice. Now, let's go and find mom. She is waiting for us with a picnic. And maybe a joke or two."

Once upon a time there was a little bird who wanted to escape. He lived in a tiny nest high up in an old tree. Every day he would gaze out of his nest and watch the children who were playing happily far below. He wanted to be down there too, but he was afraid. He knew it was too dangerous. So, he had a dream. He dreamed of flying away from his little nest, free and safe.

One day, courage filled the little bird's heart and he took a chance and flew away. All around him the wind was whistling. He had never felt so free. The scenery rushing past him was beautiful. On and on he flew until he could go no further. But he was not afraid. He was proud. Proud of himself for being so brave and escaping from his little nest.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big blue ball. The blue ball liked to travel. It would roll, and roll, and roll. One day, it rolled into a big field. The field was full of pretty flowers and soft grass.

In the field, the blue ball met a little red ball. The red ball liked to travel too. They became friends and played together in the field. They would roll, and jump, and bounce all day long.

As the sun went down, the two balls said goodbye. The blue ball and the red ball promised to meet again in the field. They knew they would have more fun days of travel and play together. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a slow turtle named Timmy. Timmy loved to walk around and explore the world. One day, Timmy accidentally stepped on his friend's toe. His friend cried and Timmy felt bad. Timmy said sorry and hoped his friend would forgive him.

But his friend didn't forgive him. His friend was very mad and didn't want to be friends anymore. Timmy felt sad and didn't know what to do. He tried to say sorry again, but his friend wouldn't listen.

Timmy realized that he made a big mistake and wished he could turn back time. He learned that it's important to be careful and to always ask for forgiveness when you hurt someone. Sadly, Timmy lost his friend and was alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big shelf in her room where she kept all her toys. One day, Lily wanted to rearrange her toys on the shelf. She thought it would look pretty if she put all the dolls together and all the cars together.

Lily picked up each toy and looked at it. She thought about where it would look the most attractive on the shelf. She put the dolls on one side and the cars on the other. When she was done, she stepped back to look at her work. She thought it looked great!

From that day on, Lily always kept her toys organized on the shelf. She liked how it looked and thought it was much easier to find her favorite toys.

Once there was a pink flute. The flute belonged to a little girl named Amy. She always played the flute outside in the sunshine.

One day, when Amy was playing the flute, the sky suddenly became dark. A cold wind was blowing and Amy felt the air get colder and colder. She knew it was time to go inside.

Amy quickly put away the pink flute and ran inside the house. When she got inside, Amy saw snowflakes falling from the sky. Everything outside had frozen!

Amy was so excited to see snow that she took the pink flute and ran outside again. She showed her friends the snow and the froze tree branches. They laughed and played for hours in the snow.

Amy kept her pink flute close by so she could play it in the snow. They had lots of fun and Amy was very happy. She knew that this would be a winter she would never forget.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was just three years old and she loved to play outside with her friends.

One day, Lucy's Mum said to her: "Lucy, it's time to go inside and put your dress on". But Lucy wanted to keep playing. She heard her Mum, but she was too busy playing to listen, so she ran off and kept playing.

Soon, it started raining and Lucy ran back to the house. Her Mum saw her and said: "See, I told you to put your dress on. Now you are all wet and it's very silly". Lucy didn't mean to be foolish, she just wanted to keep playing - but she knew that she had to listen to her Mum at all times.

So Lucy put on her dress and had a warm cup of milk before bedtime. From then on she remembered to always listen to her Mum, no matter how much she wanted to keep playing.

One night, a little boy looked up to the sky and saw a big, round moon. It was so beautiful! The little boy was amazed. He saw the moon use its beautiful light to spread across the night sky.

The little boy kept looking up at the moon until he noticed a tiny sparkle in the sky. He was so excited! He asked his mom what it was. She told him it was a star which made the little boy very happy.

The little boy wanted to get closer to the moon and star, so he asked his mom if he could fly to it.

His mom said, "Maybe someday you will be able to. But you need to be very wealthy and own a spaceship to fly that high up."

The little boy was disappointed but he kept looking up to the moon and the star. He was so excited to see it this close. He promised himself that he would work hard to one day be wealthy so he could use a spaceship to fly to the moon and to the stars.

Once, there was a cold robot. He lived in a small house. The robot felt sad because he was always cold. He wanted to be warm and happy like his friends.

One day, a little girl named Sue came to the robot's house. Sue saw the cold robot and wanted to help. She had an idea to make the robot warm. Sue went to her house to bring something for the robot.

Sue came back with a big, warm blanket. She put the blanket on the cold robot. The robot started to feel warm and happy. The robot and Sue became best friends. They played and laughed together every day. The robot was not cold anymore, and he was very thankful for his new friend Sue.

Once upon a time, there was a family. Inside this family, there was three children. They were very successful at everything they did.

One day, the family went out to the park to play together. It was sunny and fun. The three children ran around and laughed and had a wonderful time.

But then, one of the children slipped and fell. The others ran over to help. They were all very worried. But luckily, the child wasn't hurt and only got a few bumps and bruises.

After that, the child was extra careful. Everyone in the family was extra careful to make sure no one else would fall again.

The family had a great day together, and the children were happy to be safe and successful.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play at the park. They both loved the swing, but there was only one swing. They took turns to push each other and have fun.

One day, a big boy came to the park. He saw the swing and wanted to use it. He did not ask Lily and Ben, he just pushed them away and jumped on the swing. He swung very high and laughed.

Lily and Ben were sad and angry. They wanted their swing back. They waited for the big boy to finish, but he did not. He kept swinging and swinging.

"Hey, that's our swing!" Lily shouted. "We were here first!"

"Too bad, I'm bigger than you!" the big boy said. "Go away!"

Lily and Ben did not go away. They were alert and brave. They had a plan. They waited for the right moment, when the big boy was swinging back. Then they ran to the swing and grabbed the ropes. They pulled hard and made the big boy stop.

"Let go of me!" the big boy yelled. "You're mean!"

"No, you're mean!" Ben said. "You took our swing without asking!"

Lily and Ben did not let go. They made the big boy get off the swing. They got on the swing together and smiled.

"We did it!" Lily said. "We got our swing back!"

They pushed each other and had fun. The big boy left the park. He learned a lesson. Lily and Ben were happy. They were good friends. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Bubbles. Bubbles was swimming in the big blue ocean with his friends. They were playing a game of tag and having lots of fun. Suddenly, Bubbles saw a shiny hook in the water. He knew that it was dangerous, so he quickly swam away.

Bubbles warned his friends about the hook and they all decided to stay away from it. They continued to play their game of tag and were very happy. After a while, they got tired and decided to finish their game. Bubbles was the winner and he felt very proud of himself.

As they were swimming back to their homes, Bubbles remembered the hook. He knew that other fish might not be as careful as they were. So, he decided to go back and warn all the other fish about the hook. Bubbles felt happy knowing that he was helping to keep his friends safe.

Once there was a little girl who had a jeep. She loved taking it for rides. One day the little girl pointed to a flower growing beside the road. She wanted to stop and pick it, but her jeep wouldn't slow down. Suddenly she saw a policeman running toward the jeep.

The girl felt scared and guilty. She expected the policeman to be mad at her. But instead, the policeman just pointed toward a sign on the side of the road.

It said 'No Stopping'. The girl had forgotten to look for the sign. She was so relieved that the policeman wasn't mad at her, and she learned an important lesson.

From then on, the little girl always remembered to look for signs when she was driving in her jeep.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat pie, especially apple pie. One day, her mom made a big apple pie and put it on the table. Lily was so happy and said, "Yummy pie!"

But then, Lily got bored. She asked her mom, "What can I do now?" Her mom said, "Why don't you rub my shoulders? It feels good." So Lily rubbed her mom's shoulders and her mom said, "That feels nice."

After a while, Lily got tired of rubbing her mom's shoulders. She said, "I want to eat pie again." Her mom said, "Okay, let's have some pie together." So they both ate pie and were happy again. The end.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a girl named Lily. She had a unique idea. She wanted to marry a frog. Everyone in the town laughed at her idea, but she didn't care. She knew it was a good idea.

One day, Lily found a big green frog near the pond. She asked the frog if it wanted to marry her. The frog said yes. They planned a big party for their wedding. Everyone in the town was excited to see the unique wedding. They knew it would be a special day.

On the day of the wedding, the sun was shining bright. Lily and the frog stood in front of their friends and family. They said their "I dos" and kissed. Suddenly, the frog turned into a handsome prince! The town gasped in surprise. The prince told everyone that he was under a spell, and only a unique person with a special idea could break it. Lily and the prince lived happily ever after, and everyone in the town learned that having unique ideas could lead to amazing things.

Lily loved animals. She wanted to be a veterinarian when she grew up. She liked to help her mom take care of their dog, Max. Max was old and weak. He had a bad cough and could not run or play.

One day, Lily and her mom took Max to the veterinarian. The veterinarian was a nice lady who wore a white coat and a stethoscope. She listened to Max's heart and lungs. She gave him some medicine and a treat.

"Max is very sick," the veterinarian said. "He needs a lot of rest and love. You are a good girl, Lily. You can help him feel better by giving him water and cuddles."

Lily nodded. She hugged Max and said, "I love you, Max. You are my best friend. I will take good care of you."

The veterinarian smiled. She said, "You are very kind, Lily. You have a bright future. You will be a great veterinarian someday. You have a shine in your eyes that shows your passion for animals."

Lily felt happy and proud. She thanked the veterinarian and went home with her mom and Max. She hoped that Max would get well soon. She dreamed of being a veterinarian and helping more animals. She knew that she had a shine in her heart that no one could take away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the festival with her family. They would eat yummy food and play games.

One day, Lily's mom asked her to help store some toys in the closet. It was tough work, but Lily was happy to help.

After they finished storing the toys, they went to the festival. Lily had so much fun playing games and eating cotton candy. She was very tired when they got back home, but she was happy because she had helped her mom and had a great time at the festival.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys, especially her dolls. One day, Lily's mom took her to the park to play. Lily was so happy to be outside and play on the swings.

Suddenly, a gust of wind came and scattered all of Lily's toys everywhere. Lily started crying because she didn't want to lose her toys. Her mom told her not to worry and they started picking up the toys together.

Lily's mom noticed that one of the dolls had a loose arm. She told Lily that they needed to tie the arm back on so the doll could be fixed. Lily was happy to see her doll fixed and hugged it tightly. "Thank you, Mommy!" she said.

After they finished picking up the toys, Lily's mom took her to a store to buy a new toy. Lily saw a cheap toy that she really liked and asked her mom if she could have it. Her mom said yes and Lily was so happy to have a new toy to play with.

John and his mom were walking in the park. John saw a wild bird and he got very excited. He pointed to the bird and said "Look Mommy, look!" His mother smiled and said "That's lovely, isn't it?" John had never seen anything this wild before and he wanted to get a closer look. He started to walk over to the bird but his mom stopped him. "No John, we shouldn't disturb the bird," she said. John felt a little disappointed.

John and his mom kept walking. Soon they came to a playground. There were children playing and they were having lots of fun. John wanted to join them, but his mom said they should go home.

John started to walk home but then he noticed something. A man was working in a nearby garden. He was digging and planting and he was working very hard. John started to watch him. Then he realized something. The man was having fun too. He was enjoying his work and having a great time.

John was so surprised. He smiled and turned to his mom. Now he knew that work could be fun too. It didn't have to be boring. He was so excited to share this new discovery with his mom. He couldn't wait to explain it all to her!

Once upon a time, there was a town. One day the townspeople saw something spin in the sky. It went faster and faster, faster than anything they had ever seen. It was a tornado! The tornado spun through the town, destroying everything in its path. The people ran out of their homes, as they were fragile and couldn't stand up to the tornado.

The tornado spun faster and faster around the town, getting bigger and bigger. Suddenly, the tornado became too big and it couldn't fit anymore in the town. Everyone was relieved and the the tornado disappeared.

The townspeople worked together and managed to repair the damage caused by the tornado. After that, the town was peaceful and never saw a tornado again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She had a brave spirit and wanted to do something amazing. She found a nice rug and knew it would be perfect for her great adventure.

She turned the rug into a magical carpet and started to fly high in the air. She flew over the city, up high and far away. As she flew, she felt so brave and free.

Then she saw a mountain in the distance. She flew over to it and noticed a cave. She was intrigued and decided to go inside. It was dark, but she was brave and lit up a fire spell to help light the way.

She explored the cave, and found a lot of shiny coins. She was sure she had stumbled upon a secret treasure! She piled up all the coins, jumped on to her magical rug, and flew back home with her stash of treasure.

The little girl had done something truly brave and magical. She had an amazing adventure and a rug full of treasure to show for it!

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a new girl on the swings. She has long hair and a big smile.

"Who is she?" Anna asks Ben.

"I don't know. Let's go and say hello," Ben says.

They run to the swings and introduce themselves. The new girl says her name is Lily. She is from another town. She is here to visit her grandma.

"Do you want to play with us?" Anna asks Lily.

"Yes, please!" Lily says.

They play on the swings, the slide and the seesaw. They have a lot of fun. Then, they see a man with a cart. He is selling ice cream.

"Can we have some ice cream, please?" they ask their moms.

"OK, but only one scoop each," their moms say.

They go to the cart and choose their flavors. Anna picks chocolate, Ben picks vanilla and Lily picks strawberry. The man gives them their ice cream in cones.

"Thank you!" they say.

They lick their ice cream and enjoy the cold and sweet taste. But then, something funny happens. Lily's ice cream starts to fizz and pop. It makes loud noises and sprays pink powder everywhere.

"What is that?" Anna and Ben ask.

"It's crazy ice cream!" Lily says. "It's my favorite. It makes bubbles and sparks. It's fun!"

Anna and Ben are surprised. They have never seen ice cream like that. They think it looks silly and messy. But they also think it looks fun. They laugh and try some of Lily's ice cream. It tickles their tongues and noses. They make funny faces and noises.

Their moms see them and shake their heads. They think they are crazy too. But they also smile and take pictures. They are happy to see their kids having fun and making new friends.

Once there was a man. His name was Mr. Rich. He had a big nose and it was very crooked. He felt very sad about his nose so he decided to repair it. He went to the doctor. The doctor gave him a big shot and then he came back the next week. The doctor carefully adjusted the shape of his nose with his hands. Then the doctor looked at Mr. Rich and said, "Your nose looks perfect now". Mr. Rich was so happy. He thanked the doctor and went on his way with a much straighter nose. He was very happy and he felt much richer.

Tom and Lily were friends. They liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big slide. Lily wanted to try it, but Tom was scared.

"Come on, Tom, it will be fun!" Lily said. "I will go first and show you. It is not high or fast."

"OK, Lily, but be careful," Tom said. He watched Lily climb the stairs and sit on the slide. She smiled and waved at him.

Lily slid down the slide. She felt the wind in her hair and the sun on her face. She was happy. She reached the end of the slide and landed on the grass. She looked up and saw Tom.

"See, Tom, it was fine!" Lily said. "Now you try it. I will wait for you here."

Tom was still scared, but he wanted to be brave like Lily. He climbed the stairs and sat on the slide. He held his waist with his hands and closed his eyes. He pushed himself down the slide.

Tom slid down the slide. He felt the slide go up and down and twist and turn. He was not happy. He opened his eyes and saw a big tree in front of him. He screamed.

Tom hit the tree with his head. He felt a lot of pain and blood. He fell off the slide and lay on the grass. He did not move or talk.

Lily ran to Tom and saw his head. She cried and called for help. But no one came. Tom and Lily were alone in the park. The slide was not fine. It was bad.

Sam the cat was walking down the street. He loved the big city and kept exploring every day. Suddenly, he heard a voice from a nearby bench. It was an elderly lady.

The lady said, "Where are you going, kitty?"

Sam stopped and looked at the elderly lady. He said, "I am going to explore the city, I love it here!"

The elderly lady replied, "That's wonderful. Would you like to come and sit with me for a while?"

Sam hesitated for a moment and then said, "Yes, I would love to."

The elderly lady moved over and Sam hopped up onto the bench. They talked about the city and new places they could go together.

Sam stayed with the elderly lady until the sun set. When it was time to go, the elderly lady smiled and said, "Come back and visit next time!"

Sam said goodbye and waved as he trotted off, thinking about his next adventure.

Lily and Tom are twins. They like to play outside in the sun. One day, they see a big hill near their house. They want to climb the hill and see what is on the other side.

"Let's go, Tom!" Lily says. "Maybe we can find something fun!"

"OK, Lily!" Tom says. "But we have to be careful. The hill is high and steep."

They hold hands and start to walk up the hill. They see green grass, yellow flowers and red bugs. They hear birds singing and wind blowing. They feel happy and healthy.

They reach the top of the hill and look around. They see their house and their mom waving at them. They see a blue lake and a white boat. They see a big tree and a brown dog. They see a lot of things they have never seen before.

"Wow, Lily!" Tom says. "Look at that! It is the west!"

"What is the west, Tom?" Lily asks.

"The west is where the sun goes to sleep," Tom says. "It is very pretty and bright."

"I like the west, Tom," Lily says. "But I like our home more. Can we go back now?"

"Yes, Lily," Tom says. "Let's go back. Mom will be happy to see us."

They hold hands and walk down the hill. They smile and laugh. They have had a good adventure.

Once upon a time, in a big park, there was a red ball. The red ball loved to bounce high in the sky. One sunny day, the red ball met a little boy named Tim. Tim liked the red ball, and they became good friends.

Tim and the red ball played near a big tree. Tim threw the red ball up in the air, and it would bounce back down. The red ball would say, "Wee! I love to bounce!" Tim would laugh and clap his hands, watching the red ball bounce high and low.

One day, when Tim threw the red ball up, it got stuck in the tree. Tim looked up and said, "Oh no! My red ball is stuck!" The red ball was sad, but it had an idea. It wiggled and jiggled until it could bounce off a branch. The red ball bounced down to Tim, and they were happy again. They played together near the tree and had lots of fun.

Charlie the cat was feeling very sleepy. He needed to get some exercise, so he put on his trainers and decided to go for a jog. He jogged down the street, feeling the sunshine on his fur. He then spotted a big puddle, but he wanted to stay dry. So he hopped and skipped over it, and continued his jog.

Next, Charlie decided to visit his friend, the vet. He pushed open the door and saw all sorts of animals. He was curious to know what was going on, so he stood still and watched. One of the cats was having an x-ray. The vet was very quiet as he examined the x-ray.

Charlie continued his jog, feeling refreshed and energetic after his visit. He ran down his street and waved to all his neighbours. He eventually made it back home and hopped into bed. He was tired after his special jog, so he went to sleep with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, Lily went for a walk with her mommy. Suddenly, they saw a lot of fog. Lily was scared because she couldn't see anything.

"Mommy, I'm scared," said Lily.

"It's okay, Lily. We're here together," said her mommy.

Then, Lily's mommy gave her a big hug. Lily felt better and wasn't scared anymore. They continued their walk in the fog and saw a beautiful rainbow. Lily was so happy and hugged her mommy again.

"I love you, mommy," said Lily.

"I love you too, my sweet girl," said her mommy.

From that day on, Lily wasn't scared of the fog anymore because she knew her mommy would always be there to hug her and keep her safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One day, her mom asked her to clean up her toys and put them away. Lily didn't want to do it because she was having so much fun playing.

But then, her mom explained to her that it was important to take care of her toys so that they would last a long time. She also told Lily that her toys were valuable and that she should appreciate them.

Lily realized that her mom was right, so she got ready to clean up her toys. She put them away carefully and made sure to take good care of them. From that day on, Lily always took care of her toys and valued them. And she learned that it's important to take care of the things you love.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to play in the snow. They made a big snowman with a hat, a scarf and a carrot nose. They named him Bob and gave him a hug.

"Hello, Bob. You are our new friend. We will play with you every day," Lily said.

"Yes, Bob. You are very mighty. You are bigger than us and you can scare away the birds," Tom said.

But one day, the sun came out and it was very warm. Lily and Tom went outside and saw that Bob was smaller. His hat and scarf were on the ground and his carrot nose was gone.

"Oh no, Bob is melting! He is not mighty anymore. He is sad and lonely," Lily cried.

"Let's help him. Maybe we can make him cold again," Tom said.

They ran inside and got a pillow and a blanket. They put the pillow under Bob's head and wrapped the blanket around him. They hoped he would feel better.

"Here, Bob. This is for you. You can rest on this pillow and stay cozy in this blanket. We still love you," Lily said.

"Thank you, Lily and Tom. You are very kind. You are my best friends. But I cannot stay here. I have to go back to the snow. That is where I belong," Bob said.

Lily and Tom were surprised. They did not know that Bob could talk. They felt sad, but they understood.

"Goodbye, Bob. We will miss you. Maybe we will see you again when it snows," Tom said.
