The sunflower was excited. She jumped up and began hopping around. The girl laughed and applauded the sunflower's movements.

The two of them ran around and played together until the sun started to go down. They parted ways, but the sunflower felt so happy to have a new friend.

The sunflower thanked the little girl and then looked up at the beautiful clear sky. She waved her arms in the air, knowing she would always have a friend just like the sunflower.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very curious and loved to explore. One day, she went to the park with her mom and saw a big pit.

"Mommy, what's that hole?" asked Lily.

"It's a pit, sweetie. They dug it to fix something underground," replied her mom.

Lily was so curious that she went closer to the pit. Suddenly, a man came and started to spray water into the pit. Lily was amazed to see the water spraying everywhere.

"Wow, that's so cool!" exclaimed Lily.

The man smiled and said, "Do you want to try spraying the water too?"

Lily nodded her head excitedly and the man let her use the hose to spray water into the pit. She had so much fun and couldn't wait to come back to the park again.

Billie had a big yellow door at the front of her house. It was big and she could barely reach the handle. But she loved to open it and look outside.

One day, Billie was feeling a bit sad. She sighed loudly and wished she could do something fun. Suddenly, she noticed the yellow door.

"I know what I'll do," Billie said. She opened the door and stepped outside.

The sun was shining, the birds were singing, and the flowers were so pretty. Billie smiled and ran around in the bright sunshine. She laughed and splashed in the puddles.

After a while, Billie went back inside. She looked at the yellow door, smiled, and sighed happily. She'd had lots of fun, just by opening the door.

One day, a little girl was walking in to the woods. She was wearing a thick jacket. Suddenly, she heard a loud noise. The little girl started to shiver and she couldn't stop! She was so scared.

Then, she saw a big black dog wearing a collar. The big dog was looking at her. But, it didn't bark at her. Instead, it started to wag its tail. The little girl was still scared, but she slowly felt better.

The dog was friendly and it started to follow her. The little girl was feeling a bit warmer now because the dog had a thick fur coat.

They walked until they were out of the woods. The little girl thanked the dog before they went their separate ways. From that day on, the little girl was no longer scared to go into the woods.

Lily and Ben love to play soccer. They have a big ball and two goals in their backyard. Sometimes they pretend they are in a big stadium with many people watching them. They like to cheer and clap for each other.

One day, Lily and Ben want to make a stadium out of paper. They find some scissors and some colorful paper in their room. They cut out shapes of people, flags, and signs. They glue them on a big cardboard box. They make a hole in the box for the ball to go in and out.

They take their stadium and their ball outside. They put the stadium on the grass and start to play. They have a lot of fun. They score many goals and celebrate.

"Wow, you are a great soccer player, Lily!" Ben says.

"Thank you, Ben. You are very popular. Everyone likes you!" Lily says.

They hug and smile. They are happy. They love their stadium and their game.

One day there was a furry creature, and he wanted to stir something up. He looked around, and he saw a toilet in the corner of the room. He crept up to it and started to stir it. He stirred and stirred until bubbles came out of the toilet.

At first the creature was scared when he heard the bubbles. He jumped back, wondering who could be making all of the noise. But soon he heard a big slurp and a splash coming from inside the toilet. He was very curious to know what was in the toilet.

The creature looked inside, and he was surprised to see a huge fish swimming around in the water. He had stirred up the toilet and made the fish appear! He was so excited that he forgot all about being scared.

The furry creature laughed and played with the fish all day. He would stir the water and the fish would splash and make little bubbles come out of the toilet. From then on whenever he got bored, he would go back to the toilet to stir it up and make the fish appear.

A three year old girl named Mina was standing at the edge of a field. It was a bright, sunny day and a festival was taking place.

Mina looked at the festival and felt restless. She wanted to join in the fun!

"Can I go to the festival?" asked Mina.

"Of course you can, Mina," said her mum.

So Mina ran into the field and folded her arms in excitement. She watched the people dancing and singing and playing games. She smiled and laughed with joy.

The festival was coming to an end and it was time for Mina to go home. Her mum folded her in a warm embrace and whispered, "Wasn't that a nice festival?"

Mina smiled and nodded. She couldn't wait to go to the festival again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she met a friendly bear named Teddy.

Teddy said, "Hello Lily! Do you want to climb the mountain with me?"

Lily said, "Yes please! But I'm not ready yet."

Teddy said, "That's okay. Take your time and let me know when you become ready."

So, Lily practiced and practiced until she became ready. She climbed the mountain with Teddy and saw a beautiful view from the top. They both had so much fun together and became good friends.

Once there were two young friends. They were always playing in the garden together. One day they wanted to pick a peach from the tree. But when they got there, they got into a quarrel.

One of the friends wanted the big peach, but the other friend wanted it! They didn't know what to do.

Suddenly, a little bird from the tree flew down and began to sing. The friends stopped and listened to its funny song.

The little bird suggested that the two friends could both have peaches. It said that there were plenty of peaches for them both to enjoy!

The friends smiled and agreed. They shared the peaches and from then on they never quarrel!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat peaches because they were sweet and juicy. One day, she saw a big, pink peach at the store. She wanted it so badly that she begged her mom to buy it for her.

But her mom said no. "We can't always get what we want," she said. "Sometimes we have to save our money for more important things."

Lily was sad, but she listened to her mom. She started to save her money and soon she had enough to buy a toy that she had been wanting for a long time. She learned that it's important to store our money for things that we really need, instead of just buying things that we want in the moment.

Once there were two friends. One was called Kate and the other was called Jack. They were playing by painting. Kate had a special paintbrush and the brightest paint. Jack had a safe to put his paints in.

Kate said to Jack, "Let's paint a perfect picture!" Jack replied, "Yes, let's make something really special!"

So Jack got out paints in all the colors of the rainbow. First he mixed all the colors together. Then Kate and Jack painted different shapes, like stars, circles and flowers. When they were done, they had made the most perfect and beautiful picture in the world.

Kate said, "We did it! We made a perfect picture. Let's keep it safe in your paint box." Jack said, "Yes, let's keep it safe. It will look nice when we show it to our friends!"

Kate and Jack laughed and smiled. They knew that their perfect picture would always be safe in Jack's paint box.

Lily and Ben were playing with their dolls in the living room. They liked to pretend that the dolls were their babies and they were the mom and dad. They gave them names, clothes, and bottles.

"Look, this is my baby, Anna. She has a pretty face and long hair," Lily said, holding up her doll.

"And this is my baby, Tom. He has a hairy face and a hat," Ben said, showing his doll.

Lily laughed. "That's not a baby, that's a bear! Babies don't have hairy faces, silly!"

Ben frowned. "Yes, they do! My dad has a hairy face and he is a baby!"

Lily shook her head. "No, he is not! He is a grown-up! Grown-ups have hairy faces, not babies!"

Ben and Lily started to argue. They raised their voices and pulled their dolls away from each other.

"Stop it, you two!" their mom said, coming into the living room. "What are you fighting about?"

Lily and Ben told their mom what they were saying. Their mom smiled and hugged them.

"Listen, my loves. Babies and grown-ups can have hairy faces or not. It doesn't matter. What matters is that they are kind and happy. And you are both kind and happy, right?"

Lily and Ben nodded. They felt sorry for fighting.

"Yes, mom. We are sorry," they said.

Their mom kissed them and said, "It's okay. I love you both. Now, why don't you share your dolls and play nicely? I have to leave for a while, but I'll be back soon. Be good, okay?"

Lily and Ben said, "Okay, mom. We love you too. Bye!"

They watched their mom leave and then looked at each other. They smiled and hugged.

"Sorry, Lily. Your baby is pretty," Ben said.

"Sorry, Ben. Your baby is cute," Lily said.

They gave each other their dolls and played happily together. They forgot about their fight and had fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved eating meat. One day, she went to the park with her mom and dad. While playing, she saw a big dog. She became fearful and said, "Mommy, I'm scared of the dog." Her mom said, "Don't worry, Lily. Let's pause and wait until the dog goes away." After a while, the dog went away and Lily felt better. She asked her mom, "Can we go home and eat meat now?" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, we can."

Jim was a hairy boy. He was only three years old. One day he wanted to go to the park but his mum said no. Jim was so sad that he frowned. He wanted to go to the park very much. His mum had a big case. Jim thought that it was full of presents for him. He was so excited! He smiled. Jim's mum put the case in her car and took Jim to the park. He was very happy. They played on the swings and ate ice cream. Jim had a great day and was no longer frowning. He couldn't wait to come back to the park the next day!

Once upon a time, there was a big red car. The car had a seat belt to keep the driver safe. One day, the driver drove the car to a park. The driver was very tired and decided to sleep in the car. While the driver was asleep, a little bird saw the red car and decided to sit on the roof. The bird liked the red color of the car and fell asleep too. When the driver woke up, they saw the bird and smiled. They drove the car back home and the bird flew away. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to drink tea with her grandma. One day, Lily's grandma made her a special yellow tea. It smelled so good!

Lily took a sip and made a face. "This tea tastes funny," she said.

Her grandma shrugged and said, "Maybe I put too much sugar in it."

Lily didn't mind. She still loved spending time with her grandma, even if the tea wasn't perfect. They sat and chatted, enjoying each other's company.

After they finished their tea, Lily's grandma gave her a big hug. "I love spending time with you," she said. "Even if my tea isn't always the best."

Lily smiled and hugged her grandma back. She knew that spending time together was more important than the taste of the tea.

One day, a big cat and a little dog were playing in the park. They were running and having fun. The dog saw a toy on the ground. It was a long string with a knot. The dog wanted to tie the string. The cat wanted to tie the string too. They both tried to tie the string, but they could not do it together. They started to fight.

The dog and the cat pulled on the string. The string became a big mess. It was disgusting. The dog and the cat did not want to play with the string anymore. They were sad and did not want to fight. They wanted to be friends again.

The dog and the cat gave each other a big hug. They were happy to be friends again. They found a new toy to play with. It was a ball. They played with the ball and had fun. They learned that fighting is not good and that it is better to share and play together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play dress-up and wear unique outfits. Her favorite dress was a pretty pink one with sparkly stars on it.

One day, Lily and her family went on a walk and they saw a big cross on the side of the road. Lily asked her mommy what it was and her mommy said it was a special symbol that people use to remember someone who passed away.

Later that week, Lily went to a costume party and decided to wear her favorite pink dress. When she got there, she saw a boy wearing a costume that looked just like the cross they saw on their walk. Lily was surprised and happy that she knew what it was because her mommy had told her about it. She went up to the boy and said, "I know what your costume is! It's a cross!" The boy smiled and said, "Wow, you're so smart!" From that day on, Lily felt proud that she knew about the unique symbol and it made her happy to remember the person it represented.

Once upon a time, a cheerful little girl named Lily lived in a small house with her mom and dad. Lily loved to help her parents with their work. One day, her mom asked her to help pack a bag for a trip they were going on. Lily was very excited to go on a trip with her family.

Lily and her parents got in the car and drove to the park for their trip. They had a fun time playing with a ball and eating yummy food. Lily was happy to see her mom and dad laugh and have a good time together.

As the sun began to set, Lily and her parents went back to their car to go home. They were tired from all the fun they had on their trip, but they were still cheerful. Lily knew that she had helped her family have a great day, and she felt proud of her work.

Once upon a time there was a brave girl. She had an arrow and she wanted to fix it. The arrow wasn't straight so the girl tried bending it. She tried and tried but the arrow was very strong and wouldn't bend.

The girl was feeling sad but then she had an idea. She decided to make the arrow flexible. She grabbed some sticky glue and stuck it on the arrow. Then she found some cloth and wrapped it around the arrow.

Finally, the arrow was flexible! The girl was so happy that she fixed the arrow. Now it bent easily and she had lots of fun shooting it at targets. The girl was proud of her arrow because she had worked hard to fix it.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named John. He wanted to find something special. So he went on a big adventure.

John started to spin around and around. He spun so much that he didn’t know which way was which. Soon he could see a cave in the distance.

By the time he got to the cave, he was very tired. But there was something special inside the cave - a treasure! It was empty, but John knew it was something special.

John was so excited that he started to spin around again. He was so happy to find the treasure. So he took it home with him and kept it safe for many years.

John never forgot about his special treasure - and neither should you!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved going to the library and reading books. One day, she found a book about a princess and a dragon. She was so excited to read it that she accidentally knocked over a bottle of spray.

The spray went all over the library books and made them wet. Lily was very serious about fixing the mistake she made, so she tried to dry the books with a hair dryer. But it didn't work.

The librarian was very upset and told Lily that she had to pay for the damaged books. Lily didn't have any money, so she had to work at the library to pay off her debt. She worked very hard, but it took a long time to pay for all the books.

In the end, Lily learned to be more careful and never spray anything near the library books again. But she was sad that she couldn't read the princess and dragon book she wanted so badly.

Once upon a time there was a small girl. She was very, very cute. Every day she would have fun playing in her yard with her friends.

One day, she found something special. It was a diamond! It was so pretty and sparkly. She was so happy, she wanted to take it home.

She held the diamond tightly in one hand and rushed home excitedly. When she got home, she showed her mom the diamond. Her mom was very happy, and said it was very adorable.

They kept the diamond safe and the girl continued playing with her friends. Whenever they were all together, the girl would always proudly tell them how she found the diamond.

The girl was so happy to have found the diamond, and knew that it would always be an adorable reminder of the day she first held it.

Tom and Lily were playing in the garden. They liked to run and jump and dig. They saw a big pile of laundry on the grass. It was wet from the rain.

"Let's cook the laundry!" Tom said. He had a bright idea. He ran to the shed and got a big pot and a wooden spoon. He put some laundry in the pot and filled it with water from the hose.

Lily followed him. She wanted to help. She got some salt and pepper and sprinkled them on the laundry. She stirred with the spoon. "This will be yummy!" she said.

They put the pot on the fire pit. They waited for the laundry to cook. They did not see the smoke and the flames. They did not hear the siren and the horn.

Mom and Dad came running. They saw the fire and the pot. They saw Tom and Lily. They were very angry and scared. They grabbed Tom and Lily and took them away from the fire. They called the firemen to put out the fire.

"Tom and Lily, what have you done?" Mom shouted. "You could have burned the house and yourselves! You ruined the laundry and the pot! You are in big trouble!"

Tom and Lily were sorry. They did not mean to make a fire. They did not know that laundry was not food. They cried and said sorry. But Mom and Dad did not forgive them. They sent them to their room without dinner. They had to stay there until morning. They had no toys and no books. They had a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a silly little bear named Teddy. Teddy loved to play with his plastic toys. He had a plastic car, a plastic ball, and a plastic boat. One day, Teddy found a plastic wand that glowed in the dark. He was so excited!

Teddy ran around his room with the glowing wand, pretending he was a fairy. He waved the wand and made silly noises. Suddenly, he heard a noise outside his window. He peeked out and saw a glowing firefly.

Teddy ran outside and followed the firefly. It led him to a magical garden where everything glowed! There were glowing flowers, glowing butterflies, and even a glowing pond. Teddy played in the garden all night, waving his glowing wand and having the silliest time of his life.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big jar of butter, but it was so heavy that she couldn't carry it. So, she asked her mommy to help her. Her mommy said, "Let's pull the jar together!" So, they both pulled the jar and carried it to the kitchen.

But when they opened the jar, they saw that the butter was very ugly. It had turned brown and smelled bad. Lily's mommy said, "This butter is not good anymore. We can't eat it." So, they threw the ugly butter away and went to the store to buy some fresh butter.

Lily was sad that she had wasted the butter, but her mommy told her that it was okay. They had tried their best to save it, but sometimes things just don't work out. And now they had learned to be more careful with their food.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Tess. She was 3 years old and loved to have fun.

On day when she was playing in her garden, she stepped on a sharp stone. It hurt her toe and made it very sore.

Tess was very sad and started to cry but then her Mom came outside to help. She took Tess' hand and gave her a kiss on her sore toe. It felt better right away!

Then her Mom gave her a useful band-aid to put on her toe. Tess smiled and said it felt much better now.

From then on, Tess was careful when she played outside and never forgot to use her band-aids if she hurt her toes.

Mama was in the kitchen making a new meal. She had all the ingredients mixed together in a pot. They were spicy. She opened the pot and added some soap. Then she stirred it all together and closed the lid.

The soup smelled delicious! Mama put a big bowl on the table and the family gathered around to enjoy it. They all ate it with big spoons. The soup was nice and hot and a little spicy.

When everyone had finished eating, Mama filled the bowl with warm soapy water. She passed it around the table and everyone took turns washing their spoons.

When they had all rinsed their spoons off, Mama closed the bowl and put it away. Everyone praised her for her delicious spicy soup. The family all had a special moment and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved taking baths in her big bathtub. One day, Lily's little brother, Max, fell down and hurt his knee. He was suffering and crying a lot. Lily's mom picked him up and brought him to the bathroom. She put Max in the bathtub and poured warm water over his knee. Lily felt sad for her brother, but she knew her mom was being compassionate and taking care of him. After a little while, Max felt better and stopped crying. Lily was happy to see her brother feeling better and they both went to bed with smiles on their faces. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big truck. The truck was black and shiny. The driver drove the truck to a store. At the store, the driver had to load boxes onto the truck. The boxes were very heavy, but the driver was strong.

A little boy saw the truck and felt envious. He wished he could drive a big truck too. The driver saw the little boy and smiled. He gave the little boy a ride in the truck. The little boy was so happy!

Finally, the driver finished loading the boxes and drove away. The little boy waved goodbye and felt grateful for the ride. He went home and dreamed about driving a big truck one day.

Once there was a little boy. He was only three years old and he wanted to find a motorcycle. He looked every where, but he couldn't find it. Then, one day, he and his mommy went to the park. As he was walking, he saw a big, spoiled motorcycle in the corner. The motorcycle was all shiny and he wanted to take it home. Mommy said no but she did take him for a ride. They went around the park, but it was really fast for the little boy. He was so excited, he knew he had found a motorcycle!

Once upon a time, there was a girl who liked to pick pretty plants. The girl liked to pick the pretty plants and bring them home to her garden.

One day, while the girl was picking some more plants, she saw something strange in the dirt. She bent down and saw that it was a tiny plant. She was very excited and started to dig around it to pick it.

When the girl was finished picking the plant, she took it home and planted it in her garden. She put some water and sunshine on it, and everyday she talked to it and took care of it. She was very helpful to the little plant.

After a few weeks, the little plant started to grow and the girl was very happy. She loved caring for the little plant and soon it was bigger and stronger. Every day the girl would pick a few flowers from the plant and she would give them to her friends.

The girl was so happy that she had found a helpful little plant and she continued to take good care of it.

The end.

Once there was a girl. She loved to cook. Every day, she went to the kitchen and looked for something to make. One day, she saw a pot on the stove. She looked inside, and it was empty. She was excited. She quickly grabbed some ingredients and filled the pot with them.

First, she added some rare sauce. Then, she added a bit of salt, some pepper, and some herbs. She stirred the ingredients until everything was mixed together.

The girl cooked the mixture for a long time until it was bubbling. She opened the lid and looked inside. It smelled amazing! She smiled and sighed. She had made the most delicious sauce!

She quickly put the sauce in a bowl and tasted it. It was delicious! Now, she was ready to fill her plate with it. She added some vegetables and pasta, and then scooped the sauce on top. Finally, her meal was complete.

The girl had made a delicious and rare sauce. She was very proud of her creation, and she ate it with a big smile on her face.

Anna and Ben are twins. They go to school every day. They learn many things. They learn to read and write and count. They also learn to spell. Spelling is hard, but fun.

One day, their teacher gives them a spelling test. She says ten words and they have to write them on a paper. Anna listens carefully and writes the words. She likes spelling. Ben does not listen. He draws pictures on his paper. He likes drawing. He thinks spelling is boring.

The teacher collects the papers and looks at them. She smiles at Anna and says, "Well done, Anna. You spelled all the words right. You are a good speller." She frowns at Ben and says, "Oh, Ben. You did not spell any words. You only drew pictures. You are a naughty boy. You did not learn. You have to stay after school and practice spelling."

Anna feels happy and proud. She gives Ben a hug and says, "I'm sorry, Ben. Spelling is not so bad. I can help you learn. Maybe you can teach me how to draw better." Ben feels sad and sorry. He says, "Thank you, Anna. You are a good sister. I will try to learn spelling. Maybe you can draw with me sometimes." They hug again and go home. They learn to spell and draw together.

Lily and Tom were playing with their cars on the road. They liked to make noises and pretend they were driving fast. They saw a big truck coming and moved to the side.

"Hello, kids," the truck driver said. "Do you want to see what I have in the back?"

Lily and Tom nodded. They were curious. The truck driver opened the door and showed them a big cage with a monkey inside. The monkey looked sad and dirty.

"Wow, a monkey!" Tom said. "Can we touch it?"

"Sure, why not?" the truck driver said. "But be careful, he might shake you."

Lily and Tom reached their hands to the cage. The monkey grabbed them and pulled them inside. He was very strong and angry. He bit them and scratched them. He made loud noises.

"Help, help!" Lily and Tom cried. "Let us go!"

The truck driver laughed. He closed the door and locked it. He got back in the truck and drove away. He did not care about the kids. He only wanted to sell the monkey to a bad place.

Lily and Tom were trapped with the monkey. They were hurt and scared. They wished they had not gone to the truck. They wished they had stayed on the road. They wished they had listened to their mom, who told them not to talk to strangers. It was too late. It was a disgusting day.

Ben and Tom are brothers. They like to play with cars and balls. But sometimes they fight. They fight over toys and snacks and TV. Mom and Dad are not happy when they fight.

One day, Mom and Dad give them a big gift. It is a box with many books and puzzles and games. Ben and Tom are happy. They want to open the gift and see what is inside. But they have a problem. They both want to open the gift first.

"I want to open it!" Ben says.

"No, I want to open it!" Tom says.

They pull and push and shout. They fight over the gift. The gift falls on the floor. The box breaks. The books and puzzles and games spill out. Some of them are broken and torn.

Mom and Dad hear the noise. They come to see what is wrong. They see the mess and the broken gift. They are angry and sad.

"Ben and Tom, you are very stupid!" Mom says. "You fight over a gift that was meant to make you happy. You ruin the gift and waste our money. You should be ashamed of yourselves!"

Ben and Tom feel bad. They know they are stupid. They say sorry to Mom and Dad. They say sorry to each other. They hug and make up. They promise to share and not fight.

Mom and Dad forgive them. They help them clean up the mess. They fix some of the books and puzzles and games. They tell them to be careful and gentle with the gift. They tell them to enjoy the gift and learn from it.

Ben and Tom nod and smile. They thank Mom and Dad for the gift. They pick a book and a puzzle and a game. They sit together and play. They do not fight. They are happy.

Once upon a time there was a mommy and a baby. The baby wanted to weigh the glass. So mommy put the glass on a special thing called a scale. The scale told them how much the glass weighed. The baby thought it was very funny to weigh the glass.

Mommy was also very funny. She had a special game where she put different things on the scale and then said how much they weighed. The baby thought this was very exciting.

They weighed lots of things. Blocks, toys, a chair and even mommy. Mommy was very light, but the baby was very heavy.

The baby had lots of fun weighing the glass. And he was happy to find out that it weighed the same every time. What a funny game!

Tim and Mia are playing in the park. They like to go on the swings, the slide and the seesaw. They see a big wheel with many colors and lights. It goes round and round very fast. Tim wants to try it, but Mia is afraid.

"Come on, Mia, let's go on the wheel. It looks fun!" Tim says.

"No, Tim, it is too high and too fast. It will scare me. I don't want to go on the wheel." Mia says.

"Please, Mia, don't be scared. I will hold your hand. We can see the whole park from the wheel. It will be fun!" Tim says.

Mia thinks for a moment. She likes Tim and she wants to make him happy. She decides to be brave and go on the wheel with him. They get in a seat and buckle up. The wheel starts to move.

"Wow, look, Mia, we are going up!" Tim says.

Mia feels her tummy go funny. She closes her eyes and holds Tim's hand tight. She hears the wind and the music and the people. She is scared.

"Tim, I don't like this. I want to get off. Please make it stop." Mia says.

"Don't worry, Mia, it will be over soon. Just breathe and look at me. You are doing great." Tim says.

He smiles at her and tries to calm her down. He is proud of her for trying something new. He knows she is scared, but he also knows she is strong.

The wheel goes round and round a few more times. Then it slows down and stops. Tim and Mia get off the seat and walk away. Mia feels dizzy and shaky. She is glad it is over.

"Thank you, Tim, for holding my hand. You are a good friend." Mia says.

"Thank you, Mia, for going on the wheel with me. You are very brave." Tim says.

They hug each other and smile. They are happy. They go to the ice cream stand and buy two cones. They lick the ice cream and enjoy the tasty flavors. They forget about the wheel and have fun in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little squirrel named Nutty. Nutty was very fit and loved to run around in the park. One day, Nutty met a friendly dog named Spot.

"Hi there, Nutty! Want to play?" asked Spot.

"Sure, I love to play!" replied Nutty.

They played together for a while, but then Nutty had to go home. "I have to finish collecting nuts for the winter," Nutty said.

"Okay, see you later!" said Spot.

As Nutty was collecting nuts, she heard a loud noise. It was a big truck coming towards her. Nutty tried to run away, but she wasn't fast enough. The truck hit her and Nutty didn't survive.

Poor Nutty didn't get to finish collecting nuts for the winter. The end.

Maxine was a wealthy girl who went to school every day. One day, she was very afraid because she had to take a test. She was worried she would forget all the things she had learned.

The night before the test, she worked very hard to make sure she remembered all her answers. She stayed up late and even asked her mom to help her review.

Finally, the day of the test arrived. Maxine was so nervous that she got to the test room early and started pacing back and forth. All her hard work paid off and she felt ready to take the test.

Maxine was so relieved when she completed the test! She was sure she didn't forget a single answer. Sure enough, when she got the results back, she scored an A! She was very happy and promised herself to never forget to prepare for tests again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and color pictures with her crayons. One day, she wanted to print out a picture she drew on her mommy's computer.

But then, Lily's mommy got very sick and had to go to the hospital. Lily was sad and scared because she loved her mommy very much.

When they got to the hospital, Lily saw that the lights were very bright and the walls were white. But then, a nurse gave her a coloring book and some crayons to keep her busy while her mommy was getting better.

Lily stayed at the hospital for a few days, but finally her mommy was all better and they got to go home. When they got home, Lily printed out her picture and showed it to her mommy. Her mommy was so proud of her and gave her a big hug.

Lily and Tom are twins. They like to play with toys. But they do not like to share. They hate to share.

One day, Mom gives them a new toy. It is a long snake. It is green and yellow. It can bend and twist. It is cheap. Mom says it is for both of them.

Lily and Tom both want the snake. They grab it and pull it. They yell and cry.

"Mine!" Lily says. "I saw it first!"

"No, mine!" Tom says. "I like it more!"

They pull harder and harder. The snake stretches and snaps. It breaks in two. Lily and Tom both fall down. They look at the broken snake. They are sad.

Mom hears the noise. She comes to see what is wrong. She sees the broken snake and the sad twins.

"What happened?" Mom asks.

"We broke the snake," Lily says.

"We hate to share," Tom says.

Mom shakes her head. She is not happy. She picks up the broken snake.

"This was a cheap toy," Mom says. "But it was not worth fighting over. You should learn to share and be kind. Sharing is caring."

She gives each twin a half of the snake. She hugs them and kisses them.

"Maybe you can still play with it," Mom says. "But you have to be gentle and take turns. And you have to say sorry to each other."

Lily and Tom look at each other. They feel sorry. They say sorry. They hug and kiss.

"Sorry, Lily," Tom says.

"Sorry, Tom," Lily says.

They smile and nod. They take turns to play with the snake. They bend and twist it. They make it crawl and hiss. They have fun. They do not hate to share. They love to share.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a calendar on her wall with all the days of the week. Every day, she would look at it and know what day it was.

One day, Lily's mom asked her to help clean up their house. Lily thought it was an ordinary day, but she knew it was important to help her mom. She picked up her toys and put them away.

After they finished cleaning, Lily's mom hugged her and said, "Thank you for being such a good helper. It's important to be helpful and kind every day." Lily smiled and knew that being helpful was important.

From that day on, Lily made sure to be helpful every day. She would help her mom with chores and her friends with their toys. She knew that being kind and helpful made her feel happy inside.

Once upon a time there were two toddlers, Jack and Jill, who liked to play in the sunshine. They liked to run and jump and play tag.

One day, they decided to explore the woods nearby. As they walked, they saw a house with a big roof. It was so inviting that they decided to go inside.

Once inside, they saw that the roof was leaking. They knew they had to do something, so they got to work. Using their toy buckets, they filled them up with sand and stones. They spread the sand and stones on the roof and covered it completely.

Once the roof was covered, both Jack and Jill were feeling very sleepy. They snuggled up close together and soon fell asleep. As they slept, the sand and stones stayed in place, and soon the roof was fixed.

The next morning, Jack and Jill woke up feeling refreshed and happy. They made sure the roof was fixed, and then ran off to play in the sunshine!

Once there was a wise old man who lived in a small house with a big yard. One day, he went outside to the yard to do some work. Suddenly, the wind started to blow hard and it was very cold. The old man started to shiver!

He knew he had to find something to keep him warm. He quickly ran back inside his house and put on a nice warm sweater. He put on his boots and a coat, too.

He went back outside and could still feel the wind. But the wise old man was prepared and he didn't shiver anymore! He finished his work in the yard and went back inside with a big smile.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful pole. It was so tall it reached all the way to the sky. Every day, little birds would come and whisper to the pole, telling it all their secrets.

One day, a little girl came to the pole with a whisper of her own. She was only three years old, but her secret was very special. She told the pole she wanted to be a ballerina when she grew up.

The pole listened to her so carefully and it seemed to give her a gentle nod. The little girl smiled and ran away, feeling so happy and excited.

The next day, the little girl came back and the pole was there waiting for her with a graceful bow. She knew right away that the pole had accepted her special secret and wanted to help. She thanked the pole with a big hug and hugged it again and again.

The pole whispered back to the girl, “You can do it! Follow your dreams and you will be the most graceful ballerina this world has ever seen!”

Once upon a time, there was a rabbit who had a terrible suit. One day, the rabbit decided he wanted to try and change his suit, so he split it apart. This made the rabbit really happy! He was so excited that he did a little hop, skip and a jump.

The rabbit looked for new pieces for his suit, but he couldn’t find any. He wanted to make it look even better than before. He searched and searched, but he couldn’t find anything he liked.

The rabbit was sad and disappointed. He had a terrible suit, and no new pieces to make it better. He was so upset that he cried.

But then, the rabbit saw a small patch of flowers growing nearby. He picked some colourful petals and stuck them onto his suit. Suddenly, his suit was beautiful! He was so happy.

The rabbit wore his fantastic new suit everywhere he went. Everyone who saw him was amazed by how wonderful it looked! The rabbit was so proud of his brand-new suit.

The end.

Once there was a little girl called Lisa. Every day, Lisa's mom would mention that it was important to help the environment and recycle things like cardboard.

One day, Lisa found a big box of cardboard in her backyard and she got an idea! She found some markers and sketched lots of detailed patterns and shapes onto the cardboard.

Then she asked her mom "What can I do with this cardboard?" Her mom said, "Why don't you make a special project?". Lisa thought it was a great idea and started to build a castle.

She used the cardboard as walls and to build towers. She even used her felt tip markers to make a beautiful flag for the castle! When she finished, she was very proud of herself.

Her mom was so impressed she decided to place Lisa's castle in the front yard so everyone walking past could admire it.

From that day on, Lisa knew just how important it was to take care of the environment and reuse things like cardboard.

Jill was so excited to see her grandpa. He looked so charming in his favourite sweater. He was drinking a big glass of juice and gave Jill a big smile.

"Hello my beautiful girl, it's so nice to see you!", he said. Jill ran towards her grandpa and hugged him tightly. Grandpa looked at her and said, "I have something special for you, my dear".

He asked Jill to close her eyes and gave her something. "Ok, you can open them now!" He said with a smile. Jill opened her eyes and was so incredibly excited to see that it was a new toy.

Grandpa then encouraged her to play with the toy and said, "I'm so proud of you.You can do anything you want in life if you put your mind to it."

Jill was playing with the toy in the garden, when suddenly, a big gust of wind threw the toy right over the fence. Jill ran to get it, but it was too late. The toy had gone. Jill was so upset and started crying. Grandpa tried to encourage her, but it was too late. The charming moment had been ruined.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bunny named Benny. Benny loved to eat carrots and play with his friends in the forest. One day, Benny and his friends decided to go to the fair. They needed a ticket to get in, but Benny didn't have one.

Benny was sad because he wanted to go on the rides and play games. His friend, Tommy, offered to give him his extra ticket. But Benny didn't want to take it because he knew it wasn't fair. Instead, Benny decided to shoot some hoops and win a ticket for himself.

After many tries, Benny finally won a ticket! He was so happy and proud of himself for doing the right thing. Benny learned that it's always better to work hard and earn things on your own, rather than taking the easy way out.

Lily liked to play with her furry toy bunny. She named him Hoppy and took him everywhere. She hugged him, fed him, and read him stories. She also liked to dress him up with her old clothes and bandages. She said he was a doctor who helped sick animals.

One day, Lily and Hoppy went to the park with her mom. They saw a big slide and Lily wanted to try it. She put Hoppy on her lap and climbed up the ladder. But when she reached the top, she saw a boy who was bigger and meaner than her. He pushed her and Hoppy and made them fall down the slide.

Lily was scared and hurt. She scraped her knee and elbow and started to cry. Hoppy flew out of her arms and landed on the grass. His ear was torn and his bandage was dirty. Lily ran to him and picked him up. She hugged him and said sorry.

Her mom heard her cry and came to help. She saw what happened and was angry. She told the boy to go away and be nice. She took Lily and Hoppy to a bench and checked their wounds. She said they were not bad and gave them both a kiss. She said she had a surprise for them at home.

Lily and Hoppy felt better and smiled. They wondered what the surprise was. They hoped it was something good. They did not know that their mom had bought them a new furry friend. A real bunny who was white and soft and liked to hop. She wanted to make them happy and forget the bad boy. She thought they would be a good family. She delayed the surprise until they got home. She wanted to see their faces when they met their new bunny. She knew they would love him.

Once upon a time, there was a big, heavy box in a room. A little girl named Lily liked to play in that room. One day, Lily saw a thief trying to take the box away! She screamed and the thief ran away.

The next day, Lily's mom asked her to clean up her toys. Lily forgot about the box in the room. Her mom had to remind her to put the box away. Lily remembered and put the box in its place.

From then on, Lily always remembered to put her toys away and keep an eye out for any thieves. The end.

Once upon a time there was a white armchair. It sat in a corner all alone. One day, a boy named John came along. He liked the armchair and he wanted to snuggle up in its soft space. He climbed up on the armchair and it was so comfy.

John liked the armchair so much, he refused to leave. No matter how much his mom tried to get him to come down, he wouldn't surrender the armchair. But eventually, he had to because it was time to go home.

So John reluctantly gave up the armchair and got off. He was sad but he knew he'd come back soon. So, he hugged the white armchair goodbye and headed home.

Ben and Lily are playing with their toy cars in the living room. They make noises like vroom and beep as they zoom around the carpet. Mom is in the kitchen, making lunch.

"Look, Lily, I can send my car flying!" Ben says, as he pushes his car hard and makes it jump over a pillow.

"Wow, Ben, that's cool!" Lily says, as she watches his car land on the other side. "Can I try?"

"Sure, Lily, here you go." Ben says, as he gives her his car. "But be careful, don't break it."

Lily takes the car and tries to do the same as Ben. She pushes the car hard, but it doesn't jump very high. It hits the lamp and falls down.

"Oh no, Lily, you broke the lamp!" Ben says, as he sees the lamp wobble and the light go off.

"I'm sorry, Ben, I didn't mean to!" Lily says, as she starts to cry.

Mom hears the noise and comes to the living room. She sees the broken lamp and the toy cars.

"What happened here?" Mom asks, as she looks at Ben and Lily.

"Lily broke the lamp, Mom!" Ben says, as he points at Lily.

"I was trying to send the car flying, Mom!" Lily says, as she wipes her tears.

Mom sighs and picks up the lamp. She sees that the wire is loose and the gas is leaking.

"This is dangerous, kids. You can't play with the lamp. The gas can make a fire." Mom says, as she takes the lamp to the garage.

"Sorry, Mom." Ben and Lily say, as they look at each other.

Mom comes back and hugs them.

"It's okay, kids. I know you didn't do it on purpose. But you have to be more careful next time. And you have to tidy up your toys. The living room is a mess." Mom says, as she smiles.

"Okay, Mom. We will tidy up." Ben and Lily say, as they start to put their cars back in the box.

Mom helps them and then takes them to the kitchen for lunch. They have sandwiches and juice and talk about their toy cars. They are happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a poor girl who wanted to go to the mall. She was only three years old and all she had was a few coins. She wanted to go to the mall so badly but her coins weren't enough.

The girl felt sad until one day, she had an idea. She decided to ask her neighbours for help. She asked them all one by one, and each one gave her a few coins. Soon enough, she had enough coins to go to the mall!

The girl was so happy she had gained enough coins to go to the mall. She went to the mall and bought lots of nice things. From then on, she always remembered to save her coins and ask for help when she needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl who wanted to try something new. She wanted to try to zip a zipper all by herself. She had seen grownups use zippers many times, and thought it would be an amazing adventure if she could do it too.

She tried with all her might, but it seemed like an impossible task. She pulled on the zipper over and over and couldn't get it to work. But with a lot of practice and determination, she finally got it. She was so excited and proud that she had succeeded.

The brave little girl was amazed that she had done it all by herself! She smiled and showed off her new zipper skills to everyone. She was glad she had succeeded, and the people around her were happy for her too.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a rich man. He had a big house with a big garden. Every day, he worked hard in the garden. He really enjoyed it, for the sun warmed him and the dirt was soft beneath his feet.

One day, the rich man was gardening when he heard something. He looked up and saw a little girl standing in his garden. She had tears in her eyes.

"Why are you crying?" asked the rich man.

The little girl said, "I'm cold and my feet hurt. Can you help me?"

The rich man thought for a minute. Then he said, "Yes, I can help. Come into the house with me."

The little girl followed the man inside. He showed her a warm blanket and gave her a bowl of water. He said softly, "Now rub the water all over your feet. It will help them feel better."

The little girl did as she was told. Sure enough, she soon felt warmer, and her feet no longer hurt.

The rich man smiled, and said, "Now go and play in my garden. Have fun!"

And the little girl did. She ran across the grass, laughed, and felt very happy. She never forgot the rich man, and she thanked him in her heart.

Tom and Sue were playing with their toys in the garden. They had a big box that they pretended was a spaceship. They put their dolls and cars inside and made noises like rockets and lasers.

"Let's go to the moon!" Tom said.

"OK, but we need to shrink first," Sue said. She had a magic wand that she found in the attic. She waved it at Tom and said, "Shrink, shrink, shrink!"

Tom felt a tickle and looked down. He was as small as a bug. He saw Sue was small too. They climbed into the box and closed the lid.

"Ready for blast off!" Sue said.

They pushed a button and the box shook. They felt like they were flying. They saw stars and planets through a hole in the box. They were having fun.

But then, something big and scary came out of the sky. It was a bird. It saw the box and thought it was food. It swooped down and grabbed the box with its beak.

Tom and Sue screamed. They felt a shock. The box broke and they fell out. They landed on the grass. They were still small.

They saw the bird fly away with the box. They were scared and sad. They lost their toys and their spaceship.

"Help!" Tom cried.

"Help!" Sue cried.

They heard a voice. It was Mom. She was looking for them.

"Tom, Sue, where are you?" Mom said.

She saw them on the grass. She was surprised and worried. She picked them up and hugged them.

"What happened to you?" Mom said.

Tom and Sue told her about the magic wand and the bird. Mom looked at the wand. It had a button that said, "Press to undo."

Mom pressed the button and said, "Grow, grow, grow!"

Tom and Sue felt a tickle and looked up. They were big again. They were happy and relieved.

"Thank you, Mom!" Tom said.

"Thank you, Mom!" Sue said.

Mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, but no more magic wands, OK?"

"OK," Tom and Sue said.

They hugged Mom and went inside. They had some cookies and milk. They felt peaceful. They learned a lesson. They decided to play with their toys in a safer way.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck. The duck liked to swim in the pond and quack. One day, the duck went to a show. The show was very loud and lots of people were there. The duck watched the show and saw a clown. The clown did a funny trick and everyone applauded. The duck liked the sound of the applause and quacked along with it. After the show, the duck went back to the pond and told all of its duck friends about the funny clown and the loud applause. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim was always looking for interesting things. One day, Tim saw something on the ground. It was long, thin, and wiggly. "What is this?" Tim wondered.

The next day, Tim saw the wiggly thing again. This time, it was in the dirt. Tim thought, "Maybe if I watch it, I will find out what it is." So, Tim watched the wiggly thing. It moved around in the dirt and then it went into a hole. Tim was very curious.

On the third day, Tim saw the wiggly thing again. This time, he decided to pick it up with his beak. He picked it up and the wiggly thing yielded. It was a worm! Tim was happy because he found out what the interesting wiggly thing was. From that day on, Tim knew that worms were good to eat and he always looked for them.

Ben and Lily like to build with blocks. They have many blocks of different colors and shapes. They can make houses, towers, cars, and animals with their blocks. They have fun playing with their blocks every day.

One day, they decide to build a big dragon with their blocks. They use green blocks for the body, red blocks for the fire, and yellow blocks for the eyes. They make the dragon very long and scary. They are proud of their dragon.

But then, their dog Spot comes into the room. Spot is a playful dog. He likes to run, jump, and chew on things. He sees the dragon and thinks it is a toy. He runs to the dragon and bites it with his mouth. He breaks the blocks and makes a mess.

Ben and Lily are sad and angry. They shout at Spot and tell him to go away. Spot is confused and scared. He does not understand why they are mad at him. He runs away and hides under the bed.

Ben and Lily look at their broken dragon. They feel sorry for Spot. They realize he did not mean to ruin their dragon. He just wanted to play with them. They decide to forgive him and build a new dragon. They also build a bone for Spot with their blocks. They call Spot and give him the bone. Spot is happy and wags his tail. He licks their faces and says sorry with his eyes. Ben and Lily hug him and say it is okay. They all play together with the blocks and have fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She was 3 years old. Mia liked to play in the park with her friends.

One day, Mia went to the park and saw her friends. She decided to join them. They said hello to each other and hugged.

Mia's friends had a lollipop. They asked Mia if she wanted a lollipop. She said yes and took a lick. It was so yummy.

But then the wind started to blow. The lollipop was not very sticky and it started to fly away! Mia and her friends tried to catch it but it was too far away.

Mia said to her friends, "Let's make a dry lollipop instead!" Her friends agreed and they set to work making the lollipop. They used their hands to make it look just right.

When they finished, the dry lollipop was perfect. Mia and her friends ate it under the sun and had lots of fun. The lollipop was gone in no time!

Once upon a time, there was a big harbor in the big blue ocean. It was very cool and calm. All the boats liked coming to the harbor. One day, a little sailboat was caught in a big storm. It was so scared and sad.

Suddenly, a tall ship came to help. The sailboat was so happy! The tall ship had strong and cool sails. It took the little sailboat to the harbor to keep it safe.

The tall ship stayed with the little sailboat to help it feel safe until the storm was over. The little sailboat was so happy. Once the storm was over, the tall ship took the sailboat back to sea.

The tall ship was the sailboat's friend. Whenever the sailboat felt scared, the tall ship came to help. The tall ship took the sailboat to the harbor so it would always be safe. The sailboat and the tall ship were happy together.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park with their ball. They liked to kick the ball to each other and run after it. Sometimes they would try to score a goal in the net. They had a lot of fun.

But then they saw a giant coming. The giant was very big and loud and scary. He had a big bag on his back and a big stick in his hand. He looked angry and mean. He saw the ball and wanted to take it.

"Give me that ball!" he shouted. "It is mine now!"

Lily and Tom were afraid. They did not want to give their ball to the giant. They liked their ball. It was their favorite toy.

"No!" they said. "It is our ball! You can't have it!"

The giant did not listen. He ran towards them and tried to grab the ball. Lily and Tom ran away, but the giant was faster. He caught the ball and threw it in his bag. He laughed and said, "Ha ha ha! I have your ball! I will spoil it and make it flat!"

Lily and Tom were very sad. They cried and said, "Please, give us back our ball! Don't spoil it! It is not fair!"

But the giant did not care. He was very mean and selfish. He walked away with his bag and his stick. He did not see the policeman coming. The policeman saw the giant and the children. He knew the giant was dangerous and bad. He blew his whistle and said, "Stop, giant! You are under arrest! You can't take things that are not yours!"

The giant was surprised and scared. He dropped his bag and his stick and ran away. The policeman chased him and caught him. He put him in his car and took him to jail. He said, "You are a bad giant! You have to learn to share and be nice!"

The policeman gave the ball back to Lily and Tom. He said, "I'm sorry, children. The giant was very rude and wrong. Here is your ball. I hope it is not spoiled."

Lily and Tom looked at their ball. It was not spoiled. It was still round and bouncy and colorful. They were very happy. They thanked the policeman and said, "You are a good policeman! You saved our ball!"

The policeman smiled and said, "You are welcome, children. You are very brave and polite. Have fun with your ball!"

Lily and Tom hugged their ball and played with it again. They had a lot of fun. They did not see the giant again. They hoped he would learn to be nice and not spoil things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the beach with her mommy and daddy. They walked on the sand and looked at the big blue sea. Suddenly, Lily saw a little brown shrimp crawling on the sand. She was so happy and wanted to catch it, but it was too fast for her.

Lily's mommy and daddy helped her look for more shrimps. They found many little brown shrimps in the shallow water. They caught some of them and put them in a bucket. Lily was so excited to see the shrimps up close. She looked at their little eyes and their tiny legs.

At the end of the day, Lily and her family went home with a bucket full of little brown shrimps. They cooked them for dinner and they were delicious. Lily was happy that she got to catch and eat her very own shrimp. She went to bed dreaming of the next time she could go to the beach and look for more little brown shrimps.

The sun was out and it was a beautiful day. A little girl was outside playing with her friend. They were exploring the garden and seeing what they could find.

Suddenly, there was a loud sound in the sky. It was thunder! The little girl was scared. Her friend said "It's okay, it's just lightning! We have to be careful."

The moment passed and the little girl forgot all about it. She and her friend continued to explore the garden until it was time to go home.

At night, the sky lit up with bright lightning. The little girl was so excited! She wanted to see it again. She asked her mom if she could watch it from the window. Her mom said "Yes, just be careful not to get too close".

So the little girl carefully watched the lightning streak across the night sky. It was a beautiful sight and she couldn't help but get a little bit closer. But she remembered her mom's warning and stayed back.

The little girl watched the lightning until it was time to go to bed. As she drifted off to sleep, she could still remember the excitement of watching the beautiful lightning light up the night sky.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toy cars and trucks. One day, Lily had to choose which toy to play with. She picked her favorite red car and zoomed it around the room.

Suddenly, Lily's little brother came in and accidentally knocked over her car. Lily got upset and said, "I'm sorry, my car is broken now." But her brother said sorry too and helped her fix the car. They played together and had lots of fun zooming their cars around the room.

From that day on, Lily learned that it's okay to make mistakes and that saying sorry can make things better. She also learned that playing with her brother was even more fun than playing alone.

Once there was a little girl named Mandy. She was three and had lots of fun. One day, Mandy wanted to fill her knee with something. She asked her mom, "Mom, can I fill my knee with something?" Her mom said, "Yes, Mandy, you can fill your knee with sand. That'll be fun!"

So Mandy went to the beach. She found some sand and filled her knee with it. She put it all inside and then shook it back and forth, making it go crazy. Mandy was so excited that she laughed out loud!

But then something strange happened. All of a sudden, Mandy heard a voice coming from her knee! The voice said, "Help me! Help me!" Mandy was so frightened that she dropped the sand to the ground and ran away.

Later, when Mandy came back to the beach, she saw a tiny crab running around her feet. It was the crab that had been talking! Mandy was so happy that she had helped the little crab that she kissed its head and then returned it to the sand. From then on Mandy never filled her knee with sand again — but she did become friends with the crab!

Once upon a time, there was a huge bear. He was walking through a big, open field. Everywhere he went, he sneezed because the air was full of pollen. He thought, "It's so hard to breathe this way."

Just then, a little bird flew up to him. She said, "Hey, bear! I have the answer to your problem! Up in the sky, there is a lot of oxygen. If you want to breathe better, then you should fly up and get some!"

The bear thought about this. He knew that he wasn't a bird, so he couldn't fly. He said, "How can I fly? I'm too big and heavy."

The bird replied, "If you find a really big tree, you can climb up it and then jump into the sky! The oxygen is up there waiting for you!"

The bear thanked the little bird and decided to try her plan. He found a huge tree and began to climb it. When he reached the top, he jumped off into the sky. Just like the little bird promised, the oxygen was there to help him breathe. The bear thanked the little bird and happily flew off into the big, blue sky.

Once upon a time, there was a furry spider. It lived in a tree. One day, the spider wanted to work. It spun a web. The web was big and strong. The spider was proud of its work. It sat on its web and waited for food to come. The end.

Once upon a time there was an ancient grandma who loved to remember stories. Every day she took out her special scissors and she would cut pictures from magazines and create new stories.

She loved making things from the paper and was always very proud of what she created.

One day her granddaughter came to visit. She watched as grandma carefully snipped the paper and moved it around. She was very curious and wanted to help but grandma said she was too young and that she must wait a while.

But then grandma made a special surprise. She gave the little girl the scissors, and she carefully showed her how to use them.

The granddaughter was so excited! She slowly moved the scissors around and imitated what grandma had shown her. Together they laughed and enjoyed the wonderful moment.

Grandma always remembered the lovely day they spent together, and whenever she looked at the scissors she would always smile.

Once upon a time there was a bird named Polly. She was a very organized bird, and loved to keep everything tidy. One day, she wanted to explore the world and see what else she could find. She saw a bright blue door and wanted to see what was behind it.

Polly flew to the door and knocked. But the door didn't open. She looked around to see if there was a key. Sure enough, a tiny key was hiding under a bush. Polly picked it up and saw it said 'unlock'.

She flew to the door and put the key in the hole. She turned the key and the lock clicked. The door opened and Polly's eyes grew wide. Inside was a room filled with wings of all different shapes and sizes. She chose a pretty pink one that looked just her size.

She put it on and flapped her wings. She felt so powerful and free. She thanked the door for allowing her to unlock the room of wonders. Now, she was able to explore the world and fly wherever her heart desired.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to hug her mommy's soft arm. Every night, before bed, she would snuggle up and give her mommy's arm a big squeeze.

One day, Lily's mommy hurt her arm and couldn't play with Lily like they usually did. Lily was sad and didn't know what to do.

But then, her mommy told her that she needed to rest her arm so it could get better. Lily understood and decided to quit playing rough with her mommy's arm until it felt better.

Days went by and Lily's mommy's arm started to feel better. Lily was so happy that she could hug her mommy's soft arm again. From then on, she made sure to be gentle with her mommy's arm so it wouldn't get hurt again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world around her. One day, she went on a walk with her mommy and daddy. They walked up a big mountain and saw lots of pretty flowers along the way.

Lily's daddy said, "Look at the beautiful view from up here!" But Lily thought it was dull because everything looked so far away. She wanted to go back down the mountain and play with her toys.

Her mommy said, "Don't ignore the beauty around you, Lily. Look at the flowers and the trees. They are all so pretty." Lily looked around and saw all the pretty things her mommy was talking about. She smiled and said, "You're right, mommy. It's not dull at all. It's beautiful!" And they all continued to walk up the mountain, enjoying the view and each other's company.

Once there was a mum, dad and their little girl. The little girl was three and her name was Lucy.

One day it was very misty outside. The mist was filling the garden and the sky, so Lucy's mum and dad had to prevent her from going outside. This made Lucy very unhappy since she wanted to explore the misty garden.

But then dad had a brilliant idea. He found some old cups and a big sheet. He put the sheet on the kitchen table and scattered the cups across it. Now it was an original game!

Dad explained that Lucy had to carefully take each cup off the sheet without the mist touching the sheet. If the mist touched the sheet the game would have to start over again.

Lucy was so excited to try her new game and she happily played her new game all afternoon. The mist never touched the sheet and she won the game!

Once there was a little fox. He sniffed the air and saw that something was dangerous. He trotted through the trees until he came to a clearing. There he saw a snake with a long and dangerous tail.

The fox asked carefully, "What do you want?"

The snake hissed, "I want to eat you!"

The fox felt scared and thought quickly. He gathered all his courage and answered, "No way!"

The snake bristled and said, "Then I'll just have to catch you!"

Just then, the fox heard a loud roar. He saw a hunter with a giant gun. The hunter came close, and the snake roared, "Quickly, run!"

The fox ran as fast as his fox legs could carry him, but the hunter was too quick. He muttered "Gotcha!" and pointed his gun with a dangerous tail in the fox's face.

The fox knew that the hunter meant to kill him with the dangerous tail, so he said goodbye and closed his eyes. He was never seen again.

Once upon a time there was a strong cricket. He wanted to go on an adventure, so he went to the park. The cricket saw lots of kids playing and having fun.

He flew close to a little boy and demanded, "Hey, let me play too!" But the boy didn't understand. So the cricket flew closer and shouted, "Please, let me play!"

Finally, the boy said, "Yes! Let’s play together!" They ran around the park and had lots of fun. The cricket felt so strong and happy.

The boy and the cricket played until it was time to go home. The cricket wished the boy goodbye and went back to his home in the garden. From then on, they would meet in the park every day and play together.

One day, a funny cat and a funny dog were playing together. They liked to play and run in the park. The sun was shining and they were very happy.

The funny cat said, "Let's play war!" The funny dog agreed and they began to play. They would run and chase each other, then pause to hide behind trees. When they found each other, they would laugh and start running again.

As they played, a little bird joined them. The bird said, "Can I play war too?" The funny cat and funny dog said, "Yes, you can play with us!" So, the three friends played together, running, hiding, and laughing.

They paused to rest under a big tree. The funny cat, funny dog, and little bird were tired but happy. They had so much fun playing war together. They knew they would be friends for a long time.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved to explore. One day he heard the fireman on the street and wanted to go talk to him. When he got there, the fireman was sorting out his equipment. Jack was very excited and asked the fireman if he could help. The fireman said yes, and handed Jack a shiny helmet. Jack carefully sorted through the items, and the fireman smiled.

Next, the fireman took Jack to a nearby ice cream store. It was Jack’s favorite store, and there were many delicious flavors to choose from. Jack chose a chocolate ice cream cone and the fireman got a vanilla cone. They shared the ice cream and talked about the fireman’s job.

The fireman was so happy that he invited Jack to come back and help him sort out the equipment. Every time Jack visited, the fireman would give him a delicious treat. Jack enjoyed helping the fireman sort out his gear and learning all about being a fireman.

The fireman was so proud of Jack and his hard work! They both had such great times together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy motor car. He would zoom it around the floor and make it go really fast. One day, Tim's friend, Sam, came over to play.

Sam saw Tim's toy motor car and said, "Wow, that's a cool car! Can I play too?" Tim replied, "Yes, let's play together!" They both started to race their cars around the room.

As they were playing, Sam accidentally crashed his car into Tim's. Tim's car broke into pieces. Tim felt frustrated and said, "Oh no! You destroy my car!" Sam felt sad and said, "I'm sorry, Tim. I didn't mean to."

Tim took a deep breath and said, "It's okay, Sam. We can fix it together." They both worked together to put the car back together. After they fixed it, they continued to play and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time there was a family who was moving to a new house. The little three year old was so excited to see what their new home looked like! When they arrived, the family quickly got to work unpacking all the boxes and putting things in their new place.

The little three year old couldn't help but notice a sparkly gold wrapped present on the table. "What's this?", she asked her mom. Her mom put her hand on the little girl's shoulder and said, "It's a gift for you! I found it while we were unpacking, and thought you might like it."

The little three year old eagerly opened the present and discovered a flexible ball inside. She held it up and smiled. “I love it! What is it for?”, she asked her mom.

Her mom smiled and said, "You can play catch with it, you can also learn how to throw and catch to help you become better at new things."

The moral of this story is that if you are flexible and stay open to learning new things, you will discover something new and exciting, just like the little three year old did when she opened the gift.

Once upon a time, there was a doggy named Bob. Bob was very fast and love to race. One day, Bob was out running in the garden, when he saw something shiny in the corner.

Bob went over to have a closer look. It was a delicate metal wire! His tail started wagging, as he knew this was the perfect thing to race with.

Bob picked up the shiny wire in his mouth and started to bark. His mommy came out of the house.

"What is it, Bob?", she asked.

"A wire!", Bob said.

"Oh, can you show me?", she asked.

Bob nodded eagerly and bounded off with the wire still in his mouth. He raced around the garden, with Mommy chasing after him. Bob was so proud to be running so fast and the wire glittered in the sun.

After a while, Bob finally stopped and dropped the sparkling wire onto the ground. He glanced proudly up at his Mommy, wagging his tail. Mommy smiled and said, "That looked like a lot of fun, Bob."

Bob barked happily in agreement and raced off, to explore some more.

Lily and Ben were playing in the living room. They liked to pretend they were superheroes. Lily had a red cape and Ben had a blue mask. They ran around and made loud noises.

"Look, I can fly!" Lily said, jumping on the couch.

"Me too!" Ben said, following her.

They had fun until they saw a switch on the wall. It was shiny and had a picture of a light bulb on it.

"What is this?" Lily asked, pointing at it.

"I don't know. Maybe it makes something happen," Ben said, curious.

He reached for the switch and flipped it up and down. Suddenly, the ceiling fan started to spin very fast. It made a whooshing sound and blew air everywhere.

"Wow, cool!" Ben said, laughing.

But then, something bad happened. The fan was too old and loose. It came off the ceiling and fell down. It hit a vase on the table and broke it. Water spilled out of the vase and made the floor wet.

"Oh no!" Lily said, scared.

"Uh oh!" Ben said, guilty.

They heard their mom coming from the kitchen. She saw the mess and was angry.

"What did you do?" she asked, frowning.

"We were playing superheroes and we found a switch and we made the fan happen and it broke the vase and made the floor wet," Ben said, quickly.

"That was very naughty. You could have hurt yourselves. And you made a big mess. You need to clean it up and say sorry," mom said, sternly.

Lily and Ben felt bad. They said sorry to mom and helped her clean up. They learned not to touch switches they didn't know. They decided to play superheroes outside next time.

Once upon a time, there was a pirate named Jack. Jack was a very organized pirate. He had a big ship with lots of treasure. Jack loved to sail the seas and find new treasure.

One day, Jack saw a big storm coming. He knew he had to close all the windows on his ship or it would get wet inside. Jack quickly closed all the windows and waited for the storm to pass.

After the storm, Jack found a treasure map. He was so excited! He set sail to find the treasure. When he got to the island, he saw that someone had already found the treasure. Jack was sad, but he remembered that he still had his ship and his friends. They sailed off into the sunset, happy to be together.

Once upon a time, there was a baby. The baby was very small and cute. One day, the baby's mommy took her for a walk in the park. They saw many trees, flowers, and birds. Suddenly, the baby discovered a wide, blue balloon on the ground. She picked it up and smiled. Her mommy was happy too. They played with the balloon and had a great time. The end.

Once upon a time there was a big number. It was so big that everyone wanted to see it. The number was called zero.

One day, the zero was put on display for the whole town! Everyone was very excited and they all gathered round to look.

When the people saw the zero, they were so amazed. It was impressive! They couldn't believe their eyes. It was so big and shiny - it looked like a giant diamond!

The people cheered and laughed. They all agreed that the zero was the most impressive thing they had ever seen.

The town now proudly displays the zero at its centre, celebrating its impressive size and beauty.

Lily was a big girl who went to class with other big kids. She liked to learn new things and play with her friends. But sometimes she felt confused when the teacher said hard words or gave hard tasks.

One day, the teacher asked the kids to carry some books from the shelf to the table. Lily tried to carry as many books as she could, but they were heavy and slippery. She dropped some books on the floor and made a loud noise. The other kids looked at her and some laughed. Lily felt sad and ashamed.

"Are you okay, Lily?" the teacher asked. She came to help Lily pick up the books. "You don't have to carry so many books at once. You can carry one or two and make more trips. That way, you won't drop them or hurt yourself."

Lily nodded and said, "Thank you, teacher. I'm sorry I made a mess. I wanted to be fast and helpful, but I got confused."

The teacher smiled and said, "It's okay, Lily. You don't have to be sorry. You are fast and helpful, and you are also brave and kind. Sometimes we all get confused, but we can always ask for help or try again. That's how we learn and grow."

Lily felt better and smiled back. She carried one book at a time and put it on the table. She saw that some of her friends were also carrying books and helping each other. She joined them and said, "Can I help you?" They said, "Yes, please. Thank you, Lily." Lily felt happy and proud. She liked her class and her teacher. She liked to learn new things and play with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mom asked her to help her cook dinner. She said, "Lily, can you please put the pot on the stove?"

Lily replied, "Yes, mommy!" She went to the stove and saw a big, orange pot. She put it on the stove and turned on the fire. Then, she helped her mom cut some vegetables.

While they were cooking, Lily's mom asked her, "Do you believe in magic, Lily?"

Lily thought for a moment and said, "Yes, mommy! I believe in magic. Anything is possible!" They finished cooking and had a delicious dinner together. From that day on, Lily believed that anything was possible, even magic.

Once upon a time a little bird wanted to soar. But the little bird was sad, becasue he didn't know how.

Then one day he saw a big cart. He hopped onto the cart and felt brave. He closed his eyes and held on tight.

The cart began to move up, higher and higher. Soon it was so dark the little bird couldn't see. But he felt the wind against his little feathers and opened his wings.

He soared through the dark night! He felt happy and he twirled and flew around the stars. He soared in the sky until the sun came up. He was so proud of himself.

The little bird said goodbye to the cart and flew home, happy to have soared in the dark sky.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who wondered what was over the sea. He was very thoughtful and wanted to know what it was like over there.

So one day, he asked his mom if he could go over the sea. His mom said no and told him he would have to wait until he was a bit older.

But the boy still wondered what it would be like over the sea. He looked out at the ocean, wondering what secrets it held.

He thought about it day and night and every time he looked at the sea he wondered what was on the other side. He was so curious!

Finally, when the boy was old enough, he and his family took a trip to the other side of the sea.

He was amazed at what he found! He had finally discovered the answers to his questions and it was even more wonderful than he had expected. He was so happy and thankful.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Bob. Bob loved to eat carrots. One day, he saw a big sign near his home. The sign said, "Carrots for sale!"

Bob hopped to the place where the sign was. He saw a man selling the biggest, yummiest carrots he had ever seen. But the man said the carrots were expensive. Bob was sad. He did not have enough money to buy the expensive carrots.

Bob had an idea. He would trade something with the man for the carrots. He went home and found his favorite toy car. He brought the car to the man. The man liked the toy car and gave Bob two big carrots. Bob was so happy! He went home and ate the yummy carrots.

Billy and his mom had a very special day. They decided to go to the camp. It was in the middle of the woods and filled with big trees and brown leaves.

Billy's mom suggested that he pick up an acorn. When he found a big one, she asked him to show her. She was so proud of him and gave him a big hug.
