Pippa felt sorry and ashamed. She said, "I am sorry, mama. I was wrong. I wanted to be adventurous, but I did not think of the danger. I love you too, mama. Can we go home now?"

Her mama smiled and said, "Yes, Pippa, we can go home. But first, let me show you something. Look over there." She pointed to the other side of the hill, where the sun was setting and making the ice sparkle. "This is a beautiful sight, but it is not worth risking your life. You can be adventurous, but you also need to be careful and listen to me. Do you understand?"

Pippa nodded and said, "I understand, mama. Thank you for saving me and showing me this. You are the best mama in the world."

They cuddled and watched the sun go down. Then, they slid and waddled back to their home, where the other penguins welcomed them. Pippa learned her lesson and never ignored her mama again. She still liked to explore, but she always asked her mama first and stayed close to her. She was happy and safe, and so was her mama.

Once there was a little girl called Joy. She was three years old and loved playing with her toys. One day, she was playing in the garden when she saw a bird in a tree. She gasped and said to her mum, "Look at that bird, it is so colourful!" But her mum disagreed because the bird was actually black and white.

Joy was very independent and didn't like people disagreeing with her. She decided to prove to her mum that the bird was coloured. So she walked to the hospital to get an x-ray of the bird. The doctors laughed, but agreed to take an x-ray for Joy.

When the x-ray came back, the doctors were amazed to see that the bird was actually coloured! There were so many bright colours - blue, yellow and green. Joy was very proud of herself and happy that she made her mum agree with her. From then on, she always stayed independent.

Once upon a time, there was a soldier named Tim. He was a very bad soldier because he didn't listen to his captain. One day, Tim went to the store to buy some new boots.

At the store, he met a little boy named Jack. Jack said, "Hi, soldier! Can you tie my shoe?" Tim said, "Sure, I can tie your shoe." So, Tim tied Jack's shoe and they became friends.

But then, Tim's captain came to the store and saw Tim talking to Jack. The captain said, "Tim, you are a bad soldier! You should be training, not playing with children." Tim felt sad and said, "I'm sorry, captain. I will go back to training now." But Jack said, "Don't worry, soldier. You can still be my friend." And Tim felt happy again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to bake with his mommy. They would use a big mixer to make yummy cakes and cookies. Timmy loved to lick the spoon and the bowl.

One day, while they were baking, Timmy accidentally knocked over the mixer. It fell to the ground and made a loud noise. Timmy was scared, but his mommy told him not to worry. She picked up the mixer and they continued baking.

Timmy was persistent and kept helping his mommy mix the ingredients. He was very proud of himself when they finally finished baking. As they were putting the cookies in the oven, they heard a loud thunder strike outside. Timmy and his mommy hugged each other tightly and waited for the storm to pass.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play with her dolls and teddy bears. One day, her grandma came to visit her. Lily was so happy to see her grandma! They played together and had lots of fun.

Grandma brought a special present for Lily. It was a model of a big, red car. Lily loved it! She played with the car all day long, driving it around the house.

But then, something happened. Lily's little brother, Max, accidentally broke the car. Lily was so sad and miserable. She didn't know what to do.

But then, her grandma came up with an idea. She said they could fix the car together. So, they got some glue and worked on the car until it was all fixed up. Lily was so happy again! She hugged her grandma and thanked her for the visit.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the beach with her mom and dad. They had a fun day playing in the sand and splashing in the water. Lily found a pretty shell that she wanted to show her friends.

When they got back home, Lily had an idea. She wanted to perform a play for her friends with the shell. She put on a comfortable dress and called her friends to come over. She was so happy and excited.

Lily and her friends sat on the floor and she told them a story about the shell. She said that the shell was a magical shell that could sing and dance. Her friends clapped and laughed as Lily performed her play. They all had a great time and loved the story about the magical shell.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named John. He was very keen to win a prize. One day, he saw a big contest was being held to win a big, shiny prize. He was so excited and he wanted to enter! He started to zip around and around, trying to get to the contest in time.

But when he reached the contest, he saw it was really dull. All the other entries were plain and boring, and he was the only one who was zipping around. He was disappointed and felt that he didn't stand a chance of winning, but he still decided to compete.

At the end of the day, John found out he had won the big, shiny prize! Everyone around him was so surprised and happy, because he was the only one who was different.

This story teaches us that it is important to be unique and not be afraid to stand out. Being different makes you special and it can help you win prizes if you never give up!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and have fun. One day, she went to her room to play with her dolls. She saw that one of her dolls did not have a label on it. She felt sad because she did not know the name of her doll.

Lily went to her mommy and said, "Mommy, my doll does not have a label. I am sad because I do not know her name." Her mommy hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. We can make a label for your doll together." Lily was happy to hear that and they made a label for her doll. Now, Lily was happy to have her doll with a name on it.

From that day on, Lily always made sure that her toys had labels on them. She did not want to feel sad again.

Once upon a time, there was a smelly knight who lived in a castle. He didn't like to prepare for battles and always lost. One day, a wise wizard came to the castle and told the knight that he needed to prepare better if he wanted to win.

The knight didn't want to listen at first, but then he saw how the wizard prepared his spells and potions. The knight decided to take the wizard's advice and started to prepare for battles. He trained every day and made sure his armor was shiny and his sword was sharp.

Finally, the day of the big battle arrived. The knight was ready and fought bravely. Thanks to his preparation, he won the battle and became a hero. From that day on, the knight always prepared for battles and never lost again. The moral of the story is that if you prepare well, you can achieve anything you want.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a teddy bear named Teddy who was her best friend. One day, Teddy's arm broke and Lily was very sad. She asked her mommy to help her fix it.

Mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. We will complete Teddy's arm and make him all better." Lily was happy to hear that. Mommy got some thread and a needle and started sewing Teddy's arm.

As mommy was sewing, Teddy gave Lily a wink. Lily giggled and said, "Teddy, you're so silly!" After a few minutes, Teddy's arm was fixed and he was as good as new. Lily was so happy and said, "Thank you, mommy. You're so dependable."

Once upon a time there was a boy named Joe. He was very excited to go to school. He put on his pants and ran out the door. Joe was so happy to see his friends!

But when Joe got to school he saw that something was wrong. He felt frustrated. His friends were all playing, but nobody had invited him to join. Joe watched them play, but they were too busy having fun.

Joe sat alone, feeling sad. Then the teacher saw him and came over. She put her arm around him and said, "Come on, everyone! Let's make sure Joe joins in the fun!"

Joe was so happy. Now he could join in and play with his friends. They all laughed and had a great time. Joe was happy and he didn't feel frustrated anymore.

The end.

Lily was a little girl who liked to play in the garden. She liked to see the flowers and the bugs and the birds. One day, she saw something new in the garden. It was white and round and had many tiny parts. She wondered what it was.

She asked her mom, who was watering the plants. "Mom, what is that?" She pointed to the white thing.

"That is a cauliflower, Lily. It is a vegetable that grows in the ground. We can eat it later, if you want." Mom said.

Lily was curious. She wanted to see the cauliflower up close. She walked to the garden bed and bent down. She touched the cauliflower gently. It felt soft and bumpy.

"Hello, cauliflower. I am Lily. Nice to meet you." She said.

The cauliflower did not say anything. It just stayed still. But Lily felt happy. She had made a new friend in the garden.

She ran back to her mom and hugged her. "Thank you, mom, for the cauliflower. I am grateful. Can we eat it for dinner?" She asked.

Mom smiled and kissed her. "Of course, Lily. We can eat it for dinner. I am grateful for you, too. You are my sweet girl." She said.

They went inside the house, holding hands. Lily looked forward to dinner. She wanted to share the cauliflower with her mom and dad. She thought it would be yummy. She was glad she had met the cauliflower.

Nina and her friends gathered in the park on a cool summer day. They were very excited because today they were going to build a shelter. Each of them had brought different things to help build the shelter - sticks, blankets, leaves and more! They worked together to create a nice, cozy shelter. When they had finished, they ran inside and laughed. It felt so nice and cool inside! They spent the whole afternoon inside the shelter, talking and playing. When it was time to leave, they gave each other a big hug and vowed to come back soon to gather and play in their special little shelter.

One day, a little girl named Lily found an orange drum in her room. She did not know where it came from. Lily liked the drum because it was big and round. She thought it would be fun to play with it.

Lily took the drum to her friend Tom's house. Tom saw the drum and said, "Wow, that's a big orange drum! Can I play with it too?" Lily said, "Yes, let's play together!" They played the drum and made loud noises. They thought it was very fun. But they did not know that the drum had a secret.

After playing for a while, they heard a strange sound coming from the drum. They stopped playing and listened carefully. The drum started to shake and opened up. Inside the drum, they found a small toy dog. The toy dog could talk! It said, "Thank you for finding me! I was stuck in the drum for a long time. Now I am free, and I can be your friend!" Lily and Tom were very happy. They now had a new toy friend, and they played together all day long.

Lily and Max were twins who loved chocolate. They always wanted to eat chocolate after dinner, but their mom said they had to sleep first. Lily and Max did not like to sleep. They wanted to stay up and play with their toys and books.

One night, Lily had an idea. She whispered to Max, "Let's sneak out of our room and get some chocolate from the kitchen. Mom won't know. We can eat it under the table and then go back to sleep."

Max nodded. He was impatient to taste the sweet chocolate. They waited until their mom turned off the light and went to her room. Then they tiptoed out of their room and down the stairs. They found the chocolate in the cupboard and took two pieces each. They crawled under the table and unwrapped the chocolate.

"Mmm, this is so good," Lily said, biting into her chocolate.

"Shh, be quiet," Max said, "or mom will hear us."

They ate their chocolate quickly and licked their fingers. They felt happy and full. They decided to go back to their room and sleep. But as they got up from under the table, they heard a voice.

"What are you two doing here?" It was their mom. She had heard them and came to check on them. She saw the chocolate wrappers on the floor and the chocolate on their faces.

Lily and Max felt scared and guilty. They knew they had done something wrong. They hung their heads and said, "Sorry, mom. We wanted to eat chocolate and we didn't want to sleep."

Their mom sighed. She was not happy, but she was not angry either. She loved her twins, even when they were naughty. She said, "You know you have to sleep at night, right? Chocolate is not good for you before bed. It can give you bad dreams and tummy aches. And you have to brush your teeth after eating chocolate, or you will get cavities."

Lily and Max nodded. They understood. They said, "We're sorry, mom. We won't do it again. Can we have a hug?"

Their mom hugged them and kissed them. She said, "I forgive you. But you have to promise me to sleep well tonight and to eat chocolate only as a treat sometimes, not every night. OK?"

Lily and Max promised. They said, "OK, mom. We love you."

Their mom said, "I love you too. Now let's go to your room and brush your teeth and tuck you in."

Lily and Max followed their mom to their room. They brushed their teeth and put on their pajamas. Their mom tucked them in and read them a story. They felt cozy and sleepy. They closed their eyes and dreamed of chocolate.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a pond with ducks and fish. Lily wants to feed the ducks. Ben wants to catch the fish.

"I have bread for the ducks," Lily says. "They are hungry and nice."

"I have a net for the fish," Ben says. "They are fast and fun."

Lily and Ben disagree. They do not want to do the same thing. They get angry and say mean words.

"You are stupid," Lily says. "Ducks are better than fish."

"You are stupid," Ben says. "Fish are better than ducks."

They stop being friends and go to different sides of the pond. They do not talk or play.

A big dog comes to the park. He sees the bread and the net. He thinks they are toys. He runs to the pond and grabs them. He makes a mess and scares the ducks and the fish.

Lily and Ben see the dog. They are sad and scared. They want their bread and their net back. They do not like the dog.

They run to each other and hug. They say sorry and nice words.

"You are not stupid," Lily says. "Ducks and fish are both good."

"You are not stupid," Ben says. "We can share the bread and the net."

They become friends again and play together. They feed the ducks and watch the fish. They do not disagree. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a butterfly. It was different to all the other butterflies, because it was big and bright and bold. It liked to fly so high in the sky and shine its bright colours in the sunshine.

One day, the butterfly spotted something down in the garden. It flew all the way down to see what it was. Sitting in the garden there was a creamy white block of something yummy. It was creamy and white, and the butterfly knew it was butter.

The butterfly flew down and took a bite of the butter. It was delicious and so creamy, the butterfly wanted to eat all of it, and so it did. The butterfly ate all of the butter, and spoiled it for everyone else.

But then something wonderful happened. As the butterfly flew away, it noticed a colourful patch of flowers in the garden. When it looked closer, it saw that the flowers had all changed colours. Now there were lots of different coloured butterflies fluttering around, like a rainbow had come to life!

The butterfly was very happy and spoiling the butter had made all the flowers change colour. It knew that if it hadn't spoiled the butter, these beautiful butterflies would never have appeared!

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They saw a big fire in a house. Smoke and ash came out of the windows. Lily and Tom were scared and ran to their mom.

"Mom, mom, look at the fire!" Lily said.

"Oh no, that's so sad. I hope everyone is safe," mom said.

They saw some people come out of the house. They looked sad and dirty. They had no clothes or toys. Lily and Tom felt sorry for them.

"Mom, can we help them?" Tom asked.

"Of course, we can. Let's go and see what they need," mom said.

They walked to the people and mom gave them some water and blankets. Lily and Tom reached into their pockets and gave them some candy and stickers. The people smiled and thanked them.

"You are very kind and generous," one of them said.

"We are happy to share," Lily and Tom said.

They hugged the people and wished them well. They learned that it is good to help others who are poor and in trouble. They felt proud and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a small family. The mom and dad wanted their little boy to dare to do something special.

The mom said, "We want you to build something special so that everyone can see. Go and get some blocks from the toy box!"

The little boy looked around the toy box and found lots of blocks that were available for him to play with. He quickly made a tall tower with all the blocks.

The dad said, "Now, my son, I want you to add more blocks on top to make it even taller!"

The little boy was a bit scared but he wanted to show his parents that he could do it. So, he dared to reach for more blocks, and he added some on top.

The result was incredible! The tower was so tall the little boy had to almost stand on his tip toes to look at the top.

The dad smiled and said, "See, you dared to try something new, and you got a special result!"

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Ella. Ella was very excited because she was going to add something to her room. She had a frame that was very unusual. It was green and sparkly. She was so excited.

She took the frame and put it up on the wall. It looked so wonderful! She was so happy with it.

Next, she decided to add something special to the frame. She chose a picture that was very special. It was a picture of her and her family. She carefully put it in the frame and it looked so nice!

When she was finished, she stepped back and admired her work. The frame looked so amazing! It made her room look very special and unusual.

Ella was so proud of her room and the special frame she had added. She smiled and hugged it tightly.

Once there was a boy named Tom. Tom liked to be outside playing games. But today he was feeling very lazy and he wanted to stay inside and sleep. Suddenly there was a knock at the door. Tom opened the door and saw a big man wearing a big hat. "Hello," the man said, "I have a gift for you." Tom was very excited. He bowed to say thank you and the man gave him a big gift. Tom opened the box and saw that it was a toy race car. He thanked the man again and waved goodbye. Tom was so happy that he made the race car zoom around the room. He was having so much fun that he almost forgot that he had been feeling lazy.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play together. One day, their mom made some yummy pastries for them. She put them on a plate and told them to share.

Tom saw a big pastry with chocolate on top. He wanted it very much. He grabbed it and ran to his room. Lily saw him and felt envious. She wanted the chocolate pastry too.

She followed him and knocked on his door. "Tom, give me some of your pastry!" she said. "No, it's mine!" Tom said. He locked the door and ate the pastry.

Lily was very angry. She started to yell. "Tom, you are mean! You are not sharing! Mom, Tom is not sharing!"

Mom heard Lily's yell. She came to see what was wrong. She saw Tom's door was locked and Lily was crying. She knocked on Tom's door. "Tom, open the door. Why are you not sharing with your sister?" she said.

Tom felt ashamed. He knew he was wrong. He opened the door and saw Mom and Lily. He saw Lily's sad face. He felt sorry for her.

He gave her half of his pastry. "I'm sorry, Lily. I was greedy. Here, you can have some of my pastry." he said.

Lily smiled. She took the pastry and hugged Tom. "Thank you, Tom. I'm sorry I yelled at you. You are a good brother." she said.

Mom was proud of them. She hugged them both. "You are good twins. I love you both. Now, let's go and have some milk with your pastries." she said.

They all went to the kitchen and enjoyed their pastries and milk. They were happy and shared.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was in a hurry. He needed to find a coin before bedtime.

He looked high and low all around his house, but he couldn't find it. So the boy thought it was time to go outside. He went to the park and looked for the coin. Suddenly, he saw something shiny in the sand. He picked it up. It was a heavy coin!

The boy was so happy that he jumped in the air and said yay! He had found his coin. He quickly ran home and put the coin in his pocket. Then he said goodnight and went to bed.

Mrs Johnson had a big juicy melon. It was so big it was hard to carry! She was very proud of it, because it was a special melon - a rich melon. Mrs Johnson was excited to number how many slices she could get from it.

Mrs Johnson took her knife and carefully started to number the slices. 1, 2, 3, 4... It seemed like the melon would never end! 10, 11, 12. Finally she had enough slices for everyone in the family.

Mrs Johnson handed each slice to her children. They were so excited to try it. Everyone agreed it was the most delicious melon they'd ever tasted. It was definitely a very rich melon!

Mrs Johnson was so proud of the melon, she shared it with all the neighbours. Even they couldn't believe how sweet and juicy it was. From then on, Mrs Johnson was the best melon-chooser in the town!

One sunny day, Betty went outside to play. She saw a cube and she was so excited. She invited her friend Daisy over to play with her.

Betty and Daisy played for a long time. They built towers with the cube and rolled it around the backyard. Soon, they got a little too excited and accidentally knocked over their tower.

Betty and Daisy felt a bit guilty. They knew they shouldn't play too hard with the cube. Betty gave Daisy a hug and told her it was OK. Then they cleaned up the cube and put it back in the same place.

At the end of the day, they invited each other over to play again the next day. They both smiled and waved goodbye, feeling happy and much less guilty.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a soft, red velvet blanket. Lily loved her blanket very much. She would wrap it around her when she was cold or when she was sad.

One day, Lily heard a scary noise outside her room. She was afraid, so she wrapped her velvet blanket around her. She went to her mom and dad's room to tell them about the scary noise.

"Mom, Dad, I heard a scary noise," said Lily. Her mom and dad hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. We will keep you safe."

They all went back to Lily's room and listened for the noise. But the noise was gone. Lily felt safe with her mom, dad, and her velvet blanket. From that day on, whenever she heard a scary noise, she would wrap her blanket around her and remember that her mom and dad would always keep her safe.

Once, there was a little girl named Lisa. She was only three years old. One day, it started raining very hard outside of her window. Lisa looked out the window and saw her trees and the street shivering in the wind.

Lisa's mom came into her bedroom and said, "Lisa, we need to take a shower so that you don't get cold." Lisa's eyes lit up and she shouted, "Yay! A shower!" She was excited to play in the water.

Her mom took her into the bathroom and helped her undress. Lisa stepped into the shower and the warm water made her shiver with delight. She started splashing around, playing with the water and the foam.

After the shower, Lisa dried herself and put on some warm clothes. She ran to her bedroom and said to her mom, "Let's go outside and play!" Her mom smiled and told her, "We can go outside after I finish cooking dinner. It will be slow, so you must be patient."

Once upon a time there was a white angel. The angel was small and happy. She was always flying high and looking after the world.

One day she was flying near a big lake. She wanted to take a rest so she slipped and fell into the lake. The angel was very scared as the lake was very deep.

But then her angel friends came to help. They flew down from the sky and gave her a big hug. With their help, the angel felt safe and slowly she was able to climb out of the lake.

As she flew away in the sky, the white angel knew that her friends would always be there to help her if she ever slipped again.

Once upon a time, there was a huge musician. He wanted to take a walk in the park and play some music. He grabbed his guitar and headed off. As he walked, he saw lots of animals. He waved to a cow, high-fived a sheep and gave some breadcrumbs to a hungry duck. Soon he came to a big tree in the middle of the park. He decided to take a seat there and strum his guitar.

Before long, a group of children came to join him. They were very excited to hear the music. The musician strummed away and the children clapped along. It was so much fun! After a few songs, the children took out a jump rope and started to play. The huge musician jumped in and started to skip too. He was having a great time!

Soon all the animals gathered round to watch. The cow mooed, the sheep baaed and the duck quacked. The huge musician felt so happy. He was making lots of new friends. Everyone said goodbye to the musician as the sun began to set. He bid them all farewell and took his guitar off home.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the park. He would run around and pick up sticks and rocks. One day, Timmy saw a big pile of grass. He decided to throw the grass up in the air and watch it fall down.

As Timmy was playing, he saw a man walking towards him. The man looked sad and tired. Timmy's mom always told him to be kind to others, so Timmy went up to the man and said hello. The man smiled and thanked Timmy for being friendly.

Timmy felt grateful that he could make someone happy just by saying hello. He remembered the pile of grass he had thrown earlier and had an idea. He asked the man if he wanted to play with him and throw the grass up in the air. The man's face lit up and he said yes.

Timmy and the man played together for a while and had a lot of fun. As the man was leaving, he thanked Timmy again for being so kind. Timmy felt happy that he could make a new friend and was grateful for the fun they had playing together.

Once, there was an intelligent bird. It loved blueberries, and it scaled up very high in the sky. It soared across the sky, flapping its wings and enjoying the sunshine.

The bird was so fast and so high, it could almost feel the ocean. It flew all day, never stopping for a break. Finally, it saw a big field of blueberries.

The bird swooped down and gorged on the sweet and delicious fruit. It ate as much as it could, and kept on soaring. It flew faster and faster, until it felt like it was going to burst.

Finally, the bird had enough of flying and it flew to the ground. It snuggled down in the shade of a nearby tree and started to nap. Satisfied, the intelligent bird enjoyed the rest of its day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big box of colorful blocks. One day, she wanted to make a figure of a cat. She tried to put the blocks together, but it didn't look like a cat. She felt sad.

Her mom asked her, "What's wrong, Lily?"

"I can't make a cat figure," Lily replied.

Her mom said, "Let's mix the blocks up and try again."

So they mixed up the blocks and started over. This time, Lily was able to make a cat figure that she was proud of. She was happy again and showed her mom the cat figure. Her mom smiled and said, "Great job, Lily!"

Once upon a time, there was a mouse who wanted to explore the world. He saw a big lock on a door, with a keyhole big enough for him to fit into. He decided to take a closer look.

The mouse examined the lock with his paws. He noticed it was very hard and he wasn't sure how he could get through. Then, he spotted a small, soft black key. He wondered what it could do. The mouse grabbed the tiny key and put it in the keyhole. He heard a loud click, and the lock opened. He was excited! He could now explore the world.

He smiled and said, “Thank you, little key!”

Once there was a thin dog called Spot. Spot wanted to be strong and healthy, so he started to do exercises. Every day he would do sit ups and push ups and jog for a short time. Spot kept doing exercises and became stronger and stronger. Every day he got a little bit thicker. He loved feeling strong and healthy. One day he ran so fast the wind blew back his ears! Spot was the strongest and healthiest dog around. He knew that exercises were the way to stay healthy and happy.

Lily and Tom were playing in the garden. They liked to run, jump and hide behind the trees. Lily saw a big box near the fence. She ran to it and opened it. Inside, she found a soft blanket, a bottle of oil and a book with pictures of animals.

"Look, Tom, what I found!" she called to her friend.

Tom came to see. He was curious. He picked up the book and opened it. He saw a picture of a cat. The cat was lying on its back and had a smile on its face. Under the picture, there was a word: massage.

"What is massage?" Tom asked.

Lily shrugged. She did not know. She took the bottle of oil and opened it. It smelled nice. She poured some oil on her hand and rubbed it on Tom's arm.

"Maybe massage is when you make someone feel good with oil," she guessed.

Tom giggled. He liked the feeling of the oil on his skin. He took the bottle and poured some oil on Lily's hair.

"Maybe massage is when you make someone's hair shiny with oil," he said.

Lily laughed. She felt the oil dripping down her face. She looked at Tom. He looked silly with oil on his arm and his shirt. She took the blanket and wrapped it around them.

"Maybe massage is when you make someone warm and cozy with a blanket," she said.

They hugged each other and smiled. They felt happy and relaxed. They did not notice that someone was watching them from the window. It was Lily's mom. She had put the box in the garden as a surprise for them. She had hoped they would enjoy the massage kit. She saw them covered in oil and wrapped in the blanket. She shook her head and smiled.

"Those silly kids," she said. "They have their own idea of massage. But they look so cute and sweet. I'll let them have their fun." She went to the kitchen to make some cookies for them. She decided to appear later and join them for a snack.

Tom and Lily were playing with their toys in the living room. Tom had a big box of soldiers and Lily had a small doll. Tom liked to make his soldiers march and fight and Lily liked to dress her doll and comb her hair.

"Can I play with your soldiers, Tom?" Lily asked.

"No, they are mine. You have your doll," Tom said.

"But I want to play with your soldiers. They look fun. Please, Tom," Lily said.

Tom thought for a moment. He did not want to share his soldiers, but he also did not want to make Lily sad. He had an idea.

"OK, you can play with my soldiers, but only if you make them clean. They are very dirty from the war. You have to wash them and dry them and brush them," Tom said.

Lily agreed. She took some soldiers and put them in a bowl of water. She used a sponge and soap to scrub them. Then she took them out and wrapped them in a towel. She used a comb to smooth their hair.

"Look, Tom, I made your soldiers clean. They are shiny and soft. Can I play with them now?" Lily said.

Tom looked at his soldiers. They did not look like soldiers anymore. They looked like dolls. He felt angry and sad.

"No, you ruined my soldiers. You made them look silly. They are not soldiers anymore. They are dolls. Give them back to me," Tom said.

He grabbed his soldiers from Lily and put them back in his box. Lily started to cry.

"Tom, you are mean. I just wanted to play with you. I did what you said. I made your soldiers clean. Why are you mad at me?" Lily said.

Tom did not answer. He turned away from Lily and played with his soldiers by himself. He did not notice that some of his soldiers were missing buttons and belts and hats. He did not notice that Lily was still crying. He did not notice that his mother was watching them from the kitchen. He did not notice that he was not having fun.

Once upon a time, there was a big horse named Jack. Jack loved to run in the fields and eat lots of hay. One day, Jack felt very tired and couldn't run as fast as he used to. His friend, a little bird named Lily, noticed that Jack didn't look fit anymore.

Lily flew down to Jack and warned him, "Hey Jack, you don't look so good. Are you feeling okay?" Jack replied, "No, I feel very tired and my legs hurt." Lily said, "I think you need to rest and eat some healthy food to get fit again."

Jack listened to Lily's advice and rested for a few days. He ate lots of carrots and apples, which made him feel much better. Soon, Jack was back to running in the fields with Lily flying beside him. From then on, Jack made sure to take care of himself and eat healthy food so he could always be fit and strong.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sarah. One day Sarah decided to travel. She packed her bag and hopped into a car. She drove and drove until it was dark.

Sarah stopped at a hotel and went to sleep. The next morning she set out again. After a while, Sarah went to the movies. She watched a movie and it was so quiet! When the movie was over, Sarah traveled back home.

She had a great time traveling and watching the movie. The whole time she was quiet, so she wasn't in trouble.

When Sarah got home, she told her family all about her travels. They were so happy she had a great time!

Once upon a time, in a regular forest, there lived a little rabbit. The rabbit loved to move and play with his friends. One day, he met a big, wild bear who was new to the forest.

"Hello, I am rabbit," said the little rabbit. "Do you want to play with me?"

"Sure, I am bear," said the wild bear. "I like to move too!"

So, rabbit and bear played all day. They moved through the forest, hopping and running. They were very happy.

As the sun went down, rabbit and bear were tired. They said goodbye and went to their homes. Now, they were not just regular animals in the forest. They were best friends.

One day, a little girl named Sue was playing in her room. She saw a big curtain near her bed. Sue felt comfortable sitting near the curtain. She liked how soft it was.

Sue's mom came into the room and said, "Sue, it's time to eat." But Sue did not want to eat. She refused to go to the table. Sue said, "No, I want to play with the curtain."

Sue's mom thought for a moment. Then she said, "How about we eat near the curtain? That way, you can still play after we eat." Sue liked the idea. So, they ate near the curtain, and Sue was happy.

Once there were two friends. They were very curious. They wanted to explore the world! So one day, they decided to go outside and play.

They saw a big pile of soil. It was full of bugs, plants, and rocks. It looked like lots of fun. So they decided to introduce themselves to the soil!

First, they scooped a handful of soil and put it in their hands. Then, they said hello! The soil was so soft and fuzzy. They laughed and laughed, it felt funny!

They talked to the soil and played for a long time. Eventually, it was time for them to go, but they promised to come back soon and said goodbye.

The two friends were so happy and excited about their adventure! They had a lot of fun, and would never forget their new friend - the soil!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys in the bathtub. One day, he found an ancient toy boat in his toy box. It was very old and had lots of scratches.

Timmy's mom came into the bathroom and asked, "What are you playing with, Timmy?"

"I found an ancient boat in my toy box!" exclaimed Timmy.

"Wow, that's really cool," said his mom. "Can I see it?"

Timmy handed the boat to his mom and she examined it carefully. Then, she gently released it into the water. Timmy watched as the boat floated around the bathtub. He was so happy to have found such a special toy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mommy, daddy, and her pet cat, Whiskers. Lily loved to play with Whiskers and eat yummy food.

One day, Lily's mommy made some rice for dinner. The rice was white and soft. Lily thought it looked very tasty. She decided she wanted to share her rice with Whiskers. But, she had to be careful because the rice was fragile and could break easily.

Lily took a small bowl and put some rice in it. She carried the bowl very slowly and carefully to Whiskers. Whiskers sniffed the rice and started to eat it. Lily was happy that she could share her dinner with her pet. They both enjoyed the rice and had a fun time together.

Once there was a girl, her name was Sue. Sue loved to explore.

One day Sue was walking in the park alone. She turned a corner and saw something strange. In the middle of the park, there was an empty house.

Sue walked up to the house and went inside. It was dark and cold, and when she turned around, she saw a ghost!

The ghost was not scary, he just wanted to play. He said, "Let’s play tag!".

So they ran and ran around the empty house. They laughed and played until it was time to go home.

Sue said goodbye to her new ghost friend and went home. And every time she visited the park, she knew her ghost friend was right there waiting for her!

Once there was a little girl named Lilly. She loved to play and have fun with her friends. One day, Lilly wanted to have a party. She went around her house cleaning and tidying to make it ready for her guests. It was hard work, but Lilly struggled and eventually the house looked just right.

When the party started, Lilly was so happy. Everyone came with a smile and they all had such a great time! They played games with balloons and ate delicious snacks. Everyone said that it was the most fun they had ever had.

Finally, the party was over. It was time to tidy up the house. Lilly worked hard with her friends, but it was difficult. They struggled to clean and get everything back in its place. After a lot of effort, Lilly's house was tidy again.

Lilly was very proud and happy. She was glad she had worked so hard to make the party a success. It was a fun day for everyone!

Once upon a time, there was a little pig. The pig was very small and cute. It loved to play in the mud all day. One day, the pig found a magic seed. It planted the seed and watered it every day. Soon, a big tree grew from the seed. The pig was very happy and fairies came to visit the tree. They said the pig was very kind and gave it a magic apple. The pig ate the apple and grew big and strong. Now, the pig could play in the mud all day and not get tired.

Thomas was feeling lucky. He was three years old. He lived in a house with his mom and dad. They were all happy.

One day, Thomas heard a loud noise outside. He ran to the window and looked out. He saw a big truck outside. Thomas thought it was funny.

The noise got louder and Thomas started to feel scared. He screamed. Mom and dad ran to Thomas. They hugged him and calmed him down.

Thomas was lucky. It was just a construction truck. The truck was making a lot of loud noises because the workers were building a new house.

Thomas felt better. He was not scared anymore. Mom and dad smiled. They were so happy to see Thomas safe.

Once upon a time, in a small stable, there lived a rare, big horse named Bob. Bob was very special because he could talk to his human friends. Bob loved to eat apples and carrots all day long.

One sunny day, Bob's friend, a little girl named Lily, came to the stable to feed him. She brought a big bag of apples and carrots for him to eat. Bob was very happy and said, "Thank you, Lily! I love to eat these."

As they spent the day together, Lily and Bob played in the field near the stable. They laughed and had so much fun. When the sun went down, Lily said, "Goodbye, Bob. I will come back soon to play and bring more apples and carrots for you to eat." Bob smiled and said, "I can't wait, Lily. I love when you visit me!"

Once there was a little boy who lived in a very distant place. He saw a journey in the sky and wanted to join it. So he dropped his stuff he was carrying and flew through the air. He traveled high in the sky and saw many new things. He even saw the sun and the moon in the sky. After a long journey, he reached his destination and was so happy. He had enjoyed his long and distant journey so much.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little dog named Max. Max loved to play with his toys and run around in the yard. One day, Max found a cable lying on the ground. It was a powerful cable that helped the house have light and sound.

Max thought the cable would be fun to chew. So, he started to chew the cable. But, his mom saw him and said, "No, Max! Don't chew the cable! It is powerful and can hurt you." Max stopped and looked at his mom. He did not want to get hurt.

From that day, Max learned not to chew powerful cables. He played with his toys and stayed safe. The moral of this story is to listen to our parents because they help keep us safe from things that can hurt us.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jane and Pete. Jane wanted to go on a vacation but Pete thought it was too expensive. Jane was so sad. She asked Pete why he was being so rude. To make her happy, Pete said he was only joking. Jane smiled and then they decided to go on a vacation.

The next day, they both packed their bags and got ready for their trip. Jane was so excited. They booked a flight and flew to a beautiful place far away. Jane and Pete had a great time during their vacation. They went to the beach, played in the sun and laughed a lot.

Finally, after a happy week, it was time to go home. Jane and Pete said goodbye and hugged each other. They promised to take another vacation soon!

Tim and Lily were twins who liked to play outside. They had a big tree in their yard with many branches. They wanted to climb the tree and see the sky.

They asked their mom if they could climb the tree. Mom said yes, but be careful. She gave them a rope and a helmet. She said the rope and the helmet would help them be safe.

Tim and Lily put on their helmets and tied the rope to their waists. They started to climb the tree. They used their hands and feet to grab the branches. They felt mighty and brave.

They climbed higher and higher until they reached the top. They saw the birds and the clouds and the sun. They smiled and waved to their mom. They were very happy.

But then, Lily felt something hard and sharp in her mouth. She touched it with her tongue. It was a tooth. Her tooth was loose. She wiggled it with her finger. It came out. She held it in her hand.

She showed it to Tim. Tim was surprised. He said, "Wow, you lost a tooth! That means the tooth fairy will come tonight. She will give you a coin for your tooth. You are lucky!"

Lily was excited. She said, "Really? That's awesome! Let's go down and tell mom. Maybe she has a box for my tooth."

They climbed down the tree carefully. They untied the rope and took off their helmets. They ran to their mom and showed her the tooth. Mom hugged them and praised them. She said, "You did a great job climbing the tree. And you lost a tooth. That's a big day for you. I'm so proud of you!"

She gave them a small box and a glass of water. She said, "Put your tooth in the box and put it under your pillow. The tooth fairy will find it when you sleep. Now, drink some water and wash your mouth. Then, you can have a snack and rest."

Tim and Lily did as mom said. They put the tooth in the box and the box under the pillow. They drank some water and washed their mouth. They had a snack and rested. They were tired but happy. They dreamed of the tree and the tooth fairy. They were mighty twins.

Lily and Ben like to play with blocks. They make houses, towers, bridges and cars with the blocks. Sometimes they use stickers to make their blocks look more fun. They have stickers of animals, flowers, stars and letters.

One day, Lily has an idea. She says to Ben, "Let's design a symbol with our blocks. A symbol is something that means something else. Like a heart means love, or a smiley face means happy."

Ben thinks that sounds interesting. He says, "OK, how do we design a symbol?"

Lily says, "We can use different colors and shapes of blocks to make a symbol. We can use our stickers too. We can make a symbol of something we like, or something we are good at, or something we want to be."

Ben says, "That sounds fun. But it also sounds difficult. How do we know what symbol to make?"

Lily says, "We can use our imagination. We can think of something that makes us feel something, or something that reminds us of something. Then we can try to make it with our blocks and stickers."

Ben says, "OK, let's try it. I want to make a symbol of a superhero. Because I like superheroes, and I want to be brave and strong like them."

Lily says, "I want to make a symbol of a rainbow. Because I like rainbows, and they make me feel happy and hopeful."

They start to design their symbols with their blocks and stickers. They use red, blue, yellow and green blocks to make a superhero cape and a rainbow. They use stickers of eyes, mouths, stars and letters to make a superhero face and a rainbow word. They work hard and have fun.

When they finish, they show each other their symbols. They are proud of their work. They say, "Wow, you did a great job! I like your symbol. It looks like what you wanted to make. It tells me something about you."

They smile and hug. They say, "Thank you. I like your symbol too. It looks like what you wanted to make. It tells me something about you."

They put their symbols on the wall. They look at them and feel happy. They say, "We are good at designing symbols. We are good friends."

Once upon a time, there was a cute little dog named Max. Max loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Max saw a trail in the woods. He wanted to explore the trail and see where it went.

Max asked his friends, the birds, to help him. They all agreed to help Max. Together, they went down the trail. Max was very happy to have his friends with him. They walked and walked, and Max was very excited.

At last, Max and his friends succeeded in finding the end of the trail. They found a beautiful park with lots of trees and flowers. Max was so happy that he wagged his tail and played with his friends all day long.

Once there was a baby. He was so small and weak. He was always looking for something to belong to.

One day he met a dog. The dog was friendly and she gave the baby a gentle touch. The baby felt like it belonged.

The dog and the baby started playing together every day. They laughed, ran and cuddled. They were both so happy.

But one day the baby was feeling weak. He had a stomach ache and couldn't play. The dog knew something was wrong, so she gave him a gentle touch.

The baby felt better and he knew he belonged with the dog. They were the best of friends and had lots of fun.

They would always be there for each other. Together, their friendship would never be weak.

Today, Max lost a zoom. He had been playing with it in the backyard and it flew away. He ran after it, but it was too far away. He was so sad!

Max was very loud about it. He shouted and yelled, especially when it flew far away and over the trees. But he couldn’t get it back no matter how loud he was.

Max ran into the house and he told his mom what had happened. His mom was very understanding. She comforted him and told him that it was ok to feel sad.

Max made a plan. He wanted to make a new zoom! He drew a picture of it, and it looked really cool.

Max and his mom made the new zoom together. They used old newspapers, tape and string. It flew far and high, just like the old zoom! Max was so happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had two parents who loved her very much. One day, Lily's parents took her to a restaurant.

Lily saw a cute little puppy outside the restaurant and wanted to take it home. She asked her parents if they could get the puppy.

Her parents said, "No, we can't get the puppy. But we can order some yummy food for you to eat."

Lily was sad about the puppy, but happy about the food. She ordered some chicken nuggets and fries. They were delicious!

After they finished eating, they went home. Lily was still thinking about the adorable puppy. She asked her parents, "Can we get a puppy someday?"

Her parents replied, "Maybe someday, but for now, we just want to enjoy spending time with our adorable Lily."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was shy and didn't like to talk to other kids. One day, Timmy went to the park and saw some other kids playing soccer. Timmy liked soccer, but he was too shy to ask if he could play with them.

Suddenly, one of the kids kicked the ball towards Timmy. Timmy was surprised, but he kicked the ball back. The other kids were happy and asked Timmy to play with them. Timmy felt happy too and played with them until they won the game.

At the end of the game, the other kids cheered and shouted "Victory!" Timmy felt proud of himself and wasn't shy anymore. From that day on, Timmy played soccer with the other kids every day and they always had fun together.

Sara and Tom like to play soccer in the park. They have a ball and two cones for the goal. Sara is good at kicking the ball. Tom is good at catching the ball.

One day, they meet a new friend, Lily. Lily has long hair and a pretty dress. She wants to play with them. Sara and Tom say yes.

"Can I be the goalie?" Lily asks.

"Sure," Tom says. "But you have to kneel on the ground and use your hands."

Lily nods and kneels behind the cones. Sara and Tom take turns to kick the ball. Lily tries to catch it, but it is hard. The ball is fast and bouncy. Sometimes it goes over her head. Sometimes it goes under her arms. Sometimes it goes past her side.

"Good try, Lily!" Sara and Tom say. They are nice and do not laugh.

Lily feels sad. She wants to be good at soccer too. She does not like to kneel and miss the ball.

"Can I kick the ball too?" Lily asks.

"Sure," Sara says. "But you have to run and use your feet."

Lily nods and stands up. She runs to the ball and kicks it. But it is hard too. The ball is heavy and round. Sometimes it goes too far. Sometimes it goes too near. Sometimes it goes the wrong way.

"Good try, Lily!" Sara and Tom say. They are nice and do not laugh.

Lily feels happy. She likes to run and kick the ball. She does not mind if she misses the goal. She has fun with her new friends. They play soccer until it is time to go home. They say bye and hug.

"See you tomorrow, Lily!" Sara and Tom say.

"See you tomorrow, Sara and Tom!" Lily says.

She smiles and waves. She likes soccer and her pretty dress. She likes Sara and Tom. They are her friends.

The sun was beginning to set and the sky began to turn a beautiful pink. Little Adam was sitting by the pond, watching the water and listening to the birds chirping in the trees. Suddenly, a splash interrupted the quiet evening. Adam got excited and quickly ran to the edge of the pond.

There was a little caterpillar swimming in the water and it was having a difficult time. Adam got on his knees and reached out his hand to help it.

"Hey, little bug!" he said. "Let me help you!"

The caterpillar crawled onto his hand and Adam carefully removed it from the water. He then set it down onto a rock near the pond.

The caterpillar thanked Adam, grateful for his help. Adam smiled and said, "You're very welcome!" Then, with a skip and a jump, he ran off to tell his mom about his adventure!

Johnny was a timid young boy. One day he went for a walk and he stumbled in the long grass. He was so fearful, he didn't know what to do. Johnny slowly got up and looked around. He saw a big old clock standing nearby. He had never seen a clock before, so he slowly stepped closer. As the clock slowly ticked, he heard a voice inside that whispered: "Time passes slowly, but never stops."

Suddenly Johnny felt less fearful, and he smiled. He understood what the voice meant. He knew he ought to use his precious time wisely. Forgetting about his stumble, Johnny went of on his way. He felt excited to explore the world, confident that time was on his side.

One day, Mommy and Max went walking in the park. Max saw something funny while they were walking - it was a pepper! He ran over to get a closer look.

Max asked Mommy, "What's that funny thing, Mommy?"

Mommy chuckled and said, "That's a pepper, Max!"

Max was excited and decided to try and pick it up, but he stumbled and fell. Mommy rushed over to help him get back up.

Max looked up at Mommy with a big smile and said, "The pepper was funny!"

Mommy laughed and said, "Yes, it was! Now let's go home, okay Max?"

Max nodded his head and held Mommy's hand as they walked out of the park, quietly dreaming of the funny pepper they had seen.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She wanted to make something special for her mummy's birthday. She looked around her room for something she could make.

She spotted a pair of scissors. She picked them up. She knew scissors could cut things and make cool shapes. She was so excited.

Lucy looked around her room and saw lots of paper. She chose a piece of pink paper and offered it to the scissors. She carefully cut out a nice shape.

When she was done, Lucy tidied up the room. She collected all the scraps of paper and put them in the bin.

When Mummy came home, Lucy proudly presented her with the special shape she made. Mummy was so happy and gave Lucy a big hug.

"Look Mommy, a trip!” three year old Tom shouted, pointing at a bright train up ahead.

His mom smiled. "Yes, let's go! Come on, let's run and reach it!"

Tom clapped his hands and ran as fast as his little legs could go, excitedly trying to reach the bright train. But it was too far away. He huffed and puffed, but he couldn't reach it.

Tom's mom put her arms around him. "It's alright, sweetie. If we try hard enough, we'll be able to reach it next time!"

Tom smiled. "Okay, Mommy. I will try hard and reach it next time!"

Tom and his mom walked back hand in hand, looking forward to their next trip.

Once upon a time, there was a little crab named Timmy. Timmy loved to race with his friends on the beach. One day, Timmy saw a shiny oyster on the sand. He wanted to show it to his friends, but a seagull swooped down and snatched it away. Timmy was sad and angry.

He asked his friends to help him get the oyster back. They came up with a plan to distract the seagull while Timmy snatched the oyster. It worked! Timmy got the oyster back and felt fine again. He shared the oyster with his friends and they all had a yummy snack.

From that day on, Timmy learned that sometimes you have to work together to solve problems and that sharing is always a good idea. They continued to race and have fun on the beach. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a peaceful place. A little boy was walking through the peaceful place. He was looking for something. Suddenly he saw a lollipop! He got so excited. He walked over and began to poke the lollipop with his finger. He was curious to see what would happen. Suddenly, the lollipop started to spin around and around! He was so surprised. He wanted to play more with the lollipop, so he poked it again. Again, the lollipop started to spin. He had so much fun playing with the lollipop. Soon, his mom called him and he had to rush back home. But before he left, he gave the lollipop one last poke and then said goodbye. He went back home feeling happy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lila. She had an uncle who she loved very much, who always took her to the park to play. The park was very special to Lila, and it seemed like nothing could ever keep them apart. But one day, something happened that made Lila regret her decision to visit the park with her uncle.

As they were walking, Lila's uncle saw a large bird on the path and he got very excited. He pointed to it and said, "Let's go closer, so we can have a better look!" Lila was scared and she said, "No, I don't want to go any closer, it looks too big and dangerous."

But her uncle didn't listen and started walking closer to the bird. Lila was very scared and went back quickly, but she looked back just in time to see that her uncle was in trouble. The bird had flown away, but Lila's uncle had fallen over and was on the ground, hurt.

Lila ran back and helped him to stand up. He had hurt his arm and he was limping a bit but he smiled at Lila and said "That was a close call! I'm glad you're safe."

Lila regretted not listening to her instincts. Despite being scared, she had still allowed her uncle to go closer. From that day onward, Lila knew that she should always trust her gut and

Lily and Tom are twins. They like to play and have fun. They are very happy because they are going on holiday with Mum and Dad. They pack their bags and toys and get in the car.

The car goes very fast on the road. Lily and Tom look out the window and see many things. They see cows and sheep and trees and houses. They tell each other what they see and make up stories. They sing songs and laugh.

After a long time, the car stops at a big house. Mum and Dad say this is where they will stay for the holiday. They get out of the car and take their bags and toys. They go inside the house and look around. It is very nice and cosy.

But there is a problem. The house has a smelly smell. It smells like old socks and cheese and fish. Lily and Tom do not like the smell. They cover their noses and say yuck. Mum and Dad do not like the smell either. They say sorry and look for the source of the smell.

They find it in the kitchen. It is a big bin full of rubbish. Someone forgot to take it out before they left. Mum and Dad take the bin outside and throw it away. They open the windows and spray some perfume. The smell goes away and the house is fresh and clean.

Lily and Tom are happy again. They say thank you and give Mum and Dad a hug. They unpack their bags and toys and choose their rooms. They are ready to enjoy their holiday. They hope to see more cows and sheep and trees and houses. They hope to have more fun and make more stories. They hope the house does not get smelly again.

Once there was a brave boy and he wanted to try something new. He wanted to ride his bike without training wheels. His mom encouraged him, telling him he could do it.

He got on his bike and he pushed himself forward. He wobbled and fell a few times, but he kept trying. He had to make a few turns, and it was difficult.

He tried and tried, and eventually he found success! He was able to ride his bike without the training wheels! He was so proud of himself, he gave himself a big hug.

His mom was so proud of him too. She applauded and cheered him on. He was so encouraged that he kept riding, showing off his new skill to everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a thin man who was walking by a river. The river was so high that it nearly reached the top of the bank. He looked out into the flood and saw a little green frog.

The frog called out to him and asked for help. The man nodded his head and smiled. He reached out his hand and lowered it into the water. He gently scooped up the frog and held it in his palm.

The little frog was so grateful that it thanked the man by giving him something special. It changed into a sparkling coin that twinkled in the afternoon sun. The man was so happy that he held his coin up in the sky and smiled.

From then on, the thin man and the little frog were best friends. Every day they would go down to the river and share stories. The frog would tell stories about what was happening in the deep water, and the man would tell stories about all of his adventures. They were the very best of friends.

Once upon a time there was an embarrassed structure. It was all alone in the middle of a field. Every morning the structure wanted to spring, but it had never done it before. One day, it finally gathered all its courage and said "I'm going to spring!" It took a deep breath and jumped. Its jump was so high that it almost touched the sky. It was so excited that is was not embarrassed anymore. From then on, the structure loved to spring every day and it lived happily ever after!

Once, there was a big mysterious earthquake. Everyone in the town was scared. They didn't know what it was. Milly was only three years old. She was very scared too.

Milly ran and asked her Mommy, "What was that?" Mommy said, "Don't worry. It was just an earthquake."

Milly was still scared, so Mommy said, "Let's talk about it. That will make you feel better." So Milly and Mommy talked and talked about the mysterious earthquake. They talked about how it made the ground shake.

Soon, Milly wasn't scared anymore. She knew that earthquakes could sometimes be scary, but they were nothing to be scared of.

The end.

Lily and Anna were best friends. They liked to play with dolls and dress up. One day, they found a pretty box under Lily's bed. It had a lock and a key.

"What is in the box?" Anna asked.

"I don't know. It is a secret," Lily said. She took the key and opened the box. Inside, there were many shiny things. There were rings, necklaces, bracelets, and earrings.

"Wow, they are so pretty!" Anna said. She reached for a ring.

"Stop! Don't touch them!" Lily said. She pulled the box away from Anna. "They are mine! They are from my grandma. She gave them to me before she went away. She said they are very special and I have to keep them safe."

"But I just want to look at them. Please, can I try one on?" Anna said. She felt sad and angry. She thought Lily was being mean and selfish.

"No, you can't! They are not for you. They are only for me. Go away!" Lily said. She closed the box and put it back under the bed. She turned her back to Anna.

Anna felt tears in her eyes. She did not want to play with Lily anymore. She got up and ran out of the room. She did not say goodbye.

Lily heard Anna leave. She felt lonely and sorry. She did not mean to hurt Anna. She loved her friend. She wanted to share her pretty things with her. But she was afraid to lose them. She remembered how her grandma hugged her and told her to take good care of them. She missed her grandma very much.

She got the box out again and opened it. She looked at the shiny things. They were pretty, but they did not make her happy. She wished Anna was there with her. She wanted to say sorry and give her a hug. She wanted to tell her the secret of the box. She wanted to play with her again.

She took the key and ran after Anna. She hoped she would find her and make up with her. She hoped Anna would still be her friend. She hoped they could seat together and look at the pretty things and smile.

Once upon a time, there was a mummy and a daddy. They had a little boy called Jack. Every day, mummy and daddy would prepare Jack's breakfast. Today was special. He was getting ready to go to the park.

Daddy said to Jack, "Let's go get ready for the park! What do you want to bring?" Jack said he wanted to bring his toy. He had a very special toy - a blue car. Daddy said, "Let's go."

Jack, Mummy, and Daddy got ready and went to the park. Jack ran around and explored. He saw a lot of colourful flowers, so he picked some for Mummy. Mummy thanked him with a big hug.

Jack and his family spent a peaceful afternoon in the park. Jack played with his toy and ran around and laughed. He felt very happy! When the sun started to set, they prepared to go home.

Tom and Amy like to play with their toys. They have many toys of different colors and shapes. Sometimes they play a game where they sort their toys into groups. They put the red toys in one box, the blue toys in another box, and so on.

One day, they decided to play the sorting game again. But they had a problem. They had only four boxes, but they had five colors of toys. They had red, blue, yellow, green, and purple toys. How could they sort them?

Tom said, "Let's put the purple toys with the blue toys. They are both dark colors."

Amy said, "No, let's put the purple toys with the red toys. They are both bright colors."

They argued for a long time. They could not agree on how to sort the purple toys. They started to get angry and sad. They did not want to play the game anymore.

Then, their mom came in. She saw them fighting over the toys. She said, "What is wrong, Tom and Amy? Why are you not having fun?"

They told her about their problem. They said they had no box for the purple toys.

Mom said, "I have an idea. Why don't you make a new box for the purple toys? You can use this old shoe box and some stickers. You can decorate it however you like."

Tom and Amy liked mom's idea. They said, "Thank you, mom. That is a good idea."

They took the shoe box and the stickers. They worked together to make a beautiful box for the purple toys. They put stars, hearts, and flowers on it. They were happy and proud of their work.

They finished sorting their toys. They had five boxes, one for each color. They smiled and hugged each other. They said, "We did it. We sorted our toys. We had fun. We are good friends."

Jane was a three year old girl who loved to observe what was going on around her. One day, Jane noticed some construction on the street outside her home. She saw lots of workers wearing safety hats and bright, orange vests. She observed that they were building a new, tall building.

The workers smiled at Jane and waved as she watched them carefully. One worker in particular seemed to be quite successful. His foot was tapping the ground as he worked and Jane could see that he was getting things done faster than the others.

Jane continued to observe the successful worker and was impressed by how quickly he was able to do his job. She waved at him and smiled too. When he finished, he even gave Jane a thumbs up and a high-five. Jane was so proud of him.

As Jane waved goodbye to the successful worker, she thought to herself that she wanted to be like him one day – to be proud of her hard work and successful like he was.

Once upon a time there was a happy little bird. Every day the bird would dance around and around in the sky and her little wings would open wide and flap quickly. Everyone in the village watched the happy bird and smiled, because she looked so cheerful with her wings flying in the sky.

One day the bird saw a girl walking and decided to go down to talk to her. The bird landed on the girl's shoulder and smiled.

" Hi! What's your name?" asked the bird happily.

The girl was so surprised to see the bird that she didn't know what to say.

"My name is Clara. What's yours?" the girl finally replied.

"My name is Flutter and I love to dance in the sky. Will you dance with me?" the bird said.

Clara smiled and nodded. The two of them started hopping and twirling around in the sky. Clara had never seen anything so cheerful in her life. Everyone in the village watched with smiles on their faces and clapped as they danced.

After a while, Clara called out good bye to Flutter, and the little bird flew away, dancing in the sky as she went. The villagers waved goodbye, and the cheerful little bird was never seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who wanted to be something special when he grew up. He was very creative, and he dreamed of succeeding.

One day, the boy saw an old, broken freezer in the alley, and he had an idea. He went home and got some tools and supplies to fix it. Later, he proudly showed off his fixed freezer.

At first, his friends and family thought it was silly. But then they saw how happy the freezer made the boy. They all laughed and encouraged him to be creative.

The boy was so proud when his freezer worked. His friends and family said he had succeeded. With this success, the little boy felt sure that he could succeed at whatever he dreamed of.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy. His name was Tom. Tom loved to play in the woods.

One day, while Tom was playing out in the woods, he heard a loud noise. When he looked, he saw a witch. She said to Tom, "Come closer and I will spoil you".

Tom, who was only three years old, was scared but he wanted the witch to spoil him. So, he approached the witch.

The witch gave Tom some candy, and Tom ate it with joy. But then, the witch laughed and said, "Now, you are dead"! Tom quickly realised that the witch had spoiled him with a dead spell. He tried to run away but the witch used her magic to freeze him to the ground.

The witch then left and Tom was left completely alone in the woods, all alone and dead forever.

One day, John and his family went to the parade. It was a normal parade but so much fun! John saw lots of colors and people. He saw people marching and playing music. He was so excited that he cheered and clapped.

John's mommy gave him some money and told him he could pay for something at the parade. John went to a man who was selling toys. He chose a big teddy bear and gave him the money.

John was so happy when he got his teddy bear. He hugged it and waved to the parade. It was a normal parade, but for John it was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a kind girl named Lily. She loved to build sandcastles on the beach. One day, she met a boy named Jack who wanted to build a sandcastle too. They decided to build one together.

As they were building, Jack accidentally knocked down the tower that Lily had built. Lily was sad and wanted to label Jack as mean, but she remembered to be compassionate instead. She knew accidents happen and that Jack didn't mean to break her castle.

Together, they built a bigger and better castle than before. They had so much fun building it and even added a moat around it. They were happy and proud of what they had built together. From that day on, they became good friends and built many more sandcastles together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved colorful vehicles. One day, she saw a big red truck and said, "Wow, that's a pretty vehicle!" The truck driver smiled and said, "Yes, it is. Do you want to take a ride with me?"

Lily jumped in the truck and they started driving. She was so happy to be in a colorful vehicle. But suddenly, the truck started making a strange noise. Lily asked the driver, "What's happening?" The driver replied, "I don't know, but we need to stop."

The truck stopped in the middle of the road and Lily started to cry. The driver tried to start the vehicle again, but it wouldn't start. They were stuck. Lily was sad that she wouldn't be able to see any more colorful vehicles. The driver called for help, but it was too late. They were stuck there for a long time. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a smart boy. He wanted to have a special haircut so he went to the barber. When he got to the barber shop, he saw a big bowl filled with water and a toothbrush floating in it. He asked the barber what it was for and the barber said it was for cleaning his scissors. The boy was very excited and asked to try the toothbrush.

The barber smiled and said yes. The boy grabbed the toothbrush and began to splash the water all over the place. He was having so much fun that he did not want to stop. The barber just watched, laughing.

When he finished, the barber said that he had done a great job. He gave the boy a new haircut and the boy felt very smart. Everyone in the barber shop was so impressed with the boy's intelligence and creativity.

The boy thanked the barber for his special haircut and for trusting him with the toothbrush. The boy left the barber shop happy and feeling very intelligent.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a little girl named Lucy. Lucy had a lucky red hat that she loved to wear. She wore it every day and it made her very happy.

One day, Lucy was walking in the park when she saw a little boy crying. She walked up to him and asked, "Why are you sad?" The little boy looked up and said, "I lost my toy and I can't find it." Lucy wanted to help, so she told the boy, "Don't worry, I will help you look for it."

As they walked around the park, Lucy kept her eyes open for the lost toy. The boy kept his lips tight, trying not to cry. Finally, Lucy saw something shiny under a bush. She picked it up and showed it to the boy. "Is this your toy?" The boy's face lit up with a big smile. "Yes, that's it! Thank you so much!"

Lucy felt happy that she could help the boy find his toy. They played together in the park for the rest of the day, and they became good friends. From that day on, whenever Lucy wore her lucky red hat, she remembered the time she helped her friend and how good it felt to be kind.

Once upon a time there were two brothers who used to fight. One day they had an especially big fight and their Mommy got so mad she made them sit in the corner without dinner. As they both sat in their corners they could see each other, but neither wanted to make up. The Mommy decided to make them a special dinner to make them happy. She made them a big, delicious dinner of noodles and cheese. They couldn't believe how yummy it looked and when the Mommy saw them admiring it, she knew she had done the right thing.

The brothers both got up and hugged their Mommy, and finally made up. They both agreed not to fight so much and enjoyed their dinner together. Later on that night both brothers regretted fighting so much, but the delicious dinner sure was nice!

Once upon a time, there was a strong pebble. It wanted to be something more then just a pebble. It wanted to be a rock. Every day the pebble complained to the other rocks that it wanted to be like them. The rocks just laughed at the pebble and told it that it was too small and weak. The pebble didn't give up, no matter what the rocks said.

One day, a man came and took the pebble with him. The pebble didn't know what would happen to it but it was excited and hopeful. The man put the pebble in a strong machine and soon the pebble was becoming bigger and stronger. Finally, it looked just like the other rocks!

The pebble was so happy that it danced and sang with its new rock friends. It no longer had to complain about being small and weak, it was now just like the other rocks and could join their adventures.

Once there was a little girl named Emma who was three years old. She was very adventurous and loved to explore the world. One day, Emma decided to go to the beach. She packed her towel in her bag and ran out the door.

When she got to the beach, it was already very hot outside and the sand was covered with people. Emma decided to walk closer to the water and find a spot of her own. She saw a spot that looked nice, but it was very dirty and full of seaweed.

Emma started to pick up the seaweed and put it in her bag. She carried the towel over to the spot and spread it over the sand. Just as she sat down to relax, the wind started to blow and the towel flew away.

Emma ran after the towel and eventually caught it. It was now even dirtier and filthier than before. But Emma was determined to have a good time, so she used the towel to dry off her hands and face and enjoyed the rest of her day at the beach.

Once there was a little girl. Her name was Mary. Mary was a very curious girl and she wanted to explore the world. One day she went on an adventure.

She walked through the park and came to a lake. She saw lots of different types of animals around the lake. She was very excited!

Mary saw all the animals drinking from the lake. She wanted to have a drink too, so she bent down and took a sip. It was the most delicious drink she had ever had! She couldn't believe how tasty it was.

After she had her drink, Mary started counting the animals. She realized there were the same number of animals drinking from the lake. She thought that was really useful.

Mary was so happy that she had found such a wonderful thing. She smiled and went on her way!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat rice. One day, his mom made a big bowl of rice for lunch. The rice was white and clear, just the way Tim liked it.

Before Tim could eat the rice, he had to ask his mom for permission. "Mom, can I eat the rice now?" he asked. His mom looked at him and smiled. "Yes, Tim, I permit you to eat the rice," she said.

Tim was so happy. He sat down at the table and ate the clear rice. It was so yummy. He ate and ate until there was no more rice left in the bowl. Tim's mom was proud of him for asking permission and for eating all of his rice. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a rare bear. He had a big mouth and it made him sad. He often used to frown. He wanted to smile and be happy like the other animals, but he just couldn't.

One day, he found an old book. He opened it and inside he found a magical spell. The words were written in an old language, one he had never seen before. But he was still curious and he read the spell aloud.

Immediately, his nose began to twitch and his mouth began to stretch into a giant smile. He couldn't believe it! He was so happy he wanted to run around and play.

He was now the rarest and happiest bear in the world. Everywhere he went, other animals gasped at his huge smile. They were shocked that he was so happy.

From that day onwards, the bear never stopped smiling. He was the happiest bear ever - and never frowned again.

Davey was a cheerful little boy. He lived in a house full of fun things to do and he loved to explore. One day, Davey saw a shiny copper pipe inside a drawer and he decided to make something with it.

Davey took the pipe and wrapped it around a thin stick. He then made a small hole at one end of the pipe and added some string. He worked very hard, and soon enough he had made himself a little whistle.

Davey blew into it, and a delightful sound filled the room. He blew harder and harder and soon it seemed like the whole house was singing. Davey was so pleased with himself and he continued to make cheerful music with his new whistle.

Once upon a time there was a little rock. It was hot from sitting in the sun all day.

"This rock is so hot," said the little rock. It wanted to jump in the pool to cool off, but it couldn't move.

Then the wind blew. It reminded the rock of a time when it was young and could jump in the pool when it was hot. The rock wished it could still jump.

Suddenly, a butterfly came. It was big and very beautiful. It flew over to the rock and said, "I can help you, rock. I can carry you to the pool so you can cool off."

The rock was so happy! The butterfly swooped down and picked up the rock in its wings. Then, it flew to the pool and dropped the rock right into the cool water.

The rock splashed around and cooled off. "Thank you friend," it said to the butterfly. The butterfly chuckled and flew away.

The rock had a nice cool swim, and it was reminded to never forget to enjoy the little moments in life.
