Mom smiled, "That's very naughty Lucy, but make sure you don't go too far.”

Lucy smiled at her mom and jumped in the pond, making a big splash! She giggled and splashed some more with her spade.

Soon, mom called," Come out of the pond now Lucy! You've been naughty enough!”

Lucy stopped splashing and slowly climbed out of the pond. She hugged her mom and said, “I won't be naughty again.”

Mom smiled, “I know you won't, have fun playing with your spade in the sand.”

So Lucy ran back to the sand and played with her spade. She was no longer naughty, but she still had lots of fun splashing in the pond!

Once upon a time, there was a big old house. Inside the house lived two friends, Will and Andy. They were always looking for something fun to do.

One day, in the evening, they decided to make popcorn. So they put the popcorn in the pot and started to stare at it as it popped. Very soon, the kitchen was filled with the smell of the popcorn. It smelled so good!

Then, they put the popcorn in a bowl and started to eat. It was so yummy! They ate and ate until all the popcorn was gone.

But then something odd happened. A smelly smell was coming. It was so smelly! They both looked around, but they couldn't find where the smell was coming from. Then they looked at each other and started to laugh. It was Will's socks! He had forgotten to change them for three whole days!

John was a brave boy. He had an itch and he wanted to solve it. But it was difficult to find out what was causing it.

John looked everywhere, he searched high and low. He kept looking until he finally found something. It was a little creature hidden under the bed.

John was brave and tried to solve the itch. He spoke very gently and slowly. The creature heard his kind words and nodded in agreement. John slowly reached out his hand and gave the creature a pat.

The itch was gone and John was so proud of himself. He had solved the problem all by himself. John smiled and laughed with joy now that the itch was gone. He was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy called Aaron. He was a clever youth with lots of bright ideas.

One day, Aaron went to play in the park with some of his friends. As they were playing, Aaron thought of a clever game they could all play. But when he began to explain the game to his friends, they didn't want to join in.

Aaron felt sad. He walked away and sat down on a bench.

Then, an old man sitting nearby called out to him. He said, "Young man, why don't you try to behave better? That way, your friends will want to play the games you suggest."

Aaron smiled and said, "I will try my best to behave better. Thank you for the advice!" And so Aaron headed back to his friends and behaved in a kind and thoughtful way. His friends soon joined in with his games and all had lots of fun.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved playing with thread. His mom would always give him some thread to play with, and he would make all kinds of fun things with it.

One day, the little boy was having so much fun, he forgot to put the thread away when he was done playing. Later that day, he noticed that a naughty dog had gotten into the thread and was chewing it all up! The little boy tried to stop the dog, but it was too late - the thread had been destroyed.

The little boy was so upset. He started to cry and all he wanted was to play with thread again. His mom heard him crying and suddenly had an idea. She gave him some more thread and he was able to start playing again!

The little boy was so happy. He was thankful to his mom for making him feel better and he never forgot to put the thread away after playing ever again.

Steve the giant was walking through the jungle. He was looking for some new friends. Suddenly, he slipped on a rock and almost fell down. Luckily, he had caught himself.

Then, he saw a small group of humans! He waved his hand and smiled, as he was feeling very friendly. The humans smiled back at him. He was pleased and he knew they could be good friends.

Then, Steve asked the humans, "Would you like to be my friends?" They all said, "Yes, we would like to be your friends!" Steve was so happy that he did a happy dance.

The humans were also very friendly and they shared their sweet bananas with him. Steve and the humans had a fun time together. They laughed and played games until the sun went down.

Steve thanked the humans for being so friendly and said goodbye. He promised to come back soon to visit them. He was so glad to have met them!

Once there was a little girl who was very smart. She wanted to bring summer all year long! She asked her mom for help and together they made a plan.

The next morning, the little girl got up early and went to the garden. She brought a shovel and a basket. She started to dig and soon she found lots of beautiful flowers.

She carefully put them in the basket and ran back inside. She was so excited!

The little girl put the flowers around the house and suddenly it was summer all the time! Everywhere she looked she could see beautiful sunshine, sunshine and more sunshine.

The little girl was so happy. She was so smart to think of bringing summer all year long!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to play in the spring. He would hop around and smell the flowers.

One day, Benny saw his friend, a little duck named Ducky, playing in the spring too. Benny wanted to play with Ducky, but Ducky was being selfish and didn't want to share the spring with Benny.

Benny felt sad and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, he had an idea. He hopped over to a nearby puddle and started to splash around. Ducky saw how much fun Benny was having and decided to join in too.

Now, Benny and Ducky were both splashing and having fun in the spring together. They learned that it's always better to share and play nicely with others. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a smart little boy named Timmy. He liked to watch the birds flying in the sky and the ants crawling on the ground. One day, he saw a butterfly and he learned that it came from a caterpillar. He was very happy to learn something new.

Timmy had a very intelligent dog named Max. Max liked to watch Timmy play and learn new things. Timmy loved Max and thought he was the most intelligent dog in the world.

One day, Timmy and Max went to the park to watch the ducks swim in the pond. Timmy learned that ducks can swim and fly. Max watched the ducks with Timmy and wagged his tail happily. Timmy and Max had a lot of fun learning and watching things together.

Once upon a time, there was a green player named Froggy. Froggy loved to play games with his friends. They would run, jump, and laugh together all day long. But Froggy had a secret. Every time he got tired, he would yawn.

One day, Froggy and his friends decided to play a game of hide and seek. Froggy found the perfect hiding spot behind a big tree. He waited and waited, but no one came to find him. Suddenly, he felt a big yawn coming on. He tried to hold it in, but it was too strong. He let out a loud yawn.

Just then, his friends heard him and came running to find him. Froggy was so embarrassed that he had given away his hiding spot. But his friends just laughed and said, "We knew you were here all along, Froggy! Your yawn gave you away!" From that day on, Froggy learned to hide his yawns during games of hide and seek.

John was playing with his favourite toy when he heard a knock on the door. He ran over to it and shouted "Come in!" He opened the door and saw his mum. She was holding a frame in her hands.

John looked at her with a puzzled expression. "What is it?" he asked.

Mum said "This is a reliable frame. I'm going to give it to your friend, Suzy. Can you take it and give it to her for me today?"

John was excited. He said with a smile "Yes, of course I can!"

He opened the frame, but what happened next made him so scared and sad. There was a dead bird inside it!

John ran back to his mum and shouted, "What is this?!”

Mum looked worried. She said "Don't worry, it's ok. I found it in the garden. It's reliable because it will never move again. It will stay the same forever."

John was so disappointed that he didn't want to take the frame to his friend. He gave it back to Mum and went back to play with his toy.

Tom liked to look at small things. He had a toy microscope that his dad gave him. He could see bugs and leaves and hair with it. He wanted to show his friend Lily his microscope.

He went to Lily's house and knocked on the door. Lily opened it and smiled. "Hi, Tom. What do you have?" she asked.

"I have a microscope. It can make small things big. Do you want to see?" Tom said.

"Yes, please. That sounds fun. Come in," Lily said. She took Tom to her room. There was a table and two chairs. Tom put his microscope on the table and turned it on.

"Look, Lily. This is a bug. It has six legs and two wings. Can you see?" Tom said. He pointed to the bug on a slide under the microscope.

Lily leaned over and looked through the eyepiece. She saw the bug. It was big and fuzzy. She gasped. "Wow, Tom. That is amazing. The bug looks so different. It has many colors and hairs. How do you find the bugs?" she asked.

Tom smiled. "I look for them in the garden. Sometimes they are on the flowers or the grass. Sometimes they are under the rocks or the dirt. It is not difficult to find them. You just have to look carefully. Do you want to find some bugs with me?" he asked.

Lily nodded. "Yes, I do. That sounds fun. Let's go to the garden and look for some bugs. Maybe we can find some new ones. Thank you for showing me your microscope, Tom. It is a cool toy," she said.

Tom and Lily went to the garden. They looked for bugs. They found some ants, a spider, a butterfly, and a worm. They put them on slides and looked at them with the microscope. They saw many things they had never seen before. They had a lot of fun. They learned a lot. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Molly. She was three years old and loved to explore and play. One day, Molly and her family went to the store to buy something special. When they arrived, everyone was very impressed by the big, beautiful crib. It was white, with pretty hearts and stars on it. Molly's parents said, "Let's pay for this!"

So, they paid for the crib and brought it home. Molly was so excited! She helped her parents put it together and it was all done in no time. Once the crib was set up, Molly jumped right in and said, "This is so comfy!" Molly was so proud and happy with her new crib. It was very impressive!

Molly has been loving her crib ever since. She plays, reads, and takes naps in it, and she feels very special. Molly's crib is the most impressive thing in the whole house, and she loves it!

Once there was a little girl named Jane. She was only three years old, but she wanted to be wise. She wanted to be the wisest person in all the land. That’s why every day she asked her mom, “Mommy, what is wisdom?"

Her mom smiled and said, “Wisdom is when you love the right things and care for them.” Jane thought about this for a while, and then she said, “Is it like my little red toy car?” Her mom said, “Yes, it’s like that.”

Jane was happy. She thought that if she loved her little red car, then she was wise. She hugged the car tight and promised to take care of it.

Every day, Jane went outside and looked for more things to love. She found a red-breasted robin and a red flower, and she promised to take care of them, too.

The more things that Jane loved, the wiser she became. Her mom smiled and said, “See, Jane, wisdom is love.” Jane nodded, and from that day forward, she kept loving and caring for all the things around her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had long hair that reached down to her toes. One day, her mom said it was time for a haircut. Lily was scared because she didn't want her hair to break. But her mom promised that it wouldn't hurt and that she would still look pretty.

So, they went to the hair salon and Lily sat on a big chair. The hairdresser used scissors to cut her hair. It was so much fun! When they finished, Lily looked in the mirror and saw that her hair was shorter but still pretty. She smiled and felt happy.

After the haircut, Lily and her mom went to the park. Lily played on the swings and the slide. She felt the wind blowing in her face and her cheeks became pale. But she didn't mind because she was having so much fun with her new haircut.

Once there was a boy called Jack. He was 3 years old and liked to play with his fingers. One day, Jack saw a toy that he wanted. It was so big he could not carry it. So Jack asked his mom to buy it for him.

At first, his mom said no. Jack was so sad that he became very rude. He kept pestering his mom until she finally said yes, much to her regret.

So she went out to buy the toy and when she came back, Jack was so happy. He quickly hugged the toy and ran all around the house with it.

But then suddenly, with all his running, Jack accidently replaced one of his fingers with the toy! His mom quickly took him to the hospital but the doctors said it was impossible to replace his finger.

Jack was so sad but he never learned his lesson. He always thought he could get whatever he wanted with rudeness.

One day, there was a big ornament sitting on the floor. It was very graceful and colorful. A three-year-old girl saw it and she wanted to play with it. She ran over and tried to pick it up.

"Don't touch that ornament," said Mommy.

The little girl didn't listen. She shook her head and grabbed the ornament. Suddenly, it started to turn and it flew right out of her hands. It flew right out the window and broke into pieces on the sidewalk.

The little girl was very sad. She started to cry and said, "I'm sorry, Mommy."

But it was too late. Mommy shook her head and said, "That was a very bad thing you did."

The little girl was so sad that she never tried to touch any ornaments ever again.

Lily and Ben were playing in the snow. They made a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. They gave him a carrot nose and two coal eyes. They were very happy with their snowman.

But then a big wind came and blew the hat and the scarf away. The snowman looked sad without them. Lily and Ben were upset. They ran after the hat and the scarf, but they could not catch them.

They saw the hat and the scarf flying towards a house. They followed them and knocked on the door. A nice lady opened the door and smiled at them.

"Hello, children. What are you looking for?" she asked.

"Our snowman's hat and scarf. The wind took them away. They belong to our snowman. Can we have them back, please?" Lily said.

"Of course, you can. They are on the chimney. They got stuck there by the wind. You can climb up and get them, but be careful. The chimney is very high and slippery." the lady said.

She helped them climb up the chimney. They reached the hat and the scarf and took them down. They thanked the lady and ran back to their snowman. They put the hat and the scarf on him again. He looked happy now. Lily and Ben hugged him and smiled. They were not upset anymore. They had their snowman back.

Lila and Tom were friends who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a big hill with smoke coming out of it. They wanted to see what it was, so they ran towards it.

"Look, Tom, it's a volcano!" Lila said. "Maybe there are dinosaurs inside!"

"Let's go closer and find out!" Tom said. "Maybe we can take some rocks and make a necklace!"

They climbed up the hill, but it was very hot and hard. They heard a loud noise and saw fire and lava coming out of the volcano. They were scared and tried to run away, but it was too late.

"Help, Lila, help!" Tom shouted. "The volcano is angry and wants to hurt us!"

"I'm sorry, Tom, I'm sorry!" Lila cried. "We should not have come here, we should have listened to our moms!"

But no one heard them or came to help them. The fire and lava caught them and burned them. They were not fine. They were gone.

Sara and Tom are playing in the garden. They have a big box and some crayons. They want to make a house for their toys.

"Let's cut a door and some windows," Sara says. She takes the scissors and starts to cut the box.

"Be careful, Sara. Don't cut yourself," Tom says. He holds the box for her.

They cut a door and four windows. They also draw some flowers and a roof. They are happy with their house.

"Look, Mommy! We made a house!" they shout when they see their mommy arrive.

Mommy smiles and comes to see their house. She thinks it is very nice and useful.

"What a good job, Sara and Tom! You are very creative and clever," she says. She gives them a hug and a kiss.

"Can we play in the house, Mommy?" Sara asks.

"Of course, my loves. But first, let's have some lunch. You must be hungry after working so hard," Mommy says.

Sara and Tom nod and follow Mommy to the kitchen. They are hungry and excited. They can't wait to play in their house. They think it is the best house ever.

Once there was a young boy. He was three years old and loved playing outside. One day he found a new watch. He was so happy that he wanted to show it to everyone he saw.

The boy ran to the park to find his friends. He saw them playing and showed them his new watch. Then something strange happened. His friends started to change. They all suddenly looked older!

The boy was a bit scared at first but he was brave. He asked them what had happened and they said that his new watch had made them change. They were all surprised to hear this, but glad that the watch had made them grow older.

The boy was happy that his watch had made his friends change and from that day onwards, he always kept it close. Whenever he wanted to show it off, he knew that something magical would happen.

Once upon a time, there was a happy boy named Tim. Tim loved playing with his colorful blocks. He would build tall towers and knock them down with a big smile on his face. One day, Tim felt his tummy rumble and he knew it was time for a snack. He ran to the kitchen and asked his mom for a cheerful sandwich. As he took a bite, he felt the ground tremble. Tim looked outside the window and saw a big truck driving by. The blocks on his table started to shake and Tim giggled with excitement.

Once upon a time, in a dark room, there was a little girl named Lily. She was scared of the dark, so she decided to pull her big, soft blanket over her head to feel safe. But she still wanted to see some light.

Lily had an idea. She knew there was a small lamp on her table. So, she bravely pulled the blanket down a little bit to see where the lamp was. She reached out her hand and pulled the lamp closer to her.

When Lily turned on the lamp, she saw a warm, yellow light. The heat from the lamp made her feel cozy and safe. Now, the dark room was not so dark anymore. Lily smiled, pulled her blanket around her, and fell asleep with her new friend, the warm lamp, by her side.

Lily and Max were playing with their toys in the living room. They had a lot of fun making noises and pretending to be animals. Lily had a big box of crayons and paper. She liked to draw and color. Max had a small bucket of water and a plastic cup. He liked to pour and splash.

"Look, Lily, I can pour water from the cup to the bucket," Max said. He lifted the cup and tipped it over the bucket. The water made a glug-glug sound.

"That's cool, Max, but be careful not to spill," Lily said. She was drawing a green frog on her paper. She used a lot of green crayons to make it look real.

"I won't spill, Lily, I'm very good at pouring," Max said. He poured the water back and forth between the cup and the bucket. He smiled and giggled.

Lily finished her frog and showed it to Max. "Do you like my frog, Max? He is green and has big eyes and spots," she said.

"I like your frog, Lily, he is very creative," Max said. He put down the cup and the bucket and looked at the frog. "Can I draw a frog too?"

"Sure, Max, you can draw a frog too. Here, take a green crayon and some paper," Lily said. She gave Max a crayon and a paper and helped him draw a frog.

They both drew frogs and colored them. They were very happy and proud of their work. They showed their frogs to their mom and dad, who praised them and hung them on the fridge. Lily and Max hugged each other and said, "We are creative and we love green!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and explore his backyard. One day, he found a big palace made of sand. He was so excited to explore it!

As he walked closer, he saw a little crab scurrying around. Timmy wanted to play with the crab, so he poked it gently with his finger. The crab scurried away quickly.

Suddenly, a harsh wind blew and knocked down the palace. Timmy was sad that his sand palace was destroyed, but he knew he could build another one. He went to get his bucket and shovel and started building a new palace, hoping to find more friends to play with along the way.

Once upon a time there was a little monkey named Pete. Pete was a very sad monkey. He would cry all day long.

One day, Pete heard a very strange noise coming from underground. It sounded very unusual so Pete decided to investigate. He got down on his hands and knees and started crawling through the tunnel that was underground.

As he kept moving through the tunnel, the sound became louder and louder. When Pete finally reached the end of the tunnel, he discovered a small cave. Inside the cave there was a puddle of water.

Suddenly, Pete heard a soft, muffled voice coming from the puddle. It said, "Help me, Pete. I'm stuck here and I can't get out."

Pete was surprised and asked, "Who are you?"

The voice answered, "I'm an unusual turtle. I was exploring underground and I got stuck in this puddle. Please help me out!"

So Pete looked around for a stick and used it to get the turtle out of the puddle. He hugged the turtle and said, "I'm so happy I could help you!"

The turtle hugged him back and said, "Thank you. You made me so happy and I'll never forget you!"

Pete smiled and said, "Let's go home now and I'll never cry again!"

Tim and Sam were brothers who liked to play with their toys. They had many cars, trucks, and planes, but their favorite was the police car. They pretended to be police and catch bad guys.

One day, they found a fake gun in their dad's closet. They thought it was a toy and took it to their room. They lay on the floor and aimed the gun at each other. They made loud noises and said, "Bang! Bang! You're under arrest!"

Their mom heard the noises and came to see what they were doing. She saw the gun and screamed. She ran to them and tried to take it away. But Tim did not want to give it up. He pulled the trigger and a real bullet came out. It hit Sam in the chest and he fell down. He did not move or make any sound.

Tim dropped the gun and cried. He did not know what he had done. He hugged Sam and said, "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, please wake up!"

Their mom called the real police and the ambulance. They came and took Sam away. They said he was dead. Tim and his mom were very sad and scared. They wished they had never played with the fake gun.

Once upon a time, there was a furry little rabbit. He wanted to pass through the meadow to visit his friends, but he was worried. He knew that the meadow was full of danger - and he might suffer.

But he was brave. He hopped along, ever closer to the meadow. Sure enough, something bad happened! A big dog spotted the rabbit and started to chase him. The rabbit was scared and ran as fast as he could.

Suddenly, he saw something he hadn't expected. A hole in the fence! He quickly hopped inside and escaped from the dog. He was safe!

The rabbit was relieved. Although he had suffered, he was safe now and could pass through the meadow. He hopped on his way until he reached his friends. They were very happy to see him and they all played together for the rest of the day.

Sara was anxious. She wanted to go to the park with her mom and dad, but it was raining. She looked out the window and saw the gray clouds and the wet grass. She hoped the rain would stop soon.

"Sara, come here. We have a surprise for you," her mom called from the living room. Sara ran to see what it was. She saw a big bag on the couch. Her mom opened it and pulled out a yellow raincoat, a pair of red boots, and a blue umbrella.

"Wow, these are for me?" Sara asked, her eyes wide.

"Yes, they are. We bought them for you yesterday. We knew you would love to play in the rain. Do you want to try them on?" her mom said, smiling.

Sara nodded and put on the raincoat and the boots. They fit perfectly. She held the umbrella over her head and twirled around. She felt like a princess.

"Look at you, you're so pretty. Are you ready to go to the park?" her dad asked, putting on his own coat and hat.

"Yes, yes, yes!" Sara said, jumping up and down.

They went outside and walked to the park. The rain was still falling, but Sara didn't mind. She splashed in the puddles, chased the ducks, and swung on the swings. She was having so much fun. The raincoat, the boots, and the umbrella prevented her from getting wet and cold. She was glad her parents had given her such a wonderful surprise. She hugged them and said, "Thank you, thank you, thank you. I love you so much."

Once upon a time, there was a small bird. It had pale feathers and liked to fly around. One day the bird noticed a big cage with an open door. It was very curious, so it flew inside.

Inside the cage were colorful toys and food. The bird was excited and started to explore. But soon it realized something scary, the cage door was shut! The bird was stuck inside the cage and couldn't get out.

The bird noticed something else, a small window. When it flew over to the window it saw the outside. The bird noticed it could fly out if it flew high enough to reach the window.

So the bird flew as high as it could and finally made it out of the window. The bird was happy to be free again and flew away smiling.

Once upon a time there was an adorable little girl who loved to play. One day, she decided to take a walk to the local mill. As she approached the mill, she noticed something strange on the ground. It was a button! She had never seen anything so tiny before, so she decided to remove it.

When she looked back up at the mill, she noticed something else. It was a small mouse! She thought it was so cute and adorable. She held out her hand and the mouse climbed on. As the pair went together to the mill, the mouse nibbled on the button.

The mill was huge and full of all kinds of interesting things. The little girl explored every nook and cranny, but the best part was the old, weathered mill wheel. Not wanting her furry friend to get hurt, she quickly removed the wheel carefully, so she could explore further.

The little girl had a great time. She found all sorts of things, but nothing was as enjoyable as playing with the mouse. In the end, she was so happy that she decided to take the adorable little mouse back home with her. They both had a great day together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and eat shrimp. One day, Lily's mommy made her some yummy shrimp for dinner. But when Lily saw the shrimp, she got upset because they had eyes and tails.

Lily's mommy explained that the shrimp were just like little sea creatures and they were tasty to eat. Lily still didn't want to eat them, so her mommy told her to pray and ask for help.

Lily closed her eyes and said a little prayer. After she finished, she felt better and decided to try the shrimp. To her surprise, they were really delicious! From then on, Lily wasn't upset about eating shrimp anymore and she always remembered to pray when she needed help.

Once upon a time, there was a Mama, Papa and a little daughter called Daisy. Daisy was three and loved to make things. One day, Mama and Papa were busy so she decided to make some soap. She thought it would be fun!

She found some old clothes, a pot and put some water on the fire. She put it all into the pot and mixed it together. She was getting very excited, but then she made a mistake. Daisy put too much water in the mix and it was miserable!

Mama saw what had happened and said, "What have you made now, Daisy?"

Daisy said sadly, "I was trying to make soap, but I made something small and miserable."

Mama hugged Daisy and said, "Never mind sweetheart, let's try again. This time, we'll do it together. We'll make something special."

So Daisy, Mama and Papa all worked together and soon they had made something wonderful! Daisy was so proud and excited to see what they had made.

And from then on, Daisy and her family made wonderful things for each other.

One day, a cheerful little girl named Molly went to the park. Everywhere around her were exciting things to play with and discover.

Molly heard some clapping and went to investigate. To her delight, she found a large group of people clapping, singing, and dancing all around her.

Molly decided to join in the fun. She clapped above her head, danced around the park, and sang along to the music. Soon, everyone was singing, clapping and dancing together.

Then a carrot appeared, making its way around the circle. Everyone was so excited and clapped even louder.

Molly was so happy with the surprise that she smiled and clapped her hands again. All of a sudden, the carrot was opened up and a big bunch of colorful balloons were released in the sky.

The sky was so cheerful and beautiful with all the colorful balloons, everyone was clapping and laughing. Molly was so excited and started clapping with joy.

The cheerful day was a very special one for Molly and she was sure she never would forget it.

One day, a little mouse named Milo wanted to find some food. He was very hungry and he did not have any cheese or bread at home. He decided to go outside and look for something yummy. He put on his hat and his coat and he ran out of his hole.

Milo saw a big garden with many flowers and trees. He thought he might find some nuts or seeds there. He ran across the grass and he smelled something sweet. He followed his nose and he saw a big cake on a table. It had pink frosting and sprinkles. Milo's eyes grew wide and he licked his lips.

He climbed on the table and he took a big bite of the cake. It was delicious and he wanted more. He did not see the big cat that was hiding behind a bush. The cat saw Milo and he jumped on the table. He opened his mouth and he tried to catch Milo.

Milo was scared and he ran away. He saw a hole under the table and he dived into it. He hoped the cat would not follow him. He ran and ran until he reached the underground. He saw many other mice there. They looked at him and they smiled.

"Hello, little mouse. Who are you?" one of them asked.

"I am Milo. I live in a hole near the garden. I was looking for food and I found a cake. But then a cat came and he wanted to eat me. I ran away and I found this hole. Is this your home?" Milo said.

"Yes, this is our home. We are the humble mice. We live underground and we share what we have. You are welcome to stay with us. We have some cheese and bread. Would you like some?" another mouse said.

Milo was happy and he nodded. He was hungry and he liked cheese and bread. He thanked the humble mice and he bowed to them. They gave him some food and they became his friends. Milo learned to be humble and to share. He was glad he found the underground.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Allie. She was very smart and loved to build things. One day, she got a special present, it was a toy hook. She was so excited, she just had to try it out!

Allie asked her mom, "Mom, can I fix the hook?"

Mom replied, "Yes, Allie. You can try. Just be careful."

Allie set to work. She grabbed the special tools and put the hook in the right place. She tightened the screws to make sure the hook was very secure. Then she tested it out by hanging a special toy from the hook. She squealed with delight when it worked--it was perfect!

Mom smiled and said, "You did a great job, Allie! You're so smart!"

Allie was very proud of herself and said, "Thank you Mom! I fixed it all by myself."

And from then on, Allie loved to build and fix things.

Once upon a time, there was a shark. He was a big and powerful shark with lots of sharp teeth. He swam through the ocean looking for something to eat. Suddenly, he spotted something bright and smooth. It was a red shirt! The shark swam faster and faster until he got close enough to take a bite of the shirt. His teeth were so sharp that it only took one chomp! The shirt was gone in a flash. The shark was very happy to have a tasty snack. He kept swimming until he found another smooth and red shirt to bite. And that is how the shark passed the day, going from shirt to shirt, taking a big bite out of each one.

Once upon a time, there was a little lamb named Lily. She had soft and fluffy wool that everyone loved to touch. But Lily was very fearful of everything around her. She would always hide behind her mother whenever she saw something new.

One day, Lily's mother took her to the meadow to learn how to graze on grass. Lily was hesitant at first, but her mother encouraged her to try. Lily slowly started to nibble on the grass and soon realized how delicious it was. She learned that trying new things can be fun!

As the days went by, Lily continued to learn new things. She learned how to run and jump, and even how to make new friends. And as she grew older, she became less fearful and more brave. Her wool grew thicker and more beautiful too, thanks to all the delicious grass she had been eating.

One day, a big storm came and the wind blew very hard. Lily was scared, but her mother reminded her of all the things she had learned and how strong she had become. Lily remembered her mother's words and stood strong against the wind. When the storm passed, Lily felt proud of herself and her beautiful wool kept her warm. From then on, Lily knew that she could face anything that came her way.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play outside. One day, they see a big mill near the river. The mill has a big wheel that turns with the water.

"Let's go and see the mill!" Ben says. He runs to the mill.

"Wait for me!" Anna says. She follows Ben.

They go inside the mill. They see a man who works there. He makes flour from wheat. He has a big bag of flour.

"Hello, children. Do you want to learn how the mill works?" the man says. He is kind.

"Yes, please!" Anna and Ben say. They are curious.

The man shows them how he puts the wheat in a machine. The machine grinds the wheat and makes flour. The flour comes out of a pipe and fills the bag.

"Wow, that is amazing!" Anna says.

"Can I touch the flour?" Ben says.

"Be careful, it is very fine and dusty," the man says.

Ben reaches for the bag of flour. He wants to feel it. But he is too fast and clumsy. He pulls the bag and it falls to the floor. The flour spills everywhere. It makes a big mess.

"Oh no!" Ben says. He is scared.

"Oh no!" the man says. He is angry.

"Oh no!" Anna says. She is sad.

Ben looks at the man. He sees that the man is not happy. He feels bad.

"I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!" Ben says. He is sorry.

The man looks at Ben. He sees that Ben is sorry. He feels better.

"It's okay, Ben. I know you didn't mean to do it. But you have to be more careful next time. Flour is not a toy. It is food. We need it to make bread and cakes and cookies," the man says. He is kind.

"Okay, I will be more careful. I want to help you clean up," Ben says. He is sorry.

"Thank you, Ben. That is very nice of you. And you, Anna, do you want to help too?" the man says. He is kind.

"Yes, please. I want to help too," Anna says. She is sorry.

The man gives them a broom and a dustpan. They help him sweep the flour and put it back in the bag. They work together. They make the mill clean again.

"Thank you, children. You did a good job. You are good friends. Do you want a cookie?" the man says. He is happy.

"Yes, please!" Anna and Ben say. They are happy.

The man gives them each a cookie. The cookies are made with flour from the mill. They are delicious.

"Thank you, sir. You are very nice. We learned a lot today. We learned how the mill works. We learned how to make flour. We learned how to say sorry. And we learned how to be good friends," Anna and Ben say. They are grateful.

"You are very welcome, children. You are very smart. You learned a lot today. And you learned the most important thing: how to be good friends. That is the best thing you can learn," the man says. He is proud.

Anna and Ben smile. They hug the man. They hug each other. They are good friends. They are happy.

Once there was a very hungry squirrel. He was looking for food everywhere but he couldn't find anything. He was wandering through the forest when he suddenly saw a big pile of peanuts. He was so happy!

He quickly spread the peanuts around with his paws and started eating. He ate as many as he could! When he was done, he was full and happy.

The squirrel thanked the peanuts and ran away, but he left some peanuts behind him. The other animals in the forest saw the peanuts and rushed to get some for themselves. They spread the peanuts around so everybody got to eat.

Everybody was so happy that the peanut spread so that nobody was left hungry. They all enjoyed the peanuts and thanked the squirrel for leaving them behind.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. Sarah liked to play in her room. One day, Sarah wanted to see something new. She walked to the living room and entered. On the floor was a big, soft carpet. It was very colorful and Sarah thought it was so pretty! She touched the carpet and smiled. It felt so comfy and warm.

Sarah decided to sit down and play. She wiggled her toes in the carpet and laughed. The carpet was so soft and gave her a nice, sweet feeling. She made believe that she was a princess on a magic carpet and imagined flying around the entire world.

Suddenly, she heard her mom calling for her. Sarah was sad to leave, but knew she had to go home. She stood up and gave the carpet one more pat before she left. She promised herself she'd go back soon and have more fun.

Once there was a group of friends who were playing in the park. They were having a great time and playing games. Suddenly, their ball vanished! They all looked around but couldn't find it anywhere.

"Where did it go?" one of the friends asked.

Another friend answered, "I think it vanished into thin air!"

The friends were very confused, until one of them noticed the television that was nearby.

"Maybe the ball went inside the television!" the friend exclaimed.

The friends decided to look inside the television to see if the ball had gone there, and they were right! The ball was inside.

They all cheered and hugged each other. They all realized how important the television had been in helping them to find their ball. They wouldn't have been able to find it without it!

Tom and Lily like to collect things. They have a box full of shells, rocks, feathers and stickers. One day, they see a shiny card on the street. It has a picture of a man and some letters and numbers.

"Look, Lily, what is this?" Tom asks, picking up the card.

"I don't know, Tom. Maybe it is a license. It looks like the one Mommy has in her purse," Lily says.

"Can we keep it? Maybe we can trade it for more stickers," Tom says.

"No, Tom, we can't keep it. It belongs to someone else. Maybe they need it to drive a car or go to a store. We should give it back," Lily says.

"But how do we find them, Lily? There are so many people here," Tom says.

"Maybe we can ask a police officer. They help people who are lost or hurt. Come on, Tom, let's go," Lily says.

They hold hands and walk to the corner, where they see a police officer in a blue uniform. He smiles at them and says hello.

"Hello, officer. We found this license on the street. Do you know who it belongs to?" Lily says, showing him the card.

"Wow, you are very honest and kind, kids. This license belongs to Mr. Jones. He lives in that building over there. He must have dropped it by accident. He will be very happy to get it back. Do you want to come with me and return it to him?" the officer says.

"Yes, please. We want to help," Tom and Lily say.

They follow the officer to the building and knock on the door. Mr. Jones opens it and looks surprised.

"Hello, Mr. Jones. I have some visitors for you. They found your license on the street and brought it to me. They wanted to give it back to you," the officer says.

"Really? That's amazing. Thank you so much, kids. You are very smart and brave. I was looking for my license everywhere. I need it to drive to the doctor. I hurt my leg and it hurts a lot. You saved me a lot of trouble. How can I thank you?" Mr. Jones says.

"You're welcome, Mr. Jones. We are glad you are not hurt more. Maybe you can give us a sticker for our collection," Tom says.

"Of course, I can. I have a lot of stickers in my drawer. You can choose any one you like," Mr. Jones says.

He invites them in and gives them each a sticker. They choose a star and a heart. They stick them on their shirts and smile.

"Thank you, Mr. Jones. We hope your leg gets better soon," Lily says.

"Thank you, kids. You are very sweet. And thank you, officer, for bringing them here. You are very helpful," Mr. Jones says.

They say goodbye and leave. The officer gives them a high five and tells them they did a good job. Tom and Lily feel proud and happy. They go back to their box and add their new stickers to their collection. They hug each other and say they are the best collectors ever.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a very hairy dog named Max. Max liked to play fetch with Timmy. One day, while playing fetch, Max accidentally hit Timmy's nose with the ball. Timmy's nose hurt a lot, so he went home to tell his mom.

His mom looked at his nose and saw that it was red. She gave him a tissue to wipe his nose and told him to rest. After a while, Timmy's nose stopped hurting and he felt better. He decided to return to the park to play with Max again. When he got there, Max was waiting for him with the ball in his mouth. Timmy was happy to see his furry friend and they continued playing fetch together.

Mum and Dad were happy. They were getting married. They wore pretty white dresses and Dad had a new hat.

Mum asked the priest, "Can I kiss Dad now?"

The priest said, "Yes, of course!"

Mum and Dad hugged each other and kissed on the lips. They were both laughing and smiling.

The priest said, "I now pronounce you husband and wife."

Everyone cheered and showered them with white powder. Mum and Dad laughed and hugged again.

Mum said to Dad, "You look so handsome and I am so happy to be your wife."

Dad kissed Mum on the forehead and said, "I am so lucky to have married such a pretty lady."

They hugged and kissed one more time and everyone cheered again. Mum and Dad were married!

Once upon a time, a little boy named Jack wanted to be a blacksmith. Every day, he watched the town smithy weigh copper pieces on the scales. Watching this made Jack curious.

So one day, he asked the blacksmith why he used the scales. The blacksmith smiled and said, "Ah, young Jack. We use these scales to make sure the copper pieces are fair. We need to make sure each piece is the same weight."

Jack was so fascinated by this idea that he asked to give it a try. The blacksmith smiled and said, "Alright, but I don't have any copper here. Why don't you go and find some more, then come back and try it yourself?"

Jack nodded and went off to find copper pieces. Finally, he found what he needed and brought it to the blacksmith. He carefully weighed each piece of copper on the scales until he was sure that each one was fair.

The blacksmith was very impressed with Jack's work, and said, "Well, Jack, you certainly have a knack for this! You'll make a fine blacksmith someday."

Jack thanked him and beamed with pride. From that day on, Jack and the blacksmith were the best of friends.

John was feeling so happy, he was spinning around on the floor gracefully. He smiled as he spun and laughed with joy. Suddenly, he felt a hand on his shoulder and heard a loud sigh. It was his grandmother, she was standing next to him looking sad. She said, “John, your mom asked me to take something from the cabinet. She said it was important.” John nodded and helped his grandmother open the cabinet. Inside he saw a big box. Grandma sighed and said, “I can’t believe your mom asked me to take this.” John looked at the box with confusion. Grandma sighed again and said, “This box has all the things your dad left us before he passed away. It’s time to put them away.” John was saddened by the news and sadly watched as his grandmother carried the box away. He couldn’t believe his dad was really gone. He closed the cabinet and sighed, feeling sad and alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky lived near a small pond. One day, Ducky went to the pond to swim, but the pond was empty. Ducky was sad, so he decided to find out where the water went.

Ducky met a frog named Froggy. Ducky asked Froggy, "Do you know where the water went?" Froggy said, "I don't know, but let's find it together!" So, Ducky and Froggy decided to look for the water.

They walked and walked until they found a big rock. Behind the rock, they saw a hole in the ground. Ducky and Froggy decided to push the rock to cover the hole. When the hole was covered, the rain came, and the pond filled with water again.

Ducky and Froggy were very happy. They jumped into the pond and swam together. They became best friends and played in the pond every day. And they lived happily ever after.

Once there was a furry bear who lived in a breautiful forest. He loved to smile and always found something to be happy about.

One day, he was walking through the woods when he saw an old wreck. He had never seen a wreck before, and he was sure that it was an interesting sight. He cautiously approached and stopped for a moment to take a closer look.

The bear smiled as he examined the wreck. He wondered what had happened and who might have been inside. Then, with a sudden burst of joy, he noticed a little door that looked like it opened.

The bear excitedly ran to the door and opened it. Inside, he found a family of mice. They were frightened by the bear's presence, but when they saw him smiling, they felt safe and began to smile too.

The bear was so pleased that they were okay. He said goodbye, waved and then continued walking through the woods with a big furry smile on his face.

Once upon a time there was an ant. The ant was purple and it was very special. The ant lived in a garden and it liked to explore. One day, it had a surprise! The ant saw a purple flower in the garden. It was so beautiful! The ant wanted to have the flower. So it carefully collected the flower and took it to its home. The ant was so happy to have the purple flower. Every day it would look at the flower and feel so lucky to have it. And that is how the ant got its purple flower.

Tim lived in a big house with his family. His family was very wealthy and had lots of nice things in their home. One day, Tim decided to go outside and explore. He walked around the garden, but then he stumbled over a tree root and fell over. He started to cry but then his brother, Will, came over and picked him up.

Will brushed the dirt off, gave Tim a big hug and asked what he wanted to do. Tim said he wanted to play in the garden, so Will opened the gates for him.

They both ran and played in the garden, running and stumbling over all sorts of things. They laughed as they found some colourful flowers and a big blue butterfly.

When they were finished, they went back inside and had some delicious cookies. Tim was so happy to spend the day with Will, and he was grateful for such a wonderful family.

Lily was a bird who loved to fly. She liked to see the sky, the trees, and the flowers. She had many friends who flew with her. They had fun and sang songs.

One day, Lily saw a big flower. It was red and shiny. Lily wanted to touch it. She flew to the flower and landed on it. But the flower was not real. It was fake. It was made of plastic and metal. It had a sharp edge that hurt Lily's wing. Lily cried out in pain.

Her friends heard her and came to help. They saw the fake flower and the blood on Lily's wing. They were angry and sad. They took Lily to a safe place and cleaned her wound. They told her to be careful and not to trust things that look too good. They said real flowers are beautiful and gentle, but fake flowers are ugly and mean.

Lily learned her lesson. She thanked her friends for saving her. She was sorry for being foolish. She never flew to fake flowers again. She only flew to real flowers that smelled nice and made her happy. She was a good and wise bird.

Once there was a little girl named Kelly who was three years old. One day Kelly's parents decided to introduce her to luxury. They took her to a big, beautiful palace. Kelly was so excited to be there and she couldn't wait to see what was inside.

Kelly and her parents went inside the palace and Kelly's jaw dropped in wonder. Everything was so colorful and interesting. From the walls to the furniture, Kelly was amazed. She even spotted a big chandelier that sparkled like a thousand diamonds.

The palace was filled with so many wonderful things that Kelly had never seen before, she didn't know what to explore first. Her parents showed her all the different rooms and explained what luxury really meant.

When Kelly left the palace she was proud to have been introduced to luxury. She knew that it was something special. She was excited to tell her friends all about her interesting experience.

Mia was building lots of different shapes with blocks. She had built a big circle and a square and lots of different shapes! Daddy came in to join her and asked what she had built.

"I've made a circle and a square," explained Mia. "I'm going to make a cube next!"

Mia started to lay out the blocks in a cube shape. Daddy sat down and watched her build. After a while, the cube was finished!

"Look Daddy, I made a cube!" exclaimed Mia.

"That's great Mia," said Daddy.

"That cube looks really fit," he said.

Mia smiled and she was really proud of her cube. Then she started to make another cube. This one was even more fit!

Lila and Tom were playing with paper. They liked to fold it and make shapes. Lila made a paper horse. She was proud of it. She showed it to Tom.

"Look, I made a horse!" she said.

Tom looked at the paper horse. He did not like it. He wanted to make a better horse. He took Lila's paper horse and tore it.

"That's not a horse, that's a mess!" he said.

Lila was sad and angry. She cried. She wanted her paper horse back.

"Why did you do that?" she asked Tom.

Tom was not sorry. He was mean. He laughed at Lila.

"Because I can make a better horse than you!" he said.

He folded another paper and made a horse. He showed it to Lila.

"See, this is a horse!" he said.

Lila looked at Tom's paper horse. It was not a better horse. It was a big and ugly horse. It had too many legs and a long nose. It looked like a monster.

"That's not a horse, that's a monster!" she said.

Tom was surprised. He did not like Lila's words. He felt ashamed. He realized he was wrong.

"Maybe you're right, maybe it's a monster," he said.

He looked at Lila's paper horse. It was a modest horse. It had four legs and a short nose. It looked like a real horse.

"Maybe your horse was better than mine," he said.

He felt sorry. He wanted to be nice. He gave Lila his paper horse.

"Here, you can have my horse. I'm sorry I tore your horse," he said.

Lila was happy. She liked Tom's paper horse. She forgave Tom.

"Thank you, Tom. I like your horse. It's a funny horse," she said.

She gave Tom a hug. They became friends. They played with paper horses. They had fun.

Molly was a very playful girl. She loved to play outside with her hammer and nails. One day, when Molly was outside playing, her mum said, “Molly, time to leave. It’s getting late.”

Molly was sad. She said, “But I’m not done playing. Can I stay a bit longer?”

Mum said, “No, Molly. It’s getting dark. You need to put away your hammer and go inside.”

Molly was so sad. But she knew she had to do what her mum said, so she put away her hammer and left.

Molly was still a bit sad, but she was happy to know she could come back and play with her hammer again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily saw a bird flying outside her window. She wanted to go outside and play with it.

Lily went outside and saw a big chimney. It looked very attractive to her. She wanted to climb it and see the bird from the top. So, she started climbing the chimney. Suddenly, she slipped and fell down.

Lily got hurt badly and cried for help. Her mommy and daddy heard her cries and came running to her. They took her to the hospital, but the doctors couldn't save her. Lily died because of her mistake. The moral of the story is that we should never do anything that can scare us or hurt us.

Once there was a little girl called Anna. She was very excited because it was a sunny day and she wanted to go outside.

Anna took her bucket and went to the garden to pick some peaches. She managed to pick a large purple one. She could not contain her excitement and took the purple peach into the house.

Anna washed the peach off and put it on the table. She grabbed a spoon and tried to manage to cut and peel it.

Finally, Anna managed to cut the peach and make it into small pieces. She smiled as she bit into it and was very happy with the delicious fruit she had found in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty palm tree in her backyard that she loved to look at. One day, a big bird came and sat on the palm tree. Lily didn't like the bird because it was making loud noises and scaring away the other birds.

Lily decided to sing a song to try and scare the big bird away. She sang loudly and the big bird flew away. Lily was happy that her singing worked.

But then, she noticed that her palm tree was damaged from the big bird's claws. The leaves were torn and it didn't look attractive anymore. Lily was sad and didn't know what to do. She decided to ask her parents for help to fix the palm tree.

Her parents were able to fix the palm tree and Lily was happy again. She learned that even though singing can solve some problems, sometimes you need to ask for help to fix things that are broken.

Once there was a cheerful girl named Mimi. She had a funny hat, bright yellow shoes and a smile that made everyone around her happy. One day Mimi was walking in the park and saw a pear lying on the ground! She picked it up and started to sing. It was a song that Mimi had made up herself and it was full of joy. The birds joined in the singing and soon the park was filled with the sound of Mimi singing her happy song. After a while, Mimi finished her song and ate the pear. She left the park feeling cheerful and continued to sing her song as she went on her way.

One day a bird dropped down from the sky. It was an unknown bird.

In the park below, two little children were playing. "What's that?" one asked. "It's a bird!" screamed the other.

The bird watched them curiously. It began to fly away but the children ran after it.

"Where are you going?" the children shouted. The bird turned and said nothing.

The children ran after the bird until finally it flew away, out of sight. They looked up into the sky, but the bird was gone.

"That was an unknown bird," one child said. "We will never know where it went."

Once upon a time, there was a noisy prize. It was so amazing and shiny that no one could resist looking at it. All the kids wanted to win it.

One day, three kids had the chance to win the noisy prize. They all tried their best to get it but only one could win. One of the kids decided to lie and said she deserved it the most.

But it didn't work. The other two kids kept on trying harder, and one of them won the prize. The kid who lied was very sad.

The noisy prize was shared and everyone had a turn playing with it. The kids learned that it was better to tell the truth. From then on, they always told the truth and had great fun playing together.

Mia and her dad were at the beach one summer day. Mia saw a seal swimming in the ocean. She shouted "Daddy, look! A seal!" Her dad looked at the seal and said, "That's amazing Mia!"

Mia and her dad watched the seal swim around for a while, but then Mia saw another animal near the seal. It was a long, white bird. Mia said, "Look dad! That bird is shooting at the seal!" Her dad smiled and said, "Yes Mia, the bird is trying to catch the seal."

The bird flew around the seal, shooting lots of water until eventually it caught the seal. The seal was so scared that it started shaking. Then the bird took the seal in its beak and flew away. Mia and her dad watched until the bird disappeared over the horizon.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went on a trip with her family. They had to travel for a long time in a car. Lily felt uncomfortable because she had to sit in her car seat for a long time. She wanted to play with her flashlight, but it was too bright for her eyes.

Lily's mommy said, "Lily, can you please stop shining the flashlight in your eyes? It's not good for you."

Lily replied, "But mommy, I'm bored and uncomfortable. Can I please play with my flashlight?"

Mommy said, "Okay, but only for a little bit. Then we have to turn it off so we can all go to sleep."

Lily was happy to play with her flashlight for a little bit. She shone it on the ceiling and made funny shapes with her hands. Then, she fell asleep and dreamt of all the fun adventures she would have on her trip.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Millie. Millie loved her mom very much. She loved to give her mom big hugs and kisses.

One day, when Millie was walking with her mom, she saw a restaurant with a lot of yummy creamy treats. Millie's eyes lit up with joy. She had never seen anything so delicious!

Millie ran up to the window and asked her mom, “Mommy, can I have a creamy treat? Please?”

Her mom smiled and said, “Of course you can, my love.” She held Millie’s hand and together they went inside the restaurant.

When they arrived, Millie took one bite of the creamy treat and she was in heaven! She loved the way it tasted.

Millie and her mom were so happy together. Even though their days were sometimes distant, in that moment, all that mattered was the love they shared for each other.

Once upon a time, there was a big race. All the animals wanted to win. The rabbit was very fast and the turtle was very slow. The race started and the rabbit ran very fast. But then he got tired and stopped to rest. The turtle kept going and going until he reached the finish line. The animals were surprised and happy for the turtle. They cheered and clapped. The turtle felt very healthy and happy. He said "I won the race!" and everyone repeated "You won the race!"

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl who loved to play soccer. She was a good player and always had fun with her friends. One day, they were playing on a slippery field because it had rained the night before.

As they were playing, one of the players slipped and fell down. The little girl ran over to see if he was okay. "Are you okay?" she asked. The player nodded and got back up to keep playing.

After a while, the game was over and the little girl went home. She told her mom all about how one of the players slipped but was okay. Her mom was proud of her for being a good friend and caring about others. The little girl went to bed that night happy and excited to play soccer again the next day.

Lily and Rose were sisters who lived in a small house with their mom and dad. Lily was older and liked to play with dolls and books. Rose was younger and liked to play with cars and balls. They did not like to share their toys or their room.

One day, Lily took Rose's favorite car and hid it under her bed. Rose was very sad and angry. She looked everywhere for her car, but she could not find it. She asked Lily, "Where is my car? I want to play with it."

Lily lied and said, "I don't know. Maybe you lost it. It's not my car, so I don't care." She smiled and played with her dolls.

Rose felt miserable. She did not have her car, and she did not have a friend. She cried and cried. She wished she had a nice sister who would share and play with her.

Mom heard Rose crying and came to see what was wrong. She saw Lily playing with her dolls and Rose sitting on the floor. She asked, "What's going on, girls? Why is Rose crying?"

Rose told Mom what Lily did. Mom was very disappointed. She said, "Lily, that was very mean and selfish of you. You made your sister suffer. How would you feel if someone took your dolls and lied to you?"

Lily felt ashamed. She realized she had hurt her sister. She said, "I'm sorry, Rose. I was wrong. I have your car under my bed. I will give it back to you. Can you forgive me?"

Rose was happy to hear that. She said, "Yes, I forgive you, Lily. Thank you for giving me back my car. Can we play together?"

Lily nodded and hugged her sister. She said, "Yes, we can play together. I'm sorry I was not a good sister. I love you, Rose."

Mom smiled and said, "I'm glad you made up, girls. You are both very special and you should love and respect each other. Sharing and being honest are important values. Remember, sisters are friends for life."

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with clay. He would make all sorts of things like animals, cars and even a castle. One day, Timmy's friend Sally came to play with him. Sally was a bossy girl who always wanted to be in charge.

Sally saw Timmy playing with his clay and said, "I want to play with your clay too!" Timmy didn't want to share his clay because he was afraid Sally would ruin his creations. Sally became upset and said, "You have to share your clay with me or I won't be your friend anymore!"

Timmy didn't want to lose his friend, so he decided to speak up. "Okay, you can play with my clay, but please be careful with it," he said. Sally smiled and they both played with the clay together. They made a big castle and even a dragon. Timmy was happy that he spoke up and Sally was happy that she got to play with the clay. From that day on, they always shared their toys and had fun together. The end.

Mark was very old. He enjoyed sitting outside and watching the clouds pass by. One day, he heard a tapping at his door. He opened it, and there was a 3 year old child. The child smiled and said, "Welcome!" Mark smiled in surprise, and invited the child in. The child had a toy that was almost as old as Mark. They played together for a long time, until it was time for the child to go home. Mark said goodbye and welcomed the child to come back to visit soon. The child smiled and hopped away, happy to have made a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big wall. It was so big that nobody could climb over it. One day, a little boy wanted to see what was on the other side of the big wall. He tried to climb it, but he couldn't. He asked his friends to help him, but they couldn't climb it either. They all shrugged their shoulders and went home.

The little boy didn't give up. He went back to the big wall every day and tried to climb it. One day, he found a small hole in the big wall. He peeked through the hole and saw a beautiful garden on the other side. He was so happy! He went back to his friends and told them about the garden. They all wanted to see it too, but they couldn't fit through the small hole.

The little boy shrugged his shoulders and went back to the big wall. He found a way to make the hole bigger and soon all his friends could see the beautiful garden too. They were all so happy that they had found a way to see what was on the other side of the big wall. From that day on, they went to the garden every day and played together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom told her it was time to take a shower. Lily didn't want to take a shower because she wanted to play with her toys.

Lily's mom was troubled because Lily didn't want to take a shower. She said, "Lily, please take a shower now." But Lily didn't answer.

After a while, Lily's mom went to check on her. She found that Lily had slipped and fallen in the shower. Lily was hurt and crying. Her mom tried to help her, but it was too late. Lily had hurt herself badly.

Lily's mom was very sad and wished she had made Lily take a shower earlier. From that day on, Lily always listened to her mom and took a shower when she was told to.

Once there was an ugly duck. He wanted to wander and explore the world. So one day he decided to grab his bucket and wander off.

He waddled through the green grass and saw a big, red flower. He was so excited he put the flower in his bucket and kept wandering. Soon he spotted a buzzing bee. He chased the bee around until it flew away.

The duck kept wandering and soon he came to a pond. He was so happy he jumped right in splashing around and having fun. He even found a big, shiny rock and put it in his bucket.

By the time the sun was setting, the duck was ready to go home. He was very tired and his bucket was full of all kinds of treasure. So happily he waddled home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and her friends. One day, Lily was playing in the park when she felt the ground shake. She looked around and saw that there was an earthquake!

Lily was scared and she ran to her mommy. "Mommy, what's happening?" she asked. "It's an earthquake, Lily. But don't worry, we're going to be okay," her mommy replied.

After the earthquake stopped, Lily and her mommy went home. They saw that some things had fallen off the shelves and there was a thick layer of dust on the floor. "Wow, that was a big earthquake. How much do you think it weighed?" Lily asked her mommy. "I don't know, Lily. But what's important is that we're safe," her mommy said.

Lily felt better knowing that she was safe with her mommy. She hugged her mommy tightly and said, "I love you, mommy." Her mommy hugged her back and said, "I love you too, Lily."

Tommy was playing in the sand. He forgot his bucket. He wanted to make a sandcastle but he didn't have a bucket. He felt sad.

Then, he saw a pretty blue egg in the sand. He picked it up and smiled. He quickly ran home with the egg so he could show his mom.

When Tommy got inside, he found his mom. She was feeling jealous because his dad had bought a new toy for his sister.

Tommy showed his mom the egg and said "Look Mommy! I found a special egg!". His mom smiled and hugged him. She suddenly felt better. Tommy was happy that he could make his mom feel better.

They put the egg in a bowl on the kitchen table. Tommy and his mom looked at the egg and smiled together. Tommy was glad that he didn't forget his egg.

Once upon a time there was a butterfly. He was so pretty and perfect that everyone loved him.

The butterfly wanted to find a new home, so he started to look. He saw lots of places, but none seemed quite right.

Then, he saw a perfect spot underneath a microscope. "Yes!" he said. "This is it!"

He flew underneath the microscope and started to settle down. But then, he relalized that he was stuck! No matter how much he fluttered and tried to move, he could not yield.

The butterfly was so sad. He stayed underneath the microscope forever, trapped and alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the garden. One day, she found a big pair of scissors and decided to cut some flowers.

Suddenly, she heard a voice. It was an angel! The angel had unusual wings and was very beautiful. "Please don't cut the flowers," said the angel. "They are very special and need to grow."

Lily was surprised to see an angel and promised to never cut the flowers again. The angel smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are a kind girl." From that day on, Lily took care of the flowers and never cut them again.

Johnny was a little boy. He likes to take walks every day. Today he saw something special.

As he was walking, he saw a thick pigeon. It was sitting on the side of the road and trembling. Its feathers were fluffed up and it looked scared.

Johnny wanted to help the pigeon. He reached out his arm and tried to be gentle. The pigeon stopped trembling.

Johnny smiled and ran home. He knew the pigeon was safe now.

One day, two friends were playing together. They were so happy and excited! Then, one of the friends had an idea. She said, "Let's make a song!" The other friend thought it was a great idea. They worked together to make the song.

First, they made up some words. Then, they put the words together to make a song. Next, they added some sounds to it. Finally, they practiced it over and over to improve it.

When they were finished, they sang the song together. They were so happy with their song! They clapped and cheered when they finished singing.

From then on, they sang their song all the time. Every time they sang it, they made it better and better. They always felt so happy when they sang their song. The friends even learned some new words to add to the song. The song was getting better and better every day!

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Tim and Andy. They loved playing together. One day, Tim and Andy were playing a game that involved counting. They had to count every piece in a box. Tim started counting, but Andy was getting angry.

Tim: "One, two, three…”

Andy: "That's not fair! You keep counting the same number!”

Tim: "No! I'm counting each number. See, one, two, three…”

Andy: "I don't believe you! I think you're cheating!”

Tim: "No, I'm not! Look, I'll show you.”

Tim began to tell Andy a story about numbers. He explained that each number can be its own story and each story can have an ending. He explained that you can use numbers to find out things and to solve problems.

Andy: "That's cool! Now I understand why you have to count the pieces in the box."

Tim: "See? Counting isn't so hard once you get the hang of it!"

From that day onwards, Tim and Andy continued to play their number game together and Tim always made sure to explain the story behind each number.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful cat named Lily. She loved to dance and play with her friends in the park. One day, while playing, she hurt her paw.

Her friends wanted to help her heal. They took her to a kind dog who knew how to make her paw feel better. The dog put a soft bandage on Lily's paw and told her to rest.

After a few days, Lily's paw was all better. To celebrate, her friends brought her a yummy dessert. They all enjoyed the sweet treat and danced together in the park.

Once, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was always curious and liked to explore. One day, she went to the beach with her family. Lucy found a big hole in the sand, which made her very excited.

She wanted to know what was inside so she asked her mother, "What's in the hole, mum?"

Mum smiled and said, "Let's dig and see what's in there."

So mum and Lucy started to dig and soon revealed something small and round. It was a spicy pepper! Lucy was so surprised to find something so spicy in the sand.

At first, Lucy felt scared of the spicy pepper. But then she thought it might be fun to try it out. So, with a little courage, she picked it up, smiled and took a bite.

The flavour was surprisingly delicious! Lucy was so happy she had taken the chance to explore the spicy pepper.

Lily liked to teach her toys how to swim in the bathtub. She filled the tub with warm water and bubbles, and put her duck, her frog, and her doll in the water. She showed them how to kick, splash, and float.

"Look, duck, you can swim like this!" she said, moving the duck up and down. "And frog, you can jump like this!" she said, making the frog hop on the water. "And doll, you can lie on your back like this!" she said, holding the doll gently.

But the doll did not like the water. She was bald, and the water made her head cold. She also did not like the bubbles. They tickled her nose and made her sneeze. She wanted to get out of the bathtub.

"Doll, why are you sad?" Lily asked, seeing the doll's frown. "Don't you like to swim?"

"No, I don't," the doll said. "I don't have hair, and I don't like bubbles. I want to be dry and warm."

Lily felt sorry for the doll. She took her out of the bathtub and wrapped her in a soft towel. She dried her head and gave her a hug.

"I'm sorry, doll, I didn't know you didn't like the water," she said. "I was trying to teach you how to swim, but you don't have to. You can do other things that you like."

"Thank you, Lily," the doll said. "You are a good friend. Can you teach me how to do something else?"

"Sure, doll," Lily said. "How about I teach you how to sing a song?"

Once upon a time, there was a green octopus. He lived in the big blue sea with his friends. They liked to play and swim all day.

One day, the green octopus got sick. His friends were sad. The green octopus began to suffer. His friends wanted to help him feel better.

So, they went to find a big fish doctor. The big fish doctor gave the green octopus some medicine. The green octopus took the medicine, and soon he felt better. The green octopus and his friends were happy again. They played and swam in the big blue sea together.

Once upon a time, there was a little green bird. It whistled as it flew around in the sky. One day, the bird had a surprise. It was a special gift! The bird was so excited.

The bird flew down and tried to open the gift. But he couldn't open it! He tried and tried, but he just couldn't open it. The bird got angry! He kept trying and trying, but no luck.

Just then, a fox saw the bird's struggle. The fox had a good idea. He used his sharp teeth to open the gift! The bird was so happy! Inside the gift was a shiny, glittery whistle. The bird whistled and whistled all over the forest. The fox was so happy for the bird. And they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mommy brought home a new puppy named Max. Lily was so happy to welcome Max into their family. Max was so cute and playful!

One morning, Lily's daddy brought in the newspaper. Lily loved looking at the pictures in the newspaper. But when she tried to touch it, she accidentally tore a page. Her mommy told her that she shouldn't touch the newspaper because it's delicate.

Later that day, Lily's mommy made her favorite cookies. But Lily was being naughty and didn't finish her dinner. Her mommy told her that she couldn't have any cookies because she spoiled her dinner. Lily was sad but she knew she needed to listen to her mommy.

Steve had a blackboard. It was very special to him. He liked to write on it. One day, Steve went to the blackboard but it was broken. He was very sad. He wanted to fix it.

Steve asked Mommy to help him fix it. Mommy took out some soft tools and showed Steve how to use them. She explained that he had to be very careful when using the tools.

Steve worked on the blackboard for a while. He was very careful. Finally, Steve had fixed the blackboard. He was a proud of himself.

Steve smiled as he stepped back to admire his work. The blackboard was perfect. Now he could write on it again. He was very happy.

Lily and Ben are going to the theater with Mom and Dad. They are very happy. They like to watch stories on the big screen. They feel excited and curious.

They get in the car and drive to the theater. They see many people and lights. They buy tickets and popcorn. They find their seats and wait for the story to start.

The story is about a princess and a dragon. The princess is fair and kind. The dragon is big and scary. The princess wants to help the dragon, but the dragon is angry and lonely. He roars and breathes fire.

Lily and Ben watch the story. They feel many things. They feel scared when the dragon roars. They feel sad when the princess cries. They feel happy when the princess and the dragon become friends. They feel amazed when the dragon flies.

The story ends and the lights come on. Lily and Ben clap their hands. They liked the story very much. They turn to Mom and Dad and say:

"Mom, Dad, that was a good story. Can we watch it again?"

Mom and Dad smile and hug them. They say:

"Maybe another day, sweeties. We're glad you enjoyed it. It was a fair and beautiful story."

Once there was a small bear. He was looking for something special. He wanted to find a special pin. So he decided to go on a journey. He walked and he walked until he found what he was looking for. It was a small pin in the grass. He picked it up and smiled. He decided to sit down and take a rest. He put the small pin in his pocket and sat in the grass. He smiled and felt so happy that he had found a special pin. He looked up at the sky and said "thank you!"

Lori was excited for her vacation. Everywhere she went she saw so many new things. She saw a cow, a sheep and a noisy dog. But then she saw a man. He was a tall, strong man with a scowl on his face. He did not recognize Lori but she recognized him.

Everything suddenly changed. He stepped closer as Lori stepped back. She shook in fear.

"You look familiar," he said.

Lori stayed silent. She only looked down and shook her head.

The man stepped even closer.

"I always remember a face," he mumbled.

Lori ran and hid behind a tree. But the man followed. Lori tried to run away, but the man kept chasing her until he finally grabbed her. Lori screamed, but it was too late.

The man had recognized Lori as the thief who had stolen from him.

The bad ending of Lori's vacation was set up from the moment she recognized the man.

Once upon a time, there was a smart little bunny named Flopsy. Flopsy lived in a cozy burrow at the top of a hill. One day, Flopsy went for a walk in the forest and met a friendly bear named Benny. Benny liked to clap his paws when he was happy. Flopsy thought it was funny and started to clap too. They became good friends and clapped together all the time. One day, they found a shiny red top on the ground. They both wanted to play with it, so they took turns spinning it and clapping when it spun fast. They had so much fun together that they decided to have a picnic and share some carrots. From that day on, Flopsy and Benny clapped and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Suzy. She was three years old and loved to play. One day she said to her mom, "Let's make a goal!" Her mom said, "That's a great idea, Suzy!"

So Suzy and her mom put their minds together and made a goal. Suzy wanted to learn how to draw. Her mom said, "You can do it, Suzy!"

Suzy worked hard every day. She practiced and drew. But it soon became boring because it was hard work. So Suzy asked her mom, "Can I take a break?" Her mom said, "Yes, but be sure to come back and keep working towards your goal!"

Suzy was happy and went outside to play. She ran and laughed, and had lots of fun. Then when it was time, she went back inside and continued to work on her goal.
