So Star got the scale out of the cupboard and started to measure everything she needed. She was so proud of herself for helping.

Soon the cake was in the oven, and it was just a few minutes until dinner was ready. Star could smell how tasty it was going to be, and she couldn't wait to sample a piece.

Once upon a time, there was a poor little girl. Her name was Fae and she lived with her family in a small house. She had a brother and sister, and every day they would help their parents with the chores.

One day, Fae's parents asked her and her brother and sister to do the laundry. Fae was so excited to help that she ran straight into the laundry room and started sorting the clothes into piles.

After a while, it was time for Fae's bath. She went into the bathroom and started filling the bathtub with water. She had so much fun splashing around until her parents called her out so she could put her PJs on.

When Fae was finished, the laundry was all done, smelling so fresh and clean! Fae was so proud of herself for helping her family. She knew it made them very happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mommy asked her to come to the grocery store with her. Lily was very happy and excited to go. When they got there, they saw a big mess on the floor. Lily's mommy said, "Oh no, this is messy. We need to be careful not to slip and fall."

Lily said, "I can help clean it up!" But her mommy said, "No, it's not safe for you. I'll take care of it." As they were walking down the aisle, Lily saw a toy she really wanted. She asked her mommy if they could buy it, but her mommy said they didn't have enough money for it.

Lily was sad and started crying. Her mommy hugged her and said, "Don't worry, we can save up for it next time." Lily felt better and they continued shopping. When they got home, Lily helped her mommy put away the groceries. She felt happy that she could help and that they had a nice time together.

Lily and Max were twins who liked to observe things. They had a big book with pictures of animals, plants and stars. Sometimes they asked their mom or dad to read them the stories in the book.

One day, they saw their dad go outside with a big tool. They followed him and saw him cut some branches from a tree. They wondered what he was doing.

"Dad, what are you doing?" Lily asked.

"I'm pruning the tree, Lily. That means I'm cutting off the parts that are old or sick, so the tree can grow better and have more fruits," dad explained.

"What kind of fruits, dad?" Max asked.

"Plums, Max. They are sweet and juicy and purple. Do you like plums?"

"Yes, we do, dad. Can we help you prune the tree?" Lily and Max asked.

"Sure, you can help me, but be careful. The tool is sharp and the branches are heavy. You can hold the branches for me and put them in the pile over there," dad said.

Lily and Max were happy to help their dad. They observed how he pruned the tree and learned the names of the different parts of the tree. They also saw some birds and bugs on the tree and tried to find them in their book.

They worked hard for a long time, until the tree looked neat and tidy. They felt proud of their job and hoped the tree would give them many plums soon.

They were also very hungry and thirsty, so they went inside with their dad. Mom had prepared a snack for them. She had some milk, cookies and prunes.

"Prunes?" Lily and Max asked.

"Yes, prunes. They are dried plums. They are good for you and they taste good too. Do you want to try them?" mom asked.

Lily and Max nodded. They took a bite of the prunes and liked them. They were sweet and chewy and purple.

They thanked their mom and dad for the snack and the lesson. They felt happy and tired. They decided to take a nap on the couch, with their book and their prunes. They were not restless anymore. They had a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a fisherman who loved to catch fish. He went fishing every day in his boat. One day, it was very cold and the water was icy. The fisherman was shivering, but he didn't give up. He poured some hot cocoa from his thermos to warm himself up.

After a while, the fisherman caught a big fish. He was so happy and excited that he forgot to check the weather. Suddenly, a big storm came and the waves were very high. The fisherman's boat flipped over and he fell into the water. He tried to swim, but the water was too cold and he couldn't move his arms.

Sadly, the fisherman drowned and never came back. The big fish swam away, and no one knew what happened to it. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little rat named Remy. Remy was a humble rat who lived in a cozy hole in the wall. One day, Remy wanted to explore the big world outside of his hole.

Remy's friend, a kind mouse named Mickey, encouraged him to go on an adventure. "You can do it, Remy!" said Mickey. "Just be careful and stay safe."

So, Remy set off on his adventure. He saw many new things and met many new friends along the way. When Remy returned home, he was very happy and proud of himself. "Thank you for encouraging me, Mickey," said Remy. "I had a great adventure!"

Mickey smiled and replied, "You're welcome, Remy. I knew you could do it." And from that day on, Remy was no longer just a humble rat living in a hole. He was a brave adventurer who was ready for anything.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl called Lucy. She wanted to go on an adventure, so she asked her Mummy if she could go. Her Mummy said yes, but she had to wait until they had the right speed.

Lucy was excited and asked her Mummy if she could please go now. But her Mummy said no and explained that they had to wait until the speed was available.

After a while, the speed became available and Lucy's Mummy said she could go. So, Lucy and her Mummy started their adventure - and had lots of fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny. The bunny loved to jump all around the forest. One day, the bunny saw a big rainbow in the sky. It was so pretty! The bunny wanted to touch the rainbow so badly.

But the rainbow was too high up in the sky. The bunny tried to jump really hard, but he couldn't reach it. He felt sad because he wanted to touch the rainbow so much.

Then, it started to rain. The bunny looked up and saw that the rainbow was gone. He felt even sadder now. But then, he realized that the rain was making the grass and flowers grow. And that made the bunny happy again.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a dog and a cat. They loved to play together every day. One day, they wanted to build a house. They knew they had to work together to make it perfect.

First, the dog dug a big hole and the cat brought sticks and leaves to make the walls. They worked hard until the house was done. They were so happy!

But then, they had to test the house. They wanted to make sure it was strong and could protect them from the rain. So, they poured water on the roof, but it leaked. They were sad.

Then, the dog had an idea. He said, "Let's unite our skills and make the roof stronger." The cat agreed. They took more sticks and leaves and worked together to make the roof perfect. They tested it again and this time, it didn't leak. They were so proud of themselves and their new house.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play dress-up and wear costumes. One day, she found a brilliant mask in her toy box. It was shiny and sparkly, and she loved it so much.

Lily's mom saw her wearing the mask and said, "Wow, that's a beautiful mask! How many masks do you have?"

Lily replied, "I have a number of masks, but this one is my favorite because it's so pretty."

Later that day, Lily's friend came over to play. When she saw Lily wearing the mask, she said, "That mask is so cool! Can I wear it too?"

Lily said, "Sure! Let's play a game where we both wear masks and pretend we're superheroes."

So, Lily and her friend wore their masks and pretended to save the world from bad guys. It was so much fun! And Lily was happy to share her brilliant mask with her friend.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Kathy. Kathy was three years old and liked to play all the time.

One day, Kathy went to the park. She found a nice spot to sit down and began to play. She played for a long time, until she heard someone calling her from across the park.

Kathy turned around to see her mom. Her mom said, "Kathy, it's time for lunch. Let's go get some food!"

Kathy got up and followed her mom to the cafe. Inside, the cafe was very organized. Kathy and her mom each chose something to eat and then went to sit at a table.

Kathy ate her food. She was very happy and soon she and her mom went back to the park to play.

The end.

One day, Mommy was feeling very tired. She sat down on the couch with a sigh. She wanted to look at a picture to feel better. Mommy had a special picture on the wall. It was a picture of her and her family all together.

Mommy was very happy looking at the picture. She smiled and said “I love this picture”. As she looked, she noticed something different. There was a little pinch on the top corner of the picture.

Mommy was not sure how it got there. Then she saw her little baby brother. He was standing and looking guilty. He had a mischievous sparkle in his eye and a smile on his face.

Mommy asked her baby brother what he had done. He laughed and said “I pinched the picture!” Mommy shook her head and laughed. Her little brother was naughty, but he sure was cute.

Mommy scooped him up and gave him a big hug. Then she gave him a kiss on the cheek and said “Now, don’t pinch any more pictures”. They both laughed and then it was time for a nap. Mommy and her baby brother both snuggled up and fell asleep.

Lily and Ben like to play pretend. They have a hidden place under the stairs, where they keep their toys. One day, they find a microphone in a box. It is shiny and black, and has a long wire.

"Wow, look at this!" Lily says. "It is a microphone. We can sing with it."

"Let me see!" Ben says. He grabs the microphone from Lily. "I want to sing first."

"No, it is my turn!" Lily says. She tries to pull the microphone back. They both tug and tug, but no one lets go.

"Stop it!" Lily says. "You are not nice. You are a meanie."

"Stop it!" Ben says. "You are not fair. You are a greedy."

They start to shout and cry. They do not hear Mom coming down the stairs. She sees them fighting over the microphone.

"What is going on here?" Mom says. "Why are you making so much noise?"

Lily and Ben stop and look at Mom. They feel ashamed. They know they did something bad.

"We are sorry, Mom," they say. "We found a microphone and we wanted to sing, but we could not share."

Mom smiles and hugs them. "I understand," she says. "It is hard to share sometimes. But you have to be kind and take turns. How about we all sing together?"

Lily and Ben nod and smile. They like that idea. They give the microphone to Mom. She pushes a button and turns it on. Then she sings a song they know. Lily and Ben join in. They have fun singing with Mom and the microphone. They forget about their fight. They are happy again.

Once, there was a lucky lady. She was walking through the forest when she heard a loud sound. She came to a clearing and saw a bush shaking. She walked closer and saw a baby bird in the bush, its wings had broken!

Right away, the lucky lady knew what to do. She carefully picked up the baby bird, and she took it home with her. There, she fed it and gave it a warm, cozy bed.

Soon, the baby bird was feeling much better. Its wings were healed and it was able to fly! The lucky lady opened her window and the bird flew away.

The lady felt so happy and lucky. She knew she had saved the bird's life.

Once upon a time, there was a bird named Blue. Blue was nervous because he had never flown before. But then he flapped his wings and started to soar up into the sky. Blue was very happy because he could see everything from up high.

As Blue flew, he saw a tree with a reward on it. The reward was a shiny red apple. Blue was very hungry, so he decided to land on the tree and get the reward. He picked up the apple with his beak and flew away.

Blue continued to soar through the sky, feeling proud of himself for getting the reward. He knew that he could fly anywhere he wanted to now. And so, Blue flew off into the sunset, happy and content.

Once upon a time there was a grumpy jelly. It was stuck all the way at the bottom of a deep pool. The jelly was very sad. It wanted to get free!

Then one day, an brave swan swam down to the bottom of the pool. The swan saw the grumpy jelly, and it knew it had to rescue it.

The swan pumped its wings as hard as it could and as it flew up, it scooped up the jelly into its wings. Soon, the jelly was rescued from the bottom of the pool and was high up in the sky!

The jelly was so happy that it thanked the swan many times. They both then flew away into the sunset together, never to be parted again.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a new book to read. The book had pictures and words that Lily could read. She was so happy that she wanted to print out the pictures and put them on her wall.

Lily sat down and started to read her book. She listened carefully to the words and tried to say them out loud. She loved the story so much that she read it again and again. When she was finished, she asked her mommy if they could print out the pictures.

Mommy said yes, and they printed out the pictures together. Lily was so excited to see the pictures on her wall. She listened to her favorite song and danced around her room while looking at the pictures. From that day on, Lily loved to read and listen to stories.

Today was mild and the sun was shining. Sam was out and about, looking for fun things to do. Sam had an idea! He wanted to go to the park and save some animals.

At the park, Sam saw a lot of animals, but none of them were in danger. He couldn't find an animal to save, so he looked around some more. He noticed a rabbit in a hole in the ground, stuck and unable to move. Sam rushed over to save the rabbit.

Sam figured out how to get the rabbit out of the hole and he picked it up. The rabbit was so happy to be free! They said goodbye and the rabbit hopped away.

Sam was proud of himself for helping an animal in need. He felt hopeful and happy for the rest of the day. This was truly a mild and wonderful adventure for Sam!

One day, Jack had a special surprise. His mom gave him a piece of paper and said, "Jack, I have something for you!" Jack smiled. He was very excited!

Jack looked at the paper. It was blank and white. He asked his mom what to do next. His mom smiled and said, "Write something special on the paper. It can be whatever you want!"

Jack picked up a pencil and started to write. He wrote his name, then drew a picture of his family. It was very impressive!

Once he was finished, his mom said, "You did a wonderful job Jack! Now, your paper can be hung up in your room for everyone to see."

Jack was so proud of himself. His paper was amazing and he couldn't wait to show it off to everyone!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and stuffed animals. One day, she went to the park with her mommy and saw a boy playing with a toy gun.

Lily asked the boy, "What's that?"

"It's a toy gun," the boy replied.

Lily's mommy told her that guns are not toys and they can be very dangerous. "They are delicate and should only be used by grown-ups," she said.

Lily nodded her head and said, "Okay, mommy. I understand."

Later that day, Lily and her mommy went to the store. Lily saw some pretty stickers and asked her mommy to buy them. Her mommy said, "Sure, but you can only choose a certain number of stickers."

Lily counted the stickers and picked out five, which was the number her mommy said she could have. She was very happy and put the stickers on her notebook when they got home.

There was a little girl who was only three years old. She loved to collect things. Every morning she would find something new to put in her bag.

Today she wanted to collect lunch for her family. She grabbed a few apples, some oranges and some bananas. She thought it was the perfect collection.

She put everything in her lunch bag and raced home. She was so excited to show her family her perfect collection. Everyone was so proud of her. They all had a wonderful lunch.

Once upon a time, there was a grumpy bear. He didn't want to do anything - he just wanted to stay in his cave. One day, he was so grumpy that he snapped at everyone that he saw.

Then, he started to get very hungry. He looked around, but there was no food to be found. Everywhere he looked, there was nothing to eat. He growled in frustration.

Suddenly, he heard a snap in the distance. What could it be? He was curious, so he followed the sound until he came to a clearing. There, he found a lot of food! He was happy and quickly started to eat.

The bear was no longer grumpy. He enjoyed his meal and thanked whoever had left it there. From that day onwards, he made sure to always be kind and never snap at anyone again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved cars and trucks, especially big ones that could drive really fast. One day, Timmy's mom took him to a car show where he saw lots of different vehicles. Timmy loved looking at all the shiny cars and pointing out his favorites.

Later that day, Timmy and his mom were driving home when they saw a big truck on the side of the road. The truck looked troubled, like it was having a hard time moving. Timmy's mom pulled over to help. They tried to sort out what was wrong with the truck, but they couldn't figure it out.

Suddenly, the truck started moving again, but it was going too fast. It crashed into Timmy's mom's car and they were both hurt. The ambulance came, but it was too late. Timmy and his mom didn't make it. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to go to the beach with his mommy and daddy. They would play in the sand, swim in the water, and surf the waves.

One day, Timmy's mommy noticed that the water was getting higher and higher. "Look, Timmy," she said, "the water is starting to increase! We need to be careful and stay close to each other."

Timmy looked out at the waves and saw that they were getting bigger and bigger. "Wow, the waves are so big!" he said.

As they played in the water, Timmy's daddy noticed that the sky was getting clear. "Look, Timmy," he said, "the sky is starting to clear up! That means we can stay at the beach longer and have more fun."

Timmy smiled and said, "Yay! I love the beach!" And they continued to play and surf the waves until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat called a yacht. The yacht was very pretty and had a lot of colors. One day, some friends went on the yacht to sail on the water. The wind was very strong and made the yacht go fast. The friends were happy and laughed a lot.

After a while, they stopped the yacht and sat down to discuss what they wanted to do next. They decided to swim in the water and have a picnic on the yacht. They ate sandwiches and fruit and drank juice. It was a fun day on the yacht and they all went home happy. The end.

Once upon a time there was a young girl named Lucy. She was excited because it was festival time! She asked her mom, "What is the festival about?"

Her mom told her that festival was all about gaining new experiences. Lucy thought this was so fun and began to plan her day.

The next morning Lucy got ready for the festival. She put on a bright yellow dress and a flower in her hair. She ran out the door really excited to learn all the new things she could gain.

When Lucy got to the festival, she was surprised to see so many people! There were young children running around playing and having fun. She noticed a lot of activities for young kids and felt so lucky to be part of the festival.

Lucy tried all the activities like painting and dancing. She gained so many new experiences, she was glad that she had come to the festival.

At the end of the day, Lucy went home feeling so happy and fulfilled. She knew that the new experiences she had gained during the festival would stay with her forever.

One day, a big cat named Tom went for a walk. He took big steps on the soft grass. He liked to step on the grass because it felt like a massage for his paws. Tom was a serious cat who loved to explore.

While walking, Tom saw a small dog named Tim. Tim was not serious like Tom. Tim liked to play and jump. Tom thought maybe he could have fun with Tim. So, they played together, running and stepping on the grass.

After playing, Tom and Tim were tired. They sat down on the grass. Tom gave Tim a paw massage. Tim liked the massage and smiled. From that day on, Tom and Tim were best friends who loved to step, play, and give massages to each other.

Once upon a time there was a boy who loved to search. He would search everywhere he could. One day he stumbled across an engine that was far away.

He was very curious so he ran to it. When he reached it he found that it was very big and strong. He tried to turn it on, but it wouldn't move. He searched for a way to make it work and suddenly he found a key. He grabbed it, put it into the engine and it started moving!

He was so happy. He had a big smile on his face. He started exploring the engine. He went around the engine and was amazed by the many distant places it could take him. He was very excited and couldn't wait to see what new and exciting places the engine would take him to.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she found a long stick on the ground. She picked it up and pretended it was a spear. She ran around the yard, pretending to be a brave knight.

Her mom came outside and asked, "What are you doing, Lily?"

"I'm a knight!" Lily said with a big smile. "I enjoy playing with my spear."

Her mom looked at the stick and said, "Be careful, that could hurt someone."

Lily felt ashamed because she didn't want to hurt anyone. She put the stick down and went to play with her dolls instead. She still had fun, but she knew to be more careful next time.

Once there was a queen. She was very mild. Everywhere she went she watched what was going on. She watched the bees buzz in the flowers, she watched the birds fly in the sky and she watched the sun shine in the day. Everyone in her kingdom was happy.

One day the queen wanted to do something special. She asked her helpers to make a castle in the clouds. The helpers worked hard and used lots of bright colors. When they were finished the castle looked so beautiful. Everyone in the kingdom cheered when they watched it.

The queen went to the castle to have a look. She walked up to the top and saw a wonderful view. She was so happy. She watched the sunsets and fireworks for hours. Everyone in the kingdom was so happy.

The queen watched the moon rise in the sky and the stars twinkle. She watch the sun set and the clouds float by. The queen was so filled with joy. Everyone in the kingdom was happy and they watched with her.

The queen smiled and watched the sky until it was time to go to bed. She waved to everyone before she left. The queen was so mild and everyone in the kingdom loved her.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play in the garden. The garden has many flowers and trees and bugs. Lily and Ben like to look at the bugs.

One day, they find a big snail on a leaf. Lily thinks the snail is cute. She wants to touch it. Ben thinks the snail is slimy. He does not want to touch it.

"Look, Ben, a snail!" Lily says. "Can I hold it?"

"No, Lily, don't touch it!" Ben says. "It is slimy and icky!"

Lily and Ben disagree. They start to argue. They raise their voices. They make faces.

"Stop it, you two!" Mom says. She comes out of the house. She hears them fighting. She is not happy.

"What is going on here?" Mom asks. "Why are you arguing?"

"Lily wants to touch the snail, but I don't!" Ben says.

"Ben does not like the snail, but I do!" Lily says.

Mom sighs. She looks at the snail. She looks at Lily and Ben. She has an idea.

"Listen, children," Mom says. "The snail is a living thing. It has feelings. It does not like to be touched or yelled at. It likes to be in the garden, where it is clear and quiet. Why don't you let the snail be, and find something else to play with?"

Lily and Ben think about what Mom says. They look at the snail. They feel sorry for the snail. They nod.

"Okay, Mom," Lily says. "We will leave the snail alone."

"Sorry, snail," Ben says. "We will play with something else."

Lily and Ben smile at each other. They are friends again. They run to the sandbox. They play with the sand and the toys. They have fun.

Mom smiles too. She is glad they stopped arguing. She goes back to the house. She watches them from the window.

The snail is happy. It crawls away from the leaf. It finds a new spot in the garden. It is clear and quiet. It is safe.

Once upon a time, there was a pink bird named Lily. Lily liked to scatter seeds for her friends in the park. One day, a big mean cat saw Lily and her friends having fun.

The cat wanted the seeds for himself, so he made a plan. He found a cooler and put the seeds inside. Then, he hid behind a tree, waiting for Lily to come and scatter the seeds.

Lily saw the cooler and went to scatter the seeds for her friends. But when she opened the cooler, the mean cat jumped out! The cat scared Lily and her friends away. They could not eat the seeds, and the cat ate them all. Lily and her friends were sad, and the mean cat was happy.

Once there was a fair chimney. It was tall and big and beautiful. It was so special! Every day it would move a little bit. It would dance in the wind and move with the clouds. It was so fun to watch it move.

One day, the chimney had some friends come to visit. They were three little birds who laughed and played around the chimney. They sang and flew up high in the sky. They were so happy to see the tall and fair chimney.

Then one day, it started to rain. Everyone was so sad because the chimney had to move away from its friends. But the chimney was happy too, because it still had its friends in its heart. So it smiled and moved on to its new home.

The chimney was never really alone. Its friends were always there in its heart, and that made it so special.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo loved to swim in the big blue ocean. One day, Nemo saw a plastic bag in the water. "Oh no! That's waste!" Nemo said. "We must tell our friends to be careful of waste."

Nemo and his friends swam to the other side of the ocean to warn their friends. "Hey, friends! We saw waste in the water! We need to be careful!" Nemo said.

One of Nemo's friends, Sammy, asked, "What is waste?" Nemo explained, "Waste is when we throw things away that we don't need anymore. It can hurt us and our home."

Suddenly, they saw a spoiled apple floating in the water. "Ew, that looks gross!" Sammy said. "We should pick it up and put it in the trash." Nemo and his friends worked together to clean up the waste and keep their home safe.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a hot day. The sun was shining bright in the sky. All the kids were playing outside and having fun. They were very happy.

Then, a big cloud appeared in the sky. It was a very big and fluffy cloud. The cloud made a nice shade for the kids to play under. They were not so hot anymore.

The kids kept playing and laughing under the cloud. They played games and had a great time. At the end of the day, the cloud went away and the kids went home. They all had a good day because of the big cloud in the sky.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat toast for breakfast. Every day, she would ask her mom to make her toast with butter and jam.

One day, Lily's mom had to go out. She warned Lily, "Do not touch the hot toaster, it can hurt you." Lily wanted her toast, but she was a good girl and listened to her mom. But, she was also a persistent girl, so she kept asking her big brother to make her toast.

At first, her brother said no. But, Lily did not give up. She asked again and again. Finally, her brother said yes and made her the toast. Lily was very happy and thanked her brother.

Lily learned that it is important to listen to warnings and to be persistent when you want something. She also learned that asking for help is a good thing. From that day on, Lily and her brother had a great time eating toast together.

Once upon a time there were two bears. One bear was called Bear, and the other bear was called John. Bear and John went on an adventure one day. John said to Bear, "Let's slide down the hill!" Bear thought it was a good idea, so the two of them began to slide down the hill. When they got to the bottom of the hill, they saw a twisty tree with lots of branches. Bear said, "Let's twist up the tree!" The two bears started to twist around and around the tree branches. Suddenly, there was a loud bang and the tree fell down! John and Bear looked at each other in surprise. John said, "Oh no, what have we done!" Bear said, "We were being silly. We should have been more careful." They made it fine and the two bears were happy.

Moral of the story: Be careful and think before you act!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was a cheerful girl who loved to play with her toys. One day, her mom called her for lunch. Lily ran to the kitchen and saw a plate of yummy food. She took a bite and realized it tasted like her favorite fruit. She was so happy and thanked her mom for the delicious meal.

After lunch, Lily went outside to play with her friends. They played tag and hide-and-seek until it was time for dinner. Her dad called her and she ran inside. She sat down at the table and saw her favorite dessert - a chocolate cake. She took a bite and it tasted so good. She thanked her dad for the yummy cake and went to bed with a smile on her face.

Once upon a time, there was a farm with lots of sheep. The sheep were very fluffy and liked to eat grass. One day, a little lamb was born. The lamb was very small and had white fur. The lamb liked to play with its mom and the other sheep.

As the days went by, the lamb grew bigger and stronger. One day, the lamb saw a beautiful flower in the field. The flower was closed and the lamb wondered what was inside. Suddenly, the flower began to bloom and the lamb was amazed. The lamb felt happy and wanted to show its mom.

The lamb ran back to the other sheep and tried to tell them about the blooming flower. But the sheep were all sleeping and didn't hear the lamb. The lamb was very alert and didn't want to miss anything exciting. So, it decided to go back to the flower and watch it bloom again. From that day on, the lamb always kept its eyes open for new things to see and do.

Once upon a time, there was a furry bear. He was so furry that he was nice and warm. He wanted to go outside, but it was sunny. He looked around and he saw a big shade! It was green and made a nice wrap around him.

The furry bear was happy in his shade wrap. He could be warm, and not worry that the sun was too bright. He could play and explore.

He ran around, jumping and hopping. He tried to hide in the shade, but the sun kept trying to follow him. He was never too hot or too cold, because the shade wrap was there to help him.

He kept playing and exploring until he felt sleepy. Then, he crawled back into his warm, furry wrap, and fell fast asleep in his shade.

He had a nice day, and he was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear. The little bear was very hungry, so he went to find some food. He walked and walked until he found a big barrel. The barrel was very heavy, but the little bear was strong. He shook the barrel and some apples fell out. The little bear was happy because he loved apples. He took a bite of an apple, but it was bitter. The little bear did not like the bitter taste, so he kept looking for more apples.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and her favorite toy was a shiny coin. One day, Lily went to the park to play with her friends. She put the coin in her pocket, but it fell out and she didn't notice.

Later, when Lily got home, she realized the coin was gone. She looked everywhere, but she couldn't find it. She felt sad and started to cry. Her mom asked what was wrong and Lily said she lost her coin. Her mom said, "Don't worry, we'll find it together."

They searched the whole house and finally found the coin under the couch. Lily was so happy she hugged her mom and said, "Thank you, Mommy! I suffered without my coin." Her mom laughed and said, "It's okay, Lily. Losing things can be stupid, but we found it in the end."

Mommy and Daddy were taking a long walk one day. They stopped at a big, brown barn. Mommy looked at the barn and said, "Can you explain what a barn is?" Daddy smiled. He said, "A barn is a special place for animals to get shelter from the rain and the cold."

Mommy nodded. Then Daddy told her that sometimes farmers keep their tools in the barn too. Mommy said, "Oh, like shovels and rakes?" Daddy nodded. Mommy was feeling much less confused now.

But then she saw some big red doors. She asked Daddy, “What are those for?” Daddy explained, "Farmers put hay and grains in the barn so their animals can have something to eat!" Mommy smiled. She was learning so much!

Mommy and Daddy kept walking and talking. Mommy was no longer confused. She had learned a lot about barns.

Once upon a time there was a pet. It was a fluffy bunny called Flopsy. Flopsy was very hungry. He hopped around looking for something tasty to eat. He sniffed around and could smell something yummy. He saw some carrots in the garden and couldn't wait to taste them.

So he hopped over to the carrots and started to munch away. The carrots were so delicious! Flopsy ate and ate until he was stuffed. He was so happy to have found something he liked to eat.

Then Flopsy went to find his owners. He wanted to show them how yummy the carrots were. He hopped over to his owners and tried to get their attention. He was so excited and kept hopping up and down. His owners looked at him and laughed. They understood what he was saying!

The owners quickly felt Flopsy's tummy and could see how full he was. They knew he had really enjoyed the carrots. Flopsy was very happy and went to take a nap. He was no longer hungry.

Lily was a little dog who loved to play. She had many toys, but her favorite was a big bone. She liked to chew it, bury it, and dig it up again. She had the bone for a long time, and it was very old and dirty.

One day, Lily's mom came home with a surprise. She had a bag in her hand, and she said, "Lily, I have something for you. It's a new bone!" She opened the bag and showed Lily a shiny, white bone. It looked very tasty and fun.

Lily was very happy. She ran to her mom and licked her face. She took the new bone in her mouth and wagged her tail. She wanted to play with it right away. She ran to the yard and found a good spot to bury it.

But as she was digging, she saw something. It was her old bone. It was still there, under the dirt. Lily stopped digging and looked at the two bones. She felt confused. She liked her new bone, but she also liked her old bone. She didn't want to lose either of them.

She dropped the new bone and picked up the old bone. She looked at it and sniffed it. It smelled like her. She felt happy and sad at the same time. She didn't know what to do.

She carried the old bone back to the house. She saw her mom sitting on the couch. She went to her and put the old bone on her lap. She looked at her mom with big eyes and said, "Mom, I love you. And I love my new bone. But I also love my old bone. Can I keep both of them, please?"

Her mom smiled and hugged her. She said, "Of course, Lily. You can keep both of them. They are both yours. You are a very good and sweet dog. And I love you, too."

Lily wagged her tail and licked her mom's face. She felt very happy. She had two bones and a mom who loved her. She yawned and curled up on the couch. She put her head on the old bone and held the new bone with her paw. She closed her eyes and fell asleep. She had a very good day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Clara who was only 3 years old. She was feeling very lonely and wished she had someone to play with. So one day she decided to organize a club.

She invited some of her friends from preschool over to her house and they each brought something special. Together they formed a very special club.

At first, Clara was a little fearful about the whole thing. But as time went on she realized that all her friends were being very friendly and supportive.

They all decided to have fun and make lots of new memories together, and it quickly became the best club ever!

From that day on Clara was never lonely again, and the club members all had lots of fun! The end!

Once there was a little girl called Ruth. She was three years old and had a folder of special secrets. She was very careful with it because she had been told never to show it to anyone. But one day, she was feeling really brave and she decided to dare herself to show the folder to her parents. They were quite stern and harsh when they saw it, and Ruth was worried that she had done the wrong thing. But then they opened the folder and it was full of things that Ruth had made for them, like cards and pictures. They hugged her and said she was very brave for daring to share her folder with them. From then on, Ruth learned that daring could be a good thing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to hold her teddy bear tight when she went to bed. One day, Lily's mommy told her that they were going to see a lawyer. Lily didn't know what a lawyer was, but she was excited to go on an adventure.

When they arrived at the lawyer's office, Lily saw a big sign that said "Justice for All". The lawyer was very kind and talked to Lily and her mommy about something important. Lily didn't understand what they were talking about, but she saw the lawyer's serious face and knew it was something important.

After they left the lawyer's office, Lily's mommy hugged her and told her everything was going to be okay. Lily didn't know why her mommy was sad, but she hugged her back and felt her mommy's hurt go away. That night, Lily held her teddy bear extra tight and fell asleep feeling safe and loved.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play dress-up and pretend to be a princess. One day, Lily's mom brought home a beautiful necklace for her to wear. Lily was so happy and put it on right away.

But as she was playing, she noticed that the necklace felt strange. Lily's mom told her that sometimes people make fake jewelry that looks real. Lily was sad because she didn't want a fake necklace.

Later that day, Lily's friend dared her to climb the tall tree in the backyard. Lily was scared, but she didn't want to be a scaredy-cat. So, she started to climb. As she got higher, she realized that climbing the tree was hard work. But she didn't give up and finally made it to the top.

When she got back down, Lily realized that she was proud of herself for doing something she didn't think she could. She also realized that being brave and doing hard work was much better than pretending to be a princess with a fake necklace.

Tom and Mia were friends. They liked to play with their toys and share their snacks. One day, Tom got a new toy. It was an orange car that could make noises and move by itself. Tom was very happy and wanted to show Mia his car.

"Look, Mia, look!" Tom said. "I have a new car. It is orange and fast and loud. Do you want to play with it?"

Mia looked at the car. She liked orange things. She liked fast things. She liked loud things. She wanted to play with the car too. But she was patient. She knew that Tom wanted to play with his car first. She smiled and said, "Wow, Tom, your car is very nice. You are lucky. I can wait until you are done."

Tom smiled back. He was glad that Mia was his friend. He liked to share with her. He said, "Thank you, Mia. You are very kind. You can play with my car too. But first, let me show you something. My car has a secret button. If you press it, something amazing happens. Do you want to see?"

Mia nodded. She was curious. She wanted to see what the secret button did. She said, "Yes, Tom, I want to see. What does the secret button do?"

Tom said, "You will see. Follow me." He took his car and ran to the backyard. Mia followed him. They went to the big tree where they liked to hide. Tom said, "This is the perfect place. Are you ready, Mia?"

Mia said, "Yes, Tom, I am ready. Show me the secret button."

Tom pressed the secret button. The car made a loud beep. Then, it opened its doors and windows. Out of the car came four orange balloons. They floated in the air and made funny shapes. Tom and Mia laughed and clapped. They grabbed the balloons and played with them. They had a lot of fun.

Tom said, "Do you like the balloons, Mia?"

Mia said, "I love the balloons, Tom. They are so pretty and funny. Thank you for sharing your car with me. You are the best friend ever."

Tom said, "You are welcome, Mia. You are the best friend ever too. I am happy that we can play together. Let's play some more."

They hugged and played with the car and the balloons. They were very happy. They were the best friends ever.

Once there was a big tree. Everyday it grew and grew. One day, a silly bird hopped onto the tree. The bird was looking for something shiny to wear.

The bird said, "I'm looking for something to make me look fancy!" She added, "Do you know where I can find something glimmering?"

The tree thought for a moment and then said, "Yes, follow me! I can help you find it."

The bird followed the tree and soon they found a sparkling spell on the ground. The bird cheered and said, "This is perfect! Now I'm the prettiest bird around!"

The bird thanked the tree and flew away. The tree just smiled and kept growing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane wanted to go explore the wide field near her house. Her mum said she could go, but only if she acted responsibly. Jane said she would, then she ran off to the field.

Jane had a wonderful time in the field. She ran, jumped and laughed with glee. She forgot all about acting responsibly. On her way home, she came across an old lock on the ground. It glinted in the sun and she was curious about it.

Jane took the lock and ran home. She couldn't wait to show it to her mum. She acted very pleased when she saw it, but then she questioned where Jane had found it. Jane didn't want to admit that she hadn't acted responsibly.

In the end, it was revealed that the lock belonged to her neighbour. Jane had taken it from their shed and it wasn't hers. She had acted badly and embarrassed her mum. Worse than that, she had caused hassle and worry for her neighbour. Jane had not acted responsibly.

Once upon a time, there was a robot named Robby. Robby was very poor because he couldn't move his arms and legs. He would sit in the corner all day long and watch other robots play.

One day, a little girl named Lily came to visit Robby. She saw that Robby was sad and asked, "Why are you so sad, Robby?"

Robby replied, "I can't move my arms and legs. I wish I could spring up and play with my friends."

Lily felt sorry for Robby and decided to help him. She took out her tools and fixed Robby's arms and legs. Robby was so happy that he could move again. He sprang up and down with joy and thanked Lily for her help.

From that day on, Robby played with his friends every day. He was no longer a poor robot, but a happy one.

Once upon a time, a charming dove flew through the sky. She came across an open window and she happily flew in. Inside the room she found a boy. He was very surprised and opened his mouth wide. The boy and the dove looked at each other for a moment. Then the dove came over to the boy and perched on his shoulder. The boy was so happy. He patted the dove gently and she cooed. They played together for the rest of the day. The boy opened his toy box and gave the dove a pretty ribbon to wear. The dove flew out of the window into the sky with the ribbon on her neck. She was so charming. The boy and the dove were now good friends.

One morning, a deer woke up. It was a very special deer that looked very fragile. It had a thick white fur and some gentle brown eyes that could see for miles.

As the deer woke, it noticed the sun in the sky and the birds singing in the trees. It was so happy to be awake and feeling the warm sunshine in its fur.

The deer decided to take a walk in the forest. While walking, it saw a small lake where it could take a drink. After drinking, the deer began to play in the lake. It jumped and skipped so gracefully and felt so happy.

When it was time for the deer to go, it said goodbye to the lake and the forest. It had been a very special morning and it was feeling very peaceful and calm. The deer felt so thankful to be alive and so fragile.

Once upon a time there was a very charming lab named Rosie. Every morning she would speak to the birds, telling them about her day. She loved to chat with them and would always greet them with a happy bark.

One day, Rosie was feeling particularly adventurous. She decided that she would go explore the woods near her house. She set off on her own and soon stumbled upon a small creek. It was so peaceful and still that Rosie was mesmerized. She decided to take a little dip in the water and played in it for a while. After her swim, Rosie climbed out of the creek and started walking along the path. Not long after, she came across a tiny log cabin. Rosie peered inside and saw a small family sitting around the table chatting. She barked to get their attention and the family immediately lit up with delight. They invited Rosie into the cabin and the three year old child was thrilled to have her around.

The child spoke sweetly with Rosie and enjoyed scratching behind her ears. Rosie was just as enchanted by the child and the two of them spent the whole day playing. The family thanked Rosie for being so charming and invited her back again soon. Rosie happily accepted and ran off back home, feeling very content and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a sunflower that wanted to dream. But the sunflower was thick and couldn't get over the wall in its garden. So it asked the birds for help.

The first bird flew high and asked the clouds to move away. But the clouds stayed still and the sunflower still couldn't dream.

The second bird had a better idea. It flew up to the sun and asked it to give light and shine down. The sun beamed down, making the sunflower's petals flutter in the breeze. The sunflower felt free, it could dream!

The sunflower dreamed of oceans and the sunflower happily danced and grew taller and stronger. Its petals were thick and bright yellow.

The birds sang and the sunflower basked in the sun. The sunflower's dream felt real, just like a magic spell.

Once upon a time, there was an elephant. He was very creative and wanted to try something different. He decided to increase his age to become bigger. One day, he used his magic to become older. As he got older and older, he was happy to see that he was increasing in size. Eventually, he was the biggest elephant around. Everyone was so impressed with his creative plan. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing with his favorite toy car, but one day he accidentally broke it. He was very sad and didn't know what to do.

Timmy's mommy saw him crying and asked him what was wrong. Timmy told her about his broken car and how much he loved it. His mommy hugged him and said, "I know you value your toy car, but accidents happen. Let's try to fix it together."

They went to the garage and found some glue. Timmy's mommy helped him put the car back together, but it was still a little tight and didn't work as well as before. Timmy was happy to have his car back, but he knew it wasn't the same.

Later that day, Timmy's daddy came home and saw the broken car. He got angry and threw it in the ashtray. Timmy was upset and didn't understand why his daddy did that. His mommy explained that sometimes people get upset and do things they don't mean. She hugged Timmy and told him that even though his car was broken, he still had his family who loved him very much.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Benny. Benny loved to eat carrots, but he didn't like cauliflower. One day, Benny's mom made cauliflower for dinner. Benny said, "No, thank you. I disagree. I don't like cauliflower."

Benny's mom said, "Please try it, Benny. It's gentle on your tummy." But Benny didn't want to try it. He went to bed hungry that night.

The next day, Benny felt sick. He had a tummy ache. His mom took him to the doctor, and the doctor said Benny needed to eat more vegetables. Benny felt sad, and he wished he had tried the cauliflower.

The moral of the story is that it's important to try new things, even if we disagree with them at first. And eating healthy foods, like cauliflower, can help us feel better.

Once upon a time there was a very cute queen. She lived in a castle and everyone loved her.

One day, the queen wanted to go out and play. She asked her subjects if they would allow it, but they said no.

The queen was very sad that she couldn't go out and play. She decided to find someone else who would let her. She found a small three year old boy and asked him if he would allow her to go out and play. The little boy said yes and the queen was so happy!

The little boy and the queen went out and had lots of fun. They played lots of games and laughed a lot. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who loved to play his guitar. He played it every day, and it made him feel happy. One day, he went to the park to play his guitar, but there was another boy there who also wanted to play.

The two boys started to argue about who should play the guitar. They both wanted to play, but there was only one guitar. The argument grew louder and louder, and it seemed like they would never agree. But then, a kind lady came over and suggested that they unite and play the guitar together.

The boys thought about it for a moment, and then they agreed. They played the guitar together, and it sounded beautiful. The mild breeze blew through the park, and everyone who heard them play was happy. From that day on, the two boys became friends and played the guitar together every day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jenny. She had a blue towel. One day, Jenny went to the park with her towel. She found a muddy puddle and wanted to play in it. She put her towel in the puddle, and it got very dirty. She felt sad.

Suddenly, a fairy appeared and said, "Don't worry Jenny. I will give you a new towel and make your old towel clean again." Jenny smiled. The fairy gave Jenny a new, pink towel. Jenny said thank you and hugged the fairy. The fairy waved goodbye.

Jenny put her old towel in the sun and it became clean and fluffy again. Jenny smiled. She had a new pink towel and her old blue towel was clean. She was so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and sing all day long. One day, Lily was dancing with her favorite rag doll when her mom came in and said, "Lily, be careful! That's a dangerous move you're doing."

Lily stopped and looked at her mom. "What does dangerous mean?" she asked.

"It means you could get hurt," her mom replied.

"Oh no!" Lily exclaimed. "I don't want to get hurt. I'll be more careful."

Her mom smiled and then said, "But you know what, Lily? I think you deserve a round of applause for being so responsible."

Lily smiled and twirled around, holding her rag doll close. "Thank you, Mommy! Can you applaud for me now?"

Her mom clapped her hands together and Lily giggled with delight. She knew she was the best dancer in the world with her rag doll by her side.

Once upon a time, there was a spoiled baby bear. He was always looking for something fun to do. One day, he came across a big box next to his house. He went over to take a closer look.

The box was packed full of exciting things. Inside, there was something that caught his eye. It was a shiny wheel! The little bear was so excited. He wanted to unpack it right away!

He began to unpack the box, taking out all of the contents. Soon there he was, holding the wheel in his hands. He was so happy! He quickly put the wheel onto his feet and started running around in circles.

From then on, the little baby bear never stopped playing with his wheel. He would take it out every day and have a lot of fun!

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her rubber duck in the bathtub. One day, she accidentally dropped her rubber duck and it went down the drain.

Lily was very sad and started to cry. Her mommy asked her what was wrong and Lily said, "My duckie is gone, mommy. I hope we can get it back."

Mommy tried to get the rubber duck out of the drain, but it was stuck. She said, "I'm sorry, Lily. We can't get it out."

Lily was still sad, but then her mommy had an idea. She said, "Let's go to the store and get a new rubber duckie for you to play with."

Lily's face lit up with joy and she said, "Yay! Thank you, mommy!" They went to the store and picked out a new rubber duckie for Lily to play with in the bathtub. She was very happy and said, "I love my new duckie. Thank you, mommy."

Once there was a rabbit. He was very friendly. He hopped around, looking for something to eat.

He heard a noise. It was loud, but it sounded friendly. The rabbit hopped closer.

The noise was coming from a big yellow house. He hopped over, and saw the door was open. Inside, he saw a party. There was lots of food!

The rabbit hopped in and started to eat. He ate cheese and cake and all kind of yummy things. Everyone was very friendly and welcomed him. The rabbit was so happy that he ate and ate!

When he was full, he hopped out of the house and back onto his journey. He was very full, content and happy.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like winter very much. They enjoy playing in the snow with their dog, Max. They make snowballs, snowmen and snow angels. They laugh and have fun.

One day, they see a big hill near their house. It is covered with smooth, white snow. They want to slide down the hill. They ask their mom if they can go.

"Can we go to the hill, mom?" Sara says.

"Can we slide down the snow, mom?" Ben says.

"Sure, you can, but be careful. And wear your hats and gloves," mom says.

Sara and Ben put on their hats and gloves. They take their sled and their dog. They run to the hill. They are very excited.

They take turns sliding down the hill. They go very fast. They feel the wind on their faces. They shout and giggle. Max chases them and barks. They have a lot of fun.

They slide down the hill many times. They enjoy the winter very much. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to use her imagination and have fun. One day, Lucy was walking in the park when she saw a peculiar pole. It was very unusual because it didn’t seem like anything else in the park.

“What is that pole for?” asked Lucy.

“That pole is special!” said a wise old man nearby. “I will show you how to use it,” he said.

He took out a cloth and began to polish the pole. Lucy watched in wonder and couldn’t believe it - the pole was becoming very shiny.

“This pole is for dancing!” said the man.

Lucy was intrigued. “A pole can be used for dancing?” she asked, amazed.

“Yes,” said the man. “It is a bit unusual, but it is lots of fun.”

So Lucy and the man kept polishing the pole until it was gleaming. When it was finished, Lucy was ready to give it a go! She spun around the pole, jumped, and twirled with delight. Lucy really liked the pole - it was so unusual, but so much fun!

Once upon a time, there was a robot in a small village. The villagers wanted the robot to unite them, so they could all be happy.

But things didn't go as planned. The robot was too cheap. The villagers became angry.

"We can't afford this robot!" one villager said.

"It's not worth the price," said another.

The villagers didn't know what to do. Then, a wise old man stepped in. He said, "I can help you make a better robot. It will be strong and cheap!"

The villagers got to work and soon, they had a better robot. This time it was cheap and strong. The villagers smiled as the robot began to unite them.

The wise old man was happy too. He said: "See what you can do when you all unite?"

The villagers were happy again and they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Blue. Blue had a peaceful life in the forest, where he lived with his family and friends. One day, while Blue was playing with his friends, he saw a big bird with beautiful wings flying above them. Blue became curious and asked his friends, "What is that big bird with the beautiful wings?"

His friend replied, "That's an eagle. Eagles have big and strong wings. They can fly very high and fast."

Blue was amazed and said, "I want to take a ride on the eagle's back and see the world from up high."

His friend warned him, "Be careful, Blue. Eagles are big and powerful. They might not want to take you for a ride."

But Blue was determined and decided to ask the eagle. He flew up to the eagle and said, "Excuse me, Mr. Eagle. Can I take a ride on your back and see the world from up high?"

The eagle looked at Blue and said, "Sure, little bird. Hop on my back and hold on tight."

Blue was thrilled and took a ride on the eagle's back. He saw the world from up high and it was beautiful. He thanked the eagle and went back to his peaceful life in the forest, happy to have had such an amazing adventure.

Lily and Max were friends who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a man hitting a small ball with a stick. The ball flew very far and landed in a hole.

"What is he doing?" Lily asked.

"He is playing golf," Max said. "My dad plays golf sometimes. He says it is fun and hard."

"Can we play golf too?" Lily wondered.

The man heard them and smiled. He walked over to them and said, "Hello, kids. Do you want to try golf?"

"Yes, please!" Lily and Max said.

"My name is Tom. I can introduce you to golf. But you have to be careful and follow the rules. Golf can be dangerous if you are not careful."

"What are the rules?" Max asked.

"Well, the first rule is to never hit the ball when someone is in front of you. You could hurt them. The second rule is to always shout 'fore' when you hit the ball. That means 'watch out'. The third rule is to have fun and be polite."

"OK, we can do that," Lily said.

Tom gave them each a stick and a ball. He showed them how to hold the stick and swing it. He told them to aim for the hole and hit the ball gently.

Lily and Max tried to hit the ball. Sometimes they missed. Sometimes they hit it too hard or too soft. Sometimes they hit it in the wrong direction. They laughed and shouted 'fore' a lot.

Tom helped them and praised them. He said they were doing great for their first time. He said they had talent and potential.

Lily and Max liked golf. They liked Tom. They thought he was nice and funny. They did not think he was crazy. They thought golf was crazy. But they liked crazy. They wanted to play golf again.

Suzy went out to the lake with her dad. She was really excited to see the kayaks.

Dad said “Let’s get this kayak out of the car and into the lake!” He struggled to get it out from the back of the car as it was very heavy.

Once they got it to the lake, they put it in the water. But Suzy started to flap her arms excitedly, and she accidentally struck the kayak with her hand!

“Oh no!” yelled Dad. “Suzy, that was a bit messy. Let’s go and get the kayak fixed.”

So they took the kayak to the store and asked the nice lady to fix it. After a while they took it back to the lake with the kayak all fixed.

They put it back in the water, and this time they had a great time kayaking. They laughed and smiled, and had lots of fun!

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play in the kitchen with Mom. Mom is making a salad for lunch. She has a big green fruit. It is an avocado.

"Can I help, Mom?" Sara asks. She wants to cut the avocado.

"Sure, sweetie. But be careful. The knife is sharp. You need to lean on the table and hold the avocado with your hand. Like this." Mom shows Sara how to cut the avocado.

Ben watches Sara and Mom. He is curious. He wants to taste the avocado. He reaches for a piece on the plate.

"Ben, no!" Mom says. "The avocado is not ready yet. It needs some salt and lemon. Wait a minute, please."

But Ben does not listen. He puts the avocado in his mouth. He makes a face. He does not like it. It is soft and bland.

"Yuck!" Ben says. He spits out the avocado. "This is not good, Mom. This is not a fruit. This is a vegetable."

Mom laughs. She hugs Ben. "No, honey. This is not a vegetable. This is a fruit. But it is a special fruit. It is not sweet like an apple or a banana. It is creamy and healthy. Some people like it, some people don't. It's okay if you don't like it. You can try something else."

Sara smiles. She likes the avocado. She sprinkles some salt and lemon on it. She takes a bite. She thinks it is delicious.

"Can I have more, Mom?" Sara asks. "This is a good fruit. I like it."

Mom nods. She gives Sara more avocado. She is happy that Sara likes it. She hopes that Ben will like it too, someday. She thinks that avocado is a good fruit for twins.

Once there was a puppy named Sam. He was a curious little pup with a lot of energy. Every day he would spend his time running around, barking and playing.

One day Sam was outside exploring when he came across a small pond. He was so excited that he ran straight into it, but then he got a big shock! The water was freezing!

He started to swim around and was having a lot of fun. But then he started to hear a strange sound coming from beneath the water. He couldn't believe his eyes when he saw what it was - a big old fish!

Sam was so nervous and a little scared but the fish just swam right up to him. He was amazed! The fish was full of funny tricks and even made Sam laugh. The more they spent time together, the more Sam realized how crazy the fish was!

Eventually the sun started to set and it was time for Sam to go home. He said goodbye to the fish and waved to him until he was out of sight.

From that day Sam would never forget his crazy new friend.

Molly was a little girl who liked to draw and cut things out. She had special scissors that were used only for cutting. Sometimes, Molly was not careful with her scissors.

One day, Molly was playing with her scissors while sitting too close to the fireplace. Suddenly, the scissors fell onto the hot fire. Molly watched in shock as the scissors burned.

Molly felt guilty. She knew she should not have been playing with her scissors next to the fire. Molly's mom saw what happened and hugged Molly to make her feel better.

Molly knew to be more careful next time. She did not want the fire to burn anything ever again.

Mandy was observing the animals in the park. She saw a group of birds chirping and fluttering in the light. Suddenly, something caught her eye. It was a skeleton! Mandy had never seen anything like it before.

Mandy noticed that it had a long beak and long, boney wings. She asked her mom, "What is it?"

Her mom smiled and said, "That is an owl. They come out in the dark and use their big eyes to see in the night."

Mandy looked at the skeleton and imagined what it would look like if it was alive and flying around in the dark. She wondered if she would ever get a chance to see it in action.

The next day, sure enough, when Mandy was observing the animals in the park, she saw a big, brown owl flying in the dark. She was amazed and delighted. She knew it was the same skeleton she saw the day before. It was one of the most beautiful things she had ever seen.

Once there was a grumpy dinosaur. His name was Spike. He lived in the jungle and he loved to march around with his friends. Every day, Spike and his friends would march around the jungle together. They would march around tall trees, go over bridges and weave in and out of the bushes.

One day, Spike was feeling extra grumpy. He didn't want to march with his friends anymore. He stayed at home instead. Spike thought the marching was too boring!

Spike's friends were very sad. They do not know what to do without Spike. But then, an idea came to them. The decided to play a marching game without Spike. They would let him watch from his nest.

Spike watched from his nest as his friends kept on marching around the jungle. Suddenly, they began to march in the direction of Spike's nest! Spike was so surprised! His friends were marching towards him. Spike ran out of his nest and joined in the march with his friends.

The friends marched around the jungle together and Spike was no longer grumpy. He had so much fun marching with them!

Once upon a time there was a bald man named Dave. He needed to supply his village with a special port.

Dave got on his boat and sailed out to sea. He sailed far and wide, searching for the perfect port.

After a long time of searching Dave finally found what he was looking for. He filled up his boat with a big supply of the port and sailed back to the village.

When he got there, the villagers were very happy to see the bald man.

"Thank you for the port, Dave," said one of them.

Dave smiled and said, "You're welcome. I'm happy to supply you with this special port."

Once upon a time, there was a furry little rabbit. The rabbit was very hungry and sad, so it started to pray. It prayed and prayed, begging for food.

Suddenly, a big hand reached down from the sky! The hand was holding a big carrots and some lettuce. The rabbit was so happy. It ate the food and was no longer sad.

The rabbit thanked the big hand for the food. Then it jumped, hopped and twirled all around the garden in gratitude. The rabbit thanked the big hand in heaven for sending it such a yummy meal.

The moral of the story is that when we pray, good things can happen!

Sara likes to play with her bow and arrow. She has a big bow and a small bow. She likes the small bow better. It is light and easy to hold. She can shoot the arrow far and fast.

One day, Sara goes to the park with her mom. She brings her small bow and arrow. She sees a big tree with a hole. She thinks it is a good target. She runs to the tree and aims her bow.

"Can I shoot the arrow, mom?" she asks.

"Yes, but be careful, Sara. Don't hit anyone or anything else," mom says.

Sara nods and pulls the string. She lets go of the arrow. It flies through the air and hits the tree. Sara is happy. She runs to get her arrow.

But when she gets to the tree, she sees a problem. The arrow is stuck in the hole. She cannot reach it. She tries to pull it out, but it does not move. She feels sad.

"Mom, I need help!" she cries.

Mom comes to the tree and sees the arrow. She tries to pull it out, but it is too deep. She shakes her head.

"I'm sorry, Sara. I can't get it out. It is too hard," mom says.

Sara starts to cry. She loves her arrow. She does not want to lose it.

"Please, mom, please. I need my arrow. It is my favorite," she says.

Mom hugs Sara and wipes her tears. She thinks for a moment. She has an idea.

"Wait here, Sara. I'll be right back," mom says.

She runs to the car and gets a rope. She comes back to the tree and ties the rope to the arrow. She pulls the rope hard. The arrow comes out of the hole. Sara claps her hands and cheers.

"Yay, mom, you did it! You got my arrow!" she says.

Mom smiles and gives Sara her arrow. She unties the rope and puts it back in the car.

"Here you go, Sara. Your arrow is safe. Now you can play with your bow again," mom says.

Sara hugs mom and says thank you. She is happy. She plays with her bow and arrow until it is time to go home. She has a lot of fun. She loves her mom and her bow.

Once there was a little boy. His name was John and he was three years old. One day, he wanted to go to the watermill. He wore his caps and shoes and set off. When he reached the mill, he saw a big rope. He asked his mommy, “Mummy, what’s that?” His mommy said, “That’s a rope, John. It’s used to tie the mill.”

John was so confused. He asked, “Why do we tie the mill?" His mommy replied, “We need to tie it so it does not move away.”

John was still confused. He asked, “But why?” His mommy smiled and said, “Because the mill is very important to us.”

John smiled too. He said, “Let’s tie the mill so it doesn’t move away!” His mommy agreed, so they worked together to tie the rope around the mill.

When they were done, they were both very happy. John had learned something new!

Every day, Simon would go to the playground to swing on the swing. He would push with his feet and soar so high. He was always so happy on the swing. It was always so pretty.

But one day, while Simon was on the swing, a big wind came. The wind pushed him really high. He got so scared. He started to worry.

Simon looked around for help. He saw his mom and waved his hands at her. His mom smiled kindly and ran over to Simon. She helped him off of the swing.

Simon felt so happy that his mom was there to help him. He gave her a big hug and thanked her. His mom hugged him back tightly, and said she was always there to help him.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted to climb a very tall mountain. But the mountain was steep, and she struggled to get to the top. Her legs and arms felt tired and weak, and she felt like she had no power to keep going. But she didn't give up. She kept fighting against all the terrible obstacles, and took a few rest stops along the way.

Finally, the little girl made it to the top of the mountain, and she had never felt so proud. She realized that the power to succeed was within herself the whole time. It wasn't easy, but she had made it.

The moral of this story is that if you work hard, you can do anything you set your mind to. You can get through even the most difficult tasks if you never give up. Even if it feels like the obstacles are too hard, never let those terrible things stop you from succeeding.

Once upon a time, there was a great chair. It was the favorite chair of a little girl called Jane. Every day, Jane would polish her chair so that it would look super nice.

One day, Jane noticed that her chair was even more special than usual. When she looked closer, she saw that it was sparkling. Jane was so excited! She asked her Mom, "Can I keep it this way?"

Her Mom said that she could polish it, but she could not keep it polished all the time, because it wasn't a good idea. Jane was very disappointed but she agreed.

Then, Jane's brother came into the room. He saw the chair and wanted to come sit in it too. Jane screamed "NO!" and ran to her chair to stop her brother.

But her Mom said that it was okay. Jane's brother could come and sit in her chair sometimes, too. Jane reluctantly agreed. The two of them shared the great chair, taking turns polishing it so it stayed nice and shiny.

John and Roberta were best friends. They shared so many different adventures and experiences together. One sunny day they decided to set out and explore their dreams. So they headed towards the ocean.

John said, “Let’s unite and explore the ocean.”

Roberta nodded. “Let’s dive in and see what’s different!”

They jumped into the deep, blue ocean and started to explore. They were amazed by all the different creatures, colours and shapes. They even saw some dolphins swimming by and said hello. After swimming for what seemed like forever, the sun began to set and it was time to head back home.

John and Roberta had the most amazing day, full of adventure and fun. They both felt so happy and knew that their friendship was even stronger now that they had gone on this special adventure together. No matter how different life gets, they will always be united by their shared love for exploration.

Tom and Lily were friends who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a big hill with many flowers. They wanted to go up the hill and see the view. They ran and jumped over the rocks and the grass. They were very happy.

But on the way, they saw a poor dog. The dog was thin and dirty. It had no collar and no home. It looked sad and scared. Tom and Lily felt sorry for the dog. They stopped and said hello to the dog.

"Hi, dog. What is your name?" Lily asked.

The dog did not answer. It only wagged its tail a little.

"Can we pet you?" Tom asked.

The dog nodded. It liked to be petted. Tom and Lily stroked its fur and gave it some water and a biscuit. The dog smiled and licked their hands.

"Can we take you with us?" Lily asked.

The dog barked. It wanted to go with them. Tom and Lily agreed. They took the dog by the leash and continued to the hill. They were very happy.

They reached the top of the hill and saw the view. It was beautiful. They saw the sun, the sky, the trees, and the river. They also saw a rainbow. They felt lucky.

"Look, dog. This is a good day. We have a new friend. You have a new home. We are happy. You are happy. We are lucky. You are lucky." Tom said.

The dog barked. It agreed. It was a good day. It had a new friend. It had a new home. It was happy. It was lucky.

Tom, Lily, and the dog hugged and jumped. They were very happy.

The end.

Moral value: The story teaches that kindness and friendship can make a poor dog and two children happy and lucky.

Foreshadowing or setup and payoff: The story foreshadows the rainbow by mentioning the sun and the sky. The rainbow is the payoff for the kindness and friendship of the characters.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jenny. She was only three years old. One day, Jenny was playing in the garden when an old grandmother appeared.

"Would you like a cup of coffee?" the grandmother asked kindly.

Jenny's eyes sparkled. "Yes please!" she said.

So, off they went to the kitchen. The grandmother put the coffee into an old cup and handed it to Jenny. "This is my original cup!" Jenny said happily.

Jenny took small sips of the coffee, enjoying the warm liquid. Then she asked the grandmother, "How long can I stay?"

"As long as you want," the grandmother smiled.

So, Jenny stayed with the grandmother for the rest of the day, sipping her original cup of coffee.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion. He lived in a hot place with lots of sand. The sand was soft and warm. The lion liked to lay on it and feel the sun on his fur.

One day, the lion saw a small bird. The bird was scared of the lion's roar. The lion said, "Don't be scared, little bird. I won't hurt you." The bird felt better and flew away.

The lion went back to laying on the soft sand. He thought about how nice it was to be kind to others. From that day on, the lion tried to be kind to everyone he met.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw pictures of flowers and trees. One day, she went to her drawer to get her crayons, but she saw a candle burning on the table.

Lily's mom told her to stay calm and not touch the candle. She said it could burn her and make her hurt. Lily listened to her mom and stayed away from the candle.

After a while, the candle burned out and Lily's mom put it away in the drawer. Lily was happy that the candle was gone because she loved her drawings and didn't want them to burn. From that day on, she always remembered to be calm and stay away from burning things.

Once upon a time, there was a little seed. The seed was very small and fragile. It needed lots of water and sunshine to grow big and strong. One day, the rain came and watered the seed. The sun came out and shone on the seed. The seed started to grow and grow until it bloomed into a beautiful flower.

The flower was so pretty that it caught the eye of a little girl. The little girl picked the flower and put it in an envelope. She wanted to keep the flower forever. But the flower was fragile and soon wilted inside the envelope. The little girl learned that some things are meant to stay in nature and bloom for everyone to enjoy.

Mummy and daddy went to the lake to lay on a boat. There was an elderly man on the boat with them, who daddy spoke to. He was wearing funny old clothes that mummy and daddy laughed at.

Daddy steered the boat over the lake. They saw lots of ducks and other birds. The birds were quacking and flying around. The elderly man was giving daddy lots of advice.

After a while mummy and daddy got out of the boat and lay down on the grass. The elderly man stayed in the boat and kept rowing across the lake. Mummy and daddy waved to the elderly man as he rowed away.

They laid on the grass and watched the sun go down. Daddy smiled and said how happy he was to be at the lake with mummy. Then they both held hands and watched the stars come out one by one in the night sky.

Lila and Tom were going to visit their grandma for the weekend. They had a big bag with their clothes and toys. Mom helped them unpack the bag in the guest room.

"Look, Lila, I brought my dinosaur book!" Tom said, holding up a colorful book with pictures of fierce animals.

"Wow, Tom, that's cool! Can I see?" Lila asked, reaching for the book.

"Okay, but be careful. It's my favorite book," Tom said, handing it to her.

Lila opened the book and looked at the different dinosaurs. She saw one with a long neck, one with a big horn, and one with a sharp tail. She pointed at each one and said their names.

"That's a brontosaurus, that's a triceratops, and that's a stegosaurus," she said proudly.

Tom nodded and smiled. He liked that Lila knew the names of the dinosaurs. He also liked to learn new things from the book.

"Can I show you something?" he asked.

"Sure, what is it?" Lila asked.

Tom flipped to a page with a picture of a dinosaur that had a big mouth full of teeth. He pointed at it and said, "That's a tyrannosaurus rex. He's the fiercest of all the dinosaurs. He can eat anything he wants."

Lila looked at the picture and felt scared. She didn't like the tyrannosaurus rex. He looked mean and scary.

"I don't like him. He's too fierce. He might eat us," she said, hiding behind Tom.

Tom hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lila. He's not real. He's just a picture in a book. He can't hurt us."

Lila peeked from behind Tom and saw the picture again. She saw that Tom was right. It was just a picture in a book. She felt a little better.

"Okay, Tom. I'm not scared anymore. But can we look at another dinosaur? Maybe one that's nicer?" she asked.

Tom nodded and said, "Sure, Lila. How about this one?" He turned to a page with a picture of a dinosaur that had a big thumb on its hand. He pointed at it and said, "That's a thumb-saurus. He's a friendly dinosaur. He likes to give thumbs up to his friends."

Lila giggled and said, "That's a funny dinosaur. He has a big thumb. Can we give him a thumbs up too?"

Tom and Lila held up their thumbs and smiled. They liked the thumb-saurus. He was a nice dinosaur. They decided to make him their new friend.
