But Anna does not hug back. She does not sign. She does not talk. She is deaf to her mom. She is deaf to her love. She is deaf to her sorry. She turns away. She cries. She runs. She is gone.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She wanted to have something special. Her mum had an expensive paper. The girl asked her mum to remove the paper so she could have it. Her mum said she couldn't remove the paper. The paper was very expensive and delicate.

The little girl was sad, so she searched for a way to get the paper. Suddenly, she noticed something shiny on the floor. It was a coin. She knew that if she had enough coins she could buy a new paper!

She started collecting coins and saved them in a jar. Every day she would look under rugs and between cushions until she had enough coins to buy the paper. After a few weeks, the little girl had saved enough coins to buy her new paper.

The little girl was so happy! She took her coins to the shop and bought her very own new, special and expensive paper. She took it home and was very careful when she removed it from the wrapping. The little girl couldn't believe how happy she was. She proudly displayed her new paper in her room, and it made her smile every time she saw it.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Blue. Blue loved to fly high up in the sky and soar like an airplane. One day, Blue was flying around looking for some milk to drink. Blue saw a cow and asked, "Excuse me, do you have any milk for me to drink?"

The cow replied, "I'm sorry, little bird, but I don't have any milk to give you. I need all my milk for my baby calf."

Blue was very angry because he was very thirsty and wanted some milk to drink. Blue started to fly away, but then he had an idea. He flew back to the cow and said, "I'm sorry for getting angry. Can I please help you take care of your baby calf? Maybe then you can give me some milk to drink?"

The cow was happy to hear this and said, "That's a great idea! Thank you for offering to help." Blue helped take care of the baby calf and in return, the cow gave Blue some milk to drink. Blue was very happy and grateful for the milk. From then on, Blue made a new friend and always remembered to be kind and helpful.

Once there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to eat spaghetti. He would eat it every day for lunch and dinner. One day, his mom made him a big plate of warm spaghetti. Timmy was so happy! He ate and ate until he was full.

After lunch, Timmy went to play outside. He saw a bug on the ground and wanted to pick it up. But when he tried, the bug pinched him! Ouch! Timmy learned that bugs can pinch too, not just people.

Later that day, Timmy's mom made him another plate of warm spaghetti for dinner. Timmy was so excited to eat it again. He remembered the bug that pinched him earlier and decided to be careful when he played outside. From then on, Timmy enjoyed his spaghetti and played safely outside.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a dream that made him scared. In the dream, he saw a big monster that wanted to eat him. Timmy woke up in the middle of the night and ran to his mom's room. His mom gave him a hug and told him that it was just a nightmare.

The next day, Timmy decided to draw a picture of the monster from his dream. He wanted to make it look original, so he used many colors. When his friend saw the drawing, he said that it looked cool. But then, they started to fight over who would get to keep the drawing.

Timmy didn't like to fight, so he decided to make a new drawing for his friend. This time, he drew a happy sun with a big smile. His friend loved it and they played together all day. Timmy was happy that he could make his friend smile without having to fight.

Sara is a big girl. She goes to school with other big kids. She likes to learn new things and play with her friends. But today, she feels different. She has a test in math. She does not like math. It is hard and boring.

She sits at her desk and looks at the paper. She sees numbers and signs. She does not know what they mean. She feels scared and sad. She wants to cry. She looks at her teacher. She wants to ask for help. But she thinks the teacher will be angry. She thinks the other kids will laugh. She feels alone.

She hears a voice next to her. It is Ben. Ben is her friend. He is good at math. He smiles at her and whispers. "Do you need help?" He asks. Sara feels happy. She nods. Ben helps her with the test. He shows her how to do the math. He explains the numbers and signs. He is kind and patient. Sara feels better. She thanks Ben. She finishes the test. She is proud of herself.

She gives the paper to the teacher. The teacher looks at it and smiles. She says, "Good job, Sara. You did well on the test." She gives Sara a sticker. Sara feels happy. She runs to Ben and hugs him. She says, "Thank you, Ben. You are a good friend." Ben hugs her back. He says, "You are welcome, Sara. You are a good friend too." They go to play with the other kids. They have fun. They are different, but they are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emily who was playing in her garden. She liked to be outside, running around and playing with her pets.

Emily saw a bunny hopping around and she wanted to speed up to catch it. She ran and ran until finally, she caught the bunny.

The bunny was very cute. Emily thought it was so adorable. She asked the bunny, "Will you be my friend?" The bunny nodded its head and hopped around the garden with Emily.

Emily and the bunny played together for a while. Then, Emily said "I'm getting tired. Let's do some exercise!"

The bunny hopped around while Emily did jumping jacks, walked around, and ran in circles. They had so much fun doing exercise together.

When the exercise was done, Emily and the bunny hugged each other and said goodbye. Emily was so happy to have a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her round ball in the park every day. But one day, Lily's ball got a hole in it and it didn't bounce anymore. She was sad and didn't know what to do.

Lily's mom saw her sad face and said, "Don't worry, we can improve your ball. Let's go to the store and find a unique new ball for you." So, they went to the store and found a shiny, new ball that was round and unique. Lily was so happy and couldn't wait to play with her new ball in the park.

Now, Lily's ball bounced higher and faster than ever before. She was so happy and thanked her mom for helping her improve her ball. From that day on, Lily played with her unique ball every day and had lots of fun in the park.

Once there was an elderly lady who liked to attach things. She always carried a bag of items she had attached.

One day, she decided to see a friend she had not seen in a long time. When she arrived at her friend's house, she asked a question.

"Do you need help with anything that needs to be attached?", asked the elderly lady.

Her friend's face lit up with surprise. "Why yes, I do need help! I just bought some new decorations, but I don't know how to attach them to the wall," she said.

The elderly lady smiled. She made quick work of attaching the decorations to the wall.

Her friend thanked her. The elderly lady waved goodbye and continued on her way, her bag filled with the things she had attached.

Emma loved to play dress-up. She had so many beautiful dresses. But one day, her mom realized one was missing. Emma quickly realized that her pet dog had taken it. He had worn the pretty dress all day!

Emma felt sad and sorry. She knew she had to help restore the dress. She asked her mom for help. Her mom laughed and said it was no problem. She made the dress look just like new. Emma was so happy and she thanked her mom for taking care of it.

They put the dress away for special occasions. Now Emma knew to keep her dresses away from her dog! She was sorry for not being more careful. But she was happy that the dress was restored. Emma learned an important lesson that day.

A famous postman named Bob was out delivering mail one day. He was so busy that he became quite tired. After he had finished delivering the mail, he went off to take a nap.

Bob found a nice patch of grass and lay down. He planned to take a short nap and then go back to work. But Bob ended up napping for much longer than he had intended.

When he awoke, the sun was setting in the sky. Bob was amazed at how long he had been asleep. He quickly finished his route and returned home for the night.

Bob couldn't believe how famous his nap had become. Everyone in town was talking about Bob's nap and his postman uniform. From that day on, Bob was known as the famous napping postman.

Once upon a time, there was a new duck. The new duck loved to swim in the pond. One day, the new duck saw a big mean dog. The new duck wanted to play with the big mean dog. But the big mean dog did not want to play with the new duck.

The big mean dog tried to catch the new duck. The new duck tried to fly away, but it was too new to fly. The new duck tried to run away, but the big mean dog was too fast. The new duck did not know how to prevent the big mean dog from catching it.

Sadly, the big mean dog caught the new duck. The new duck could not escape. The new duck was very scared. The big mean dog did not want to play with the new duck. The big mean dog wanted to eat the new duck. The new duck could not prevent the big mean dog from eating it. The bad ending was that the new duck became the big mean dog's dinner.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient house. It was old and dusty and looked like it had not been taken care of in years.

One day, a little girl named Millie came to the old house. She had a bucket full of Special bubbles and started to decorate the house with them. Millie drew a smiley face on the front door, colorful flowers around the windows and a rainbow on the roof.

Millie smiled as she stepped back to admire her work. Suddenly, she heard a strange noise.

A little mouse peered out of a nearby window. "Wow, Millie, your house looks so pretty!" the mouse said.

Millie smiled. "Thank you mouse," She said happily, "I hope everyone likes decorating it with bubbles!"

The mouse nodded in agreement, then Millie and the mouse went off to find even more bubbles to use for decoration.

The End.

Once there was a little girl named Lucy. She was only three years old. Lucy liked to wake up early. She would get out of bed and run around the house, making lots of noise. One morning, her mom heard all the noise and got very angry. She ran over to Lucy and slapped her hand. Lucy started to cry. She had never been slapped before. "It is important to stay quiet in the morning," said mom. "Let's learn this lesson together." Lucy wiped away her tears and nodded her head. From that day on, Lucy was more careful. She would wake up quietly and make sure not to bother her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max liked to play outside and dig in the dirt. One day, Max found a bone in the dirt. He was so happy to have a bone to chew on.

But then, a little girl came over to Max and tried to take his bone away. Max didn't like that. He barked at the little girl and was very rude. The little girl didn't want to be friends with Max anymore.

Max realized that he shouldn't be rude to his friends. He went over to the little girl and wagged his tail. He gave her the bone as a present. The little girl was happy again and Max was happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to hop around in the meadow and play with his friends. One day, Benny saw a vendor selling carrots. He wanted to buy some, but he didn't have any money.

Benny asked the vendor if he could pay him back later, but the vendor said no. Benny was sad, but then he remembered that he had a flexible body. He decided to show the vendor how he could do somersaults and cartwheels, hoping to make him smile.

The vendor was impressed and gave Benny some carrots for free. Benny learned that being kind and flexible can make people happy and help you get what you want. From then on, Benny always tried to be kind and flexible with others.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very eager to buy a new chair for her room. She went to the store with her mommy and daddy to look at the furniture.

Lily saw a pretty pink chair that she really liked. She asked her mommy and daddy if they could buy it for her. Her daddy said they could pay for it and take it home.

Lily was so happy and sat in her new chair all day. She loved her new furniture and was grateful to her mommy and daddy for buying it for her. The end.

Lila was a princess who lived in a big palace. She had many toys and dresses and books, but she was not happy. She wanted to go outside and play with other children, but her father, the king, said no. He said it was too dangerous and she had to stay inside.

One day, Lila saw a bird fly by her window. She opened the window and called to the bird. The bird came closer and landed on her hand. It was a blue bird with a yellow beak and a red tail. Lila smiled and said hello to the bird. The bird said hello back and told her his name was Riko.

Lila and Riko became friends. They talked and sang and played every day. Riko told Lila stories about the world outside the palace. He told her about the trees and the flowers and the animals and the people. Lila wanted to see them with her own eyes. She asked Riko to take her with him.

Riko said yes, but he warned her that she had to be careful. He said she had to lie to her father and say she was sick. He said she had to wear a cloak and a hat to hide her face. He said she had to follow him and not talk to anyone. Lila agreed. She was brave and curious.

The next morning, Lila told her father that she felt bad. She said she had a headache and a sore throat. Her father felt sorry for her and said she could stay in bed. He said he would send a doctor and a maid to take care of her. He kissed her forehead and left.

Lila waited until the coast was clear. She put on a cloak and a hat and grabbed a basket. She opened the window and saw Riko waiting for her. She climbed out and joined him. They flew away from the palace and into the sky.

Lila felt free and happy. She saw many wonderful things with Riko. She saw the green grass and the colorful flowers. She saw the fluffy clouds and the bright sun. She saw the friendly animals and the smiling people. She felt the warm breeze and the fresh air. She laughed and sang and played.

But she also saw some sad things. She saw the dirty streets and the broken houses. She saw the hungry children and the angry men. She saw the cold rain and the dark night. She felt the bitter cold and the fear.

Lila realized that the world was not all good or all bad. It was both. She felt sorry for the people who had less than her. She felt grateful for the things she had. She felt love for Riko and her father.

She decided to go back to the palace. She thanked Riko for showing her the world. She hugged him and said goodbye. She promised to see him again. She climbed back into her window and into her bed.

She lied to her father and said she felt better. She smiled and said she had a good dream. She did not tell him about Riko or the world. She kept it as a secret. She knew he would not understand. She knew he would be angry and scared.

She was happy and sad. She missed Riko and the world. She loved her father and the palace. She was a princess who had seen both. She was a princess who had grown.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sue. She was 3 years old, and she was very curious. She had a lovely chest full of toys and games. One day, Sue opened the chest and looked inside. She saw all the wonderful things that were waiting for her to play with.

Sue said, "I want to fill my chest with even more lovely things!"

Just then, her mum appeared and said, "Let me help you, Sue. We can go to the shop and fill your chest with lovely new things."

So Sue and her mum went to the shop and bought lots of lovely things - dolls, balls, cars and books. Sue filled her chest and felt so happy!

The chest was now full of wonderful toys, just for Sue. She hugged her mum, and said, "Thank you! I love my lovely chest!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his toys and his dog, Max. One day, Timmy found a shiny rock in the dirt. He was so proud of his new discovery that he showed it to his mom.

"Wow, that's a beautiful rock," said Timmy's mom. "But be careful, sometimes things in the dirt can be dangerous, like poison."

Timmy didn't know what poison was, but he nodded his head anyway. Later that day, Timmy and Max were playing in the yard when Max suddenly started digging a hole. Timmy saw that Max had found something buried in the ground.

"What did you find, Max?" Timmy asked.

Max barked and dug deeper, until he uncovered a bone. Timmy was excited to have found something buried too, but then he remembered what his mom had said about things in the dirt being dangerous.

"Max, we have to bury this bone again," Timmy said. "It might be poison."

So Timmy and Max buried the bone back in the ground, and Timmy felt proud that he had made a good decision to keep himself and Max safe.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named John and Jane. They wanted to have fun and so they decided to sail a boat.

John said to Jane, “Let’s go sail! It will be so cool!”

Jane agreed, “Yes! Let’s go sail in the lake.”

They sailed their boat in the lake. John and Jane had a lot of fun. After sailing, they decided to cook something to eat.

John said, “Let’s cook something yummy!”

Jane answered, “Yes! Let’s cook some nice food in the kitchen.”

The two friends had a lot of fun cooking in the kitchen. They cooked some delicious food and ate it.

John and Jane had such a cool and fun day sailing and cooking!

Once upon a time, there was a happy girl named Jacky. Every day, Jacky went to the gym and skipped around. She did a lot of funny dances and sang many silly songs. She just loved to skip!

One day, Jacky was in the gym and it smelled really smelly. She had no idea why the gym was so smelly, so she asked her mom who was nearby.

"Mommy, why does the gym smell smelly?" Jacky asked.

Her mom replied, "Sometimes, when too many people go to the gym, it can smell smelly."

Jacky, who was very curious, wasn't satisfied with this answer. She wanted to know more. "What can I do to make the gym not so smelly?"

Her mom thought for a moment, then replied with a big smile, "I have an idea. Let's skip in the gym together and make the air clean again. That way the gym won't be so smelly. What do you think?"

Jacky beamed with excitement and jumped out of her chair to grab her skipping rope. The two of them skipped around the gym together, laughing and singing silly songs. After a while, the air was much cleaner and the smelly smell was gone! From then on, Jacky and her mom spent time at the gym skipping together and keeping the air clean.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to play together. One day, they found a big mug in the kitchen. It was blue and had a picture of a cow on it. They decided to use it as a toy.

"Let's pretend this is a house for our dolls," Lily said. She put her doll inside the mug and lay a napkin over it. "Now she is cozy and warm."

"That's a good idea," Tom said. He put his doll next to Lily's and lay another napkin over it. "Now they are friends and have a peaceful sleep."

They smiled and hugged each other. They were happy with their new toy.

But then, they heard a loud noise. It was their mom, who came into the kitchen. She saw the mug on the floor and was angry.

"Who did this?" she asked. "This is my favorite mug. It was a gift from Grandma. You could have broken it."

Lily and Tom felt scared and sorry. They did not mean to make their mom mad. They did not know the mug was special.

"We are sorry, Mom," they said together. "We just wanted to play with it. We did not know it was yours."

Mom sighed and picked up the mug. She saw the dolls and the napkins inside. She realized that Lily and Tom were just using their imagination. She felt a little less angry and a little more understanding.

"I know you were just playing, but you have to be careful with things that are not yours," she said. "This mug is very old and fragile. It could have cracked or chipped. And it means a lot to me, because Grandma gave it to me before she passed away."

Lily and Tom nodded. They felt sad that Grandma was gone. They remembered how she used to read them stories and bake them cookies. They loved her very much.

"Can we say sorry to Grandma?" Lily asked.

"Of course you can," Mom said. "She is always in our hearts. And I'm sure she would forgive you, because she loved you very much too."

She hugged Lily and Tom and kissed them on their heads. She told them to put their dolls away and wash their hands. Then she gave them each a cookie and a glass of milk. She let them keep the mug as a toy, but only if they promised to be gentle with it and put it back in the cupboard when they were done.

Lily and Tom agreed. They thanked their mom and said sorry to Grandma. They ate their cookies and drank their milk. Then they played with the mug and their dolls again. They were careful and happy. They felt peaceful and loved.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Dave and Amy. Dave was a big, strong bear and Amy was a tiny, bouncy rabbit.

One day, Dave and Amy decided to go on an adventure. First, they found a trumpet. Amy was so excited she hugged it tightly.

Next, they went deep into the woods. The trees were tall, and the shadows were deep. They couldn't see very far, but they could hear a strange noise. It was a trumpet!

So, Dave and Amy hugged each other tight and followed the sound of the trumpet. Eventually, they came across a kind old man playing his trumpet in the middle of the woods.

Dave and Amy smiled, and Amy hugged the man tightly in thanks. The old man hugged her back and thanked them for coming to listen to his music.

The three friends hugged, and Dave and Amy said goodbye to the old man. They couldn't wait to go on more adventures together!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very happy because her mommy gave her an invitation to a birthday party. Lily was so excited to go to the party and play with her friends.

But when they got to the party, Lily's mommy realized she forgot to pay for the invitation. Lily's mommy was very worried, but luckily the nice lady at the party said it was okay and they could still come in.

Lily had so much fun at the party! She played games, ate cake, and even got a balloon animal from the clown. When it was time to go home, Lily was still so happy and thanked her mommy for taking her to the party.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play outside at night. They would look at the stars and the moon and make wishes. One night, Ben saw a big, bright moon and wanted to have it. He pointed at the moon and said, "I want that! Give me the moon!"

Lily looked at Ben and shook her head. She said, "You can't have the moon, Ben. The moon is for everyone. It is not a toy. It is very far away and very big. You can't take it home."

Ben did not listen to Lily. He stamped his feet and shouted, "I want the moon! I want the moon! Give me the moon!" He was very angry and very rude. He demanded the moon.

Lily felt sad and envious. She wished Ben would share and be nice. She said, "Ben, please stop. You are being mean and silly. The moon is not yours. It is beautiful and we can enjoy it together. Why don't you make a wish instead?"

Ben did not want to make a wish. He wanted the moon. He said, "No! I don't want to wish. I want the moon! I want the moon! Give me the moon!" He cried and cried.

Lily did not know what to do. She looked at the moon and hoped it would help. She said, "Moon, please help. Ben is being bad and wants to have you. Can you make him happy and calm?"

The moon heard Lily and smiled. It said, "Lily, you are a good and kind sister. Ben is being greedy and foolish. He does not understand that the moon is not a thing to have, but a thing to love. I will show him the truth."

The moon shone brighter and brighter. It made a big, round shadow on the ground. It said, "Ben, look. This is the moon. This is how big and far I am. You can't have me, but you can love me. You can see me every night and say hello. You can make wishes and I will listen. You can share me with Lily and everyone else. That is the way to be happy and wise."

Ben looked at the moon and the shadow. He felt ashamed and sorry. He said, "Moon, I am sorry. I was wrong. You are right. I can't have you, but I can love you. You are very beautiful and kind. Thank you for showing me the truth. I will not demand you anymore. I will share you with Lily and everyone else. I will make wishes and say hello. I will be happy and wise."

Lily smiled and hugged Ben. She said, "Ben, I am glad. You are a good and smart brother. I love you and the moon. Let's make wishes and say hello. Let's be happy and wise."

The moon smiled and winked. It said, "Lily and Ben, you are wonderful and sweet. I love you too. Let's make wishes and say hello. Let's be happy and wise."

Once upon a time there lived a little girl named Mark. Every day, Mark would take a nap. She loved her nap time, so she would always curl up in her bed and quickly drift off.

One day Mark really wanted a new toy. She asked her mom for a toy, but her mom said that it was too expensive. Mark was so disappointed until her mom showed her a special store with cheap toys. So together, Mark and her mom went to the store to find a toy for her.

At the store Mark was amazed. She saw so many fun toys! She couldn't decide which one to pick, until she saw a very nice and cheap toy. It was perfect! She quickly took it and hugged it tight.

Mark was so happy that she took a nap right there, in the store. When she woke up, she was still holding her new toy.

Mark hugged her mom and said thank you. Then they took the toy home and Mark and her toy became best friends. They had many fun times together and never stopped napping!

Once upon a time, there were some kids who were friends. They loved to play together and have fun. One day, they saw some youth who looked sad and alone. They decided to go and talk to them.

The youth told them that they were having a tough time at school. The friends listened and tried to help. They discussed what they could do to make the youth feel better. They decided to invite them to play with them and be their friend.

From that day on, the youth was no longer alone. They had new friends who cared about them. The friends were happy that they could help someone in need. They learned that discussing problems and being kind to others can make a big difference.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Emma and Jack. One day, they wanted to discuss furniture.

"Let's talk about furniture," said Emma.

"Yes," said Jack.

They looked around the room and saw a small table.

"What is that?" asked Emma pointing to the table.

"That is a small table," answered Jack.

They looked at the small table and discussed what they could do with it.

"We could use it as a game table," said Emma.

"Yes!" said Jack.

They discussed other ideas until they had the perfect plan. They agreed to use the small table as a game table. They laughed and cheered and had lots of fun.

The end!

Once there was a powerful human named Jack. He was very strong and liked to pick quarrels with other humans. One day Jack was walking in the park when he noticed another human.

"Let's have a quarrel!" shouted Jack.

"No thank you!" said the other human. "I don't want to quarrel with you."

Jack got angry and stepped closer. He was so powerful that the other human was scared.

The other human said, "Please don't quarrel. Let's just be friends."

Jack thought about it and eventually decided to be friends with the other human. They hugged and became the best of friends.

From then on, Jack never wanted to quarrel with anyone. He was so powerful, but he chose to use his powers for good.

Once there was a little girl and her name was Sandy. She was very playful and loved exploring her backyard. She would often pick flowers, find bugs and explore the grassy patches. One day, Sandy noticed something delicious in the grass - butter. She picked up the butter and held it in her hands. She wanted to eat it, but she knew she should not. She complained to her mommy - she wanted to have the butter. Her mommy said, "No, Sandy. That is not for us to eat. Look how the grass bugs enjoy it." Sandy pouted, but eventually agreed. The grass bugs were so playful - they were jumping around and playing with each other. Sandy kept watching them, wishing she could play too. Finally, she stopped complaining and decided to play in the grass. She had so much fun, she almost forgot all about the butter!

Once upon a time there was a boy named John. One day, he was walking in the garden when he saw something special. He saw a goose that had a smooth, shiny feather.

John was so excited and ran over to take a closer look. He asked the goose, "What is your name?"

The goose replied, "My name is Randy, and I like to make music."

John was so amazed. He asked Randy, "How do you make music?"

Randy said, "I make music by flapping my wings and singing songs."

John smiled in delight. He said, "That sounds so fun! Can you teach me how to make music with you?"

Randy happily agreed and taught John some simple songs. Soon, John was following Randy and making his own music. The smooth music filled the garden. Everyone was so happy.

The End.

Once upon a time there were two brothers who were always fighting. William and Scott were the best of friends, but they argued constantly. One day, the brothers were in the back garden playing a game of tag. In the middle of their game, William noticed that Scott was ignoring him. When William asked him what he was doing, Scott said he was trying to spell a word.

"What are you spelling?" William asked. Scott replied that he was trying to spell the word “quiet”. The brothers decided to try and spell the word together, and soon enough, they were able to say it perfectly.

Suddenly, William realised the soft sound the wind was making, and the peacefulness of the garden. He asked Scott if he felt the same, and Scott nodded in agreement. For the first time in a long time, the two brothers played together in complete harmony, enjoying the quiet moment in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a smart octopus. He loved to collect things. One day, he found a shiny shell by the sea. He liked it so much that he kept it.

Then, he looked around and saw some colorful stones. So, he collected them too.

Next, he spotted a beautiful starfish. He was very careful and slowly reached out to collect it.

Finally, he found a treasure chest! He opened it carefully. Inside, there were lots of sparkly coins. He was so excited he collected them all.

The smart octopus was very happy with his new treasures. He couldn't wait to go home and show his friends his collections.

Once there was a long, slim camera. It was special because it could take pictures and show them back on the screen. One day, the camera had an idea. It wanted to be released! It wanted to explore the world on its own.

So, the camera rolled off the shelf and made its way to the door. It soon reached the door handle and stretched out its little lens. With all its might, it grabbed the handle, pushed the door open and released itself!

The camera rolled outside and was so excited. It looked around and then started rolling down the long driveway. The world was even more beautiful than it had imagined and it couldn't wait to start taking pictures and documenting its journey.

Lily liked to sew with her mom. She had a small needle and some thread. She made a stitch on a piece of cloth. She wanted to make a doll.

"Mom, can I use some buttons for the eyes?" she asked.

"Sure, honey. Here are some blue ones. They are very pretty," her mom said.

Lily sewed the buttons on the cloth. She also sewed a mouth and a nose. She stuffed the cloth with cotton. She made a dress for the doll out of another piece of cloth. She sewed a ribbon on the dress.

"Look, mom. I made a doll. She is very sweet," Lily said.

"Wow, Lily. You did a great job. She is very sweet indeed. What is her name?" her mom asked.

"Her name is Rose. She is my new friend," Lily said.

She hugged the doll and smiled. She was very happy. She had become a good sewer.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to play in the sunshine. One day, he saw a dark vegetable in the garden. The little boy decided to pick it and sign. He quickly put it into his pocket and ran home.

When he arrived at home, his mother saw the dark vegetable in his pocket. She asked, "What is that?" The little boy said, "This is a vegetable I've signed!" His mother said, "Oh no! You should never sign things without my permission!"

The mother was very angry. She said to the little boy, "You have been so naughty! You must not sign anything else ever again!"

The little boy didn't understand why his mother was so angry. He was very sad, but he knew his mother was right. He never made the same mistake again--he never signed anything else without his mother's permission.

It was a beautiful day and Mommy said, "Let's go to the store to buy something fancy!"

So little Susie put on her shoes and off they went. Susie was so excited to see all the goodies in the store.

Once they got there, Susie ran over to the shelves and saw the lotion. "Mommy, can I get this lotion? It's purple. It's so fancy!"

Mommy smiled and said, "Of course, sweetheart. Let's go over here to get something else fancy, too."

Mommy and Susie looked around for a few minutes and eventually found a pretty box full of colorful beads. "We can sort them by color," Mommy said.

Susie knelt down and started sorting the beads into piles. It didn't take long for Susie to sort the beads. She was so proud of herself! She was getting so good at sorting things.

Mommy smiled and said, "That was really excellent. Now, let's take our fancy things home!"

They paid for the lotion and beads and went back home. Little Susie had lots of fun at the store and was so pleased with her fancy things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to skip everywhere she went. One day, she saw a painter working on a big white wall. "What are you doing?" Lily asked. "I'm painting a beautiful picture for everyone to see," the painter replied.

Lily watched the painter for a little while, and then she said, "That looks yummy!" The painter laughed and said, "No, it's not yummy. It's just paint."

Lily thought for a moment and then said, "I wish I could paint like you." The painter smiled and said, "You can! All you need is some paint and a brush."

Excited, Lily ran home to get her own paint and brush. She skipped back to the wall and started painting her own picture. The painter watched and smiled as Lily created her own masterpiece. From that day on, Lily skipped to the wall every day to paint and practice her skills.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine and feel the grass tickle her toes. One day, her mom made spaghetti for dinner and Lily helped pour the sauce on top. She loved the way the red sauce looked like a wild river flowing over the noodles.

After dinner, Lily's mom told her they were going on a special adventure. They walked through the woods and Lily saw a big, scary bear. She was scared, but her mom told her not to worry. They had a secret weapon - a jar of honey. They put the honey on a tree and the bear went wild for it. Lily was amazed and loved the adventure.

Later that night, as Lily lay in bed, she thought about the bear and the honey. She realized that sometimes things that seem scary can turn out to be fun and exciting. And she loved that she got to go on an adventure with her mom. From that day on, whenever she ate spaghetti with sauce, she thought about the wild bear and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat yogurt for breakfast every day. One morning, her mom brought her a new flavor of yogurt - strawberry. Lily was so happy and said, "This yogurt is charming, Mommy!"

Later that day, Lily went to the park to play. She met a boy named Timmy and they started talking. Timmy said, "I believe in magic. Do you?" Lily thought about it for a moment and said, "I believe in magic too! Just like how this yogurt is magically delicious."

Timmy laughed and said, "You're funny, Lily. Let's go play on the swings!" They had so much fun together and Lily couldn't wait to tell her mom all about her new friend and their charming conversation.

Once upon a time, there was a small bunny. He liked to hop all day long. One day, he wanted to go see his friend who lived far away. He didn't know the way, but he was determined to find it. He hopped and hopped until he found a small path. He followed the way until he finally arrived at his friend's house. They played together and had a lot of fun. When it was time to go home, the bunny hopped all the way back, feeling very happy.

Tim and Lily were friends. They liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big dog. The dog was brown and had a long tail. The dog ran to them and wagged his tail.

"Hello, dog!" Tim said. He petted the dog's head. The dog licked his hand. Lily was scared. She hid behind Tim.

"Don't be scared, Lily," Tim said. "The dog is nice. He just wants to say hello."

Lily peeked from behind Tim. The dog looked at her and smiled. He came closer and sniffed her. Lily giggled. The dog was soft and warm.

"Can I pet him too?" Lily asked.

"Sure," Tim said. "He likes it."

Lily reached out and touched the dog's fur. The dog wagged his tail harder. He was happy. He gave Lily a kiss on her cheek. Lily laughed.

"Thank you, dog," Lily said. "You are sweet."

The dog barked. He was grateful. He liked Tim and Lily. They were his new friends.

Just then, a man came to the park. He had a leash and a bag. He called the dog.

"Rex, come here, boy!" the man said. "It's time to go home. I have some beef for you."

The dog heard the man. He heard the word beef. He loved beef. He ran to the man.

"Bye, Rex!" Tim and Lily said. "We hope to see you again."

The dog looked back at them. He barked. He said goodbye. He was grateful for their kindness. He hoped to see them again too. He followed the man. He smelled the beef. He was hungry. He was happy.

Lovely Larry was a humble boy who was always looking for things to do. One day he decided to join a special club. He saw a notice that said that a watch club was holding its first meeting and he decided to join.

So he put on his best outfit, found his watch and set off.

When he arrived, he met two other children. One was called Bunny and the other was called Bluebird. They greeted each other and joined hands.

Bluebird said, “Let’s each show off our watches. Let’s start with you, Lovely Larry.”

Larry took off his watch and held it up proudly. “I got this watch from my mommy for my birthday,” he said.

The other two children showed off their watches too. Then they all decided to sit in a circle and share stories about their watches.

At the end of the meeting, Lovely Larry thanked everyone for letting him join their watch club.

“We would be honored to have you here next time,” said Bunny.

Larry smiled and said goodbye. He felt so happy to have found a new place where he belonged.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Abi. She had a special bow that she liked to play with. One day Abi's mom decided that it was time for a new suit.

Abi was so excited and went to the shop to choose a new suit. When they got to the shop, Abi found the most beautiful suit. But it was far too filthy. It was covered in mud, and it was too dirty to wear.

Abi's mom decided to take it home, and Abi could help her clean it. So Abi grabbed her bow, and the two of them set to work cleaning the suit.

They worked for a long time, scrubbing, washing and rinsing the suit until it was as clean and spotless as can be. When they were finished, Abi held up her bow, proud of the work she had done.

The suit looked so nice and it fit Abi perfectly. From then on, Abi was proud to wear her new suit every day!

Once there were two friends, a white cat and a brown dog. Every day, they would go to the harbor and watch the boats sail. One day, the cat wanted to get on a boat, but the dog refused. The cat became very angry and said bad things to the dog. The dog was hurt and sad and he walked away.

The next day, the cat went to the harbor by himself. He saw a big boat that was so white and shiny. A man on the boat said he would take the cat for a ride. The cat agreed and he hopped on board.

But as soon as the boat started sailing away, the cat realized he had made a mistake. The bad man refused to let the cat off the boat.

The cat sadly spent many days at sea, until the boat docked at a harbor far away. The cat had no way of getting back home, and so he had to stay there, all alone.

The white cat never saw his friend, the brown dog, ever again.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Jack. Jack was a boy who loved adventure. One day, Jack decided to explore a lovely forest. As Jack was walking in the forest, he heard a funny noise. He followed the noise and found a secret cave!

Inside the cave, Jack saw something sparkly. He walked into the cave and saw a treasure chest. Jack was excited and opened the chest. Inside, there was a big gem! The gem was glowing brightly.

Jack took the gem and decided to pass it to his mom. She would know how to take care of it. But then something strange happened. Suddenly, the gem started to move! The gem passed by Jack and went into the forest!

Jack was confused. He wanted to find the gem and keep it as a treasure. He searched the whole forest but he couldn't find it. He was sad and went back to his mom. From then on, Jack was always careful with his treasures and never confused again!

Tom and Ben were friends who liked to play music. Tom had a trumpet that he got from his dad. Ben had a drum that he made from a can and a stick. They would play songs together and have fun.

One day, Tom saw a new trumpet in a shop window. It was shiny and big and had many buttons. Tom wanted the new trumpet very much. He was envious of anyone who had a better trumpet than him. He thought his old trumpet was not good enough.

He asked his dad to buy him the new trumpet, but his dad said no. He said that Tom should be happy with what he had and take good care of it. He said that the new trumpet was too expensive and that Tom was not ready for it.

Tom was angry and sad. He did not listen to his dad. He hid his old trumpet under his bed and did not play it anymore. He hoped that his dad would change his mind and get him the new trumpet.

But his dad did not change his mind. And Tom's old trumpet did not get any love. It got dusty and dirty and rusty. It started to rot. The sound became bad and the buttons got stuck.

One day, Ben came to visit Tom. He wanted to play music with him. He brought his drum and asked Tom to get his trumpet. Tom felt ashamed and did not want to show his trumpet to Ben. He said that he did not want to play music anymore.

Ben was surprised and sad. He liked to play music with Tom. He asked him why he did not want to play music anymore. Tom did not answer. He just looked away.

Ben looked under Tom's bed and saw the trumpet. He pulled it out and saw how rotten it was. He was shocked and sad. He asked Tom what happened to his trumpet. Tom did not answer. He just cried.

Ben felt sorry for Tom. He said that he liked Tom's trumpet and that it was a good trumpet. He said that he did not care about the new trumpet in the shop window. He said that he cared about Tom and their friendship.

He said that Tom should not be envious of others and that he should be grateful for what he had. He said that Tom should take good care of his trumpet and his friends. He said that Tom should play music with him again and have fun.

Tom realized that Ben was right. He felt sorry for being envious and for neglecting his trumpet and his friend. He hugged Ben and said that he was sorry. He said that he liked his trumpet and that it was a good trumpet. He said that he liked Ben and that he was a good friend.

He said that he wanted to play music with Ben again and have fun. He asked Ben to help him clean his trumpet and make it sound good again. Ben agreed and smiled. They cleaned the trumpet and played songs together and had fun.

The moral of the story is: Be happy with what you have and take good care of it. Do not be envious of others and lose what you have. Cherish your friends and play music with them.

Jill was very strong for her age. She had thick muscles and could do more push-ups than most adults. Her friends were always impressed by her strength.

One day, Jill was playing in the garden when she heard a loud noise. She quickly looked up to see a monster. The monster was huge and had thick black fur.

The monster roared and demanded that Jill give it something. Jill was frightened but she decided to come closer and talk to the monster.

"What do you want?", asked Jill bravely.

The monster said he was looking for some cake. He said he had to have cake or he'd get very angry.

Jill was scared but she knew she was strong. She stood up tall and said, "I'm brave and I have big muscles! I can help you find the cake".

The monster was happy and thanked Jill for helping. Together, they went on a search for cake.

At the end of their journey, the monster found some delicious cake and thanked Jill for helping him out.

From that day on, Jill was known as the brave girl with the thick muscles.

Riley was standing in the kitchen, looking around and taking in all the fascinating things he could see. He saw the oven and stove, the wooden table and the tall refrigerator. He was always so amazed at how big things seemed to him now.

Suddenly, his older brother Danny walked in and stopped to say hello. "You're so gifted, Riley," he said, pointing to the refrigerator. "Just look at that refrigerator, with all it's different compartments. You're so lucky."

Riley was so excited, he couldn't help himself. He ran right up to the refrigerator and opened the door. Inside were all sorts of new and exotic flavors and smells that he had never seen before.

But when he reached in, Danny had to stop him. "Quick, we need to close the door," Danny said with a cautionary voice. "If we don't, all this cold air will escape and the refrigerator won't be able to keep things cool. See, it's a special machine and needs to be used carefully." Riley understood and obediently closed the door. He smiled as he thought about his brother's warning, and how it seemed to foreshadow something else. What kind of trouble could a gifted child like Riley get into with a refrigerator? He couldn't wait to find out.

Once upon a time there was a girl who wanted to go to a restaurant. She was excited to eat something yummy and delicious. But when she got to the restaurant, it was closed. She was sad and felt ignored.

The girl decided to look for an answer. She went to the owner of the restaurant and asked why it was closed. The owner explained that he had to cut something in the kitchen and he didn't know when the restaurant would open again. He was ignorant of the girl's feelings and needs.

The girl was feeling upset and heard a noise coming from the kitchen. She looked through the window and saw the owner cutting vegetables and making food. She got an idea and asked the owner if she could help. The owner was so thankful and the girl happily started helping him.

Soon, they finished and the restaurant was open again. Now the girl can eat something yummy and delicious!

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Kitty. Kitty lived in a small house with a nice family. One day, Kitty saw a big red ambulance outside her house. The ambulance had bright lights and made a loud noise. Kitty was curious and wanted to see what was happening.

Kitty went outside and saw a man lying on the ground. He couldn't move, so the ambulance came to help him. The people from the ambulance put the man on a bed with wheels and took him inside the ambulance. Kitty wanted to help, so she followed them.

Inside the ambulance, Kitty saw the man start to feel better. He looked at Kitty and said, "Thank you for coming with me, Kitty. You made me feel less scared." Kitty felt happy that she could help the man. Soon, the ambulance took the man to a place where he could get better, and Kitty went back to her small house with her nice family.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with dolls and eat cookies. One day, she found a shiny penny on the ground. She was very happy and showed it to her mom. Her mom was enthusiastic about the penny too.

Later that day, Lily's mom had to go to work. Lily started to worry because she didn't want her mom to leave. But her mom gave her a big hug and said she would be back soon. Lily felt better and played with her dolls.

When her mom came back, Lily showed her the penny again. Her mom was still enthusiastic about it and said they could put it in her piggy bank. Lily was happy and went to bed with a smile on her face. She didn't worry anymore because she knew her mom would always come back. The end.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Gabby. She woke up in the morning feeling sad, so she went to look for her mommy. Her mommy saw her and said "Gabby, what's wrong? Why are you so sad?"

Gabby said "Mommy, I'm scared because the buckle looks ugly. It's so big and loud!"

Mommy said "Gabby, don't be afraid. Here, let me comfort you." She gave Gabby a big hug and said "See, the buckle is not so bad. You don't have to be scared. I will always be here for you."

Gabby smiled and hugged her mommy back. She felt much better now. Everything was ok again.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a handsome prince and a beautiful princess. The prince said to the princess, "Let’s go to the ball. Everyone will be so impressed by you." The princess agreed and the prince offered his hand to her, and she took it.

When they arrived at the ball, the prince and princess were the most attractive couple there. Everyone stared at them and whispered. Then, the prince announced that there will be a contest. He said, “Whoever can dance the best, the judge will offer a prize!”

The princess smiled and said, “I’m ready!” She began to dance gracefully and everyone cheered. When she finished, the judge announced that the princess had won the contest. He offered her a golden necklace with a diamond in the centre.

The princess thanked the judge and said, “Thank you for this wonderful gift!” She put the necklace around her neck and smiled. Now she was not just the princess, she was the most attractive princess in the whole kingdom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had lots of toys, but one of her favorites was a car. She loved to play with it every day.

One day, the little girl asked her mom for another toy. But her mom said no and that made the little girl sad. She felt very mad and wanted to fight.

Just then, her mom found a way. She said that they could play a game. The little girl was very happy. She forgot all about fighting.

They played the game together and it was lots of fun. They could race their cars around and laugh. The little girl was so happy that she forgot about the problem.

Her mom and the little girl found a way to have fun without fighting. They found a little way to be happy.

Once upon a time there was a child who felt alone. He didn't have a parent or someone to take care of him. The child wished and wished that he could belong to someone special. One day while he was walking, he heard a noise. It was coming from a careless mommy who had left her baby alone! The baby was crying and feeling scared. The child came over and said, "I can help you. I want to be your parent". The mommy was so happy and said "Yes, I would love for you to take care of my baby".

The two children became best friends and the child became the parent of the baby. He took very good care of it and finally he felt like he belonged. They were both so happy that he had found a special place to belong. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore. One day, she went to the park with her mom. They brought some equipment to play with, like a ball and a jump rope.

Lily was having so much fun, she ran fast and laughed a lot. Suddenly, she saw a little boy crying. She went to him and asked, "What happened?"

The boy said, "My sister pinched me!" Lily felt sad for him and said, "That's not nice. Let's play together and forget about it." They played together and had so much fun. When it was time to go home, Lily said, "I had a great time. Let's play again soon!"

Once upon a time there was a mom and a dad. The mom was in the kitchen, prepare dinner. She had made a big pot of soup.

The dad was in the living room. He was so careful to not make a mess. He was looking out the window and saw a bird outside. He called the mom over. "Come look fast! There's a bird outside the window!"

The mom came and saw the bird. They watched it for a minute. Then, the bird flew away.

Suddenly, the mom and dad heard a noise. It sounded like it was coming from the bedroom. They went in and saw that the bedroom door was open. It was their daughter! She had been careless and had opened the bedroom door.

The mom and dad were so surprised. They hadn't thought she was awake.

The mom smiled and hugged her daughter. "Now it's time to prepare for bed, sweetie. Come on, let's go get ready.”

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to her grandma's house. Her grandma made her a yummy cake. Lily loved it so much that she asked for more. Her grandma said, "You can have one more piece, but remember, too much cake is not good for you."

Lily didn't listen to her grandma and ate three more pieces of cake. After a while, she started to feel sick and her body began to tremble. Her grandma took her to the chamber and gave her some medicine. Lily learned that she should listen to her grandma and not eat too much cake. She promised to be more careful next time.

The moral of the story is that we should always listen to our elders and not overindulge in things that are not good for us.

Lily likes to write with her crayons. She writes her name, her mom's name, and her cat's name on a big paper. She is very happy.

But then she hears a loud noise outside. She looks out the window and sees a big dog. The dog is barking and running around. Lily is scared. She does not like big dogs.

She runs to her mom and says, "Mom, there is a big dog outside. He is scary. Can we go away?"

Her mom hugs her and says, "Don't worry, Lily. The dog is not here to hurt us. He is just lost. He is looking for his home. We can help him."

Her mom takes a piece of meat from the fridge and a box from the garage. She says, "We can make a trap for the dog. We can put the meat inside the box and leave it outside. When the dog smells the meat, he will go inside the box. Then we can close the box and take him to the animal shelter. There they will find his owner or a new home. He will be safe and happy."

Lily thinks this is a good idea. She helps her mom to make the trap. She writes "Dog" on the box with her crayon. She says, "Maybe he can read. Maybe he will know we are his friends."

They put the trap outside and wait. Soon they hear a thump. They look out the window and see the dog inside the box. He is wagging his tail and licking the meat. He is not barking anymore.

Lily and her mom go outside and lift the box. The dog looks at them with big eyes. He is not scared anymore. He is thankful.

Lily and her mom take the dog to the animal shelter. They say goodbye to him and hope he will find his home. They are proud of themselves. They are kind and brave.

Once there was a little girl called Anna who was very clumsy. One day she wanted to learn how to count, so she went to get her favourite mug.

Anna started counting the numbers on the mug. "One, two, three!" she said. She was getting better and better at counting.

Suddenly, Anna felt very clumsy and she dropped her mug. "Oh no!" she cried. She looked at the mug and counted the pieces. One, two, three!

Anna soon got better and slowly started to count them all back together. One, two, three! When she was finished, the mug was fixed and Anna was very proud of herself. She continued counting the numbers on her mug until she knew them all.

Once upon a time, there was a guard who was very creative. He thought of different ways to make sure the people in his town were safe. One day, he heard from the people in the town that something was wrong. Everyone was scared.

The guard had to think quickly. He decided to make a plan and see if it worked. He told everyone to go outside and be quiet.

The guard said, "Listen carefully and I will tell you what to do." Everyone stopped and listened.

He said, "I am going to stand guard at the entrance of the town. If I see a problem, I will let everybody know."

Then people went back inside and waited. Sure enough, the guard soon saw a problem and shouted out a warning. Everyone was very grateful and thanked the guard for being so creative.

The guard was happy to help and said, "You are welcome! Don't worry. As long as I'm here, I will always listen and be ready to help." Everyone cheered.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and dress them up in pretty clothes. One day, Lily's mom gave her a special button to carry in her pocket. Lily was so happy and put the button in her pocket right away.

Later that day, Lily went to the park to play on the swings. She was having so much fun when suddenly she heard a loud noise. It was a big dog barking and running towards her. Lily was upset and scared, but then she remembered the button in her pocket.

Quickly, Lily took out the button and threw it on the ground. The dog stopped and sniffed the button. Then, it picked up the button in its mouth and ran away. Lily was so relieved and happy that the button had saved her from the scary dog. From that day on, Lily never forgot to carry her special button with her wherever she went.

Mommy and baby were playing in the yard. Mommy was busy working in the garden, pulling weeds and planting flowers. Baby wanted to help, but he was a bit too small. He saw a faucet spraying the grass and was fascinated. Mommy saw him and said, "Oh! Would you like to pay with the faucet?" Baby laughed and nodded enthusiastically.

Mommy helped him turn on the faucet. Baby was so excited to play! He ran around, splashing water everywhere and laughing. Mommy laughed too. She was so happy to see her little one having so much fun!

After a while, Mommy suggested it was time to turn off the faucet. Baby was sad. He wanted to play longer, but he knew that Mommy was busy. So he agreed to turn it off. He knelt down and with Mommy's help, he turned the faucet to the off position.

Baby and Mommy smiled. They had had a lovely time playing with the faucet. It had been so much fun!

Once upon a time there were two friends named Pete and Sam. They were the best of friends and always did everything together. One day, they wanted to have a fight. But, when they did, the fight made them both feel troubled and sad.

They both started to cry, which made the snow melt around them. The snow had been beautiful and special to them, so now it was all gone. They were both very sad, but then they remembered that they were still best friends.

They hugged and hugged, until the snow started to return! Their troubles had melted away and they were happy again. Pete and Sam hugged each other and they both said they would never fight again. They kept their promise and stayed friends forever!

Once upon a time there was a little girl who went for a walk. As she was walking, she saw something on the ground. She went closer to have a look and discovered it was a broken salad bowl. She was surprised because she didn't expect to find a salad bowl in the middle of the grass!

The little girl picked up the broken bowl and saw some pieces of salad inside. She tasted the salad and it was delicious! She was so happy because she was hungry and now she had something to eat.

She looked around and saw a broken branch. She took the branch and put some of the salad in the branch. Then she had fun giving some of the salad to the birds and animals she saw.

After she was done, she was full! She discovered how fun it is to explore and to discover new things!

Lily and Tom were playing in the bathroom. They saw a shiny thing on the sink. It was a razor. Lily wanted to touch it.

"Look, Tom, a shiny thing!" Lily said.

"No, Lily, don't touch it! It is sharp and can hurt you!" Tom said.

But Lily did not listen. She reached for the razor. Tom tried to stop her, but it was too late. Lily cut her finger with the razor. She cried out loud.

"Ow, ow, ow! It hurts!" Lily said.

Tom felt sorry for Lily. He ran to get a band-aid and some water. He came back and helped Lily. He put the band-aid on her finger and gave her some water.

"There, there, Lily. It will be okay. You are brave," Tom said.

Lily stopped crying. She hugged Tom and said thank you. She looked at the razor again. She did not like it anymore. She wished it would vanish.

"Tom, can we make the shiny thing go away? It is stupid and mean," Lily said.

Tom nodded. He had an idea. He took the razor and threw it in the trash can.

"Bye-bye, shiny thing. You are gone now. You cannot hurt us anymore," Tom said.

Lily smiled. She was happy. She and Tom went back to playing. They did not touch the razor again. They learned their lesson.

Once there was a little girl who liked to wander. Every day she put on her shoes and went out to explore.

One day, she found an orange. She was delighted and held the orange tight in her hands. She wandered further, but soon the sky became dull and dark.

The little girl was scared, but she continued to wander until she found an old hut. She knocked on the door and heard someone say "come in". She opened the door, but she was too scared to go in.

The person inside the hut said, "Why don't you come in? I have something to give you, it's a surprise!"

The little girl hesitated, but eventually stepped in. Suddenly, the door closed behind her and she couldn't get out. She was locked inside the hut with the stranger!

The little girl wanted to cry, but all she could do was sit there and wait. The foreshadowing of the dull clouds and dark sky had been a warning, but the temptation of the orange had been too enticing. In the end, the bad ending came true, and the little girl was never seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat avocados. One day, she was holding an avocado in her hand, but it slipped and fell on the floor. The avocado broke into two pieces. Lily was sad and grumpy.

Her mom saw her sad and asked, "What happened, Lily?"

Lily replied, "My avocado broke. Now, I can't eat it."

Her mom said, "Don't worry, Lily. We can still eat the good part of the avocado. Let's cut it and enjoy it together."

Lily smiled and was happy again. She learned that even if something breaks, there is always a way to make it better.

Lila and Ben were playing in the sand by the sea. They made a big castle with shells and sticks. They were very happy and proud of their castle.

"Look, Mommy, look at our castle!" Lila shouted.

Mommy came over and smiled. She was very thoughtful and brought a towel for each of them. "Wow, what a beautiful castle! You worked very hard, Lila and Ben. You are very clever and creative. Do you want to rest for a while? You can use these towels to dry off and keep warm."

"Yes, please, Mommy. We are a little tired and cold." Ben said.

Mommy wrapped them in the towels and hugged them. She took them to a shady spot under a big umbrella. She gave them some juice and cookies. They snuggled up to Mommy and thanked her.

"Thank you, Mommy. You are very kind and sweet. We love you." Lila and Ben said.

"I love you too, my darlings. You are very welcome. You can rest here as long as you want. Then we can play some more or go for a swim. How does that sound?" Mommy asked.

"That sounds great, Mommy. You are the best." Lila and Ben said.

They closed their eyes and rested. They felt warm and cozy and happy. They dreamed of their castle and the sea. They knew Mommy would always take care of them.

Bob looked up at the sky. The clouds were in the shape of animals and the sun was so bright and beautiful. Bob loved to look at the sky.

Bob and his dad drove to the mechanic's shop. His dad's car needed to get fixed. Bob loved going to the mechanic's shop. There were so many interesting looking things there.

The mechanic was very kind. He fixed the car quickly. When the mechanic told them how much it would cost, Bob's dad was very happy because he was very wealthy and could pay the mechanic easily.

When the car was fixed, Bob and his dad drove home. Bob was very happy they had the mechanic to fix the car. He was glad they could be home safe and sound.

Ernie and his mommy were looking at a photo. Ernie loved the photo because he could see himself in it. The photo was very light, like a big happy sun in the sky. Ernie smiled and asked his mommy to take him to the park.

When they arrived at the park, Ernie was happy because there were lots of birds and trees. There was even a nice soft rug to sit on. Ernie and his mommy had some yummy sandwiches to eat. After they finished eating, Ernie decided to go explore the park.

Ernie found a butterfly and followed it around the park. He thought it was so cool! Ernie laughed and smiled as he ran around the park, chasing the butterfly and watching it flutter around in the light.

Ernie and his mommy went home after a long day of fun. Ernie was tired from all the playing, but he was very happy. As he closed his eyes, he still had the photo in his head and a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, in a very deep forest, a little girl named Jill lived in a small cabin with her mom.

Jill loved grapes and she asked her mom to take her to the nearest supermarket. Her mom agreed, but she warned that Jill must be careful.

After they arrived in the grocery store, Jill and her mom started to explore the shelves. Jill's eyes lit up when she saw a big box full of purple grapes. She wanted to buy them and asked her mom to buy them.

Her mom said, "We'll see," and continued to explore the store.

When they were ready to leave, Jill's mom opened her purse and handed Jill a bag full of grapes. Jill was so excited that she couldn't help but give her mom a big hug and display her appreciation.

Jill carried the bag of grapes back to the little cabin in the deep forest and shared it with her mom. From then on, it was their favorite snack!

Once upon a time, there was a kind person. This person needed to paint a picture for their friend. But before the person started to paint, they decided to have a snack. They ate a yummy treat to give them energy for the painting.

The kind person was painting for a very long time. They used the paintbrush to make a beautiful picture of a rainbow. The picture was so colorful it made people smile.

Finally, the painting was done. The kind person thought the picture was wonderful. Then they ran to show their friend the completed painting.

The friend was thrilled with the painting. They thanked the kind person and gave them a hug. It was a happy ending to the kind person's painting adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. Jack was a very lively boy and he liked to play in his garden. One day when Jack was outside, he saw something shiny on the ground. He bent over and picked it up. It was a little silver buckle!

Jack was so excited and he wanted to show everyone. Suddenly, he heard a noise behind him. He turned around and saw a big black dog with a wagging tail! Jack's eyes widened and he stepped back.

Suddenly, the dog blinked! Jack was so surprised, he couldn't move. Then, the dog smiled and licked Jack's hand. The dog was warm and friendly. Jack said, "Hello Doggie!"

The dog barked and ran away. Jack looked down and noticed the little silver buckle in his hand. Suddenly, he remembered: the buckle was attached to a shoe! He looked around and saw a little shoe with a heel on the ground.

Jack smiled and picked up the shoe. He knew it must be the dog's and at least he could return it back to the dog. He said goodbye and ran off to find it.

The next day, Jack saw the same dog again in his garden. Jack was so happy to see the dog and he showed it the little shoe with a heel. The dog instantly recognized it and licked Jack's face.

The pair became good friends and even today

Ravi and Jaya were playing in the garden. Everything was very colourful and beautiful. They saw a big hairy caterpillar. Jaya had never seen anything like it before. She asked her brother, "What is that Ravi?"

Ravi smiled and said, "It's a caterpillar! It will turn into a butterfly soon." Then the caterpillar started to move. It showed a pattern as it went along. Jaya was fascinated.

Ravi said, "Let's follow it and see where it goes. Maybe we can see it turn into a butterfly!" So the two of them followed it. They followed it until it stopped near some trees. Ravi said, "This is where the caterpillar will turn into a butterfly!"

The caterpillar looked around and then it wriggled. Suddenly beautiful colourful wings unfolded from its body. Jaya was amazed! The caterpillar had transformed into a butterfly!

"Look at the pattern on the butterfly," said Ravi. "It's so beautiful!"

Jaya smiled and said, "Yes. Now I understand why it's so special!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mommy took her to the store to buy some candy. Lily was very happy and excited. She picked out her favorite candy and ate it all up. But then, Lily started to feel very sleepy.

When they got home, Lily went to take a nap. But she had trouble falling asleep because her tummy hurt from eating too much candy. Her mommy told her that eating too much candy can spoil your tummy and make you feel sick.

From that day on, Lily learned that eating too much candy can cause trouble and make you feel sleepy. She promised to only eat a little bit of candy at a time so that she wouldn't get sick again.

It was a hot day and Sandy and her mommy were at the park. Sandy blinked in the bright sunlight and looked around. Everything was so much fun.

Suddenly, Sandy saw a butterfly fluttering in the sky. She was mesmerized. She started to walk towards it when her mommy yelled "wait, Sandy!"

Sandy stopped and looked back at her mommy. Her mommy blinked and smiled. "Let's go and have a picnic," she said.

So they spread a blanket on the grass and unpacked the food. While they ate, the butterfly flew down and landed on Sandy's shoulder. Sandy gasped in surprise and smiled. She closed her eyes and blinked slowly. She felt so happy.

Afterwards, Sandy and her mommy packed everything away and headed home. Sandy couldn't stop smiling. She promised herself that she would always remember that special day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl named Lucy. She loved to play in her room with all her toys. One day, she saw a big cabinet in her room. The cabinet was new and she had never seen it before.

Lucy wanted to open the cabinet, but she was scared. She felt the urge to see what was inside. She asked her friend, Teddy the bear, to help her. Teddy said, "Don't worry, Lucy. We can be brave together."

Lucy and Teddy held hands and opened the cabinet. Inside, they found a big box. Lucy was scared again, but Teddy urged her to be brave. They opened the box and found lots of new toys to play with. Lucy and Teddy were so happy and played with the new toys all day. They knew that being brave was good.

Ben and Lily were playing in the yard. They liked to make things with sticks and stones and leaves. They found a big pile of dry leaves and decided to make a nest for their toy birds.

"Look, our birds have a cozy home!" Lily said, putting a blue bird in the nest.

"Let's make it more cozy. Let's make a fire!" Ben said, picking up a match from the ground. He had seen his dad use matches to light candles.

"No, Ben, fire is bad! Fire can hurt us and the birds!" Lily said, scared. She tried to take the match from Ben, but he was faster.

"Fire is fun! Watch!" Ben said, striking the match and throwing it into the nest. The leaves caught fire and made a big flame. The toy birds melted and burned.

"Ben, what did you do? You changed our nest into a fire! You are mean!" Lily cried, running away from the fire.

The fire spread quickly and reached the fence. The fence was made of wood and it burned too. The fire reached the house and the curtains. The house was made of bricks, but the curtains were made of cloth and they burned too.

The fire alarm went off and made a loud noise. Ben and Lily's mom and dad came out of the house and saw the fire. They were angry and scared. They called the firemen and tried to put out the fire with water.

The firemen came with a big truck and a hose. They sprayed water on the fire and made it smaller. They put out the fire and made it stop.

But it was too late. The house was damaged and the toys were gone. Ben and Lily's mom and dad were sad and mad. They hugged Lily and scolded Ben.

"Ben, you were very naughty and careless. You played with fire and you changed our home into a mess. You could have hurt yourself and Lily and us. You are in big trouble!" they said.

Ben felt sorry and ashamed. He wished he had listened to Lily and not played with fire. He wished he could change everything back to how it was before. But he couldn't. He had made a big mistake and he had to face the consequences. He had learned a hard lesson.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who liked to play with clay. He had a big bucket of clay and he loved to squish it and shape it. Every day he would make new clay figures and dreams.

One day, the little boy had an idea. He wanted to make a surprise for his mom. He grabbed a little bit of clay and began to shape it. It was not easy to get the clay to look right, but soon he had made a pretty little flower.

The little boy was very careful not to spoil the flower as he brought it to his mom. She was so happy to see the flower and told the little boy that she would keep it forever.

The little boy had so much fun making clay figures and dreaming. He was so happy that he had been able to make his mom a special gift. He never forgot how much fun he had and he made sure to never spoil his clay time.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to pick some blueberries with her mommy. They found a big bush with lots of yummy blueberries on it. They picked and ate them until their tummies were full.

But then, they saw a fire in the distance. The fire was big and hot, and it started to burn the trees. Lily and her mommy were scared. They ran away from the fire as fast as they could.

After they were safe, they sat down to rest. Lily's mommy gave her a snack. It was a spicy cracker that made her mouth tingle. But Lily loved it anyway. She was happy that they were safe and had yummy blueberries and spicy crackers to eat.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy box that was very full. One day, her mom came in and said, "Lily, it's time to clean up your toys." Lily didn't want to clean up because she loved all of her toys. But her mom said, "You can't keep them all, it's too expensive."

Lily started to cry because she didn't want to get rid of any of her toys. But then her mom said, "Let's open the toy box and see what we can give away. We can give away just an inch of toys." Lily thought about it and agreed.

They opened the toy box and Lily saw that she had so many toys that she didn't even play with anymore. She picked out just an inch of toys to give away to kids who didn't have any toys. When they were done, Lily felt happy because she knew she was helping others. Her mom hugged her and said, "It's important to share with others, even if it's just an inch of what we have."

Once upon a time, there was a big, fierce lion named Leo. Leo lived in a green forest with his friends. One day, Leo started to feel very sick. He could not play with his friends anymore. His friends were worried about him.

Leo's best friend, a kind monkey named Max, went to find some help. Max found a wise old owl who knew about medicine. The owl gave Max some special medicine to make Leo feel better. Max thanked the owl and went back to give the medicine to Leo.

Max gave the medicine to Leo, and soon, Leo started to feel better. Leo was very happy and thanked Max for helping him. Now, Leo could play with his friends again. Everyone in the forest was happy and they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a rich man. He had a big house, lots of toys and all the food he wanted. One day, the rich man wanted a drink so he took a big bottle out of his cupboard. He wanted to open it but the lid was stuck.

He grabbed a knife and started to cut the bottle. After a few tries, the lid came off and the rich man had his drink. He was so pleased that he smiled from ear to ear!

The end!

Once upon a time there was a boy named Tim. He was very little and only three years old.

One day he was sitting on a seat in the park when he heard a loud noise. He looked around and he saw a big dog barking. He was very scared and he started to cry.

Tim's mom saw the dog and ran to him. She said, "Don't be scared, I'm here to help you." But the dog was still barking very loudly.

The dog was very strong, but Tim was very weak. He was too scared to move. His mom tried to calm the dog down, but it didn't work.

Suddenly, the dog started running towards Tim. Tim was so scared that he fell off the seat. Unfortunately, the dog bit him and he started to cry even harder.

His mom was very sad, but she was also very brave. She quickly took him to the hospital. In the end, Tim was okay but he was very sad. He learned his lesson and he became less scared of dogs.

Ben and Lily liked to play in the park. They liked to run, swing, slide and climb. One day, they saw a big cross on the grass. It was bright red and had a sign on it. The sign said "Do not touch".

Ben and Lily were curious. They wanted to know what the cross was for. They walked closer to the cross and looked at it. It was made of wood and had nails on it. It looked old and heavy.

Lily said, "Maybe it is a treasure. Maybe someone hid something under it. Let's remove it and see." Ben said, "But the sign says do not touch. Maybe it is dangerous. Maybe it will hurt us." Lily said, "Don't be scared. It is just a cross. We can lift it together. Come on, help me."

Ben and Lily grabbed the cross and tried to remove it. They pulled and pushed and tugged and twisted. But the cross was too big and too stuck. They could not remove it. They got tired and sweaty and dirty.
