Suddenly, they heard a loud voice. It was the park keeper. He saw Ben and Lily trying to remove the cross. He was angry. He said, "What are you doing? Stop that! That cross is not a toy. It is a memorial. It is for remembering people who died in a war. You should respect it, not touch it. You are very naughty. Go away now!"

Ben and Lily were scared. They let go of the cross and ran away. They felt sorry and ashamed. They learned a lesson. They learned to obey signs and not to remove things that are not theirs. They learned to be careful and respectful in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly glove. It was soft and colorful, and liked to go on walks with its friends.

One day, the glove decided to take a step outside and explore. It slowly and carefully stepped closer to the edge of its garden. Looking around it noticed bright colors, big trees and lots of birds singing.

The glove was so excited that it decided to step further around the garden. It saw pink flowers, red apples and lots of bugs.

Then the glove realised it was feeling brave and decided to take one more step. It just had to see what else was out there. So, it stepped out and saw a huge pond full of ducks, frogs and fish.

The glove was so happy that it felt like jumping! It was so happy it stayed in the garden all day and stepped around it with its friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She was three years old and she loved to explore the world around her.

One day, Jane asked her mom if she could go outside and play. Mom said yes and Jane went out with a big smile on her face.

As Jane was walking outside, she saw a big tire in the garden. She asked her dad, “What is this?” Dad said, “It’s a tire. You can use it for fun!”

Jane liked the tire, but it was dry. She asked her mom, “Can I put water on the tire?” Mom said, “Sure, honey. That will make it fun for you!”

So Jane filled up the tire with water and had a great time splashing and playing in it. She soon forgot all about the dry tire and just enjoyed playing in the cool water.

Jane had such a great time with the tire that by the end of the day, she didn’t want to leave!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Laura. She loved dinosaurs. One day, she asked her mom if she could take a dinosaur to the park. Her mom said no because the dinosaur would make a big mess.

Laura was very sad. She did not understand why she could not take a dinosaur to the park. She wanted to play and have fun.

She went outside to think about it and saw that her neighbor had a clean sandbox. She asked her neighbor, Mrs. Smith, if she could borrow it. But Mrs. Smith said no. She wanted to keep her sandbox clean.

Laura was very sad. She did not understand why she could not take a dinosaur to the park or borrow a sandbox from Mrs. Smith. She started to cry.

Mrs. Smith saw how sad Laura was, so she said, "If you help me to clean the sandbox, you can take it and your dinosaur to the park." Laura was so happy that she gave Mrs. Smith a big hug. She thanked her, grabbed the dinosaur and happily ran off to the park.

One day, Timmy was taking a bath and washing his feet. He soaped up his toes and scrubbed them with a soft cloth.

Suddenly, Timmy felt funny. Everything around him started spinning and he felt dizzy. He held onto the edge of the tub.

"Mommy, I'm dizzy!" Timmy shouted.

Mommy rushed in and held him tight. "It's okay, Timmy. You just need to take a deep breath," she said.

Timmy took a deep breath and soon his dizzy feeling went away. He continued washing his toes and finished his bath. When he came out, Mommy gave him a big hug. He felt so happy and safe in her arms.

The end.

Once there was a lazy girl called Ann. Ann loved to dream. One day she got up early and thought it would be a great idea to go to the beach. But Ann didn't wear her swimming costume and that made her feel embarrassed. Ann was very sad and ran away from the beach.

But then she saw all the other kids playing in the water and she thought it looked so much fun. Ann gathered all her courage and decided to go back. She put on her swimming costume and ran into the sea. Everyone cheered for her and it made her feel much better.

Ann swam and laughed and splashed all day. She dreamed of having fun like this every day. Now Ann knows that there is nothing to be embarrassed about.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to dance. She would put on her favorite jazz music and twirl around the room, feeling happy and warm inside.

One day, Lily's mom told her they were going on a special trip to the park. Lily was so excited! She packed a blanket and some snacks in her backpack and they set off.

When they arrived at the park, Lily saw a big gate with a sign that said "Do Not Enter". She asked her mom what it meant, and her mom said it was closed and they couldn't go in. Lily was sad, but her mom promised they would come back when it was open.

A few weeks later, Lily and her mom went back to the park. This time, the gate was open! Lily ran inside and saw a beautiful stage with a band playing jazz music. She danced and twirled to the music, feeling happy and warm inside. She was so glad they came back and the gate was open for them to enjoy the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and read books. One day, her mommy and daddy took her to a big place called a university. It was very big and had lots of buildings.

Lily's mommy and daddy told her that the university was a place where people go to learn new things. They also told her that it was important to be safe and listen to the rules. Lily promised to be safe and listen to the rules.

As they walked around the university, Lily saw many people studying and working. She saw books and computers and classrooms. She was very curious and asked lots of questions. Her mommy and daddy answered all of her questions and were very patient.

Before they left, Lily said "please" and thanked her mommy and daddy for taking her to the university. She was very happy and excited to learn more things one day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved cookies very much. One day, her mom made some impressive cookies for her. They were big and yummy. Lily was so happy and excited to eat them.

But when she tried to take a cookie from the plate, she accidentally tore it. She felt sad and worried that she ruined the cookie. But her mom said it was okay and gave her another one. Lily learned that sometimes things can tear, but it's okay because we can always try again.

From that day on, Lily enjoyed her cookies even more, and she always remembered to be careful when taking them from the plate. The end.

Bob looked up at the sky. He saw lots of dark grey clouds. Suddenly, he felt a few drops of water. It was raining! When it started raining harder, Bob's mommy told him they needed to leave.

Bob looked outside. He saw that it was flooding. The water was coming up so high! He was so scared.

Bob and his mommy got in the car. Bob was worried but his mommy kept pointing out things to him. She pointed to a big boat that was helping people away from the flood. She pointed to the nice police officers who were helping too. She pointed to the sun, coming out from behind the clouds.

Bob felt a little better. His mommy said "It's important to be safe during a flood" and Bob nodded. He knew that being safe was very important.

Soon the flooding stopped and Bob and his mommy went home. It was a scary experience, but Bob was happy that he stayed safe.

Lila and Ben were playing with their toys in the living room. Lila had a doll and Ben had a car. They were having fun, but then Lila saw Ben's car and wanted it.

"Give me your car, Ben. It is shiny and fast. I like it more than my doll," Lila said.

"No, Lila. This is my car. You have your doll. We can share, but you cannot take my car," Ben said.

Lila was angry and grabbed Ben's car. Ben was sad and tried to get it back. They started to fight and yell.

"Stop it, both of you!" their mom said. She came from the kitchen and saw the mess. "Why are you fighting over a toy? You have many toys to play with. You should be kind and share with each other."

"But mom, Lila took my car. She did not ask me. She was mean," Ben said.

"But mom, Ben has a better toy. He did not let me play with it. He was selfish," Lila said.

Mom sighed and looked at them. "Listen, children. You are brother and sister. You should love and respect each other. Sometimes, you may want what the other has, but you cannot just take it. You have to ask nicely and accept the answer. Sometimes, you may have to give up what you have, but you can also get something else. You have to be generous and grateful. That is how you make each other happy and grow as a family."

Lila and Ben thought about what mom said. They felt sorry for what they did. They hugged each other and said sorry.

"I am sorry, Ben. I should not have taken your car. Can I play with it for a minute, please?" Lila said.

"I am sorry, Lila. I should have let you play with it. Yes, you can play with it for a minute. Can I play with your doll, please?" Ben said.

They smiled and exchanged their toys. They played nicely and happily. Mom was proud of them and gave them a kiss.

"See, children. That is much better. You learned a valuable lesson today. You learned to share and accept. You learned to be kind and happy. You learned to be a good family," mom said.

Lila and Ben nodded and hugged mom. They looked at each other and said, "We love you, mom. We love you, brother. We love you, sister."

They felt warm and cozy in their living room. They did not care about the distant noise outside. They had everything they needed inside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and run around outside. One day, Lily went to the store with her mommy. They saw a toy that Lily really wanted, but it was too expensive. She told her mommy her opinion, "I really like that toy, but it's too much money."

Lily and her mommy walked around the store and found a funny book. They started to read it together and Lily couldn't stop laughing. Her mommy loved to hear her laugh and it made her happy too. They decided to buy the book instead of the expensive toy.

When they got home, Lily showed her daddy the book and they read it together. They all laughed and had so much fun. Lily's opinion changed from wanting the expensive toy to being happy with the funny book. From then on, Lily learned that sometimes the best things in life can make you laugh and don't have to cost a lot of money.

Jimmy was standing next to the pond. It was a big pond with lots of blue water. The sun was shining and Jimmy felt happy. He watched the water ripple beneath him.

Suddenly, Jimmy felt uncomfortable. He looked around and saw a big frog. The frog was staring at him! Jimmy was scared and he wanted to run away.

But the frog said, "Come here. I need you to help me." So Jimmy stepped closer. The frog said, "I need you to jump into the pond so I can get home."

Jimmy was scared and said no. Then the frog got really mad. The frog said, "If you don't help me, I'll make you stand here forever!"

Jimmy was very scared. So, he had to jump into the pond. Jimmy was very uncomfortable, but he jumped anyway. He stayed in the pond until dark, and then the frog let him go.

Jimmy never wanted to stand near the pond again.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. Tim brought his favorite toy, a ball, in a sack. At the park, Tim played with other kids and had a lot of fun. They ran, jumped, and laughed together. Tim was very happy.

After playing for a long time, Tim wanted to eat a tasty snack. His mom gave him a yummy apple to eat. While Tim was eating, he forgot about his ball in the sack. When he finished his snack, he looked for his ball, but it was not there.

Tim and his mom started a search to find the ball. They looked under the trees, behind the bushes, and near the swings. Finally, they found the sack with the ball inside it. Tim was so happy to find his ball. They played some more and then went home.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy dog named Spot. Spot liked to sleep all day and not do much. He had a lot of stuff that he did not like to share with others.

One sunny day, a little bird named Tweet came to visit Spot. Tweet saw all the stuff that Spot had and asked if they could play together. Spot did not want to share his stuff and said no. Tweet was sad but went to find other friends to play with.

As the days went by, Spot noticed that all the animals were playing and sharing their stuff with each other. They were all having fun, but Spot was still alone with his stuff. One day, a big storm came, and all the animals helped each other stay safe. Spot was scared and needed help, but no one came to help him because he never shared with them. In the end, Spot was very sad and wished he had learned to share.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sally. She lived with her mum and dad. Every day she went out to play.

One day, Sally went out to play in the woods. She saw a naughty monster there. She was a bit scared but she was brave and decided to lead it away.

Sally said to the monster: "Come on, naughty monster! Let's go!" The monster followed Sally. They went all the way to the park.

At the park, Sally saw lots of children playing. She said to the monster, with a smile: "Let's play together!" The monster smiled back and they both started playing.

Sally and the naughty monster played together all afternoon. Then, it was time for Sally to go home. She said goodbye to the monster and the monster waved goodbye. And that was the story of how Sally led the naughty monster away.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who lived in a big castle. She had a yellow dress that she loved to wear. One day, she went for a walk in the garden and saw a little bird. The bird was sad and alone.

"Hello little bird, why are you sad?" asked the princess.

"I am sad because I have no friends," replied the bird.

"Don't worry, you can join me and we can be friends," said the princess with a smile.

The bird was happy and flew to the princess. They played together all day and the princess was happy to have a new friend. From that day on, the bird joined the princess every day and they had lots of fun together. The end.

Lily liked to write stories. She had a big book and a red pen. She wrote about animals and people and places. She wrote every day.

One day, she wrote a story about a crocodile. The crocodile was poor. He had no friends and no food. He was sad and lonely. He wanted to be happy.

Lily showed her story to her brother, Ben. Ben was older and mean. He laughed at her story. He said, "That is a silly story. Crocodiles are not poor. They are big and strong and scary. They eat other animals. They do not need friends. They are happy."

Lily felt bad. She said, "No, Ben. That is not true. Crocodiles can be poor too. They can be sad and lonely too. They can want friends too. They can be happy too."

Ben did not listen. He took her book and her pen. He said, "You do not know how to write stories. You are too little. I will write a better story. A story about a brave and smart and cool boy. A boy like me."

He ran away with her book and her pen. Lily cried. She wanted her book and her pen back. She wanted to write more stories. She wanted to make the crocodile happy. She did not like Ben. He was mean.

Tom and Jen are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big slide. They want to go on the slide.

"Let's have a race!" Tom says. "Who can go down the slide faster?"

"OK!" Jen says. "I will win the race!"

They run to the slide. They climb up the steps. They sit on the slide. They say "Ready, set, go!" They slide down very fast.

Tom slides faster than Jen. He reaches the bottom first. He jumps up and shouts "I win! I win the race!"

Jen slides slower than Tom. She reaches the bottom second. She feels dizzy. She falls down and hurts her head.

Tom sees Jen fall down. He runs to her. He sees blood on her head. He feels scared. He cries "Help! Help! Jen is hurt!"

A man hears Tom cry. He runs to the slide. He sees Jen hurt. He calls 911. He says "A girl is hurt on the slide. She needs help!"

An ambulance comes to the park. The paramedics take Jen to the hospital. They say "She has a bad cut on her head. She needs stitches."

Tom feels sad. He says "I'm sorry, Jen. I didn't mean to make you dizzy. I hope you get better soon."

Jen feels pain. She says "It's OK, Tom. It was an accident. But I don't want to race on the slide anymore."

Once upon a time there was a blue house. It was a very special house. Every day, when the sun came up, a boy and a girl went outside and clapped their hands together. They clapped as loud and as fast as they could.

The blue house heard the clapping and started to move. It moved around the garden, up and down the hills and across the meadows. As it moved, it laughed and everyone inside clapped along.

The boy and the girl were so excited. They kept clapping and the house kept moving. They laughed and clapped until they couldn’t clap anymore.

Finally, when the sun went down, the house stopped moving and the boy and girl collapsed into a heap. They said goodbye to the big blue house and walked back inside. They would definitely come back tomorrow to do it all over again!

Once upon a time there was a loop. It was a small loop and it was all alone. The loop was scared. It was too scared to move.

But then one day something happened. It started to rot. The rot ate away at the loop until it was almost gone. The loop looked very scared and sad.

Just when it was about to be gone completely, a friendly bird flew by and stopped to help. The bird lifted the loop up and flew it away. They flew high up into the sky until the loop was safe.

The loop was happy again. It smiled and sang as they flew around in big loopy circles. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a puppy. He had a white spot on his collar. The puppy's name was Splodge. He was very selfish and loved to spread mess all over! One day, Splodge went on a walk and saw a rabbit. The rabbit had carrrots all around it. Splodge wanted to spread them everywhere, so he kicked at the carrots and they flew all over the place. He felt so proud of himself!

After the rabbit was gone, Splodge began to spread his mess again. He jumped and ran around, spreading his mess wherever he could go. But soon, he noticed something - the white spot on his collar was missing! He searched high and low, but he couldn't find it.

He realized how selfish he had been. He had been too busy spreading his mess to take care of his collar. He wanted the white spot so badly, so he decided to go back and tidy up his mess. He put the carrots back in one pile and cleaned the ground. After all of his hard work, the white spot on his collar reappeared. Splodge was so happy!

From then on, Splodge was much more careful with his mess; he remembered how much he missed the white spot from his collar. He was happy that he learned to be a lot less selfish!

Once upon a time, there was a black cat. The cat liked to play with a cane. One day, the cat went to the park with the cane.

At the park, the cat met a big dog. The dog wanted the cane. The cat did not want to surrender the cane. The cat and the dog started to fight.

In the end, the dog took the cane away. The cat was sad and went home without the cane. The cat never found the cane again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He liked to play near the old creek. It was fun to throw rocks and watch the water splash.

One day, Tim saw a big, sharp stick near the creek. He wanted to play with it. But his mom said, "No, Tim! That stick is too sharp. It can hurt you."

Tim was sad, but he knew his mom was right. He left the sharp stick and went back to throwing rocks in the creek. And he had lots of fun playing safely by the water.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a little girl named Lucy. She had a big red ball that she loved to play with. One day, while playing outside, her red ball rolled under a big cardboard box.

Lucy tried to get her ball but it was too far under the box. She felt sad and let out a big sigh. She wanted her red ball back but didn't know how to get it.

Then, her friend Tom came by and saw her sad face. He asked her what was wrong. Lucy pointed at the cardboard box and her red ball under it. Tom smiled and said, "Don't worry, I can help you." He pushed the big cardboard box away and got the red ball out for Lucy. She was so happy and thanked Tom. They played with the red ball together for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time there was a car called Big Red. Big Red was old and rusty, but it had a sweetheart of an engine. Every day Big Red would drive around the block looking for a special wheel.

One day, Big Red found a wheel! It was a big, shiny wheel that glinted in the sun. Big Red wanted it right away.

Big Red drove up to the wheel, and stopped. Then Big Red opened his door, and the driver, who was a small rabbit, popped out. The rabbit looked at the wheel and said, "I want that wheel!" Then the rabbit hopped onto the wheel, and the wheel rolled away! Big Red ran quickly after the wheel, but the wheel was too fast.

Big Red was sad, he wanted the wheel so much. But then, he heard a voice call out from behind him. It was the wheel! The wheel had stopped and it wanted Big Red to enter.

Big Red was so excited! He quickly jumped into the wheel and raced away. As they sped away, the wind blew through Big Red's rusty old body, giving him a feeling that was warm and sweet!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Ben. He loved to imagine new adventures. One day, he walked to the park with his mom. It was freezing cold outside with snowflakes in the air. He was careful to put on his warmest clothes. He put on his hat, scarf and gloves so he wouldn’t get too cold. Ben could hardly wait to go on his adventure. He imagined that he was a brave knight on an enchanted journey. As he walked through the park, he imagined that he was meeting magical creatures and great warriors. Luckily, he remembered to be careful and follow the path. He slowly made his way back home at the end of the day. Ben smiled – it had been a wonderful adventure!

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play with toys. They had a toy phone that could record their voices. They liked to pretend they were talking to each other or to other people.

One day, they decided to play a prank on Lily's big sister, Mia. They hid the toy phone under Mia's bed and recorded a scary message. They said, "Hello, Mia. We are the monsters under your bed. We are going to get you when you sleep. Boo!"

They giggled and ran away, leaving the toy phone on. They waited for Mia to come home and hear the message. They thought it would be very funny.

But Mia did not come home that day. She had to stay at the hospital because she was sick. Lily and Ben did not know that. They got bored and went to play with other toys.

That night, Lily's mom came to her room and told her the bad news. Mia had a fever and had to stay at the hospital for a long time. Lily felt very sad and scared. She wanted to see her sister and hug her.

She went to her bed and tried to sleep. But then she heard a voice under her bed. It was the toy phone. It said, "Hello, Mia. We are the monsters under your bed. We are going to get you when you sleep. Boo!"

Lily screamed and cried. She thought the monsters were real and they had come for her. She did not remember that it was her and Ben who recorded the message. She called for her mom, but her mom did not hear her. She was too busy talking to the doctor on the phone.

Lily felt very alone and afraid. She wished she had not played the prank on Mia. She wished she had been a humble and kind sister. She wished Mia was there to protect her. But she was not. She had left her alone with the monsters.

Ben likes hockey. He has a hockey stick and a puck. He plays hockey with his dad in the yard. Sometimes he plays hockey with his friends at the park.

One day, Ben sees a new hockey stick in the store. It is very nice. It is red and blue and it glows in the dark. Ben wants the new hockey stick. He asks his dad to buy it for him.

"Please, dad, can I have the new hockey stick? It is so nice and it glows. I can play hockey at night with it."

Dad looks at the new hockey stick. He sees the price tag. It is very expensive. He shakes his head.

"Sorry, Ben, but we cannot buy the new hockey stick. It is too much money. You already have a good hockey stick at home. You don't need another one."

Ben feels sad. He really likes the new hockey stick. He thinks it is the best hockey stick ever. He looks at it with big eyes.

"Please, dad, please. I will be very good. I will do my chores. I will share my toys. I will eat my vegetables. Please, can I have the new hockey stick?"

Dad smiles. He loves Ben very much. He wants to make him happy. But he also wants to teach him a lesson.

"Ben, I know you like the new hockey stick. But you have to learn to be happy with what you have. The new hockey stick is not important. What is important is how you play hockey. You can play hockey with any stick. You can have fun with your dad and your friends. You can be a good sport and a good team player. That is what makes you a good hockey player. Not the new hockey stick."

Ben thinks about what his dad says. He knows his dad is right. He hugs his dad and says sorry.

"Sorry, dad. You are right. The new hockey stick is not important. I can play hockey with my old stick. I can have fun with you and my friends. I can be a good sport and a good team player. Thank you for teaching me."

Dad hugs Ben back and says he is proud of him.

"I am proud of you, Ben. You are a good son and a good hockey player. You don't need the new hockey stick to glow. You already glow with your kindness and your talent."

Ben smiles. He feels happy. He does not want the new hockey stick anymore. He wants to play hockey with his dad and his friends. He runs to the yard with his old stick and his puck. He glows with joy.

One day, a funny hippo went to play near the river. He liked to splash in the water and make his friends laugh. The funny hippo was very big and always happy.

While playing, the funny hippo saw a big ball. He wanted to play with the ball too. So, he used his big tail to slap the ball. The ball went very high in the sky and all his friends clapped and laughed.

The funny hippo and his friends played with the ball all day long. They were very happy and tired. At the end of the day, the funny hippo went back home with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a strong man. He was wearing a red shirt and red pants. The strong man carried a cable. It was long and heavy. He needed to lift it up high. He used all of his strength. He was able to lift the cable up before him. It was very long and one end of it was ugly. It was tangled and had dirt on it. But the strong man was brave. He kept lifting the cable up high until it was in place. He smiled at his accomplishment and cheered. The strong man was proud.

Once upon a time, there was a team of animals who loved to play together. They were patient with each other and always had fun. One day, they decided to play hide and seek.

The first animal, a bunny, hid behind a tree. The second animal, a bird, flew up high in the sky. The third animal, a squirrel, climbed up a tall branch. But when it was the fourth animal's turn, a fox, he disappeared and never came back.

The team searched and searched for the fox, but they couldn't find him. They were sad and worried. They asked all the other animals in the forest if they had seen the fox, but no one had.

Days turned into weeks, and the team never found the fox. They missed their friend and didn't understand why he had disappeared. They never played hide and seek again, and the team was never the same without the fox.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a favorite sock. It was a mild day when Sue went to play outside with her sock. She liked to make it dance in the wind.

Sue saw a small cat. The cat looked sad. Sue wanted to help the cat feel better. She thought that maybe the cat would like her sock. So, she offered her sock to the cat. The cat sniffed the sock and started to play with it.

The cat was very happy with Sue's sock. Sue felt happy, too. She knew that her sock had a new friend. From that day on, Sue and the cat played together every mild day. And they all lived happily ever after.

Sara and Ben were twins who liked to play in their big house. One night, they heard a strange noise from the attic. They were curious and wanted to see what it was. They took a flashlight and climbed the stairs.

When they reached the attic, they saw a big box with a hole in it. They peeked inside and saw a white sheet with two holes for eyes. It was a ghost! They were fearful and screamed. The ghost also screamed and flew out of the box.

Sara and Ben ran down the stairs and told their mom what they saw. Their mom hugged them and said it was not a real ghost. It was a costume that their dad used to wear when he was a kid. He wanted to scare them as a joke, but he forgot to take it out of the box.

Sara and Ben felt better and laughed. They said they were not afraid of ghosts anymore. They remembered how their dad liked to play tricks on them. They decided to play a trick on him too. They put the ghost costume on and waited for him to come home. When he opened the door, they jumped out and said "Boo!" Their dad was surprised and smiled. He said they were very clever and brave. They all hugged and had fun.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his laser gun. He would shoot it at trees and pretend he was a superhero. One day, Timmy was playing with his laser gun and he accidentally shot his friend in the eye. Timmy was careless and didn't mean to hurt his friend, but his friend had to go to the hospital.

Timmy felt very sad and sorry for what he had done. He promised to never be careless with his laser gun again. But the next day, Timmy was playing with his laser gun again and he saw a bird flying in the sky. He aimed his laser gun at the bird and shot it. Timmy thought he had won because he hit the bird, but he didn't realize that he had hurt the bird.

The bird fell to the ground and Timmy ran over to see if it was okay. But it was too late, the bird had died. Timmy felt very sad and realized that winning wasn't always the most important thing. He learned to be more careful with his laser gun and to think about the consequences of his actions.

The sun shone bright in the summer sky and the birds sang merrily in the distance. Bobby was playing in the garden. He ran and ran until he was out of breath. Suddenly, he saw an old bald man dancing on the field. His steps were quick and graceful. Bobby rushed over to him and asked, "Why are you dancing? Can I dance too?". The strange old man smiled and said, "Yes, of course you can join me. If you learn these steps, you will be able to dance everywhere!"

Bobby was excited and began to follow the old man's steps. But, he soon noticed the old man seemed to be getting faster and faster. Bobby couldn't keep up and started to pant and sweat. The old man laughed and said in a mysterious voice, "You must learn to keep up or you'll never be able to dance!" Bobby was a bit scared but he felt determined to learn the steps.

Days later, the summer was almost over and Bobby had mastered the old man's steps. On the last day of summer, Bobby was dancing in the field. The old man had disappeared, but Bobby kept dancing. He kept dancing until the stars began to come out and the sky turned from blue to black.

The next morning, Bobby woke up early and ran back to the field. He wanted to find the old man and thank him for teaching him how to dance. But, the old man was

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily saw a pretty rose in her garden. The rose was pink and smelled very nice. Lily liked the rose so much that she wanted to call it her own.

Lily's mom told her that the rose was very delicate and needed mild care. So, Lily watered the rose every day and made sure it got enough sunshine.

One day, Lily's grandma came to visit her. Lily was so happy to see her grandma that she wanted to show her the rose. She called out to her grandma and said, "Look at my pretty rose!" Her grandma was very proud of Lily for taking such good care of her rose.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Benny. Benny loved to hop around in the grass all day long. One sunny day, Benny saw a little girl named Lily walking by with her pet dog, Max.

"Hi, Benny!" said Lily. "Do you want to play with Max and me?"

"Sure!" said Benny, excitedly. "I love to hop and play with friends."

As they played, the sun got hotter and hotter. Benny started to feel very hot and thirsty.

"I need a drink of water," said Benny. "I'm so hot."

"Don't worry," said Lily. "We can go get some water for you."

So, they all went to get some water for Benny. After drinking the water, Benny felt much better. He was happy to have such good friends like Lily and Max to play with.

Once there was a girl named Sally. She liked to play outside with her friends. One day she was at the park and she found a pretty cup hidden amongst the trees. She was so excited! She decided to take it home with her, so she put it in her bag and she locked it with a key.

When she got home, Sally put the cup on her shelf. Then she ran to get her mom and show her the beautiful cup. Her mom was so happy for her and promised to keep the cup safe and locked away in a drawer.

Every day, Sally looked at the cup and smiled. She loved how pretty it was, and would often show it to her friends when they came over. She was so proud of the cup and how it sparkled in the sun.

One day, Sally decided it was time to unlock the cup. She wanted to use it and show it off. So she took out the key and unlocked the cup. She smiled as she took out all the special things she had put inside - a flower, a hat, and a toy rabbit.

Sally was so happy to have her very own special cup. She was sure she would always keep it safe and locked up.

Once there was a mommy and a daddy who wanted to build a new bathtub. They asked their little girl to be helpful. She smiled and said yes.

First, the mommy and daddy went to the store to find some things they needed. Then they brought them home. They went to the backyard with a hammer, nails and lots of wood.

The daddy nailed the wood together and the mommy used a saw to cut it. The little girl held the hammer and nails and even made a few taps.

After a lot of work, the mommy and daddy finally had a brand new bathtub. The little girl was so proud of all the helpful work she had done. The mommy and daddy were very happy too.

They filled the bathtub with lots of water and it was so much fun! From then on, the family enjoyed taking baths in their new bathtub.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful girl who had a pretty glove. Every day she liked to take it outside and play.

One day, while playing she saw a butterfly. She was so excited and reached out to try and catch it. But before she could, the wind came and the butterfly flew away.

The girl was so upset and she wanted the butterfly back. So she grabbed her glove, made a fist with it, and struck the air!

The wind saw this and thought it was playful. So it sent a gentle breeze back to the girl and the butterfly flew back to her hand.

The girl was so happy. She thanked the wind for sending the butterfly back and from then on, every time she played with her glove she thought of the butterfly, and the graceful way the wind had struck her hand.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to play in the garden. One day, they saw a big red strawberry on a green plant. They wanted to eat it, but it was too high for them to reach.

"Let's get a stool and step on it," Lily said.

"Good idea," Tom said. They ran to the shed and found a small stool. They carried it to the strawberry plant and put it under the fruit.

Lily climbed on the stool and reached for the strawberry. But as she did, she saw a fat bee buzzing around it. She was scared of bees and screamed.

"Help, help, a bee!" she cried.

Tom heard her and ran to help. He saw the bee and tried to shoo it away. But the bee was angry and stung him on the nose. He felt a sharp pain and cried too.

"Ow, ow, a sting!" he cried.

Their mom heard them and came to see what was wrong. She saw the stool, the strawberry, the bee, and the twins crying. She hugged them and took them inside. She put some ice on Tom's nose and gave them some honey to eat.

"It's okay, it's okay, don't cry," she said. "The bee is gone and the sting will heal. You can have another strawberry later."

Lily and Tom felt better and thanked their mom. They decided to leave the big red strawberry for the bee. Maybe it was his lunch.

Once upon a time, there was a princess. She was a very special princess who had many friends. One day, her friends had a surprise for her. They made her a special gift. The gift was very impressive. It included lots of treats and fun things inside. The princess was so excited to open the gift. Inside she saw a toy, a book and some sweets. She was so happy to have such an impressive gift from her friends. She wanted to thank them for the thoughtful present. Everyone was glad to have shared the special moment together.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Ben and Cole. Ben was creative and liked to come up with new ideas all the time, while Cole was always trouble. One day, Ben had a very creative idea - he wanted to go on a picnic. He urged Cole to join him, but Cole was stubborn. He said he didn't want to go and he wanted to stay at home.

Ben was upset and tried to urge Cole many times, but he wouldn't listen. He kept saying 'no' and telling Ben that it was a bad idea. Ben kept trying, but Cole kept refusing and wouldn't listen.

Meanwhile, trouble was brewing. Ben was getting frustrated and angry with Cole. He didn't want to stay at home and he wanted to do something fun. Cole kept saying no and wouldn't budge.

Finally, Ben had had enough. He decided to take matters into his own hands and take Cole with him on the picnic, whether Cole wanted to or not! He grabbed his friend's arm and dragged him to the picnic spot.

Once there, Ben urged Cole to enjoy the picnic. But even then, Cole was still in trouble. He was adamant not to have a good time. Eventually, Ben's creative ideas won out and Cole ended up having a great time.

The end!

Once upon a time there was a tall painter. The painter loved to paint pictures for everyone. They would make beautiful works of art with paint, paper and lots of bright colors.

One day, the painter went to a special party. At the party everyone was eating treats and having fun. But the tall painter couldn't remember anything from the party.

The next morning, the painter woke up with a big feeling of sadness. They were trying to remember why they were so sad, but the memory was blurry.

The painter eventually remembered that at the party, their friends had made fun of their tall painting. The painter was very hurt.

But the painter was determined to carry on anyway. They found happiness in their painting and made lots of beautiful pictures. The painter never forgot the pain of that day, but they also remembered the joy of painting.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to whistle. She would practice each day to get better and soon she could whistle really well.

One day, the girl wanted to find something new and creative to do with her whistle. She decided to try to make music with a net. She took the net outside, and started a song by whistling into it.

The net made a unique sound when the girl whistled into it, and she thought it was amazing! The girl began to practice with her net and her whistle - she could make beautiful music.

The girl was so pleased with what she had created and enjoyed playing with her net and whistle. She liked that she had been creative and made something new and fun.

Jim was a 3 year old boy. He liked to count numbers and take his time. Every day Jim went to the park with his fan. He liked the fan for it kept him cool in the warm sun. One day, Jim went to the park and decided to count slowly to 10. He slowly counted and when he reached 10, he was very proud. He waved his fan and looked around the park. He saw birds flying slowly from tree to tree. He watched as the leaves fell from the trees slowly. Jim was happy as he slowed counted from 10 to 15 and waved his fan. He looked at the clouds slowly moving in the sky. Then he counted to 20 and began to laugh. He laughed and waved his fan until it was time to go home. Jim smiled. He had a good day and had enjoyed counting those slow numbers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to a restaurant with her family. When they sat down, the waiter gave them a menu. Lily looked at the menu and saw lots of yummy foods. She asked her mom what she should pick.

Her mom said, "Let's complete our meals with something healthy. How about a salad?"

Lily thought that was a useful idea. She ordered a salad and her mom ordered one too. When the salads arrived, Lily said, "This is yummy! I completed my meal with something healthy!" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, you did a great job picking something from the menu."

Once upon a time there was a wealthy lady who had a wagon. Every day she took her wagon out to the market and bought delicious vegetables, fruit and flowers. One day while she was pushing her wagon down the road, she started to sneeze. She said “Achoo!” She sneezed so much that her wagon started to shake. She had to stop and rest, so she sat in the shade and drank some cool water.

Once she felt better, the lady continued pushing her wagon to the market. When she arrived, she bought lots of beautiful flowers, fruits, and vegetables and put them in the wagon. She was so happy with all the things she had bought.

On her way home, her wagon was so full of food and flowers that it was very heavy. But she was a wealthy lady, so she was able to push it without getting tired.

When she got home, she was very pleased with all the delicious food and pretty flowers she had bought. The lady thought, “What a wonderful day!”

Once upon a time there were two friends who were looking for a snack. They went on a long search, but nothing seemed to be the right snack.

Eventually, they stumbled across a rare sort of snack. It was covered in bright colors and smelled like something yummy. Both friends were so excited that they quickly grabbed some of the snack and shared it between them.

They savoured the soft, sweet snack. It tasted like nothing else they had ever tried before. They enjoyed their snack so much, that they wanted some more.

But as they looked around, the snack had suddenly disappeared! The friends looked high and low, but the rare snack was gone. They searched and searched, but could not find the snack anywhere.

They sat down, feeling a little sad that they hadn't gotten enough of the yummy snack. But as they sadly sat together, the snack suddenly reappeared!

They quickly grabbed some more of the rare snack, and happily munching away until it was all gone. They were so happy that they had found the snack, and that it was back for them to enjoy again.

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to play with planes. They have many planes in their room. Some are big, some are small, some are red, some are blue.

One day, they see a new plane in the sky. It is very big and shiny. It makes a loud noise. They want to see it closer. They run outside and follow it.

"Wow, look at that plane!" Tim says. "It is so cool!"

"I want to be a pilot when I grow up," Sam says. "I want to fly a plane like that."

They run and run until they reach a big field. There they see the plane land. It stops near a big tent. They see a man come out of the plane. He wears a helmet and a suit. He is the pilot.

"Hello, kids," the pilot says. "Do you like my plane?"

"Yes, we do!" Tim and Sam say. "It is awesome!"

"Thank you," the pilot says. "This is a special plane. It can help people who are sick or hurt. It can fly very fast and carry medicine and doctors."

"Wow, that is amazing!" Tim and Sam say. "How do you do that?"

"Well, I have a team of helpers. They are in the tent. They are nurses and engineers. They work together to make the plane ready. They unite to help others."

"Unite?" Tim and Sam ask. "What does that mean?"

"It means to join or work together for a common goal," the pilot says. "Like you and your friend. You are united by your love of planes."

"Oh, I see," Tim and Sam say. "That is nice."

"Would you like to see the plane and the tent?" the pilot asks. "Maybe you can learn something new."

"Yes, please!" Tim and Sam say. "That would be fun!"

The pilot smiles and takes them by the hand. He leads them to the plane and the tent. He shows them the inside of the plane and the equipment. He introduces them to his team. They are friendly and kind. They explain what they do and how they help.

Tim and Sam are very happy. They learn a lot of new things. They see how the pilot and his team unite to save lives. They think they are very brave and strong.

They also see some people who are sick or hurt. They are in the tent. They look sad and weak. They need the plane and the team to help them.

Tim and Sam feel sorry for them. They want to help them too. They ask the pilot what they can do.

"Well, you can do something very simple but very important," the pilot says. "You can smile and talk to them. You can make them feel better. You can show them that you care."

"Really?" Tim and Sam say. "That can help?"

"Yes, it can," the pilot says. "Sometimes, a smile and a kind word can make a big difference. They can make someone feel stronger and happier. They can unite their hearts."

Tim and Sam nod. They understand. They go to the tent and smile and talk to the people. They tell them their names and their stories. They tell them about their planes and their dreams. They listen to their stories and their hopes. They make them laugh and smile.

The people are very grateful. They thank Tim and Sam for their kindness. They tell them they are very sweet and smart. They tell them they are like little pilots.

Tim and Sam are very proud. They feel good. They hug the people and say goodbye. They thank the pilot and his team for their work. They say they want to be like them when they grow up.

The pilot and his team are very proud too. They hug Tim and Sam and say goodbye. They tell them they are very brave and strong. They tell them they are already like them.

Tim and Sam smile and wave. They hold hands and run back to their home. They are happy and united. They have learned a lot today. They have learned about planes and people. They have learned about helping and caring. They have learned about uniting.

Once upon a time, there was a fun monster. He was very happy, but one day he realised he had lost his toy. He searched high and low but he could not find it.

The monster felt sad but then he noticed a small hole. He peeked inside and there was his toy! He smiled so big and was very excited.

The monster scooped up his toy and with a hop, he jumped out of the hole. Then he looked at the hole and noticed it was amazing. He put his hand inside and found some more fun toys. He picked them up and put them in his pocket.

The monster was very happy and he hoped there would be more holes like this one. He thanked the hole for giving him these amazing surprises.

Once there was a family who had a car. The car was very special to them because they valued it. One day, they went on a drive to the countryside. When they arrived, they were all very hungry. They stopped at a restaurant and ordered some food. When the food arrived, they all enjoyed it. After eating, they got back into the car and drove back home. They were all very happy, and they valued and loved their car.

One day, a girl named Sally wanted to bake a cake. She wanted to make an original cake that no one had ever seen before. She thought and thought. Then, she had a great idea!

Sally went to the kitchen and found some broccoli. She said to her mom, "I want to put broccoli in my cake!" Her mom looked at her and said, "That is a very original idea, Sally. Let's try it!"

So, they baked the cake with the broccoli inside. When the cake was ready, they shared it with their friends. Everyone was surprised to see the green cake, but they all liked it. Sally was happy that she made an original cake that everyone enjoyed.

Once there was a mommy and a toddler. The toddler wanted to try to do yoga with mommy. So they tried it together.

The toddler tried to touch his toes, but he could not do it. He felt frustrated. Mommy said, "Stretch your legs, sweetheart. You can do it!"

The little one tried again and he actually got his toes to touch. He felt proud and happy, but it still seemed like a long way for him to do yoga. The mommy held his hand and said, "Let's take it slow, and practice often."

The toddler and mommy kept practicing yoga and soon, the little one could do long stretches. He smiled and told mommy, "Look what I can do now!"

The moral of the story is that practice and patience can help us do anything, even if it seems too hard or too long in the beginning.

Lily liked to read books. She had many books in her room. She read them every day. She read about animals, and stars, and magic. She read when she was happy, and when she was sad, and when she was bored.

But Lily was lonely. She had no friends to play with. She lived far away from other kids. Her mom and dad worked a lot. They did not have time to read with her. Lily wished she had someone to share her books with.

One day, Lily's mom said, "Lily, we are going to a lecture today. It is about books. Do you want to come?" Lily was excited. She said, "Yes, mom, I want to come! Maybe I will meet other kids who like books too!"

They went to the lecture. It was in a big hall. There were many people there. Some of them were kids. Lily saw a boy who had the same book as her. It was a book about dragons. Lily loved dragons. She went to the boy and said, "Hi, I like your book. I have it too. Do you want to read it with me?"

The boy smiled. He said, "Hi, I like your book too. Yes, I want to read it with you. What is your name?" Lily said, "My name is Lily. What is yours?" The boy said, "My name is Ben. Do you want to be my friend?" Lily said, "Yes, I want to be your friend!"

Lily and Ben sat together and read the book. They talked about the dragons and the adventures. They laughed and had fun. They did not care about the lecture. They had found something better. They had found each other. Lily was not lonely anymore. She was happy.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a stubborn little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside, especially when it rained. One day, after a big rain, Tim saw a big puddle outside his house. He wanted to jump in it.

Tim's mom saw him and said, "Tim, please don't jump in the puddle. You will get all wet and dirty." But Tim did not listen. He was very stubborn.

Tim jumped in the puddle and played for a while. He paused for a moment and looked at his mom. She was not happy. Then, Tim slipped and fell in the mud. He started to cry. His mom came to help him, but Tim was all wet and dirty. He had to go inside and take a bath. Tim was sad because he could not play outside anymore.

One day, a boy named Tim wanted to play in his backyard. He wanted to use his new red ball. He asked his mom, "Can I play with my red ball in the backyard?" His mom said, "Yes, but be careful and don't go too far."

Tim was very happy. He went outside and started to play with his red ball. He threw it high and far. He was very successful at catching it every time. He played and played, having lots of fun.

But then, the red ball went too far. It went over the fence and into the neighbor's yard. Tim was sad. He asked his mom, "Can I get my red ball back?" His mom said, "No, it is too late now. We can try tomorrow." Tim went to bed sad because he lost his red ball.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Snowy. Snowy was very white and fluffy. One day, Snowy wanted to travel to a new place. Snowy asked his friends if they wanted to come, but they all said no. Snowy was sad, but he decided to travel alone.

As Snowy was hopping along, he saw a bird who looked guilty. Snowy asked the bird what was wrong, and the bird said he had eaten all the seeds in the garden. Snowy told the bird it was not nice to eat all the seeds and that he should say sorry to the gardener.

Snowy continued on his journey and eventually found a beautiful meadow. Snowy was so happy he decided to take a nap. When he woke up, he saw that his friends had followed him and were playing nearby. Snowy was overjoyed that he was not alone anymore and they all played together in the meadow.

Once upon a time, there was a brave knight named Jack. Jack had a sword that he loved to play with. One day, Jack went on an adventure to find a yummy apple pie. He searched high and low, but he couldn't find any apple pie.

Suddenly, he saw a dragon! The dragon demanded that Jack give him his sword. Jack was scared, but he knew he had to be brave. He said, "No, I need my sword to protect myself."

The dragon got angry and breathed fire, but Jack was quick and dodged it. He swung his sword and defeated the dragon. Jack was happy that he was able to keep his sword and he continued on his adventure to find the yummy apple pie.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl named Ann. On a special day, she decided to explore the nearby woods. As she walked, Ann saw a castle in the distance. She was very excited, so she ran up to it.

When Ann reached the castle, she noticed something strange. Instead of the big door she had expected to see, the castle had lots of tiny doors. Each one was a different color.

Ann decided to try one of the doors. Suddenly, a big, bossy voice said, "Who goes there?" Ann was scared, so she paused for a moment. Then, she answered, "I'm Ann."

To her surprise, the voice said, "Come on in, Ann! I've been waiting for you." Ann opened the red door and stepped inside. The voice belonged to a fairy, who lived in the castle with lots of other fairies.

The fairy said, "Welcome, Ann. This is your magical castle now." Ann smiled and began exploring her new home.

Once there was a kind girl named Maya. Maya loved to dream big dreams. One day, Maya had a dream where she was a princess. She was wearing a beautiful dress and spun round and round in circles until she felt so dizzy that she had to stop.

Maya was inspired to try the same thing while she was awake the next day. She spun round and round until she could go no more. She was so happy when she came to a stop and she smiled even bigger when she realized she could do it again.

Every day after that, Maya would take a turn and dream of a world full of adventure, kindness and fun. She would keep spinning until she felt like she had enough and then she would fall back down onto her feet, happy and content, until she could dream again the next day.

John was celebrating his third birthday and was super excited. He was wearing a colourful mask and had invited all his friends to his house. They were all in the backyard, playing games and having fun.

Suddenly, John’s mom said to all the children, “Time to organize the birthday cake before it’s dark outside!”. The children all ran to help John's mom. John was so graceful as he managed to carry the cake to the backyard.

John was so proud of his mask, as he had made it with his mom. Everyone started singing 'Happy Birthday' to John, who had bought a special candle to put on the cake.

Just as they had finished singing, a strong wind blew and the mask that John was wearing flew away.

John was devastated and started crying. He yelled at his friends, telling them it was all their fault. His friends were so sad to see him so angry and they quickly ran away.

John's mom tried to comfort him, but he was too angry. John just wanted his birthday back, but it was too late. His birthday had ended in disaster.

Ben and Mia are twins. They like to play outside in the sun. They have a big yard with a swing and a slide. They also have a dog named Spot. Spot is funny. He likes to run and jump and bark.

One day, Ben and Mia see a bird on the roof of their house. The bird is red and yellow and blue. It sings a pretty song. Ben and Mia want to see the bird up close. They ask their mom if they can go on the roof.

"Please, mom, can we go on the roof?" they say.

"No, you can't go on the roof," mom says. "The roof is too high and too steep. You could fall and get hurt. You can watch the bird from the window."

Ben and Mia are sad. They really want to go on the roof. They think of a plan. They get a ladder from the garage and lean it against the house. They wait until mom is busy in the kitchen. Then they sneak out and climb the ladder.

They reach the roof and see the bird. The bird is even prettier up close. It flaps its wings and hops around. Ben and Mia smile and clap. They try to talk to the bird.

"Hello, bird," they say. "What is your name? Do you want to be our friend?"

The bird looks at them and tilts its head. It opens its beak and says, "Woof, woof, woof!"

Ben and Mia are surprised. They look at each other and then at the bird. The bird is not a bird. It is Spot. Spot has a red and yellow and blue feather on his head. He has climbed the ladder and followed them to the roof. He is pretending to be a bird. He is very funny.

Ben and Mia laugh and hug Spot. They say, "Spot, you are so funny. You are the best dog ever. We love you."

Spot licks their faces and wags his tail. He says, "Woof, woof, woof!"

Mom hears the noise and looks out the window. She sees Ben and Mia and Spot on the roof. She is shocked and angry. She runs out and shouts, "Ben and Mia, what are you doing on the roof? Come down right now! And Spot, how did you get up there? You are a bad dog!"

Ben and Mia and Spot are scared. They say, "Sorry, mom. We wanted to see the bird. But it was Spot. He was funny. Please don't be mad."

Mom sighs and shakes her head. She says, "I'm glad you are safe, but you are very naughty. You could have been hurt. You have to listen to me. You can't go on the roof. And Spot, you have to stay on the ground. You are not a bird. You are a dog."

She helps them down the ladder and takes them inside. She gives them a hug and a kiss. She says, "I love you, but you have to be careful. And no more roof adventures, OK?"

Ben and Mia and Spot nod and say, "OK, mom. We love you too."

They go to their room and play with their toys. They still think Spot is funny. They hope to see a real bird someday. But they don't go on the roof again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Penny. She was very sorry because her mom had to work all day. Penny wanted her mom to stay home with her.

One day, Penny's mom wanted to surprise Penny. She went to the store and loaded a cart full of fun things for Penny.

When Penny's mom came home, Penny was so surprised and happy! She hugged her mom and said "Thank you!"

They went inside and Mom showed Penny all the things she had loaded into the cart. Penny saw tons of toys and games that she could play with. She was so excited!

After that, Penny and her mom had a great time playing together. Even though Penny was still sorry that her mom had to work all day, she was glad that she was able to have time together at the end of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a heavy rock. The rock could not move, but it had a voice. It could talk to the animals in the forest. The rock liked to spend time with the animals.

One day, a bird came to visit the heavy rock. The rock said, "Hello, bird! I like your voice." The bird was happy and sang a song for the rock. They spent the day talking and singing.

As the sun went down, more animals came to see the heavy rock. The rock spent the night talking and laughing with all its friends. The animals loved the rock's voice, and they all had a fun time together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very restless and couldn't sleep at night. Her mommy and daddy tried to sing her lullabies and read her stories, but nothing seemed to work.

One day, Lily's friend Timmy came to play. He suggested they go outside and play in the sunshine. Lily loved that idea! They played tag and jumped on the trampoline. After a while, they got tired and sat down to rest.

As they rested, Timmy pulled out a little notebook and showed Lily the notes he had written about their adventures. Lily thought it was so cool and wanted to write her own notes too. They spent the rest of the day playing and writing notes in their notebooks. When it was time to go home, Lily was so tired that she fell asleep right away. From then on, she slept much better at night knowing she had fun adventures to write about in her notebook.

Once upon a time there was a small girl called Emily. Every day Emily went out to play with her friends in the park. One day, Emily noticed something strange. Everyone was walking around very slowly, and there was a quiet hush in the park. Emily paused to question why it was so quiet. Suddenly, she saw her friends standing in a circle. Emily was curious and went to join them.

When Emily got closer, she heard them talking about something. She couldn't quite make it out, but she knew it wasn't normal. Emily asked her friends a question. "What are you talking about?", she said. They all looked up and smiled. One of them said "We're talking about a surprise party for you, Emily." Emily was delighted.

Emily and her friends went back to playing as normal, but with a huge smile on Emily's face. She couldn't wait for the surprise party that was coming soon!

Once there was a happy little girl called Susie. She was three years old, and every day she would go and play in the garden.

One day, Susie found a little box. Inside was some medicine. She didn't know what it was, so she asked her mum. Her mum told her it was medicine to make her better when she felt sick.

Just then, Susie became very happy. She ran and found a piece of cloth and began to wrap the medicine in it. She wrapped and wrapped until it was all covered up.

When she finished, Susie ran outside to show her mum. Her mum said she was very clever for wrapping the medicine. And with that, Susie was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to ask questions and learn new things. One day, she saw a person walking down the street and thought they looked interesting.

"Hi there! What's your name?" asked Lily.

"My name is Sarah," answered the person.

Lily was excited to meet someone new and asked Sarah lots of questions. But Sarah seemed busy and didn't answer many of Lily's questions. This made Lily sad.

Later, Lily talked to her mom about what happened. "Why didn't Sarah answer my questions?" she asked.

"Well, sometimes people are busy or don't feel like talking," explained Lily's mom. "But if you keep asking questions, you'll find someone who wants to answer them."

Lily felt better and decided to keep asking questions. She met many new people who were happy to answer her questions and she learned lots of new things.

Lila and Ben were playing in the garden. They liked to look at the flowers and the bugs. They saw a bee flying from one flower to another. The bee was yellow and black and had a fuzzy body.

"Look, a bee!" Lila said. "It is making honey."

"Can we have some honey?" Ben asked.

"No, we have to let the bee finish its work. The honey is for the bee and its friends. They need it to eat and stay warm." Lila said.

They watched the bee for a while. It was very busy and fast. It had a long tongue that it used to drink the nectar from the flowers. The nectar was sweet and sticky. The bee stored the nectar in a special place in its body.

"Be careful, the bee can sting you if you touch it. The sting is sharp and hurts." Lila warned.

"I won't touch it. I just want to see it." Ben said.

He moved closer to the bee. He saw that the bee had delicate wings that made a buzzing sound. The wings were thin and shiny. They helped the bee fly and balance.

The bee finished drinking from the flower. It flew away to another flower. Lila and Ben followed it. They wanted to see more of the bee and its work. They learned a lot from the bee. They had fun in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly crocodile who lived in a small pond. He had lived there his whole life and very rarely met anyone on his adventures.

One day, he decided to explore the pond to see what he could find. He was very surprised to come across a delicious fruit in the water! It tasted sweet and he knew he just had to have a taste.

He gobbled up the fruit whole and it made his tummy feel so good. He continued to explore around the pond and found more fruit for himself.

The elderly crocodile was so happy he had discovered this wonderful treat. He enjoyed the fruity taste and spent his days swimming in the pond, searching for more fruit.

Eventually, he decided to share his secret with the animals around him, but he never told anyone else where he had found it. Even to this day, no one knows how the elderly crocodile found that magical fruit in the pond!

Once upon a time, in a perfect little town, there lived a brave dog named Spot. Spot loved to save people and animals when they were in trouble. He was always ready to help.

One sunny day, Spot was playing with his ball when he heard a tiny voice cry, "Help! Save me!" Spot looked around and saw a little bird stuck in a tree. The bird was scared because of a big cat nearby. The cat was a threat to the bird.

"Stay still, little bird. I will save you," said Spot. He barked loudly at the cat, and the cat ran away. Spot then jumped up and gently grabbed the bird in his mouth. He put the bird down on the ground, and the bird was safe.

"Thank you for saving me, Spot," said the bird. "You are my hero."

Spot wagged his tail and smiled. He was happy that he could save his new friend from the threat. They played together all day long in the perfect little town.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play and joke with each other. One day, they find a big box in the park. They wonder what is inside.

"Maybe it is a toy," Lily says.

"Maybe it is a cake," Tom says.

They open the box and see a hairy strip. It is brown and furry. It looks like a tail.

"What is this?" Lily asks.

"It is a tail," Tom says.

"Who does it belong to?" Lily asks.

"Maybe it is a lion's tail," Tom says.

He picks up the hairy strip and puts it on his back. He roars like a lion.

"Rawr! I am a lion!" he jokes.

Lily laughs. She thinks Tom is funny. She picks up another hairy strip. It is black and white. It looks like a skunk's tail.

"I am a skunk!" she jokes.

She puts the hairy strip on her back and pretends to spray Tom.

"Pew! You stink!" she jokes.

Tom laughs. He thinks Lily is funny. They play with the hairy strips and pretend to be animals.

They do not know that the hairy strips are from a costume shop. They were in the box by mistake. The costume shop owner is looking for them. He is not happy. He thinks someone stole his tails. He follows the trail of fur to the park. He sees Lily and Tom playing with his tails.

"Hey! Give me back my tails!" he shouts.

Lily and Tom are scared. They do not know who he is. They drop the hairy strips and run away.

They think he is a mean man. They do not want to play with his tails anymore. They find another place to play and joke. They are still friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, she went to the park with her mommy and daddy. They played on the swings and went down the slide. Lily laughed and had so much fun.

After playing, they went to get ice cream. The ice cream man asked Lily what number ice cream she wanted. She said "Two, please!" and her mommy and daddy smiled.

Later that day, they watched a movie about a scared cat. Lily didn't like when the cat was scared, but she laughed when the cat did silly things. After the movie, Lily went to bed and dreamed of playing at the park and eating ice cream.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was very happy because she had a new kite. It was small and very pretty.

The girl ran outside to fly her kite. She smiled as she watched it soar in the sky. She felt like she was flying too.

But then the wind started to blow. The girl held on tight to her kite. Suddenly, it started to slide down the hill. She slid down with it, laughing as she rolled in the grass.

When she got to the bottom of the hill, the girl picked up her kite and hugged it tight. She was so excited to fly it again.

And so, she happily ran back up the hill and flew her kite with a huge smile on her face.

Once upon a time there was a wild cat. He lived in a big forest and loved to run through the trees and explore. He had lots of fun in the forest and saw many different animals.

One day, he stumbled across a house in the forest. The cat was curious and wanted to explore. He crept inside to take a look.

When he stepped inside he was amazed by what he saw - it was completely silent! He had never experienced such silence before. The cat was fascinated so he stayed to see what would happen.

He waited in the silent house for hours until he heard some noise coming from outside. The cat raced to see what was causing the noise and he saw a family of children playing in the garden.

The cat watched them and saw them manage to play together without making much noise. He realised that he too could manage silence and he spent a lot of time in the silent house learning to enjoy peaceful moments.

The wild cat grew to love his memories in the silent house. He learnt to appreciate the beauty of the wild forest and adapted to his new way of life. He was always happy there!

One day, a mommy and her little girl were walking in the forest. They came across a beautiful lake, surrounded by tall trees and a house in the distance. The mommy said, "This is a wonderful place to play. Let's go explore."

The little girl smiled and stepped forward, but suddenly she started to scream. Without thinking, the mommy raced to her daughter's side. She saw a mop lying on the ground and a dead bird beside it. The mommy said, "My darling, don't scream. It must have been a hunter."

The little girl was scared, so the mommy hugged her tight. That night, the mommy said, "Remember what you saw today, darling. It will help you in the future."

The little girl didn't understand, but she nodded anyway.

Years later, when the little girl was grown up, she returned to the same spot. While exploring the area, she heard a hunter shouting and a gunshot firing. Suddenly, she remembered the mop and dead bird from long ago. She knew it was a warning and quickly left.

The mommy was right. The little girl remembered the earlier foreshadowing, and it saved her life.

Once upon a time, there was a little house in the woods. A girl named Lily lived there. She had a dog named Max. They liked to play in the woods.

One day, Lily and Max saw an unknown path. They walked on it and found a big tree. Max started to dig under the tree. Lily saw him and yelled, "Max, what are you doing?"

Max found a box under the tree. They opened it and found a key. Lily and Max took the key back to the house. They looked around and found a locked door. Lily used the key to open it.

Behind the door was a beautiful room full of toys and games. Lily and Max were so happy. They played all day and had lots of fun. And from that day on, they knew they had a secret room just for them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom asked her to deliver some cookies to their neighbor. Lily was happy to help and carried the cookies in a basket.

On the way to the neighbor's house, Lily saw a big fireplace in someone's yard. She stopped to warm her hands by the fire for a little while. But, she got too close and it hurt her hand. "Ouch!" she said, rubbing her hand.

When she arrived at the neighbor's house, she knocked on the door. "Hi Lily, what brings you here?" the neighbor asked. "I brought you some cookies," Lily said, holding out the basket. The neighbor smiled and said, "Thank you, that's very kind of you."

Lily felt happy that she could help her neighbor and forgot all about her hurt hand. She skipped back home, feeling proud of herself for delivering the cookies.

Once there was a little girl named Jessie. She was only three years old and loved to go outside and play. On this day, the sun was shining brightly and there were lovely puddles everywhere.

Jessie wanted to play in the puddles, so she stood in the biggest one. She scooped her hands through the water and laughed as the puddle splashed around her.

As she was standing there, she saw an even bigger puddle in the distance. She grabbed her jumping boots and started running through the grass, splashing the puddles as she went.

When she arrived at the big puddle, she could not believe how lovely it was. She jumped in and felt the cool water on her feet. She stood in the middle and spun around. She had lots of fun that day, feeling the sun on her face and the cool water on her feet. As she left she knew she felt extra lucky to have such a lovely place to play.

Mandy and Tim were best friends. They did lots of things together and one of their favorite things to do was work on quizzes.

Tim looked at the quiz they had made and said, "Let's do this one together!"

Mandy smiled and said, "Sounds fun! What kind of quiz is it?"

"It's a safe quiz," Tim said proudly. "It's about friendly things."

Mandy nodded and said, "That sounds nice! OK, let's do it!"

So the two friends started to work on the quiz. All the questions were about things that made them feel happy and safe. They both did really well on the quiz and ended up getting a perfect score.

"We did great, Mandy!" Tim said as he gave her a high-five.

Mandy smiled and said, "We sure did! Now let's do it again and see if we can get the same score!"

And so the two friends continued to work on their safe quiz, having lots of fun along the way.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved Sundays because he got to eat pancakes for breakfast. Pancakes were his favorite food in the whole wide world.

One Sunday, Timmy heard a loud noise outside his window. He looked outside and saw a big truck driving by. The truck was so loud that it made his ears hurt.

Timmy decided to go outside and see the truck up close. He ran to the truck and asked the driver what he was carrying. The driver said he was carrying toys for all the good boys and girls. Timmy was so happy that he couldn't stop smiling. He couldn't wait to get his hands on those toys!

One day, a playful dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a big tree and wanted to lean on it. So, he walked to the tree and leaned on it to rest. While resting, he heard a funny sound.

Max looked around and saw a horn on the ground. He picked it up with his mouth and blew into it. The horn made a loud "toot!" sound. Max was very happy and wagged his tail.

A little girl named Lily heard the sound and came to see what it was. She saw Max with the horn and said, "Hi, doggy! Can I play with the horn too?" Max gave the horn to Lily, and they took turns making funny sounds with it. They laughed and played together all day long.

Once upon a time, in a small garden, there was a little onion. This onion was rough on the outside, but it was very kind on the inside. It liked to play with its friends, the carrot and the tomato, every day.

One day, the carrot was sad because it could not grow as tall as the other plants. The onion wanted to help, so it said, "Don't worry, carrot. I will encourage you to grow tall and strong!" The carrot smiled, and the onion made sure to cheer it on every day.

With the onion's help, the carrot started to grow taller and stronger. The rough onion, the carrot, and the tomato became the best of friends. They played together in the garden, and they were always there to encourage each other. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very eager to play the violin. She looked at her mum and asked, "Mum, can I grab my violin?" Her mum smiled and said, "Of course, sweetheart!"

The little girl ran over to the violin case and grabbed the instrument. With a big smile on her face, she hugged it close.

The mum watched as her daughter played and felt happy that her child was so eager. With every note she played, the little girl's face lit up with joy.

At the end of the song, the mum smiled and said, "That was beautiful, sweetheart!" The little girl smiled back and gave her mum a big hug.

Poppy was a tall girl who liked to create things. She had many crayons, papers, scissors and glue. She made pictures, cards, hats and dolls. She was very happy when she created something new.

One day, she wanted to create a poppy flower. She loved poppies because they were red and pretty. She found a red paper and cut out a circle. She cut out four petals and glued them to the circle. She made a black dot in the middle. She found a green paper and cut out a stem and a leaf. She glued them to the flower.

She showed her poppy to her mom. "Look, mom, I made a poppy!" she said proudly.

Mom smiled and hugged her. "That's a beautiful poppy, Poppy!" she said. "You are very creative and clever. I love your poppy and I love you."

Poppy felt warm and happy. She gave her mom the poppy and said, "I love you too, mom. Thank you for helping me create things."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play with her toys. One day, she decided to make a fort out of her furniture. She took her pillows and blankets and put them on the floor to make a cozy space.

As she was building her fort, her mom came in and said, "Lily, be careful with the scissors. They can cut your fingers." Lily replied, "Okay, Mom. I will be careful."

After she finished building her fort, Lily sat inside and looked around. She felt happy because she had made a dependable fort that would keep her safe. She said to herself, "I love my furniture. It helps me make fun things like this fort."

From that day on, Lily knew that she could always depend on her furniture to help her make fun things to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One day, her mom took her to the store to buy a toy. Lily saw a shiny toy she liked, but it had a high price. Her mom said they couldn't buy it because it was too expensive.

Lily got upset and started to cry. She didn't want to leave without the toy. Her mom told her to ignore the toy and look for something else. Lily didn't want to listen and kept crying. Suddenly, she saw a little boy who didn't have any toys. He looked sad.
