Once there was a big bathtub. It was warm and inviting. Every night, a little boy would get ready to bathe. He would take off his clothes and step into the tub. The water was always warm and it sparkled in the light. He loved the way he felt getting all clean.

Sometimes his big brother would join too. They would splash around and make lots of noise. Together, they would make bubbles and play with the warm water. It was so exciting!

When it was time to get out, the boy would hop out of the bathtub and wrap himself in a cozy towel. He felt so happy and clean after each bath. He couldn't wait until the next time he could bathe in the warm light.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sue. Sue was feeling very uncomfortable and couldn't figure out why. She looked around her room, but nothing seemed wrong.

Then, she noticed an old rug that had been cut in two. It was very strange, she thought.

So she asked her mom, "Why is the rug cut in two?" Her mother smiled and said, "Because it was uncomfortable. So I cut it in two so it can be more comfortable".

Sue was amazed!

She ran over to the rug and felt how much softer it was. Now she was comfy and happy! She smiled and said, "Thanks, Mommy!"

Anna and Ben were playing in the park with their mom. They saw an enormous slide that looked like a dragon. Anna wanted to go on the slide, but Ben was scared.

"Come on, Ben, it's fun!" Anna said. "You can go with me."

Ben shook his head. "No, thank you. It's too big and scary."

Anna sighed. She remembered when they went to the zoo and saw a real dragon. Well, not a real dragon, but a lizard that had a label that said "dragon". It was small and green and had spikes on its back. Anna liked the lizard, but Ben did not.

"Look, Ben, it's not a real dragon. It's just a slide. See, it has a label that says 'slide'. And it has a smiley face. It won't hurt you." Anna pointed to the sign and the painted face on the slide.

Ben looked at the label and the face. He felt a little better. Maybe it was not so scary after all. He decided to try the slide with Anna.

"Okay, Anna, I'll go with you. But you have to hold my hand."

Anna smiled and took Ben's hand. They climbed up the stairs and sat on the slide. They slid down together, laughing and screaming. They had so much fun that they wanted to go again and again.

Mom watched them and smiled. She was proud of Ben for being brave and Anna for being kind. She remembered when she was a little girl and went on the same slide with her brother. She felt happy and nostalgic. She took a picture of Anna and Ben on the slide and put a label on it that said "My brave and kind kids". She would keep it forever.

Once upon a time there was a fair princess. She loved to go for walks and explore the forest. One day, while out walking, she saw a small twig on the ground. She picked up the twig and started to giggle and smile.

Suddenly, the twig started to move and it was actually a little fairy! The princess was very surprised. She asked the fairy why it was in the forest.

The fairy told the princess that it had been embarrassed. Another fairy had made fun of it for being too small. So it ran away and found the twig to hide in.

The princess was very kind and said that the little fairy didn't need to be embarrassed. She said that everyone was special and special in different ways. The little fairy smiled and thanked the princess. Then he fluttered away with a wave of thanks.

Once upon a time, there was a squirrel who loved to dance. Every day, he would spin and leap across the ground with joy.

One day he found a useful item lying in the ground - a key! He knew that keys were meant for unlocking special things, so he decided to take it home.

He hopped away and put the key in his nest for safekeeping. Another squirrel saw him and asked him why he had the key.

The first squirrel said, "I'm going to use this key to unlock something special."

The other squirrel asked, "Will you share it with me when you find out what it unlocks?"

The first squirrel thought for a minute and said, "Yes, of course!"

The moral of the story is that it is important to share with your friends if you have something special. A little sharing goes a long way.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved chocolate. Every day, she would go to the store and buy a bar of choclate. She would take it home and eat it all up, feeling happy and content when she was finished.

One day, when she went to the store, she could not find the chocolate she wanted. She looked for a long time but she could not find it, so she surrendered and went home.

When she got to her house, she was surprised to see that all the windows were clean and sparkling. Inside the door was a big, shiny box full of chocolates. The little girl was so excited and ate all the chocolates until her tummy was full.

The little girl learned that even when things don't turn out the way she wants them to, sometimes it can turn out even better if she surrenders and just waits to see what happens! She was so happy that she decided to keep all her windows clean from then on. The End.

Once upon a time there was a thin girl called Mia. She always wore a colourful mask when she was outside so nobody could tell who she was. One day, Mia went out to walk in the park with her mummy. She saw a man in the park who had a big nod in his hand. Mia was so curious about what he was carrying, so she asked her mummy "What's that man holding in his hand?"

Mummy smiled and said, "That's a noddle. It's very yummy, I'm sure you'll like it". Then, she turned to the man and asked politely, "Would you like to give a noddle to my girl?" The man smiled and nodded. He gave the noddle to Mia, and she happily thanked him.

Mia loved the noddle so much that she kept asking her mummy, "Can I have a noddle again?" Her mummy started to laugh and nodded. They had a few more noddles during the nice walk in the park.

At the end, Mia took off her mask and smiled. She was so happy that she was able to eat the noddles. She gave the man a big nod and thanked him again for the noddles. Then, she and her mummy started to go home. Mia was so glad that she had such a fun day with her mummy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved summer because she could play outside all day. One day, Lily's mom asked her to carry a basket of apples to their neighbor's house.

Lily picked up the basket and started walking. She felt the apples were heavy, but she wanted to help her mom. Along the way, she saw her friend Timmy playing with his toy car.

"Hi, Lily!" Timmy said. "What are you doing?"

"I'm carrying apples to our neighbor's house," Lily replied.

"That's nice of you," Timmy said. "Be safe on your way."

Lily smiled and continued walking. She felt proud of herself for helping her mom and being safe. When she arrived at the neighbor's house, she gave them the apples and they said thank you. Lily felt happy and went back home to play with Timmy.

Ben and Lily liked to play in the park. They liked to slide, swing, and run. But their favorite thing was to whistle. They learned how to whistle from their dad, who whistled all the time. They whistled loud and soft, high and low, fast and slow. They whistled songs and sounds and words.

One day, they saw a big hole in the ground. It had a sign that said "Underground". They wondered what was inside. They wanted to see. They walked to the hole and looked down. It was dark and deep. They heard a noise. It sounded like a whistle.

"Hello?" Ben whistled.

"Hello!" a voice whistled back.

"Who are you?" Lily whistled.

"I'm Tom. I work here. I dig tunnels for the trains. Do you like trains?" the voice whistled.

"Yes, we love trains!" Ben and Lily whistled.

"Me too. Do you want to see the trains?" the voice whistled.

"Yes, please!" Ben and Lily whistled.

"OK, but you have to be careful. It's dangerous down here. Follow me. I'll show you the way." the voice whistled.

Ben and Lily were excited. They wanted to see the trains. They wanted to see Tom. They wanted to see the underground. They followed the voice. They whistled as they went. They were careful. They had fun. They learned a lot. They made a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big yellow house on a hill. An elderly lady lived in the house, and every day she would lay in the sun.

One day, a young boy named Daniel walked up to the house on the hill. He saw the elderly lady laying in the sun, and asked “What are you doing?”

The lady replied “I am laying in the sun to stay warm. It feels nice!”

Daniel thought this was fun and wanted to try it. So he went and laid down in the sun next to the elderly lady. They both felt very warm and happy.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and go to the park. One day, she went to the park and saw a beautiful swan swimming in the pond. She said, "Look, Mommy! A pretty bird!"

Her mom said, "That's not a bird, Lily. That's a swan. They are very graceful and elegant."

Lily said, "Can we bring some bread to feed the swan?"

Her mom said, "Sure, let's go get some bread from the store."

When they came back with the bread, the swan came closer to them. Lily fed the swan and said, "I like the swan. It's not ignorant like some other birds."

Her mom asked, "What do you mean, Lily?"

Lily said, "Some birds don't know how to be polite and say thank you when we bring them food. But the swan is very nice and says thank you with its eyes."

Once upon a time, a wise cow lived on a farm. She had big brown eyes and soft fur. One day, she saw a little girl walking towards her. The girl said, "Hi cow, can I play with you?"

The cow replied, "Sure, but be careful. I am trying to balance on this log." The girl watched as the cow tried to balance on the log. She said, "Wow, you are so good at balancing!"

The cow smiled and said, "Thank you, I have been practicing." The girl asked the cow if she wanted to play tag. The cow agreed and they ran around the field. After a while, they got tired and sat down to rest.

The girl said, "You are my new best friend, cow. You are so wise and fun to play with." The cow blushed and said, "Thank you, you are a great friend too." From that day on, the girl visited the cow every day and they played together, always having fun and balancing on logs.

Once there was a clown named Bob. Bob was silly and he always dressed up in funny clothes. Every day, he would go to the grassy park and sit on the seat there. He watched the birds eating worms and the flowers swaying in the breeze.

One day Bob spotted a funny worm crawling out of a hole in the ground. He tried to grab it but it got away! Bob sat on the seat and laughed as the worm climbed up a blade of grass.

Bob had seen lots of worms, but he had never seen one so silly. He laughed and laughed until his tummy hurt. Every day after that, Bob would go to the grassy park and sit on the seat. He watched the worms and the flowers, and he smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a little parrot with lovely feathers. Every morning he liked to sing very loudly. But one day, he found something new! A bow, dangling from a branch in a nearby tree.

He flew over to it and said, "Wow!" He tried to pick it up but it was too high for him. He tried again, but he was too small.

Just then, he heard a voice. It was a friendly voice that said, "Hey little parrot, why don't you fly up to me and I will help you get the bow?"

The parrot followed the voice and found a very kind deer. The deer lowered their head, and the parrot grabbed the string of the bow with their beak.

The deer then said, "That bow looks lovely on you my friend. Now sing your beautiful song and make everyone happy!"

The parrot was so pleased and sang the most lovely song. From then onwards, he wore the bow proudly, and everyone marvelled at his kindness and beauty.

Once upon a time there was a tall tree. On top of the tree, there was a big branch. One day, a pigeon flew up to the branch. At the top of the branch, the pigeon found a tasty treat. The pigeon couldn't reach the treat.

So, the pigeon flew down from the branch and found a little boy. The pigeon chirped at the boy and flew back up onto the branch. The boy looked up and saw the tasty treat. He smiled and reached up to get it for the pigeon.

The boy got the treat for the pigeon. The pigeon was so happy and grateful! It took the tasty treat in its beak and flew away. The boy waved goodbye to the pigeon as it flew away. And they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion who lived in the jungle. He was very strong and brave. One day, he saw a bird flying high in the sky. The lion wanted to fly too, but he was too heavy.

The lion was feeling very hot, so he went to the river to drink some water. Suddenly, the wind started to blow and it became very cold. The lion felt chilly and shivered.

The bird saw that the lion was cold and offered to share his feathers to keep him warm. The lion was very grateful and thanked the bird. From that day on, the lion and the bird became good friends and the lion never forgot the kindness of the little bird who helped him when he was cold.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly ghost. He lived in a big old house. The ghost was very intelligent and knew a lot of things. He loved to read books and learn new things.

One day, the ghost noticed that some fruit had started to rot. He didn't want anyone to get sick, so he threw the fruit away. He was happy that he could help keep everyone healthy.

The people who lived in the house were very happy to have such a helpful and intelligent ghost around. They knew that he would always be there to help them when they needed it. And the ghost was happy to have friends who appreciated him.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly elephant named Ellie. Ellie loved to play in the jungle with her friends. One day, Ellie's friend monkey requested her to play hide and seek. Ellie happily agreed and started counting while her friends hid.

Ellie searched for her friends everywhere, but she couldn't find them. Suddenly, she heard a giggle from behind a tree. It was her friend monkey who was hiding there. Ellie was so happy to find her friend and they continued playing together.

After a while, Ellie's tummy started to rumble. She requested her friends to join her for a snack. They all sat down and shared some delicious bananas. Ellie was grateful for her wonderful friends and their fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to wear his red vest every day. It was his favorite vest. He wore it to school, to the park and even to bed sometimes. Timmy's mom told him he needed to wear other clothes too, but Timmy liked his vest the best.

One day, Timmy's mom told him he needed to study for his test. Timmy didn't like studying, but he knew it was important. So, he put on his vest and sat down at his desk. He studied his regular words and his regular numbers. He studied for a long time, but he didn't give up.

When the day of the test came, Timmy felt nervous. But he remembered all the things he studied and he did really well! Timmy was so happy that he wore his red vest to celebrate. From that day on, Timmy knew that studying was important and he wore his vest proudly every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little seed. It lived on a shelf in a big garden. The seed was very playful and liked to roll around. One day, the seed felt something strange. It started to grow and grow until it turned into a beautiful flower. The flower bloomed with bright colors and made the garden very happy. The little seed was now a big, playful flower on the shelf. The end.

John and Jane were walking through the park. It was sunny, and the sky was a bright blue color. "It's so pretty!" Jane smiled. John nodded his head and smiled too. They could hear children laughing.

Jane looked around. "What color do you want to play with?" she asked. John thought for a second. "Green!" he said. He liked the way it felt safe and happy.

So they played with the green toy. John and Jane took turns pushing it, and they laughed. They played until it was time to go.

John smiled at Jane. "That was fun!" he said. Jane smiled back. "Yes it was," she said.

John grabbed Jane's hand and they started walking. They looked safe and happy, while the sky stayed a bright blue color.

Once there was a little boy called Sam. He was three years old and loved playing make believe. So one day, Sam wanted to pretend to go to an office. He got all dressed up in his best clothes and even brought his toy briefcase.

Sam's mummy was surprised when she saw him all dressed up. She asked him where he was going and he smiled and said he was going to the office!

So off Sam went, knocking on the door of the office. Inside was a weird-looking man. Sam nervously walked up to the man and asked if he could work at the office.

The weird-looking man laughed and said no, but he asked Sam if he wanted to call his mummy and tell her what he was doing. So Sam called his mummy and told her all about the office. She laughed and promised to come pick him up soon.

The weird-looking man said goodbye to Sam and said it was nice to meet him. Sam thanked the man and opened the door of the office, ready to go back home.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the water and splash around in the pool. One day, Timmy's mom gave him an amazing towel with his favorite superhero on it. Timmy loved his new towel and couldn't wait to use it.

When Timmy got out of the pool, he raised his arms up high and his mom wrapped the amazing towel around him. The towel was so soft and cozy that Timmy didn't want to take it off. He cuddled up in the towel and felt warm and happy.

From that day on, Timmy always used his amazing towel after swimming. He would raise his arms up high and his mom would wrap him up in the cozy towel. Timmy loved his towel and it made him feel safe and happy.

Lily and Ben are best friends. They like to play together in the park. One day, they find a big cake on a table. It looks yummy. They want to eat some.

"Who made this cake?" Lily asks.

"Maybe it is for a marriage," Ben says. "A marriage is when two people love each other and wear nice clothes."

"Can we have some cake too?" Lily says. "We love each other and we wear nice clothes."

Ben nods. He takes a plate and a knife. He cuts a piece of cake for Lily and one for himself. They sit on the grass and eat the cake. It is sweet and soft.

"Mmm, this is yummy," Lily says.

"Yes, it is," Ben says. "Do you want to marry me, Lily?"

Lily smiles. She takes Ben's hand. "Yes, I do, Ben. You are my best friend."

They hug and kiss. They are happy. They do not see the angry bride and groom who run to the table and see their cake is gone.

Jill and her dad were in the school. Jill was quite small, but she loved to learn new things.

Dad said, "Look Jill, this is the blackboard!"

Jill was excited and said, "What is this, dad?"

Dad replied, "This is a blackboard. We use it to gather important things to learn. You can use it too when you come to school."

Jill nodded and said, "Okay, I'll remember that."

Jill and her dad began writing on the board. After a few minutes, they had gathered all of the important things they needed to learn.

Jill smiled and said, "Wow, look how much we have gathered!"

Her dad smiled back and said, "That's right, remember it's very important to gather what you learn. You can use it to do many things."

Jill was happy and nodded her head. She knew that what she was gathering would be important for the rest of her life.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a pretty picture frame that he loved very much. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He played on the swings and the slide, but when it was time to go home, he realized he lost his frame.

Tim started to cry and his mom asked him what was wrong. Tim said, "I lost my frame, it was smooth and pretty." His mom hugged him and said, "Don't worry, we will look for it together."

Tim and his mom searched the park for the frame, but they couldn't find it. Just when Tim was about to give up, a kind lady found the frame and gave it back to him. Tim was so happy and thanked the lady. He hugged his frame tightly and said, "I'm so glad I didn't lose you forever."

Once upon a time there was a mall. It was full of people who were shopping and having fun. One of the shoppers was a little girl. She was very thoughtful.

The little girl liked to look at the flowers. She wanted to have a flower to take home. Then one day, she found a flower that was starting to bloom. She was so happy!

She carefully picked the flower and put it in her pocket. Then she went to the toy section and looked around. She chose a small toy for her brother as a surprise.

The little girl walked out of the mall with a smile on her face. She had a beautiful flower and a thoughtful gift for her brother. She was very happy that day.

Once upon a time, there was a big tank. The tank was green and had wheels. It could go very fast! The tank had a friend, a dog named Spot. Spot was very obedient and always listened to the tank.

One day, the tank and Spot went for a ride. They drove through the fields and over the hills. They saw cows and sheep, and even a big tree. The tank would wave at the animals and they would wave back.

As they were driving, they saw a little boy who was sad. The tank and Spot stopped to see what was wrong. The boy had lost his toy. Spot sniffed around and found the toy. The boy was so happy and waved goodbye to the tank and Spot as they drove away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. One day, Emma wanted to find an oyster. She asked her mom and dad, but they said no. Emma was determined, so she insisted. Her parents were nervous, but they let Emma go.

When Emma got to the beach, she looked everywhere. Finally, she saw it! An oyster was glistening in the sun. She excitedly shouted, "Mom, look! I found one!" But when she tried to pick it up, it wouldn't move.

Emma asked it, "Please come with me?" The oyster said nothing. Emma tried again and again, but the oyster didn't move. She kept insisting and eventually, the oyster agreed to come with her.

Emma was so happy and proud, and off she went, hand in hand with her oyster. The End.

One day, Sam went for a walk. But when he stepped outside, there was a thick fog. It was difficult to see anything. Sam waited and waited, but the fog didn't go away. It seemed to be delaying him from getting to his destination.

He started to worry that it was going to rain, so he turned around and went home. At home, his mom offered him a treat from the store. Poor Sam wanted to go to the store, but the fog was still there!

Sam's mom went to the store instead. When she came home, Sam was so excited to open the bag. This was the surprise! It was a brand new toy car. It was big, fancy and really expensive!

Sam was thrilled with his new toy car and he thanked his mom for going to the store in the fog. He began to play with it, and soon enough, the fog had gone away.

Everything was perfect! Sam was so glad that he wasn't delayed anymore.

One day in the woods, a curious otter spotted a mysterious object. He insisted that he had to get closer and have a look. So he crept closer, but he was careful to remain hidden.

Suddenly, the object started to move. It was a little girl! She looked around and saw the otter.

The Otter squeaked: "Hello!"

The girl smiled and said: "Hi, who are you?"

The Otter replied: "I'm an otter. What are you doing here?"

The girl replied: "I'm looking for something mysterious!"

The Otter said: "Maybe I can help you. I'm good at discovering mysterious things. What are you looking for?"

The girl replied: "I need to find my lost toy. I want it back!"

The Otter said: "Let's look for it together. I insist!"

The lovely little girl smiled and said: "OK, thank you!"

They both searched together until eventually, the little girl found her toy. She squealed with joy and thanked the Otter for his help.

The Otter smiled, happy that he could make her day. They waved goodbye and went their separate ways.

Once upon a time, there was a family. They had a lot of luggage. Every morning they would add more luggage to the pile. It was too much to carry, so they asked their friends to help.

The friends happily said yes, and they found a big truck to transport all the luggage. They added all the luggage to the truck, and it was still available. They drove off on their journey to their new home. Along the way, they saw a lot of beautiful things. Whenever something caught their eye, they would add it to the truck. Even though the truck was full of luggage, there was still room for more things.

Finally, they arrived at their new home. They unloaded all the luggage and available items. They placed them in their new home, and everyone was so happy.

The end.

James and his mum were walking along the path near the swamp. He kept looking around, taking everything in. His mum said, "Look at all of the amazing things this swamp has to show us!".

James spotted a fake snake hiding in the grass and he called out, "Mummy, look! A snake". His mum was surprised and said, "It's not real James, it's fake!".

After looking all around the swamp, they moved to the other side, and James kept searching. He found all kinds of things, like frogs and flowers, but what he liked the most were the big trees. He said, "Mummy, I want to keep looking!".

So, they kept exploring until the sun started to set. Then it was time to go home and James said, "Mummy, I will always keep the swamp's secret".

His mum smiled and said, "That's a great idea James!"

Sara loved animals. She liked to look at them, touch them, and talk to them. She had a cat, a dog, and a fish at home. But she wanted to see more animals. She wanted to see the animals at the zoo.

One day, her mom said, "Sara, we can go to the zoo tomorrow. But you have to promise me something. You have to promise me that you will not be nosy. You have to stay with me and not run away. Some animals can be scary or dangerous. Do you promise?"

Sara nodded and said, "I promise, mom. I will not be nosy. I will stay with you. I want to see the animals, but I do not want to be scared or hurt."

The next day, they went to the zoo. Sara was very happy. She saw lions, monkeys, elephants, and many other animals. She listened to her mom and did not run away. But she was very curious. She wanted to know more about the animals. She asked her mom many questions.

"Mom, why does the lion have a big mane? Mom, why does the monkey have a long tail? Mom, why does the elephant have a big trunk?"

Her mom smiled and answered her questions. She was glad that Sara was interested in the animals, but not nosy. She said, "Sara, you are a good girl. You kept your promise. You are not nosy, you are smart. I am proud of you."

Sara hugged her mom and said, "Thank you, mom. I love you. And I love the animals."

Angie was very sleepy. She was so sleepy that she wanted to take a shower.

When she got into the shower, the warm water made her feel better. After her shower, she went back to her bedroom.

Angie grabbed her favorite book and got into bed. She opened the book and started to read. The words helped her fall into a deep sleep.

When she woke up she felt refreshed. She felt happy and she wanted to read more.

Once upon a time, there was a bear who loved yummy things. He kept looking for something yummy but would never find anything. So he decided to climb a wall. As he climbed, he smelled something yummy. He went to the top and recognized a basket filled with cakes and cookies. He ate them all and was very happy.

But then something bad happened. The owner of the wall came out and saw the bear with the yummy things. The owner was very mad and chased after the bear. The bear ran away, but the owner quickly caught up to him. He was so mad that he put the bear in a cage.

The bear never recognized yummy things again. He was very sad. He had learned his lesson but it was too late.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the forest near her house. One day, she saw a big, green pine tree. It was so tall and beautiful. She wanted to climb it, but her mom reminded her that it was too dangerous.

Lily listened to her mom and decided to play with her toys instead. But as she played, she couldn't stop thinking about the pine tree. She wanted to climb it so badly. She decided to sneak out and climb the tree while her mom was cooking dinner.

As she climbed, she felt so happy and proud of herself. But suddenly, she slipped and fell from the tree. She hurt herself badly and had to go to the hospital. Her mom was so sad and worried.

The moral of the story is to always listen to your parents and not do dangerous things. Even if something seems fun, it's not worth getting hurt.

Once upon a time, there was a farm with two friendly cows. They were happy living on the farm with the farmer.

One day, the farmer went away for a few days. When he returned, he noticed one of the cows was very sad.

When he asked the cows what was wrong, the other cow was selfish and did not answer. But soon the sad cow began to tell the farmer what had happened.

The selfish cow had laughed at the sad cow, and said mean things. The selfish cow had been very naughty - it had not been very nice!

The farmer was very sad. He told the selfish cow that its behavior was wrong. Then he told them both to be kind to each other and not be selfish.

The cows listened, then started to laugh together. They were both happy again, and were good friends!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Shannon. She was three years old and was always curious about the world. She was visiting her uncle and aunt's house.

One day, Shannon asked her aunt if she could go to the station. Her aunt said yes, so Shannon put on her colorful coat and cap, and went out.

When Shannon reached the station, she was very excited to see lots of colorful trains. She wanted to get on one of them and explore.

Suddenly, an announcement came over the loudspeaker: "All passengers, please put your bag on the train before boarding."

Shannon smiled, and put her bag on the train. She was delighted to be going on her first train journey.

"Where is the train taking me?" Shannon asked her aunt.

"It's your surprise, Shannon." said her aunt. "Let's find out when we arrive".

Shannon smiled, and went on an adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy who loved to play with marbles. He had a big bag of marbles and he would play with them every day. One day, he went to the park to play with his marbles. He saw a little girl playing alone and he asked her if she wanted to play with him.

The little girl said, "Yes, please!" Timmy was happy and gave her some marbles to play with. They played together for a while, but then the little girl started to cheat. She would mark her marbles with a pen so she could win. Timmy saw this and said, "That's not fair! You can't mark your marbles!"

The little girl felt bad and said, "I'm sorry. I just really wanted to win." Timmy forgave her and said, "It's okay. Let's just play fair and have fun." The little girl smiled and said, "Okay, I'll be obedient and play fair." From that day on, they played together every day and had lots of fun with their marbles.

Once upon a time there was a brave knight who liked to ride his horse. Every week he would ride around the kingdom looking for adventure. He always carried his big sword and was very brave.

One day the knight saw a funny-looking creature in the forest. The creature made silly noises and was very small. The knight said, “What are you doing here?” The creature said, “I just want to play.”

The knight smiled and said, “Let’s go for a ride.” The knight and the creature hopped on his horse and rode around the kingdom. The knight showed the creature all the different animals and plants. They stopped to have a snack of apples and he showed the creature how to sharpen his sword.

The knight explained that everyone should help each other because friendship is more important than swords. The creature smiled and the knight said goodbye and rode away.

The moral of the story is that friendship is more important than swords and that we should always look for fun things to do with our friends and help each other.

Once upon a time, there was an unknown structure. It was very large and lots of people suffered whenever they were near it. Everyone was scared and tried to stay away.

One day, a brave little girl decided to see what it was all about. She went up to the structure and noticed that it was made of many tiny pieces. She decided to try and fix it.

The little girl worked hard for days and weeks and eventually managed to fix the unknown structure so that it looked beautiful. Everyone was so happy and proud of the little girl for helping them.

Their suffering was over thanks to the brave little girl, and everyone was forever thankful for her help.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man who lived in a little house in the forest. Every day, the bald man would go outside and march all around the forest. Everyone thought nothing of it, until one day they noticed smoke in the sky.

The bald man kept marching, but then one day the sky turned black and the smoke kept rising. Everyone was scared and tried to stop the bald man, but he kept marching through the forest.

Finally he marched up a giant hill and when he reached the top, he stopped and looked around. Everyone was worried, but then a huge waterfall came out of the sky and drenched them all. The smoke cleared away and everyone cheered!

The bald man had marched up the hill to save the forest from the smoke. He was a hero! From then on, the bald man and his march were celebrated by the villagers.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Teddy and Lily. They liked playing together.

Today, the two friends wanted to play a game. They had to choose what to do.

Lily said: "Let's try a hide and seek today. It will be fun!"

But Teddy wasn't so sure. He replied: "No, I'm feeling a bit sleepy today. Maybe another day."

Lily thought for a moment then suggested: "How about a colouring game? We can draw and colour in the day!"

Teddy smiled. He liked the idea. "Ok, let's go!" he said.

So off they went and had lots of fun colouring in the day. Teddy was no longer sleepy. When they finished, Lily laughed and said: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"

Teddy agreed and the two friends smiled, excited for the next game they would choose.

Mum and Sam wanted to go for a drive. Sam loved going in the car, but first he had to have a walk. Sam put on his shoes and went outside with Mum. He walked all the way to the car and Mum lifted him up to put him in his seat.

Sam was excited as Mum turned the key and the car came to life. They drove down the road and went around the corner. Sam saw lots of houses and trees outside his window.

The car stopped at the store. Mum and Sam went inside and Sam saw lots of colourful things. He saw a big green box of apples, they looked so juicy and sweet. But Mum said they should get the sour lemons instead.

Mum and Sam made sure they had all the things they needed and got back in the car. Finally, they drove back home and Sam excitedly ran out of the car and into the house.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Tom and he was three years old. Tom lived on a big open ranch with his family. One day he went out to the ranch to explore. He saw cows, horses, sheep, and a big red barn.

Tom was getting tired so he decided to take a nap under the big tree in the middle of the ranch. He closed his eyes and drifted off to sleep.

Suddenly, Tom heard his mom calling out for him. He opened his eyes and rubbed them.

"Tom, time to eat," his mom said.

Tom said, "Okay, Mommy," and jumped up. He ran back to the house feeling happy, ready to enjoy a nice meal.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play in the park. One day, she found a secret treasure hidden under a delicate flower. She was so happy and excited!

When she got home, her mommy told her it was time to bathe before dinner. Lily didn't want to take a bath because she wanted to keep her secret treasure safe. But her mommy promised to keep it safe while she bathed.

After her bath, Lily felt clean and fresh. She ran to her room to check on her secret treasure. It was still there, safe and sound. She hugged it tightly and smiled. It was the best day ever!

One day Sally was playing with her blocks when something happened. One of the blocks broke! Sally was so sad, but her daddy told her he could repair the block. He knew how to do fix things because he was smart.

He asked Sally to find the broken part and then he said, “Let me try to fix it, okay?”

But Sally didn’t want her daddy to fix it, because she wanted to do it herself. She shouted. “No, I can fix it!”

Her daddy said, “Okay then, let’s see if you can do it.” He showed Sally how the broken parts fit back together, then he said, “Let's see you try.”

Sally looked at the blocks and thought really hard. She tried and tried to put the blocks together, and finally she did it!

Her daddy smiled and said, “See, you can do it. You’re so smart!”

Sally smiled back and was happy because she fixed her block. She hugged her daddy and said, “Let’s go play now!”

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He was always playing outside and running around. One day, Timmy saw a big tree outside. He couldn't climb it, but he wanted to see the ceiling of the sky. So he ran as fast as he could, trying to reach the top.

But no matter how hard he tried, the tree was too tall and he couldn't get to the ceiling. He was so sad and was about to give up. Suddenly, he heard a voice beside him.

It was his mom. She said: "You won't be able to get to the ceiling by yourself. If you want to reach the top of the tree, you need help from a strong friend".

Timmy looked around and saw his best friend. His friend smiled and said "Yeah, let's rush for the top together". So they held hands and started climbing the tall tree.

Finally, they reached the top. It was a rewarding feeling for both of them. They looked up at the ceiling of the sky, feeling happy and fulfilled.

The moral of this story is that if we work together, we can reach the highest of goals. Working together makes us strong.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty girl named Lily. She had a cell phone that she loved to play with. One day, she went to the park and met a little boy named Timmy. Timmy saw Lily's cell phone and said, "Can I play with it, please?" Lily said, "Sure, you can play with it for a little bit."

After a while, Timmy said, "Can I keep playing with it?" Lily thought for a moment and then said, "I'm sorry, but I need my phone back now." Timmy said, "Okay, thank you for letting me play with it!"

Lily smiled and said, "You're welcome. And if you ever want to play with it again, just request it and I'll let you!" Timmy smiled and said, "Okay, I will!" And they both went on to play together in the park.

Anna and Ben are friends who live next door to each other. They like to play together in their yards and sometimes they write notes to each other and put them in their mailboxes. One day, Anna has a new idea. She wants to make a surprise for Ben and put it in his mailbox. She finds some stickers, a crayon and a piece of paper and makes a card that says "You are my best friend".

She runs to Ben's mailbox and opens it. But she sees that there is already something inside. It is a big envelope with a red stamp and a lot of words. Anna does not know what it is, but she thinks it looks important. She does not want to take it out or move it. She tries to fit her card in the mailbox, but it is too small. She is frustrated. She wants to give Ben her surprise, but she does not want to mess up his mail.

She hears Ben coming out of his house. She hides behind a bush and waits. Ben sees his mailbox and goes to check it. He opens it and takes out the big envelope. He looks at it and smiles. He says, "Wow, this is from my grandma. She lives far away and she sent me a present. I wonder what it is." He opens the envelope and pulls out a book. He says, "Cool, it is a book about dinosaurs. I love dinosaurs. Thank you, grandma."

He puts the book under his arm and looks in the mailbox again. He sees Anna's card. He says, "Hey, what is this?" He takes it out and reads it. He says, "Aww, this is from Anna. She says I am her best friend. That is so nice of her. I wonder where she is." He looks around and sees Anna peeking from behind the bush. He says, "Anna, come here. I have something for you."

Anna comes out of the bush and runs to Ben. She says, "Hi, Ben. I made you a card. I wanted to surprise you, but your mailbox was full. I hope you like it." Ben says, "I love it, Anna. You are my best friend too. And I have something for you too. Look, my grandma sent me a book about dinosaurs. Do you want to read it with me?" Anna says, "Yes, please. I like dinosaurs too. Thank you, Ben." Ben says, "You are welcome, Anna. Come on, let's go to my yard and read it together." They hold hands and walk to Ben's yard. They are happy. They have mail, they have books, and they have each other.

Jack was scared. He took a step and turned around. He was afraid of the dark. He closed his eyes and took another step. When he opened his eyes, he saw a light. He was so happy he took another step. He took four more steps until he reached the light. When he looked around he saw a switch. He was so brave, he reached up and turned it on! All the darkness disappeared and Jack was no longer scared. He knew that he had been brave and he was very proud.

The river was flowing underneath the bridge. The shore was near the bridge. It was an amazing sight to see. Max looked around the shore and could see a lot of boats.

One of them was his Dad's boat. It was blue and shiny. Max wanted to join him but he couldn't reach. Suddenly, his Dad started to reverse the boat. The motor was making noise and Max was getting closer and closer to the shore.

Max was happily jumping when he finally reached the shore. He waved goodbye to his Dad and started to explore the shore. It was amazing! He could see a lot of fish and sand crabs by the water. He had a wonderful time.

Once upon a time, there was a wide carrot. The carrot wanted to test how far it could go so it began to roll. It rolled and rolled over the hills, across the fields and through the woods.

The carrot finally came to a big lake. It looked so wide, the carrot wasn't sure it could make it across. So, the carrot decided to test how deep it was. It slowly rolled into the lake and suddenly stopped! It was so deep, it couldn't go any farther.

The carrot was sad it couldn't see the other side of the lake and test how far it could go. But then something wonderful happened. A friendly car came along and offered to take the carrot across the lake.The car drove across the lake and the carrot continued to roll until it reached the other side.

The wide carrot was so happy to have tested its limits and seen the other side of the lake!

Once upon a time, there was a purple gun. The gun was very scary! One day, a little girl saw the gun and shouted, "Oh no! It's so scary!" She ran away as fast as she could.

The gun did not move. It just sat there, all purple and shiny. Then, the girl's mommy came and picked it up. She smiled and said, "Don't worry. This gun won't scare you anymore."

The girl was happy again. Her mommy promised to keep the purple gun in a safe place. She would never let it scare the little girl again.

The End

George woke up feeling very hungry. He decided he wanted a nut so he looked around the kitchen to find one. He opened a cupboard and saw a jar full of nuts. He took a handful and wanted to eat them.

Suddenly he felt something strange on one of the nuts. He looked closer and saw it was a dead bug. He decided he didn't want to eat that nut anymore, so he put it aside.

He was happy when he found some nice, clean, un-buggy nuts. He grabbed a few of them and sat in his chair to eat them. They were so yummy and he felt much better after eating them.

George was very happy with his decision and he felt satisfied. He went back to the kitchen and put away the jar of nuts for another day.

Once upon a time, there was a family that wanted something new. They were looking for something special to make their house brighter. One day, they went out and found a piano. It was big and shiny, and it had all the keys for music.

The family was very happy and brought the new piano home with them. They put it in the living room, so everyone could enjoy the music it made.

They soon realized that none of them knew how to play the piano. So they decided to ask their neighbors for help.

The neighbors were very kind and provided the family with a teacher. The teacher taught the family how to play, and they all started to learn the notes and songs.

Soon the house was filled with beautiful music every day. The family was very thankful for the new piano and all the joy and peace it provided them.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a diary. He wrote in it every day. One day, Tim wrote about a terrible storm. It was very loud and scary.

The next day, Tim saw a big red car outside his house. It was shiny and new. Tim wanted to see the car go fast. He asked his mom if he could watch the car zoom down the street. His mom said yes, but only if he held her hand.

Tim and his mom stood by the street. They watched the big red car zoom by. It went so fast that it made Tim's hair blow. Tim laughed and clapped his hands. He couldn't wait to write about the zooming car in his diary.

Max was walking in the market with his mom. Everywhere he looked there were new and exciting things. He felt a bit dizzy from all the exciting sights. Then, he spotted something he recognized from home! It was his favorite toy. He eagerly pointed out the toy to his mom. She couldn't believe it either. She picked it up and smiled. He was so happy he had recognized it. He thanked his mom for the toy and held it tight. He knew this new toy would bring him lots of joy!

Once upon a time there was a chubby bunny. She was out hopping around in the woods. As she hopped, she stopped to admire a beautiful leather jacket on a bush. She decided to mention it to her friends.

"Oh, look at this!" she said. "I wonder who it belongs to?"

Just then, a little fox appeared. "That's mine," he said proudly. "It was made of the finest leather, and I must mention that I look quite dashing in it!"

The bunny was amazed. She had never seen someone look so handsome wearing a leather jacket before. She thanked the fox for letting her see it.

The fox smiled and said, "You're welcome. Now, I must be off!"

He hopped off into the woods, and the bunny looked after him with admiration. She had learned about the amazing leather material and how someone could look so dapper wearing it.

The bunny hopped off back to her friends, ready to mention what she had seen.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her garden. One day, she saw some green beans growing on a plant. She picked them and put them in a basket. She wanted to gather more beans to eat for dinner.

But the beans were dirty and she needed to clean them first. So, she took them inside and washed them with water. After they were clean, she put them in a pot to cook.

When dinner was ready, Lily's family ate the beans and they were delicious. Lily was happy that she could gather and clean the beans all by herself. From that day on, she always looked for beans in her garden to gather and clean for her family to eat.

Once upon a time, there was a kind lady. She was walking in the countryside when she heard an unusual noise. She stopped and listened carefully. The noise was coming from a cornfield.

The kind lady decided to explore the source of the noise in the cornfield. She walked through the tall stalks of corn and discovered a little girl. The little girl was crying and was very scared.

The kind lady asked the little girl what was wrong. The little girl said she had gotten lost while walking with her family to the nearby town.

The kind lady listened very carefully to the little girl and said," I will help you find your family. They must be very worried." The little girl was so relieved. The kind lady and the little girl walked to the town together, and soon the family was reunited.

The family was so happy and grateful to the kind lady. They thanked her endlessly and offered her a big bag of corn as a sign of their appreciation. The kind lady smiled and accepted their generous gift.

And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big band. The band had many instruments like drums, guitars, and trumpets. They loved to play music and make people happy.

One day, the band wanted to play a concert in a big park. They set up their instruments and started to play. But then, they saw a big bee buzzing around them. The bee was very angry and started to zoom around the band.

The band tried to keep playing, but the bee was too loud and distracting. They didn't know what to do. Suddenly, a little girl came up to them and said, "I know how to help!" She had a big jar and caught the bee inside. The band was so happy and grateful that they played a special song just for the little girl. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a doughyman who was very adventurous. He liked to explore the world and try new things.

One day, doughyman invited a friend to join him in his adventures. At first his friend was scared, but doughyman insisted. He said, “Come on! It will be fun! You’ll see!”

So his friend joined him and they had a wonderful time. They went on exciting journeys, tried new foods, and met all kinds of people. Doughyman was so happy that his friend enjoyed it too.

From then on, whenever doughyman wanted to go on a new adventure, he would always insist that his friend join him. And his friend would always agree, because it was always so much fun!

Once there was a mom and her baby. Baby wanted something special to keep her warm and cozy. So Mommy bought her a strong sweater. It was very soft and it kept Baby warm and happy.

During the day, Baby played and sang, but when night-time came, Baby got tired and put on her strong sweater. She snuggled into bed and fell asleep.

In the morning Baby woke up and took her sweater off. She was so excited to play because the sun was out and shining. She ran outside and laughed, feeling so happy and strong with her sweater on.

Every night before Baby went to sleep, she put on her strong sweater. It kept her warm and cozy. And soon enough, Baby fell asleep, dreaming sweet dreams.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty bird named Blue. Blue loved to soar high in the sky. Every day, he would fly up, up, up, and look down at the trees and houses.

One day, Blue found a tight little nest. In the nest, there was a small note. The note had a picture of a happy face on it. Blue liked the note and wanted to find out who made it.

Blue showed the note to all his friends. He asked the cat, the dog, and the fish. No one knew who made the note. Then, Blue met a little girl named Lily. Lily said she made the note for her friend. Blue was happy to find Lily and give her the note back. Lily and Blue became good friends and played together every day.

Once there was a little girl named Lily who loved to run. She would run all around her house and yard, giggling and laughing as she went. One day, her mom brought home a new scale to weigh themselves on. Lily was curious and wanted to see how much she weighed, but her mom told her she was too little to use the scale.

Lily was disappointed, but she didn't give up. She kept running and playing, hoping one day she would be big enough to use the scale. One day, she woke up feeling terrible. Her head hurt and her tummy felt funny. She didn't feel like running or playing at all.

Her mom took her to the doctor, who said she had a bad cold. The doctor gave her some medicine and told her to rest. Lily was sad she couldn't run or play, but she knew she needed to get better. After a few days of rest, Lily felt much better. Her mom let her use the scale, and she was so happy to see she had grown a little bit. From then on, Lily knew that taking care of herself was just as important as running and playing.

Molly was playing in the park with her friends. She loved to run around with them and there was always something exciting to do. But this time she noticed something unusual on the ground. It was a filthy toe! Molly was a bit scared and so she asked her friends, "What is this?"

Her friends just laughed and said, "It's a toe, silly!"

Molly wasn't sure what to do, so she asked them again, "But why is it so filthy?"

They all replied, "It must have been there for a while. Maybe someone lost it!"

Molly thought about it for a minute and then an idea came to her. She smiled and said, "Let's make it into a necklace!"

Her friends all thought it was a great idea and began to clean the toe. Once they were done, they proudly wore the necklace around their necks.

Molly was so pleased with her new necklace. With a beaming smile, she declared, "My toes are better now than before!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to go on walks with his mommy and daddy. One day, they went to a park with a big hill. Timmy climbed to the top of the hill and saw a beautiful view of the town. He said, "Wow! Look at the pretty view!"

Suddenly, a nice lady came up to Timmy's family and offered them some cookies. Timmy's mommy said, "Thank you for the offer, but we already had lunch." The lady smiled and said, "That's normal. Have a nice day!"

Timmy and his family continued their walk, enjoying the view and the fresh air. Timmy felt happy and grateful for his family and the kind lady's offer. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby cat named Tom. Tom loved to play outside with his ball. One day, he saw the big, round moon in the sky and wanted to grab it.

Tom jumped and jumped, trying to grab the moon. But it was too high for him. He felt sad and sat down. Then, a little girl named Sue came to play with Tom. She saw him looking at the moon.

Sue had an idea. She ran inside and came back with a long stick. Together, they tried to grab the moon with the stick. They laughed and played, pretending to touch the moon. Even though they couldn't really grab the moon, they had fun trying. And Tom was happy again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who had a furry comb. She liked to play with it in the sun and it always made her smile. She called it her "Sunny Comb" because it made her so happy.

One day, she was playing in the garden with her Sunny Comb when suddenly it began to grow! Its long, furry bristles were getting longer and longer, until eventually it was almost as big as she was. She was so amazed and excited and ran over to show her mom.

But when her mom saw the giant comb she got angry. "What have you done? You need to put this comb away in the drawer where it belongs!"

The little girl started to cry. She was so sad that she couldn't keep her Sunny Comb. All she wanted was to play with it in the sun. Her mom saw how sad she was and told her something important.

"You can keep your comb as long as you take care of it. You have to treat it nicely, brush it softly and it will keep growing and be your special friend forever."

The little girl smiled and hugged her mom. She was so happy and she knew that taking good care of her Sunny Comb was the best thing she could do.

One day Jack and Jill went on an adventure down to the sea. It was a sunny day, and Jack and Jill were so excited for what might be at the end.

When they arrived, they were amazed at all the sights and sounds. The waves crashed against the shore and the seagulls chirped in the sky. As they looked out, the horizon seemed to never end.

Jack and Jill decided to stay and explore some more. They built sand castles, played in the waves, and laughed in the sun until the day was almost over. As the sun started to set, they decided to have one last look at the sea.

Just then, something miraculous happened! A rainbow appeared in the sky and the sea glittered with all its amazing colors. Both Jack and Jill were in awe.

The rainbow eventually faded, but the memory of that amazing moment in time was a treasure that Jack and Jill would never forget.

Lily liked to help her mom in the kitchen. She wanted to serve breakfast to her dad and her brother. She put bread in the toaster and waited for it to pop. She got a knife and a plate.

"Can I put butter on the toast, mom?" she asked.

"Sure, honey, but be careful with the knife. It can cut you," mom said.

Lily nodded and took the butter from the fridge. She opened it and tried to cut a slice. But the butter was too hard and the knife slipped. Lily felt a sharp pain in her finger. She dropped the knife and the butter and started to cry.

"Ow, ow, ow! Mom, I hurt myself!" she sobbed.

Mom ran to her and hugged her. She looked at her finger and saw a small cut. She took a napkin and wrapped it around her finger.

"It's okay, Lily. It's just a little cut. You're very brave. Let me get you a band-aid," mom said.

She went to the bathroom and came back with a band-aid. She put it on Lily's finger and kissed it.

"There, all better. You're a big girl, Lily. You can still serve breakfast to dad and brother. Do you want to try again?" mom asked.

Lily sniffed and nodded. She wiped her tears and smiled.

"Yes, mom. I want to try again. I can do it," she said.

She picked up the knife and the butter and went to the toaster. She saw that the toast had popped. She took one and put it on the plate. She carefully cut a slice of butter and spread it on the toast. She did the same with the other toast. She was very proud of herself.

"Look, mom. I did it. I made toast with butter," she said.

Mom smiled and clapped her hands.

"Good job, Lily. You did it. You're very brave and helpful. Let's go serve breakfast to dad and brother. They will love your toast with butter," mom said.

They took the plate and went to the dining room. Dad and brother were waiting for them. They saw the toast with butter and smiled.

"Wow, Lily. Did you make this? It looks delicious," dad said.

"Yes, dad. I made it. I put butter on the toast. Do you want some?" Lily asked.

"Yes, please. Thank you, Lily. You're very kind," dad said.

He took a toast and bit it. He made a yummy sound.

"Mmm, this is very good. You're a great cook, Lily," he said.

Lily beamed and gave him a hug.

"Thank you, dad. I love you," she said.

She gave the other toast to her brother.

"Here, brother. This is for you. I made it. I put butter on the toast. Do you like it?" Lily asked.

"Thank you, Lily. I like it. You're very nice," brother said.

He took the toast and ate it. He made a yummy sound too.

"Mmm, this is very good. You're a wonderful sister, Lily," he said.

Lily smiled and hugged him.

"Thank you, brother. I love you too," she said.

Mom watched them and felt very happy. She was proud of her brave and helpful daughter. She joined them and they ate breakfast together. They all enjoyed the toast with butter that Lily had made. It was a good morning.

Once upon a time there was a big family who lived in a big house. One day the little boy wanted to play outside so his mummy said 'OK'. She warned him to stay away from the naughty square, but the little boy wasn't listening. He was too busy running and playing.

The naughty square was a wild place. All sorts of animals lived there, but the little boy wanted to explore. He saw a rabbit and tried to catch it, but it hopped away just in time.

Suddenly, the little boy heard a loud noise from the naughty square. He ran to see what it was, and there he found his daddy had been punished. His mummy was very angry, and said 'you should have listened!'. But the little boy was too scared to say anything.

The little boy learned an important lesson that day: never go to the naughty square again. He promised himself he would never disobey his mummy's instructions again. He kept this promise, never again entering the naughty square and living happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy dog named Max. Max loved to play in the park with his owner, a little girl named Lily. One day, while they were playing, Lily heard some music. "What's that sound?" she asked Max.

Max barked and ran towards the music. When they got closer, Lily saw a man playing a big shiny instrument. "That's jazz music," said the man. "Do you like it?"

Lily nodded and smiled. "Can we change our game and dance to the music?" she asked Max.

Max barked happily and wagged his tail. They danced and played to the jazz music until the sun went down. From that day on, whenever they heard jazz music in the park, Lily and Max would stop and dance together.

Once there was a little girl named Amy. She was three years old. One day, while Amy was playing in the garden, she noticed a fierce goose. The goose was making some noise and was looking at Amy. Amy was scared but she slowly moved closer to the goose. Suddenly the goose flew right up to Amy and gave her a big hug! Amy was surprised, but soon she was very happy to receive the goose.

Amy and the goose spent the rest of the day playing together in the garden. They went chasing after each other and became very good friends. Amy loved her new goose and was always very happy when it was around.

From then on, Amy and the goose were always together. Whenever Amy was sad or scared, the fierce goose would come and comfort her. It was so wonderful to receive the goose's love and friendship. It was exactly what Amy had been hoping for.

Lily and Max were playing in the park with their toys. They liked to pretend they were explorers, looking for new things. They saw a big hill with a lot of trees and bushes. They decided to climb it and see what was on the other side.

"Maybe we will find a treasure or a castle," Lily said.

"Or a dragon or a dinosaur," Max said.

They held hands and walked up the hill. They heard a loud noise from behind the trees. It sounded like a roar.

"What was that?" Lily asked.

"I don't know. Let's go and see," Max said.

They were brave and curious. They pushed the branches aside and peeked through. They saw a big animal with fur and claws and teeth. It was a lion. But next to the lion, there was something else. It was a baby. A baby lion.

The baby lion saw Lily and Max and made a small roar. It wanted to play with them. The big lion saw them too and made a big roar. It wanted to protect the baby.

Lily and Max were scared and amazed. They had never seen a lion before, let alone a baby lion. They wondered how they got there and why they were hiding behind the trees. It was a mysterious thing.

"Hello, lion. Hello, baby lion," Lily said softly.

"Roar, roar," the baby lion said.

"Roar, roar," the big lion said.

Lily and Max smiled and waved. They wanted to be friends with the lions. But they also knew they had to be careful and respectful. They backed away slowly and went back to their toys.

They had a lot to tell their parents and friends. They had found a treasure and a castle and a dragon and a dinosaur. They had found a lion and a baby lion. They had found a mystery and an adventure. They had found a story.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was being tucked into bed by her mom. Every night, the mom would show her a sweet hug and kiss before she said good night and turned off the light.

One night, the little girl couldn't sleep. She was having a nightmare, and it was making her scared. Her mom came in to check on her and noticed that she was shaking and didn't feel very warm.

So, Mom got in bed with the little girl and showed her a hug that made the little girl feel safe. She started to feel warm and the nightmare went away. Eventually, the little girl drifted off to sleep, feeling secure and warm all night long.

Lily and Tom were playing in the garden. They saw a big bird with a red head and a yellow beak. It was a hen. The hen had a nest with many eggs. Lily and Tom wanted to see the eggs.

They went near the nest and looked at the eggs. They were white and smooth. Lily touched one egg with her finger. It was warm. Tom wanted to touch one too. He reached for an egg, but the hen saw him. The hen was angry. She did not want Lily and Tom to touch her eggs. She pecked at Tom's hand. Tom cried out. He pulled his hand back. The hen had pinched him.

Lily and Tom ran away from the nest. They were scared and hurt. They did not understand why the hen was so mean. They were confused. They went to their mom and told her what happened. Mom hugged them and gave them a band-aid for Tom's hand. She explained that the hen was protecting her eggs. She said that the eggs were her babies and she loved them very much. She said that Lily and Tom should not touch the eggs or bother the hen. She said that they should be kind and gentle to all animals.

Lily and Tom nodded. They said they were sorry. They learned their lesson. They decided to play with their own toys instead. They left the hen and her eggs alone. They were happy and safe. The hen was happy and safe too. The end.

Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow, there lived a fast little kitten. Each day, the kitten would run around the meadow, chasing after butterflies.

One day, she heard something strange coming from the trees. She stopped to listen and heard a strange sound repeating over and over again. It sounded like, "meow, meow". So, the kitten slowly walked closer, and saw a tiny, little kitten meowing. It was so little and scared, so the fast kitten went up to it and said, "meow".

The little kitten stopped meowing and looked up happily at her new friend. It then said, "meow" again and jumped up to give the fast kitten a big hug. The fast kitten was so happy that she said, "meow" back and started to cuddle and play with the little one.

They both continued to play and repeat, "meow". They could not stop and became the best of friends for life.

Ben liked to study the stars. He had a big equipment that helped him see them better. It was a telescope. He got it from his dad for his birthday. He put it in his room near the window.

One night, he heard a noise outside. He looked out and saw a big light in the sky. It was not a star. It was something else. He grabbed his telescope and ran to the backyard. He wanted to study the light.

He set up his equipment and looked through it. He saw a round thing with windows and lights. It was a spaceship. He was amazed. He wondered who was inside.

"Hello, little one," a voice said. Ben turned around and saw a small green creature. It had big eyes and a long tail. It was holding a device that looked like a phone. It was talking to him.

"Who are you?" Ben asked.

"I am Zee. I come from another planet. I am here to study your world. And you are?" the creature said.

"I am Ben. I like to study the stars. And this is my equipment. It is a telescope. It helps me see them better," Ben said.

"That is very interesting. Can I see?" Zee said.

"Sure. Come here. I will show you," Ben said.

Ben and Zee became friends. They studied the stars together. They also played with Ben's toys and books. Zee was very playful and curious. He liked to learn new things.

Ben's dad came home and saw them. He was surprised and scared. He did not know what to do.

"Ben, who is this?" he asked.

"Dad, this is Zee. He is from another planet. He is here to study our world. And he is my friend," Ben said.

"Hello, sir. I mean no harm. I am just visiting. I will leave soon. But I wanted to meet your son. He is very smart and kind," Zee said.

Ben's dad was speechless. He did not know what to say. He looked at the spaceship, the telescope, and the green creature. He wondered if he was dreaming. He decided to sit down and listen to their story. He hoped they would not get in trouble. He also hoped they would have fun.

Once there was a girl who was walking in the woods. All of a sudden she heard a loud noise. She was so scared that her body began to tremble. She looked around and saw a big, black bear! The bear was huge and the girl knew she needed to get away fast. She turned and ran away as fast as she could. The bear followed her and when she felt it was getting closer, she ran even faster! She kept running until she was out of the woods and safe. Even back at home, her body trembled from fear. But soon the fear went away and she was happy to be safe again.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys. They have a big box of gems. The gems are shiny and pretty. They have red, blue, green, and yellow gems.

One night, Sara and Ben are getting ready for sleep. They brush their teeth and put on their pajamas. They each pick a gem to keep by their bed. Sara picks a red gem and Ben picks a blue gem. They say good night to their mom and dad and go to their room.

But Ben is not happy. He wants the red gem, not the blue gem. He thinks the red gem is more shiny and pretty. He waits until Sara is asleep. Then he sneaks to her bed and takes the red gem. He puts the blue gem in its place. He goes back to his bed and smiles. He hugs the red gem and falls asleep.

In the morning, Sara wakes up and sees the blue gem by her bed. She is upset. She knows Ben took her red gem. She runs to his bed and sees the red gem in his arms. She tries to take it back, but Ben wakes up and holds it tight.

"Give me back my red gem!" Sara says.

"No, it's mine now!" Ben says.

They start to fight over the gem. They pull and tug and yell. Their mom and dad hear the noise and come to their room. They see Sara and Ben fighting over the gem.

"What's going on here?" their mom says.

"Ben took my red gem!" Sara says.

"No, I didn't! I found it!" Ben says.

Their dad picks up the gem and looks at it. He sees a small sticker on it. The sticker has a letter S on it.

"This is Sara's gem," he says. "It has her initial on it. Ben, you should not take things that are not yours. That's not nice."

Ben feels bad. He knows he did something wrong. He gives the red gem back to Sara. He says he is sorry.

Sara feels happy. She gets her red gem back. She says she forgives Ben. She gives him a hug.

Their mom and dad smile. They tell Sara and Ben to share their gems and play nicely. They give them each a kiss and a hug. They say they love them.

Sara and Ben say they love them too. They put their gems back in the box. They decide to play with them together. They are not upset anymore. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a rag doll that she loved very much. The rag doll was her best friend and they did everything together.

One day, Lily was feeling sad and her rag doll was feeling sad too. But then, Lily had an idea! She decided to make her rag doll a cheerful dress. She got some colorful fabric and sewed a beautiful dress for her rag doll.

When her rag doll put on the cheerful dress, something magical happened. The rag doll became cheerful too! Lily was so happy that her rag doll was happy again. From that day on, they were both cheerful and they played happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a wealthy man who had a basket. He wanted to make people happy, so he decided to give the basket away. He walked around town and gave it to everyone he met. The basket was filled with nice things.

When the wealthy man gave the basket to a little girl, she was so happy! She thanked him and ran to show it to her friends. Everyone was so excited they decided to throw a party to celebrate.

At the party, the little girl shared her basket with her friends. Everyone had a great time. There was lots of food, games and singing.

When it was time to go, the little girl said good-bye to the wealthy man. She thanked him again and thanked him for making everyone so happy with the gift of his basket.

Mum was very serious. She asked the 3 year old to go and do a test. She was excited, but a bit scared at the same time.

The 3 year old went to another room. It was full of dolls, puzzles, and books. There were also lots of pens and paper.

The test was hard, but the 3 year old tried her best. She kept on trying and eventually finished the test.

Mum was very happy and excited to hear the news. She hugged the 3 year old and said: "Great job! You did really well."

The 3 year old was happy too and felt excited. She knew she had done her best and was proud of herself.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to wear an apron. It was her favorite, and it was very expensive.

Every day, the little girl liked to wear her apron while she played. She would twirl and twirl, always in her favorite dress and special apron.

One day the apron came off while she was spinning. The little girl was so sad. But then, a magical hug made it all better. Her mom and dad pulled her close and hugged her tightly. The little girl knew she felt loved and special.

The mom and dad took the apron and sewed it back together. When the little girl opened it up, she gasped in amazement. It was as good as new and even shinnier than before.

The little girl loved wearing her apron again and thanked her parents for the magical hug. She felt so happy and twirled around and around in her amazing, expensive apron.

Maggie was a very smart and brave girl. She wanted to help her friends, so she decided to go on an adventure. She put on her watch and smiled, she was ready to go.

Suddenly, a big truck pulled up and the door opened. The driver said, “Are you Maggie? I’ve come to deliver something to you.”

Maggie nodded and the driver handed her a big box. He said, “This is for you.” Maggie thanked him and quickly opened the box. Inside, she saw a magical wand. She smiled and thanked him again.

The driver smiled back. “Don’t worry,” he said. “You’re very intelligent. I know you can make good use of it.”

Maggie took the wand and began her journey. She was determined to be brave and use her wand to help her friends. With her smarts and courage, Maggie was sure she could deliver the help they needed.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Coco. She loved to hop and play in the forest. One day, she found a furry twig on the ground. Coco thought it was pretty and wanted to keep it.

But then, a big bad wolf appeared! He wanted to take the twig from Coco. She was scared and didn't know what to do. But then, she remembered her mommy's words: "If you ever feel scared, trust your instincts and run away!"

So Coco trusted herself and ran as fast as she could. She didn't look back until she was safe in her cozy burrow. The wolf didn't catch her and she still had her furry twig. Coco felt happy and proud of herself for being brave.

Mary was playing in the park. Suddenly, she saw a red man. She was a little scared at first, but then the man said "Welcome!" with a friendly smile.

Mary was now curious. She slowly walked towards the man and he said "Hello, my name is Mark. Would you like to play?"

Mary was so excited! She said "Yes!", so they started playing tag. Whenever Mary caught up to Mark, he would laugh and call out "Welcome, Mary!"

After playing, they both sat down to catch their breath. Mary looked up and saw the clouds in the sky turning red. She said "Look, the sky is like you!"

Mark was happy and smiled and said "Yes, Mary! Welcome to the red sky!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and get dirty. He would run around in the mud and grass all day long. But when it was time for dinner, his parent would say, "Timmy, it's time to bathe!"

Timmy didn't like to take a bath at first, but then he realized how nice it felt to be clean. His parent would use soap and warm water to wash away all the dirt and grime from his skin. Timmy loved the feeling of the water running over him.

After his bath, Timmy's parent would wrap him up in a nice warm towel and give him a big hug. Timmy felt so loved and cared for by his parent. He knew that taking a bath was important to stay clean and healthy. From then on, Timmy looked forward to his baths every day.

Tommy was a very stubborn child. He always wanted to do things his own way.

One day, his mum offered him a pastry for dessert. Tommy smiled and jumped up and down in excitement.

But when the pastry arrived he didn't like it. He wanted a different kind. His mum told him he couldn't have it, but he refused to listen.

His mum tried to remove the pastry from the table, but Tommy held on so tightly that his mum couldn't do it. In the end, she had to give in and let him have the pastry he wanted.

Tommy was very happy and ate up the pastry with a big smile on his face. He showed his mum that even when he was being stubborn, he still got what he wanted!

Once upon a time, there was a tall bear. He had a big fluffy tail. The bear loved to go on adventures. One day he went to the forest to find something new and exciting.

As he was walking, he heard a sound. Something was squeezing his tail. The bear looked around, but he couldn't see what was squeezing his tail. He jumped and looked around to find the culprit. He saw a small rabbit in the bushes.

The bear asked the rabbit why it was squeezing his tail. The rabbit said it was because it was scared. The bear smiled and said it was ok. He asked the rabbit if it wanted to come on an adventure with him. The rabbit hopped up and down with excitement.

The bear and the rabbit had lots of fun exploring the forest. They looked in every bush and every tree. The bear would protect the rabbit if he got scared or hugged his tail if it was shaking. They both made sure to have a very fun and safe adventure.

When it was time to go home, the bear and the rabbit said goodbye to each other. The bear thought to himself that although using his tail was a bit uncomfortable, he was glad it helped the rabbit feel safe enough to explore.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was wearing a blue dress and walking down a hallway. She looked at a big metal door and asked her mom, “What’s that?”

Her mom smiled and said, “That’s an elevator. It takes us up and down. Would you like to try it?”

The girl smiled and said, “Yes!” Then she followed her mom into the elevator.

The little girl was so excited. The elevator made funny noises, and it even had blue buttons. She wanted to press all of them!

Her Mom said, “Let’s press the top one. That will take us up.”

The little girl said, “Ok!” She pushed the top button and the elevator started to move.

The little girl couldn’t believe it. She was so excited! She kept pressing the button and the elevator went faster and faster.

When they reached the top, the little girl was still so excited. She couldn’t stop smiling!

Her Mom said, “Let’s go back down, and then we’ll have a treat.”

The girl smiled and said, “Ok!” Then she followed her mom out of the elevator.

Sandy was a kind 3 year old girl. One day, she was in her bedroom playing. She wanted to make a surprise for her mom and dad. Sandy had an idea! She took off her pants and filled them with stuffing from her old pillow. After she was done, she put the pants on the floor. Then she clapped her hands and said 'rise!'
