Suddenly, the stuffed pants rose up. Sandy clapped and laughed. She knew that mom and dad would love her surprise. Sandy gave the stuffed pants a big hug. She was so happy that her special surprise was finished.

Now, Sandy could show her parents her special surprise. She ran into the living room and said "Look mom and dad, I made something special". Mom and dad admired Sandy's surprise. They were so proud of her. Sandy smiled, she knew that she had made something special with her kind heart.

Once there was a young boy named Jim. He was playing outside on a beautiful day. He was admiring all the colourful things around him. Then he noticed a heavy sack by the side of the road. He wondered what was inside the sack.

He went over to take a closer look. He was so excited when he saw lots of toys inside the sack. All of the toys were different shapes and sizes. They were so brightly coloured andJim couldn't help but admire them.

He picked up one of the toys and it was very heavy. It was too heavy for Jim to carry. But he was determined to bring it home with him. So he pushed and pulled until the sack was rolling behind him.

Finally, Jim made it back home with the heavy sack of toys. He was so happy with the treasures he had found. Jim spent the rest of the day playing with all the wonderful toys. He knew he would always appreciate and admire the special memories it brought.

Once, there was a curious little girl named Jane. Jane wanted to explore the world, so she went for a walk. As she walked, she saw a big store. Inside, she saw lots of exciting things, but her favorite was the big pile of bricks. She excitedly grabbed one and started running.

Suddenly, a frightening noise made Jane stop. She was so scared that she dropped the brick and started to run away. The noise came from the storekeeper, who was angry that Jane took the brick.

But then, the storekeeper smiled. He said "Don't be frightened, I'm not mad. You can keep the brick."

So Jane happily ran home with her brick. She was excited to show her mom and dad, and vowed to explore more tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who loved music. He played the flute every day and dreamed of being a famous musician. One day, he found a fancy flute hidden in a secret place. He was so happy and played it all day long.

But then, something bad happened. The boy's sister was jealous of his new flute and wanted it for herself. She stole it when he wasn't looking and hid it in her room. The boy searched everywhere for his flute but couldn't find it.

Finally, his sister revealed that she had taken it. The boy was very sad and angry. He tried to take it back but his sister wouldn't let him. The boy never played music again and his dream of being a famous musician was shattered.

Once upon a time, there was a famous chef who knew how to make the best pasta in the world. Every day, he made a different type of pasta. His pasta was so yummy that everyone wanted to eat it!

One day, the famous chef was making lasagna. That is a big, hot, cheesy pasta. When it was done, he put it in the oven to keep it warm. The chef was so excited to eat his special pasta.

When he opened the oven the pasta was gone! He looked everywhere but he could not find his famous lasagna.

The chef knew who had eaten his pasta. It was his little nephew who was only three years old. He had opened the oven and taken the lasagna.

But the chef didn't mind. He just laughed because he knew that his nephew loved the pasta as much as he did.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. She was so excited because the sky turned from blue to orange. She was so happy she started to run. Lucy shouted, "Look at the sky, Mummy, it's a rainbow!"

Mummy smiled and said, "Yes, sweetheart, it sure is a rainbow".

Suddenly, there was a noise which sounded like a fire burning. Lucy looked around but could not see anything. Then she noticed smoke rising from the forest. She said to Mummy, "something's burning!"

Mummy said, "Yes, sweetheart, the forest is burning". Lucy was so scared. Mummy held her close and said, "It's okay, the fire will die out soon".

The fire burned and burned, until the sky turned dark. Then the rain started to fall. The rain put out the fire, and the sky was empty again. Everyone was relieved, and Lucy watched a rainbow appear in the sky. She smiled and said, "Look, Mummy! The rainbow is back. Everything is okay now."

Once upon a time, there was an old man. He had a wide, grey beard and a friendly smile. He used to go for walks in the woods.

One day, he felt an itch in his body. He tried to ignore it, but it kept coming back. He stopped walking to feel where it was coming from. He soon realised that something was telling him to keep walking. He felt an urge to go deeper into the woods.

He followed the urge and eventually came to a clearing. In the middle was a big tree. He stood in awe and wondered what the itch and urge had been about. He stepped closer and saw a treasure chest tucked away at the bottom of the tree. He could hardly believe his eyes!

He bent down and opened the chest. Inside were gold coins and jewels. He felt so lucky. He picked up the treasure and carried it back home. He was smiling from ear to ear.

The old man followed his itch and urge and it had led him to a big surprise!

Once upon a time, there was a little star in the sky. The star liked to speed across the night sky, playing with the moon and other stars. It was a happy star, always shining and laughing.

One night, the star met a bird who was not very smart. The bird was trying to fly to the moon. The star thought the bird was a little stupid, but it did not want to be mean. So, the star decided to help the bird.

The star told the bird, "You cannot fly to the moon, but we can play together here!" The bird was happy and they played all night. The star would speed across the sky and the bird would try to follow. They laughed and had fun. In the end, the star and the bird became best friends.

Once upon a time, there were two animals. One was a rabbit, and one was a fox. The rabbit was hopping through the forest and enjoying the day. Suddenly, the rabbit saw the fox coming closer.

The rabbit stopped and he asked, "Hello, why are you here?"

The fox said, "I'm here to give my opinion about the best way to make this forest better."

The rabbit was happy to hear this. He said, "That's great! Please tell me what your opinion is."

The fox said, "I think we should scatter seeds across the forest. That will make the forest beautiful."

The rabbit thought about this for a moment and said, "I agree. I think it's a very good idea!"

The rabbit and the fox scattered the seeds together. As they were working, they were both glad.

Moral: No matter who you are, it's always a great idea to think of ways to make things better.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Bruce. Bruce had a lot of fun. He loved to be outside.

One day a grape fell from the sky and landed in front of Bruce. The grape looked very yummy. Bruce wanted to try it, so he picked it up.

Bruce bit into the grape and it was so warm and yummy. He smiled from ear to ear and said, “Yum!”

But then he looked up at the sky and saw that more grapes were falling. They were falling so fast that Bruce had to run! He ran and ran until he couldn’t run anymore. Then he stopped.

The sky had stopped raining grapes. Bruce smiled, knowing that he had enough grapes to share with his friends. He was so happy.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jack and Dan. They loved to keep jokeing and have a laugh together.

One day, Dan had to go away for a while. Jack was sad and thought that he was going to miss Dan a lot.

But when Dan came back, Jack was so happy! They jokeed and laughed just like before.

Jack noticed that Dan had become very independent. He was doing things on his own, like cycling to the store for the first time.

Jack was very proud of Dan, and wanted to help him keep being independent. So whenever Dan did things on his own, Jack gave him a big smile and said "great job".

The moral of the story is that it is important to support your friends so they can keep being independent.

Tim and Lily went to the zoo with Mom and Dad. They saw many animals, like lions, monkeys, and birds. But their favorite was the otter. The otter was brown and furry, and it liked to swim and play in the water.

"Look, the otter is sliding on the rock!" Tim said.

"It is so funny and cute!" Lily said.

They watched the otter for a long time, and gave it some fish to eat. The otter was happy and made noises like "eeek" and "chirp".

"Can we take the otter home?" Lily asked Mom.

"No, sweetie, the otter belongs to the zoo. It has a nice home here, with other otters and a modern pool. It would not be happy in our house," Mom said.

"But I want to be its friend," Lily said.

"You can be its friend, but you have to let it stay here. Maybe we can return to the zoo another day and see it again," Mom said.

"Okay, Mom. Bye, otter. We will come back soon," Lily said.

She waved to the otter, and the otter waved back with its paw. Tim and Lily smiled and followed Mom and Dad to the exit. They had a fun day at the zoo.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Benny. Benny loved to eat carrots. He would nibble on them all day long. One day, Benny saw a big, juicy carrot in the garden. He hopped over to it and started to chew.

But suddenly, Benny heard a loud noise. It was a fox! The fox wanted to eat Benny for dinner. Benny was scared and didn't know what to do. But then he remembered something his mom had told him. She said that he was an independent rabbit and could take care of himself.

So, Benny quickly hopped away with the carrot in his mouth. The fox chased him, but Benny was too fast. When he got home, he felt proud of himself for being independent and smart. He shared his carrot with his family and they all lived happily ever after.

A family of four went to an expensive ranch in the summer. It was their first time there, and they were excited for what was to come.

The Dad said, "Let's do something fun today! We can go on the horse ride."

The Mom and the two kids, Linda and Jane, cheered in agreement. They went to the ranch and picked out their horse.

They had a lot of fun riding around, and they enjoyed the beautiful scenery. After they finished riding, they stopped at a store to buy some snacks.

The Dad asked, "What do you want? This place has lots of snacks!"

Linda said, "I want ice cream!" Jane said, "I want candy!"

They all laughed, the Dad said, "We are going to need a lot of money to buy all this - this store is very expensive!"

But the Mom said, "Let's do it! We'll buy it all and enjoy our time here."

So, the family happily went home with their snacks and big smiles on their faces.

Once upon a time, a family was looking for a perfect dish. They all wanted to find something they could all enjoy.

Mum said, “Let’s come and look in the kitchen. We might find something that’s just right.”

So they went to the kitchen, and look what they found! A perfect dish that was sitting on the counter.

Mum smiled and said, “That looks perfect! Let’s get everyone to come and try it.”

The family sat down and all tried the perfect dish. It was just as tasty as it looked! Everyone gave happy smiles and said it tasted great.

They all said, “This dish is perfect! Let’s have it again soon.” And ever since, the family continues to come back to the kitchen to try that perfect dish!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to read books with pictures on every page. One day, Lily wanted to play outside, but it started to rain. She was confused because she didn't know what to do. Her mom told her to put on a raincoat and jump in the puddles.

Lily put on her raincoat and went outside. She saw a big puddle and jumped right in it! The rain was coming down harder, so Lily went back inside. She grabbed her favorite book and snuggled up on the couch. She turned the page and saw a picture of a rainbow. She wasn't confused anymore because she knew that the rain would stop soon and a pretty rainbow would appear.

Once upon a time, there was an old cup. It was very special because it was made of magic. One day, something very exciting happened. A boy was playing outside with a toy gun. He spotted the old cup and decided to shoot it with the gun. The magic in the old cup came alive and made the boy's wish come true. Suddenly the boy had lots of toys to play with. He was very joyful and thanked the old cup for making his wish come true. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a special flower. It had many colours and wanted to meet other flowers. So, it decided to start a network. The flower asked all the flowers it knew if they wanted to be part of it. Soon, many other flowers were available and the network bloomed. They all shared stories, gave each other advice and made each other laugh. The flower was so happy that its network was full of such special friends. Everyone had so much fun together. Then, when the night came, they waved goodbye until the next morning. It was the perfect place for the special flower.

Once upon a time, there was a frog named Freddy. Freddy hopped around the pond, looking for something special.

Suddenly, Freddy saw something sparkly and bright. He hopped over to take a closer look. It was an ugly shell! Freddy liked it, so he hopped back to the pond to show his friends.

When he arrived, they were all surprised to see the ugly shell. Freddy was so proud of his discovery. They all wanted to touch and play with it. Freddy proudly hopped around the pond showing everyone the ugly shell.

He had a great day with his friends. As the sun went down, Freddy hopped home with his shell. It was the best find ever!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the festival with her family. The festival was very fun and had lots of yummy food and pretty lights.

One day, Lily and her mom went to the festival. Her mom got a big bag of popcorn and asked Lily to carry it. The bag was very thick and heavy, but Lily was strong and carried it all the way to their spot.

After they ate their popcorn, they walked around and saw lots of people dancing and singing. Lily saw a little boy who looked sad, so she gave him a hug and made him smile. Her mom was proud of her for being kind and carrying the heavy bag of popcorn. They had a great time at the festival and went home happy.

One day, a cute little cat named Kitty had a big plan. She wanted to find the secret chamber in her house. She heard her mom and dad talk about it. Kitty was very excited.

Kitty asked her friend, Bunny, "Do you want to help me find the chamber?" Bunny said, "Yes, let's go!" They looked in every room. They looked under beds and behind doors. But they could not find the secret chamber. Kitty and Bunny felt sad.

Then, Kitty's big sister, Ella, came into the room. She saw them looking sad and asked, "What's wrong?" Kitty said, "We can't find the secret chamber." Ella smiled and said, "I know where it is. Follow me." She took them to a small door in the corner. Kitty and Bunny were so happy! They found the secret chamber and had a fun day playing inside.

Tom was a rabbit who liked to eat celery. He ate celery every day for breakfast, lunch and dinner. He liked the green and crunchy celery very much. He did not like to share his celery with anyone.

One day, Tom saw a big and yellow carrot in the garden. He thought the carrot looked very tasty. He wanted to try the carrot. He left his celery behind and ran to the carrot. He did not see the trap that the farmer had set.

The trap snapped on Tom's leg and hurt him a lot. He cried and cried, but no one came to help him. He was stuck in the trap. He could not move. He could not eat. He could not go back to his celery.

He looked at his celery and felt very sad. He wished he had not left his celery. He wished he had shared his celery with his friends. He missed his celery and his friends. He learned that celery was better than carrot, and sharing was better than being greedy.

But it was too late. The farmer came and took Tom away. He put Tom in a cage and sold him to a pet shop. Tom never saw his celery or his friends again. He had a bad ending.

Tim and Lily were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a lot of fog in the air. They wanted to see what was in the fog, so they ran into it. They did not listen to their mom, who told them to stay close to the house.

As they ran, they got lost in the fog. They could not see each other or the house. They were scared and cold. They called for their mom, but she could not hear them. They tried to find their way back, but they only got deeper into the fog.

Suddenly, they heard a loud roar. It was an enormous bear, who lived in the woods. The bear smelled the twins and wanted to eat them. The twins screamed and ran, but the bear was faster. The bear caught them and bit them. They felt a lot of pain and then they stopped feeling anything. The bear ate them and left their bones in the fog.

The fog cleared and their mom came looking for them. She saw the bones and knew what happened. She cried and cried. She wished she had made them listen to her. She was very sad and lonely. She never played outside again.

Once upon a time, there was a pink potato. It wanted to march forward, but it was stuck in one spot. It saw a big, black bird fly above its head and thought to itself, "If only I could fly like that bird, I could march anywhere I wanted."

The pink potato was so determined to march that it thought hard and long about how to fly. Finally, it figured out a way. It lifted up its stem and began to flap it back and forth. It was working!

The pink potato kept on flapping until the stem became too heavy and it fell back to the ground. It didn't give up though. It had a plan. It rolled down a hill, and as it did, it kept on flapping its stem. The wind caught it and lifted it up and carried it farther and farther away.

Now, the pink potato is free to march all around. It floats in the sky and marches from flower to flower, all the while waving goodbye with its stem.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Floppy. Floppy liked to play in the sunshine and eat carrots. One day, Floppy made a mistake and accidentally knocked over a vase. His mom was very upset, but Floppy said he was sorry and asked for forgiveness. His mom forgave him and gave him a hug.

Later that day, Floppy was playing with his friends when it started to get dark. They couldn't see very well, so Floppy had an idea. He hopped over to the light switch and turned on the light. His friends were so happy and thanked him for being so smart.

Floppy was a very modest bunny. He never bragged about his good ideas or his nice fur. He just enjoyed playing with his friends and being a good bunny.

Anna loved dolphins. She had a big toy dolphin that she hugged every night. She wanted to see real dolphins in the water. One day, her mom and dad took her to the sea park. They said there were dolphins there.

Anna was very happy. She ran to the big pool where the dolphins were. She saw them jump and splash and make funny noises. She clapped and laughed. She wanted to get close to them. She saw a gate that led to the pool. She ran to the gate and opened it.

But the gate was not for people. It was for the dolphins. When Anna opened the gate, the dolphins saw a way out. They swam fast to the gate and escaped. They left the pool and went to the sea. Anna was upset. She did not mean to let the dolphins go. She wanted to play with them.

The sea park people were upset too. They ran to the gate and tried to close it. But it was too late. The dolphins were gone. They looked at Anna and were angry. They said she was a bad girl. They said she had to leave.

Anna cried. She was sorry. She did not know the gate was for the dolphins. She did not know they would leave. She wanted to say sorry to the dolphins and the sea park people. But they did not listen. They took her away. She hugged her toy dolphin and wished she could see the real dolphins again.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Tom and Sally. Tom had a very creative idea for the day. He was going to make a turkey.

Tom said to Sally, "Would you like to help me make a turkey?" Sally agreed and the two of them started gathering the things they needed.

Tom asked Sally, "What do you think we need for a turkey?"

Sally replied, "We need some feathers and some glue." So Tom and Sally got some feathers and glue, and set off on their creative mission.

Tom said, "We need to make a turkey shape". So they got to work cutting the feathers and gluing them to the paper.

When they were done, they stepped back and admired their work.

"It looks so good," said Sally.

"Let's show everybody," said Tom.

So they ran off to show all of their friends their turkey. Everyone was impressed by their creative work and allowed them to keep it!

The two friends had so much fun making the turkey and were so happy that all their friends allowed them to keep it. They decided to make a different turkey every week, and each one was more creative than the last!

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful cat. The cat was very happy. One day, the cat found a marble. The marble was very pretty. The cat liked the marble a lot.

The cat played with the marble every day. The cat was very careful with the marble. But one day, the cat saw a big dog. The cat was scared. The cat started to tremble.

The cat ran away from the dog. The cat was still trembling. The cat dropped the marble. The marble broke. The cat was very sad. The end.

Once there was a little boy called Ryan. He wanted to go on a zoom, but he didn't know which direction to go. He asked his dad.

"Dad, which way should I go to find a zoom?" Ryan asked.

His dad smiled and replied, "Why don't you sort out the problem yourself?"

Ryan thought for a bit, then he had an idea. He ran to the park and began to look for other kids.

"Hey! Do you know how to find a zoom?" he asked. But all the kids just laughed. They thought he was being foolish.

Ryan was determined, though. He kept searching until he found what he was looking for – a zoom. It was a huge playground full of slides, swings and tunnels. Ryan was delighted!

He ran inside and started playing. He had so much fun that he didn't want to go home. His dad was really proud of him for using his brain, rather than being a foolish little boy!

Once upon a time there was a beautiful lion. He loved to roar! He was so proud of his big, loud roar. But one day, a painter came to the lion's kingdom. The painter wanted to make a picture of the lion, so the lion had to stand still for a long time. As the painter painted, the lion started to feel pain in his lion toes. He couldn't take it anymore and let out a big roar. The painter was so scared that he ran away! Everyone in the kingdom cheered and praised the lion for his beautiful roar. They all loved it so much and the lion was so happy!

John and Maria were best friends. Every day they would stay out in the backyard and try and come up with fun adventures to do. One day, they wanted to go explore in the woods.

John started running but Maria hesitated, she was scared of all the creatures that roamed the woods. John ignored her and just kept running, leaving her behind.

“John, come back!” Maria yelled, but he just kept going and didn’t turn back. Maria felt ashamed, so she decided to try something to get his attention. She grabbed a stick and pretended it was a missile and threw it at John. It worked and John stopped.

He turned back and said “Come on Maria, let’s go together. I know you’re scared but I won’t leave you behind”. Maria smiled, she was relieved and knew she could trust John. They quickly ran off into the woods and started having an amazing adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Tommy. Tommy was playing in the garden with his mom when he saw something out of the corner of his eye. He looked at it very carefully and saw a tiny ant scurrying across the patio, wearing a pair of tiny pants.

Tommy was so enchanted by the ant's pants that he decided to make some of his own. So, he went in the house and found some of his daddy's old material. He glued and stitched and before long he had a pair of pants, just like the ant had.

He took his new pants out to show his mom, but when she saw them, she looked at them with a frown. She told him to take them off and to never wear pants outdoors again!

Tommy was upset but obeyed his mom and put away his tiny pants. Years passed and one day his mom called all the family together. When they arrived, his mom revealed that she had bought a small garden all for Tommy.

Tommy was thrilled and in the garden, he found a tiny ant wearing a pair of tiny pants! Tommy was surprised, but his mom smiled and told him that he had made the right decision by not wearing the pants outdoors. Tommy was so happy that he had listened to his mom, and the ant scurried away with a smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who wanted to fly. He flapped his wings and tried so hard, but he just couldn't get off the ground.

One day he saw a banana and thought he might be able to use it to help him fly. He grabbed the banana with his beak and started to flap his wings with all his might. Soon enough, he was soaring high in the sky!

The little bird flew over the rainforest and saw so many amazing things. He saw tall trees and wet birds that playfully flew around. He flew high above the clouds, until his arms got tired and he started to get hungry.

He remembered the banana in his beak and knew that it would make the perfect snack. After he had his banana, he flapped his wings and started to soar again.

The little bird was so happy that he was able to fly and he thanked the banana for giving him the chance to make his dreams come true.

Tim and Kim were playing with their new toy lasers in the park. They liked to pretend they were space heroes, fighting evil aliens. They made loud noises and ran around, shooting their lasers at trees and rocks.

"Zap! Zap! You're frozen, alien!" Tim shouted, pointing his laser at Kim.

"No, you're frozen, hero!" Kim replied, shooting back.

They laughed and had fun, until they saw a little girl sitting on a bench, crying. She had a broken doll in her hands.

"What's wrong, little girl?" Tim asked, feeling sorry for her.

"My doll is broken. I dropped her and her arm came off. She was my best friend," the girl sobbed.

Tim and Kim looked at each other. They knew how much they loved their toys, and how sad they would be if they broke. They decided to do something nice for the girl.

"Here, you can have my laser. It's very cool and fun. You can pretend you're a space hero, too," Tim said, giving his laser to the girl.

"And you can have mine, too. They work better together. You can make your own adventures," Kim said, handing her laser to the girl.

The girl smiled and wiped her tears. She thanked Tim and Kim and hugged them. She said they were very kind and humble.

Tim and Kim felt happy and proud. They learned that sharing and helping others was more important than playing with their toys. They made a new friend and had a new game. They played with the girl and her doll, using their imagination and their hearts.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty princess. She liked to do yoga in her castle. She was very charming and kind to everyone she met. One day, a prince came to visit her. He was handsome and brave. The princess liked him very much and they decided to get married. They had a big party with lots of cake and dancing. Everyone was happy for the charming princess and her brave prince. They lived happily ever after in their castle doing yoga together.

Tom and Lily are playing with their dolls. They have a big box of clothes for their dolls. They like to dress them up and make them talk.

"Hello, I am Anna. I like to wear pink dresses and hats," Lily makes her doll say.

"Hi, I am Ben. I like to wear blue shirts and pants," Tom makes his doll say.

They pretend that Anna and Ben are friends and go to the park together. They have fun playing with their dolls.

But then, Tom has an idea. He wants to make his doll look crazy. He takes off Ben's shirt and pants and puts on a dress and a hat from the box. He also puts on a strip of paper as a scarf.

"Look, Lily, look at my doll. He is crazy!" Tom says and laughs.

Lily looks at Tom's doll and does not like it. She thinks Tom is being silly and mean.

"No, Tom, no. That is not funny. That is bad. You have to wash your doll and put on his right clothes," Lily says and gets angry.

She grabs Tom's doll and runs to the bathroom. She turns on the tap and puts the doll under the water. She washes off the dress, the hat and the strip of paper.

"Stop, Lily, stop. You are wetting my doll. Give him back to me," Tom says and follows her.

He tries to take his doll from Lily, but she holds on tight. They start to pull and push each other. They make a lot of noise.

Their mom hears them and comes to the bathroom. She sees them fighting over the doll. She sees the water and the clothes on the floor.

"What are you doing, Tom and Lily? Why are you making such a mess?" she asks and looks cross.

Tom and Lily stop fighting and look at their mom. They feel sorry and ashamed.

"We are sorry, mom. We were playing with our dolls, but then Tom made his doll look crazy and I tried to wash him and we started to fight," Lily says.

"Yes, mom, we are sorry. I was just trying to be funny, but I was wrong. I will not do it again," Tom says.

Their mom sighs and shakes her head. She picks up the doll and the clothes and gives them back to Tom and Lily.

"Okay, I forgive you, but you have to clean up this mess and be nice to each other. And no more crazy dolls, okay?" she says.

"Okay, mom, we will. Thank you, mom," Tom and Lily say.

They hug their mom and their dolls. They go back to their room and play nicely. They dress their dolls in their right clothes and make them say sorry to each other. They are happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a poor boy named Tom. He lived near the sea. Tom loved to watch the big navy ships go by. He wanted to be on a navy ship one day.

One day, Tom found a toy gun. He liked to play with it and pretend to shoot. Tom would point at the ships and say, "Bang! Bang!" He would laugh and run around.

Tom met a navy man named Jack. Jack saw Tom playing with the toy gun. Jack said, "Hi, Tom! Do you like to shoot?" Tom said, "Yes, I do! I want to be in the navy like you!" Jack smiled and said, "Keep practicing, Tom. Maybe one day you can join the navy too!" Tom was very happy and kept playing with his toy gun, dreaming of the day he could be in the navy.

Mum and Dad wanted to buy new equipment. So they went to the shop. At the shop, Mum was very bossy. She told Dad what to buy. Dad was a little frustrated, but he listened to Mum. He knew she only wanted the best for their family.

Mum bought lots of different things: a big bed for their bedroom, a table for the kitchen, some chairs for the living room, and a nice TV for the lounge. Dad also found a big toy for their son to play with.

When they got home, the equipment looked really good. Dad was really proud of Mum. She always knew how to buy the best things. The family had a great time playing with the new things they bought. The little boy loved his new toy the most. He couldn't tell Mum and Dad how thankful he was, but he showed it in other ways—by being bossier than ever!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a pink cushion that she loved to hug. One day, Lily's mom asked her to go to the kitchen and get some cookies. Lily ran to the kitchen, but she slipped on a banana peel and fell down.

"Ouch!" cried Lily.

"What happened?" asked her mom.

"I slipped on a banana peel," said Lily.

"Are you okay?" asked her mom.

"Yes, I'm okay," said Lily. "But my cushion got dirty."

"Don't worry," said her mom. "We'll wash it and it will be clean again."

Lily smiled and hugged her cushion. She was happy that it would be clean and pink again.

Once upon a time there was an ordinary mule. The mule liked to take long walks. Whenever the mule became tired, she would rest. This meant she would lay down in the shade and take a nap.

The mule loved to explore. Every day she would go to a new place and look around. She loved checking out the flowers, the trees and the animals.

One day the mule rested for a little too long and fell asleep. When she woke, it became dark very quickly. She was so scared! She didn't know how to get home.

But then she felt a gentle touch. It was a kind man who could see the mule was lost. He helped the mule find her way home.

The mule was so happy she was home safe and sound. She thanked the man with a smile and trotted back to her stable. The mule was relieved to be safe and sound. From then on, the mule was more careful when she took her walks and rested for only the right amount of time.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Jack and Sam. They went for a walk together and all around them were big trees and tall grass. They decided they wanted to go on an adventure so they started to walk down a path.

Sam wanted to go straight but Jack wanted to turn right. Jack insisted, so they turned right and kept walking. The path was really long, but it was also really nice.

The sun was shining as they kept walking, and all around them were birds singing in the trees. They were getting a bit tired, but then Jack spotted something up ahead. Around a bend in the path, he saw a big hill with lots of lovely wildflowers growing on it.

Excitedly, Jack and Sam decided to climb the hill. At the top they could see all the way to the horizon. They were so happy that they had followed the path, and they decided to come back to the hill soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and explore. One day, he went to the park to play. He saw a big rock and wanted to climb it.

"Mommy, can I climb the rock?" Timmy asked impatiently.

"Sure, but be careful and stay close to me," his mommy replied.

Timmy climbed the rock and sat on top of it. He looked down and saw his mommy smiling at him. "I did it!" Timmy exclaimed happily.

"You did a great job, Timmy," his mommy said. "Now let's go play on the swings."

Timmy and his mommy played on the swings and had a lot of fun. Timmy felt proud of himself for climbing the rock and staying safe.

Sandy was a thin bear and he was very sad. He had been alone for months and he wanted to stay with his family. He suffered a lot without them.

One day, a kind man saw him walking around and offered him a ride. He was so happy and nodded yes. The man drove him back home! When Sandy saw all his family and friends, he couldn't believe it.

They were so happy to see him and hugged him tight. Sandy was so happy and never wanted to stay apart from his family ever again. He could finally forget about the pain he had suffered all alone.

Once there was a little boy who was three years old. He was sad because he had no friends. He hated being lonely.

One day he saw something strange on the ground. It was a shiny thing that looked interesting and it was available. He picked it up and soon realized it was a key!

He was so happy to have a key and wanted to show someone. But he was still alone and had no one to show it to. He was sad again.

The little boy started to think of ways he could use the key. Then he had an idea! He started to look everywhere for a door that the key would fit. After searching around, he finally found a door that opened with the key.

When he opened it, he saw a room full of toys. He was so happy that he screamed out loud! He had finally found something he did not hate - a room full of toys!

Once there was a white bunny who lived in a meadow. One day she decided to go see the world. She hopped away and finally arrived at a university. She was so excited to explore the new place!

The bunny jumped high and bounded around the university grounds. She saw lots of tall buildings and quiet libraries. She hopped up the stairs and explored the classrooms and lecture halls.

Then the white bunny found a pond and hopped in. The cool water felt wonderful on her fur. She splashed around in the shallows and tried to catch dragonflies. After playing in the water, she hopped out onto the grass.

The bunny had had a wonderful time. She hopped back across the meadow. It felt so good to be home again!

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Emma. She was three years old and obedient.

One day while playing, Emma found a page which had numbers on it. She asked her mom "what's this?".

Her mom said, "It's a number matching game".

Emma was curious and said "What do I do?".

Her mom explained, "Look at the numbers on the page and match them with the same numbers you see in this book".

Emma was so excited to play the game and started matching the numbers. She showed her mom how obedient she was and completed the game in no time.

At the end, Emma was happy that she had won the game and her mom praised her for being so obedient.

Tom was a king. He had a big crown made of gold and jewels. He liked to wear his crown and sit on his throne. He felt very important and proud.

One day, he had to go to a party with other kings and queens. He wanted to show off his crown and make them jealous. He put on his best clothes and his crown and walked to his carriage.

But on the way, he did not see a stone on the ground. He stumbled and fell. His crown flew off his head and rolled away. He hurt his knee and his nose. He cried out loud.

"Help! Help! Where is my crown?" he shouted.

A girl who was passing by heard him. She saw his crown and picked it up. She ran to him and gave it back.

"Here is your crown, sir. Are you okay?" she asked.

Tom took his crown and looked at it. It was dirty and bent. Some of the jewels were missing. He felt miserable.

"Thank you, but my crown is ruined. It is not shiny and pretty anymore. The other kings and queens will laugh at me. I don't want to go to the party anymore," he said.

The girl felt sorry for him. She smiled and said, "Don't be sad, sir. Your crown is not the most important thing. You are still a king. You have a big heart and a kind voice. You can make people happy and help them. That is what makes you a good king. The other kings and queens will like you for who you are, not for what you wear."

Tom listened to her words. He wiped his tears and smiled back. He realized she was right. He thanked her and hugged her. He put on his crown and got on his carriage. He went to the party and had fun. He made new friends and learned new things. He was happy and proud. He never forgot the girl who helped him. He always remembered to be a good king.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with puzzles. He had a big pile of them in his room. One day, he was trying to put together a puzzle of a puppy, but it was very hard. He started to frown because he couldn't figure it out.

Suddenly, his dad came into the room and saw Timmy's puzzle. "That looks like a foolish puzzle," his dad said. "Let me help you." Timmy was happy that his dad was going to help him. Together, they put the puzzle together and it looked just like a real puppy!

Timmy smiled and hugged his dad. "Thank you for helping me," he said. From that day on, Timmy and his dad would work on puzzles together all the time. And whenever Timmy got stuck, he would just ask his dad for help.

Once there was a bald man who was very lonely. He wanted a friend but he had no one to play with. One day he saw a video of a little girl playing. He smiled and decided he wanted to have a friend like her. He watched the video every day until one day he decided to part with his loneliness. He decided to go find the girl from the video. He booked a plane and flew to her house. When he arrived he saw her playing outside. She had long brown hair and a big smile. He walked up to her and asked if she wanted to be friends. She said yes and they became best friends. They spent every day playing together and having fun. He was never lonely again.

Once upon a time there was a young girl and her name was Emma. She was three years old and very curious. Every day, she would peek into her grandparent’s home. She loved to see what they were doing.

One day, she peeked in and saw a charming photo on the wall. It was of a little dog standing in a garden. He had a smile on his face! Emma loved this photo so much. She wished she had a little dog of her own like in the picture.

So, the next day, Emma peeked in to see if anything had changed in the photo. Amazingly, the little dog had moved! Now he was running happily through the garden. Emma was thrilled!

From that day on, whenever Emma peeked in to her grandparent’s home, the little dog in the photo always had a different pose. It was so fun to see what it was doing each time! It was truly a charming photo.

Once upon a time, there was a brown bus. It went vroom vroom down the road. One day, it was very cold outside and the people on the bus started to shiver. The bus driver turned up the heat to make them warm. The people were happy and stopped shivering. The end.

Once there was a dancer who whistled as she skipped. She was so persistent that she kept on whistling the same tune all day.

She passed by a playground where she stopped to admire the children playing. A few of them noticed her and asked what she was doing.

The dancer grinned and said, "I'm whistling a tune for you so that you can tap your feet and dance along with me!"

The children all cheered and danced around her until the sun began to set. The dancer smiled and said, "That was so much fun! Let's do it again!"

And so every day, the children would come to the playground to dance and whistle with the persistent dancer. They all had the best time!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She went to a restaurant with her family. When they sat down, the waiter gave them a menu. Lily looked at the menu and saw some unusual foods she had never seen before. She asked her mom what they were, and her mom explained.

After they ordered, Lily saw a big TV on the wall. It was displaying pictures of animals. She pointed and said "Look, mom! Animals!" Her mom smiled and they talked about the animals they saw.

When their food came, Lily's dish was unusual too. It had bright colors and looked very pretty. She was so happy to try it. After they finished eating, Lily's dad paid the bill and they left the restaurant. Lily said "Bye-bye, animals!" as they walked out.

Molly was bored. She had nothing to do, nowhere to go. So she decided to help her mom do the chores. She grabbed the mop and began to clean the kitchen. After a few minutes, her mom noticed and smiled.

"Thank you Molly!" she said. "That looks much better!"

Molly nodded. She liked helping her mom. She went on to mop the living room floor. The furniture was moved out of the way, and Molly happily mopped away.

Suddenly, she heard a loud noise! Startled, she stopped and looked.

To her surprise, there was a puppy in her living room, chasing its tail! Molly smiled, and the puppy wagged its tail when it saw her.

"Come a play!" Molly said. The puppy barked and the two of them began to play. Molly had forgotten about mopping because playing with the puppy was much more fun!

Tim has a dog named Max. Max is big and brown and likes to run and play. Tim loves Max very much and gives him a red collar with his name on it. The collar has a bell that makes a sound when Max moves.

One day, Tim and Max go to the park with Mom. There are many other dogs and people in the park. Max sees a ball and runs after it. He does not see the fence and bumps into it. The collar falls off his neck and lands on the grass.

A girl named Mia sees the collar and picks it up. She likes the bell and the red color. She does not see Max or Tim. She is careless and does not look for the owner. She puts the collar in her pocket and walks away.

Max comes back to Tim and Mom. He is happy and wags his tail. But Tim sees that his collar is gone. He is sad and worried. He says, "Mom, where is Max's collar? I gave it to him and it has his name on it. We have to find it!"

Mom says, "Don't worry, Tim. Maybe someone found it and will bring it back. Let's look around and ask the people in the park. Maybe they saw it."

They walk around and ask the people and the dogs. But no one has seen the collar. Tim feels more sad and angry. He says, "Who took Max's collar? It is not nice to take things that are not yours. Max needs his collar. It is his mark. It shows that he is my dog and I love him."

Meanwhile, Mia goes home with the collar in her pocket. She shows it to her mom and says, "Look, Mom, I found a pretty collar in the park. It has a bell and a name on it. Can I keep it?"

Her mom looks at the collar and sees the name Max. She says, "Mia, this is not your collar. This is someone else's collar. It belongs to a dog named Max. He must be very sad and scared without his collar. You have to give it back. It is not fair to keep it. How would you feel if someone took your necklace or your toy?"

Mia thinks for a moment. She remembers how she felt when she lost her favorite doll. She feels sorry for Max and his owner. She says, "You are right, Mom. I was careless and selfish. I did not think about Max or his owner. I will give it back. Can we go to the park and look for them?"

Her mom says, "Yes, we can. That is very kind and honest of you, Mia. I am proud of you."

They go back to the park and look for Max and Tim. They see them sitting on a bench with a sad face. Mia runs to them and says, "Hi, I am Mia. I am sorry, I took your collar by mistake. I did not know it was yours. Here it is. I hope you are not mad at me."

Tim and Max are surprised and happy. They see the collar and recognize it. Tim says, "Hi, I am Tim. This is Max. Thank you for bringing back his collar. I was very worried and sad. I thought I lost it forever. I am not mad at you. I am glad you are honest and kind."

Max barks and wags his tail. He licks Mia's face and puts his head on her lap. He is happy to have his collar back. He likes Mia and forgives her.

Mia smiles and pets Max. She says, "You are welcome, Tim. I am sorry for taking your collar. I like your dog. He is very nice and friendly. Can we be friends?"

Tim smiles and nods. He says, "Yes, we can. I like you too. You are very brave and sweet. Can we play together?"

Mia nods and says, "Yes, we can. I have a ball. Do you want to play catch with Max and me?"

Tim says, "Yes, I do. That sounds like fun."

They get up and run to the field. They play catch with Max and the ball. They laugh and have fun. They are happy and forget their troubles. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky was very excited because today was his birthday. He waddled around the pond, quacking happily.

Suddenly, Ducky saw his friend, Bunny. Bunny said, "Happy birthday, Ducky! I have a surprise for you." Bunny spread his arms and revealed a big carrot cake.

Ducky was so excited that he flapped his wings and splashed water everywhere. "Thank you, Bunny! Let's share the cake with all our friends," Ducky said. So, they invited all the animals in the pond to the party and everyone had a great time eating cake and swimming.

Once there was a little girl called Emily. She was three years old and loved watching TV. One day, she was watching her favorite show when a gentle man she had never seen before suddenly appeared on the screen. Emily couldn't believe it and stared at the TV with amazement.

Gradually, Emily began to recognize something familiar in the man's face. He looked like her dad! She began to smile and ask her mom, "Is that my daddy?"

Her Mom nodded, tears of joy in her eyes, and said, "Yes, that's your Daddy!" Emily was so happy and quickly ran to her Dad to give him a big hug.

They embraced for a very long time, with Emily finally recognizing that she had the most gentle Dad in the world. She was so happy to be spending time with her Dad, and from then on Emily watched her favorite TV show with her Dad every day.

Once upon a time, there was a woman who was a little bit crazy. Every day she would take out a big pot and pour a lot of water into it. She kept pouring and pouring until it was completely full.

The woman always made funny faces while she was pouring. She would throw her arms up in the air, and twirl around like she was dancing.

One day, a little boy who was only three years old noticed the woman and started laughing at her. The woman stopped pouring and smiled at the little boy. She said to him, "That's how you make soup!"

The little boy thought it was so funny! He laughed and laughed, and never forgot that moment. He remembered that crazy woman, and the way she poured water into the pot.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Lola. Lola had a black scarf and she loved to wear it. One day, she went outside and saw an amazing thing. She saw her own shadow! Lola had never seen a shadow before and she wanted to catch it. She grabbed her scarf, ran outside and started chasing it. She tried to catch her shadow, but it was too fast. It kept running around and around. Lola stopped, but her shadow kept moving. It was playing hide and seek with her. Suddenly, the sky turned dark. Lola looked up and saw big, black clouds coming in. Then it started to rain. Lola and her shadow had to go inside. But Lola was still happy. She knew her shadow would be waiting for her outside when the sun came back out.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved Wednesdays because that was the day his mom took him to the park. The park was always busy with kids playing and dogs barking.

One day, Timmy saw a bird with a broken wing. He wanted to help the bird, but it was too heavy for him to lift. So, he asked his mom for help. Together, they lifted the bird and took it to the vet.

The vet said the bird would be okay, but it needed to rest for a few days. Timmy was happy he could help the bird and he couldn't wait for next Wednesday to come so he could play at the park again.

Once upon a time, there was a witch who lived in a big, dark house. She was very lonely because no one ever came to visit her. One day, a little girl named Lily decided to visit the witch. She wanted to be friends with her and play together. The witch was happy to have a visitor and they spent the day making potions and casting spells.

But as the sun started to set, the witch's mood changed. She became angry and wanted to keep Lily forever. Lily tried to run away, but the witch caught her and turned her into a frog. Now Lily was all alone and sad, and the witch was still lonely in her big, dark house. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big, big elephant. He was so enormous! He liked to walk around and play with his friends. One day, he saw a little bird who was hurt. The bird was patient and waited for the elephant to help. The elephant was kind and picked up the bird with his trunk. He took the bird to the doctor and waited until the doctor said that the bird was all better. The bird was happy and flew away. The elephant was happy too because he helped the bird. And that's the end of the story.

Lily likes to play on the couch. She jumps and rolls and bounces on the soft pillows. She pretends she is a bird flying high in the sky. She flaps her arms and makes bird sounds.

One day, Mommy says it is time to stop playing and go to bed. Lily does not want to go to bed. She wants to play more. She says no to Mommy and runs away. She hides behind the couch. She thinks Mommy cannot find her there.

But Mommy is smart. She knows where Lily is. She walks around the couch and sees Lily's feet sticking out. She says, "I see you, Lily. Come out and get ready for bed." Lily pouts and says, "No, I want to play." Mommy says, "You can play again tomorrow. But now you need to sleep. Sleeping is good for you. It makes you grow and dream."

Mommy picks up Lily and carries her to her room. She puts her in her bed and tucks her in. She kisses her and says, "I love you, Lily. Good night." She turns off the light and closes the door. Lily feels sad and lonely. She misses the couch and the sky. She wishes she could play more.

But then she hears a soft sound. It is her teddy bear. He is in her bed with her. He says, "Don't be sad, Lily. I am here with you. We can cuddle and snuggle and keep each other warm. We can also pretend we are on the couch and flying high. We can make bird sounds and have fun. We can do anything in our dreams."

Lily smiles and hugs her teddy bear. She says, "Thank you, teddy. You are my best friend. I love you, too. Good night." She closes her eyes and falls asleep. She dreams of the couch and the sky and the birds. She is happy.

Jack was a 3-year-old boy and he loved to bounce. He liked to bounce so much, he even bounced when he walked down the street. One day, he reached a park with a big rubber bounce house. He was so excited to jump inside.

Jack hopped in and started to bounce. He said to himself, "This is so much fun! I'm going to bounce until I can't anymore!" He kept jumping around and laughed as he flew high into the air.

Suddenly, he heard his mom calling him from outside.

"Time to go home, Jack!" said mom.

Jack did not want to leave so he asked his mom.

"Mom, can we come back tomorrow?"

His mom smiled and said, "Sure thing. Now let's go home and have some yummy dinner!"

Jack happily ran outside and saw his mom with a dictionary and a big smile on her face.

"What's that dictionary for?" asked Jack.

"I want to check up on something," said his mom with a twinkle in her eye.

Jack and his mom went home, and he enjoyed his yummy dinner. He was eagerly waiting for the next day so he could visit the bounce house again!

Once there was a family. Dad was cheerful and he loved to take his family for drives in the car. He would turn the key and the engine would start with a gentle purr.

One sunny day, Dad said, "Let's go for a drive!"

The children were very excited, as this was always a treat. Dad filled the car with gas, then they part of the house, waving goodbye to Mom.

The family drove out into the countryside, singing and laughing. As they turned a corner, Dad said cheerfully, "Let's go to the park." The children cheered and clapped, looking forward to a fun day.

When they arrived at the park, Dad put the car in park and got out. But when he turned the key, the car wouldn't start.

Dad frowned. He said, "It looks like we're stuck here until someone comes with more gas."

The children noticed the frown on Dad's face, but he quickly turned it into a cheerful smile.

Soon enough, Mom arrived with some extra gas and Dad was able to get the car moving again. The children were so relieved to be able to finally part the park and head back home.

Mommy was in the kitchen. She was holding something big, but it was light. She asked little Jake to come and join her. Jake quickly ran to her.

Mommy had a box in her hands. She said she was going to explain a truck. Jake waited for her to explain.

Mommy explained that the box was like a truck. The truck was really big and heavy. Jake was so excited. He asked lots of questions about the truck.

Mommy said that one day Jake could have a truck too. Jake smiled so big. He couldn't wait to have his own truck.

Lily and Ben were bored. They wanted to play outside, but it was raining. They looked at the window and saw a big puddle. They had an idea.

"Let's put on our boots and coats and go to the puddle!" Lily said.

"OK!" Ben agreed.

They ran to the door and opened it. They saw a goat in their yard. The goat was eating their flowers. They were surprised.

"Hey, goat, stop that!" Lily shouted.

The goat looked at them and made a loud noise. It did not stop eating. Lily and Ben ran to the puddle. They picked up some sticks and dipped them in the water. They tried to spray the goat with the water.

"Shoo, goat, shoo!" Ben said.

The goat did not like the water. It shook its head and ran away. Lily and Ben laughed. They had fun spraying the water. They forgot about the rain. They were happy.

Once upon a time, two cool friends were chatting. They were so happy to be together. They spoke happily about their day and all the cool things they did. Their conversation was so much fun!

They suddenly heard a loud noise coming from outside. It was a train on its way to the hospital. The friends looked at each other in surprise. They knew someone must be going for an operation.

The train stopped nearby and the friends heard a voice. It was the patient who had to go for the operation. The voice spoke softly and kindly, "I'm so scared, but I have to be brave. Wish me luck!"

The friends cheered and cheered for the patient. Their cheers were so loud and happy. The patient thanked the friends for all their kindness and love. Then, as the train started to move, the patient waved goodbye to everyone.

The friends waved back and cheered one last time. They were so excited to know that the patient was on their way to a cool operation!

There once was a brave little girl. She had curly brown hair and wore a pink dress. Every day she wanted to see what was in the mailbox. But the mailbox was too tall for her and she couldn't reach it.

One day, the little girl was very brave. She sat down and got on her tippy toes. She stretched her arms high and opened the mailbox. Inside the mailbox, she found lots of surprises!

The brave little girl found cards, pictures and even a little toy. She smiled when she saw them all and now she knew just exactly why she had been so brave.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna. She loved exploring in her backyard, and went out everyday to find something new. One day she heard a funny whistle sound coming from near the river. She was curious so she walked over and said, "Hello? Who is here?"

But there wasn't anyone there. Instead, she found a beautiful whistle. It was red and shiny and made an incredible sound. Anna was so excited and couldn't wait to show her friends.

But when she got back home, she realised that she had been gone for a very long time and her mum was very angry. Mum didn't understand why Anna was so excited about the whistle. She said, "It is time to come inside now or you won't be able to play tomorrow."

Anna was very disappointed but she knew she had to obey her mum. She reluctantly put the whistle away and went inside. But the next day when she was allowed to play again, Anna remembered the whistle and went back to find it again. To her joy it was still there! She was so happy and couldn't wait to show her friends. They all agreed that it was an incredible whistle.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys and books. One day, they go to the park with their moms. They see a big slide. Lily wants to go on the slide, but Ben is scared.

"Come on, Ben, it is fun!" Lily says. "I will teach you how to slide."

"No, no, no, it is too high!" Ben says. "I will fall and hurt myself."

Lily shakes her head. She thinks Ben is stupid. She runs to the slide and climbs up the ladder. She sits on the top and smiles at Ben.

"Look, Ben, it is easy!" she says. "You just zip down and land on the sand. Whee!"

She pushes herself and slides down. She laughs and feels the wind on her face. She lands on the sand and jumps up.

"See, Ben, I did it!" she says. "It was so much fun! You should try it too!"

Ben watches Lily. He sees that she is happy and not hurt. He feels a little brave. He walks to the slide and looks up. It is still high, but not as high as before. He climbs up the ladder slowly. He sits on the top and holds the sides. He looks at Lily.

"Lily, I am scared!" he says.

"Don't be scared, Ben, you can do it!" Lily says. "Just zip down like me. I will catch you!"

Ben takes a deep breath. He lets go of the sides and slides down. He feels the wind on his face too. He lands on the sand and Lily catches him.

"Ben, you did it!" Lily says. "You are not stupid, you are brave!"

Ben smiles. He feels proud and happy. He hugs Lily.

"Thank you, Lily, you are a good friend!" he says. "You are a good teach too!"

They laugh and hug. They go on the slide again and again. They have a lot of fun. Their moms watch them and smile. They are proud of their kids. They are good friends too.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, especially his toy cars. One day, he was playing with his favorite car when he realized that one of the screws was missing. He looked everywhere but he couldn't find it.

Timmy was sad because he couldn't play with his favorite car anymore. He asked his mom to help him find the screw but she couldn't find it either. Timmy was getting more and more upset. Then, suddenly, he had a weird idea. He decided to use a different screw from another toy car.

At first, it didn't work very well. The car was wobbly and didn't go straight. But Timmy kept trying and eventually he got the screw just right. His car was as good as new! Timmy was so happy that he realized he didn't need to be upset about the missing screw anymore. He was proud of himself for fixing his car all by himself.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to paint with her fingers and make beautiful pictures. One day, she painted a big yellow sun with a smiley face in the sky.

After painting, Lily's mommy made her some yummy toast with butter. The toast was warm and crunchy, and Lily ate it all up.

Later that day, Lily went outside to play with her friends. She saw a yellow butterfly fluttering by and tried to catch it. But the butterfly flew away, leaving Lily feeling a little sad. So, she painted a picture of the yellow butterfly to make herself feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who wanted to measure her room. She asked her mom if she could borrow her measuring tape. Her mom said yes and gave her the measuring tape. So the little girl spent the day measuring the length of the wall and the width of the floor.

After she finished measuring the room, the little girl went outside. She saw an independent vendor who was selling vegetables in the market. She asked him if she could measure the vegetables. The vendor said yes so the little girl measured each vegetable one by one.

When she was finished, the little girl thanked the vendor and ran back home. She told her mom that she had a great day measuring all kinds of things. Her mom smiled and said that she was proud of her for being so independent. The little girl smiled and went off to play.

John had a baseball he liked to play with. Every day he would take it outside and throw it in the air. He really enjoyed it and was very happy when he was playing.

One day, John went outside only to discover that his baseball was locked away. Someone had locked it in a box and it could not be opened. He felt sad and began to cry.

John's mom heard him crying and knew he was upset. She quickly found the key and unlocked the box. Inside was John's baseball. Seeing his baseball unlocked, John's face lit up with joy!

John thanked his mom and went outside to play with his baseball. He felt spoiled because his mom had been so nice to help him and he told her thank you again. He went outside and now he could play with his baseball as much as he wanted.

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big pond with fish. Tim has a rod. He wants to catch a fish. Sam does not have a rod. He is jealous of Tim.

"Can I use your rod, Tim?" Sam asks.

"No, it is mine. You can watch me catch a fish," Tim says.

Tim puts a worm on the hook. He throws the rod into the pond. He waits for a fish to bite. Sam watches him. He is bored.

"I want to try, Tim. Please let me have a turn," Sam says.

"No, you have to wait. I am the best fisher," Tim says.

Tim feels a tug on the rod. He pulls hard. He sees a big fish on the hook. He is happy.

"Look, Sam, I caught a fish. It is bigger than your head," Tim says.

He tries to lift the rod out of the water. But the fish is too heavy. The rod slips from his hand. It falls into the pond. Tim is sad.

"Tim, you lost your rod. And your fish," Sam says.

He laughs. He is not jealous anymore. He is glad.

"Maybe you are not the best fisher, Tim. Maybe you need some help," Sam says.

He reaches for the rod in the water. He tries to grab it. But he slips on the wet grass. He falls into the pond. He is wet.

"Sam, you are silly. And you are wet," Tim says.

He laughs. He is not sad anymore. He is sorry.

"Maybe we are both bad fishers, Sam. Maybe we need to play something else," Tim says.

He helps Sam out of the pond. They hug. They are friends again. They go to play on the slide. They forget about the rod and the fish. They have fun.

Once there was a lady who had a special leg. It was deaf and she never wanted to talk about it.

One day, a little boy asked the lady why her leg was so special. She was surprised he noticed!

The lady smiled and told the boy she was deaf in the leg because she was born that way.

The boy was surprised— he thought it was unusual but very cool! He asked the lady to teach him sign language and she gladly agreed!

The lady taught the boy many things, including how to communicate with people who can’t hear.

From then on, the little boy and the lady shared a special bond— they both knew that being different could be a wonderful thing.

Once upon a time there was a princess who was kind and helpful. She loved to help others and had magical powers. One day, the princess noticed a strange texture in the air. It felt as if something was trying to talk to her. Trying to be brave, she decided to find out what the texture was.

The princess followed the texture to the nearby forest. As she looked around, she noticed a big furry monster with big teeth. The monster seemed scared and the princess wanted to help.

She carefully stepped closer and asked the monster why it was scared. The monster said he was scared because other monsters were not behaving nicely.

The princess knew this was not right and she wanted to help the monster. She thought for a minute and came up with a plan. She asked the other monsters to say sorry for not behaving nicely.

The other monsters said sorry and promised to behave better. The princess was pleased and the monsters all said goodbye. With her help, peace was restored and the texture in the air became soft once more.

Once there was a family who went for a high walk in the mountains. As they reached the top of the hill, they discovered a mystery. The family didn't know what it was but it was so exciting!

The family went up to it and looked closely. Suddenly they saw a little door in the middle of the mysterious thing. They opened it and inside they found a beautiful lake. It was so high that they could see the whole world as far as their eyes could see.

The family was so happy - they had discovered a beautiful secret! They made it part of their regular adventure and would visit it often. They had discovered a mysterious high secret and kept it safe. It was their special place.

Lily loved dolphins. She had a big picture of a dolphin on her wall. She had a soft toy dolphin that she hugged at night. She had a book about dolphins that her mom read to her. She dreamed of seeing a real dolphin one day.

One day, her mom said, "Lily, I have a surprise for you. We are going to the sea park. They have real dolphins there. You can watch them swim and play. Maybe you can even touch one."

Lily was so happy. She put on her sun hat and her swimsuit. She packed her toy dolphin and her book. She could not wait to see the sea park.

But when they got to the sea park, something was wrong. There were many people outside. They looked upset. They had signs that said, "Save the dolphins. Stop the sea park. The sea park is bad for the dolphins."

Lily did not understand. She asked her mom, "Mom, why are they upset? Why do they say the sea park is bad?"

Her mom said, "Lily, the sea park is not a good place for the dolphins. They keep them in small tanks. They make them do tricks for food. They spoil their lives. The dolphins are not happy here. They belong in the ocean, where they can swim freely and be with their families."

Lily felt sad. She did not want to see the dolphins in the sea park. She wanted to see them in the ocean. She said, "Mom, can we go to the ocean instead? Can we see the dolphins there?"

Her mom said, "Yes, Lily, we can. Maybe we can find a boat that can take us to see the dolphins. Maybe we can even hear them talk to each other. They make beautiful sounds, you know."

Lily smiled. She said, "That sounds wonderful, Mom. I love dolphins. I want them to be happy."

Her mom hugged her. She said, "I love you, Lily. You are a very kind and smart girl. Come on, let's go to the ocean."

One day, a little boy named Tom went to the park with his mom. He saw a big fountain with water and many shiny coins inside. He wanted to take some coins and put them in his pocket.

"Mom, can I have some coins?" he asked.

"No, Tom, those coins are not ours. They belong to the people who threw them in the fountain. They made a wish with them. It is not nice to take other people's things. You have to resist the temptation," his mom said.

"But they are so pretty and shiny. I want them," Tom said. He was not happy with his mom's answer.

He waited until his mom was looking at some flowers. Then he ran to the fountain and reached his hand inside. He grabbed a handful of coins and tried to pull them out.

But he did not see an elderly lady sitting on a bench near the fountain. She saw what Tom was doing and she was not happy. She got up and walked to Tom. She grabbed his arm and made him drop the coins.

"Hey, you little thief! What do you think you are doing? Those coins are not yours. You should be ashamed of yourself. How would you feel if someone took your toys or your candy?" she scolded him.

Tom was scared and ashamed. He started to cry. His mom heard him and came to see what was wrong. She saw the coins and the lady and she understood what happened. She apologized to the lady and thanked her for stopping Tom. She took Tom by the hand and walked away.

"Tom, I am very disappointed in you. You did a very bad thing. You did not listen to me and you tried to take something that was not yours. You hurt the lady's feelings and you broke the rules. You have to say sorry and learn from your mistake. Do you understand?" she said.

Tom nodded and sniffled. He felt sorry for what he did. He learned that he should not take other people's things and he should resist the temptation. He said sorry to his mom and the lady. He promised to be a good boy from now on. He learned a valuable lesson that day.

Once upon a time, there was a little man who loved avocados very much. Every day he went to the market to see what new avocados were for sale. One day, he found a very dirty avocado - it was so dirty he had to wash it. But the little man didn't mind - he was sure the avocado was still good on the inside.

He brought the avocado home and carefully peeled it open. He was so happy to find it was still perfect inside! With a beaming smile, the little man ate the avocado and enjoyed every bite.

When the little man was finished, he realised he had to share his happiness - and he wanted to support other little people who also loved avocados. So he went back to the market and bought more dirty avocados, so he could help others enjoy them too.

The little man shared his avocados with everyone and they all enjoyed them very much. Now the little man has become very famous in the neighbourhood! Everyone is so happy to have someone support them with delicious avocados.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Thomas. He was three years old and loved exploring. One day, he decided to take a walk around his neighbourhood.

As he was walking, Thomas came across an ugly junk yard. He was curious, so he went closer to have a look. He found lots of broken toys and furniture. He wanted to take everything home with him, but he only had small hands.

Suddenly, the owner of the junk yard appeared and shouted at Thomas for getting too close. He asked Thomas to leave, so Thomas quickly turned around and ran back home.

When Thomas arrived back at his house, he was sad he couldn't find any new toys in the junk yard. But then he remembered all the toys he had already at home. He smiled and went inside to play with them.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful dog named Spot. Spot loved to play fetch with his owner, Timmy. One day, Timmy and Spot went to the park to play. Timmy threw the ball, and Spot ran to get it. But when Spot came back, he saw a square hole in the ground.

Spot barked and said, "Timmy, look! There's a hole! Let's bury the ball!"

Timmy said, "No, Spot. We can't bury the ball. We need to take it home."

But Spot didn't listen. He dug a hole and buried the ball. Timmy was sad because he loved that ball. He said, "Spot, why did you bury the ball? Now we can't play with it anymore."

Spot felt bad. He said, "I'm sorry, Timmy. I didn't mean to be unhelpful. I just wanted to bury something."

But it was too late. The ball was lost forever. Timmy and Spot went home, and Timmy got a new ball. But Spot knew he had made a mistake, and he never buried anything again.

Jill liked to eat prunes. She liked how they were sweet and soft and good for her tummy. She always asked her mom for prunes when she was hungry.

One day, Jill saw a big bowl of prunes on the kitchen table. She ran to the table and grabbed a handful of prunes. She put them in her mouth and smiled.

"Jill, what are you doing?" her mom asked. She was surprised to see Jill eating so many prunes.

"I'm eating prunes, mom. They are yummy!" Jill said.

"Jill, you can't eat all the prunes. Those are for everyone. You have to share, honey." her mom said.

"No, mom. I want all the prunes. They are mine!" Jill said. She was angry and stubborn. She did not want to share. She demanded all the prunes.

"Jill, that's not nice. You have to be compassionate. Think about how other people feel. How would you feel if someone took all your toys?" her mom said.

Jill thought for a moment. She remembered how sad she was when her brother took her doll. She did not like that feeling. She looked at her mom and the bowl of prunes. She felt sorry.

"I'm sorry, mom. You are right. I have to be compassionate. I will share the prunes." Jill said.

She gave some prunes to her mom and some to her brother. They thanked her and smiled. Jill felt happy. She learned a lesson. She ate some prunes and gave some away. She was compassionate.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl, who was very careless. She always forgot to put away her toys and never tidied up her room. One day, she saw a pipe in her garden, and she decided to take it. She remembered that her mom had said not to take things without asking first, but she thought it was too pretty to pass up.

The little girl wanted to write her name on the pipe, so she found a marker in her room and carefully wrote her name on it. She was so pleased with her work, she showed it off to everyone.

The little girl was so careless with her pipe, she soon forgot about it. So when it was time for her to move to a new house, she couldn't find the pipe anywhere. She was so sad, and she wished she had taken better care of it. But even though she had lost her pipe, she would always treasure the memory of writing her name on it.

Tim and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to sort the leaves by color and shape. They made piles of red, yellow, green and brown leaves. They had fun throwing the leaves in the air and catching them.

"Look, Tim, I found a big stick!" Lily said, holding a long, thin branch. "Let's use it to make a fence for our leaves."

"OK, Lily, that's a good idea," Tim said. He took the stick from Lily and started to poke it into the ground. He made a line of holes around their piles of leaves.

But the stick was not a stick. It was a bone. A bone from a skeleton. A skeleton that was buried under the leaves. A skeleton that was angry and hungry.

The skeleton felt the bone moving. It woke up from its long sleep. It pulled the bone out of the ground. It saw Tim and Lily. It smiled with its big, white teeth.

"Hello, little ones," the skeleton said in a low, calm voice. "Do you want to play with me?"

Tim and Lily were scared. They screamed and ran away. But the skeleton was faster. It grabbed them with its bony hands. It dragged them under the leaves. It ate them up.

The end.

Once upon a time there were two sisters, Amy and Katie. They were very close friends and always had each other’s back. One day, they were walking along the beach when they suddenly saw a wild yacht! It was so shiny and beautiful.

The two sisters wanted to board the yacht, so they made their way to it. But, Amy stopped and said to her sister, “Wait, let’s not go too close to the yacht. It’s not ours and we don’t know who owns it. We’d better be safe!” So they took a step back and stayed far away.

Katie agreed with her sister and they went back home together. But Amy told her sister, “Remember, when we don’t know who something belongs to, it’s best just to stay away and be safe. That’s the moral of our adventure today!” Katie smiled and nodded.

The two sisters walked home hand in hand, happy to have stayed safe and close.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She loved animals and always had a big smile on her face. One day, her mommy and daddy took her on a special trip. They went on a safari to see all the animals Mia loved.

As they drove through the safari, Mia saw lions, elephants, and giraffes. She was so happy and excited. Her mommy and daddy were patient and let her watch the animals for a long time. Mia smiled and waved at the animals as they passed by.

At the end of the day, Mia was very tired but still smiling. She thanked her mommy and daddy for the best day ever. They all went home and Mia had sweet dreams about her new animal friends from the safari.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved holidays because he got to play with his toys all day long. One day, his mom told him they were going on a holiday to the beach. Timmy was very excited and packed all his favorite toys in his bag.

When they arrived at the beach, Timmy wanted to play in the water. But his mom said, "Not yet, we have to test the water first to make sure it's safe." Timmy didn't understand why they had to test the water, but he listened to his mom.

Later, when they went to the beach, Timmy saw a big sign that said, "Be Alert, Sharks in Water." He was scared and asked his mom if they could go home. But his mom said, "Don't worry, we tested the water and it's safe. We'll just stay close to the shore."

Timmy felt better and they had a great time playing in the water. He learned that sometimes we have to test things to make sure they're safe and be alert for any dangers.

Once there was a little boy named Billy. He was very patient and kind. One day he wanted to help his mom in the kitchen.

"Mommy, can I fix something for you?" Billy asked. His mom looked surprised.

"Sure, sweetheart. What do you want to fix?"
