The little girl knew that it wasn't normal, and she asked, "Can I have some?"

Mommy laughed and said, "No, you can't. Now let's go outside and enjoy our picnic."

The little girl smiled and said, "Ok!" and they went off to enjoy the sunny day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her colorful blocks. One day, she was building a tall tower with her blocks when her little brother, Jack, came to play with her.

"Can I play too?" Jack asked.

"Sure!" Lily said. "But be careful not to tap the tower or it will fall down."

Jack tried to balance the blocks on top of each other, but it was hard. Lily showed him how to do it and soon they had a big tower. They were so happy and proud of their tower.

Suddenly, the tower started to wobble and Jack got scared. "Oh no, it's going to fall!" he cried.

Lily quickly caught the tower and balanced it again. "Don't worry, Jack. I've got it!" she said with a smile. And they continued to play with their colorful blocks, building more towers and having fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a nice boy. His name was Mark. Mark had a football and he wanted to play with it. He asked his dad if it was ok. His dad said yes, and encouraged him to go play.

Mark was very excited and went outside to play. He kicked the football around for a while and had so much fun. He laughed when it went too far and he had to run after it.

When it started to get dark outside, Mark's dad came and asked him to come inside. He said it was time for bed. Mark was sad to leave his football, but his dad said he could play again soon.

Mark felt good knowing that his dad encouraged him to play with his football. He was happy as he went to bed that night.

Karen and her dad were in the kitchen, preparing dinner. Karen's dad was cutting the beef into small pieces. "Mmmm, I can't wait to eat the beef," Karen said, feeling excited.

"Me too," her dad replied, and gave her a hug. He then put the beef into the pan and started cooking it.

Karen sighed. She looked around the kitchen, which was very messy. "I wish I could help clean up, but I'm too little," she said sadly.

Her dad smiled, understanding how she felt. "Don't worry, we'll clean up the kitchen together once dinner is ready," he said.

Karen smiled and nodded. She went to help her dad cook the beef and waited patiently for dinner. Soon, the kitchen was full of delicious smells and they both enjoyed the delicious meal they had prepared together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a box of pastel colors that she loved to draw with. One day, she wanted to draw a picture of a castle, but she couldn't find her pastel box. She looked everywhere but couldn't find it.

Then, her mom came and helped her look. They searched and searched until they found the box. It was locked, but her mom had a key to unlock it. When they opened the box, Lily was so happy to see all her pastel colors again.

Lily was a modest girl and didn't like to show off her drawings. But when she drew the castle with her pastels, she couldn't help but show it to her mom. Her mom was so proud and told her she was a great artist. From that day on, Lily unlocked her creativity and drew many more beautiful pictures with her pastels.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a toy copper kite and loved it very much.

One day, Lucy took her kite out in the park to enjoy. She ran around the park, playing and having fun. Suddenly, the wind picked up and Lucy's kite flew away. She ran all around trying to catch it, but nothing seemed to work.

Just then, a friendly old man came along. He saw Lucy trying to catch the kite and said, "Don't worry my dear, here, take this kite. It's fit for the wind, and you can enjoy it better in the air".

The man gave Lucy a new kite. This time, it was fit even in strong winds! Lucy thanked the man and flew the kite high in the sky. She enjoyed herself and learned an important lesson: Good things come to those who have a fit attitude.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Daisy. Every morning she loved looking out of her window and watching the sunrise. She saw how the sky turned a beautiful orange colour.

One day, Daisy's best friend Molly came over to play. Daisy showed Molly the sunrise and they both watched together in awe. Daisy turned to Molly and said:

"Isn't the sunrise beautiful?".

Molly nodded, "I wish I could watch it every day."

Daisy smiled and told her friend, "You can come and watch it with me whenever you like!".

Molly felt envious, as she wanted to have a view like Daisy's every morning. Then Daisy gave Molly an idea.

"We can use my daddy's hosepipe to dry the grass so that we can lay on it and watch the sunrise!"

Molly agreed and the two girls spent the afternoon drying the grass with the hosepipe. The next morning, Daisy and Molly lay on the grass and watched the sunrise together. They were so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a graceful fountain. It sparkled in the sun and filled the air with a soft tinkling sound. Every day, a beautiful bird came to the fountain to take a bath. She enjoyed the water and the sun on her wings.

One day, the bird was so happy that she started to weep with joy. She was happy to be there in the sun, singing sweetly. But then her tears began to fill the fountain, and soon it was overflowing.

The other animals nearby were very surprised. They had never seen the fountain flood with such joy. The bird hopped from the fountain and rejoined her flock with a happy singing goodbye.

The fountain now overflows with joy every day, just like when the bird visited. It still sparkles in the sun and tinkles sweetly, but no one forgets the day when a graceful bird filled the fountain with its happy tears.

Once there was a baby and a cabinet. The baby saw the cabinet and was very happy. She wanted to go and play with it. She toddled over to the cabinet, tugging on its handle with her little hands. She opened the door, and was so amazed by what she saw inside.

The baby recognized something familiar inside the cabinet. It was her favourite toy! She was so excited to see it again and started to play with it.

Suddenly, the baby’s mom came into the room. She looked very angry and told the baby not to touch the cabinet. She sternly said that only grown-ups were allowed to use it.

The baby was sad and confused. She didn’t understand why she was not allowed to play with the cabinet. But she knew that her mom was angry and she didn’t want to make her mom any angrier, so she stopped playing with her toy and started to walk away from the cabinet.

The baby walked back over to her toy and picked it up. She knew she couldn’t play in the cabinet, but at least she could still play with her favourite toy.

Once there was a girl named Daisy. Daisy was out in the yard, looking around for something fun to do.

Then she saw something exciting. A mat! It was lying out in the east corner of the yard. It was smooth and bright, filled with colorful squares.

Daisy picked up the mat and took it to the grass. Then she started to put the squares together to form shapes and animals. She matched each one, until she had the perfect picture.

When Daisy was done, she was so happy. She ran to tell her mom what she had done. Daisy's mom smiled and said, "That looks so pretty. You did an amazing job!"

Daisy smiled and hugged the smooth mat. Then they went inside to get some ice cream as a treat. Daisy was so happy she had found the fun mat, and she would never forget the special moment they shared.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to watch things. He looked at buildings, clouds and birds. One day he saw a brilliant play happening in the park. All the kids were laughing and having fun. The little boy wanted to join in too.

So, he ran to the park and joined the play. The children laughed when they saw him, but welcomed him with open arms. He played some games and enjoyed every minute.

He watched the other children and tried to copy them. Then, he saw something really brilliant. One of the children had made a robot using sticks and stones, and it moved around all by itself. The little boy watched in amazement.

The playtime finally ended, and everyone said goodbye. The little boy went home, feeling happy, and couldn't wait to see what fun the next playtime would bring!

Once upon a time there was a powerful steam train. Every day it traveled up and down the track, making a lot of noise. It could go very fast, and it made lots of kids smile.

One day, the train stopped on the track and some little kids came to play with it. They were so happy and excited to be able to talk to the steam train. They wanted to make it go faster.

The kids got their daddy to help them. He was very strong and knew how to fix things. He filled the train with lots of steam from the ground. Then he pushed a button and made the powerful steam train go very fast.

The kids were thrilled and laughed as the train quickly whizzed by and was gone. They continued to play, pretending to be the steam train going fast up and down the track.

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl. She wanted to explore the world and see new things, so one day she left her home. She opened the gate and saw a new and exciting place. As she walked around she noticed many things and stumbled across a mysterious box.

The box opened, revealing an exciting surprise. Inside was a secret book, full of stories and drawings. The girl was so happy she could learn and explore all the new things the book had to offer!

The girl kept reading and exploring until she eventually came to a special page that was only available to brave explorers like her. On the page was a map, showing her the way back home. She followed the map and eventually made it back to the gate, safe and sound.

The brave little girl had revealed her own adventure and returned home, feeling happy and proud.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bear named Benny. Benny loved balloons and would often play with them in the forest. One day, Benny saw a group of animals having a party with lots of balloons. He wanted to join the party, but nobody invited him. Benny felt sad and left the party.

As he walked, he saw a bird who also looked sad. Benny invited the bird to play with him and his balloons. The bird was happy and they had fun together. But then, a mean fox came and tried to take their balloons. Benny and the bird didn't want to give them up, so they held on tight.

The fox got angry and started to chase them. Benny and the bird ran as fast as they could, but the fox was catching up. Just when they thought it was over, the other animals from the party appeared and scared the fox away. They apologized to Benny for not inviting him earlier and invited him to join their party. Benny was happy and felt loved. From then on, Benny and the bird were always invited to the animal parties, and they always had balloons to play with. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved flowers and wanted to grow her own. So, she planted a seed in her garden.

Every day, Lily would water the seed and be careful not to step on it. She would ask her mom, "When will it bloom?"

Her mom would say, "On Tuesday, it will bloom."

Lily was very excited and waited patiently for Tuesday. Finally, Tuesday arrived and the flower bloomed beautifully.

Lily learned that with patience and care, beautiful things can grow. She was very happy and proud of her flower.

Once upon a time there lived two furry friends - a bear and a rabbit. The two friends lived far away from each other and had never met before.

One day, the two decided that they wanted to meet so they united in a nearby field of flowers. In the sunlight, they saw how popular they could be. Other animals were quickly drawn to their fur and happy personalities, and they all made lots of new friends.

The bear and rabbit were so happy that they decided to reunite in the same field every weekend. They invited their new friends, and the group of animals grew and grew.

Still today, the bear, the rabbit and their new friends meet in the field every weekend, and all their friends are happy to unite and play together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved going to the gym. She would run and jump and play with all her friends. One day, Lily's mom noticed that Lily was being very stubborn and didn't want to go to the gym anymore.

Mom: "Lily, why don't you want to go to the gym today?"

Lily: "I don't like the gym anymore. It's boring."

Mom: "But Lily, you used to love going to the gym. What changed?"

Lily: "I don't know. I just don't like it anymore."

Mom: "Well, how about we try something new at the gym today? Maybe we can change it up and make it more fun."

Lily thought about it for a moment and decided to give it another try. When they got to the gym, Lily's mom showed her some new exercises and games to play. Lily had so much fun that she forgot all about being stubborn and not wanting to go to the gym. From that day on, Lily looked forward to going to the gym again and trying new things.

Sara and Ben were best friends. They liked to play pretend games in the park. One day, they decided to play marriage. They found some flowers and a ring made of grass. Sara put the ring on Ben's finger and said, "Now you are my husband and I am your wife. We have to love each other and share everything."

Ben nodded and smiled. He liked Sara very much. He gave her a hug and said, "You are my wife and I am your husband. We have to be kind and help each other."

They played happily for a while, until they saw a big dog running towards them. The dog looked angry and scary. Sara and Ben were afraid. They ran away from the dog, but they dropped the ring and the flowers.

The dog stopped and sniffed the ring and the flowers. He liked them. He picked them up with his mouth and ran away with them.

Sara and Ben were sad. They lost their ring and their flowers. They felt guilty. They thought they broke their marriage.

They looked at each other and said, "I'm sorry. I love you."

They hugged each other and felt better. They decided to make a new ring and new flowers. They said, "We are still husband and wife. We don't need a ring and flowers to show it. We have each other."

Once upon a time there was a hammer. It was very boring and it never moved. One day it got tired of being so still, so it asked for help.

The hammer saw a burning fire and it shouted out, "Can you help me?" Right away, the fire said, "Yes! I can burn you so you can move."

The hammer was excited but also a little scared. But the fire was very gentle, and soon it was burning the hammer in a nice and warm way.

Soon enough, the hammer was moving and it was having lots of fun. As it danced around the fire, it realized the fire had given it a magical power.

Suddenly, the hammer had the power to make all sorts of things out of wood and metal. From chairs to toys and even hammers - all made with its own special burning power.

The hammer was so pleased with its new life. It finally had something to do, instead of just sitting around being boring!

Billy and his mom were in the living room. His mom was sitting down while he was standing. Then he spotted something soft. It was a cushion. He walked over to it, picked it up and gave it a big hug. The cushion felt so soft and he liked it so much.

His mom said, "Do you want to sit down and try it out?" Billy was so excited. He sat down on the cushion and it was like he was sitting on a cloud. The cushion was so soft and he felt so comfy.

He liked it so much he decided to stay there. He stayed sitting on the cushion for a long time, until his mom told him it was time for dinner. He said goodbye to the cushion and stood up. He was sure he would visit the cushion again soon!

Once upon a time, there was a bell. It was round and made of shiny metal. It was so thick that it was hard to move.

One day, a boy was playing in the snow. It was so cold that everything was freezing. Suddenly, he heard a sound. It was coming from the bell!

The boy decided to take the bell to his house. When he did, he saw a tiny bird inside! The bird had been cold, so it had frozen.

The boy was happy when the bird thawed and flew away. He was even happier that the bell was now free to make its happy sound!

Once, there was a girl named Susie who liked to play outside. She had a big garden with lots of wonderful things to explore and discover. One day, Susie noticed something high in the sky. It was so high that she had to use her mouth to try and reach it. She started to blow and blow and blow, and then something happened! All of a sudden, Susie was in the sky!

Susie was so excited! She flew from one place to another, so high above the ground. Everywhere she saw new things that she had never seen before. She saw funny animals, big old trees and big balls of bright light in the sky.

Susie had so much fun! After a while, she used her mouth again to blow and blow and blow until she was back on the ground again. She ran inside to tell everyone what she had seen and everyone was amazed.

From then on, Susie loved to use her mouth to blow things high in the sky. She had so much fun exploring the world around her.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a toy pipe that he liked to play with. The pipe was very popular with all of his friends, and they all wanted to play with it too.

One day, Timmy and his friends were playing at the park when they saw two birds fighting in the sky. They all looked up and saw the birds flying around and making lots of noise. Timmy thought it looked like fun, so he pretended to fight with his friends too.

After they finished playing, Timmy went home and showed his mom the pipe. She thought it was a nice toy, but reminded him to be careful with it. Timmy promised to take good care of it and put it away in his toy box.

From that day on, Timmy and his friends played with the pipe every day. They never fought over it because they knew they could all have a turn. And whenever they saw birds fighting in the sky, they would pretend to fight too, just like Timmy did that day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the grass. One day, she found a big bucket and decided to fill it up with grass. She was very creative and made a beautiful crown out of the grass.

Lily wore her grass crown all day and showed it to all her friends. They thought it was so pretty and wanted to make their own grass crowns too. So, Lily helped her friends fill their buckets with grass and they all made creative crowns together.

From that day on, Lily and her friends loved to play in the grass and make all sorts of creative things. And whenever they saw a bucket, they knew they could fill it up with grass and make something new and fun. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a baby. The baby wanted to go for a walk, so mummy and daddy put her in a big heavy crib. They pushed the crib and it passed by all the other toys. It rolled and rolled, until it stopped by the window. The baby looked out, watching the bright and sunny world outside. She laughed and giggled and waved her tiny hands. But mummy and daddy said it was time to come back inside. Daddy picked up the heavy crib and passed it back to the bedroom. The baby said goodbye to the world outside, and said hello to the warm cuddly crib. Then mummy tucked the baby in and gave her a big kiss, and that's how the baby had her lovely walk.

Ben and Mia are friends. They like to play with cardboard. They make a big house with cardboard. They cut windows and doors. They draw flowers and trees. They are happy.

They want to show their house to Mom and Dad. They call them. Mom and Dad come to see. They say, "Wow, what a nice house! You are very clever!" They applaud. Ben and Mia smile.

But then, a bald man comes. He is angry. He says, "This is my cardboard! You took it from my shop! You are very naughty!" He grabs the cardboard. He tears it apart. He throws it away. He leaves.

Ben and Mia are sad. They cry. Their house is gone. Mom and Dad are sorry. They hug them. They say, "We are sorry. The bald man was very mean. We will find you more cardboard. We will help you make a new house. We love you." But Ben and Mia are still sad. They do not want a new house. They want their old house. They do not like the bald man. The end.

Once upon a time there was a wise old man. He carried a cane and he always had a smile on his face.

One day, the man set his cane down and he started to walk. He walked a long way until he saw a lake. He settled down by the lake and looked up at the sky.

The wise old man stayed at the lake for a long time. He watched the birds flying and the fish swimming. The man settled into the calmness and enjoyed the peace of nature.

But then one day, a storm came and it knocked the man's cane into the lake. The old man tried to dive in and find it, but it was too deep. He was sad and he knew he wouldn't get home without it.

Suddenly, a fish swam up and put the man's cane in his hand. It was amazing! The wise old man was so grateful.

He thanked the fish and then settled back by the lake, this time with his cane. He rested there until the storm passed.

The wise old man was happy to have his cane and he went back home with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and run around in the park. One day, she heard a loud bell ringing. It was coming from the old, scary house next door.

Lily was curious, so she went to take a look. She saw a man inside the house ringing the bell and shouting loudly. It was very scary, and Lily felt afraid. She ran back to her house and told her mommy what she saw.

Her mommy called the police, and they went to the scary house. But when they got there, it was too late. The man had hurt himself and the bell had stopped ringing. Lily felt sad and scared, but her mommy hugged her and told her everything would be okay. From that day on, Lily never went near the scary house again.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play together. But sometimes they also liked to fight over toys and food. One day, they had pasta for lunch and their mom gave them each a fork to eat with.

Lily wanted to have Ben's fork because it was blue and shiny. She said, "Give me your fork, Ben. It is nicer than mine."

Ben said, "No, Lily. This is my fork. You have your own fork. It is yellow and pretty."

Lily did not listen to Ben. She tried to grab his fork from his hand. Ben did not let go of his fork. He pulled it back and said, "Stop it, Lily. You are selfish. You always want what I have."

They started to fight over the fork. They tugged and pushed and shouted. Their mom heard them and came to the kitchen. She saw them fighting and was angry. She said, "Lily and Ben, what are you doing? Why are you fighting over a fork? You have the same food and the same plates. You should share and be nice to each other."

She took the forks from them and gave them each a spoon instead. She said, "Now, eat your pasta with a spoon. And say sorry to each other. Fighting is not good. It makes you and others unhappy."

Lily and Ben felt sorry for fighting. They said sorry to each other and hugged. They ate their pasta with a spoon and did not fight anymore. They learned to be happy with what they had and to share with each other. Their mom was proud of them and gave them a kiss.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved flowers. She had a little garden where she grew a lot of beautiful flowers, but her favorite was a little rose. Every day, she would go to her garden and water her little rose with a big smile on her face.

One day, she went to her garden to check on her little rose, but she discovered that it was gone! She looked everywhere, but she couldn't find it. She was so sad and started to cry.

Later that day, her mom told her that a little boy from the neighborhood had taken her little rose. The little girl was very angry and went to the little boy's house to get her little rose back. However, the little boy had already destroyed her little rose. The little girl was heartbroken and cried all day.

From that day on, the little girl never trusted anyone again and stopped growing flowers in her little garden.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play outside and see all the pretty flowers. One day, she saw a skunk and it sprayed a stinky smell. Lily did not like it and ran away.

Lily went to school and saw her friend Johnny. Johnny had a tasty snack, it was a yummy apple. Lily asked him if she could have a bite, and it was very tasty. They went to class and saw their teacher, who was a nice lady. The teacher had big pupils, and Lily thought they looked like circles.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went to visit her friend, Tommy. They played together for a while until Tommy said, "Lily, I saw a ghost in my room last night!" Lily got scared and asked, "What did the ghost look like?" Tommy said, "It was big and white, and it floated around my room."

Lily didn't believe Tommy, so she went to his room to check it out. She saw nothing, but Tommy insisted that the ghost was there. Lily said, "Tommy, you're deaf. Maybe you heard a noise, but it wasn't a ghost." Tommy said, "No, no, I saw it! It was real!"

Lily didn't know what to do, so she suggested they count the number of ghosts they saw. They looked around the room and found zero ghosts. Tommy was disappointed, but Lily was relieved. They continued to play and forgot all about the ghost.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Henry. He was three-years old and he loved skipping. Every day, Henry's mom gave him an cookies as a snack.

One day, Henry got two cookies. He smiled and started to skip around the house. As he skipped, one of the cookies fell and broke into smithereens.

Henry started to cry. He looked around to make sure his Mom couldn't see him, but she had already seen what had happened.

"Oh, Henry," said his Mom softly. "It is ok. Let's go get another cookie."

Henry stopped crying and smiled. He put the other cookie into his pocket and they both went out to the store to get another cookie.

At the store, Henry chose his favorite cookie and he skipped all the way home with his mom. When he got home, he ate the cookie and shared the other cookie with his Mom.

Henry was so happy and he never stopped skipping.

Lily and Sam liked to play with their toys. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big gorilla. The gorilla was soft and brown and had a funny face. They hugged the gorilla and made it talk and jump.

One day, they went to the store with their mom. The store had many things, like food and clothes and books. But Lily and Sam only wanted to see the toys. They ran to the toy aisle and looked at all the colorful and shiny toys.

There, they saw a new gorilla. The new gorilla was bigger and blacker and had a scary face. It made loud noises and moved its arms and legs. Lily and Sam wanted the new gorilla. They asked their mom to buy it for them.

But their mom said no. She said they already had a gorilla at home, and they did not need another one. She said the new gorilla was too expensive and too noisy. She said they had to be happy with what they had.

Lily and Sam were sad and angry. They did not want to leave the store. They did not want to go back to their old gorilla. They were jealous of the new gorilla. They cried and kicked and screamed.

Their mom was not happy. She took them by the hand and dragged them out of the store. She said they were being naughty and rude. She said they had to say sorry and be nice to their old gorilla.

Lily and Sam did not say anything. They pouted and looked at the ground. They did not want to say sorry. They did not want to be nice. They wanted the new gorilla. They wished they had the new gorilla.

Fred was a robot who lived on a planet far away. He loved to go on adventures and one day he wanted to explore. He put on his running shoes and began to jog. He thought it would be a nice day for running.

As he jogged, he looked up at the sky and saw an enormous planet. It was so big and sparkly that he wanted to go and see it. Fred ran even faster and eventually he got to the enormous planet.

When he arrived, he felt so excited! He wanted to explore the planet. He looked around and said, “Hello? Anyone home?” Suddenly, he heard a voice from the sky. “Hi Fred, I’m here!” Fred looked up and saw a giant smiling at him. The giant said, “Welcome to my planet – let’s explore together!”

Fred and the giant had a wonderful time exploring the enormous planet. They ran and jogged around the planet, discovering new things and having great adventures. Fred was so happy and grateful to have found this amazing planet. He couldn’t wait to come back and explore it again!

Once upon a time, there was a little ant named Andy. Andy was very lonely because he had no friends. One day, he saw a big and strong ant carrying a tool. Andy asked, "What is that tool for?" The big ant replied, "It's for digging tunnels."

Andy was fascinated by the tool, and he asked the big ant if he could borrow it. The big ant agreed, but warned Andy to be careful. Andy took the tool and started to crawl into the ground. He dug and dug until he found a big room filled with other ants.

The other ants were amazed by Andy's tool and invited him to stay with them. Andy was no longer lonely and made many new friends. From that day on, he used the tool to help his new ant friends dig tunnels and create new homes.

Once upon a time there were two bears. One was named Peter and the other was named Lime. Peter was a big, strong bear with lots of nice fur. Lime was a little, ugly bear and had only a few patches of fur.

One day, Peter and Lime decided to number. Together they counted to ten, but then Lime got confused. He couldn't remember the numbers, so he started to cry.

Peter saw that Lime was feeling sad, so he gave him a big hug. "Don't worry," he said. "I will help you learn the numbers." Peter slowly counted the numbers again, starting with one. He helped Lime count up to ten.

Once Lime had learned all the numbers, he was so happy. He thanked Peter and gave him a big hug. "You are the best, Peter," he said.

With a smile, Peter replied: "It was my pleasure, Lime. Let's count together again soon!"

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Timmy and Tommy. They both loved to play with toys and share them with each other. One day, Timmy found a shiny crown in his toy chest. He was so happy and wanted to show it to Tommy.

When Timmy showed the crown to Tommy, Tommy accidentally dropped it and it broke into pieces. Timmy was sad and said, "Oh no! My crown is broken." Tommy felt bad and said, "I'm sorry, Timmy. Let me help you fix it."

Together, they worked on fixing the crown and were able to share it again. Timmy and Tommy learned that sharing and helping each other is important and makes them both happy.

Alice was out with her mom in the park. It was a beautiful day and Alice was so happy to be outside. She saw something that made her giggle. It was a big structure with lots of leafy green plants. The structure looked like a castle.

Alice's mom told her to kneel down so she could see it better. Alice got down on her knees and put her hands on the structure. It felt really cool to the touch. She felt a little bit scared at first, but then she realized that it was friendly and happy.

Alice's mom was also kneeling beside her and said, "Do you like it? It's very helpful to the environment." Alice thought that sounded nice and she liked how the structure looked. She even wanted to climb on it, but her mom said it wasn't allowed.

Alice and her mom stayed kneeling down for a while and just looked at the structure. Alice felt very special to share that moment with her mom. It was a moment she would never forget!

Anna and Ben are playing pirates in the garden. They have a big box for a ship, a stick for a sword and a map for treasure. The map shows them where to dig in the sand.

"Arrr, matey, we are almost there!" Ben says, looking at the map. "The treasure is under the big red X!"

Anna nods and follows him with her shovel. They find the spot and start digging. They dig and dig, but they do not find anything.

"Maybe the map is wrong," Anna says, feeling sad.

"Or maybe someone else took the treasure," Ben says, feeling angry.

They hear a noise behind them. They turn around and see a big dog. The dog is black and has a red bandana around its neck. It is holding something shiny in its mouth.

"Look, it's the treasure!" Ben shouts. "It's a gold coin!"

The dog growls and barks. It does not want to share the coin.

"Give us the treasure, you scurvy dog!" Ben says, waving his stick. "Or we will make you walk the plank!"

The dog barks louder and shows its teeth. It does not yield the coin.

Anna feels scared. She sees that the dog is bigger and stronger than them. She also sees that the dog has a collar with a name tag. It says "Spot".

"Ben, stop!" Anna says, pulling his arm. "The dog is not a pirate, it's a pet! Maybe it belongs to someone who lives here. Maybe they are looking for it. We should not fight with it, we should be nice to it."

Ben looks at Anna. He sees that she is pale and shaking. He also sees that the dog is not happy. He thinks that Anna is right.

"Okay, okay," Ben says, lowering his stick. "We are sorry, Spot. We did not mean to make you angry. You can keep the coin. It is yours."

The dog stops growling and barking. It wags its tail and licks Ben's hand. It likes Ben and Anna.

"Good boy, Spot," Anna says, petting the dog. "You are a good dog. Do you want to play with us?"

The dog barks and nods. It wants to play with them.

Anna and Ben smile and hug the dog. They forget about the treasure and the map. They have a new friend. They are happy.

Once upon a time there was a sad little girl. She felt so lonely and sad, but she didn't know why.

One day, she decided to try and find some friends. She asked her mom if she could please go to an event. Her mom said yes and the little girl was so excited!

When she arrived, the girl met so many new people and made lots of friends. Everyone was so friendly and it made her so happy.

Unfortunately, there was one mean person at the event. He was very bitter and shouted at her and her friends. She felt so scared and sad.

The little girl tried to be brave and asked the mean man to please stop shouting. To her surprise, he apologised and became nice.

The little girl realised that even the meanest people can change and that made her very happy. From then on, she was never sad or lonely again!

One day a tall bird was sitting in a tree. It looked up at the sky and decided to dive. It spread its wings wide and took off.

The bird flew higher and higher, until it was almost touching the sky. Suddenly, something strange happened. A big net came down from the sky and caught the bird. It couldn't break free!

The bird called out to someone, "Help! I'm stuck!" But nobody could hear it.

Eventually, the bird stopped struggling, and the net went back up to the sky. The poor bird flew away, never to be seen again.

Once upon a time there was a small dog called Spot. Spot was a very spoiled pup, who liked to eat lots of treats.

One day, Spot was having a good time when his collar buckle suddenly broke. Spot was surprised! He tried to fix it, but he couldn't.

"What's wrong, Spot?" his owner said.

"My buckle broke!" Spot replied.

His owner looked at the broken buckle and sighed. He knew he had to find a new one.

He went to the pet shop and bought a new buckle for Spot. Spot was so happy when he saw it!

His owner put the buckle on Spot's collar and soon he was up and playing again. Spot was so thankful that his owner was able to get a new buckle for him.

Mummy was talking to Grandma on the telephone. Grandma was asking questions from far away.

Mummy explained, "It's a very long cord that stretches from here to Grandma's house so we can talk. It's a special cord."

Teddy, a three-year-old, was watching with wide eyes. He was jealous of the cord. He wanted one!

Mummy said, "Now Teddy, your Grandma is so far away we can't just drive to her house. But when she talks to us on the telephone it's like she's right here."

Teddy was very excited. He wanted to play with the cord!

Mummy explained, "We can't play with the cord Teddy. It's too special. We just use it to talk to Grandma, but it won't last forever. That's why we have to talk to each other as much as we can."

Teddy smiled and hugged his Mummy, happy to have her close. He wasn't jealous of the cord anymore, now he understood its purpose.

Once upon a time, there was a lady who lived far away in a distant place. One day, she wanted to reach the moon, so she put on her special space hat and jumped very high. She jumped and jumped and jumped, until she was high enough to touch the shimmering moon.

When she got back down to earth, the lady was so excited. She wanted to show everyone what she did! So she went to tell the other people. She spotted a little boy in the park and ran to him with a big smile on her face.

The little boy was amazed by her story. He asked the lady to help him reach the moon too! She told him not to worry because she knew just what to do. She took his hand and instructed him to jump really high, up in the sky.

The boy jumped and jumped, until he was beside the lady, high up in the sky. He pointed to the moon and the lady laughed. He had reached his goal and was so proud of himself. They both enjoyed the view from the distant place, until the little boy got too tired and returned to the ground. He waved goodbye to the lady and thanked her for helping him reach the moon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, but her room was always messy with lots of junk on the floor. Her mom would always tell her to clean up her room, but Lily didn't like to do it.

One day, Lily's friend came over to play. When she saw the mess in Lily's room, she said, "Wow, your room is so messy! Can we play with your toys?"

Lily felt embarrassed and didn't want her friend to see her room like that, so she decided to clean it up. She started to pick up the junk and put it in a box. It was hard work, but she kept going until her room was clean.

After she finished, Lily felt really proud of herself. She said to her friend, "Look at my room now! It's not messy anymore. I don't feel dizzy when I look at it."

Her friend smiled and said, "You did a great job, Lily! Now we can play with your toys without any junk in the way."

Lily learned that it's important to clean up after yourself and keep your things in order. She felt happy that she had done the right thing and made her mom proud.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Joanna. Joanna lived in a village near a big mill. Every day, Joanna would go to the mill and watch the farmers as they worked hard to make flour.

One day, Joanna dared to venture into the mill. It was very noisy and she was a bit scared, but she was also a bit curious. As she walked around the mill, she noticed a small flutter of wings coming from one corner of the room.

Joanna cautiously stepped closer and found a small bird perched on an old crate. The bird seemed to be hurt.

Joanna smiled and said to the bird, “I will help you. Don’t be afraid.” Sharing a small piece of bread from her pocket, the bird quickly got better.

After a few crunchy bites, the bird was feeling much better! Joanna was so grateful that she had been able to help the bird.

The bird looked up at Joanna and said: “Thank you for helping me. Let’s be friends!”

Joanna grinned and said, “Yes, let’s be friends!”

And they lived happily ever after.

Anna loved to help her mom in the kitchen. She liked to stir the pot of soup, smell the spices, and taste the carrots. Mom was generous and always gave Anna a spoonful of soup to try.

One day, Anna wanted to surprise her mom with a special gift. She found a small pot in the cupboard and filled it with water. Then she added some salt, pepper, and sugar from the table. She stirred the pot with a wooden spoon and put it on the stove.

"Mom, I made you something!" Anna called out.

Mom came into the kitchen and saw the pot on the stove. She smiled and hugged Anna.

"Thank you, sweetie, what did you make?" Mom asked.

"I made you soup, Mom. I used water and salt and pepper and sugar. Do you want to try it?" Anna said proudly.

Mom looked at the pot and saw the water was boiling and bubbling. She turned off the stove and took the pot off the heat.

"Wow, Anna, you are very creative. But you know, we have to be careful when we use the stove. It can be very hot and dangerous. Next time, you can ask me to help you, okay?" Mom said gently.

"Okay, Mom. I'm sorry. I just wanted to make you happy. I love you, Mom." Anna said.

"I love you too, Anna. And I appreciate your generous gift. But you know what? I think this soup is too spicy and sweet for me. Maybe we can share it with the birds outside. They might like it more." Mom suggested.

"Okay, Mom. Let's do that. Maybe the birds will love it too." Anna agreed.

They poured the soup into a bowl and took it outside. They put the bowl on the grass and watched as the birds came and pecked at the soup. Anna and Mom laughed and clapped as they saw the birds enjoy the soup.

"See, Anna, you made the birds happy too. You are a very kind and generous girl. And I love you very much." Mom said.

"I love you too, Mom. And I love the birds. And I love the soup. And I love the pot." Anna said.

Once there was a girl named Jane who loved to eat delicious food. One day, Jane was eating some spicy noodles and she decided to leave them in the closet. Jane thought she would come back later and finish them, but she forgot all about them.

Days went by and Jane had all but forgotten about the noodles in the closet. Then one day, she smelled something strange coming from her closet. Jane opened the door and saw that the once spicy noodles were now hot and humid in her closet.

Jane had to leave the hot and humid noodles in the closet, because they were no longer safe to eat. She was so sad that she had to leave the delicious noodles behind.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a happy dog named Max. Max loved to eat bones and play with his toys. One day, Max was walking in the park when he heard a voice. It was a little girl who was crying. Max went to her and said, "Why are you sad?" The little girl said, "I lost my toy and I can't find it." Max said, "Don't worry, I will help you find it."

Max and the little girl looked and looked for the toy. Suddenly, Max saw the toy under a tree. He barked cheerfully and said, "I found it!" The little girl was so happy and she hugged Max. She said, "Thank you, Max. You are my hero!" Max smiled and said, "You're welcome. Now, let's go eat some bones together." And they walked away happily, enjoying their new friendship.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom was three years old and he loved playing outside. One day, Tom and his mum decided to go to the park to play.

Tom's mum said "Tom, let's go to the park and pay on the enormous ear we will find!" Tom was very excited and couldn't wait to visit the park.

When they got to the park they found the biggest ear Tom had ever seen! It was very soft and inviting. Tom said "Wow, mum! That ear looks enormous!"

His mum smiled and said "Go ahead, Tom! Pay on it!" So Tom jumped onto the ear and it was so much bigger than he expected. He bounced higher than ever before and had so much fun.

His mum said "It looks like you're having an enormous amount of fun, Tom!" Tom smiled and replied tearfully "Yes mum, I am. This is the best pay ever!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bears. One day, Lily's mommy took her to a park. In the park, there was a big club where people played games. Lily saw a boy playing with a ball and asked her mommy, "Can I play too?"

Her mommy said, "Sure, but we have to find something safe for you to play with." They found a matching ball for Lily to play with. She was so happy! She played with the ball and made new friends. One of her new friends said, "Let's play a game with the ball. We have to match the colors of the ball with the colors of the flowers."

Lily liked the game and said, "Okay, let's do it!" They played the game and Lily won. She was so proud of herself. She said, "Thank you for playing with me. I had so much fun!" Her new friends said, "We had fun too. Let's play again sometime." And they all smiled and laughed together.

Jack and Ted were best friends, and they loved to play together each day. They were walking in the park when they saw a skull lying on the ground.

"What's that?" asked Jack.

"That looks like a skull," Ted said.

"Let's mark it with a piece of string," Jack said.

The boys found some string and Jack tied it around the original skull.

"Now everyone will know it's here," Jack said.

Ted nodded in agreement. Then they continued their walk in the park, happy they had made a mark to remember that they had found a skull.

Once upon a time, there was a little star. The star lived high in the sky. The star liked to lean on the moon and watch the world below. The star was friends with the moon and they talked every night.

One day, the star saw a loud bird. The bird was singing a happy song. The star wanted to sing too. The star asked the moon, "Can I sing like the bird?" The moon said, "You can try, little star."

So, the star tried to sing. It was not loud like the bird, but it was a pretty sound. The star was happy. The star and the moon sang together every night. And the world below listened to their sweet songs.

Once upon a time, a great cup was sitting on the table. It was golden and sparkly and it made the room look even more special.

The cup felt like it had something special inside of it, something that made it very happy.

Suddenly, a three year old came into the room. The little one saw the cup and smiled. She liked the way it shined and sparkled.

The three year old went and got her favorite toy and put it inside the cup. She wanted to make sure it was safe so she closed the cup tight.

The little one wanted to make sure no one else would take her toy away. She was so happy that the cup was so great and had made her toy safe. And from that day on, the cup was always by her side.

Once upon a time, there was a tall giraffe named Jerry. Jerry loved to jump around and play with his friends. One day, Jerry was playing with his friends when he saw a teaspoon on the ground.

"What is that?" Jerry asked his friend, the monkey.

"It's a teaspoon," the monkey replied.

Jerry had never seen a teaspoon before, so he picked it up and looked at it closely.

"It's so small," Jerry said. "I'm so tall, I could probably fit a hundred teaspoons on my head!"

All of Jerry's friends laughed and agreed. They spent the rest of the day playing and jumping around, with Jerry holding the teaspoon in his mouth. It was a fun day for everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. She was three years old, and she lived in a big house with her mom and dad. One day, Daisy's dad took her outside to play. She was excited! Her dad had a rake and was ready to support her in tidying up the garden.

Daisy began to use the rake, but soon felt scared. She looked around and noticed a strange animal in the bushes. She asked her dad, "What is that animal?"

Her dad smiled and said, "It's just a little bunny rabbit. Don't worry, he won't hurt you."

But Daisy was still afraid. She decided to stop using the rake and stay close to her dad.

Suddenly, the bunny rabbit hopped out of the bushes and right up to Daisy. She felt surprised, but then realized it was not so scary. Dad had been right about the bunny rabbit.

Daisy went back to raking and was so proud of herself for overcoming her fear. Her dad was very proud too. He supported her the whole time, and Daisy was thankful for it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and run around outside. One day, Timmy's mommy asked him to help move some furniture in the living room. Timmy didn't want to help because he thought it was silly to move furniture around.

"Timmy, can you please help me move this chair?" asked his mommy.

Timmy shrugged his shoulders and said, "I don't want to, mommy. It's too heavy."

"It's okay, Timmy. I'll help you. We can move it together," said his mommy.

Timmy and his mommy worked together to move the furniture. It was hard work, but they did it! Timmy was proud of himself for helping his mommy. From that day on, Timmy didn't think moving furniture was silly anymore.

Once there was a loyal dog. He liked to sit in the garden and that is where he would pass most of his days. One day, however, he saw an old man walking towards him with a cane in his hand. The dog got scared and started barking at the man. The man tried to calm him down by saying gentle words, but the dog wouldn't stop barking.

Finally, the man had had enough and he started to run after the dog with his cane. The dog was spooked and wanted to escape, but he was also loyal. He couldn't just run away from the old man. He decided to sit and stay loyal as the old man walked closer and closer.

Luckily, when the old man got to him, he wasn't angry at all. He put his cane away and gave the dog lots of cuddles and treats. From that day on, the loyal dog and the old man were always together in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a princess. She had lots of things to do, but she was bored. She wanted to do something different. The princess thought of a great idea. She decided to make an unusual thing. She gathered lots of things and started to make her unusual thing. She mixed and stirred, and put together lots of pieces. After a while, the princess finished making her unusual thing. She was very proud of what she had made. She showed everyone her unusual thing. The princess and everyone else were so happy! They were amazed at what the princess had made. From that day on, the princess made lots of unusual things. Everytime she made something she felt very proud and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a fragile butterfly. It flapped its wings and repeated the same flight path each day. It flew around the same blooming flowers, and over the same pond of still water.

The butterfly had a special friend, a little mouse. Everyday they would sit in the quiet silence of the garden and whisper secrets to each other.

One day, however, the mouse wanted to explore and set off to find new paths in the meadow. The butterfly repeated its same journey around the garden, but no matter how hard it tried, the mouse never returned.

The butterfly repeated its journey without its special friend, but the silence of the garden seemed even louder without its companion. The butterfly was sad, but it kept flying, hoping that the mouse might one day come back.

The butterfly kept strong and repeated its same flight path, until one day the mouse finally returned. The fragile butterfly was so happy that its special friend had returned, and from then on they would never let each other go.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys in the living room. There is a big armchair in the living room. Lily and Ben both want to sit on the armchair. It is soft and cozy.

One day, Lily finds a hat in the closet. It is a red hat with a feather. Lily thinks it is pretty. She puts it on her head and runs to the living room. She sees the armchair is empty. She jumps on it and says, "Look at me! I have a hat! I am the queen of the armchair!"

Ben sees Lily on the armchair. He is jealous. He wants to sit on the armchair too. He wants to wear the hat too. He says, "No, you are not the queen! Give me the hat! It is my turn to sit on the armchair!"

Lily and Ben start to fight. They pull the hat and the armchair. They yell and cry. They make a lot of noise.

Mom hears the noise. She comes to the living room. She sees Lily and Ben fighting. She is not happy. She says, "Stop it, both of you! You are not being nice to each other. You have to share the hat and the armchair. Or you have to play with something else. Do you understand?"

Lily and Ben nod. They are sorry. They say, "Yes, Mom. We understand. We are sorry."

Mom smiles. She says, "Good. Now, why don't you take turns wearing the hat and sitting on the armchair? And you can also play with your other toys. There are plenty of them. How about that?"

Lily and Ben agree. They say, "Okay, Mom. That sounds good."

They hug Mom and say, "We love you, Mom."

Mom hugs them back and says, "I love you too, Lily and Ben."

One day, two friends had an object. It was charming! They laughed as they looked at it, and their eyes sparkled. They wanted to find something special to do with their object, so they decided to take it to the park to share their joy.

When they arrived, they saw how the trees swayed in the gentle breeze and the leaves glowed in the sun. They were mesmerized. The two friends felt so lucky to have such a charming object to share.

They took turns playing with it. They jumped and hopped and spun around, enjoying every moment. Soon they realized it was almost time to go home.

But they didn't want that special moment to end. So they agreed to meet up again with the object at their favorite park. And they did, time and time again, never forgetting the happiness they felt when they had the charming object in their hands.

Once there was a nosy girl who loved to care for others. She always wore a special scarf around her neck. Every day she did something to care for someone else. One day, she found a puppy who was cold and alone. She wrapped him in her scarf and brought him home. She cared for the puppy, giving him lots of love and food.

Soon the puppy was happy and no longer cold. The nosy girl was so happy because she had been able to care for the animal. From then on, she would always wear the same scarf so she could remember how much she had been able to help the puppy.

The nosy girl continued to be nosy but always used her nosiness to care for others. She found more animals who needed help and she gave them a scarf for warmth. Whenever she cared for another creature, she added a stitch to her scarf. Now her scarf is filled with memories of all the caring things she has done.

Tom and Mia liked to swim in the pool. They wore swim suits and goggles. They splashed and kicked and had fun.

One day, they saw a new boy sitting on the edge of the pool. He looked sad and scared. He did not have a swim suit or goggles.

"Hi, what is your name?" Tom asked the boy.

"I am Sam," the boy said in a small voice.

"Do you want to swim with us?" Mia asked.

"I don't know how to swim," Sam said. "I am afraid of the water."

Tom and Mia were thoughtful. They wanted to help Sam. They had an idea.

"We can teach you how to swim," Tom said. "We can hold your hand and show you how to float and kick."

"Yes, and we can give you our goggles and a floaty," Mia said. "They will help you see and stay up."

Sam smiled a little. He liked Tom and Mia. They were kind and friendly.

"Okay, I will try," Sam said.

Tom and Mia helped Sam put on the goggles and the floaty. They held his hand and walked into the water. They spoke to him in a gentle voice and showed him how to swim.

Soon, Sam was swimming with Tom and Mia. He was not afraid anymore. He was happy and proud.

"Thank you, Tom and Mia," Sam said. "You are the best swim teachers ever."

"You are welcome, Sam," Tom and Mia said. "You are a great swimmer. We are glad you are our friend."

Jim and Jill wanted to buy a present for their mom. At the store, they looked and looked but couldn't find anything they liked. Then, they saw a soft, fluffy blanket. They both touched it and it was so nice they knew it was the perfect present. When they got home, they were so excited to give their mom the blanket. She was so happy with the present and gave Jim and Jill a big hug. Jim and Jill hugged her back, feeling a little embarrassed. They never knew buying a present could make them so happy.

Once upon a time there were two friends named Bob and Joe. Bob wanted to find the best vacation ever, so he searched and searched. Joe was frightened because he didn't want to search.

Finally they found the best vacation ever! It was a sunny beach with lots of sand and palm trees. There was a blue ocean and the sand was warm.

Bob was so excited to go on the vacation and Joe felt better because he knew his friend was happy.

They drove for hours and when they arrived, Bob and Joe jump out of the car and ran to the beach. They laughed and played in the sand and the waves, and it was the best vacation ever!

Lily liked to draw. She had many colors and papers. She made many pictures. Some were of her family, some were of her toys, some were of her dreams. She liked to make original pictures, not like anyone else's.

One day, she found a new symbol in her book. It was a big circle with a line and a dot in it. She did not know what it was. She thought it looked funny. She decided to draw it on her paper. She used a black color. She made the circle big and the line and the dot small.

She showed her picture to her mom. Her mom looked at it and gasped. She said, "Lily, where did you see this symbol?" Lily said, "In my book. Why, mom?" Her mom said, "This is a bad symbol, Lily. It means something scary. It is not a good thing to draw."

Lily felt scared. She did not want to draw something bad. She did not want to make her mom sad. She said, "I'm sorry, mom. I did not know. I just liked the shape. Can I make it go away?" Her mom said, "Yes, Lily. You can. Here, take this white color and cover it up. Then you can draw something else. Something nice and happy."

Lily took the white color and covered the bad symbol. She felt better. She said, "Thank you, mom. I love you." Her mom said, "I love you too, Lily. You are a good girl. And a good artist. You can draw anything you want, as long as it is not scary or mean." Lily nodded. She smiled. She drew a heart and a flower and a sun. She made a new original picture. She was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going on holiday with her family. They would go to the beach and play in the sand. One day, Lily's favorite toy, a teddy bear, broke. She was very sad and didn't know what to do.

Lily's mom asked her, "What's wrong, sweetie?" Lily replied, "My teddy bear is broken." Her mom said, "Don't worry, we can fix it." But Lily was still sad. Later that day, they went for a walk and saw a magician performing tricks. The magician made things disappear and reappear.

Lily was amazed and asked her mom, "Can the magician fix my teddy bear?" Her mom smiled and said, "Let's ask." They went up to the magician and asked him. The magician said, "Of course, I can make your teddy bear disappear and then reappear all fixed." Lily was so happy and couldn't wait to see her teddy bear again. The magician did his trick and just like that, Lily's teddy bear was fixed!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. One day, she wanted to do something fun. So, she decided to go outside and jog. Lucy looked around and saw a beautiful park. It was so peaceful.

She ran around the park and stopped at a big tree. It had a long string hanging from the tree. She looked up and saw it was connected to a little bird house. She asked the bird, "What are you doing"? The bird replied, "I'm building a nest for my babies".

Lucy smiled and asked the bird, "Can I help you"? She grabbed the string in her tiny hands and started to help build the nest. When she was done, she said goodbye to the bird and started to jog around the park.

She ran so fast that when she looked up it was already dark. Above the trees, the stars were twinkling in the night sky. Lucy was very happy and she jogged back home with a big smile on her face.

The End.

One morning, the sun was shining and there was a little boy walking. His name was Joe, and he was wearing red shoes and a very happy smile. He was in a hurry to get to his friend's house to show her something special.

When he arrived, she said, "Wow, what do you have there?" Joe pulled out something shiny and spun it around. He said, "It is my original toy plane!"

Joe then ran outside with his plane and started to push it along with his toe. Soon, the plane took off and it was flying around in the sky. Both Joe and his friend couldn't believe how fast it was going!

Joe kept running with the plane and when his friend shouted, "Faster, Joe! Faster!" and Joe ran even faster, until finally the plane couldn't fly any more. Then Joe and his friend ran back inside, excited from the amazing flight.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl named Amy. She was very brave and adventurous. One day, she wanted to go to the beach but it was high tide.

Amy was a little scared, but she was determined to go. She put on her little yellow raincoat and headed to the beach.

When she arrived, the waves were rolling in and out and the tide was high. She was a bit scared, but then she saw her dad. He smiled and said, “Don’t worry, Amy. I’ll stay with you and we’ll complete this together.”

Amy felt a lot better and smiled. She and her dad splashed in the water, looked for shells and played in the sand.

After a few hours, the tide began to go down. But then, a giant wave came crashing in. Amy got very angry and shouted, "That's not fair!"

Her dad held her hand tightly and smiled. “The tide will go back out soon, but until then, let’s have some fun.”

And they did. They built sand castles, searched for pretty shells and watched the waves crash against the shore. Together, they completed their fun beach adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Benny. Benny had a smooth fur coat and loved to hop around the forest. One day, Benny met a hedgehog named Harry. Harry had spiky fur and was very slow.

"Hi, Harry! Do you want to race with me?" asked Benny.

"Sure, Benny! But I'm not very fast," replied Harry.

"That's okay! We can still have fun," said Benny.

So, they started the race. Benny hopped very quickly, but Harry was struggling to keep up. Suddenly, Harry tripped on a rock and fell down. Benny stopped and went back to help Harry.

"Are you okay, Harry?" asked Benny.

"Yes, thank you for helping me," said Harry.

Benny and Harry became good friends and continued to explore the forest together. Even though they didn't finish the race, they both had a great time.

One day, a little girl named Sally found her mom's makeup. She thought it looked fun to use. She opened the fragile box and saw many colors inside.

Sally called her friend, Tim. "Tim, come see the makeup! We can use it to play!" Tim came over and they started to use the makeup. They put it on their faces and laughed at each other.

As they played, Sally's mom saw the mess. "Oh no! My fragile makeup is everywhere!" she said. Sally and Tim felt sad. They knew they should not have used the makeup without asking. They helped clean up the mess and said sorry to Sally's mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved eating cherries, but her mom always told her not to eat too many. One day, Lily went to the park and saw a big cherry tree. She climbed up and ate all the cherries she could reach.

When Lily came home, her mom saw her tummy was big and asked, "Did you eat too many cherries?" Lily nodded her head and said, "Yes, but they were so yummy!"

Her mom said, "I told you not to eat too many. Now you will be punished and have to go to bed early tonight." Lily felt sad and went to her room, but she knew she shouldn't have eaten so many cherries.

Later that night, Lily had a dream about an ugly monster who wanted to eat all the cherries in the world. She woke up and realized she didn't want to be like the monster, so she promised to listen to her mom from now on.

Once upon a time, there was a tall lion. He lived in a big jungle with other animals. One day, the lion wanted to show off his strength.

He jumped as high as he could and then he landed on a tree. He thought he was very brave, but the tree broke!

The lion was not happy. He wanted to find something else to break and show how brave he was. But, he looked around and all he could find were other animals.

He couldn't break them, so the lion just sat down and smelled the flowers instead. The other animals were happy that the lion didn't break anything else.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she was drinking hot chocolate from her favorite mug when she accidentally dropped it on the floor. She felt sad because her mug was now broken.

Lily's mom saw her daughter feeling frustrated and said, "It's okay, Lily. We can fix your mug with glue." Lily was happy to hear that and they glued the mug back together.

The next day, Lily's little brother was playing with a ball in the house. Lily warned him to be careful and not break anything. But he accidentally hit the mug and it broke again. Lily felt even more frustrated this time.

Her mom hugged her and said, "I know it's frustrating, but remember that things can always be fixed. What's important is that we learn from our mistakes and try to be more careful next time." Lily understood the lesson and felt better. From that day on, she made sure to keep her favorite mug in a safe place.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to travel and explore the world. Today, she was on her way to a new place and was very excited.

At the station, Lucy went to the ticket counter to get her ticket. The nice man behind the counter gave her a little ticket and told her to get on the train.

Lucy got on the train and found a seat. There were boxes and packages all around her. Then she heard a loud noise. It was the train conductor, asking everyone to load the luggage onto the train.

So Lucy got up and helped the others put their bags on the train. Soon the train was loaded, and they were ready to go! Lucy waved goodbye to everyone at the station and settled into her seat. She was ready for her adventure to begin!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and eat yummy snacks. One day, her mommy asked her to clean up her toys. Lily didn't want to work, but she knew it was important to listen to her mommy.

After she finished cleaning, Lily's mommy gave her a snack. It was a juicy apple that was so tasty. Lily felt happy and not grumpy anymore. She realized that sometimes working can be hard, but it can also make you feel proud and happy when you finish. From that day on, Lily tried to help her mommy more often and always enjoyed her snacks after.

Lila and Tom are playing with their dolls. Lila has a purple dress for her doll. She likes the dress very much. She wants to make it more pretty. She finds some thread and a needle in her mom's sewing box.

"Look, Tom, I can sew some flowers on the dress," she says.

"Can I help you?" Tom asks.

"OK, but be careful with the needle. It is sharp and can hurt you," Lila says.

They sit on the floor and start to sew. Lila makes a yellow flower. Tom makes a blue flower. They are having fun.

But then, Tom's dog, Spot, comes into the room. Spot is curious. He sees the thread and thinks it is a toy. He runs to Lila and Tom and grabs the thread with his mouth. He pulls hard and runs away.

"Hey, stop, Spot! That is not your toy! That is our thread!" Lila shouts.

She and Tom chase after Spot. They try to get the thread back. But Spot is faster and stronger. He bites the thread and breaks it. He makes a big mess.

Lila and Tom are sad and angry. They look at their dolls. The flowers are gone. The dress is torn. They cry.

"Bad dog, Spot! You ruined our dress!" they say.

Spot does not understand. He thinks they are playing. He wags his tail and barks. He wants more thread.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to ride her bicycle. She rode it every day to the park to play with her friends. One day, Lily's mom told her that they were going to paint her bicycle a pretty color. Lily was so excited!

They went to the store and picked out a bright pink paint. Lily's mom cleaned the bicycle so it would be ready to paint. While they waited for the paint to dry, Lily asked her mom, "Can we ride our bikes to the park now?" Her mom said, "Not yet, we have to wait until the paint is dry."

After the paint was dry, Lily and her mom went outside to ride their bicycles to the park. Lily's bicycle looked so pretty with its new pink color. When they got to the park, Lily's friends were amazed by her clean and shiny bicycle. They all wanted to ride it, but Lily said, "No, it's mine!" and she rode it proudly all afternoon.

Henry had a very busy day. He played hide and seek in the garden and chased the cats around the house. Home time came quickly and his mom told him it was time to go to the park.

Henry was very excited as he had never seen a firework before. He looked around the park and saw colorful lights in the sky. When he heard the loud noises he started to get scared. He closed his eyes and held onto his mom.

The firework show lasted for what seemed like hours. Henry saw red and blue lights dancing in the sky. When the show was over, he was amazed. His mom praised him for yielding and being brave.

When it was time to go home, Henry was very tired. He was also very messy. He had grass stains on his shirt and dirt on his pants. He was still smiling though as he had enjoyed the firework show.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom liked to sleep all day and didn't like to play or do any work. One day, Tom got sick and his owner gave him a pill to make him feel better. But Tom didn't want to take the pill, he was too lazy to even open his mouth.

Days went by and Tom's owner noticed that he wasn't getting any better. She knew that if Tom didn't take the pill, his sickness would never end. So, she decided to trick Tom by hiding the pill in his food. Tom ate his food and unknowingly took the pill.

After a few days, Tom's sickness ended and he felt much better. His owner explained to him that sometimes we have to do things we don't want to do in order to make things better in the end. Tom learned his lesson and promised to never be too lazy to take his medicine again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big, dependable dog named Buddy. He lived in a small house with a big lawn. Every day, Buddy played on the lawn with his friends, the birds and the bugs.

One day, while Buddy was playing, he saw a tiny ant working hard to carry a big leaf. Buddy wanted to help the ant, but he was worried he might pinch it with his big paws. So, he watched the ant from far away and cheered it on.

The ant was very happy to have a dependable friend like Buddy. With Buddy's help, the ant and his friends finished their work on the lawn. They all played together and had a lot of fun. From that day on, Buddy and the ant became the best of friends.

Anna likes to visit her grandma every week. Grandma lives in a big house with a garden and a cat. Anna loves to play with the cat and help grandma with the flowers.

One day, Anna wants to bring a gift for grandma. She thinks hard about what grandma likes. She remembers that grandma likes books and tea. She asks her mom to help her find a book and a tea bag.

Mom helps Anna wrap the book and the tea bag in a nice paper. She tells Anna to be honest and say thank you to grandma. Anna nods and puts the gift in her backpack.

They take the bus to grandma's house. Anna is excited to see grandma and the cat. She runs to the door and knocks. Grandma opens the door and smiles. She hugs Anna and mom.

Anna gives grandma the gift and says, "This is for you, grandma. I hope you like it. It is a book and a tea bag. Mom helped me find them. Thank you for letting me visit you. You are the best grandma ever."

Grandma is very happy and proud of Anna. She says, "Thank you, Anna. You are very sweet and honest. I love the book and the tea bag. They are perfect for me. I love to read and drink tea. You are the best granddaughter ever."

They go inside and have a nice time. They read the book together and drink tea. They play with the cat and the flowers. Anna is glad that she brought a gift for grandma. She thinks that grandma is glad too. She loves to visit her grandma.

Once upon a time, there was a big, big slide in the park. It was enormous! A little girl named Lily loved to slide down it every day. But one day, when she went to the park, she saw that the slide was broken. She was sad because she couldn't slide anymore.

Then, she saw a boy named Max playing in the sunshine. He had a toy car that Lily liked very much. She asked Max if she could play with it, but Max said no. Lily felt sad again. She didn't like conflicts.

Suddenly, Max's toy car went under the enormous broken slide. Max was too scared to get it. But Lily was brave! She went under the slide and got the toy car. Max was happy and thanked Lily. They became friends and played together in the sunshine. From that day on, Lily was not sad anymore because she had a new friend to play with.

One day, Margo the bear was feeling very gloomy. She had a lot of work to do, but she couldn't find the power to start. Suddenly, she heard a voice. It was her friend Stella saying, "Let me help you Margo!"

Margo smiled and said, "Thank you Stella! What should we do first?"

Stella had a plan. "Let's clean the room!" Together, they started to clean up. Margo put away her toys and Stella wiped the windows. As they worked, Margo's gloom began to fade.

Finally, the room was clean and shiny. Stella smiled and said, "See, now the room is all nice and tidy. You should feel better now!"

Margo looked around the clean room and smiled. "Yes, I feel much better now. Thank you Stella!"

Once there was a furry cat. He was a brave cat and wanted to have an adventure. So one day he decided to go on a journey.

He tried walking and running. He tried jumping and hopping. He tried swimming and flying. But he had never done any of them before and he wanted to keep trying!

He was on a long journey and he kept trying. He jumped to the top of a tree and tried balancing on the leaves. He tried walking on a log over a river. He tried swimming in the river.

After a while he was tired and finally made it back home. He was safely back in his home and even though he was tired he was proud of himself for trying. He had been on a journey and tried lots of things on his way!

One day, a boy named Tom wanted to play cricket with his friends. He asked his mom to prepare his bat and ball for him. His mom said, "Okay, Tom, but first you have to eat your lunch and clean your room."

Tom did not like to eat his lunch or clean his room. He thought they were boring and hard. He wanted to play cricket right away. He was ignorant of his mom's feelings and rules. He said, "No, mom, I don't want to do that. I want to play cricket now!"

His mom was angry and sad. She said, "Tom, you are being rude and selfish. You have to do what I tell you. You have to eat your lunch and clean your room. If you don't, you can't play cricket today."

Tom did not listen to his mom. He ran out of the house with his bat and ball. He did not say sorry or thank you. He was ignorant of his mom's words and love. He went to the park to play cricket with his friends.

But when he got to the park, he saw that his friends were not there. He looked around and saw a sign that said, "No cricket today. Park closed for maintenance." Tom was confused and sad. He had no one to play with and no place to play. He wished he had listened to his mom. He was ignorant of his own mistake and loss. He went back to his house with his bat and ball. He hoped his mom would forgive him and let him play cricket another day.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to help their mom in the kitchen. One day, mom asked them to complete a task. She gave them each a bowl of rice and said, "Please wash the rice and put it in the pot. Then I will cook it for dinner."

Lily and Ben nodded and took their bowls to the sink. Lily was calm and careful. She poured some water on the rice and rubbed it gently with her hands. She drained the water and repeated until the water was clear. Then she put the rice in the pot and smiled.

Ben was not calm and careful. He poured too much water on the rice and splashed it everywhere. He rubbed it roughly with his hands and spilled some rice on the floor. He drained the water and did not repeat. He put the rice in the pot and grinned.

Mom came back and saw the mess. She was not happy. She said, "Ben, what did you do? You did not wash the rice well. You wasted water and rice. You made the kitchen dirty. You did not complete the task."

Ben felt bad. He said, "I'm sorry, mom. I wanted to be fast and fun. I did not mean to make a mess."

Mom said, "Being fast and fun is not always good. You need to be calm and careful when you do something. You need to complete the task well. That is how you help me and yourself. Do you understand?"

Ben nodded and said, "I understand, mom. I will be calm and careful next time. Can I help you clean the kitchen?"

Mom smiled and said, "Yes, you can. Thank you, Ben. And thank you, Lily. You did a good job. I'm proud of you both."

Lily and Ben hugged mom and helped her clean the kitchen. They learned to be calm and careful when they complete a task. They also learned to say sorry and help when they make a mistake. They enjoyed their dinner of rice and other yummy food. They were happy and grateful.

Lily liked to take books from the shelf and look at the pictures. She wanted to know what the words said, but she could not read them yet. One day, she saw a big book with a red cover and a picture of a fox and a crow. She took the book and sat on the floor.

"What is this story about?" she asked her brother Max, who was older and could read.

Max looked at the book and smiled. "This is a story about a clever fox and a silly crow. Do you want me to read it to you?"

"Yes, please!" Lily said.

Max opened the book and began to read. He told Lily how the fox saw the crow with a piece of cheese in her beak. He wanted the cheese, so he thought of a trick. He said to the crow, "What a beautiful voice you have! Can you sing for me?" The crow was very proud and wanted to show off. She opened her beak to sing, but the cheese fell out. The fox caught the cheese and ran away, laughing. "Thank you for the cheese, and for the song!" he said.

Lily listened to the story and laughed too. She thought the fox was very clever, but also very naughty. She said to Max, "That was a good story. Can you read me another one?"

Max nodded and looked for another book. He liked to read stories to Lily, and Lily liked to listen. They had fun together.

Once upon a time there was a doctor who liked to laugh. She was very loud and always made her patients laugh too.

One day a little girl named Sara wanted to go to the doctor but she was scared. She kept hiding from the doctor and wouldn't let anyone take her to the doctor's office.
