Then the doctor said softly to Sara, "It's alright, you don't have to be scared. I will help you." Sara still wouldn't come out.

Then the doctor said, "Sara, you don't have to be afraid. I'm here to help you. All you have to do is surrender to me and I promise it won't hurt."

Finally, Sara decided to surrender to the doctor. She walked into the doctor's office, holding the doctor's hand, and off they went. The doctor took care of Sara and soon enough she was back in her happy place.

The end!

Once there was a little girl called Molly. She was three and very excited. She always wanted to explore and discover new things.

Today, Molly was exploring in the park. She looked around and found a large knot on the ground. She wanted to see what it was so she grabbed it. To Molly's surprise, when she touched it, the knot started to move! She pulled it and the knot grew bigger and bigger!

Molly watched in amazement as the knot started to make shapes in the air. It made a butterfly and then a dog! Molly was so impressed. She grabbed the knot and ran home to show her parents what she could do.

Molly's mom and dad were really surprised. They said the knot was really impressive! They said that Molly was very clever to make shapes out of it.

Molly was proud of her knot and kept playing with it all day long. She even taught her friends how to make shapes like she did. They all had a lot of fun with Molly's knot!

One day, there was an elderly man walking down the street with a box. Suddenly, he heard a voice. He looked around and he saw a little girl holding a pair of scissors. The girl was very tiny and her hair was in two big pigtails. She asked the elderly man if he wanted her to cut the box. He smiled and agreed.

The little girl took the scissors and carefully cut the box in half. She was so brave and so careful. When she finished, she jumped for joy and the elderly man smiled. He thanked the little girl for helping him out. She beamed with pride!

The elderly man thanked the little girl once more before he went on his way. He had a big smile on his face, and the little girl was very happy. She had helped the elderly man and it felt good. She skipped away with a smile.

Once upon a time, there was a small volcano. The volcano had a friend named Sam. Sam was a tough little rock. They lived in a big forest with many trees and animals. They liked to talk and play with each other.

One day, Sam said to the volcano, "I want to climb to the top of you, but I am scared." The volcano said, "Don't panic, Sam. I will help you. You are a tough rock, and you can do it."

Sam started to climb the volcano. He felt scared but kept going. The volcano cheered for him, "You can do it, Sam!" Sam reached the top and saw the beautiful view of the forest. He thanked the volcano for helping him and they both were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little squirrel named Sammy. Sammy was very adventurous and loved to explore the forest. One day, Sammy met a friendly rabbit named Rosie.

"Hi, Sammy!" said Rosie.

"Hi, Rosie!" replied Sammy. "What are you doing?"

"I'm trying to split this nut open," said Rosie. "But it's too hard."

"I can help!" said Sammy. "I'm very good at splitting nuts."

Sammy used his strong teeth to split the nut open. Inside, they found a delicious treat.

"Yum!" said Rosie. "Thanks for helping me, Sammy."

"No problem!" said Sammy. "I love being adventurous and helping my friends."

Once upon a time there was a silly boy named Scott. He loved teasing animals and playing tricks. One day he saw a hairy little rabbit in the garden. He wanted to tease it so he started running after it.

The rabbit was scared and it was so quick that it hopped away into the woods. Scott decided to go after it, but it was dark and he could not find the rabbit anywhere. He looked and looked but could not find it.

Then he heard a voice from above him. It was the rabbit!

The rabbit said, "Do not tease me or other animals, for it only leads to sadness! If you want to learn about something, search for it in books or by asking others, but do not tease".

Scott realised he had been wrong to tease and he thanked the rabbit for teaching him a good lesson. From that day onwards, he stopped teasing animals and always learnt by searching instead.

Jack and Jane were best friends. Today they were going to catch the bus together. Jack was so excited because he had never catching a bus before.

As they neared the stop, Jack saw the bus was coming. He started to run but Jane shook her head and made a sign with her hands. She wanted him to wait. Jack was confused but he waited as Jane said.

The bus pulled up and Jack hopped on. Jane smiled and opened his wallet. She took out a bus card inside and waved it at the driver. Jack was surprised. He didn't know she had a bus card!

But then he noticed that the driver wasn't happy. He scowled and waved his hands in the air. He was angry because the bus card was spoiled. Jane looked embarrassed.

But then the driver patted her on the head. He nodded at Jack and said he could ride for free. Jack was so happy he gave them both a big hug.

They had a great ride and it was even more special because they had overcome the conflict together!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Abigail who wanted a pet for her birthday. She asked her mom if she could get a pony, so her mom said yes. Abigail was so excited!

When the day came to pick the pony, Abigail went to the stable. She saw lots of horses and ponies running around, but she wanted to find the perfect one.

Suddenly, she saw a little pony in the corner of the stable. Its name was Buttons and it was very brave and alert. Abigail knew Buttons was the pony for her! She petted Buttons and was very excited to take him home.

Abigail and her mom used a special cart to bring Buttons home. Abigail used special equipment to help take care of Buttons.

"Abigail," her mom said, "you need to be very alert around Buttons! He's a very gentle pony, but you never know!"

Abigail nodded, and smiled. She promised to always use care around Buttons.

The End

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the beach with her family. The sand was warm, and the water was cool. She liked building sandcastles and collecting seashells.

One day, while playing, Lily saw a bright and attractive seashell. She wanted it so badly, but it was in the water. Her mom told her not to go too deep, but she urged to get the seashell.

As she reached for it, a big wave came and took her away from the shore. She tried to swim back, but the waves were too strong. Her family called for help, but it was too late. Lily drowned, and her family was heartbroken.

Remember, it's important to always listen to your parents and be careful when playing in the water.

Mum and Dad were discussing something very important. Mum and Dad have been married for a while, so they knew all the important topics to talk about.

Dad held one of his fingers up. He was making a point, so he used his finger to explain. Dad was very delicate with his words. He was trying to make sure Mum understood what he was saying.

Mum smiled and said, “I understand.” Then she put her hand on Dad's shoulder and patted it gently. Dad smiled and said, “Thanks.”

The little 3 year-old girl watched from the corner of the room. She didn't understand what Mum and Dad were talking about but she knew they were discussing something important. She couldn't help but to stay quiet and listen.

Mum and Dad finished their discussion and hugged each other. Dad looked at the little girl and said, “Want to know what we were talking about?”

The little girl nodded her head.

Mum smiled and said, “We were discussing how much we love you.”

John was confused. He had been trying to help his friend for days, but he didn't know what else to do. He wanted to help make his friend feel better, but he didn't know how.

Then one day, John had an idea. He thought if he offered his friend a reward, it might make him feel better. So, John gathered up some of his nicest toys, took them outside and placed them on the ground.

John waited and watched. Eventually, his friend saw the reward, and he smiled. His friend slowly walked over to the toys, picked them up, and he seemed so happy. John felt so relieved that his plan worked.

John waited some more, and then he felt something in his pocket. He reached in and was surprised to find something there. He had received a reward for helping his friend. It was a little card with a picture of a star drawn on it. John was so thankful for his reward. He quickly thanked his friend, gave him a big hug and sent him off with a smile.

Once upon a time, there was a big port where many boats came and went. One day, a little girl went to the port with her loyal dog. They saw many people and animals walking around.

Suddenly, some music started playing and the little girl and her dog started to dance. "I love to dance," said the little girl. "Me too!" barked the dog happily.

As they danced, they saw a man with a big bag. "Excuse me, sir," said the little girl. "What's in your bag?" "It's full of toys," replied the man. "Would you like one?" The little girl and her dog looked at each other and wagged their tails. "Yes, please!" they said together.

The man gave them a toy and they continued to dance happily at the port. They had a great day and went home with big smiles on their faces.

Once upon a time, there was a bad mud. It was the yuckiest mud around. It was so yucky that no one wanted to play in it.

Then one day, a little bird came along. The little bird wanted to settle in the mud. So, he hopped around and pushed the mud around with his little beak. Little by little, the bad mud began to settle.

The little bird worked hard until the mud was nice and soft. Everyone was so happy about it. They could now play in the mud and have lots of fun.

The little bird was very proud of his hard work. He sang a happy song and flew away.

The End.

Once upon a time there was a jeep. It was in a very big field. The jeep was weighed down with too much stuff. It felt very heavy. The jeep wanted to be lighter. It tried to take off the things from its back. But it was still too heavy. The jeep was feeling very dizzy and it was beginning to get tired.

Just then, two little kids came running up to the jeep. They were waving big red balloons. The jeep was excited. The kids said, "Let's tie these balloons to your back. That might help you feel lighter!" The two kids did just that.

The balloons made the jeep feel much better! It was able to move around and it felt much lighter. The jeep was so happy that the two kids helped it. It thanked them and said, "You helped me feel lighter, and I don't feel dizzy anymore!" The two kids smiled in delight.

One day, a little boy named Tom went to the park with his mom. They played with a big red ball. Tom liked to shout when he kicked the ball. He was a very tough little boy.

Tom saw a dog on the left side of the park. The dog was big and brown. Tom wanted to play with the dog, so he went over to say hello. The dog wagged its tail and looked happy.

Tom's mom called out, "Tom, be careful with the dog!" But Tom was not scared. He threw the ball and the dog ran to get it. They played together and had lots of fun. Tom was very happy he made a new friend.

Once there was a little boy called Max. He was only 3 years old and loved to play. One day, he was walking in the park, when he found something. It was a small object, unknown to him. Max picked it up and saw that it was a peanut! He was very excited!

Max: "Look mummy, I have a peanut!"

Mummy: "That's lovely, Max. Where did you get it?"

Max: "I found it in the park!"

Mummy: "Well, now you have to decide what to do with it."

Max thought long and hard and then he had an idea. He decided to look around and see if he could find something else that was unknown. He looked and looked, but couldn't find anything. So he decided to take the peanut home with him and show his mummy the next day.

Max was very happy and he couldn't wait to show mummy the next day. He put the peanut safely in his pocket and went home with a big smile on his face.

Sara was a deaf girl who liked to play with her dolls. She had a big bed in her room where she put all her dolls and made them sleep. She liked to pretend that she was their mom and provide them with food, clothes and hugs.

One day, her mom came to her room and said, "Sara, it's time to go to the park. Do you want to come with me?" Sara did not hear her mom, but she saw her lips move. She nodded and smiled. She loved the park. She picked up her favorite doll, Lily, and put her in a small bag. She left the other dolls on the bed and said, "Bye-bye, dolls. I'll be back soon."

Sara and her mom walked to the park. Sara saw many things that made her happy. She saw flowers, birds, dogs and children. She wanted to play with them, but she did not know how to talk to them. She felt shy and stayed close to her mom.

Her mom saw a lady with a dog. The lady waved and said, "Hello, I'm Anna. This is my dog, Spot. He's very friendly. Do you want to pet him?" Sara's mom said, "Hello, I'm Mary. This is my daughter, Sara. She's deaf, but she can understand some words if you speak slowly and clearly." Anna said, "Oh, I see. How old is she?" Sara's mom said, "She's three. She likes dolls and animals." Anna said, "That's nice. My niece likes dolls too. She's four. She's at the playground. Do you want to meet her?"

Sara's mom nodded and said, "Sure, that would be lovely. Come on, Sara. Let's go to the playground." Sara followed her mom and Anna. She saw a girl with long hair and a pink dress. She was playing with a doll that looked like Lily. Anna said, "This is my niece, Mia. Mia, this is Sara and her mom. Sara is deaf, but she can understand you if you speak slowly and clearly. She likes dolls too. Do you want to play with her?" Mia smiled and said, "Yes, I do. Hi, Sara. I like your doll. What's her name?" Sara took out Lily from her bag and showed her to Mia. She pointed to her mouth and said, "Lily." Mia nodded and said, "Lily. That's a pretty name. This is my doll. Her name is Rose." She showed her doll to Sara. Sara pointed to her mouth and said, "Rose." Mia nodded and said, "Rose. That's a pretty name too. Do you want to play with me and Rose?" Sara nodded and smiled. She felt happy. She had made a new friend.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Susan who loved horses. She wanted one more than almost anything else in the world.

One day, her mom took her to the farm and said, "Look children, I'm going to give you the best present ever".

"A horse!!" exclaimed Susan, her eyes beaming with delight.

"Yes!" said her mom.

Susan was so excited and ran up to the horse. She gave it a big hug, but the horse was a little bit upset.

"Don't worry," said her mom, stroking the horse gently. "It's just because this is a new place for her. She just needs a little time to get used to it."

So while Susan said hello to the horse, her mom gave her an apple to feed her. That made the horse very happy.

And they all lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the airport with her mommy and daddy. They were going on a big airplane to visit their grandma and grandpa. Lily was so excited to see the big planes zooming in the sky.

When they got to the airport, Lily saw a little boy with a toy airplane. She wanted to play with it, but the boy didn't want to share. Lily felt jealous and sad.

Suddenly, Lily heard a loud noise and looked up to see a big airplane zooming down the runway. She forgot about the toy airplane and watched the big one take off into the sky. "Wow, that's amazing!" she said. Her mommy and daddy smiled and said, "Yes, it is!"

Once upon a time, there was a group of friends. They wanted to do something special, so they gathered together to plan.

They decided they would have a picnic. It was easy to find food to bring, so each person brought something yummy.

When they arrived, they spread out a blanket and set up the food. They ate and talked and laughed together.

When it was time to go, they gathered up the blanket and food. It was not hard to do, because everyone worked together. Everyone felt happy and had a good time.

The friends promised to gather together again soon. They had made a special wish, and with teamwork, it would be easy to make it come true.

Timmy was at the park today. He loved the park! He played on the swings and the slide. Everything was so fun! Suddenly he saw the most wonderful thing. It was a big cake with candles on it! He wanted a little piece but it was so far away.

Timmy decided to try to get the cake. He started walking but it was hard. He wanted to run but he couldn't. Things were difficult.

Suddenly, his mom called out, "Timmy, don't come over here". Timmy knew he shouldn't, but he wanted the cake. He kept walking.

When Timmy got closer, he heard his mom's voice again. "Timmy, don't touch the cake. You know the rules". He knew his mom was right but he wanted the cake so much. He reached out to grab it.

But it was too late. His mom caught him. She was angry and Timmy knew he had done something wrong. He never got to have any of the cake. He was sad.

Mia was playing with her friends at the park when she felt something at her feet. She looked down, and saw a big, slimy worm. She picked it up and waved it around. She turned to her friends and shouted, "Look at the nice worm!"

Mia's friends shrunk away, embarrassed. Mia didn't understand why they were so bothered, but her mom did. She said, "Mia, stop waving the worm around! It's not very polite."

Mia's friends were from a wealthy family, who had a very different way of living than Mia's family. Mia didn't understand why her friends were embarrassed, and why her mom was so careful about how she behaved around them.

Mia listened to her mom, and put the worm back in the grass. She smiled and said, "Okay Mom. I'm sorry for embarrassing my friends."

Lily and Tom were playing in the old house. They liked to explore the rooms and find old things. But they were afraid of the attic. They heard noises there. They thought there was a ghost.

One day, they found a new toy in a closet. It was a robot. It had buttons and lights and wheels. They wanted to play with it. But it did not work. It was broken.

"Maybe we can repair it," Tom said. He took a screwdriver from a toolbox. He opened the robot's back. He saw wires and batteries and gears.

"Be careful," Lily said. "Don't break it more."

Tom tried to fix the robot. He moved some wires and changed some batteries. He closed the robot's back. He pressed a button.

The robot made a sound. It blinked its lights. It moved its wheels. It worked!

"Wow!" Lily and Tom said. They were happy. They hugged the robot.

But then they heard another sound. It was a loud bang. It came from the attic.

They looked up. They saw a hole in the ceiling. They saw something white and fuzzy. It had eyes and a mouth. It was a ghost!

"Boo!" the ghost said. It smiled. It was not scary. It was friendly.

"Hello," the ghost said. "I'm Gus. I live in the attic. I heard you repair the robot. It was my toy. I like it. Can I play with you?"

Lily and Tom were surprised. They were not afraid anymore. They nodded.

"Sure," they said. "You can play with us. We can share the robot. It is a new friend for all of us."

One day, a little girl was very excited. She liked to watch the pigeons fly around in her garden. All of a sudden, she noticed that one of the pigeons was hurt. It had a broken wing! She wanted to help.

The girl quickly found her dad. She asked her dad to help fix the pigeon. He said he would try. They set out to the garden.

The pigeon was scared and wouldn't let them near. But the dad knew what to do. He talked to the pigeon in a soothing voice. Then he slowly tried to put the broken pieces of the wing back together.

The girl watched with excitement. After a while, she saw that the pigeon could fly again! She was so happy that her dad was able to help fix the pigeon.

The girl was very excited to watch the pigeon fly off into the sky again. She and her dad smiled, happy with the good deed they had done.

Once upon a time there was a little kid. He was walking through the forest and he came across a hidden spinning thing. He had never seen anything like it before.

So he stepped closer to take a better look and he put his hands on the thing. He started to spin it round and round and it made him laugh. He spun it faster and faster, bigger and bigger circles.

The spinning thing made a funny noise and it started to fly around his head. The kid laughed as he watched this thing spin around him.

He spun it faster and faster until it disappeared. But the kid knew it was still out there, hidden somewhere. He just had to find it! So he kept looking and sure enough, he found it again.

The kid was so happy to be able to play with the spinning thing. He spun it from one corner of the forest to the other and he had so much fun.

He gathered the spinning thing up and took it home with him. He would never forget the hidden thing that he had found in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She loved to wear jewelry. She had a pretty necklace with shiny beads. One day, she went to the park with her mom.

At the park, Jane saw a big tree. She wanted to lean on the tree and play with her necklace. But when she leaned on the tree, she felt something bitter on her hand. It was a bitter bug!

Jane was scared and cried. Her mom came and took the bitter bug away. Jane's mom told her not to worry. They went home and Jane washed her hands. She was happy again and played with her jewelry all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy boat in the pond near his house. One day, Timmy's boat got stuck in some weeds and he couldn't get it out. He tried and tried, but it wouldn't budge.

Timmy was getting scared because he didn't want to lose his boat. Suddenly, he saw a man walking by and asked him for help. The man came over and tried to pull the boat out, but it wouldn't come. Then, the man had an idea. He told Timmy to open his backpack and get a pair of scissors. Timmy did as he was told and the man cut the weeds with the scissors. The boat was free!

Timmy was so happy that he thanked the man and went home to play with his boat. From that day on, Timmy knew that if he ever got stuck, he just needed to ask for help and someone would come to his rescue.

Once upon a time there was a white hippo. The hippo was so cute and small. It could not walk or run, so it had to crawl everywhere. One day, the white hippo saw a little boy. He was playing in the garden and he was very happy. The white hippo crawled closer to the boy and said in a soft voice, "Hello there! What are you doing?"

The boy looked at the white hippo in surprise and said, "I'm playing hide and seek with my friends!"

The white hippo smiled and said, "That sounds like a lot of fun. Can I play too?"

The boy nodded and said, "Yes, let's play! You have to try to find us and we have to try to find you!"

The white hippo crawled around the garden a few times and enjoyed the game very much. When everyone was tired and the game was over, the white hippo said goodbye and crawled away.

The boy was sad to say goodbye to the white hippo, but he knew that soon enough he would be back to play hide and seek with him again.

Once upon a time there was a girl who was very worried. She was worried about a story she had heard. When she asked her mum what the story was, her mum only smiled and said nothing.

The girl said again: "Mum, why can't you tell me the story?"

Her mum replied: "I think it's for you to find out."

The girl was even more worried but decided to look for the story. She asked everyone she knew but nobody could tell her.

Then one day, while she was walking in the garden, she saw an old lady who was smiling. She asked the old lady her question and the old lady replied:

"Why don't you look up at the stars and tell me a story?"

The girl looked at the stars and thought of all the stories she knew. She closed her eyes and when she opened them, a big bright star was shining right in front of her. She felt happy knowing that she had found the story she was looking for.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom cook dinner. One day, they were making spaghetti and meatballs. Lily's job was to help separate the meat into little pieces. She was very gentle so she wouldn't squish it too much.

After they finished cooking, they sat down to eat. Lily took a bite of her meatball and didn't like it. She asked her mom if she could have just the spaghetti. Her mom said that was okay and separated the meat from the spaghetti for her. Lily was happy and ate her dinner.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird that wanted to fly a lot, but he was too young. One day, his mommy decided that it was time for him to explore the world. She went to the store and bought a cage for him so he could be safe.

When she got home, the little bird asked, "Mommy, can I take this out of the cage so I can explore the world?"

His mother smiled and said, "No sweetheart, you must be polite and stay in the cage while I supply it with food and water."

The little bird was sad but he understood why he had to stay in the cage. He knew he had to be safe and polite before he could fly and explore the world.

The moral value of the story is to always be polite and listen to your parents and adults, otherwise you might not be able to explore and experience new things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old, and she loved to sing. Some of her favorite songs were about animals and rainbows.

One day, Sarah was out in the garden, singing. She was singing her favorite song, when she felt a little dizzy. She stopped singing, and looked around. There was a bird in the tree, singing a song of its own.

Sarah smiled and watched the bird for a moment, before looking around for something else. Then, she saw it! There was a pretty butterfly perched on her arm. She couldn't believe it; she thought it was so special!

She was so excited, she started singing her song again, just for the butterfly. The little butterfly stayed on her arm, and even seemed to be singing along too!

Sarah and the butterfly continued singing until Sarah wasn't dizzy anymore. Then, the butterfly flew away into the sky. Sarah watched it go, until she couldn't see it anymore.

Sarah went inside, singing her favorite song, feeling very happy and excited. She never forgot her special moment with the butterfly.

Lily was a clever girl who liked to play with her toys. She had a lot of dolls and animals and cars and blocks. She liked to make them talk and do funny things. She also liked to dress them up in different clothes.

One day, she found a hanger in her closet. It was a big hanger with a hook and a bar. She thought it looked like a swing. She wanted to make her toys swing on it. She took the hanger and put it on the door knob. Then she picked up her favorite doll, Anna, and put her on the bar. She pushed Anna gently and made her swing back and forth.

"Look, Anna, you are flying!" Lily said. "Wee, wee, this is fun!"

Lily's mom heard her voice and came to see what she was doing. She saw Lily and Anna swinging on the hanger. She smiled and said, "What a clever girl you are, Lily! You made a swing for your doll!"

Lily was happy that her mom liked her idea. She said, "Thank you, mom! Do you want to swing too?"

Lily's mom laughed and said, "Maybe later, sweetie. But first, let's put the hanger back in the closet. We don't want to lose it or break it."

Lily nodded and took Anna off the hanger. She gave her a hug and said, "You are a good flyer, Anna. But now it's time to rest."

She put the hanger back in the closet and the doll back in her bed. Then she gave her mom a hug and said, "I love you, mom. You are clever too."

The end.

Jimmy and his mom were walking in the woods. It was an icy cold day, and the trees were filled with snow. Suddenly, Jimmy heard something moving. He looked up and saw a deer! The deer was standing in the frozen woods, looking at him.

Jimmy was so excited. He waved at the deer. He said, "Hello there! What are you doing?"

The deer waved back at Jimmy and said, "Hi there! I'm looking for something to eat."

Jimmy and his mom smiled. Together they went out to find some food for the deer. When they came back, they saw the deer happily eating the food. Jimmy waved goodbye to the deer and said, "Bye! Stay safe and warm!"

The deer waved back at Jimmy and said, "Goodbye, and thank you for the food!"

Jimmy and his mom smiled, and started to walk away. It was a magical moment, walking in the snowy, icy woods with a deer saying goodbye!

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo liked to swim and play with his fish friends. One day, while swimming, Nemo saw a shiny hook in the water. He knew that hooks were dangerous and he felt anxious.

Nemo swam away from the hook but his friend Dory didn't listen to him. Dory swam towards the hook and got caught. Nemo tried to help but it was too late. The fisherman had already caught Dory.

Nemo felt regret for not warning Dory more strongly. He wished he had been more careful and had listened to his own instincts. From that day on, Nemo always made sure to stay away from hooks and warned his friends about the dangers of them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to drink cocoa, especially on cold days. One day, she asked her mom if they could have cocoa together. Her mom said yes and made some cocoa for them.

As they drank their cocoa, Lily's mom asked her how her day was. Lily told her about playing with her toys and going to the park. They discussed what they could do together the next day.

After they finished their cocoa, Lily's mom washed the cups and put them away. She noticed that they were now clear and shiny. Lily helped her mom clean up and they talked about how nice it was to spend time together.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Tony. He was very excited one day because he was going to have a tea party with his family. He set the table with cups and napkins and carefully laid out some treats for everyone to share.

Just as the family was about to sit down and enjoy their tea, Tony noticed something strange. The cups began to shrink! Everyone at the table gasped in surprise as the cups slowly got smaller and smaller.

"What is happening?" Tony's mom asked.

"I don't know!" Tony replied.

His dad then said, "I think the cups are shrinking because the tea is getting cold!"

Everyone laughed at the slow shrinking of the cups. Tony was very relieved that the cups weren't disappearing forever. He was happy to be able to enjoy his tea and treats with his family.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He was very excited because he was going to the park with his mommy. When they arrived at the park, Timmy saw a big rock and he wanted to climb it.

"Mommy, can I climb the rock?" Timmy asked.

"Sure, be careful," Mommy said.

Timmy climbed the rock and he felt very proud. He looked down at his mommy and shouted, "Look, Mommy! I'm on top of the rock!"

Mommy smiled and said, "Good job, Timmy! You're a great climber."

Timmy felt very happy and excited that he climbed the big rock all by himself.

Once there was a creative girl who loved to talk. She talked all the time! One day, she found a diamond in the park and she was so excited. She ran to get her mom and talk to her about it. When her mom saw the diamond, she was so happy and told her daughter that it was very special.

She put the diamond in a safe spot and then they talked about what to do with it. They decided to take it to a jeweler. The girl was so excited, she couldn't wait!

At the jeweler's shop, the girl talked about her diamond, and the jeweler was very impressed. He said that it was the most beautiful diamond he had ever seen. The jeweler put it in a necklace and made it even more beautiful.

The girl and her mom went home and talked about her diamond. She was so proud of her diamond and that she was so creative to find it. She promised to take care of it and to wear it always.

Little Jimmy was so excited. He was going to examine his dream today. He had been dreaming about it for weeks and now he was almost ready to see it. He could barely contain his excitement.

He slowly opened the door to his dream and examined it carefully. It was filled with amazing things that he never knew he wanted. Everywhere he looked there was something amazing. His dream was even bigger and better than he ever imagined.

He couldn't believe he was seeing something so incredible. He looked down and saw a little toy car and he had to stop himself from running to it. He felt like his dream was even bigger now and it was so exciting.

Little Jimmy knew that he had the best dream ever. He couldn't wait to tell his friends all about what he had found in his dream. He went to bed that night excited to have his dream with him forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she saw a big, wild dog running around. Lily was scared, but then the dog stopped and wagged its tail. It wanted a hug! So, Lily hugged the dog and it licked her face.

After that, Lily saw a merry-go-round. She climbed on and asked her dad to spin it fast. She loved the feeling of spinning around and around. When she got off, she was a little dizzy, but she felt happy. Lily went home and told her mom all about her wild adventure in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Tilly. Tilly liked to explore and go on adventures. One day, he went on a walk in the park and he saw a bird flying in the sky.

Tilly said, "hello little bird!" The bird replied, "hello Tilly!"

Tilly was so happy that he smiled and said, "let's be friends!" The bird smiled and flapped its wings.

Suddenly, Tilly saw that the bird was in trouble and the bird was struggling to stay in the sky.

Tilly was so clever and said, "I will save you!" He reached out his hand and carefully grabbed the bird. He held the bird close in his hands and felt the bird's soft feathers.

The bird thanked Tilly as it flew away. As the bird flew away, it left behind a special gift. It was a small berry with a sweet taste. Tilly was so happy and ate the berry with a big smile. It was the most delicious taste ever!

The end

There was a good bell in a garden. It rang like a song through the meadow. One day a little boy wanted to find the bell, so he ran to the garden. After a while, he found a path. As he walked, he heard the bell ringing merrily. When he got to the end of the path, he saw the bell. He was so excited and wanted to ring it. He reached up and pulled the rope, and the bell yielded a beautiful sound. The boy smiled and laughed with joy. He had found the bell and made it ring. He loved the good bell in the garden.

Once upon a time there was a mighty reindeer. He lived in a magical forest that was full of fun and joy. The reindeer loved to explore and make new friends.

One day, the reindeer saw some other animals and decided to go and say hello. He shouted "Hi there! My name is Reindeer. What's yours?"

The other animals were so surprised that the brave reindeer could talk. But then, something curious happened. All the animals began to shout and rave about the mighty reindeer! They thought he was the bravest creature of all and wanted to have him as their leader.

The reindeer was very happy to hear the animals' kind words. He thanked them and said that he was ready to be their leader and to lead them on many adventures. And with a mighty shout, the reindeer and the other animals began their journey!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go for walks with her mommy. One day, they walked down a weird street. The houses were all different colors and shapes.

Lily saw a big dog carrying a bone in his mouth. She said to her mommy, "Look, mommy! The dog is carrying something!"

Her mommy replied, "Yes, he is. Dogs like to carry things sometimes."

Lily thought it was funny and kept walking down the weird street. Suddenly, a man walked up to them and said, "Hello, little girl. Do you like this street?"

Lily said, "Yes, it's weird, but I like it."

The man smiled and said, "I like it too. I live on this street. It's always full of surprises."

Lily and her mommy said goodbye to the man and continued their walk down the weird street, happy to have met a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. He was very happy and loved playing games. But one night, he had a really bad nightmare. He saw a giant monster coming to eat him. He was so scared!

He ran to his mom and dad and told them what had happened. They hugged him tight and said there was nothing to worry about. "It was just a bad dream that's gone now," said dad.

Jack felt better after his parents hug. He took a deep breath and looked up at the stars. He felt so peaceful and knew that tomorrow was going to be a perfect day.

The next morning, Jack woke up feeling happy and free. He smiled from ear to ear and even though he still thought about his nightmare, he knew it was gone forever! He ran outside with his friends and played until the sun went down.

Jack was much happier now and always remembered that nightmares can come and go, but your perfect days are always there waiting for you!

Ben and Mia liked to play in the pool. They had a big ball that they threw to each other. Sometimes they dived under the water to catch the ball. They had fun and laughed a lot.

One day, they saw a new toy in the pool. It was a bull. It was enormous and had horns and a tail. It floated on the water and made a loud noise. Ben and Mia were curious and wanted to touch it.

"Look, Mia, a bull!" Ben said. "Let's go and see it."

"OK, Ben, but be careful. It might be scary," Mia said.

They swam closer to the bull. It looked at them with big eyes. Ben reached out his hand to touch its nose. The bull snorted and moved its head. Ben got scared and dived under the water. Mia followed him.

They came up on the other side of the pool. They saw the bull still floating and making noise. They decided to leave it alone and play with their ball again.

They threw the ball to each other and dived under the water. They had fun and laughed a lot. They forgot about the bull.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Mia. Mia was three years old and loved playing with her friends. One day Mia's Mummy said to her, "Mia, why don't you try yoga? It's a really fun way to stay safe and get better at different movements". Mia was excited and asked if she could try it.

Mia and Mummy attended yoga class every week, and before long Mia was improving her skills. The instructor said Mia was really good and was pleased with her progress. Mia was so proud of herself.

One day after class, Mummy said to Mia: "I'm so proud of your progress. Maybe one day you can be a yoga teacher, like the instructor!".

Mia smiled and said: "I'm glad I'm getting better and I think one day it will be fun to teach others!"

Mia has been attending yoga classes ever since and keeps improving each week. She always remembers to stay safe and have lots of fun with her friends.

Lily and Tom were friends. They liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big melon on a bench. It was green and round and looked yummy.

"Let's eat it!" said Tom.

"But it is not ours," said Lily. "Maybe someone left it here by mistake."

"Who cares?" said Tom. "They will not come back. Come on, it is just a melon."

Lily was not sure, but she was hungry. She followed Tom to the bench. They picked up the melon and ran to a corner. They used a stick to break it open. It was red and juicy inside. They ate it with their hands. It was sweet and good.

They did not see the man who came back to the bench. He was looking for his melon. He had bought it for his wife, who was sick. He was very angry when he saw the empty rind and the seeds on the ground. He looked around and saw Lily and Tom. They had melon juice on their faces and clothes.

"Hey, you little thieves!" he shouted. "You stole my melon! How dare you!"

Lily and Tom were scared. They tried to run away, but the man was faster. He caught them and grabbed them by their arms. He was very strong and rough. He dragged them to the park office. He told the park ranger what they had done. The park ranger called their parents.

Lily and Tom were in big trouble. Their parents were very mad at them. They scolded them and took them home. They had to say sorry to the man and his wife. They had to give them a new melon and some money. They had to stay in their rooms for a week. They had no toys, no TV, no games, no fun.

Lily and Tom were very sad. They wished they had not eaten the melon. They wished they had not forgotten to be good. They wished they had been more alert. They learned a hard lesson. They never stole anything again.

Dad was at the market. He heard a voice from behind him asking, "Please, can I have some beef?" Dad turned around and saw a little girl. She had big eyes and long hair.

Dad said, "Yes, of course." He handed the girl some beef.

The girl thanked Dad. She said, "Thank you so much. Now I feel safe and full."

Dad smiled. He said, "You're welcome. Please make sure to always request help if you need it."

Once there was a blue bird. He lived in a big palm tree by the beach. Everyday he would take naps in the branches of the palm tree and look at the beautiful blue sky and the sparkling ocean.

One day, the bird decided to take a little adventure and explore the beach beneath his tree. He flew around the shoreline and saw a small fish swimming in a shallow pool of water. He watched in awe as the fish swam around in the water.

But just as the bird was about to land, he noticed something that worried him. The fish had started to rot and it made him sad. He flew away in a hurry, but the awful smell followed the bird.

He quickly returned to his palm tree, and was frightened yet again by an even bigger rotting fish lying beneath the branches. He feared the beach was all rotting and he would never be able to rest in the branches of his beloved tree again.

The blue bird sadly flew off, away from the rotten beach. Sad, he was never able to visit his beloved palm tree and the beach again.

Once upon a time, in a small, pretty house, there lived a modest fairy. She had a tiny, soft bed and a little, round table. She liked to play with her toy cat and dog.

One day, the fairy found a sharp rock in her garden. She was careful not to touch it. She knew it could hurt her. The fairy wanted to make her garden safe for her friends.

She called her friend, the big, strong bear. The bear came to help the fairy. He picked up the sharp rock and put it far away. The fairy was very happy. Her garden was safe again. The fairy and the bear played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Tom. Tom loved to eat candy, but he didn't like the taste of it when it was dirty. One day, he went to a candy store to buy some candy, but he noticed that the candy looked dirty. He asked the store owner to polish the candy, but the owner said no.

Tom got very upset and started to cry. He really wanted the candy, but he didn't want to eat it if it was dirty. Suddenly, a kind little girl walked into the store and saw Tom crying. She asked him what was wrong, and he told her about the dirty candy.

The little girl went up to the store owner and asked him to polish the candy for Tom. The store owner listened to the little girl and polished the candy. Tom was very happy and thanked the little girl for helping him. From that day on, Tom always went to the candy store with the little girl because she had a good taste in candy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a loyal dog named Max. One day, Lily was drinking water from a glass when she accidentally knocked it over. Max saw what happened and leaned over to lick up the water before it spilled everywhere.

"Thank you, Max!" Lily said happily.

Max barked and wagged his tail, happy to help his best friend. From that day on, Lily always made sure to keep her glass on a stable surface so Max wouldn't have to lean over to save the day again.

One day, Sarah was playing in her garden. She saw a vine growing up the wall and was curious to see what was above it. She thought to herself, "I wonder what's up there, I guess I'll have to climb it!"

So Sarah grabbed a hold of the vine and started to climb. As she got higher and higher she noticed the vine seemed to keep getting longer and longer.

Finally she reached the top and asked excitedly, "What's up here?" To which a voice from the other side of the wall replied, "I don't know, you'll have to guess!"

Sarah laughed and thought "what a funny surprise" as she clung onto the long vine. She couldn't wait to get down and tell her friends about her adventure.

Once there was a little girl who was very excited. She loved cactuses and always wanted one of her own.

One day, her mom gave her a special present - a small cactus! The girl was so excited she could barely contain her joy. She hugged the cactus, ran around with it and showed it to all her friends.

The girl loved her cactus so much and took care of it every day. She watered it, gave it sun and talked to it.

But one day, something bad happened. She didn't know how, but the cactus suddenly fell on the ground and broke into pieces. It seemed that all its good care wasn't enough - talking was not enough for it.

The girl started crying and was so sad. Her mom tried to make her feel better, but nothing helped. The little girl was devastated.

Such is life - sometimes, even when we give a lot of love, it doesn't work out the way we expected.

Once upon a time, there was a safe penguin. He was happy and he liked to swim in the big ocean. One day, while he was out enjoying himself, he suddenly vanished. He was nowhere to be seen.

The other penguins were afraid, they didn't know what had happened to the safe penguin. They searched and asked everyone, but no one knew where he was. Finally, one of the penguins figured out what had happened.

The safe penguin had gone on a new adventure. He was having such a good time that he didn't remember to come back. But eventually, after a long journey, he came back home and the other penguins were very happy to see him again. They hugged him tight and welcomed him home.

The safe penguin never vanished again, he was content to stay with his friends and enjoy the ocean each day.

Once there was a little girl who had a red toy car. She decided to push it around the house. It was a luxury car, so it was very fancy. It had black seats with golden designs and it shone brightly.

The little girl had so much fun pushing her red car around the living room. She pretended it had a driver and it was going very fast. She sang a song as she pushed it around the room.

The little girl went to the backyard. She wanted to push her car around the grassy fields. But it was too heavy, so she decided to try the next best thing. She shouted "vroom vroom" and gave her car a big push. It flew across the grass, so fast!

The red car was having a great time, until it crashed into an old tree. The little girl was sad, but also very happy with all of the fun she had. She picked up the car and climbed up the tree to get one of its red leaves as a souvenir.

The little girl took her red luxury car inside and placed it on the shelf. She smiled and remembered all the fun she had.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little girl called Jane. Jane loved to explore the world, so one day she decided to have an adventure. She opened the door and peeked out, disguising herself with her blue pen.

Jane trundled off until she arrived at a big yellow house. Being curious as ever, she opened the door and peeked inside.

The house was empty, but suddenly Jane heard a voice.

“What are you doing here?” said the voice angrily.

Jane looked around, but she couldn’t see where the voice was coming from. She gulped and felt a bit scared.

“It’s me!” shouted the voice. Suddenly, a little bluebird flew out from behind a vase.

“I’m the guardian of this house and I don’t want intruders!” said the bird. “Can you leave please?”

Jane was a bit scared but she was also brave.

“I’m sorry I was peeking without asking” she said. “I didn’t mean to scare you. I'll go now.”

The little bluebird softened.

“Well,” said the bird, “I guess it’s okay this time. Just remember to always ask before you peek

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world. One day, she met a furry cat in her backyard.

"Hello, kitty! What are you doing here?" Lily asked.

"I'm counting the planets in the sky," the cat replied.

Lily looked up and saw the stars twinkling in the night sky. "Wow! I see the planets too!" she exclaimed.

The cat smiled. "Yes, they are beautiful. But there's one planet that's my favorite. It's called Earth, and that's where we live."

Lily was amazed. She never knew there were so many planets in the sky. She hugged the furry cat and said, "Thank you for teaching me about the planets. I love Earth too!"

Once upon a time there was a wise little bird. The bird lived in a forest, and liked to sit on a twig to sing its songs. One day, a strong wind blew and the twig started to wobble. The bird got a bit scared, so it decided to quit the twig. But then the wind stopped and the twig was still.

The wise little bird looked around and noticed a bigger twig. The bird flew over and hopped onto the new twig. This one was much stronger and steadier, so it gave the bird a feeling of safety. The bird sang its songs and was very happy that it had not quit its favorite pastime.

And ever since that day, the wise little bird has never quit the big twig. It sits there every day singing its songs, enjoying the peace and quiet of the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to play outside. One day, he saw a cricket hopping around in the grass. Timmy wanted to play with the cricket, so he tried to catch it. But the cricket was too fast and kept jumping away.

Timmy got impatient and started to cry. His mom came outside and asked him what was wrong. Timmy told her he wanted to play with the cricket but it wouldn't let him catch it. His mom smiled and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. I'll bring you a jar and we can catch the cricket together."

Timmy was so happy and ran inside to wait for his mom to bring the jar. When she came back outside, they caught the cricket and watched it hop around in the jar. Timmy was so excited to have a new friend to play with. The end.

One day, a little girl went outside to examine the world. When she looked up, she saw an unusual rainbow above her. She had never seen anything as beautiful as the rainbow before. She admired the bright colours and knew she had to get a closer look. She jumped up and down and waved her arms around until she was close enough to touch the rainbow.

The little girl was so excited to feel the rainbow. She examined it carefully and noticed something special. Not only were the colours of the rainbow beautiful but they had the most remarkable smell. She could smell the sweet smell of rain and the fresh smell of grass.

The little girl felt so lucky to experience something so wonderful and unusual. She wanted to look at the rainbow forever, but eventually the sun went down and the rainbow disappeared. She knew that she would never forget her magical moment and she would treasure it forever.

Once upon a time there lived a rabbit. He had a very soft fur and a large appetite. One day, he stumbled across a delicious patch of berries. He hopped over, and began nibbling on the berries.

Suddenly, a wise old fox walked over. "Hold on, rabbit," he said. "Those berries are poison! If you eat them, you will get very sick." The bunny looked surprised. "But they look so tasty," he said.

The fox smiled. "Sometimes, things that look tasty are not good for us," he said. So, the fox and the rabbit left the patch of berries and began walking again.

The fox and the rabbit became good friends. Every time the fox shared his wise knowledge, the rabbit would applaud and say 'thank you!'

The moral of this story is that it is important to listen to wise people who can help you make good decisions. It is always better to be safe than sorry.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily was playing with her toys when she heard a loud noise. She ran to her mommy and said, "What was that, mommy?"

Her mommy said, "I don't know, let's go see." They went upstairs and saw that a picture had fallen off the wall. Lily's mommy was troubled and said, "We need to fix this."

Lily asked, "Can I help, mommy?" Her mommy said, "Yes, you can help me pick up the picture." They picked up the picture and put it back on the wall. Lily was happy to help her mommy.

Liam was a spoiled little boy. He loved to nap each day. One day he decided to go on an adventure. He packed his lunch and said "Bye Mommy!" He set off on a journey across the land.

He walked for a long time and came upon a big tree. "What should I do?" Liam asked himself. Just then, he heard a voice calling out to him. It was a little bird high up in the tree.

The bird said, "Come up and take a nap here with me! The view is beautiful and you'd be so cozy." Liam climbed up into the tree and the bird spread out it's feathers for Liam to lay down. He curled up and fell asleep.

When he awoke, it was dusk. The bird said, "Time to go, it's getting dark!" Liam thanked the little bird for the cozy nap and started off on his way home. He was full of adventure and ready for more!

Once upon a time there was a chubby squirrel. He lived in a tree near a lake. Every day the squirrel would watch people kayak on the lake. He was jealous of them and wanted to go kayaking too.

One day, the squirrel got up the courage to demand a kayak. He asked the lake every day to give him a kayak, but nothing happened. Finally, the lake heard the squirrel's demand and a kayak floated to the shore.

The squirrel jumped into the kayak and pushed off. He paddled around the lake, having the best time ever. When he finished kayaking, the squirrel thanked the lake and waved goodbye.

The chubby squirrel was so happy. He got the kayak he wanted and finally got to experience the joy of kayaking.

Lily and Ben went to the beach with Mom and Dad. They liked to play in the sand and look for shells and rocks. Lily found a big rock that was smooth and shiny. She showed it to Ben.

"Look, Ben, I found a rock. It is pretty and interesting. Do you want to see?" Lily said.

"Yes, please. Can I hold it?" Ben said.

Lily gave the rock to Ben. He felt it in his hand. It was heavy and cool. He liked it too.

"Can we keep it?" Ben asked.

"Sure, we can keep it. But we have to share it. It is our rock now," Lily said.

They put the rock in their bucket and went to look for more. They did not know that the rock was not just a rock. It was a special rock. It had a secret inside.

Later, when they went home, they put the rock on their table. They wanted to show it to Mom and Dad. But when they came back, the rock was gone. They looked around and saw something moving on the floor. It was a little turtle. It had come out of the rock. The rock was its shell.

"Wow, look, Lily, it is a turtle. It was in the rock. How did it do that?" Ben said.

"I don't know, Ben. But it is amazing. It is a magic rock. And a magic turtle. Can we keep it?" Lily said.

They ran to Mom and Dad and told them what happened. Mom and Dad were surprised and curious. They said they could keep the turtle, but they had to take good care of it. They gave it a name and a bowl of water. They fed it and played with it. They loved their magic rock and their magic turtle. They were happy.

Once upon a time there was a clever rabbit. He loved to jump! Everywhere he went he hopped and skipped. One day, he was hopping around and he saw a start at the top of a hill. The clever rabbit was so excited, he could not wait to jump on it!

He hopped and hopped until he reached the start. He jumped on it and he felt so happy! Then he jumped off it and rolled down the hill, back to the bottom again!

He was so full of energy that he kept jumping and hopping around the start. He had so much fun that he didn't even stop when his friend, Mrs Frog, came by to visit.

Mrs Frog was so surprised to see him that she too started jumping and hopping around with the rabbit! They both laughed and had so much fun around the start! It made the rabbit even more clever!

The rabbit and Mrs Frog kept jumping and hopping around the start until the sun set. They said goodbye and the clever rabbit hopped off into the night, happy and full of energy.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars. They have many cars of different colors and sizes. They make roads and bridges with blocks and books.

One day, Tom finds a new car in his toy box. It is a big car, black and shiny. It has four doors and a trunk. Tom likes the new car very much. He shows it to Sam.

"Look, Sam, I have a new car. It is black and big. Do you want to play with it?" Tom asks.

Sam looks at the car. He sees something inside the car. It is a figure. The figure is small and gray. It has a head, a body, and two arms. It does not have legs. It sits on the seat of the car.

"What is that?" Sam asks. "Who is that?"

Tom does not know. He picks up the car and looks at the figure. He tries to take it out, but it does not move. It is stuck to the seat.

"I don't know. It is a figure. Maybe it is the driver of the car. Maybe it is a robot. Maybe it is a toy," Tom says.

Sam is curious. He wants to see the figure better. He takes the car from Tom and holds it close to his face. He looks at the figure's eyes. They are black and shiny, like the car. They look at Sam.

"Hello, figure. What is your name?" Sam says.

The figure does not answer. It does not talk. It does not smile. It does not blink. It just looks at Sam.

Sam feels scared. He does not like the figure. He does not like the car. He gives the car back to Tom.

"Here, Tom, you can have the car. I don't want to play with it. It is creepy. The figure is creepy. It does not talk. It does not move. It just looks," Sam says.

Tom does not mind. He still likes the car. He likes the figure. He thinks it is cool. He puts the car on the floor and drives it around. He makes engine noises and honks the horn.

"Vroom, vroom, beep, beep. I have a black car. I have a figure. I have a driver. I have a robot. I have a toy. I have fun," Tom says.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She had brown hair and two blue eyes. Her name was Lily. Every day, Lily went to the store with her mommy. Sometimes at the store, Lily would get very sleepy. When that happened, her mommy would say, "Let's go home for a nap."

When Lily woke up, she always felt better. After she was rested, she liked to play with her toys. First, she liked to race around the house, because she was so fast. After that, she liked to play dress-up. She would try on her mommy's shoes and dresses.

One day, Lily was playing dress-up and she pretended to be at the store. She was fast like a store clerk, packing her pretend groceries into bags. When she was done, she said to herself, "I'm sleepy now. It's time for a nap!"

So Lily went back to her bedroom and snuggled into bed. She closed her eyes and soon it was nap time. Lily had a nice, long nap. When she woke up, she was ready to go back to the store again.

Scott had a movie. He watched it and loved it. He wanted his friends to watch it too. So he covered it with a blanket and he took it to their house. His friends were excited and wanted to watch it right away. But then something went wrong. The movie didn't work and they couldn't watch it. Scott was very embarrassed and he felt ashamed. He put the movie under the blanket and he went home. He was sad. He wanted to show the movie to his friends and make them happy. But it didn't happen. Scott thought about the movie for days. He learned a lesson and never covered his movies again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside in the mud and dirt. She loved getting dirty! But one day, her mom asked her to help with the laundry. The laundry was very dirty and needed to be cleaned.

Lily didn't want to stop playing, but she knew she had to help her mom. So, she helped her mom wash the laundry. They put the laundry in the washing machine and added soap. They waited for the washing machine to finish.

After the laundry was clean, Lily's mom thanked her for helping. Lily felt happy that she could save the day by helping with the laundry. And even though she loved getting dirty, she knew it was important to help her mom with the chores.

Once upon a time there were two best friends named Daisy and Emily. They liked to play together all the time, but one day they started to quarrel.

Emily wanted to play with her dolls, but Daisy wanted to go outside and play tag. Daisy said, "Let's go outside and play tag, please please please!!"

Emily said, "No, I want to play with my dolls today." She began to cry.

Daisy felt really sad and said, "Let's do something we both like to do, like eating warm pizza!"

Emily looked up and wiped her tears away. "Yes, let's do that. I love eating warm pizza!"

So, Daisy and Emily went to the kitchen and got some delicious warm pizza. They ate it together and forgot about their quarrel. They had so much fun that they decided to eat warm pizza whenever they quarrel and it always made them happy again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She liked to play with her pet. One day, she wanted some butter to eat, so she asked her mom for some. Her mom said "Yes, you can own some butter but you must be careful. Be sure to put it away in a safe place so that nobody takes it".

The little girl was frightened. She had never seen butter before, so she was scared to touch it. Then her mom helped her and showed her how to take a little bit of butter.

She was so happy that she ran to show it to her pet. She gave it some butter, and her pet loved it! The pet licked its lips and said "Yum".

The little girl was so excited that she ran around the garden, laughing and shouting. She was no longer frightened. She owned butter and she was happy.

Once there was a little girl and her name was Sue. Sue had a special shoulder blanket that she always kept clean. It was her very favorite thing in the world.

One day, Sue rode her bike to the park. She had her shoulder blanket with her. When she went down the slides, the blanket got caught and it started to tear! Sue felt so sad and upset.

She sadly watched the tears in the blanket grow bigger and bigger. In the end, the blanket was too tattered to fix. But sue still hugged it tight to her shoulder and remembered all the happy times she had with her blanket before it was torn

Sue decided to mend the blanket the best she could and hang it up in her room. That way she could always remember how special it was and that it kept her shoulder safe and clean.

Once upon a time, there was a mop. The mop was very selfish. It did not like to share. It wanted all the water and soap for itself.

One day, the mop met a broom. The broom was very kind. The broom wanted to be friends with the mop. The broom tried to encourage the mop to share. The broom said, "Let's clean together. It will be fun!"

The mop thought about it. It wanted to have a friend. So, the mop decided to share with the broom. They cleaned the floor together. They had a lot of fun. The mop learned that sharing is good. The mop was not selfish anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little princess. She was so small, she could fit in the palm of your hand! One day, she went for a beautiful walk in the forest. As she spun around, she noticed something sparkly on the ground.

It was a little pot of gold! She was so excited and began to pick it up when all of a sudden it started to melt! She was so scared and ran away as fast as she could, but the gold kept melting.

When she reached her castle, she found she was safe. But the gold had melted away. The little princess was so sad she had lost her pot of gold. But then she remembered something magical.

The kind fairies had told her that if you make a wish when you see a pot of gold, your wish will come true! So she closed her eyes and wished with all her might. Suddenly, a sparkly rain of gold appeared in the sky - her wish came true!

The little princess was so happy, she skipped and danced all the way back to the castle. She knew now that wishes do come true, if you just believe!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, even when it was very cold and the ground was icy. One day, she was playing with her friend Timmy when they saw a beautiful bird in a tree.

"Look, Timmy! Look at the pretty bird!" said Lily, pointing with her finger.

Timmy looked up and his eyes got very big. "Wow, that bird is so cool! It makes me excited!" he said.

Lily and Timmy watched the bird for a while, but then it flew away. They were sad that they couldn't see it anymore.

"Maybe we can see it again another day," said Lily. "But we should remember to always appreciate the beautiful things we see with our eyes, even if they don't stay with us forever."

"Okay, Lily," said Timmy. "I will remember that."

And from that day on, Lily and Timmy always looked for the beauty in the world around them, even when it was icy and cold outside.

Lila and Ben were playing in the garden. They liked to dig in the dirt and look for bugs and worms. They had a small shovel and a bucket to put their finds in.

"Look, Lila, I found a big root!" Ben said, holding up a brown and twisty thing. "It was under the flower. Maybe it is part of the flower."

"Can I touch it?" Lila asked, reaching out her hand.

"OK, but be gentle. It might break." Ben said, handing her the root.

Lila felt the root with her fingers. It was hard and rough and had little hairs on it. She wondered what it was for.

"Maybe it drinks water from the dirt." She said.

"Maybe. Or maybe it holds the flower in place." Ben said.

They heard a voice calling them from the house.

"Lila! Ben! Time for lunch!" It was their mom.

"OK, mom, we're coming!" They shouted back.

They put the root in their bucket and ran to the house. They were hungry and impatient to eat. They hoped mom had made their favorite sandwiches. They also wanted to show her their root and ask her what it was. They thought it was a very interesting thing to find in the garden.

Once there was a mighty leopard. He lived in a big jungle. He had many friends.

One day, the mighty leopard saw a little bird. The bird was sad. The bird lost its mom. The leopard wanted to help.

The mighty leopard offered to find the bird's mom. They looked all around the jungle. They found the bird's mom in a tree. The bird was happy. The mighty leopard and the little bird became good friends.

Once upon a time there was a whale. He liked to swim in the ocean and look at the clouds overhead. One day he decided to talk to all the other sea creatures and asked them to come together. The whale was very organized. He asked all the sea creatures to help him in making an organized plan.

Everyone agreed and they decided that they would all take turns in looking after the sea. The whale looked very pleased with the plan. Everyone took their jobs seriously and they worked together to keep the ocean healthy and clean.

The whale was so proud of his friends. He was so glad that he had talked to them and asked them to help him. From then on, the whale and his friends kept talking and working together to keep their home in the sea safe and organized.

The little boy went to the park one day and observed the trees. He noticed a rabbit hopping around. He was excited and asked his mom if he could feed it. His mom said yes, so the boy ran to the store to get some yummy carrots.

Back at the park, the little boy was so excited to feed the rabbit. He held out a carrot and the rabbit came right to him. The boy was amazed! He watched as the rabbit nibbled on the carrot, feeling so special that he could feed the bunny.

One day, the boy was walking in the park and something made him stop in his tracks. He looked ahead of him and noticed that the rabbit was hopping along, dragging something. Then, he noticed it was a baby bunny! The boy had never seen a baby bunny before and was so delighted. He remembered how he had fed the rabbit the yummy carrots, and was glad he was able to help the rabbit bring a special moment to him.

Once upon a time there was a factory that was very old and rusty. It was the only factory in the town and everyone had to work there. Everyday the workers were very tired and never had any fun. One day something wonderful happened. A big colourful bird appeared out of nowhere and flew over the factory. Suddenly the factory started to spring to life! The rusty old factory was colourful and lively as beautiful flowers began to bloom.

The town grew excited about the amazing bird and its magical powers. All of the sad and tired faces quickly turned to smiles! Even the old factory started to look warmer and brighter. Everyone was having so much fun!

But then something unexpected happened. From the sky down came a big mouth and it began to eat up the flowers! It ate them up so quickly and there were so many of them. The town was so disappointed because the happiness was gone just as quickly as it appeared.

But then, the colourful bird flew down and sang a sad song. Its song was so bittersweet that the big mouth had to stop eating the flowers. Everyone was so happy and the factory returned to its old vibrant self. Everyone was so thankful for the magical bird and its song. They all thanked it and from that day on it was their good luck charm!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, it started to rain outside. Lily's mom gave her an umbrella and said, "Lily, please shut the door behind you and be careful outside."

Lily went outside with her umbrella, but the wind was strong and it was hard to hold onto it. A man saw her struggling and said, "Hey little girl, let me help you. Here, I'll hold your umbrella for you."

Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, that's easy for you to do." The man walked with Lily to her school and gave her back the umbrella. Lily said, "Thank you for helping me. You're very kind."

The man replied, "It was my pleasure. Have a good day at school, Lily." And with that, Lily went inside and the man walked away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun with her friends. One day, they found some shiny rocks that looked like gold. Lily's friend said they were called minerals.

They decided to have a competition to see who could find the most minerals. They looked everywhere and ran around a lot. After a while, they got very thirsty and went to get some water.

When they came back, they saw that the sun had dried up all the moisture on the shiny rocks. But Lily found the most minerals and won the competition! She was very happy and proud of herself.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max liked to perform tricks for his friends. He could jump high, roll over, and play fetch. Max was very good at doing tricks, but he wanted to learn more.

One day, Max saw a big dog who could do a trick he had not learned yet. The big dog could stand on two legs and dance! Max wanted to be independent and teach himself this new trick. He tried and tried, but he could not do it.

Max felt sad, but then he had an idea. He asked the big dog to help him learn the new trick. The big dog was happy to help. Together, they practiced and practiced. Soon, Max could stand on two legs and dance too! Now, Max could do more tricks and he was proud to be independent.

Lila and Ben were best friends. They liked to play in the park with their toys. Lila had a doll and Ben had a car. They shared their snacks and had fun.

One day, they saw a big orange cat in the park. It was sitting on a bench, licking its paw. Lila and Ben wanted to pet the cat. They walked slowly towards it.

"Meow," the cat said. It looked at them with green eyes.

"Hello, cat," Lila said. "You are very pretty. Can we pet you?"

The cat did not answer. It arched its back and hissed.

"Be careful," Ben said. "The cat does not like us. It might scratch us."

Lila did not listen to Ben. She reached out her hand to touch the cat. The cat swiped at her with its claws.

"Ow!" Lila cried. She pulled back her hand. It had a red mark on it. It hurt a lot.

"I told you to be careful," Ben said. He was a reliable friend. He always warned Lila when something was dangerous. He took out a tissue from his pocket and wrapped it around Lila's hand.

"Thank you, Ben," Lila said. She was sorry she did not listen to him. She hugged him.

The cat jumped off the bench and ran away. Lila and Ben decided to leave the cat alone. They went back to their toys and played some more. They were happy.

One day a girl picked up a twig. She looked at it closely and thought that it was interesting. She thought about the different things she could do with it. She decided to draw shapes and animals in the dirt, using it as a tool. She had lots of fun drawing, and before long she had many different pictures she could show to her friends.

The girl then realized that the twig wasn't just for drawing. She used it to pick and pluck dandelions from the ground. She made a wish as she blew on them and watched as the petals flew away.

Finally, the girl used the twig to make a whistle. She enjoyed making music and whistling tunes with it. When she was done playing, she put the twig down in a safe spot so she could pick it up next time.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient tree. Its leaves were soft and green. The tree loved the sun and smiled when it shone brightly.

One day, a gust of wind came and blew gently. The tree waved its branches in the wind, like it was dancing. Suddenly, a spark flew up from the ground and landed on the tree. The tree's leaves started to smoke.

The wind blew stronger and soon the tree was burning. Its leaves vanished and became ashes that flew away in the wind. The tree was gone, but now its spirit flew around in the air.

The ancient tree will never be forgotten, because its ashes still fly in the wind.

Once upon a time, there was a powerful king who ruled over a big kingdom. He had a lot of money and a big castle. The king was very proud of himself and thought he was better than everyone else.

One day, the king saw a poor man kneel down in front of him and ask for some food. The king didn't like the smell of smoke on the man's clothes and thought he was dirty. The king refused to give the man any food and sent him away.

Later that night, the king had a dream where he saw himself as the poor man, kneeling down and asking for food. He woke up feeling ashamed of himself and realized that he should have been kind to the man. From that day on, the king became a kind and generous person, helping anyone who needed it. The moral of the story is to always be kind to others, no matter who they are or what they look like.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she found a shiny stone on the ground. It was very pretty, but it was also very difficult to pick up because it was heavy.

Lily's mom came outside and saw her struggling. "What's wrong, Lily?" she asked.

"This stone is too difficult to pick up," Lily replied.

"Well, why don't we try melting it?" her mom suggested.

"Melt it?" Lily asked, confused.

"Yes, we can put it in the sun and it will get so hot that it will melt," her mom explained.

So, they put the stone in the sun and watched as it slowly started to melt. Lily was amazed and couldn't stop staring. "Wow, it's melting!" she exclaimed.

Her mom smiled and said, "See, sometimes things that seem difficult can be solved in a simple way."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, but one day it was very cold and the ground was icy. Lily's mom told her to be careful and wear her warm coat.

Lily went outside and saw a maze made of hay bales. She thought it looked like fun, so she ran into the maze. But soon she got lost and didn't know which way to go.

Lily's mom called for her, but Lily ignored her because she wanted to find her way out of the maze on her own. Finally, Lily found her way out and her mom gave her a big hug. From that day on, Lily knew to always listen to her mom and be careful in the icy weather.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl called Anna. She loved to paint with her special painting set. One day, Anna's mommy gave her a brand new pan to paint with. She was so excited!

Anna said, "Oh thank you mommy! What will I paint?"

Mommy saw a beautiful rainbow sky outside and said, "Why not paint the sky, Anna? It looks so mild and lovely today."

Anna smiled and set to work. First she got some bright blue paint and put it in the pan. Then she used a brush to paint the sky. After a few minutes, it was done!

Anna proudly looked at her beautiful rainbow painting. She beamed and said, "Mommy, it looks so nice!" Mommy nodded in agreement.

Anna and Mommy admired the beautiful painting together. It was Anna's very first painting in her new pan and they both loved it!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was very proud of his toy car collection. He loved to play with the cars, making them race and crash into each other.

One day, Tim saw a new toy car in the store. It was just an inch long, but it was the coolest car he had ever seen. He knew he had to have it. So, Tim went to his mom and requested, "Mom, can I have the car, please?"

His mom smiled and said, "Yes, Tim, you can have the car, but you have to be a good boy and help me with chores." Tim agreed and helped his mom with the chores. He was a very happy and proud boy when he got the new toy car.

Tim played with his new car all day long. He raced it against his other cars and had so much fun. Tim was proud of his new car, and he knew that by being a good boy and helping his mom, he could make her proud too. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Ben. Ben loved to play in the forest with his friends. One day, Ben found a big rock and wanted to climb it. He struggled to climb it because it was very high, but he didn't give up. Finally, he made it to the top and felt very proud of himself.

As Ben walked through the forest, he felt something strange on his paw. He looked down and saw a leaf with a rough texture stuck to it. He tried to shake it off, but it wouldn't budge. He asked his friend, the rabbit, for help. The rabbit gently pulled the leaf off and Ben felt much better.
