The little girl was so happy. She smiled and hugged her board. After that, she had the power to swim anywhere.

Once upon a time, there was a stubborn little girl called Lily. Every day, Lily's mum would cook lunch for her which was usually rice. But every day, Lily would refuse eat it and instead would pout her lips and make a sad face.

Today was no different. Lily's mum placed her plate of rice on the table and said, "It's lunch time! Are you hungry?" But Lily just sighed and refused to eat.

Seeing the sad look on her daughter's face, Lily's mum said, "Come on now, don't be stubborn. Just have one bite of your favourite food - rice!"

At this, Lily smiled and happily replied, "Ok mum!" She eagerly started to eat her plate of tasty rice.

Lily's mum smiled and said, "See, it's not so bad, is it?"

Lily nodded her head and said with a full tummy, "It's yum yum!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived on a farm. She had her own pet pig named Stan, who she loved very much. Everyday, she would take Stan for a walk around the farm.

One day, the little girl went to the forest to find some sticks to make a fire with. As she was walking, she saw a reliable old man who was chopping wood with an axe. The little girl stopped and watched the old man chop the wood.

The old man saw the little girl and said, "Hi! You must be looking for sticks too?" The little girl nodded, and the old man said that they should work together.

The little girl, Stan, and the old man all worked hard chopping wood and soon, they had a big pile of wood. The old man smiled and said, "Thank you, I'm grateful to have met you."

The little girl smiled at him, hugged Stan, and said, "Thank you for helping us. We're also grateful we met you!" The old man smiled, waved goodbye, and walked back to his home. From that day, the little girl remembered the old man and always thought of him as reliable.

Anna and Ben were playing in the park. They liked to jump on the swings and slide down the slide. They saw a big tree with many leaves. They wanted to climb the tree and see the sky.

"Look, Ben, I see an angel!" Anna said, pointing to a white cloud. "She is so pretty and shiny. Do you think she can hear us?"

"Maybe, Anna. Maybe she can. Let's say hello to her," Ben said. He climbed higher on the tree and waved his hand. "Hello, angel! We are Anna and Ben. We are your friends!"

Anna followed Ben and climbed higher too. She also waved her hand and said hello. She felt happy and excited. She wanted to touch the angel.

"Ben, I have an idea. Let's jump to the angel. Maybe she will catch us and take us to heaven. It will be fun!" Anna said.

"Are you sure, Anna? That sounds dangerous. The tree is very high and the ground is very hard. What if we fall and hurt ourselves?" Ben said. He was scared and serious.

"Don't be silly, Ben. The angel will not let us fall. She will protect us and love us. Come on, let's jump together. One, two, three!" Anna said. She let go of the tree and jumped to the cloud.

Ben saw Anna jump and felt sorry for her. He wanted to stop her, but it was too late. He heard Anna scream and saw her fall. He saw blood and tears. He saw the angel fade away. He cried and cried. He wished he could jump too, but he was too afraid. He was alone and sad. He wished he never saw the angel. He wished he never played in the park. He wished he never met Anna.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her favorite blanket at bedtime. It was soft and cozy and made her feel safe. One night, Lily went to bed with her blanket, but she couldn't fall asleep. She tossed and turned, but she just couldn't get comfortable.

Suddenly, she heard a persistent noise coming from under her bed. It sounded like something was trying to get out. Lily was scared, but she knew she had to be brave. She took a deep breath and slowly pushed her blanket aside. That's when she saw a little mouse stuck in a trap.

Lily knew she had to help the mouse. She carefully pushed the trap open and the mouse scurried away. Lily felt happy knowing she had helped a little creature in need. She snuggled back under her blanket and fell asleep with a smile on her face. From that night on, Lily slept soundly, knowing she had done a good deed.

Ben and Lily are playing with their toys in the living room. They have a lot of cars, dolls, blocks and animals. Ben likes to attach things together and make new toys. Lily likes to pretend that her dolls are her friends and talk to them.

"Look, Lily, I made a rocket!" Ben says, showing her a car with a block and a bottle on top. "It can fly to the moon and back!"

"That's cool, Ben!" Lily says, smiling. "Can I see it?"

Ben gives her the rocket and Lily holds it in her hands. She makes a whoosh sound and moves it in the air.

Suddenly, their cat, Fluffy, jumps on the couch and sees the rocket. Fluffy is a clumsy cat. He always knocks things over and chases things that move. He thinks the rocket is a toy for him. He pounces on it and tries to grab it with his paws.

"Hey, Fluffy, stop!" Ben shouts. "That's my rocket!"

"Meow!" Fluffy says, not listening. He bites the bottle and pulls it off the car. He runs away with it in his mouth.

"Oh no, Fluffy broke your rocket!" Lily says, feeling sorry for Ben. "I'm sorry, Ben."

Ben is sad and angry. He loves his rocket and he worked hard to make it. He wants to get it back from Fluffy.

"It's okay, Lily," he says, trying to be brave. "Maybe we can fix it. Let's go find Fluffy and get my bottle back."

Ben and Lily get up and follow Fluffy. They see him hiding under the table with the bottle. He is playing with it and making it squeak.

"Fluffy, give me my bottle!" Ben says, reaching for it.

"Meow!" Fluffy says, holding it tighter.

Ben and Lily try to get the bottle from Fluffy, but he is too fast and too strong. He scratches them and runs away again.

"Ow, Fluffy, that hurts!" Lily says, rubbing her arm.

"Bad cat, bad cat!" Ben says, shaking his fist.

They chase Fluffy around the house, but they can't catch him. He is too clever and too clumsy. He knocks over lamps, books, vases and pictures. He makes a big mess.

"Fluffy, stop!" Ben and Lily say, but Fluffy doesn't stop.

Mom and Dad hear the noise and come to see what's going on. They see Ben and Lily running after Fluffy and the mess he made.

"What are you doing, kids?" Mom asks, surprised.

"Fluffy took my rocket and broke it!" Ben says, pointing at the cat.

"Fluffy is a naughty cat!" Lily says, nodding.

Mom and Dad look at Fluffy and see the bottle in his mouth. They understand what happened.

"Oh, Fluffy, you silly cat!" Mom says, shaking her head.

"Fluffy, come here!" Dad says, calling him.

Fluffy sees Mom and Dad and drops the bottle. He runs to them and rubs his head against their legs. He purrs and looks at them with his big eyes.

"Meow!" Fluffy says, as if to say sorry.

Mom and Dad pick up Fluffy and cuddle him. They love Fluffy, even if he is a clumsy cat.

"Fluffy, you can't take Ben's toys and break them," Mom says, gently.

"Fluffy, you have to be careful and not make a mess," Dad says, softly.

Ben and Lily come closer and look at Fluffy. They are still mad at him, but they also love him. He is their cat, after all.

"Fluffy, you are a bad cat, but we forgive you," Ben says, touching his nose.

"Fluffy, you are a silly cat, but we still like you," Lily says, stroking his fur.

Fluffy licks their hands and makes a happy sound.

"Meow!" Fluffy says, as if to say thank you.

Mom and Dad smile and hug Ben and Lily. They are proud of them for being kind and forgiving.

"Kids, you are good kids," Mom says, kissing them.

"Kids, you are sweet kids," Dad says, hugging them.

Ben and Lily smile and hug Mom and Dad. They are happy and grateful.

"Mom, Dad, we love you," Ben and Lily say, together.

They all sit on the couch and cuddle with Fluffy. They forget about the rocket and the mess. They are a happy family.

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Lily and Pete. They were playing in the park together. All of a sudden, Lily had an idea. She said, "Let's make a medal." Pete got really excited and started to look for some stones, sticks and leaves. Together, they used the stones and leaves to make a beautiful medal.

Then Lily and Pete put it on a blue ribbon and tied it tightly. They both looked at the medal and laughed with joy. It was so creative! They both felt very proud.

After that, Pete put on the medal and so did Lily. Then they ran around the park and laughed more. They both had the best time together.

The medal will always remind them of how fun it was to play together and how creative they were being. They will often look back and laugh, remembering the special day they made the medal.

Once upon a time, there was a brave pink rabbit called Bob. Bob was a gentle creature and he spent most of his days observing the world around him. One day, Bob had a funny urge to try something crazy. He felt something was telling him to do something wild, like hopping up to the sun! Bob thought this was a silly thought and dismissed it.

But then something strange happened. As Bob continued to observe, he noticed a cloud up in the sky slowly moving directly over the sun. Perhaps this was Bob’s sign? He took a deep breath and decided that he should try something he never did before.

So Bob hopped as hard as he could and jumped right on top of the cloud. He was shocked! He was so high up! For a moment, Bob felt like he could touch the sun. After a while, Bob started to feel scared and had to quickly make his way back down.

Once he was back in his little home, Bob learnt an important lesson. He didn’t have to do something wild and crazy to have an exciting adventure. He could just observe and appreciate the world around him. Bob was satisfied that he had learnt a valuable lesson and happily hopped off to bed.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She always wanted to win but was never a winner. Every day she tried her best, but still never won.

One day she found a vest. It was a blue vest with colorful flowers all over it. She was so excited that she wore it everywhere she went.

The girl tried one more time, and this time she WON! The people around her cheered and clapped. She was so happy, she ran around and around with her new vest on.

She was having so much fun that she got careless and stumbled. Her vest got caught on a fence. She was about to cry, but then something amazing happened. A special fairy came with a pair of scissors and cut the vest off. She was so relieved, and from then on always tried to be careful, just in case she ever WON anything like that again!

Once upon a time there was a very powerful package. It was a wonderful package and all the kids wanted it. One day, a 3 year old child called John wanted to play with the package. He wanted to improve it.

So John gave it his best try. He added some colors to it and made it nicer. He kept on trying and soon the package was looking even better. Everyone thought it looked super duper.

John was so happy. His little effort made a big change and he was proud of himself. He wanted to improve it even more and made it look even better.

At the end of the day, John had made a powerful package! Everyone was very impressed and they were very happy with the work John had done.

John had improved the package and was very proud of himself. From then on, John always took time to make things even better.

Once upon a time, there was a king who loved to play hide-and-seek. He always played with his best friend, a little mouse. One day, the king forgot to play hide-and-seek with his friend. The little mouse waited and waited, but the king never came.

The little mouse went to the king's castle to find him. When he saw the king, he said, "Why did you forget to play with me today? I was waiting for you."

The king felt ashamed and said, "I'm sorry, my friend. I forgot. Let's play now!"

They played hide-and-seek until the sun went down. The king promised to never forget about his friend again. From that day on, they played every day and the king was always happy to have his little friend by his side.

Once upon a time there was a wealthy family. They lived in a beautiful house and had many special treasures. One day, an old wise man paid a visit to the family and gave them a gift. It was a special box and inside it was a magical stone. The family was very excited and welcomed the wise man warmly into their home.

The wise man said that the magic stone could receive something special. He told the family to make a wish, think about what they wanted most, and the magic stone would make it happen.

The family thought hard about what they wanted but could not decide. Suddenly their three year old son ran up and said, "I wish we could travel around the world together!" The wise man smiled and said, "Your wish will be granted!"

The family was overjoyed. They thanked the wise man and hugged their son. And by the power of the magical stone, the family went on a worldwide adventure, full of magic and surprises.

Once upon a time, there was a very cheerful bird. She always smiled and sang brightly every day. She lived in a beautiful park with lots of trees, but her favorite spot was the gate at the entrance.

One day, the bird left the park in search of adventure. She wanted to explore the world and see what else was out there. She had a great time, but eventually, the bird missed the cheerful gate at her home.

The bird's heart was filled with joy as she returned to the park. The gate was just as cheerful as ever and the bird smiled. She spent the rest of the day flying around the park, enjoying her home and the warm welcome from the gate.

The cheerful bird stayed in the park for a long time, happy to finally be home.

One day, a poor family had no money. The father said to his daughter, "We need to find a way to make money. Please help us!"

The little girl had an idea. She knew of a rug in the attic. She ran up and grabbed it. She returned and showed it to her father.

The father said, "Good work! Now if you can sell this rug, we will have some money to buy food."

The little girl took the rug to the market. She showed it to different people, but nobody wanted to buy it. She was feeling sad and desperate.

Suddenly, an old man said, "I'll buy the rug. I can make something beautiful with it." The little girl was delighted and they both agreed on the price.

The man thanked the girl and said, "Your task is complete. You should be proud of yourself." The girl thanked him and ran home, happy to have helped her family.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a favorite toy, a teddy bear, that she loved to hold all day long. One day, while playing outside, Lily fell and hurt her leg. She was upset and started to cry.

Her mom came over and asked, "What happened, Lily? Are you okay?"

Lily replied, "I fell and my leg hurts. Can you hold me?"

Her mom picked her up and held her close. Lily felt better knowing her mom was there to comfort her. She held her teddy bear tight and said, "Thank you, Mommy. I love you."

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved music and wanted to start a band. But he didn't have any friends to play with him. One day, he met a bald man who played guitar. "Can you help me start a band?" asked Timmy. "Sure, I can manage that," replied the bald man.

They started practicing every day and soon they had a great band. One day, they went to play in the park. A little girl came up to them and said, "I love your band! Can I join?" "Of course!" said Timmy. "We need a singer." The little girl started singing and they sounded even better.

From that day on, they played together every day. They managed to get better and better. They even got to play at a big concert. Timmy was so happy that he managed to start a band with his new friends.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play in the farm. One day, they see a big truck with many bags of wheat. The truck is slow and loud.

"Where is the truck going?" Anna asks.

"Let's follow it and see," Ben says.

They run after the truck, but they are careful not to get too close. They see the truck stop at a big building with a sign that says "Mill". They hear a noise like "zzzz".

"What is that?" Anna asks.

"That is the mill. It makes the wheat into flour," Ben says.

"What is flour?" Anna asks.

"Flour is what you use to make bread and cake and cookies," Ben says.

"Yum, I like bread and cake and cookies," Anna says.

"Me too," Ben says.

They watch as the men take the bags of wheat from the truck and put them in the mill. They see a white powder come out of the mill and go into another truck.

"Can we have some flour?" Anna asks.

"No, we can't. It is not ours. It belongs to the baker," Ben says.

"Who is the baker?" Anna asks.

"The baker is the person who makes the bread and cake and cookies," Ben says.

"Can we follow the baker?" Anna asks.

"OK, let's follow the baker," Ben says.

They run after the truck with the flour. They hope to see the baker and maybe get a treat. They are happy and curious. They like to follow and learn.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and drink milk before bed. One night, Lily's doll, Rosie, broke her arm. Lily was very sad and didn't know what to do.

The next day, Lily's mom took her to a toy store. They found a man who could repair Rosie's arm. Lily was very happy and thanked her mom.

Later that day, Lily's little brother spilled milk all over the kitchen floor. Their mom was angry and told him to clean it up. Lily helped him and they both laughed.

That night, Lily hugged Rosie tightly and whispered, "I'm so happy you're all better now."

Gloria was a graceful girl. She was always helping her mom. One day, she found an old fork in the corner of the kitchen. She thought it was so cool and decided to take it outside and hang it on a tree.

She balanced the fork carefully on a big branch, so it looked like it was floating in the breeze. She thought she had done a good job but when she was about to go back inside, the wind picked up and the fork too. It flew away and now it was nowhere to be seen.

Gloria was very sad. She had wanted to keep the fork but now she couldn't even find it. She realized that it had been a bad idea to hang it on the tree and that she had better listen to her mom next time.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He was a very wealthy little boy and he liked to wear his fancy sweaters every day. One day, Tim’s mom gave him a special sweater to wear. It was bright blue with a green stripe.

Tim put on his new sweater and went out to play in the garden. Suddenly, Tim heard a loud snap. He looked around and saw that his special sweater had ripped in two. Tim started to cry and said, “I can’t wear my new sweater anymore!”

Tim’s mom walked up to him and said, “Don’t worry, Tim. I can fix it.” Tim’s mom took out her needle and thread and began to stitch the two pieces of sweater together. In no time at all, his special sweater was as good as new.

Tim was so happy that his mom could fix his sweater. From then on, he was extra careful whenever he was wearing it. Even though Tim was wealthy, he still wanted to take care of the things he loved.

Once upon a time, there lived a very happy family. The father was named Jack and the mother was named Jill. They had a daughter named Lily. Lily was only three years old and loved playing with her toys. One day, Jack and Jill decided it was time for them to marry.

When Lily heard the news, she clapped her hands and was so excited. She asked her parents, "What will I get for the marry?"

Jack and Jill smiled and handed her a shiny coin. Lily studied the coin and saw that it was harmless. She liked the coin very much, and kept it in a safe place.

From then on, the family was very happy. Whenever they looked at the coin, they remembered the day they decided to marry each other.

Once upon a time, there was a fat little girl named Daisy. Daisy loved to dress up in the prettiest clothes. One day, she was having fun while playing dress up when she heard a voice coming from her closet. It said, "Hey, Daisy, come over here!" Daisy was scared and ran away as fast as she could.

The next day, Daisy was still scared but also curious. She crept slowly to the closet and asked, "Who's in there?" The voice said, "Come and find out!" Daisy slowly opened the closet and to her surprise, out came a big, fat duck!

The duck said, "I knew you were brave enough to come in. Do you want me to give you a dress so you can look even more beautiful than you already do?" Daisy said yes and the duck gave her a golden dress. Daisy put the dress on and it fit her perfectly!

From that day on, Daisy and the duck were best friends. Whenever Daisy needed a dress, the duck was always there to help her. Daisy never had to be scared in the closet ever again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a kite. It was a very popular kite. It was red and blue. All the kids liked it. Tim was happy.

One day, a girl named Sue saw Tim's kite. She liked it a lot. She wanted to buy it. "Can I buy your kite?" she asked. Tim thought for a moment. He liked his kite, but he wanted to be nice to Sue.

Tim said, "Yes, I will sell you my kite." Sue was very happy. She gave Tim some money. Tim gave Sue the kite. Now, Sue had a popular kite, too.

Sue and Tim played with their kites every day. They had lots of fun. All the kids wanted a kite like Tim's and Sue's. They were the most popular kids in the park.

Ben and Mia are friends. They like to play together. One day, they go to the park with their moms. They see a big slide. They want to go on the slide.

"Can we go on the slide, mom?" Ben asks.

"Yes, you can. But be careful and wait your turn," his mom says.

Ben and Mia run to the slide. They are enthusiastic. They love the motion of sliding down fast. They laugh and scream.

"Wow, this is fun!" Mia says.

"I want to do it again!" Ben says.

They go up and down the slide many times. They are happy. Their moms watch them and smile. They are proud of their children. They think they are brave and kind. They have a good time at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to crawl around on the ground like a little bug. He would crawl under tables and chairs and even under his bed.

One day, Timmy's mom took him to the park. There were lots of kids playing on the swings and slides. Timmy saw that the slide was very popular and he wanted to try it too.

But when he got to the top of the slide, he was scared. "I don't want to go down," he said to his mom.

"It's okay, Timmy," his mom said. "Just crawl down on your tummy like a little worm."

So, Timmy crawled down the slide on his tummy and it was so much fun! He laughed and giggled all the way down. From that day on, crawling and sliding became his favorite things to do at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little frog named Tim. Tim loved to hop all day long. One day, Tim saw the big sea and wanted to hop there too.

Tim hopped and hopped until he reached the sea. He saw a big fish and thought the fish was stupid. Tim wanted to play a game with the fish, so he hopped into the sea.

The big fish saw Tim and wanted to play too. They played and had fun in the sea. Tim learned that the fish was not stupid, but very smart and nice. They became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mary. She was very tired and sleepy, so she decided to go to bed. She went up the stairs and into her room. She put on her pajamas and snuggled up to her favorite teddy bear.

Mary was almost asleep, when she heard a sound that made her jump. It was a loud noise that came from outside. She was scared, so she got up to find out what it was.

Mary tiptoed to the window and peeked out. She saw a group of people playing with sparklers in the yard. They made lots of loud noises, and the sparklers made pretty lights in the dark night.

Mary watched the people until they finished their fun. After they left, it was very quiet and peaceful. She felt much better and very tired, so she went back to bed. She fell asleep to the peaceful sound of crickets chirping.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who had a goal. She wanted to go to the top of the mountain and see what was there. But the mountain was very high, and the path was long.

The girl began to climb and soon the sun went down. When it was dark, the girl stopped walking. She was tired and she was cold.

The girl began to weep. She was far away from her home and she was stuck. She didn't know what to do.

Then, after a while, the girl saw a light. It was coming from a big house at the top of the mountain. The girl walked towards the house and when she got there, she saw a kind woman. She gave the girl some food to eat and a warm bed to sleep in.

The kind woman said, "You can stay here tonight and then tomorrow you can keep climbing and reach your goal".

From that day, the girl never stopped believing in her goal. She kept climbing and she eventually reached the top of the mountain. And there, she saw the most beautiful view.

She was glad she stayed strong and never gave up. She was proud of her long journey and all she had accomplished.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little monkey named Tommy. He lived in the jungle with all his animal friends.

One day, Tommy was feeling adventurous and he wanted to try something new. He wondered what surprises the jungle might have in store for him.

He asked his best friend, a giraffe named Jerry, to join him. Jerry agreed quickly, saying "Let's go explore the jungle".

So the two of them set off, curious about what life in the jungle had to offer. Along their journey, they noticed something strange - the air had changed. It felt like something was different.

Suddenly, they heard a noise. Tommy and Jerry look around to see a big elephant holding a big treat in his trunk.

The elephant said "Hi Tommy and Jerry. I brought this treat as a surprise. I know you were curious to discover something new today - so I thought I would give you a special treat!"

Tommy and Jerry were overjoyed. They thanked the elephant and soon found out that surprises were everywhere in the jungle. It was really fun to explore and make new discoveries.

One day, Jack and his dad went to the park. Jack saw many different flags hanging in the sky. He asked his dad what they were.

Dad said, "These flags bring us together as one, no matter what we look like or where we come from."

Jack asked, "Why do some people not like flags?"

Dad explained, "Some people don't understand the flags and are ignorant. They don't understand that the flags represent peace and friendship."

Jack smiled and said, "I like flags because they are pretty and they mean we are all friends."

His dad smiled, too, and said, "Me too, son. Me too."

Lily was a clever girl who liked to help her mom. One day, she saw her mom's razor on the sink. She thought it was a toy and wanted to play with it. She picked it up and ran to her room.

"Look, mom, I have a toy!" she shouted.

"No, Lily, that's not a toy, that's a razor!" her mom said, following her. "It's sharp and can hurt you. Give it to me, please."

But Lily did not listen. She wanted to see what the razor could do. She tried to cut her doll's hair with it, but it did not work. She tried to cut her blanket, but it did not work. She tried to cut her book, but it did not work. She got angry and threw the razor on the floor.

CRACK!

The razor broke into pieces. Lily was scared. She saw blood on her hand. She had cut herself with the razor. She started to cry.

"Mom, mom, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!" she sobbed.

Her mom hugged her and took her to the bathroom. She washed her hand and put a band-aid on it. She threw away the broken razor and told Lily to never touch it again.

"It's okay, Lily, you're not in trouble, but you have to be careful," her mom said. "Razors are not toys, they are for grown-ups. Next time, ask me before you take something that is not yours, okay?"

"Okay, mom, I'm sorry, I love you," Lily said.

"I love you too, Lily, you're a clever girl, but sometimes you need to listen more," her mom said. "Now, let's go and read a book together, how about that?"

Lily nodded and smiled. She learned her lesson and never touched a razor again. She and her mom read a book and had a happy day.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a silly bird named Bobo. Bobo loved to fly high in the sky and play with his friends. One sunny day, while Bobo was flying, he saw a sad cat named Mimi on the ground.

Bobo flew down to Mimi and asked, "Why are you sad, Mimi?" Mimi looked up at the sky and said, "I wish I could fly like you, Bobo. I want to see the sky up close." Bobo thought for a moment and then had an idea. He offered to help Mimi see the sky.

Bobo told Mimi to jump on his back and hold on tight. Mimi was scared at first, but she trusted her friend. Together, they flew up into the sky. Mimi was so happy to see the sky up close. They flew around and had a lot of fun.

When they came back down, Mimi thanked Bobo for his help. She learned that even though she was different, her friends would always be there to help her. Bobo learned that it was good to help others and that it made him feel happy too.

The moral of the story is that we should always be kind and offer help to our friends, even if they are different from us.

Lily was very happy. She had a great idea. She wanted to invite her friends to play with her new toy. It was a big box with many ropes and beads. She could make knots and bracelets and necklaces with them.

She ran to her mom and said, "Mom, can I invite Sam and Mia and Ben to play with me? I have a new toy and it is very fun!"

Mom smiled and said, "Sure, Lily, you can invite them. But first, you have to clean your room and eat your lunch. Then you can call them and ask if they can come."

Lily nodded and said, "OK, Mom, I will do that. Thank you!" She ran to her room and put away her books and toys. Then she ate her lunch very fast. She was eager to play with her new toy and her friends.

She picked up the phone and called Sam. He said, "Hi, Lily, what's up?"

Lily said, "Hi, Sam, I have a great toy. It is a box with ropes and beads. You can make knots and bracelets and necklaces with them. Do you want to come and play with me?"

Sam said, "Wow, that sounds cool. Yes, I want to come and play with you. Can I bring Mia and Ben?"

Lily said, "Yes, of course. The more, the merrier. Come to my house at two o'clock. See you soon!"

Lily hung up the phone and clapped her hands. She was very excited. She had invited her friends to play with her new toy. She knew they would have a lot of fun making knots and bracelets and necklaces. She ran to the box and opened it. She took out some ropes and beads and started to make a knot. She was very happy.

Once upon a time there was a jolly bone. The bone belonged to a doggy, who wanted to play with it all the time. The bone was special because it could roll around all by itself and the doggy loved chasing it.

One day, a naughty rabbit came and wanted to play too. The rabbit was so excited when he saw the bone, he started to playrough. He tried to take the bone away from the doggy.

The doggy wasn't happy about this and growled at the rabbit. The rabbit ran away, but not before knocking down the bone, which made it break. The doggy howled sadly. The naughty rabbit had destroyed the bone.

The End.

Once there was a wealthy robot who liked to do things in reverse. He reversed all the way to work, then he reversed all the way home again. He reversed when he went shopping and reversed when he went out to play. Everyone thought it was really strange but the robot liked it!

One day, the robot was reversing through the park when he saw a little boy playing. The robot was so excited he reversed right up to the boy. The boy was scared at first, but then he saw the robot was friendly and started to laugh. He asked the robot to reverse all around the park with him and the robot happily agreed!

The boy and the robot had so much fun. The boy chased the robot, and the robot chased the boy. They went around and around until it was time for the boy to go home. Before the robot left, he made sure the boy was safely back with his parents.

The robot and the boy played together a lot after that. They went on many adventures, always reversing and laughing. They were the best of friends!

Once upon a time, there was a bald man who went for a walk. On his way, he met a pink bird sitting on a branch. The man said “Hello, bird! What are you doing here?” The bird said, “I am waiting for someone to pick me up.”

The bald man asked, “Is he someone special to you?” The bird nodded and said, “Yes, he is.” The man smiled and said, “I can help you meet him. I will take you to him now.”

So the bald man and the pink bird went walking together. As they were walking, the man noticed that the bird wasn’t happy. He asked her what was wrong, but the bird would not answer.

Finally, they arrived at the man’s house. But when the bird saw what was inside, she started to cry. The man was not the one she was looking for. He had tricked her into coming to his house.

The pink bird never met the person she was hoping to meet. And the man never saw the bird again. The bad ending made the bald man feel very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy. He had never been on a boat before. One day, he and his mom went to the lake. The boy was so excited to see the boat! He had never seen one before.

The boat was big and white. He stepped onto it and was amazed. All around him were blue waves. But then he got scared. The boat was rocking on the water and he felt a little frightened.

Suddenly, the boat started moving. The boy clung to his mom's hand. He watched the shoreline get farther and farther away. He didn't know what to do.

But then the boat stopped. The boy let out a deep breath and was not so frightened any more. He looked around and noticed that the boat was now in a different spot. He had been on a boat ride!

The small boy's mom gave him a big hug. She was glad that he had faced his fears and gone for his first boat ride. He was so brave!

The boy smiled and waved goodbye to the boat as it sailed away. He was so proud of himself. He had been scared, but he had seen a boat and gone on a ride.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to climb trees and play outside. One day, she saw a unique bird with colorful feathers. She wanted to get a closer look, so she climbed up the tree. As she was climbing, she felt herself starting to tip over. But she held on tight and made it to the top. She watched the bird for a while before climbing back down. From that day on, Lily always looked for unique birds to climb up and see.

Once there was a bird. It was small and grey and it could fly. Every day it went out to perform. It loved to fly up high. It flew right up to the clouds and then glided back down to the ground.

One day, the bird was feeling very brave and it decided to fly farther than ever before. So, it spread its wings and set off. It flew for a very long time and eventually it could not see the ground anymore.

The bird was amazed at all the things it could see from up there. There were so many colors and shapes. It thought to itself, "This is wonderful!" The bird was happy and enjoyed the view for a long time.

When the bird was ready, it started to make its way back to the ground. It had to perform many flips and turns to find the right way home. After a while, the bird found the ground, and it was relieved to be there.

The bird was sure to remember its long adventure in the sky. It had been a very thrilling experience that it would not soon forget.

Once upon a time, there was a thin tank. It was filled with water and made everything around it wet. The tank didn't want to delay but it had to wait. It knew someone was coming to help it out.

So it waited patiently by a tree in the sun. The sun was so hot but the tank stayed still. The ants and bugs crawled by the tank. Soon, a boy came to help the tank. He was a big boy, with strong hands.

The boy put the tank on his back and started walking. He was careful not to delay, so they were soon on the move. The tank was glad to have a new home. The boy trekked up a big hill, with the thin tank on his back.

At the top, the tank could see for miles. The tank could finally start its long awaited journey. With the boy leading the way, there was no need for delay. The tank and boy cheered for joy!

Once there were two friends, Sammy and Andy. Sammy had an ordinary padlock. He was so excited to use it, because it was brand new!

Andy had a new pair of scissors that were very special. He said that it could help Sammy to unlock the padlock. Sammy was curious and asked how.

Andy smiled, telling Sammy that he needed to press the sharp point of the scissors against the padlock. Sammy tried it, and it worked! The padlock opened and Sammy was so excited!

From then on, Sammy and Andy had a special secret they shared. Everywhere they wanted to open something, they could use the scissors to unlock it.

They had so much fun and Sammy was so thankful that he had Andy to help him discover this wonderful secret.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a diary where she wrote about her day. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. They played on the swings and the slide, but Lily didn't want to include one of her friends in the game they were playing. Her friend felt sad and left the park.

Lily felt bitter about what happened and went home. She looked at her diary and realized that she had written mean things about her friend. She felt bad and decided to apologize to her friend the next day. The next day, Lily went back to the park and found her friend. She said sorry and asked her to play with them. Her friend forgave her and they all had fun together. From that day on, Lily made sure to include everyone in their games and never wrote mean things in her diary again.

Once upon a time there was a cute girl called Daisy. She liked to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she found a daisy growing in the grass and thought it was beautiful. She decided to pick the daisy and take it home to show her parents.

When Daisy got home, she showed her parents the daisy and they thought it was really cute. Her mom helped her make a daisy crown for her to wear.

Afterwards, Daisy went outside to play. She twirled around in the sunshine and picked more daisies to make a pretty daisy chain. When she was finished, she showed her new daisy chain to her parents. They thought it was very cute and clever.

So the next time you see a daisy, remember Daisy and how much fun she had playing with it.

Once upon a time there was a young queen who was very smart, but also very poor. She was looking to buy new clothes, but all the ones she liked were too expensive. One day the queen went to the store and saw an amazing dress that she knew she had to have.

"How much is this dress?" she asked the shopkeeper.

"It's just five dollars!" the shopkeeper replied.

The queen was so happy! She took the dress home, but when she tried it on she realized it was too big. She stretched and stretched the dress, but it would not fit.

Then, she remembered something! She ran to the kitchen and grabbed a pot of boiling water. She poured it over the dress and it started to shrink and shrink until it fit perfectly!

The queen was so pleased with her new dress. She wore it every day and was the happiest queen in all the land.

Once there was a boy who was three and loved to roll in the grass. One day while he was rolling, something shiny caught his eye. He stopped and said "What's that?"

His mom smiled and said "It's a treasure, maybe it's useful."

So the boy picked it up and saw it was a shiny coin. He rolled it around in his hands and grinned. Then he asked, "What can I do with it?"

Mama said "You can do whatever you want, it's your treasure and it can be very useful!"

The little boy thought for a moment and then said, "I'll save it for when I'm bigger!"

He put his coin in a safe place and went off to play and roll in the grass.

Once upon a time, there was a big tank in the middle of a field. It was very dirty and needed to be cleaned. A man came with a hose and started to remove the dirt from the tank. But then, he saw that the tank was too big for him to clean alone.

Suddenly, a little boy came and saw the man struggling. He asked the man if he could help. The man was surprised but said yes. The little boy was very fit and was able to climb up the tank easily. He started to remove the dirt from the top of the tank.

But then, the little boy saw that there was a problem. There was a big hole in the tank and water was leaking out. The little boy knew he had to do something fast. He quickly climbed down and told the man about the hole. Together, they were able to fix the hole and clean the tank. The little boy felt very proud that he was able to help.

Tommy was playing hide and seek in the garden. He wanted to find the best hiding spot. He spotted a nice dry spot next to some old logs. He ran to it and started to dig with his hands. He dug and dug until he hit something hard. He moved the dirt away to see what it was. It was a box! He opened it and found lots of memories inside-- photographs and toys Tommy used to love when he was little. Tommy was so happy to have found them and he decided to bury the box so that he could find the memories again in the future. He put the box into the hole and carefully covered it with the dry dirt so that nobody else could see it. Now Tommy always remembers the special memory-filled box that is buried in his garden.

Sara loves her pet cat, Max. Max is old and has gray fur. He likes to sleep on Sara's bed and cuddle with her. Sara always gives Max food and water and plays with him.

One day, Sara's mom brings home a new pet. It is a puppy, with brown fur and big ears. Sara's mom says, "This is Coco, our new family member. He is very cute and friendly. Do you want to meet him, Sara?"

Sara looks at Coco and feels curious. She wants to touch him and see how he is. But she also feels worried. What if Max does not like Coco? What if Coco is too loud and playful for Max? Sara loves Max and does not want him to be sad or scared.

She goes to her room and finds Max on her bed. She hugs him and says, "Don't worry, Max. You are still my best friend. I will always love you and take care of you. You are my favorite pet."

Max purrs and rubs his head against Sara's cheek. He is happy and calm. He does not care about Coco. He ignores him and stays with Sara.

Coco runs around the house and barks. He wants to play and make friends. He sees Max and Sara in the room and goes to them. He wags his tail and jumps on the bed. He tries to lick Max and Sara and invites them to play.

Max hisses and scratches Coco. He does not like him. He thinks he is annoying and rude. He wants him to go away and leave him alone.

Sara scolds Coco and says, "No, Coco. Bad puppy. You cannot do that. You have to be gentle and polite. You have to respect Max. He is old and needs rest. You have to wait until he is ready to play with you."

Coco whines and lowers his ears. He does not understand why Max and Sara are angry at him. He just wants to have fun and be friends. He feels sad and lonely.

Sara's mom comes to the room and sees what happened. She says, "Sara, I know you love Max, but you have to give Coco a chance. He is new and needs your love and attention too. He is not a bad puppy, he is just excited and curious. He will learn to behave and get along with Max. You have to be patient and kind with him."

Sara thinks about what her mom says. She feels sorry for Coco. She knows he is not mean, he is just different. She decides to give him a chance. She says, "Okay, mom. I will try to be nice to Coco. But I still love Max more."

Sara's mom smiles and says, "That's fine, Sara. You can love both of them. They are both your pets and part of our family. They will both love you back."

Sara nods and smiles. She pets Coco and says, "Hello, Coco. I'm Sara. Do you want to play with me?"

Coco wags his tail and licks Sara's face. He is happy and grateful. He says, "Woof, woof. Yes, Sara. I want to play with you. You are my friend."

Max watches them and sighs. He is not happy, but he is not angry either. He thinks, "Maybe Coco is not so bad after all. Maybe we can be friends too. But I will always be Sara's favorite pet." He closes his eyes and sleeps.

Once upon a time there was an orange sock. He lived his life in a very simple way. Every day he would keep running around and around, never stopping. He was a very happy sock.

One day he saw something interesting. It was a big, blue box. He wanted to explore what was inside, so he kept running towards it, until he made it to the box.

He opened the box and found a surprise inside. It was another orange sock! He was so excited and they kept playing together all day long.

The two socks were best friends from then on and they kept spending time with each other, playing, running and having fun. They were so happy that they never wanted to be separated.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to walk in the park with his mom. They would hold hands and look at the pretty flowers and trees. One day, Timmy saw a bird with a broken wing. The bird looked helpless and sad. Timmy wanted to help the bird, but he didn't know how.

Timmy's mom told him they could call a number to get help for the bird. Timmy was excited and watched as his mom made the call. Soon, a kind lady came to the park and took the bird away. Timmy felt happy that he was able to help the bird. From that day on, Timmy loved to walk in the park even more because he knew he could always help if he saw an animal in need.

One day, a three-year-old boy was very excited. He was getting his own special cane! It was bright and colorful, and just the right size for him. The boy waved the cane around and couldn't wait to show his friends.

His mom told him he could take a walk outside and explore. The boy couldn't wait! He stepped outside and waved his cane around in the air.

He made friends with some birds and showed them his cane. He kept walking and soon came across a pond. He used his cane to try to catch some fish.

After a while, the boy was ready to go home and show his family his special cane. He was very proud and happy. He had completed a great adventure, and he couldn't wait to tell them all about it.

Lily liked to play with her mom's makeup. She liked to put it on her face and pretend she was a princess. She liked the purple lipstick the most. It was shiny and pretty.

One day, Lily saw her mom's makeup on the table. She wanted to play with it. She took the purple lipstick and opened it. She put it on her lips and smiled. She looked in the mirror and felt happy.

But then, her mom came into the room. She saw Lily with the lipstick. She was not happy. She said, "Lily, what are you doing? That is my makeup. You are not allowed to play with it. You made a mess. Look at your face. And look at the table. There is lipstick everywhere. You need to clean it up."

Lily felt sad. She did not want to clean up. She wanted to play. She said, "But mom, I like the purple lipstick. It is so pretty. Please let me play with it. Please, please, please."

Her mom shook her head. She said, "No, Lily. You cannot play with my makeup. It is not for you. It is for grown-ups. You have your own toys to play with. And you need to learn to ask before you take something that is not yours. Now, give me the lipstick and help me clean up. Or you will have a time-out."

Lily did not like to have a time-out. She did not want to make her mom more angry. She gave the lipstick to her mom and said, "Sorry, mom. I will not do it again. I will help you clean up."

Her mom smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily. I love you. But please, no more playing with my makeup. OK?"

Lily nodded and said, "OK, mom. I love you too. But can I have a purple lipstick when I grow up?"

Her mom laughed and said, "Maybe, Lily. Maybe."

Once upon a time, there were two good friends, Jack and John. They went out to play one day, but then a problem arose. Jack found a trunk with a lot of money in it. He wanted to keep it all for himself.

John said, "Please don't. It's not yours." But Jack was being very foolish and he wouldn't listen. So John started to cry.

The tears made Jack feel bad, so he changed his mind. He shared the money with John, so they could both be happy.

The moral of this story is that it's better to be kind and share with others than to do something foolish.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old and loved the ocean. Every day, she would take a trip with her family to the port and wave to the ships as they sailed away.

One day, her family decided to try something new. They picked a ship that was heading to a distant land. As they boarded the ship, Lucy noticed a box of spicy food on the deck. She started to reach for it, but her mom stopped her.

"No, Lucy," her mom said. "It's not safe. You don't know what's inside of it."

But Lucy didn't listen. She opened the box and found a strange and spicy powder inside. She quickly put some of it in her mouth and it tasted really strange.

Suddenly, Lucy started to feel very sick. She wanted to get off the ship, but it was too late. She passed away on the ship before it even reached the port.

The family was devastated. When they returned home, they spread Lucy's ashes into the ocean, waving goodbye to her one final time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and her toy cars. One day, Lily and her mommy went to the store to buy some new toys.

Lily saw a big sign that said "Toys on Sale!" and she got very excited. She asked her mommy if she could buy a new doll and her mommy said yes. But Lily had to pay for it with her allowance money.

Lily counted her coins very hard and finally had enough to buy the doll. She gave the money to the lady at the store and got her new toy. She was so happy and said to her mommy, "Look, I paid for it myself!"

Her mommy was proud of her and said, "You did a great job, Lily!" They hugged and went home to play with the new doll.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat. He liked to lay in the sun all day long, so he didn't do much. One day, there was a big storm in the sky. The cat looked up and saw a tornado. He was scared and ran inside to hide.

The tornado was coming closer and closer, so the cat hid under the bed. He was really scared. Suddenly, a big gust of wind blew the cat out of the house. He was so scared that he forgot to be lazy!

The tornado started to move away, so the cat slowly climbed back inside. He was safe and sound, and he could lay in the sun again. From that day on, the cat was never so lazy!

Once there was a small boy. He was walking in the park when the sky suddenly turned dark. He was scared. He saw lightning in the sky. He was confused and didn't know what to do. He started to run away, but the lightning kept following him. He quickly ran to a nearby tree for safety. He knew the tree would protect him. Unfortunately, the lightning struck the tree and the tree started to catch fire.

The boy was so confused. He didn't know what to do. He tried to remove the fire with his hands, but it was too strong. He started to cry and asked for help. Unfortunately, no one was there. He was all alone and the fire was becoming bigger and bigger.

The little boy was so scared. All of a sudden, the ground started to shake and remove the fire. The tree was saved but the boy was still confused. He looked up at the sky and saw the lightning again. Suddenly, the lightning came down and hit the little boy. He was no more. It was a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to tell jokes to his friends. One day, Timmy told his best friend Billy a joke. Billy laughed so hard that he fell to the ground.

Later that day, Timmy and Billy were playing hide-and-seek. Timmy found a really good hiding spot and whispered to himself, "Billy will never find me here." But Billy searched high and low and eventually found Timmy.

As they were walking home, Timmy's shoelaces were too tight and hurting his feet. He asked Billy to help him untie them, but Billy was too busy laughing about Timmy's joke from earlier.

Suddenly, Timmy tripped on his shoelaces and fell down. He hurt his head and had to go to the hospital. Timmy learned that it's important to take care of himself and not rely on others for help.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who went to the beach. She had never seen such a fancy beach before. It was filled with sand and shells and tiny fish swimming in the water.

The little girl was so excited, she started to nod her head up and down. She ran around and played in the sand, making castles with her hands. She found a sand dollar and held it tight in both of her hands.

The little girl was having so much fun. She planted a flag in the sand and pretended it was her own special beach.

The sun was starting to set so the little girl went back home. She couldn't wait to come back to the beach tomorrow and play again. She nodded her head up and down, happy to have such an amazing beach nearby.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily put on her cozy bathrobe and went to the park to play. She saw her friend, Tommy, and they ran to the swings together.

After a while, Lily's mom called her and said, "It's time to go home and take a bath, Lily." But Lily didn't want to leave the park. "I wonder if I can stay a little longer?" she thought.

Tommy said, "Don't be selfish, Lily. Your mom needs you to take a bath and get clean." Lily realized Tommy was right and said goodbye to her friend. Later, when she was all clean and snuggled up in her bed, she thought about how nice it was to have a friend like Tommy who always looked out for her.

Once upon a time, there was a clever little girl. She loved to sort things. Every morning, she got up early to sort all the toys in her room.

One day, the little girl saw a big clock in the shop. She begged her parents to buy it for her. So they did. She was very happy and quickly sorted the clock into her collection of other toys.

The little girl was so busy sorting that she forgot about time. Before she knew it, it was dark outside. The little girl ran to her parent's room, but nobody was there. She quickly realised that she had overslept and her parents had left without her.

The little girl was very sad. She never saw her parents again. All she had was the clock to remind her of how clever she had been to get it in the first place.

One day, a family went to the mall. They wanted to buy some clothes and things. As they walked around, the little girl grabbed at things. She was so happy to find pretty things! But sometimes she grabbed things without being careful, and her parents had to tell her to be more careful! She was a bit careless when she was playing.

Eventually, they found some fun things. Her mom bought her a new teddy bear, and her dad got her a special toy. She was so excited!

When it was time to leave, she grabbed the teddy and toy and hugged them both tightly. She was so thrilled with her new things! They all left the mall, and the little girl had so much fun that day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a dog named Max. They lived in a small house with a big tree. Sue and Max liked to play under the tree every day.

One day, Sue got a letter in the mail. She was very happy. "Look, Max," she said, "I got a letter!" But Max looked troubled. He wanted to chew the letter. Sue said, "No, Max! You can't chew the letter."

Sue opened the letter and read it. It was an invitation to a party. Sue was so excited. She told Max, "We are going to a party, Max! You can't chew anything there, okay?" Max barked and wagged his tail. They went to the party and had a lot of fun. Max did not chew anything, and Sue was very proud of him.

John was at the park with his mom. He had a bag in his hand. He was very excited, he wanted to get a new toy.

Suddenly his mom said "John, can you please be polite and remove your bag from the playground."

John was so surprised! He was polite and listened to his mom. He removed the bag and put it next to his mom.

John then looked around and saw a big slide, swings and lots of colorful toys. He was so happy and ran to play with the toys.

His mom watched him play and smiled. She was happy that John had been so polite and knew to remove his bag from the playground.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play with blocks. They had many blocks of different colors and shapes. They liked to build towers and houses and cars with their blocks.

One day, they decided to have a contest. They wanted to see who could build the highest tower with their blocks. They each picked a spot on the floor and started to stack their blocks. They tried to make their towers strong and steady.

Lily saw that Ben's tower was taller than hers. She felt sad and jealous. She wanted to win the contest. She looked around and saw a bottle of wine on the table. She had an idea. She took the bottle and poured some wine on Ben's tower. The wine made the blocks wet and sticky. Ben's tower fell down with a loud crash.

Ben saw what Lily did. He felt angry and hurt. He shouted at Lily. "Why did you do that? That was not nice! You ruined my tower!" He threw some blocks at Lily. Lily threw some blocks back at him. They started to fight and cry.

Mom heard the noise and came to see what was wrong. She saw the mess on the floor and the wine on the table. She saw Lily and Ben fighting and crying. She felt disappointed and upset. She said to them. "What is going on here? Why are you fighting? Why did you spill the wine? You know you are not supposed to touch that!"

Lily and Ben stopped fighting and crying. They felt ashamed and sorry. They told Mom what happened. They said they were sorry. Mom said to them. "You both made a mistake. You should not have a contest that makes you feel sad and jealous. You should not add wine to your blocks. That is not how you play with them. You should not be angry and hurt your friend. That is not how you treat them. You should be kind and share your blocks. That is how you have fun and make friends."

Lily and Ben nodded and hugged Mom. They said they understood. They said they were sorry to each other. They cleaned up the mess and the wine. They decided to play with their blocks together. They built a big house with their blocks. They invited Mom to join them. They had fun and were happy.

Once there was a man who lived in a small house. Every day, he would laugh and smile. He was a very happy man.

One day, he went walking outside. He came across an old tree with a tight rope tied around it. The man smiled and grabbed onto the rope. He started laughing as he swung back and forth.

Suddenly, he heard a voice coming from the ground. He looked down and saw a small 3-year-old girl. She said to him with a big smile,

"Hello Mr Man! Will you swing me too?"

The man laughed and said, "Of course!" He then grabbed onto the tight rope with one hand and the little girl with the other, and started swinging them both together.

The man and the girl laughed until the sun started to go down. When it was time to go home, the man hugged the little girl and said,

"It's been great fun playing together. Let's do it again soon!"

The girl ran back to her house with a big smile on her face. The man watched her go and then started walking back to his house, with a big smile on his own face too.

One day a little girl was very worried. She could see her dad working with a long cable. She watched as he plugged it into the wall and secured it, but it was all a bit confusing. She didn't understand why they needed it.

The little girl was beginning to feel upset, so she went to find her mom. But mom was busy talking on the phone and didn't seem to hear the little girl's question.

Suddenly, a loud voice called out from the other room. It was the little girl's dad! He was asking Mom to help him with the cable. The little girl ran to the room to see what was happening.

Mom and Dad were discussing how best to plug the cable in. Mom was helping Dad to make sure it was secure, but the little girl could tell that Mom was worried too.

They eventually finished and it became clear that the cable was for the internet! The little girl was relieved, and so were Mom and Dad. They all gave each other a big hug and the little girl smiled. No more worrying!

Once upon a time, there was a little bird. The bird loved to sing all day long. It sang in the morning, it sang in the afternoon, and it sang at night. The bird was so happy when it sang.

One day, the little bird saw a net on the ground. The net looked like a big spider web. The bird thought it would be fun to play with the net. So, the bird flew down to the net and got stuck.

The bird tried to fly away, but it couldn't. It was stuck in the net. The bird was scared and sad. It couldn't sing anymore. The bird wished it had never played with the net.

The other birds heard the little bird's cries and came to help. They tried to free the bird, but it was too late. The little bird had died. The other birds were grateful for the little bird's beautiful singing, but now they were sad that it was gone forever.

Once there was a bunny and a worm who were best friends. Every day they would race each other, trying to outrun the other. The bunny always seemed to win, which made the worm sad.

One morning the worm asked the bunny, "Why can you always beat me? I wish I could race faster." The bunny smiled and replied, "It's easy! You just need to eat some tasty carrots."

The worm was filled with hope. That very day, he started to eat all the carrots he could find. After only a few days, he was feeling faster and was sure he could win the next race.

The next morning, the bunny and the worm lined up to race. They dashed with all their might, and the bunny was surprised to find out that the worm had won the race!

The bunny smiled and congratulated his friend. The worm had proved that with a little bit of extra effort, it's possible to overcome any challenge. From then on, they would race each other every day and the worm always won – proving that tasty carrots are the secret to a winning race!

Mommy said, “It’s time for dinner!” She put some spaghetti in a big pot and put it on the stove. The kitchen became dark and quiet. Suddenly, the pot made a loud noise and Mommy said, “Oh no!” She opened the pot and saw that all the spaghetti had turned dark. She said, “No one can eat this.”

Mommy went to get some more spaghetti. While she was gone, her little boy wanted to do something special. He found some food coloring and quickly dumped a bunch into the pot. He mixed the spaghetti around and it turned a bright purple.

Mommy came back and said, “What happened here?” The little boy said, “I made it special! Now it looks like a party.” Then Mommy started to laugh. She got some more spaghetti and showed her little boy how to put it in the pot without any food coloring.

Mommy and the little boy had a fun spaghetti party together. They ate their special purple spaghetti and were both happy.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. They lived in a big, impressive city. One day, they went for a walk around the city. Everything about the city was so wonderful.

The buildings were so tall and sparkly. The parks were full of nice things to play on. And the people were so friendly. The friends had a great time.

Then, one of the friends started to blink. It was so strange. The other friend asked why and the blinking friend said, "I'm so amazed by this city, I can't help but blink." The friends laughed and kept walking.

They saw more of the city, but nothing was more impressive than the first time. Every time they thought about the impressive city, they both started to blink! It was their way of showing how much they enjoyed their time in the city.

Tom and Lily are twins. They like to play outside in the snow. Mom gives them warm vests to wear. She says, "Be careful, kids. Do not go too far."

Tom and Lily run and jump in the snow. They make snowballs and snowmen. They have fun. But Tom sees a big hill. He wants to slide down the hill. He says, "Lily, come with me. Let's slide down the hill."

Lily looks at the hill. She sees that it is steep and slippery. She is scared. She says, "No, Tom. That is not safe. Mom said be careful. We should stay here."

Tom does not listen. He says, "You are a baby. I am brave. I will slide down the hill." He takes off his vest and puts it on the snow. He sits on the vest and pushes himself down the hill.

Lily watches Tom. She sees him go faster and faster. She hears him scream. He cannot stop. He hits a tree. He falls off the vest. He cries.

Lily runs to Tom. She sees that he is hurt. He has a cut on his head and a bruise on his arm. She says, "Tom, are you okay? I told you to be careful. Why did you do that?"

Tom is sorry. He says, "I was silly. I wanted to have fun. But I was not careful. I hurt myself. I am sorry, Lily. Can you help me?"

Lily hugs Tom. She says, "It's okay, Tom. I will help you. Come on, let's go back to Mom. She will make you feel better. And next time, be careful, okay?"

Tom nods. He says, "Okay, Lily. Thank you. You are a good sister. And you are brave, too."

Lily smiles. She says, "You are welcome, Tom. You are a good brother, too. And you can be brave, too. But you have to be careful, too."

They put on their vests and walk back to Mom. Mom sees them and says, "What happened, kids? Are you okay?"

Lily tells Mom what happened. Mom says, "Oh, Tom. That was not smart. You could have been hurt badly. You have to be careful when you play outside. And you have to listen to Lily. She is smart and she loves you."

Tom says, "I know, Mom. I am sorry. I learned my lesson. I will be careful next time. And I will listen to Lily. She is smart and she loves me."

Mom says, "That's good, Tom. I am glad you are okay. And I am proud of you, Lily. You were careful and you helped Tom. You are a good sister and a good friend."

Lily says, "Thank you, Mom. I love you and Tom."

Mom says, "I love you, too, kids. Now, let's go inside and have some hot chocolate. You deserve it."

Tom and Lily say, "Yay! Hot chocolate!"

They go inside and have hot chocolate. They are happy. They are careful. They are friends.

Jill was enthusiastic about her day at school. She was ready to write! She grabbed her pencil and notebook and went off to school.

When she arrived, the teacher taught them about rivers. She explained how they flow and how they can be different colors. Jill was fascinated! She was excited to write something down.

The teacher gave Jill a special assignment. She asked her to draw a picture of a river. Jill was so enthusiastic she started right away. She used blue and green to draw the river, with grassy land around it.

When she was finished, Jill was very proud of her work. She carefully wrote her name on the front of the page so that the teacher would know it was her drawing. She was so excited to share her work with her teacher.

Jill was so happy that she learned something new about rivers and got to write about them. She skipped home with a smile on her face.

Once upon a time there was a little red car that was feeling very sad. He wanted to go on lots of adventures, but he was too small. All of his friends were bigger than him and he couldn't keep up.

One day, a helpful fairy saw the car and had an idea. She reached into her magic bag and pulled out a switch. She waved it in the air and said the magic words "Shrink, shrink, shrink".

Suddenly, the car started to shrink, until it was big enough to join his bigger friends and go on adventures. Now the car was so happy, he could go wherever he wanted. The fairy had been so helpful.

The little car thanked the fairy for her help and went on lots of adventures with his bigger friends. They all laughed and had such fun.

The End.

Tom and Mia were friends. They liked to play in the park. They had a ball and a kite. They kicked the ball and ran with the kite. They had fun.

One day, a big dog came to the park. It barked and chased the ball. Tom and Mia were scared. They ran away from the dog. The dog ran faster. It caught the ball and bit it. The ball popped.

"Bad dog! Give us our ball!" Tom shouted.

The dog growled and ran away with the ball. Tom and Mia were sad. They had no ball to play with. They looked for their kite. But the kite was gone too. The wind had blown it away. Tom and Mia were very sad. They had no toys to play with.

They sat on a bench and cried. A nice lady saw them. She was troubled. She wanted to help them. She had a bag with her. She opened the bag and took out two things. She gave them to Tom and Mia.

"Here, you can have these. They are for you," she said.

Tom and Mia looked at the things. They were a teddy bear and a book. They smiled. They liked the things. They thanked the lady.

"Thank you, nice lady. You are very kind," they said.

The lady smiled too. She was happy. She had made them happy.

Tom and Mia hugged the teddy bear and looked at the book. They forgot about the dog and the kite. They had new toys to play with. They were happy again.

One day, a smelly cat named Tom went to a fun event. At the event, there were many games and toys for kids to play with. Tom saw a big ball and wanted to play with it.

Tom used his paw to strike the ball. The ball went flying across the room and hit a big cake. The cake fell on the floor and made a big mess. Everyone at the event looked at Tom and the cake.

Tom felt sad for making a mess. But the kids laughed and clapped. They thought it was funny. Tom cleaned up the mess and everyone had a great time at the event. The smelly cat was now a happy cat.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big melon on a table. The melon is green and round.

"Look, a melon!" Anna says. "I want to eat it."

"Me too," Ben says. "But how can we get it?"

The table is too high for them. They need something to stand on. They see a big box near the table. They push the box to the table.

"Let's climb on the box," Anna says. "Then we can reach the melon."

They climb on the box. But the box is weak. It wobbles and cracks. Anna and Ben try to balance on the box. They stretch their arms to the melon.

"Be careful," Anna says. "The box might break."

"I have it, I have it," Ben says. He grabs the melon. But the melon is heavy. Ben loses his balance. He falls off the box. The melon falls with him.

"Ouch!" Ben says. The melon lands on his tummy. It hurts.

"Are you okay?" Anna says. She jumps off the box. She runs to Ben.

"I'm okay," Ben says. He rubs his tummy. He smiles. He sees the melon. It is split in half. He sees the red and juicy inside.

"Look, the melon is open," Ben says. "We can eat it now."

"Yay!" Anna says. She picks up a piece of melon. She gives another piece to Ben. They sit on the grass. They eat the melon. It is sweet and yummy.

They share the melon. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a lamp in her room that she loved to turn on every night. One day, Lily's mom made her yummy cookies and told her to eat them after dinner. Lily was very excited to eat the cookies and she promised her mom that she would behave.

After dinner, Lily went to her room and turned on her lamp. She took out the cookies and started eating them. Suddenly, her little brother came into her room and asked for a cookie. Lily didn't want to share and told him to go away. Her brother started crying and told their mom what had happened.

Lily's mom was very disappointed in her behavior. She took away the rest of the cookies and told Lily that she couldn't have them anymore. Lily was very sad and wished she had shared with her brother. She learned that it's always better to behave and be kind to others.

Once upon a time, there lived a bunny. It was alert, always spotting danger. One day, the bunny went out of its hole. It was looking for carrots. It spotted one in the distance and hopped over excitedly.

Suddenly, it heard a sound. The sound was like thunder. The bunny stopped and became alert. It looked around and saw a fox walking towards it.

The fox said, "Hello, bunny. I love carrots. Can I have your carrot?"

The bunny shook its head no. It tightened its grip on the carrot and said, "This is my carrot. I'm returning home with it!"

The fox stepped back and replied, "Oh, okay. Have a nice day!"

The bunny hopped off back to its home with the carrot safely in its arms. It was happy to be returning home with the carrot, and it vowed to stay alert from now on.

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to play outside. One day, they find a hose in the yard. They turn on the water and spray each other. They laugh and have fun.

But then, a big dog comes. The dog is angry. The dog does not like water. The dog barks and runs at Tim and Sam. Tim and Sam are scared. They try to run away.

The dog is faster. The dog bites Tim on the leg. Tim cries and bleeds. Sam tries to help Tim. He yells for help. But no one hears him. The dog is deaf. The dog does not hear Sam.

The dog bites Sam on the arm. Sam cries and bleeds too. Tim and Sam are hurt. They are alone. They are sad. They learn that playing with the hose is not safe. They learn that the dog is bad. They learn that no one can help them. The end.

One day, a frog named Tim went for a hop. He saw a big case. The case was red and blue. Tim wanted to find out what was inside the case.

Tim hopped up to the case and said, "Hello, case! Can I see what's inside you?" The case opened up and showed Tim a lot of sour candies. Tim was very happy.

Tim took a sour candy and said, "Thank you, case!" He hopped away, eating the sour candy. It was a fun day for Tim and the case.

Lila and Ben were playing on the beach. They liked to make sand castles and look for shells. Sometimes they saw fish and crabs in the water. But they never went too far, because their mom told them to be careful of the jellyfish.

"Look, Ben, a jellyfish!" Lila pointed to a pink blob on the sand. "It's so pretty and shiny. Can we touch it?"

"No, Lila, we can't touch it. It can hurt us with its stings. Mom said so." Ben shook his head. "We should leave it alone. Maybe the waves will send it back to the sea."

"But I want to see it closer. Maybe it's friendly. Maybe it's lonely." Lila moved closer to the jellyfish. "Hi, jellyfish. Do you want to play with us?"

The jellyfish didn't answer. It didn't move. It didn't seem to care about Lila and Ben. It was very independent. It didn't need anyone to play with. It was happy in its own way.

Lila felt sad. She wanted to make a new friend. She reached out her hand to touch the jellyfish. But Ben grabbed her arm and pulled her back.

"Ow, Ben, that hurts. Let me go!" Lila cried.

"Lila, no. Trust me. The jellyfish is not a good friend. It can make you sick. Come on, let's go play with something else." Ben said.

"Fine. But I still think the jellyfish is pretty." Lila said.

They left the jellyfish on the sand and ran to their mom. She gave them some juice and cookies. She hugged them and told them she loved them. They felt happy and safe. They didn't need the jellyfish. They had each other.

Once upon a time there was a chubby little girl named Sara. She had two arms that were small and round like buttons. Every morning when the sun would shine, Sara would stretch out her arms and say "Good morning, sunshine!".

One day, Sara decided to go outside and play. She jumped around, twirled around and even did somersaults in the grass. Eventually, Sara got tired and stopped playing. Looking up, she noticed the big bright sun shining. She opened her arms up wide and said, "Look at that big, bright sunshine!". She felt so happy, she could hardly stand still.

Sara then ran back to the house and told her mom all about the sunshine. Her mom said, "I know! It's so warm outside! Now why don't you put on some sunscreen before you go out and shine again? That way, you can enjoy your time outside without getting too hot".

With a smile, Sara put on sunscreen and ran outside. Sara stretched out her chubby arms and spun around until the sun set. It was the best day of her life.

Once there was a brave boy named Mark. Mark loved playing in the park. One day, Mark heard loud noises and saw lights in the sky. He decided to go explore.

He soon arrived at the park and saw a lot of people rushing around. Suddenly, an ambulance drove up. Mark saw that the people had boxes and were quickly setting up an operation.

Mark knew something important was happening so he made sure to stay out of the way. He watched as the people worked together to help someone who was hurt. In the end, they struck success and everyone cheered. Mark felt glad that he was able to help out.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was a very messy girl. Her room was always full of toys and clothes all over the floor. One day, her mom told her to clean her room.

As Lucy started to clean her room, she began to discover toys she had not seen in a long time. She found a toy car, a doll, and even a toy dinosaur. She was so happy to see these toys again, and she played with them for a little while.

After playing, Lucy remembered that she needed to clean her room. She put all her toys in a big toy box and put her clothes away in the closet. When she was done, her room was no longer messy. Lucy's mom was very proud of her, and they both enjoyed playing with the toys Lucy had discovered.

Once upon a time, there was a little gray beetle who loved to fly around and explore the world. One day, the beetle felt very tired and decided to rest on a big green leaf. As the beetle rested, it noticed a big, juicy-looking fruit hanging from a nearby tree.

The beetle thought to itself, "I wonder if that fruit is as delicious as it looks." But the beetle was too tired to fly over and take a closer look. So, it decided to rest some more and wait until it had more energy.

The next day, the beetle woke up feeling refreshed and ready to explore again. It flew over to the tree and saw that the fruit was actually a shiny red apple. The beetle took a bite and it was the most delicious thing it had ever tasted! From then on, the little gray beetle made sure to rest when it was tired so it could have the energy to discover new and exciting things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to stack blocks and make tall towers. One day, she was playing with her blocks when her little brother came in.

"Can I play too?" he asked.

Lily smiled and said, "Of course!"

They started to build a big tower together, but suddenly it fell apart. Her brother was frightened and started to cry.

"Don't be scared," Lily said. "I believe we can build an even bigger tower."
