But then, Lily started to feel uncomfortable. The makeup was itchy and made her want to tear it off her face. She tried to rub it off, but it just made her face more red and itchy. Lily started to cry.

Her mom heard her cry and came to help. She gently cleaned Lily's face with a soft cloth and warm water. The makeup was gone, and Lily felt much better. Her mom hugged her and told her that she was beautiful just the way she was. From that day on, Lily never played with makeup again.

Once upon a time, there was a bald tree. Its leaves had all fallen off and it was the only tree in the woods without any leaves. Every morning, birds would fly to the tree and rest in its branches.

One particular morning, two birds decided to stay a bit longer. They decided to take a nap and forget it was time to go home. Suddenly, with a gust of wind, they were both blown away into the sky!

The two birds were so sad that they had forgotten to go home. They vowed to come back to the bald tree some other day.

But when they returned to the tree, it was gone! They searched high and low for it, but it seemed that the bald tree had vanished.

The birds never forgot the special place where they once rested. They often return to the forest in search of the lovely bald tree, but it is still missing to this day.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sam. Sam was 3 years old. Sam really liked to shake her little arms. She would shake her arms in the backyard, she would shake them in the morning when she woke up, and she would even shake them in the bathtub.

One day, a magic fairy appeared to Sam. The fairy said, "If you shake your arms one more time, something amazing will happen". Sam was very excited! She shook her arms as hard as she could.

Suddenly, wings began to grow from Sam's back. When Sam opened her eyes, she saw a huge, beautiful set of wings spread out from her back! They were so bright and colourful! It was so impressive!

Sam was now able to fly all around the world. Everywhere she went, people were amazed by her wings. Sam was so proud of her impressive wings! She never stopped shaking her arms, and the magic of the wings was with her forever.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved motorcycles and he always dreamed of riding one. One day, Timmy saw a motorcycle parked outside his house. He was very happy and wanted to ride it. But his mother warned him not to touch it as it was not his.

Timmy was sad but he understood. He went inside his house and saw his sister playing with her toys. Timmy asked his sister if he could play with her toys but she said no. Timmy was upset and started crying. His mother came to him and asked what happened. Timmy told her about his sister not sharing her toys.

His mother then told him to be generous and share his toys with his sister. Timmy thought about it and realized that it was a good idea. He went to his sister and shared his toys with her. His sister was happy and thanked Timmy. Timmy was happy too and he realized that being generous was a good thing.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in his backyard. One day, while he was playing, he found an enormous rock.

"Wow, this rock is so big!" Timmy exclaimed.

His mom came outside and saw the rock. "That is a very big rock, Timmy. What do you want to do with it?" she asked.

"I want to bury it in the ground," Timmy said.

"Why do you want to bury it?" his mom asked.

"Because it's too big to play with and I don't want it to hurt anyone," Timmy said.

So, Timmy and his mom buried the enormous rock in the ground. Timmy was happy that he made sure no one would get hurt by the big rock.

Tom was a restless boy. He did not like to sit still or play with his toys. He wanted to see new things and have fun. One day, he saw a big tree in the park. He wanted to climb it and see what was on top.

He ran to the tree and grabbed a branch. He pulled himself up and looked around. He saw birds and squirrels and leaves. He smiled and climbed higher. He felt like a king of the tree.

But then he heard his mom call his name. She sounded worried and angry. She told him to come down right now. Tom did not want to go. He wanted to stay in the tree. He ignored his mom and climbed higher.

He did not see the hole in the branch. He stepped on it and slipped. He fell down and hit the ground. He cried and hurt his arm. His mom ran to him and hugged him. She said he was very naughty and scared her. She said he should not wander off and climb trees without her.

Tom felt sorry and sad. He said he was sorry and he loved her. His mom said she loved him too and took him to the doctor. The doctor gave him a bandage and a sticker. He said Tom was brave and lucky. He said he should be careful and listen to his mom.

Tom learned his lesson. He did not wander off and climb trees anymore. He played with his toys and his mom. He was still restless, but he was also happy and safe.

Lily was playing with her dolls in her room. She liked to imagine that they were her friends and they had fun adventures together. She gave them names and voices and made them talk to each other.

"Hello, Anna, do you want to go to the park?" Lily said, holding a doll with brown hair.

"Yes, please, Emma, I love the park!" Lily said, holding a doll with blonde hair.

"OK, let's go then! Maybe we can see some birds and flowers!" Lily said, making the dolls walk on her bed.

Lily was so busy playing that she did not hear her mom calling her for dinner. Her mom came to her room and smiled when she saw Lily and her dolls.

"Lily, it's time for dinner. Come on, sweetie, you must be hungry," her mom said.

"But mom, I'm playing with Anna and Emma. They are my friends," Lily said.

"I know, honey, but you can play with them later. Dinner is ready and it's very yummy. We have chicken and potatoes and carrots and a large cake for dessert," her mom said.

"A large cake? Wow, that sounds good!" Lily said, her eyes shining.

"Yes, a large cake. It's a special treat for you, because you have been such a good girl. Now, come on, let's go to the kitchen. You can bring your dolls with you, if you want," her mom said.

"OK, mom, thank you! Come on, Anna and Emma, let's go have dinner. Maybe we can share some cake with you," Lily said, picking up her dolls and following her mom.

Lily was happy. She loved her mom and her dolls and her dinner. She imagined that they were all a big family and that they had many more adventures to come.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved the ocean. He loved to splash in the waves and collect seashells. One day, Timmy's mom told him they were going on a boat ride. Timmy was so excited!

Timmy and his mom got on the boat and sailed out into the ocean. They saw dolphins jumping and whales spouting water. Timmy felt so lucky to see all the sea creatures.

Suddenly, the boat started to shake and Timmy felt scared. But then, he saw a big island in the distance. The boat sailed towards the island and Timmy felt excited again. They got off the boat and explored the island. They found a treasure chest full of gold and jewels! Timmy felt lucky again and was so excited to show his friends when he got home.

One day, a mom and her daughter walked around their city. The mom pointed to tall buildings and said, "Look at all these skyscrapers. This is our city." The girl was amazed.

The mother showed her daughter the playground. "Let's have fun together," she said. The girl jumped with joy and ran off to the slide. As the mother watched, she saw someone else at the playground. It was a man.

He smiled and said, "Hi. I'm here to support this city. I'm persistent." The mother was pleasantly surprised.

The man explained that he started a project to support the city. He wanted to help make the city even more beautiful. The mother liked the idea and joined his cause.

Soon, mother and daughter began volunteering together. From planting trees to cleaning up litter, they worked together to make their city look amazing. The man was very grateful for their help. He was happy to have such persistent supporters.

Tim and Mia are friends. They like to play with blocks. They build towers and houses and bridges. They have fun.

One day, they want to make a big tower. They use all the blocks they have. The tower is very tall. But it is not stable. It wobbles and shakes.

"Look at our tower!" Tim says. "It is so high!"

"Yes, but it is not strong," Mia says. "It will fall down soon."

"How can we make it strong?" Tim asks.

"We need to support it," Mia says. "We need to put more blocks at the bottom and on the sides. Then it will not move."

They work together to support the tower. They find more blocks and add them to the base and the walls. The tower becomes stable. It does not wobble or shake anymore.

"Wow, we did it!" Tim says. "Our tower is stable now!"

"Yes, and it is still high!" Mia says. "We are good builders!"

They are happy and proud. They hug each other. Then they hear a funny noise. It is Tim's dog. He is barking and wagging his tail. He wants to play too.

"Uh-oh," Tim says. "He likes blocks too. He might knock down our tower!"

"Quick, let's hide it!" Mia says. "Or he will make a mess!"

They laugh and run to protect their tower. They play with the dog and the blocks. They have fun.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was like most children her age; she loved playing and having fun. One day she decided to take a walk to the nearby park. As she was walking, she noticed an ice-cream stand. She was so excited to see it, and she ran up to get some ice-cream.

Suddenly, she saw something move in the bush nearby. She was fearful, so she stopped and looked around. Then, to her surprise, she saw a rabbit! She was so excited, she tried to catch it.

But the rabbit was too fast for the little girl and it jumped away. She chased it until, suddenly, it stopped in front of the ice-cream stand. She caught it and carefully held it in her arms.

The little girl was so proud of herself. She smiled as she thought of how she could bring the rabbit home to her Mum. But, before she went home, she bought an ice-cream as a reward for catching the rabbit. The little girl was so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse named Mickey. Mickey loved to climb. He climbed trees, rocks, and even walls. One day, Mickey saw a big piece of cheese on a table. He wanted to climb up to the table and eat the cheese. But it was too high for him to climb.

Mickey felt sad and hungry. He saw a fridge nearby and thought maybe he could find some cheese inside. He climbed up the fridge and opened the door. Inside, he found a big block of cold cheese. He was so happy and started eating it.

But as he ate, he started to feel sick. The cheese was too cold and made him feel bad. Mickey tried to climb down from the fridge, but he was too dizzy. He fell down and hurt himself badly. From that day on, Mickey learned to be careful when climbing and eating cheese.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big bath with lots of bubbles. She loved to play with her rubber duckies and splash around in the water. One day, she wanted to try something new. She put a washcloth in the water and watched it soak up all the bubbles.

After her bath, Lily went to turn off the water with the switch on the wall. But when she touched it, she got a little frightened because she heard a loud noise. She quickly ran to her mommy and told her what happened. Her mommy explained that the noise was just the sound of the water stopping.

Lily felt much better and went to bed with a smile on her face, thinking about all the fun she had in the bath and how she learned about soaking and switches. The end.

Once there were two friends who were two circles. One lived far away from the other. The circle that lived far away was lonely; it longed to meet its friend.

One day, the lonely circle set out to find its friend. Along the way it saw many beautiful flowers and trees. Soon it arrived at the other circle's home.

The lonely circle was so excited to meet its friend. It ran over and said, "Hello! I have come to visit you!"

But to its disappointment, the other circle didn't feel the same. It said, "Go away! I don't want to be your friend!"

The lonely circle was so sad. It slowly turned around and started walking back the way it had come. It never made it back home. Nobody knows what happened to the lonely circle, and it never got the chance to meet its friend.

Once there was a boy who wanted to taste a brick. He thought it would be funny. So, he found a hot brick next to a wall and licked it. It tasted awful, so he spit it out quickly. He had a big smile on his face and laughed a lot.

Then the boy saw a nice hot ice cream. He wanted to taste it. So, he licked it a few times until it was gone. It tasted creamy and delicious! He wanted more, but he was all out.

The boy decided to never try to taste a brick again, but to always enjoy creamy sweet treats.

Once there was an enormous arrow. It was silver and glistened in the bright sunshine.

This arrow was so enormous that it was able to split rocks with ease.

One day a little girl and her dad were walking near the riverbank near the arrow. The daughter looked up and said to her dad, "Daddy, can you split the rocks with the big arrow?"

Her dad smiled and said, "I sure can! Let's give it a try."

The dad placed the arrow in front of the rocks and with a loud shout, he split them into two! The little girl was amazed as she watched the arrow move and cut the rocks with ease.

Afterwards, the dad and daughter hugged and laughed. They enjoyed watching the enormous arrow split the rocks and celebrated their success.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play in the snow. They made a big igloo with snow blocks and a hole for the door. They went inside the igloo and pretended it was their house.

"Look, we have a cozy igloo!" Lily said. "We can stay here all day and have fun!"

"Yes, it is very nice!" Ben agreed. "But we need some food. I am hungry."

Lily thought for a moment. "I have an idea. We can go and pick some berries from the bushes. They are sweet and juicy."

"OK, let's go!" Ben said. They put on their hats and gloves and left the igloo.

But when they came back, they saw something bad. Another boy was in their igloo. He had a mean face and a big stick. He was breaking their snow blocks and making a mess.

"Hey, that's our igloo!" Lily shouted. "Go away!"

The boy laughed. "No, it's mine now. I found it and I like it. You can't have it back."

Lily and Ben were angry. They wanted their igloo back. They ran towards the boy and tried to push him out. The boy fought back with his stick. He hit Lily and Ben with it. It hurt a lot.

"Ow, stop it!" Lily cried. "You are mean and bad!"

"Ha, ha, ha!" The boy said. "You are weak and silly!"

Lily and Ben were sad and scared. They ran away from the igloo and the boy. They did not have their igloo anymore. They did not have any berries either. They were hungry and cold. They wished they had never left their igloo. They wished they had a better friend.

Anna and Ben are going on a big trip with Mom and Dad. They are very happy and excited. They pack their bags and toys and get in the car. Mom and Dad tell them they are going to fly in a big plane to see Grandma and Grandpa.

At the airport, they have to wait in a long line. Mom and Dad have to show their passports to a man. A passport is a small book with your name and picture in it. It tells the man where you are from and where you are going. Anna and Ben do not have passports. They are too little. They only need their tickets.

The man looks at Mom and Dad's passports and smiles. He says they can go to the plane. He gives them a stamp on their passports. The stamp is a picture of a bird. Anna and Ben think the stamp is pretty. They want one too. Mom and Dad say they can have one when they are older.

They walk to the plane and find their seats. They buckle their seat belts and put on their headphones. The plane makes a loud noise and starts to move. Anna and Ben look out the window and see the ground getting smaller and smaller. They see the clouds and the sun. They are flying!

Anna and Ben are not scared. They think flying is easy and fun. They watch a movie and eat some snacks. They fall asleep and dream of Grandma and Grandpa. They can't wait to see them and give them hugs and kisses. They are going to have a great trip.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to decorate her room with pretty flowers and colorful stickers. One day, her mom asked her to help decorate the kitchen for a special dinner. Lily was so excited to help!

They made a big pot of soup for the dinner. Lily loved soup, especially when it was hot and yummy. But as they were decorating, Lily heard a loud noise outside. She felt frightened and didn't want to go outside to see what it was.

Later that night, they sat down to eat their soup. It was so delicious and everyone was happy. But then, they heard the same loud noise again. This time, Lily wasn't frightened anymore. She remembered that her dad had told her it was just the sound of the wind blowing through the trees. They all laughed and continued enjoying their soup together.

Once there was a little girl called Susie. Susie loved to go to the park. Today was a cold day, but Susie still wanted to visit the park.

When Susie got to the park, she saw many things - lots of trees and things to play on. It was even cold enough for some of the puddles to have a layer of ice! Susie had so much fun, she didn't want to go home.

But then it started to snow! The snow made Susie cold. She said goodbye to the park and ran home. All the way home, she kept her name warm in her pocket.

Once safely back home, Susie snuggled up in her cosy bed. She knew that she would be able to come back to the park tomorrow, when it was warm again!

Once upon a time, there was a little birdie with big, curious eyes. She loved to fly high in the sky with her pretty wings. One day, she saw a big pile of sticks and decided to organize them. She picked up one stick at a time and put them in a neat pile.

As she was organizing, she noticed a little bug crawling on one of the sticks. She was very curious about the bug and decided to take a closer look. The bug was very small and had shiny wings. The little birdie was so fascinated by the bug that she forgot about organizing the sticks.

After a while, she realized that she had only organized a few sticks and there were still many more to go. She quickly got back to work and finished organizing the pile. Even though she was distracted by the bug, she was happy that she had accomplished her task.

Once upon a time, there was a kangaroo. He loved to paint, but he couldn't seem to decide what to paint. So he asked his friend, the elephant, what he should paint.

The elephant said, "Why not paint a fine sunset? I really like sunsets." The kangaroo was very excited and said, "Yes! That sounds great! It's going to look so beautiful." Then he ran off to get his paints.

The kangaroo worked very hard painting his beautiful masterpiece. When he was done, everyone was amazed. The colors were so bright and vivid even though he had only used the simplest paints. When the sun started to set, the painting was even more perfect.

The elephant grinned and said, "That's just fine! Now everyone can see the sunset even when it's not there." Everyone was so excited to see the picture, and the kangaroo was very proud of himself.

Even years later, the beautiful painting of the sunset remains a reminder to the kangaroo of how no matter what stands in the way, even with the simplest ingredients, something beautiful can be created.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to collect rocks and minerals. One day, Lily went for a walk with her mom and dad. They found a big shiny mineral near a river.

Lily's dad picked up the mineral and said, "This is a safe mineral to keep, Lily. Don't forget to put it in your collection."

Lily was so happy to add the shiny mineral to her collection. She replied, "Thank you, dad! I won't forget."

As they continued their walk, Lily's mom asked her, "What's your favorite mineral, Lily?"

Lily replied, "I love all the minerals, mom. But this shiny one is my new favorite!"

Lily was a little girl who liked to play with her toys. She had a doll, a ball, a car and a bear. She liked to make them talk and sing and have fun. But sometimes, she got very tired from playing so much.

Her mom told her that it was time for a nap. Lily did not want to nap. She wanted to play more. She said, "No, no, no!" and ran away from her mom. She hid under the table with her bear.

Her mom looked for her and found her. She said, "Lily, you need to nap. Napping is important. It helps you grow and learn and be happy. If you nap, you will have more energy to play later. And I will read you a story when you wake up."

Lily looked at her mom with her big eyes. She loved stories. She said, "Really? A story?" Her mom nodded and smiled. She said, "Yes, a story. But first, you need to nap."

Lily thought for a moment. She was still tired. She said, "OK, mom. I will nap. But only for a little bit." Her mom said, "That's fine. Come on, let's go to your bed." She picked up Lily and her bear and took them to her room. She tucked them in and kissed them. She said, "Sweet dreams, Lily. I love you." Lily said, "I love you too, mom." She closed her eyes and napped.

Joe had a great day. He was excited to go to a new place. He had never been there before. He got in the car and they drove. The car was hot but Joe didn't mind. Finally, they reached the place. Joe hopped out of the car and he was amazed. He wanted to explore everywhere. He looked around and saw lots of things he wanted to touch. He ran to the swings and jumped on. He laughed and laughed. He reached for the sky and smiled. Joe had a wonderful time at the new place. He couldn't wait to come back.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Rose. Rose lived in a big country with lots of bright, green fields. Every day, Rose would run outside and skip happily in the sunshine. She skipped through the fields and into the woods.

As she skipped, she saw lots of brightly coloured birds singing all around her. She skipped so fast she felt as if she was flying!

Suddenly, Rose heard a high, happy voice calling to her. She turned around and saw a little fairy in the trees! The fairy had bright wings and a smiling face. She asked Rose to come fly with her to the next country.

Rose grinned and said yes! She held tight to the fairy and the two of them flew off together. They flew high and far, over mountains and oceans, until they reached the next country.

Rose and the fairy skipped together in this new country. The land was even brighter and more magical than the one they had left behind. They laughed and skipped, and didn't stop until the sun went down.

Rose promised to come back again and visit the fairy. She waved goodbye, then skipped all the way home.

Once upon a time, there was a tiny girl. She was small and restless, and she loved running and playing outside.

One day, she was playing near a wire. She wanted to stand on the wire, so she tried to climb onto it, but it was too high.

The tiny girl was not happy that she could not stand on the wire. She asked her mom for help, and her mom said yes.

Her mom tied one end of the wire to a big tree, and then she held the other end. She told the tiny girl to climb up.

The tiny girl was so excited! She jumped onto the wire and stood on it. She felt so proud of herself and happy that she could stand on the wire.

The tiny girl smiled and laughed. She felt so brave and strong!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Lucy. She was very excited for her first day of preschool.

In the morning she woke up, ate breakfast, and put on her best clothes. When she arrived at the preschool, all her new friends were playing.

Lucy saw a big pillow in the corner and she wanted to play with it. She ran to the pillow and started talking to it. She asked the pillow questions like: What's your name? How old are you?

The pillow didn't answer back, so Lucy decided to give the pillow a name: Pillowy. From then on, Lucy and Pillowy were best friends.

When Lucy went home each day, she would talk to Pillowy and tell him all about her day. Every day Lucy was more and more excited to come back to school and play with Pillowy.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit. He was so lonely living all by himself! He wanted to make some friends, but he wasn't sure how.

One day he had an idea. He saw a cable lying nearby and he thought he could use it to zip around and find some friends. So he grabbed the cable and zipped off.

Pretty soon the little rabbit found a group of other rabbits. They were so happy to meet him! They all talked and ran about, and had a great time.

The little rabbit was so happy now that he had friends. From that day on, he made sure to always keep his cable with him, just in case he ever felt lonely again.

Once upon a time, there was a great jet flying in the sky. Bob the pilot was driving it and he could go very fast. Bob was a nice person and he promised a special surprise to his three-year-old friend, Anna.

Anna was so excited! As Bob flew the jet higher and higher, Anna started to see something. It was a rainbow! She was so happy to see it from so high up in the sky.

After the surprise, Bob landed the jet back on the ground. He opened the door and gave Anna a big hug. He promised Anna that the next time he flew the jet, she could join him. Anna couldn't believe it—she smiled the biggest smile ever. She was so excited to fly in the great jet again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun and feel the warm light on her face. One day, she saw an elderly woman walking down the street. The woman looked tired and sad.

Lily ran up to her and said, "Hi! Are you okay?" The woman smiled and said, "I'm just a little lost. I can't find my way home." Lily said, "Don't worry, I can help you. Let's go together!"

They walked for a while and finally found the woman's house. The woman was so happy and grateful. She said, "Thank you so much, Lily. You are so kind." Lily smiled and said, "It's okay. I accept your thanks." The woman hugged her and said, "You are a bright light in this world." Lily felt happy and proud. She had made a new friend and helped someone in need.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play games. One day, they found a big box in the attic. Inside the box, there were many pieces of wood with different shapes and colors. They looked like little people and animals.

"What is this?" Ben asked.

"I don't know. Maybe it's a puzzle," Lily said.

They took out the pieces and tried to fit them together on a board with black and white squares. But they could not make a picture. The pieces did not match.

"This is a weird game," Ben said. "How do you play it?"

"Maybe we can ask Dad. He knows many games," Lily said.

They ran downstairs with the box and the board. They found Dad in the living room, reading a book.

"Dad, Dad, look what we found!" they shouted.

Dad looked at the box and the board. He smiled.

"That's not a puzzle, kids. That's a game called chess. It's a very old and smart game. Do you want to learn how to play it?" he asked.

"Yes, yes, please!" Ben and Lily said.

Dad took the pieces and showed them how to set them up on the board. He explained the names and the moves of each piece. He taught them some rules and some tricks. He let them play against each other and helped them when they got stuck.

Ben and Lily liked the game very much. They thought it was fun and challenging. They played many times and learned new things. They thanked Dad for teaching them.

"Chess is not a weird game. It's a cool game," Ben said.

"I agree. It's a cool game. And you are a cool brother," Lily said.

They hugged each other and smiled. They were happy to play chess and to have each other.

Lily and Ben were playing with their toys in the garden. They liked to make houses and cars and animals with their blocks and sticks and stones. Lily was making a house for her doll. She found a soft cloth to use as a roof. She put it on top of her blocks.

"Look, Ben, I made a house for my doll. Do you like it?" she asked.

Ben came over to see. He saw something moving under the cloth. He lifted it up and saw a big spider. He screamed and dropped the cloth.

"Spider! Spider! Get it away!" he shouted.

Lily was scared too. She did not like spiders. She ran to her mom, who was sitting on a bench. She hugged her mom and cried.

"Mom, there is a spider in my house! It is big and scary!" she said.

Mom got up and went to see. She saw the spider crawling away from the cloth. She picked it up gently and showed it to Lily and Ben.

"Don't be afraid, children. This is a harmless spider. It was just looking for a place to hide. It won't hurt you or your toys. See, it has eight legs and two eyes and a furry body. It is not so scary, is it?" she said.

Lily and Ben looked at the spider. They saw that it was not so big and not so scary. They felt sorry for making it run away.

"Can we keep it, mom? Can we make a home for it?" they asked.

Mom smiled and nodded. She found a jar and some leaves and put the spider inside. She poked some holes in the lid.

"Okay, you can keep it, but you have to take good care of it. You have to give it water and food and a place to make a web. And you have to include it in your games. What will you name it?" she asked.

Lily and Ben thought for a moment. Then they said together:

"Softy!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy bear named Teddy, who she loved very much. One day, Lily was playing with Teddy near the fireplace. She was holding him close when she accidentally touched his fur to the flame.

Teddy's fur caught on fire! Lily was scared and didn't know what to do. "Teddy, are you okay?" she asked. Teddy didn't answer, but Lily knew he needed help.

Lily quickly blew out the flame and then gave Teddy a big kiss. Teddy was okay, but his fur was a little singed. "I'm sorry, Teddy," Lily said. "I won't let that happen again." Teddy didn't say anything, but Lily knew he forgave her. From that day on, Lily made sure to keep Teddy away from the fire.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a fearful tiger. The tiger was scared of everything. He was scared of the wind, the rain, and even the little bugs.

One day, the fearful tiger found a small, lost kitten. The kitten was all alone, and it was sad. The tiger wanted to help the kitten, so he decided to carry it on his back. Together, they walked through the forest, looking for the kitten's home.

As they walked, the fearful tiger started to feel brave. He was not scared of the wind or the rain anymore. The little kitten made the tiger feel strong. Finally, they found the kitten's home, and the tiger was very happy. From that day on, the tiger was not fearful anymore. He had a new friend, and they lived happily in the big forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to watch films with his mommy and daddy. One day, Timmy and his family went to see a film at the movie theater. The film was about a big, fearful monster who lived in a castle.

Timmy loved the movie, but he was scared of the monster. His mommy and daddy told him that the monster was just acting, and that it wasn't real. Timmy felt better knowing that the monster wasn't real, and he enjoyed the rest of the film.

After the film was over, Timmy and his family went home. Timmy couldn't stop talking about the film and how the monster was just acting. He wanted to watch more films with his family, and he wasn't afraid of any monsters anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a flower called Poppy. Poppy loved the sun and always wanted to be proud. Whenever the sun came out, Poppy bloomed.

One day, Poppy decided that she wanted to find the shore. She had heard so much about it from the other flowers and wanted to see it for herself.

So Poppy set off on her journey. She moved through the grass, over the hills, and around the trees and when she was almost there, the sun came out. Poppy bloomed so brightly.

Eventually, Poppy reached the shore. It was so bright, so beautiful and so majestic. Poppy was so proud of what she had achieved. Standing at the shore, she smiled and bloomed even brighter.

Once upon a time, there was a delicate princess named Lily. She lived in a big castle with her family. Princess Lily loved to race with her friends in the garden.

One sunny day, Princess Lily and her friend, Tom the bunny, decided to have a race. They stood at the start line, ready to go. "Ready, set, go!" shouted Princess Lily, and they ran as fast as they could.

As they raced, Tom the bunny tripped on a rock and fell down. Princess Lily stopped and said, "Are you okay, Tom?" Tom was sad but said, "Yes, thank you for helping me." They walked back to the castle together, holding hands.

Princess Lily learned that winning the race is not as important as being a good friend. From that day on, she always helped her friends when they needed her. And everyone in the kingdom loved the kind and caring princess.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a nice cat named Mittens. One day, Lily wanted to make some cookies, so she got a big bowl and a spoon. She put some flour, sugar and butter in the bowl and started to mix it with the spoon.

Mittens came over and said, "Meow! Can I help, Lily?"

Lily smiled and said, "Sure, Mittens! Can you rub the butter with the flour?"

Mittens used his paws to rub the butter with the flour. Lily then asked, "Can you get me a teaspoon, Mittens?"

Mittens went to get a teaspoon and brought it back to Lily. They continued to mix the ingredients until they made some yummy cookies. Lily and Mittens enjoyed their cookies together and they were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to school every day, but one day she forgot her backpack inside the classroom. When she went back to unlock the door, she noticed something strange. The door was already unlocked.

Lily felt a bit scared, but she decided to go inside and get her backpack. As she walked towards her desk, she saw a bitter smell coming from the teacher's desk. She opened the drawer and found a half-eaten apple inside.

The next day, Lily told her teacher about the unlocked door and the bitter smell. Her teacher thanked her for telling her and promised to be more careful. From that day on, Lily always made sure to lock the door when she left the classroom.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was just three years old and wanted to explore the world.

One day she went out and found an unknown tree. It was huge and so tall it touched the sky.

The little girl was amazed and wanted to climb it, so she started to lean against the trunk and she managed to climb up.

When she reached the top, she was delighted. She could see so far and there were so many new things to explore. Then, she saw something very cool, a laser that was shining in the distance.

She didn't know what it was and it made her very curious. She kept leaning against the tree and watched the laser. After a while she got bored, so she crawled down the tree and went home.

Lily loved to read books. She liked to learn new words and say them out loud. She had a big book of animals that her mom gave her. She opened the book and saw a picture of a giraffe.

"Wow, look at this!" she said to her mom. "What is this animal?"

"That is a giraffe, Lily," her mom said. "It is a very tall animal that lives in Africa. It has a long neck and spots on its fur."

Lily pointed to the giraffe's neck. "Why is its neck so long?" she asked.

"Because it needs to reach the leaves on the trees," her mom said. "The leaves are its food. The giraffe can grow very tall and eat a lot of leaves."

Lily nodded. She thought the giraffe was brilliant. She wanted to grow tall too and eat leaves. She said the word "giraffe" over and over. She liked how it sounded.

"Can you say another word, Lily?" her mom asked. "How about this animal?" She turned the page and showed her a picture of a penguin.

Lily looked at the penguin. It was black and white and had a beak and wings. It was very different from the giraffe. She tried to say the word "penguin" but it was hard.

"Pen...pen...ping?" she said.

"Almost, Lily," her mom said. "It is penguin. Try again."

Lily repeated the word. "Penguin. Penguin. Penguin."

"Good job, Lily!" her mom said. "You are learning new words every day. You are a brilliant reader."

Lily smiled. She felt happy and proud. She hugged her mom and her book. She wanted to read more and more. She loved words.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man who lived in a big house. He loved to test new things, so one day he wrote a note. The note said that he was going to try a new test. He wanted to see how much people cared about him.

So he sent out the note to all his friends and family. He asked them to do something special for him, like bring him a new toy or a tasty treat.

The man waited and waited, but nobody came. He was very disappointed and it made him feel sad.

But then, on the last day, someone came to the house with a big surprise. It was his family, coming to give him lots of hugs and kisses. The family had read the note and they wanted to show the man how much they cared.

The man smiled and hugged everyone. With that, the test was over and it proved that the man was rich in loving friends and family.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane loved to imagine special things. One day, she imagined that she was at the top of a big stair. Jane looked down at the stair. It was very different than steps she had seen before. She could even feel herself getting closer to the top.

With every step, Jane imagined new things. She dreamed of a beautiful garden at the top. When she finally reached the top, there was a magical garden waiting for her to explore. It was full of many different colours and smells. Jane was so excited!

Jane walked around the garden and it looked very different from the stairs she climbed. There were so many interesting plants to explore. Jane had never imagined such a special place before.

She stayed in the garden for a long time and imagined all the different adventures she could have there. When she finally went home, she couldn't stop thinking of the magical garden at the top of the stair.

Jack and Jill were walking up the hill. It was very hot outside and they were both getting very sweaty. Suddenly, Jack tripped and fell. He started to cry because he was so embarrassed. Jill wanted to help but Jack got angry. He started to fight with Jill. Jill was annoyed and shouted "Stop it! You are being so foolish!" But Jack wouldn't listen. He kept fighting until he felt too hot. He started to pant and knew he needed to cool down. So, he ran to get something cold to drink. After that, Jack stopped fighting and apologized to Jill. Jill smiled and they continued walking up the hill - together.

Lily liked to skip. She skipped to school, she skipped in the park, she skipped at home. She liked to skip with her friends, too. They skipped and sang and laughed.

One day, Lily was skipping with her friend Ben. They saw a big, hairy dog. The dog was friendly and wagged its tail. Lily and Ben wanted to pet the dog. They skipped to the dog and said hello.

But the dog was scared of the skipping. It barked and jumped and ran away. Lily and Ben chased the dog. They did not see the rock on the ground. Lily tripped on the rock and fell. She hurt her knee and it bled.

Lily cried and Ben helped her. He took her to his mom. His mom was nice and gave Lily a bandage. She put the bandage on Lily's knee and kissed it. She said it would be okay.

Lily smiled and thanked Ben and his mom. She felt better. She still liked to skip, but she learned to be careful of rocks and dogs. She and Ben skipped back to the park and played some more. They had fun.

Once upon a time there was a little bird, who could fly and sang sweet songs. One day, he decided to go on an adventure. He flew through the clouds and soon arrived at an apple tree. He saw a strawberry on a branch and wanted to try it. He flew up to it and took a bite, but it tasted strange.

The bird became confused and looked down. He saw the tree was covered with dirt! Suddenly, the strawberry didn't seem so good anymore. It had become dirty.

Then the bird heard a voice, and a big cat-like creature appeared. The creature said it was the guard of the apple tree and told the little bird to leave. The bird was startled and flew away quickly, leaving the strawberry behind.

The bird never returned to the apple tree, but it did learn a valuable lesson. Next time he wanted to try something new, the bird was prepared to take a closer look before taking a bite!

Once upon a time, there was a little crab. One day the crab went walking through the sand and heard a loud noise. "What is that noise?" the crab asked.

Suddenly, a big giant appeared! The giant said, "I have a question for you, little crab". The crab looked up and said, "What is it?". The giant replied, "I need an answer".

The crab thought for a moment and answered, "Yes". The giant smiled and said, "That’s right! Now I’m going to give you a reward". He gave the crab a shiny pearl.

The crab was so happy. He thanked the giant and ran off. From that day on, the crab was the happiest creature in the sea!

One day, Toby had a big event. He was so excited! He put on his special outfit and waved goodbye to Mommy. At the event, Toby saw many people. Everyone was working and having a good time.

Toby noticed a smelly food cart and his mouth started to water. He asked one of the workers what kind of food they had. "We have hot dogs and hamburgers," said the worker. Toby wanted to try a hot dog.

He ordered the hot dog and waited. When his order was ready, Toby took a big bite. But something was not right. "It tastes yucky," he said.

The worker laughed. "That's because the hot dog is smelly," he said. Toby was so embarrassed! He thanked the worker and quickly went home. Mommy laughed when she heard the story. From then on, Toby was more careful when choosing his food!

One day, a little dog named Bob was in his yard. He saw a big box by his dog stand. He was scared. Bob did not know what was in the box. He wanted to find out, but he was too scared to get close.

Bob's friend, a cat named Sam, came over. Sam saw the box too. Sam was not scared. Sam said, "Let's sort the things in the box. Maybe it is not so scary." Bob agreed, but he was still scared.

They opened the box and found toys! They sorted the toys into two piles: one for Bob and one for Sam. Bob was not scared anymore. They played with their new toys by the dog stand all day.

Once upon a time, there was an old boat. The boat was near a big tree. The tree had many leaves. Some leaves fell on the boat. The wind blew the leaves away. The leaves turned into ash.

One day, a girl and a boy found the old boat. They wanted to sail on the water. They pushed the boat into the water. The boat started to move. They were very happy.

They sailed across the water. They saw fish and birds. The sun was shining. They played and laughed. The old boat took them on a fun adventure. They had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a flower. It was small and green and it lived in a garden. One day, the flower started to grow bigger and bigger. Then, it bloomed! It was so pretty with its pink petals.

The flower was happy but then it got sick. It needed a doctor. A thoughtful doctor came and looked at the flower. He gave it some medicine and soon the flower was feeling much better.

The flower was grateful to the doctor for being so thoughtful. It continued to grow and bloom, making the garden a beautiful place. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a cute prince. He had a big castle with lots of rooms and toys. One day, the prince went outside to play. He saw a butterfly and tried to catch it, but it disappeared. The prince looked everywhere, but he couldn't find it. He felt sad and went back to his castle. But then, the butterfly appeared again and landed on the prince's nose. The prince was happy and smiled.

Once there was a boy, and he was unhappy. He was so miserable he never smiled.

One day, all his friends wanted to help him, so they made him something special. It was a big, white lung.

At first, the boy didn’t know what to do with it. Then, he figured out what it was for. He breathe in deeply, and it made him feel better. He smiled with joy.

The lung made him so happy that he never stopped smiling. Everyone saw, and they were so happy they all smiled too.

The boy was no longer miserable. The special lung chased the clouds away, and only the sunshine remained.

Anna likes to go to the gym with her mom. The gym has many things to play with. Anna likes to jump on the big mat, swing on the rope, and roll on the ball. She has fun with her mom and the other kids.

One day, Anna finds a pink gum in her mom's bag. She thinks it is candy. She puts it in her mouth and chews it. It is sweet and sticky. She likes it. She chews and chews and chews.

But then, the gum gets stuck in her hair. She tries to pull it out, but it hurts. She cries. Her mom hears her and comes to help. She sees the gum in Anna's hair. She is not happy. She says, "Anna, you should not chew gum. It is not good for your teeth and your hair. Where did you get it?"

Anna feels sorry. She says, "I found it in your bag. I thought it was candy. I'm sorry, mom."

Her mom hugs her and says, "It's okay, Anna. I forgive you. But next time, ask me before you take something from my bag. And don't chew gum. It is not for kids. Now let's go to the bathroom and try to get the gum out of your hair."

Once there was a mommy who was frustrated. Every day, she raised her lip in a sad frown. She was so sad because she didn't have any kids.

One day, she heard a knock on the door. When she opened it, there was an angel with a baby in her arms. The angel said, "This baby is for you!" The mommy was so happy that she jumped for joy.

From then on, the mommy raised her baby with lots of love. She held her close and read her stories and gave her hugs. Every night she kissed her baby's forehead and sang a special lullaby.

The baby grew into a happy 3 year old girl. The mommy was so proud of her and no longer felt frustrated. She watched her daughter run, jump, and play and her heart was full of joy.

The mommy and her daughter laughed, smiled and hugged each other every day. The mommy was so happy that she had been chosen to raise her beautiful daughter.

Once upon a time there lived a famous mustached man. He was the most organized man in the world and kept everything in its proper place.

One day, a young girl visited him and was amazed by his organization. She asked him, "How do you stay so organized?"

The man smiled and replied, "It is because I always put others first. I help people with their needs and that helps me stay organized."

The girl was very pleased and she thanked him for the valuable lesson. She learned that if she helped others with their needs, it would keep her organized and help her do her own work better.

The girl went on to teach others the same lesson and the man with the famous mustache smiled with pride. He was happy to see that his lesson had helped so many people. The moral of this story is that when we put others first, it helps us to stay organized, which in turn helps us do better in our own lives.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play with toys. Sara has a new toy. It is a laser. It makes red light. Tom wants to play with it too.

"Can I have the laser?" Tom asks Sara.

"No, it is mine. You have your own toys," Sara says.

"But I like the laser. It is different. It is cool," Tom says.

He tries to take the laser from Sara. Sara does not let him. They pull and push. The laser falls on the floor. It breaks. The red light is gone.

Sara and Tom are sad. They are sorry. They say sorry to each other.

"I am sorry I broke your laser," Tom says.

"I am sorry I did not share with you," Sara says.

They hug. They are friends again.

They go to Sara's mom. She is in the kitchen. She is making cookies.

"Mom, can you fix the laser?" Sara asks.

"I am sorry, honey. I can't fix the laser. It is broken," Mom says.

"But can you provide us with a new one?" Tom asks.

Mom smiles. She says, "Maybe for your birthday. But for now, I can provide you with some cookies. Do you want some?"

Sara and Tom nod. They say, "Yes, please!"

They take some cookies. They are yummy. They are happy. They forget about the laser. They play with other toys. They have fun. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lily. Lily was very happy to go exploring in the park.

When she got there, Lily saw a big sign. She was curious and walked up to it. The sign said, “Follow the path!” Lily decided to do what the sign said.

She followed the path and soon she saw something that made her very excited. There was a magical door hidden in the trees!

Lily hugged the door, and it opened. Inside the door there was a surprise! It was a present for Lily! She was so happy!

The present revealed a plan for the whole day. Lily was going to learn and have fun with her friends! She was so excited!

She spent the day learning and playing with her friends, and when the day was over she was very happy. Her magical day was all thanks to the sign in the park!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lisa. One day, Lisa went for a walk in the forest. When she arrived at the forest, she found a filthy dog. She was so amazed when she saw it!

Lisa said to the dog, "Hey! Who are you?"

The dog said, "My name is John."

Lisa was so happy to make a new friend. She asked him, "Do you want to come home with me?"

John replied, "Yes, please!"

Lisa and John walked back to her house together. Lisa's mom saw them and asked, "What did you find in the forest?"

Lisa proudly said, "I found a new friend, his name is John!"

Then Lisa's mom smiled and said, "It's so nice to have a new friend!"

From that day on, Lisa and John were the best of friends. They played together and had lots of fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her toy car. One day, Lily's toy car got stuck in a cable. She tried and tried to pull it out, but it wouldn't budge. She asked her mom for help.

"Mommy, can you help me unlock my toy car from the cable?" asked Lily.

Her mom tried to pull it out too, but it was no use. Suddenly, Lily felt very dizzy and fell down. Her mom called for an ambulance, but it was too late. Lily had hit her head and passed away.

From that day on, her mom always made sure to keep Lily's toys away from cables so that no one else would get hurt.

Once upon a time, there was a funny fisherman named Bob. He loved to spend his days by the water, catching fish. Bob had a big, round belly and a red nose. He made everyone laugh with his silly jokes.

One sunny day, Bob met a little girl named Lily by the water. "Hi, I'm Lily!" she said. "What are you doing?" Bob smiled and said, "I'm a fisherman! I spend my days catching fish. Do you want to try?" Lily nodded and took the fishing rod.

Together, they spent the whole day fishing and laughing. Lily caught her first fish and felt very proud. Bob was happy to have a new friend. As the sun started to set, they said goodbye and promised to meet again by the water.

From that day on, the funny fisherman and Lily spent many days together, catching fish and sharing laughs. The days were filled with joy, and Lily learned that spending time with a friend could be the best thing in the world.

Once upon a time, there was a cool rat. He liked to rub his soft fur against the walls in his home. He would rub until his fur felt nice and smooth.

One day, the rat decided to go on an adventure. He ran and jumped, exploring the world around him. Everywhere he went, he rubbed his fur against things he saw.

The rat explored for a long time and eventually he found himself in a garden. Suddenly, he heard a noise. It was coming from a nearby bush. As the rat moved closer, he saw an ol' mean cat. The rat hurried away, but the cat followed him. The rat rubbed his fur together, but the cat was getting closer.

The rat was scared, so he ran as fast as he could. Suddenly he remembered something! He remembered a big tree nearby. So, the rat ran to the tree and climbed up the trunk. The cat followed him, but the rat was too quick. He reached the top of the tree and rubbed his fur against the branches to make himself feel safe.

The rat was relieved and the cat was stuck down below. The rat was happy he was safe, and even cooler because he had gone on an adventure and found a way to get away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to cook. She always helped her mommy in the kitchen and learned how to make yummy food. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to get a pot from the cabinet to cook some soup. Lily went to the cabinet and opened it gently. She found the pot and gave it to her mommy.

Later that day, Lily's mommy asked her to help make cookies. They got all the ingredients from the cabinet and mixed them together. Lily was so excited to see the cookies cook in the oven. She waited patiently and when they were done, she tasted them and they were delicious. From that day on, Lily loved to cook even more and always remembered to open the cabinet gently.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Bob and Sue. They went to the park to play. Bob had a toy that he liked to shoot. He had it pointed at a birds nest when Sue yelled, "You're not allowed to shoot at the birds!"

Bob sighed and said, "What should I shoot at then?"

Sue smiled and said, "I know! We can shoot at the mugs over there."

So the two friends went over and set up the mugs. Bob lined them up one by one. His aim was rough but he was able to get them all lined up in a row. Sue said, "Let's have a competition, who can get the most mugs?"

Bob nodded in agreement and started to shoot. After a few rounds, Bob had shot at all the mugs. Unfortunately for Bob, he did not hit a single one of them. Sue laughed at her friend and said, "It looks like you lost the competition, my aim was a lot better than yours!"

Bob frowned and went home feeling sad and disappointed. He learned his lesson and the next time he was at the park, he only shot at the mugs that he knew he could hit.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and her favorite toy was a teddy bear named Teddy. One day, Lily's mom brought home a shiny ornament for their Christmas tree. Lily thought it was so pretty and she wanted to hold it.

Lily's mom warned her not to touch it because it was fragile and could break. But Lily didn't listen and she accidentally dropped it. The ornament broke into a million pieces and Lily felt really stupid. She started to cry and said, "I'm sorry, Mommy."

Her mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. Accidents happen. Just remember to be careful next time." Lily nodded and promised to be more careful. She helped her mom clean up the broken pieces and then they released the rest of the ornaments onto the tree. From that day on, Lily learned to listen to her mom and be more careful with fragile things.

Once upon a time, there was a shy panda. The panda had a lot of friends in the forest, but the panda was too shy to play with them. One day, the panda decided to join the other animals and play with them. The panda played and had fun with the other animals until it was time to finish playing.

The panda said goodbye to its friends and went back to its home. But on the way home, the panda got lost in the forest. The panda looked and looked but couldn't find its way back home. The panda was sad and scared.

The night came and the panda was still lost. It was cold and the panda was hungry. The panda cried and cried until it fell asleep. The next day, the other animals looked for the panda but they couldn't find it. The shy panda was never seen again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a chicken named Sarah. She was a reliable chicken, always there when her friends needed her help. One day, her friends asked her to help them find some special tools they needed. Sarah knew just the place. She grabbed them with her beak and sharp claws and flew to the top of the hill.

Once they arrived, Sarah handed her friends the tools. With them, they were able to finish their project. Everyone was so happy! Her friends all thanked Sarah for her being so reliable.

At the end of the day, they all celebrated in the best way they knew how - by having a special dinner. As a treat, Sarah cooked a delicious chicken dinner.

Everyone smiled and gave Sarah a big hug. From that day forward, she was known as the most reliable chicken in all the land.

Once upon a time there was a baby that wanted to raise high. Its parents gave it a big hug and it felt so happy. Its parents decided to give the baby a gift. They went to the store and bought a special bottle with red wine. The baby was so excited and wanted to take the bottle. Its parents laughed and opened the bottle for the baby.

The baby smelled the red wine and took a sip. It was so sweet and delicious! The parents were so happy to see the baby enjoying the gift they gave. After a while, they all sat down by the table and raised their bottles up in celebration. The baby felt so grown up and proud. Its parents smiled and gave it big hugs and kisses.

The baby had a wonderful time with its parents and was so happy. It was like a magical moment that was full of love.

Lila and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big truck. The truck has ice-cream. Lila and Ben love ice-cream. They run to the truck.

The man in the truck is nice. He smiles at Lila and Ben. He says, "What do you want?" Lila and Ben look at the ice-cream. There are many kinds. Lila wants chocolate. Ben wants strawberry. They tell the man.

The man gives them ice-cream. He says, "That will be two coins." Lila and Ben look at their pockets. They have no coins. They are sad. They say, "Sorry, we have no coins."

The man sees their sad faces. He feels sorry for them. He is humble. He says, "It's okay. You can have the ice-cream for free. But you have to do something for me." Lila and Ben say, "What do we have to do?"

The man says, "You have to use your manners. You have to say thank you and please. And you have to share your ice-cream with someone who has none." Lila and Ben say, "Okay, we can do that." They say, "Thank you, sir. You are very kind." They take their ice-cream and go to the park.

They see a girl sitting on a bench. She has no ice-cream. She looks lonely. Lila and Ben go to her. They say, "Hi, we are Lila and Ben. Do you want some ice-cream?" The girl says, "Yes, please. That would be nice." Lila and Ben share their ice-cream with her. They make a new friend. They are happy. They use their manners. They use their ice-cream. They are humble.

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Lucy and Jack. Jack was very rich. One day, Jack told Lucy about a special law that said that it was against the law for him to lift heavy things. He said it was called the 'no-lifting law'.

That afternoon, Lucy asked Jack, "Why don't you lift the heavy things?"

Jack looked sad, and replied, "I'm sorry Lucy, I can't break the law. But I have enough money to hire someone to lift them for me. That's why I'm rich."

Jack smiled, happy that he was able to obey the law. Lucy smiled too, and said, "Let's go and play now!"

So they played together all afternoon, and never stopped lifting their spirits!

Tim and Sam were best friends. They liked to play with toys and make things. One day, they found a big box in the garage. It had many jars and bottles inside. Some had labels, some did not. They were curious.

"Let's open them and see what they are!" Tim said.

"OK, but be careful. We don't know what they are," Sam said.

They opened some jars and bottles. They saw different colors and shapes. Some were liquid, some were solid, some were powder. They smelled them and touched them. Some smelled good, some smelled bad, some smelled nothing. Some felt soft, some felt hard, some felt sticky.

"Look, this powder is blue. I wonder what it does," Tim said. He poured some on his hand.

"Maybe it makes you smart. Or strong. Or fast," Sam said.

"Or maybe it makes you blue," Tim said. He laughed.

He rubbed the powder on his face and arms. He felt funny. He felt itchy. He felt hot.

"Tim, are you OK? You look weird," Sam said. He saw Tim's skin turning blue.

"I don't know. I don't feel good. I think this powder is bad," Tim said. He started to cry.

"Let's go to mom. She can help. She can solve this," Sam said. He grabbed Tim's hand and ran to the house.

But it was too late. The powder was not just blue. It was unknown. It was dangerous. It was poison. Tim fell down and stopped breathing. Sam screamed and cried. Mom came and saw them. She was shocked and scared. She called for help. But it was too late. Tim was gone. Sam was sad. He wished he never opened the box. He wished he never played with the powder. He wished he listened to Sam. He wished he could have his best friend back. But he couldn't. The end.

Once upon a time there was a bird. The bird was always so happy. He would fly high in the sky and look for interesting things.

One day, he noticed the sun was especially bright. He knew he couldn't reach it though. So he flew higher and higher until he could touch it.

But as he flew closer and closer, he felt something sharp. It was poking him in his tummy. He was so unhappy and he said sorry to the sky.

He looked down and saw that it was a tall tree. He had flown too close to the tree and it had scratched him. But the tree was sorry too.

The bird decided not to fly so high next time. He was happy again, and flew off to find something else to explore.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends decided to play a game of catch. Timmy tried his best to catch the ball, but it kept slipping out of his hands.

Suddenly, the ball flew over Timmy's head and landed in a nearby net. Timmy ran over to the net and tried to get the ball out, but it was stuck. He pulled and pulled, but the ball wouldn't budge.

Timmy's friends came over to help him. They all tried to get the ball out of the net, but it was no use. Timmy's arm started to hurt from pulling so hard. Just when they thought they would never get the ball back, Timmy's big brother came to the rescue. He easily got the ball out of the net and gave it back to Timmy. Timmy was so happy and grateful to his brother for helping him.

Molly and Sammy were twins, and they liked to have a lot of fun. Together, they would skip down the hallway, giggling and hopping.

One day, they decided to skip over to the kitchen. But when they saw what was inside the fridge, Molly stopped in her tracks.

"Sammy, look!" she said in a delicate voice. She pointed to the fridge. There were more treats than either of them could imagine.

"Wow!" Sammy said. "Let's take one each."

But Molly shook her head. "Mummy said we have to be delicate," she said. "We don't want to get in trouble."

So instead, they skipped back to the living room, holding hands and laughing. They knew they'd make up for the snacks another day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play on the swings at the park. One day, she met a boy named Max who was playing on the other side of the playground. Max had an unusual toy that Lily had never seen before, and she wanted to play with it.

"Can I play with your toy?" asked Lily.

"No, it's mine," said Max.

Lily was sad and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, an old man came and sat next to them. He said, "I can teach you both something important. Sharing is caring. If you share your toys, you can make new friends and have more fun."

Max thought about it and decided to share his toy with Lily. They played together and had a great time. The old man smiled and said, "See, sharing is always the best side to choose. It makes everyone happy."

From that day on, Lily and Max became best friends and always shared their toys. They learned that it's important to be kind and share with others.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, they found a big slide and they all took turns sliding down it. Lily loved the feeling of the wind in her hair as she slid down the slide.

As they were playing, they saw an ugly dog walking towards them. The dog looked sad and scared. Lily and her friends decided to show the dog some love and kindness. They brought the dog some food and water and played with him. The dog soon became happy and wagged his tail.

From that day on, the dog would come to the park to play with Lily and her friends. They would slide down the slide together and have so much fun. Lily realized that even though the dog was ugly, he was still a good friend and she loved him just the same.

Once upon a time, there was a happy girl named Lily. She loved to wear her sunglasses and play outside. One day, she met her friend, a cheerful boy named Max.

Max said, "Lily, let's play catch!"

Lily said, "Okay!" and they started to play. But then, Lily's sunglasses fell off and broke. She started to cry.

Max said, "Don't cry, Lily. Let's take a nap and then we can think of a way to fix your sunglasses."

Lily stopped crying and said, "Okay, let's sleep." And they both took a nap. When they woke up, Max had an idea to fix Lily's sunglasses. They were both happy again and continued to play catch.

Here is one possible story, but there are many other ways to write it.

Ben and Lily went to the park with their mom. They saw a big maze made of tall plants. They wanted to play in the maze. Mom said, "Be careful, don't get lost. I will wait for you here."

Ben and Lily ran into the maze. They had fun finding new paths and hiding from each other. But soon they realized they did not know how to get out. They started to feel scared and sad. They called for mom, but she did not hear them.

They saw a sign that said, "Exit this way." They followed the sign, hoping to see mom. But the sign was a trick. It led them to a dead end. There was a camera and a speaker. A voice said, "Ha ha, you fell for it. This is a modern maze. It is a prank. You are on TV. Everyone can see how silly you are."

Ben and Lily felt very embarrassed. They wanted to cry. They wished they never went into the maze. They wished they stayed with mom. They did not like the modern maze. They did not like the prank. They did not like the voice. They did not like the TV. They did not like anything.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Honey. She was strong and powerful, and she had a plan.

Honey loved to explore and she wanted to see different places. So one day, Honey decided to go for a walk. She put on her shoes and opened the front door.

The bright sunshine made Honey so happy. She skipped around and she waved to all the bugs that she saw. Soon, Honey got tired from all the exploring. She wanted to get a snack.

So Honey went to the kitchen. She found a jar of honey and she scooped some out with a spoon. She took a big bite and it was sweet and yummy.

Honey smiled, feeling happy and powerful again. She would keep exploring and plan even more adventures.

Once there was a little girl. She was three years old. She saw a plane pass by in the sky one day. She was very jealous.

The little girl wanted to fly in a plane like the one she saw. She asked her mom if she could fly in a plane one day. Her mom said, "Yes, of course you can fly in a plane one day."

The little girl was so excited! She asked her mom when she could fly in a plane. Her mom said, "We will have to wait and see when the time is right."

The little girl was a bit jealous that she had to wait. But she was happy that she would be able to fly in a plane one day. She smiled and went about her day.

The little girl kept watching the sky every day, looking for a plane. Finally, one day, she saw one pass by. She waved goodbye as it flew, content knowing that one day she would get to fly in a plane too.

Jill and Tom were hungry. They wanted to eat something sweet. They saw a big bowl of peaches on the table. They liked peaches. They took two peaches and washed them.

"Let's prepare the peaches," Jill said. "We can cut them and put them in a dish."

"OK," Tom said. "But how do we cut them? They have a hard thing in the middle."

Jill showed Tom how to cut the peaches. She used a small knife and cut around the hard thing. Then she twisted the peaches and pulled them apart. She took out the hard thing and threw it in the trash.

"Look, Tom, this is the pit. It has a weird shape. It is not round like the peach. It is pointy and bumpy."

Tom looked at the pit. He touched it with his finger. It felt rough and hard. He did not like it.

"Yuck, I don't want to eat the pit. I only want to eat the peach. It is soft and juicy and sweet."

Jill agreed. She put the peach halves in a dish and gave one to Tom. They ate the peaches and smiled. They were happy. They liked to prepare and eat peaches. They did not like the weird pits.

Once upon a time there was a lovely cherry tree. It was so big and full of nice, red cherries. Every day a little girl would come to the tree. She would need to pick several cherries for her mommy.

One day, the little girl was very sad. She looked up to the tree and said "Cherry tree, I need your help." The cherry tree heard her and looked down. It said "Why, little girl, what do you need?"

The little girl said "I need cherries for my mommy to make a pie." The cherry tree said "My cherries are so lovely, I will give some to you." So the cherry tree gave the little girl all the cherries she needed.

The little girl was so happy. She thanked the cherry tree and gave her a big hug. Then she went home and made mommy the pie.

The cherry tree was so proud, it knew it had helped the little girl. This made it happy and it promised to keep giving lovely cherries to the little girl every day.

Once upon a time, there was a silly dinosaur. The dinosaur was very foolish and did not want to support his friends. One day, while walking through the jungle, he saw one of his friends carrying a heavy tree. He thought it looked funny, but he should have offered to help.

Suddenly his friend stopped and asked, "Why won't you support me?" The foolish dinosaur had no good answer, so he just stood there and said nothing. His friend sighed and said, "If you won't support me, I'll never be able to move this tree".

The silly dinosaur felt bad, so he decided to help his friend. He put on his biggest smile and said, "I'm here to support you!" Together, they were able to move the tree, and the happy dinosaur knew he had made the right choice. From then on, he was always sure to support his friends no matter what.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the grass with her toys. One day, her little brother wanted to play too.

Lily said, "No, I don't want you to play with me. Go away!"

Her brother was frustrated and started to cry. He demanded, "I want to play with you! Please let me play!"

Lily didn't want to share, so she said no again. Her brother was very sad and went inside.

Later that day, Lily went back inside too. She found her brother had taken her favorite toy and broke it. She was very upset and didn't know what to do. She realized that not sharing made her feel bad and she wished she had let her brother play with her.

Once upon a time, there was a human who loved to dance. He would move his body in smooth movements and made everyone smile. Even when he was alone, he always seemed to be dancing.

One day, he saw a beautiful meadow filled with flowers and he knew it was the perfect place to dance. He smiled and started moving his body, spinning and twirling through the meadow. He felt so free and happy.

He moved so smoothly that some of the animals in the meadow stopped and watched. A rabbit, a squirrel, and a deer were all mesmerized by the human's dance. The human laughed and waved at them as he continued.

Soon the sun started to set and the human knew it was time to go home. He thanked the animals for watching, and he gave them each a hug before he left. He took a deep breath and smiled, knowing he had enjoyed a wonderful day of smooth dancing.

Once upon a time, there was a queen. She was very sad and miserable. She wanted to sort her jewels but didn't know how. One day, a little girl came to the palace and saw the queen crying.

"What's wrong, queen?" asked the little girl.

"I want to sort my jewels, but I don't know how," replied the queen.

"I can help you sort them!" said the little girl with a smile.

The queen was happy and together they sorted the jewels. The queen was no longer sad and miserable. She thanked the little girl and gave her a special jewel as a gift. From that day on, the little girl became the queen's friend and they sorted jewels together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a strong bear who was called Bear. He wanted to lead something special. So, he made a big circle with lots of friends. Everyone was happy, and they all sang and danced inside the circle.

The strong bear showed them how to play a game. He said, “Everyone take hands and walk round the circle.” He started leading the game, and the friends followed him in a line. They laughed and sang as they went round.

After they had gone round a few times, the strong bear stopped them. “Let’s do it again!”, he said. Everyone screamed with joy and started to run around the circle, faster and faster.

They had lots of fun! Bear was a very good leader, and his friends thanked him for the amazing game. They said, “Thank you, Bear! You are very strong!” Bear smiled, happy that he could lead them and show them how to have a good time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved oranges. She was a very cheerful girl who always smiled and waved at everyone she met. One day, she went to the market with her mommy to buy some oranges.

When they arrived at the market, they saw a man who was selling oranges. Lily ran to him and said, "Hello, Mr. Orange man! Can I have one orange, please?" The man smiled and said, "Of course, little girl! Here you go."

Lily took the orange and started to wave it around, making everyone around her laugh. "Look, mommy! I have an orange! It's so round and cheerful!" she said. Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, it is. Now let's go home and eat it together."

Lily was so happy that she hugged her mommy and said, "Thank you for taking me to the market, mommy. I had so much fun waving my orange around!" Her mommy hugged her back and said, "You're welcome, my dear. I'm glad you had fun." And they went home, happy and cheerful.

Once upon a time, there was a lucky child. The child was very happy and had lots of fun. One day, the child wanted to explore the world by itself. It asked its mother if it could go. The mother said, "No, you must trust me" and the child said, "Yes, I trust you".

So the child's mother went along with the child, and they explored together. They saw lots of wonderful things like the trees, the birds and the bugs. The child was so excited.

At the end of the day, the mother said, "It's time to go home now. You must trust me again." The child remembered this and said, "Yes, I trust you. Thank you for taking me."

The child went home and felt safe and happy. It was so lucky to have a mother that it could trust. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, while playing hide and seek, Lily's friend Tommy vanished. Lily was scared and didn't know what to do.

Lily ran to her mommy and daddy and told them what happened. Her daddy said, "Let's go find Tommy. We will ask the lawyer who lives next door if he saw anything."

The lawyer was very honest and told them that he saw Tommy playing near the lake. They rushed to the lake and found Tommy safe and sound. Lily was so happy that her friend was okay. From that day on, Lily and her friends never played near the lake again.

Lily and Ben were playing in the garden. They had a big hose and a bucket of water. They liked to spray each other and make big splashes.

"Spray me, spray me!" Ben shouted, running around the grass.

"OK, here I come!" Lily said, aiming the hose at him. She sprayed him with a lot of water and he laughed.

But then, they heard a loud noise from the house. It was Mom, and she sounded angry.

"What are you doing?" Mom asked, coming out of the door. She had a cake in her hands, and it was messy. It had frosting and sprinkles all over it, and some of it had fallen on the floor.

"We were playing, Mom," Lily said, dropping the hose.

"Playing? You were supposed to help me with the cake! It was for Grandma's birthday, and now it's ruined!" Mom said, showing them the cake.

Lily and Ben felt sorry. They did not mean to make Mom sad. They wanted to make Grandma happy.

"We're sorry, Mom," they said together.

"Can we help you fix the cake?" Lily asked.

Mom sighed. She looked at the cake, and then at the children. They were wet and dirty, but they had sweet faces.

"Maybe we can," she said. "But first, you need to dry off and clean up. Then, we can make a new cake together. And no more spraying, OK?"

"OK, Mom," they said. They hugged her and ran to the bathroom. They hoped Grandma would like the new cake.

Anna and Ben like to create things with their crayons and paper. They draw houses, trees, animals and people. Sometimes they draw what they see outside, and sometimes they draw what they imagine.

One day, they decide to create a big picture of the sky. They use blue, white, yellow and pink crayons. They draw the sun, the clouds, the stars and the moon. They also draw some birds, planes and kites.

"Look, Anna, I made a playful kite!" Ben says, showing his paper. "It has a long tail and a smiley face. It flies high in the sky."

"That's a nice kite, Ben," Anna says. "I made a playful bird. It has colorful feathers and a big beak. It sings in the sky."

They stick their papers together and hang them on the wall. They are proud of their creation. They pretend they are in the sky, flying with their kite and bird. They laugh and have fun. They love to create and play.

Once upon a time, there was an otter living in a gloomy pond. Every day the otter would swim and play, but he was always sad because none of the other animals would play with him. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't make any friends.

One day, a very kind frog came to the pond to replace the otter's loneliness. With the frog, he could swim and play as much as he wanted. The frog also brought lots of colourful things into the pond, which helped make the otter much happier.

From then on, the otter was never lonely again. Every day, he and the frog would swim, laugh and play together. Those gloomy days were replaced with happy ones.
