One day, Lily hurt her leg. She stepped on a sharp rock and it made a cut. It hurt a lot and she cried. Her family took her to the vet. The vet gave her a bandage and some medicine. He said she had to rest and not run for a while.

Lily was very grumpy. She did not like to rest. She did not like the bandage. She did not like the medicine. She did not want to walk slowly behind her family. She wanted to lead. She growled and whined and tried to pull away.

Her family was sad. They loved Lily and wanted her to get better. They tried to cheer her up with treats and toys and cuddles. But Lily was still grumpy.

One day, Lily noticed that her leg was feeling better. It did not hurt as much and the cut was healing. She wagged her tail and licked her family. She was ready to lead again.

Her family was happy. They took off the bandage and let Lily run in front of them. She sniffed new things and barked at other dogs. She was a happy dog.

Once upon a time there was a smart girl called Jane. Jane was always very curious and today she was feeling extra curious. She was very keen to discover the truth about something but she didn't know what it was.

Jane's mum said, "Let's go for a walk. Maybe this will help you find out the truth." So they set off together and soon, they came across a tractor. Jane was delighted and asked her mum, "What is it, mummy? What does it do?"

Her mum explained that the tractor was used to load things. Suddenly, Jane remembered all the times she had seen the tractor loading things on her granddad's farm. She was so pleased to discover the truth about the tractor.

But the best thing of all was that she felt smart too. Jane had used her curious mind to find out the truth. She knew she was getting smarter every day.

Ben and Lily were playing in the park with their dog Spot. Spot was a big dog with a long tail. He liked to run and chase balls and birds. Ben and Lily loved Spot very much.

One day, they saw a big pond in the park. It had ducks and fish and frogs in it. Ben and Lily wanted to see them closer. They ran to the edge of the pond and looked at the water. Spot followed them and wagged his tail.

"Look, a duck!" Lily said, pointing at a white bird with a yellow beak. "It is so pretty!"

"Can we feed it?" Ben asked, holding a piece of bread.

"Maybe. But be careful. Don't fall in the water. It is deep and cold," Lily said.

Ben nodded and threw the bread to the duck. The duck quacked and ate the bread. Spot barked and jumped. He wanted to play with the duck too. He ran to the water and tried to catch the duck. But he was too fast and slipped. He fell in the pond with a splash.

"Spot!" Ben and Lily shouted. They were scared. Spot was in trouble. He could not swim well. He tried to paddle and reach the shore. But the water was too deep and he was too tired. He whined and cried.

"Help! Help!" Ben and Lily yelled. They did not know what to do. They could not swim either. They looked around and saw a man with a boat. He was fishing in the pond. He heard their cries and saw Spot in the water.

"Hey, kids, what's wrong?" the man asked.

"Our dog! Our dog is in the water! He can't swim! Please help him!" Ben and Lily said.

The man saw Spot and felt sorry for him. He quickly rowed his boat to Spot and reached out his hand. He grabbed Spot's tail and pulled him up. He put him in the boat and wrapped him in a blanket. He rowed back to the shore and gave Spot to Ben and Lily.

"Here you go, kids. Your dog is safe. He is just wet and tired. He needs some rest and some love," the man said.

"Thank you, thank you, thank you!" Ben and Lily said. They hugged the man and hugged Spot. They were so happy and relieved. Spot licked their faces and wagged his tail. He was happy too.

The man smiled and waved goodbye. He went back to his boat and his fishing. Ben and Lily took Spot home and gave him some food and water. They dried him and cuddled him. They told their mom and dad what happened. They were proud of their dog and grateful to the man. They learned a lesson. They would never let Spot near the pond again. They would always watch him and keep him safe. They loved him very much.

One day, a compassionate bird named Tim wanted to fly far away. He wanted to go to the big airport. Tim was a small bird, but he knew he could increase his speed if he tried hard.

Tim met a kind cat named Sam. Sam said, "I can help you fly faster to the big airport!" Tim was happy and asked, "How can you help me, Sam?" Sam said, "I will push you with my paw, and you will increase your speed."

So, Sam pushed Tim with his paw, and Tim flew faster and faster. Soon, they reached the big airport. Tim thanked Sam for his help. They became best friends and played together every day.

Lily loved to play with her dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite was a princess doll. The princess doll had a long pink dress, shiny shoes and a crown. Lily got the princess doll for her birthday from her grandma. Grandma said it was a very expensive doll, and Lily should take good care of it.

One day, Lily wanted to play with her princess doll in the garden. She took the doll outside and put her on a swing. She pushed the swing gently and sang a song. She was very happy. But then, she saw a butterfly. The butterfly was very pretty, with blue and yellow wings. Lily wanted to catch the butterfly. She left the princess doll on the swing and ran after the butterfly.

Lily chased the butterfly for a long time. She forgot about the princess doll. She ran across the grass, behind the trees, and over the fence. She did not see where she was going. She did not hear her mom calling her name. She only saw the butterfly.

But the butterfly flew away. Lily was sad. She looked around and realized she was lost. She did not know where she was. She did not know how to go back home. She started to cry. She wished she had her princess doll with her. She remembered her grandma's words. She remembered how much she loved her princess doll. She was sorry she left her on the swing.

Lily cried louder and louder. She hoped someone would find her. She hoped someone would help her. She hoped someone would bring her back to her mom and her princess doll. She hoped she would never lose her princess doll again.

Once upon a time, there was a brave explorer named Jane. She had been travelling for many days and was exhausted. She decided to take a break in a very small oasis.

When she arrived, it seemed so beautiful. The trees and flowers looked so pretty. Jane was so captivated, she decided to stay and rest for a while.

Suddenly, the air turned chilly. Jane felt a little scared, but she decided to keep exploring. She started walking in one direction, and soon came across a terrible sight - a dense fog covering the whole oasis.

Jane was so scared that she screamed, "What should I do?" Suddenly, Jane heard a hissing noise from behind her. She turned around and saw a big, black snake slithering towards her.

Even though she was petrified, Jane managed to run away as fast as possible and climbed a big tree for safety. But the fog was too thick and the snake kept chasing her. It was a terrible sight.

Jane screamed for help, but no one came to save her. Eventually, the snake bit her off the tree and devoured her.

The brave explorer was gone forever, and so was the oasis, covered in a terrible fog.

The sun was gloomy and it made the day seem so still.

Bob wanted to go outside and play, so he pushed open the door and ran out.

Everything seemed so big and exciting. He saw huge trees and colourful flowers. But then he noticed that the playground wasn't open yet.

Bob was sad and he didn't want to go back inside. But his mom told him he had to wait.

Bob sighed and crossed his arms. He knew he had to wait before he could play.

So he waited and waited, watching the sun until it was time to go in.

But just before he went inside, he saw the playground open. He smiled and pushed open the gate and ran inside, ready to have fun.

Tom and Mia like to play with their toys. They have a bow and arrow, a ball, a teddy bear and a doll. They take turns to shoot the arrow at the ball. They try to hit it and make it roll.

One day, they see a huge bird in the sky. It is black and white and has a long neck. It is a swan. Tom and Mia want to see it better. They run to the window and look up.

The swan flies over their house. It is very pretty. Tom has an idea. He grabs the bow and arrow and runs outside. He wants to shoot the arrow at the swan. He thinks it will be fun.

Mia follows him. She sees what he is doing. She is scared. She knows it is bad to hurt the swan. She shouts at Tom. She tells him to stop. But Tom does not listen. He lifts the bow and aims at the swan.

Mia runs to him. She tries to take the bow and arrow from him. They tug and pull. The arrow slips from the bow. It flies in the air. It does not hit the swan. It hits the window. It makes a loud noise. It breaks the glass.

Tom and Mia are shocked. They drop the bow and arrow. They hear their mom coming. She is angry. She sees the broken window and the arrow. She asks them what they did. They are sorry. They tell her the truth. They say they are sorry.

Mom is not happy. She tells them they are naughty. She tells them they could have hurt the swan and themselves. She tells them they have to pay for the window. She tells them they have to clean up the mess. She tells them they have to go to their room.

Tom and Mia are sad. They wish they did not play with the bow and arrow. They wish they did not try to shoot the swan. They wish they listened to Mia. They hug each other. They say they are sorry. They go to their room. They hope the swan is okay. They hope mom will forgive them. They learn their lesson.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide and seek with her toys. One day, she decided to play with her toy bunny, named Binky. Lily closed her eyes and counted to ten while Binky went to hide.

Binky found a hidden spot behind the fridge. He thought, "Lily will never find me here!" Lily started looking for Binky. She looked under the bed, behind the door, and in the closet. But she could not find Binky anywhere.

Lily started to feel sad. She called out, "Binky, where are you?" Binky heard Lily and felt bad for hiding in such a hard place. He called back, "Lily, I'm behind the fridge!" Lily found Binky and gave him a big hug. They both learned that it's more fun to play when everyone can find each other easily. And they lived happily ever after.

Once there was a shy girl. She wanted to improve her world so she decided to get a map. The map showed her where she could go and how she could help.

The shy girl improved the world by picking up garbage everywhere she went. Whenever anyone saw her, they would give her a smile and a wave.

The shy girl also planted flowers and trees. Everywhere she went, she improved the world one little bit at a time.

Finally, the shy girl finished her work. Everywhere she went was much brighter and more beautiful. She smiled sadly, knowing that her work was done.

But then the girl realized something. She could always keep improving the world around her! So, she took out her map, planning out the next place to go and improve.

Once upon a time there was a young girl named Bella. Bella had a special pet turtle named Ting. Ting was a bright yellow turtle and she was very happy.

One day, Bella took Ting to the park to play. While they were there, they met a terrible dog. The dog barked very loudly and it made Bella scared.

But then, Bella noticed that the dog was wearing a ribbon with a big bow. It was a pink ribbon! She decided to introduce Ting to the dog.

At first, the dog was scared of Ting, but once it sniffed her yellow shell it became very friendly. From then on, Bella, Ting and the dog were the best of friends! They hung out at the park all the time and went on many adventures together.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty crystal necklace that she loved to wear. One day, Lily accidentally dropped her necklace and it broke into tiny pieces. She felt sad and her heart felt empty.

But then, her mommy came and gave her a big hug to comfort her. She wiped away Lily's tears and said, "Don't worry, we can fix your necklace." So, they gathered all the little pieces and glued them back together. Lily was happy again and her necklace looked as good as new.

From that day on, Lily made sure to take extra care of her crystal necklace. And whenever she felt sad or empty, she remembered the love and comfort her mommy gave her.

Once upon a time, there was a kind girl who loved to jump. She had a special notebook that she would take everywhere with her. Every time she jumped, she would put a note in her notebook.

One day, she went to the beach with her parents. She loved watching the waves crash on the shore and listening to the birds chirp. Then, she saw the best thing ever — a giant jumping tower. She ran over and asked her mom if she could try it out.

Her mom said, “Of course! Jump as much as you want.” So she did just that! She jumped and jumped and jumped until she was too tired to go anymore.

When she got back home, she snuggled up in bed and opened her notebook. She looked back at all the notes she had written when she was jumping. It reminded her of all the fun she had had that day. She smiled, hugged her notebook tight and went to sleep.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to run and play with her friends. One day, Lily entered a race at her school. She ran as fast as she could and won a huge trophy! Lily was so happy that she smiled from ear to ear. She showed her trophy to everyone she met and they all smiled too. From that day on, Lily felt proud of herself and kept her trophy on her shelf to remind her of her big win.

Once upon a time, there was a wide forest. It was full of mystery. Every day, the animals explored the mysterious forest.

One day, the animals saw something special. It was a shiny door. It was so bright and sparkly! The animals wondered what was behind the door.

They opened the door slowly and saw a room. Inside the room were thousands of bright, colourful balls. It was amazing!

The animals welcomed the balls and began to play together. It was so much fun! They were glad to meet the balls.

The animals played together for hours. When it was time to go, the animals gave their new friends a big hug goodbye. They promised to come back soon.

The animals left the wide forest with a big smile on their faces. They never forgot the amazing mystery they found that day.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play outside. They were very independent and did not need much help from their mom or dad. One day, they decided to go to the forest and look for berries. They took a basket and a map and walked along the path.

"Look, Lily, I found some red berries!" Ben said, pointing to a bush. "They look yummy!"

"Be careful, Ben, some berries are bad for you. They can make you sick or hurt you," Lily said, looking at the map. "We need to find the blue berries. They are good for you and sweet."

They walked some more and found another bush with blue berries. They picked some and put them in the basket. They were very happy and proud of their find.

"Let's go back and show mom and dad our berries. They will be so happy too!" Lily said, holding the basket.

"Good idea, Lily. Maybe they will let us make a pie or a jam with them," Ben said, holding the map.

They walked back to their house and knocked on the door. Mom and dad opened the door and smiled.

"Wow, what do you have there?" mom asked.

"We have blue berries! We found them in the forest. We were very independent and careful," Lily said, displaying the basket.

"That's amazing, Lily and Ben! You are very brave and smart. We are very proud of you," dad said, hugging them.

"Can we make something with the berries?" Ben asked.

"Of course, we can. How about a berry pie for dessert?" mom suggested.

"Yay, berry pie!" Lily and Ben cheered.

They went inside and helped mom make the pie. They had a lot of fun and enjoyed their dessert. They were very happy and independent twins.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom lived in a small house with a little girl named Lily. Tom loved to play with Lily, but he also loved to find shiny things. One day, Tom found a shiny copper coin in the garden.

Tom took the copper coin to Lily and said, "Look, Lily! I found a shiny thing!" Lily looked at the copper coin and smiled. "Wow, Tom! That is very pretty!" she said. Tom was very happy that Lily liked his shiny copper coin.

Later, Tom saw a bird outside. He wanted to play with the bird, so he requested, "Bird, come play with me and Lily!" The bird flew down and played with Tom and Lily. They all had a fun time together. At the end of the day, Tom, Lily, and the bird were tired but happy. They all became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat oatmeal for breakfast every day. One morning, her mom made her oatmeal with some yummy fruits on top. Lily loved it so much that she asked her mom to make it every day.

One day, Lily's little brother came into her room and started being bossy. He wanted to play with her toys, but she didn't want to share. So, Lily decided to test him. She gave him a puzzle to solve and said if he could do it, then he could play with her toys. Her brother tried really hard and finally solved the puzzle. Lily was proud of him and decided to share her toys with him.

From that day on, Lily and her brother played together every day and enjoyed their oatmeal breakfasts together.

Once upon a time there was a dark wolf. He lived in a park by a big pond. Every day he would go for a walk in the park. He would look for a bush so he could take a nap in the shade.

At night the wolf would explore the dark park. He would howl at the moon and listen to its echo. He was so excited to explore the forest at night!

One night while he was out exploring, he heard a noise. He turned around and saw a big dark bear. They stared at each other for a few moments. But suddenly the wolf made a big jump and ran as fast as he could back to the park!

The wolf never returned to the dark forest again. He was content with exploring the park during the day. He knew there was something in the dark forest he didn't want to meet again!

One day, there was a modern boat sailing on the ocean. A 3 year old child was on the boat with their parents. The child saw something in the water, it was a big whale.

The child was excited, and started to run around the boat collecting the whale. The parents were worried that the child would hurt themselves, but the child said “I can do it!”

So the parents let the child try. The child made it to the whale and started to pet it. However, the whale suddenly dived under the water and the child tumbled off the boat.

The parents were scared to see the child fall into the water. They jumped in trying to save the child. But it was too late, the current was too strong and the child was gone.

The parents were devastated, they had lost their beloved child. The whale had taken their child away.

Sarah and Mommy went to a stadium. It was big and unfamiliar. Sarah was feeling uncomfortable.

Mommy said, "Look Sarah! That man is going to watch the game in the stadium."

Sarah looked and saw lots of people. She saw a big field. She couldn't figure out what was going on, but it looked interesting.

Mommy said, "Come on, let's watch the game too!" So Sarah and Mommy found a seat. Sarah was still feeling a bit uncomfortable, but she was still happy to watch the game.

The players ran around the field while Sarah watched. She laughed and clapped when they did something exciting. In the end, the players won the game and Sarah cheered.

She had a great time watching the game and wasn't so uncomfortable anymore.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Mia. She loved to go out to the porch and play in the sun.

One day Mia decided to have a special, sweet treat-- a big, juicy apple. Mia was so excited, she ran to the porch to get the apple. But, as she ran, her slippery feet slipped on the ground and the apple flew away!

Mia was very sad. She waited and waited, hoping to see the apple again. Then, a butterfly appeared! The butterfly led her around the porch, and suddenly Mia saw her apple again!

Mia was so happy. She ran towards the apple and picked it up. She took a big, sweet bite and smiled. Mia enjoyed her sweet treat, and ever since then she has been careful when running on the porch.

Once upon a time, there was a kid named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toys and run around outside. One day, Timmy's mom surprised him with a new toy. "Wow, mom! This is so cool!" Timmy said with a big smile.

Later that day, Timmy went to play with his friends. They were building a tower with blocks. Timmy had an idea and said, "Let's build it taller!" They all worked together and were successful in making the tower even taller.

When Timmy went home, he told his mom about his day. "We built a really tall tower, mom! It was so much fun," he said. His mom was happy to hear about his successful day playing with his friends.

Once upon a time there was a brown golf ball. It wanted a friend to play with it. But every day it just sat by itself. One day a boy called Bob came along and saw the golf ball.

“You look lonely,” said Bob.

The golf ball replied, “Yes, I am very lonely. Will you be my friend?”

Bob smiled and said, “Of course. I would love to be your friend.”

So Bob and the golf ball became friends. They played together every day. They had lots of fun running and chasing each other around the golf course.

The golf ball was so happy to have someone to play with. It was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat. The fat cat lived in a small house. The house had a chimney. One day, the fat cat saw a thin dog. The thin dog looked sad.

The fat cat wanted to help the thin dog. The fat cat said, "Let's add food to your bowl." The thin dog smiled and ate the food. The thin dog felt better. The fat cat and the thin dog became friends.

The fat cat and the thin dog played together. They learned that sharing and helping each other made them happy. The fat cat and the thin dog lived happily ever after. The moral of the story is to be kind and help others.

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play with toys. But they have only one doll. They both want the doll. They start to fight.

"Give me the doll!" Tom says. He pulls the doll's arm.

"No, it is mine!" Anna says. She pulls the doll's leg.

The doll is sad. She does not like to fight. She wants to be with a nice friend.

She sees Ben. Ben is sitting on the floor. He is playing with a car. He is attractive. He has big eyes and curly hair. He smiles a lot.

The doll thinks: "I want to be with Ben. He is attractive and kind. He does not fight."

She makes a plan. She lets go of her arm and leg. She falls to the floor. Tom and Anna do not notice. They keep fighting.

The doll rolls to Ben. She stops near his car. She looks at him. She says: "Hello, I am the doll. Do you want to play with me?"

Ben sees the doll. He is surprised. He says: "Hello, you are the doll. You are pretty. Yes, I want to play with you."

He picks up the doll. He puts her in his car. He drives the car around the room. He makes vroom-vroom sounds.

The doll is happy. She thinks: "I win. I have a new friend. He is attractive and fun. He does not fight."

Tom and Anna stop fighting. They look for the doll. They see her with Ben. They are angry. They say: "Hey, that is our doll! Give her back!"

But Ben says: "No, she is my friend. She likes me. She does not like you. You fight too much."

Tom and Anna are sad. They lose. They have no doll. They have no friend.

They think: "Maybe we should not fight. Maybe we should share. Maybe we should be nice."

John was a young boy who loved to play outside. One day, he went outside and saw the green grass and the blue sky. He started running and jumping around, but then he stumbled and twisted his ankle. He grabbed his ankle, wincing in pain, and then he started to cry. Tears ran down his cheek and he twisted his lips in pain.

His mother came running outside and saw him with his twisted ankle. She checked his ankle and saw it was already swelling. John looked up at his mother and she wiped his tears away with her thumb.

She said, "Don't worry, John. I will take care of it." She got a cold cloth and put it on his swollen ankle. Soon, John stopped crying and the pain began to lessen. He smiled at his mother and said, "Thank you."

His mother smiled back and said, "Now let's get you inside for a rest!" John thanked his mother and he found that he could walk without any pain. He waved goodbye to the green grass and the blue sky as he returned inside with his mother.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who was very quiet. He loved to sit on the bench outside and listen to the birds chirping happily. He never made any noise or said a word, but he always seemed to manage to have a good time.

One day he decided to go for a walk and he found a noisy playground full of children playing. The boy was overwhelmed by the sound of all the children laughing and shouting. He didn't know what to do at first, but he decided to stay and watch.

He managed to stay quiet while the other children played, but eventually he got bored. He started to make a little noise and he soon found himself playing with the other kids. He had so much fun that he didn't want to go home, but eventually it was time.

The little boy waved goodbye to all his new friends, and then he started walking home. He was still a bit noisy on the way, but he managed to get back to his house in time for dinner.

He knew he had managed to make some friends and share a fun day, and he was very proud of himself!

John was a very smart 3 year old. He had an idea - he wanted to organize a hospital!

So, one day, he grabbed his wagon and went to the store to buy some supplies. He put band-aids, medicine and crayons in the wagon.

John's mom was nearby and saw what he was doing. She asked, "What are you doing, John?"

"I'm organizing a hospital!", he said proudly.

His mom smiled. She was so proud of him. She said, "You are so smart, John. I can't wait to see your hospital!"

So, John went home and set up a hospital in his room. He made signs and put them on his walls. He was very proud of his hospital.

John invited all of his stuffed animals to come and be patients at his hospital. He took care of each of them and made sure they all felt better.

John had organized a smart hospital, and he was proud of it!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved eating pizza more than anything else in the world. One day, Timmy's mom made him a pizza with all his favorite toppings.

Timmy took a big bite of the pizza but accidentally burned his tongue. "Ouch!" he cried. His mom told him to be patient and that his tongue would heal soon.

Later that day, Timmy went to play with his friend Billy. Billy was very thoughtful and asked Timmy how he was feeling. Timmy told him about his burned tongue and Billy suggested they play a game that didn't involve talking.

They played hide and seek and had so much fun that Timmy forgot all about his burned tongue. When he got home, he realized his tongue had healed and he could enjoy pizza again. Timmy was grateful for his thoughtful friend and the fun they had together.

Once upon a time, there lived a green mole. He lived in a grassy hill and would often spin around in circles.

One day, he heard a loud sound coming from beyond his hill. Curious, the mole decided to investigate.

The mole dug and dug until he reached the end of the hill. To his surprise, he saw a spinning wheel! He was amazed by its beauty, so he jumped onto the wheel and began to spin.

The wheel spun faster and faster, until the mole began to spin so quickly that he was a blur. He kept spinning until suddenly the wheel came to a stop.

When the wheel stopped, the mole saw a bright, shiny object in the center of the wheel. He carefully stepped off the wheel and nudged the object with his nose.

He realized that it was a magical coin! He had found a treasure that would bring him luck for the rest of his days!

Once upon a time there was an ostrich named Sam. He was fit and active and he loved to run. He ran every day around the farm, and the other animals would cheer him on.

One day, Sam was running faster and harder than ever before. He went faster than he meant to and tripped over a rock. He hurt his foot and couldn't run anymore. Sam cried and said, "My foot hurts, who will fix it for me?"

Just then, an elephant came walking by. He said to Sam, "I know how to fix your foot. I can make it strong again. Would you like me to try?" Sam nodded his head yes and the elephant said, "Let me get to work!"

The elephant got some herbs from the farmer and put them on Sam's foot. He rubbed them in and said, "Now your foot should feel fit in no time!" And sure enough, it did! Sam thanked the elephant and said, "Now I can run again!" The elephant smiled and said, "You're welcome!"

Sam was quite happy, and ran around the farm as fast as ever. He always remembered to thank the elephant for fixing him, and he still runs around the farm everyday with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a quiet lawn. The lawn belonged to Bob and he was very proud of it.

One day, a 3 year old girl called Milly saw the lawn and wanted to play. Bob smiled at her and said, "This lawn belongs to me. You are welcome to play here."

Milly squealed with joy and ran around the lawn, playing on the grass. Bob watched proudly as she chased butterflies and laughed with delight.

Then, slowly, Milly started to pick some of the flowers from Bob's lawn. Bob got angry and shouted, "No! My lawn does not belong to you!"

Milly was startled and started to cry. She ran away, never to be seen again.

From then on, Bob was sad and he never smiled again. He had always been a friendly person, but this experience taught him that he had to be careful about who he let play on his lawn. He had learned his lesson too late.

Once there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was three years old and very happy. Every day, Sally liked to dance. She would put on different shoes and spin around the room. One day, she noticed her thumb twirling around in circles. The thumb was so funny, she couldn't help but smile. She held up her thumb and danced.

Sally's mommy was watching and clapping for her. She told Sally that dancing was healthy for her. She said it made her happy, and when she was happy it made her feel better!

Sally couldn't believe it! She was so excited that she danced even faster. She twirled her thumb and spun around in circles. She laughed and giggled and smiled the whole time.

The next day, Sally put on her special shoes and danced around the living room again. She twirled her thumb around while she did all sorts of silly dances. She felt so happy and healthy and she knew it was because of her dancing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, Lucy went to the park to have fun.

As she played, she heard a small sound. "Meow, meow!" Lucy looked around and saw a new kitten. The kitten was very small and cute. Lucy wanted to help the kitten. She picked it up and gave it a big hug.

Lucy and the kitten played all day. They ran, jumped, and laughed. Lucy was so happy to discover her new friend. They had a great time together. From that day on, Lucy and the kitten were best friends.

Once there was a duck who loved solving mysteries. Everywhere she went, she tried to figure out answers to questions. But one day, she came up against a puzzling problem that she couldn't seem to solve.

The duck went to ask her friend, the clever owl, for help. "This problem seems impossible to solve," she said, honestly. "Can you help me with it?"

The wise owl sighed. "That's easy," he said. "The key is to be honest with yourself and your friends. Honesty is the best way to solve any problem. And that's the secret to solving this one, too.

The duck understood and thanked the owl for his wisdom. After that, she was able to solve her problem with the power of honesty. From then on, she made sure to use her new knowledge whenever a problem arose.

The moral of this story is to be honest with yourself and others, as it is the best way to solve problems.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was very brave and liked to explore. One day, Sarah decided to go on an adventure. She looked around and saw a big box in the corner. She wanted to see what was inside, so she opened the box. Inside the box was a powder that was very sparkly and colorful. Sarah was excited and decided to touch the powder. But when she touched it, she got a scary surprise. Suddenly a big monster appeared! Sarah was very scared and wanted to run away. She quickly closed her eyes and wished for the monster to go away. When she opened her eyes, the monster was gone. Sarah was so relieved, but she was also brave! She went back to the box and looked inside. She was happy to see that the powder was still there - she grabbed some to take home with her. Sarah was so proud of herself for being so brave and going on an adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine, but sometimes it would rain. When it rained, she would get sad and angry because she couldn't play outside.

One day, Lily made a wish that it would never rain again. But then she thought about all the plants and flowers that needed the rain to grow. She realized that her wish was not very nice and she felt bad.

Lily learned that sometimes things happen that we don't like, but they are important for other things to grow and be happy. So, she decided to be happy even when it rained and she found fun things to do inside. And she was never angry again. The end.

Once there was a rabbit named Jack. Jack was very happy living in the woods. Every day he would eat some delicious carrots that he found in the garden.

But one day something changed. There was a big, rough badger who moved into the woods. The badger was always very mean to Jack. He would take Jack's carrots and never said please or thank you.

Jack felt very sad but he didn't know what to do. He thought about it for a very long time.

Finally, Jack decided to be brave. He decided to quit running and face the badger. He stood tall and said, "you don't have to take my carrots, please and thank you".

The badger was very surprised. He did not expect Jack to be so brave. From then on the badger stopped taking Jack's carrots.

Jack was very proud of himself. Now he could eat his carrots without worrying. Life in the woods was peaceful and happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and act like a princess. One day, her mommy gave her a test to see how much she knew. Lily was so happy to take the test and show her mommy what she could do.

The test was about being flexible and bending her body like a gymnast. Lily tried her best and was so proud of herself. She acted like a monkey and a snake, twisting and turning her body in all sorts of ways.

After the test, Lily's mommy gave her a big hug and told her she did a great job. Lily was so happy and felt like a flexible princess. From that day on, she knew she could do anything if she tried her best and acted like a brave princess.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she wore her favorite pink dress and went to the park to play.

As she was running, she stumbled and fell down. But she got up quickly and continued playing. She saw some noisy birds flying around and tried to catch them.

After playing for some time, Lily got tired and decided to go home. Her mom was waiting for her with a surprise. She had made pink cupcakes for Lily. Lily was so happy and enjoyed eating the delicious cupcakes with her mom.

From that day on, Lily always wore her pink dress to the park and had lots of fun playing with her friends. And whenever she stumbled, she got up and kept going, just like the noisy birds flying in the sky.

Once upon a time, there was a poor little fish. The fish lived in a net with many other fish. They swam around all day and played games. One day, a big fisherman came and caught the net with the poor fish inside.

The fisherman took the net to a store where he put the fish on display. All the people who walked by could see the poor fish. The fish was sad and missed its friends.

But then, a kind girl came to the store. She saw the poor fish and felt sorry for it. She bought the fish and took it home to her fish tank. The fish was so happy to have a new home and friends to play with.

Once upon a time there were two brother mice called George and Max. George was a very friendly mouse and he never got scared of anything. But Max was different. He was very shy and always afraid of even the smallest things.

One day, George and Max were running around the house when suddenly Max slipped and fell down onto the bed. He wasn't hurt but he was very surprised. He had never been on the bed before and he thought it was very high up.

George smiled and said, “don’t be afraid Max, the bed isn’t so mighty. You just need to be careful and watch where you’re going.”

Max looked at George and nodded his head. He realised that being brave was sometimes the best way to deal with life’s challenges.

The moral of the story is that courage is always better than fear. No matter how big or mighty something seems, it’s always better to face it with courage than to run away from it in fear.

Once upon a time, there lived an old man by the ocean. Every day, he would take a boat out to sea and stare curiously at the horizon.

One day, it happened to be the most beautiful day yet - the sky was a brilliant blue and the sun shone in all its glory. As the old man gazed out across the endless ocean, he saw a graceful ship coming his way.

He quickly grabbed his binoculars and called out to the ship, "Ahoy! What brings you here?"

The ship slowly pulled up alongside the old man's boat, and a voice boomed out, "We are here to pour some grace on the ocean".

The old man was confused - why would they be pouring grace on the ocean? He watched with awe as the crew on the ship began to pour sparkling liquid into the ocean, making the waters glimmer and shine brightly.

The old man smiled. What a wonderful sight! He thanked the crew for their kind efforts, and he knew that his boat was now surrounded by grace - so much it was spilling over into the ocean of the world.

The old man waved goodbye and set sail back to shore with a feeling of contentment.

Once upon a time there was a sweet little girl. She was so young and always full of joy. Every morning she would wake up and feel the mild sunlight come in through her window. She always felt so happy when she woke up to the new day.

One morning when the girl woke up, she could smell something delicious coming from the kitchen. She hopped out of bed and hurried downstairs. When she got there she saw her mommy and daddy making pancakes! The little girl was so excited she couldn't wait to eat the yummy breakfast.

After the girl ate, she asked her mommy if she could go play in the garden. Her mom said yes, so off she went. She could feel the soft grass with her bare feet and smelled the flowers. She ran around and laughed and even found a caterpillar which she quickly named Spotty.

Eventually the sun started to set and it was time for the little girl to go back inside. She kissed Spotty goodbye and said “See you again soon!” She put on her pyjamas and went off to bed, happy that she had such a mild and wonderful day.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys and sing songs. One day, Lily finds a flute in her room. She blows on it and makes a loud noise.

"Look, Ben, I have a flute!" Lily says. "Do you want to play with me?"

Ben shakes his head. He does not like the flute. He thinks it is too noisy and hurts his ears.

"No, thank you, Lily. I do not want to play with the flute. I want to play with the blocks. They are quiet and fun. You can make a house or a tower with them."

Lily disagrees with Ben. She thinks the flute is fun and pretty. She likes the sound it makes. She thinks the blocks are boring and dull.

"No, Ben, the flute is better than the blocks. The blocks are crazy. They do not make any sound or color. You can only make the same things with them. The flute is different. You can make many sounds and songs with it."

Lily and Ben argue about the flute and the blocks. They raise their voices and frown at each other. They are not happy. They are not friends anymore.

Then, Mom comes in. She hears the noise and sees the faces. She is not happy either.

"What is going on here?" Mom asks. "Why are you fighting? Why are you not sharing?"

Lily and Ben tell Mom their reasons. They both think they are right and the other is wrong. They do not listen to each other.

Mom sighs. She picks up the flute and the blocks. She puts them on the table.

"Listen, Lily and Ben. You are both wrong and you are both right. The flute and the blocks are both good toys. They are both fun and creative. They are not crazy. They are different. And that is okay. You do not have to like the same things. You do not have to play with the same things. But you have to respect each other. You have to be kind and polite. You have to share and take turns. That is how you can be friends. Do you understand?"

Lily and Ben nod. They understand. They are sorry. They say sorry to each other. They hug and smile. They are happy. They are friends again.

They decide to play with both the flute and the blocks. They take turns and listen to each other. They make sounds and songs and houses and towers. They have fun. They thank Mom. Mom is happy too. She is proud of them. She loves them.

Once upon a time, there was a big, big, enormous bear. He lived in a cozy cave in the forest. Every morning, the bear would wake up and go outside to play. But after a while, he would get very sleepy and need to take a nap.

One day, a little rabbit came to visit the bear. The bear was so happy to have a friend to play with! They ran and jumped and had so much fun. But soon, the bear started to yawn and knew it was time for his nap.

The rabbit didn't want to leave the bear alone, so he curled up next to him and they both took a nap together. When they woke up, the sun was setting and it was time for the rabbit to go home. The bear was sad to see his friend go, but he was happy that he had such a fun morning and a good nap.

Mum and Dad took Jessie to the park. Jessie was so excited! She ran around in circles and laughed.

Mum said to her, “Why don’t we get something delicious to eat, Jessie?”

Jessie nodded and said, “Cake!”

Mum smiled. “Not yet, Jessie. Look up ahead. See the big circle?”

Jessie squinted, and saw a huge round sandpit at the end of the park. “What’s that?”

“It’s a sandpit. Let’s go check it out.”

Jessie held on tight as Mum and Dad led her closer. When they reached the sandpit, Jessie could see that it was filled with delicious chocolate cake!

“It’s cake!” Jessie shouted.

Mum said, “Yes! It’s a surprise. Let’s dig in.”

Jessie carefully stuck her fingers into the soft cake. It was delicious. She and her parents laughed and ate until their tummies were full and all the cake was gone. The park had been so much fun!

“That was the best end of the day ever!” Jessie said, happily.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy lived in a big house with his mommy and daddy. They were very rich and had lots of toys for Timmy to play with.

One day, Timmy went to the park to play with his friends. They decided to have a race to see who was the fastest. Timmy ran as fast as he could, but he didn't win. His friend Johnny won instead.

Timmy felt sad, but Johnny came up to him and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. You did a great job. The result doesn't matter, it's all about having fun." Timmy smiled and nodded his head. He realized that Johnny was right and that he had fun anyway.

Ben and Lily were twins who shared a room. They liked to play with their toys and read books before they went to sleep. But one night, there was a big storm outside. The wind made loud noises and the rain hit the window. Ben and Lily felt scared.

"Ben, I don't like the storm. It's scary," Lily said, hugging her teddy bear.

"Me neither, Lily. But don't worry, we have each other. And Mom and Dad are in the next room. They will keep us safe," Ben said, holding his dinosaur.

They tried to close their eyes and sleep, but they could not. They heard a drip-drip-drip sound from the ceiling. They looked up and saw a wet spot. There was a leak in the roof!

"Ben, look! There's water coming from the roof! What if it falls on us?" Lily said, pointing at the leak.

"Oh no, Lily! That's not good. We have to tell Mom and Dad. Maybe they can fix it," Ben said, getting out of bed.

They ran to their parents' room and knocked on the door. Mom and Dad opened it and saw their scared faces.

"Mom, Dad, there's a leak in our room! Water is dripping from the ceiling! Can you help us?" Ben and Lily said together.

Mom and Dad hugged them and said, "Oh, you poor things. We're sorry you're scared. We didn't know there was a leak. Come on, let's go see what we can do."

They followed Mom and Dad to their room. Dad got a bucket and a towel and put them under the leak. He said, "This will catch the water for now. Tomorrow, I'll call someone to fix the roof. Don't worry, it won't hurt you."

Mom said, "Why don't you sleep with us tonight? We have a big bed and plenty of blankets. You'll be warm and cozy and safe."

Ben and Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Mom and Dad. We love you."

They climbed into the big bed and snuggled with Mom and Dad. They felt better and less scared. They listened to Mom and Dad's soft voices and gentle breathing. They closed their eyes and fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was very shy. He was far too scared to make friends or talk to people very much. Everywhere he went, he hid in his closet to feel safe.

One day, he heard a noise coming from outside his closet. He opened the door slowly and peeked out to see what it was. It was a girl! She was sitting by the window and crying so loudly.

The boy was so scared, he quickly shut the closet door. But as he did, he heard the girl cry out, "Why won't anyone be my friend?"

The little boy was so sad that he started to weep. He felt so sorry for the girl and wished he could help her. But he was so shy, he just stayed in his closet and kept crying.

Then, he had an idea. He opened up the closet door, stepped out and walked up to the girl. With all his courage, he said "I'll be your friend!"

The girl quickly stopped crying and smiled. Now the boy and the girl were the best of friends. Whenever the girl felt scared and lonely, the boy would always be there to cheer her up and make her feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a long pumpkin. The pumpkin was so long that it reached the sky. One day, a little girl walked by and saw the long pumpkin. She said, "Wow, that pumpkin is so long!"

Suddenly, a naughty boy came and disturbed the pumpkin. The little girl said, "Hey, why did you do that? You shouldn't disturb things that don't belong to you."

The naughty boy said sorry and walked away. The little girl felt happy that the pumpkin was safe. She learned that it's important to respect other people's things and not disturb them. The end.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl called Amy. She was only three years old and lived in a small cottage.

One day, Amy was playing in the garden of her cottage. Suddenly, she saw a pile of grey ash. She felt a bit scared and curious at the same time. She decided to go near it to explore.

When Amy got close, she heard a voice coming from the ash. It said, "Help me." It was a magical fairy called Sam. She had an accident and now she was stuck in the ash. She looked very hurt.

Amy was determined to help the fairy. She smiled and said, "Sam, don't worry. I will make sure you improve."

Amy started clapping her hands and singing a magical song. Immediately, the ash started to sparkle and the fairy was freed.

Amy was happy that she helped her new friend. The fairy hugged Amy and said, "Thank you for helping me. You make me feel much better."

The two became good friends. They hugged and laughed together, and enjoyed each other's company.

Ben and Mia liked to play outside in the sun. They had sunglasses to keep their eyes safe. They also had ice cream cones to keep them cool. Ben had chocolate ice cream and Mia had vanilla ice cream.

They ran around the yard, playing tag and hide and seek. They were fast and happy. They did not see that their ice cream was melting. The sun was very hot and made the ice cream drip. Soon, their cones were empty and their hands were sticky.

They went to the porch to get some napkins. They saw their mom sitting on a chair. She was reading a book and wearing sunglasses too. She smiled at them and said, "Did you have fun?"

Ben and Mia nodded. They wiped their hands and faces. Then they noticed something. Their mom's sunglasses were not on her nose. They were on her book. And they were melting too! The sun had made the plastic soft and bendy.

Ben and Mia gasped. They ran to their mom and showed her. She looked surprised and laughed. She said, "Oh no, my sunglasses are melting! Thank you for telling me. I guess they are not very good for the sun."

She took them off her book and threw them in the trash. Then she hugged Ben and Mia and said, "Let's go inside and get some water. And maybe some new sunglasses."

Timmy was impatient. He wanted to go to the bathroom. He ran around and around, smiling the whole way.

Finally, Mommy saw him. She laughed and picked him up. She took him to the bathroom.

Timmy was so excited. He smiled and pointed to the toilet. He wanted to go.

Mommy smiled, too. She helped Timmy climb onto the toilet. He was so proud.

When he was done, Mommy helped him wash his hands. After that, they both smiled. Timmy felt like the happiest little kid in the world.

Once upon a time there was a little puppy named Fluffy. Fluffy had the softest fur in the whole world. Fluffy was so happy and loved to play all the time.

One day, Fluffy went to a picnic with his family. Fluffy saw a big bowl filled with pasta. He was so excited and couldn't wait to eat some. He bit into the delicious pasta and it was so soft and yummy.

After eating so much pasta, Fluffy was filled with happiness. He ran and jumped around, feeling more energized than ever.

Fluffy's family was very happy to see him so full of joy. They all enjoyed the picnic and ate all the pasta. Fluffy was so thankful for having such a wonderful day.

Once upon a time there was a boy who had a sailboat. He wanted to sail around the world so he made a plan. He sailed in the summer season when the wind was nice and the sun was hot. But the summer season ended and he had to go back home.

When he came back, the weather was bad. The wind blew hard and the water was cold. The boy didn't want to sail in such bad weather. But he wanted to keep his plan going so he decided to keep sailing.

He waited all day for the bad weather to end. Finally, the sun came out and the wind stopped blowing. The boy was so happy he shouted for joy and jumped into his sailboat. The boy had a wonderful sail and he kept his plan going. He was so proud, he was going to sail around the world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat dinner with her family every night. One day, her mom made her favorite food, spaghetti with meatballs. It smelled so delicious that Lily's tummy started to growl.

As they were eating, Lily accidentally dropped her fork on the floor. She tried to pick it up, but it was too slippery. Suddenly, her brother came over and tried to grab it, but he accidentally stepped on it and it snapped in half.

Lily was sad because she loved that fork, but her mom told her not to worry. She gave her a new fork and said that dinner was still delicious, even without the old fork. From that day on, Lily learned that accidents happen, but it's important to enjoy the good things in life, like a yummy dinner with her family.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his ball. One day, Timmy's ball got stuck under a bridge. He couldn't reach it. Timmy felt sad.

Then, Timmy saw his friend Billy. "Hi, Billy!" Timmy said. "Can you help me get my ball?"

Billy said, "Sure, Timmy! I can throw your ball to you!"

Billy threw the ball to Timmy and Timmy caught it. "Thank you, Billy!" Timmy said. "You're the best!"

Timmy's ball was wet from the water under the bridge. But Billy said, "Don't worry, Timmy! We can dry it off!" And they did. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an old aunt who lived by herself. One day, she was walking through the park when she stumbled and fell. Even though she was old, she was strong and she picked herself back up. She kept on walking until she came to a pond. There she saw a beautiful flower. She decided to bend down and pick it up, but when she did, she stumbled again! This time, the flower flew out of her hand and landed in the pond. She only had a few moments to look at it before it was gone. But she had a big smile on her face as she continued walking around the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to have fun. She liked to play with her toys and run around in the park with her friends. One day, she saw a shiny, attractive toy in the store window. She wanted it so much, but her mommy said they couldn't buy it right now.

Lily felt sad and sighed, but her mommy told her to be patient. She said they could save up some money and buy the toy later. Lily didn't understand what "save up" meant, but she trusted her mommy.

Days passed and her mommy gave her some coins to put in her piggy bank. Lily was excited and put them in right away. She knew that when she had enough money, she could buy the toy she wanted so much. Finally, the day came when she had enough money. She ran to the store with her mommy and bought the toy.

Lily was so happy and had so much fun playing with her new toy. She realized that sometimes, waiting for something can be worth it. She hugged her mommy and said, "Thank you for teaching me to save up. I'm so happy now!"

Once upon a time there was a big blackboard in a classroom. It was so big that it almost reached the ceiling! The teacher had been writing on the blackboard all morning when something amazing happened. The blackboard started to talk! The teacher was very surprised and told the students to mind the blackboard.

The students were very excited and listened carefully. The blackboard said, "I am here to teach you something very special. I will tell you all a story that will help you to understand things better". The students were all eager to learn what the blackboard had to say.

The blackboard started to tell a story about a small bird that had a very big heart. The bird wanted to help all the other birds in the forest and make them happy. The blackboard said, "Remember the bird and the big heart. Always put your own big heart first and help others".

At the end of the story, the teacher smiled and thanked the blackboard for the lesson. The students all said that they had learned something very important and thanked the blackboard too. The blackboard waved goodbye and disappeared.

From that day on, the students always remembered to mind their own big hearts and to help others. It was a lesson that they would never forget!

One night, a naughty fox was walking in the woods. He wanted to steal something, but he couldn't find anything to take. Then all of a sudden, he saw a long wire coiled up in a corner.

The fox got excited and he asked the wire, "Do you want to come with me?" The wire was very quiet and did not answer the fox.

The fox was a bit confused, but he decided to take the wire anyway. He snatched it up and started to run.

But suddenly, he felt something tugging at him. He looked around and saw that the wire was trying to run away! The fox started to chase the wire, but it was too fast and disappeared in the dense forest.

The naughty fox was annoyed, but he did not give up. He started looking for the wire again and soon, he found it! The fox was delighted, so he quickly grabbed the long wire and ran away with it.

From that day on, the naughty fox was careful when he tried to steal something. He made sure to ask if the object wanted to come with him before he snatched it up!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Ellie. Ellie was adventurous and she loved exploring new places. One day, she went to the park. When she arrived, she saw a rabbit with a big, white nose.

“Come and join me," said the rabbit.

Ellie was so excited! She followed the rabbit and they began to explore the park together. They saw many new and exciting things; Ellie loved it!

As it started to get dark, the rabbit said goodbye to Ellie.

“Thank you for joining me today,” said the rabbit.

“Thank you,” said Ellie with a smile.

Then they said goodbye and went their separate ways. Ellie had had an adventurous day with her new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One sunny day, she went to the park with her mommy. They sat down on a bench near a pond. Lily saw some ducks swimming in the water and she wanted to play with them.

"Mommy, can I go play with the ducks?" asked Lily.

"No, sweetie. You can't swim. The water is too deep and you might get hurt," replied her mommy.

Lily felt envious of the ducks because they could swim in the water. Suddenly, she saw a small stick on the ground and picked it up. She split the water with the stick and pretended she was swimming like the ducks. Her mommy smiled and said, "You're so creative, Lily."

Once upon a time, there were two best friends; one was a pig called Percy and the other was a rabbit called Ralph. They loved playing in the garden together. One day, they decided to do something special.

So, they ran around the garden together, covering all sorts of things with leaves. Percy made a leafy blanket and Ralph covered the garden stool with them. They had so much fun!

Then, Ralph hopped to the pond and noticed that it was getting a bit filthy. He wanted to find a way to clean it. Suddenly, he remembered an old bucket he had seen in the shed earlier. He quickly hopped to the shed, grabbed the bucket and went back to the pond. Together with Percy, they covered the pond with water from the bucket. They kept doing this until the pond was clean again.

By the time they were done, the sun was setting and it was time for them to go home. The two friends were very proud of their hard work and had a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Benny and his friends decided to dig a hole in the ground. They dug and dug until they found something very exciting. It was a secret underground tunnel!

Benny's friend, Timmy, said, "Let's explore the tunnel!" But Benny was scared. He said, "I don't want to go. It's too dark and scary down there."

Timmy said, "Don't be a scaredy-cat. It will be fun!" But Benny still didn't want to go. He said, "I quit. I'm going home." Benny felt sad that he couldn't be brave like his friend.

Later that day, Benny went to the store to buy some carrots. He saw a sign that said, "Cheap carrots for sale!" Benny was happy because he could buy lots of carrots with his little bit of money. He felt proud that he could be smart and save his money.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, she saw a big tree and felt happy because it was so pretty. She ran to the tree and hugged it tightly.

But then, she saw some apples on the ground that looked spoiled. They were brown and mushy. Lily felt sad because she loved apples and wanted to eat them. She decided to pick them up and throw them away so nobody would get sick.

After that, Lily felt better and continued playing with her friends. They ran around the tree and played hide-and-seek. Lily felt grateful for the tree that provided shade and fun. She promised to take care of it and never let anyone spoil it. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly man who lived at the foot of a volcano. Every morning, the man would get up and drink from the clear spring at the top of the mountain. One day, he decided to take the risk and climb to the peak of the volcano.

When he arrived, he saw a beautiful pool of bubbling water. He was so amazed that he decided to take a drink from it. "This water is so refreshing," the elderly man said.

Just then, he heard a deep rumble coming from within the volcano. The man quickly jumped into the pool and watched as molten lava began to fill the volcano's crater. He swam to the top of the pool and looked around.

Just then, an elderly lady appeared. "These waters are magical," she said. "Come, drink from them and be blessed with eternal youth."

The man was hesitant at first, but then he took a sip and was filled with strength and joy. The elderly lady smiled and vanished, leaving the man to enjoy the beauty of the volcano forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She liked to play with her toys and have fun with her friends. One day, Amy's mom gave her a special wrap for her lunch. It was her favorite: a yummy cheese wrap!

At school, Amy met her friend Tim. Tim was sad because he didn't have any lunch. Amy wanted to help, so she said, "Tim, you can have my wrap!" Tim was very happy and they shared the wrap together. But, when they were playing, Amy accidentally dropped the wrap on the ground. It was dirty and they couldn't eat it anymore. Both Amy and Tim felt hurt.

Amy and Tim went to their teacher and told her what happened. The teacher said, "It's okay, accidents happen. The important thing is that you tried to help your friend. That's very kind of you, Amy." Then, the teacher gave them both a new wrap to share. They learned that sharing and helping others is a good thing, even if sometimes things don't go as planned.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna who had a special doll. She loved her doll with all her heart and treated her like a real friend.

One day, Anna asked her doll "What do you wish for?"

The doll just stared back.

Anna tried again: "Will you tell me what you wish for?"

Suddenly, the doll's eyes lit up and it said in a polite voice "I wish to explore the world!"

Anna was surprised. She asked "How can you explore the world without leaving this room?"

The doll smiled and revealed its secret plan. "If you give me a balloon, I can fly away! Please help me fulfill my wish!"

Anna was so excited. She hugged the doll and ran outside to find a balloon. Soon she returned with one in her hand and said, "I will help you explore the world and fulfill your wish!"

She tied the balloon to her doll and watched in amazement as it slowly flew away. The doll waved goodbye and shouted with joy "Thank you so much Anna!"

Anna laughed and waved goodbye as the doll flew off towards the horizon.

Jill was sitting in her seat on the porch. She looked up at the sky and it was so blue and beautiful. The sun was shining and the birds were singing. But it was wet too - it had been raining all morning. Now the rain had stopped, but everything was still damp.

Jill wanted to explore, so she stood up and ran out into the garden. She stepped in a puddle and it made her shoes wet and muddy. She saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. She put her hands on the bark and tried, but it was slippery and she couldn't get to the top. So she gave up and went back to her seat.

This time when she looked up at the sky it was different. The sun was coming out and making the sky a bright blue. Jill was happy that the rain had stopped, so she could play outside. She watched the clouds in the sky move and shift. They were so different from before the rain. She watched them until the sun was high in the sky and it was time for lunch.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl who loved to play outside. One day, she was playing in her yard when she stumbled upon a lime. Her eyes sparkled with delight. She carefully picked it up and examined it. It was so pretty and shiny and she couldn't wait to show it off to her friends.

Suddenly, a crow flew down from the sky and snatched the lime out of her hands. The girl screamed and chased the bird, but the bird was too fast and flew away. She was so sad and frustrated that she wanted to cry.

She felt so lost and confused, but then she remembered her mother's words - when you're feeling angry and upset, try to rest. So the brave little girl lay down on the ground and tried to rest.

The girl felt much better after she had rested. She was determined to get her lime back! She got up and started looking around. She eventually spotted the crow and the lime in a nearby tree and kept looking until she found a tall ladder.

Eventually, she grabbed the ladder, climbed all the way up to the top and was able to reach the lime. She snatched the lime and ran back home safely. As she rested that night, she was content and happy that the young girl got her beloved lime back.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and balls. One day, they see a big pile of waste near the park. It has old boxes, cans, papers and clothes. Tom and Sam think it looks fun. They want to join the waste and make a fort.

They run to the waste and start to pick up things. They put boxes on top of each other. They use cans and papers to make windows and doors. They find a big cloth and make a roof. They are happy. They have a strong fort.

But then, they hear a loud noise. It is a big truck. It comes to take the waste away. Tom and Sam are scared. They do not want to lose their fort. They do not want to go with the waste. They run out of the fort and hide behind a tree.

The truck driver does not see them. He sees the fort. He thinks it is part of the waste. He uses a big claw to grab the fort and put it in the truck. He drives away with the waste.

Tom and Sam are sad. They cry. They lost their fort. They wish they did not join the waste. They wish they played with their cars and balls instead. They learn a lesson. They say sorry to the park and the earth. They promise to not join the waste again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, while helping her mom, she accidentally dropped a plate and it broke into many pieces. Her mom was upset but she didn't scold Lily. Instead, she told her that accidents happen and it's important to be careful.

A few days later, Lily was helping her mom load the dishwasher. She was so excited to help that she wasn't paying attention and dropped a dish. This time, the dishwasher broke and water spilled all over the floor. Lily's mom was upset but she didn't scold her again. She simply reminded her to be alert and pay attention to what she was doing.

Lily felt bad for what happened and told her mom that she was sorry. Her mom hugged her and told her that it's okay to make mistakes as long as we learn from them. The moral of the story is that accidents happen and it's important to be careful and alert so we don't lose or break things.

One day, Sarah and her best friend, Jack, were playing in the park. Sarah was a very obedient girl and always listened to her mom. All of a sudden, Sarah started to joke around with Jack. She made his cheeks go pink!

Jack liked the way it felt and started to joke, too. They both laughed until they couldn't stop.

Pretty soon, they had a lot of fun together and they felt like they had a special power. They felt like they could do anything!

Sarah and Jack kept joking until the sun went down and it was time to go home. They were both very obedient and said goodbye to each other. Sarah was sure that she and Jack would have lots more fun in the future.

The little girl opened the box and was so excited to unpack it. Inside was a wide variety of animals! She pulled out a bright yellow duck and held it in her hands. Next, she uncovered an orange and black striped cat. She couldn't take her eyes away! At last, she saw a white and brown spotted cow. It looked so friendly!

The little girl was thrilled as she held each of the animals. She cuddled them and whispered sweet words. She was so happy to have her new animal friends to play with. She couldn't help but smile as she watched them jump and run around her room.

The little girl was so excited and she thanked her parents. She hugged them tightly with a big smile on her face. She was so happy and content to have these wonderful animals in her life. She would never forget her experience of unpacking the box full of wide and beautiful animals.

Once upon a time there was a little kid called Timmy. He was three years old and he loved learning new things. Timmy's mum always reminded him to be careful when he was playing outside. But sometimes Timmy didn't listen.

One day, Timmy was playing outside and he found a new whip. He backed away from it, remembering what his mum had said. But he was curious and he wanted to try the whip. He picked it up and started to swing it around.

Suddenly, there was a loud noise. Timmy was so scared! He had broken a window in his garden and he was really worried. He ran inside and hugged his mum, telling her what had happened. His mum wasn't angry. She reminded him that he should always listen to her and be careful when he's outside.

Timmy apologised and promised that he would be more careful next time. He also thanked his mum for reminding him to be careful.

From then on, Timmy was very careful in the garden and remembered to do exactly as his mum said. He was very happy and the new whip was part of his favourite game.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was playing with his toys when he fell and hurt his knee. His mommy saw him crying and called the nurse. The nurse came and put a bandage on Timmy's knee.

"Thank you, nurse," said Timmy.

"You're welcome, Timmy. Be careful not to hurt yourself again," said the nurse.

"I will mind my steps," said Timmy.

After the nurse left, Timmy's mommy made him a rare treat - a chocolate cake. Timmy was so happy and said, "Mommy, you make the best cake ever!"

"I'm glad you like it, Timmy," said his mommy with a smile.

Timmy enjoyed his cake and played with his toys until it was time for bed. He fell asleep with a smile on his face, happy that he had such a caring mommy and nurse.

Lily and Ben like to watch films on the large TV. They sit on the sofa with their snacks and blankets and choose a film. Today they want to watch a film about animals.

"Look, Ben, there is a lion!" Lily says, pointing at the screen. "He is very large and has a big mane. He can roar very loud."

"Yes, he is the king of the animals," Ben says. "But I like the monkey better. He is funny and can swing on the trees. He can also make funny faces."

They watch the film and laugh and learn about the animals. They see elephants, giraffes, zebras, and more. They also see a bird that can talk.

"Hello, hello, I am a parrot," the bird says on the film. "I can call your name. What is your name?"

Lily and Ben are surprised and excited. They want to talk to the bird.

"My name is Lily," Lily says to the TV.

"My name is Ben," Ben says to the TV.

The bird repeats their names and says hello again. Lily and Ben clap and giggle.

"Wow, he can call our names!" Lily says. "He is very smart and colorful. I wish we had a parrot like him."

"Me too," Ben says. "Maybe we can ask mom and dad if we can get one."

They finish the film and hug each other. They had a lot of fun watching the film about animals. They hope they can watch another one soon.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to add things together. One day she found a pot full of sugar and she decided to add it to her tea.

The little girl stirred the tea with a spoon and it started to look really yummy. She kept stirring and added some more sugar until it was just perfect. She smiled as she saw how cute the tea looked.

Then she took a sip and it was sweet, just like she wanted. She took another sip and added a big spoonful of sugar. The tea was so delicious!

The little girl smiled, happy that she was able to make her tea so tasty. From then on she always added sugar to her tea and it was always the sweetest.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly boy named Jack. He loved to go to the park and play. One day, he saw something special in the park. It was a big pile of wood. Jack was so excited and he ran to it. He hugged the wood and said, "This is so special, I want to take it home!"

Jack's mom and dad saw how much he valued the big pile of wood. So, they said it was okay for him to take it home. Jack was so happy and he took the wood home on his back.

When they got home, they set the wood in the backyard. Jack played with the wood all day long, building different structures and imagining he was in a house made of wood. Jack had so much fun.

Every day, Jack would play with the wood, and he learned to value it more and more. The wood made Jack so jolly and his mom and dad were so happy to see him having fun.

Jack learned that although the wood was simple, it could make him so happy if he just valued it.

One day, a polite boy named Tim went for a walk in the woods. He saw a crystal on the ground. It was shiny and pretty. He picked it up and smiled. Tim wanted to show it to his friend, Sam.

Tim said to Sam, "Look at my pretty crystal. It is so shiny!" Sam smiled too. He wanted to play with the crystal. But Tim did not want to share. He held the crystal tight.

The sky turned dark and cloudy. Tim and Sam heard a loud noise. They were scared. The crystal fell from Tim's hand and broke. Both boys were sad. Tim wished he had shared the crystal with Sam.

Lila and Ben like to play at the beach. They have a big surf that they can ride on the waves. Lila is strong and can carry the surf by herself. Ben is not so strong, but he is fast and can run to the water.

One day, they see a big rock near the shore. It has sharp edges and looks scary. Lila says, "Let's stay away from that rock. It can cut us if we touch it." Ben says, "OK, but I want to see how close I can get to it. It looks fun."

Lila and Ben take their surf and go to the water. They wait for a big wave and then jump on their surf. They glide on the water and feel happy. But Ben is not careful. He goes too close to the rock and his surf hits it. He falls off and feels a pain in his leg. He looks and sees blood. The rock cut him.

Lila hears Ben cry and goes to help him. She sees his leg and says, "Oh no, Ben, you are hurt. Come, I will take you to Mom and Dad. They will make you better." She helps him get out of the water and carries him to their parents. They put a bandage on his leg and hug him. They say, "You were brave, Ben, but you have to be careful. The rock is dangerous. Next time, listen to Lila and stay away from it."

Ben says, "I'm sorry, Lila. I was silly. I won't go near the rock again. Thank you for helping me. You are a good sister." Lila says, "You're welcome, Ben. I love you. You are a good brother." They smile and hug. They still like to play at the beach, but they never go near the rock again. They have fun with their surf and their friends. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. One day, Timmy's mommy asked him to help her prepare dinner. Timmy was very excited to help. His mommy gave him a knife to cut some vegetables. Timmy was very careful with the knife because he knew it was sharp.

Suddenly, Timmy's mommy realized that they were running late. She told Timmy to rush and finish cutting the vegetables quickly. Timmy tried to cut the vegetables as fast as he could, but he accidentally dropped the knife. It made an unusual sound when it hit the floor.

Timmy's mommy asked him if he was okay and Timmy said yes. They finished preparing dinner together and it was delicious. Timmy felt proud that he helped his mommy and he promised to be more careful with the knife next time.

Once there was a boy who was very scared. He had been left alone in a dark room and couldn't find a way out. He looked around but there were no doors or windows and he didn't know how he was going to get out.

Then right in front of him he spotted an old rusty box. He went up to it and tried to open it but it was locked. He looked around and saw a key on top of a shelf. He grabbed the key, went back to the box and unlocked it.

When he opened the box he found a big surprise inside. It was full of yummy food! The boy was so excited and began eating the food straight away.

He ate so much food that he got so full that he almost popped. Now that he had some food, the boy wasn't so scared anymore. He knew he could eventually find a way out of the dark room.

Bella was a dog who loved to dig. She dug in the yard, in the park, and in the woods. One day, she found a big bone in the dirt. She was very happy and ran to show it to her friend, Milo.

"Look what I found, Milo!" she barked. "A big bone! It is mine!"

Milo was a cat who liked to nap. He opened one eye and looked at the bone. He was not impressed.

"That is not a bone, Bella," he meowed. "That is a stick. A very old and dirty stick. It does not belong to you."

Bella was confused. She sniffed the stick. It smelled like a bone. She licked the stick. It tasted like a bone. She felt the stick. It was hard like a bone.

"How do you know it is not a bone, Milo?" she asked. "Have you seen a bone before?"

Milo nodded. He had seen a bone before. A very special bone. A bone that belonged to a famous dog. A dog who was on TV and in books. A dog who was brave and smart and kind. A dog who was his hero.

"I have seen a bone before, Bella," he said. "A bone that belonged to Lassie. She was a famous dog. She saved many people and animals. She was a good friend. She had a bone with her name on it. It was shiny and pretty. It was not like your stick."

Bella was curious. She wanted to see the bone that belonged to Lassie. She wanted to know more about the famous dog. She wanted to be a good friend too.

"Can you show me the bone that belonged to Lassie, Milo?" she asked. "Can you tell me more about her? Can we be friends like her?"

Milo smiled. He liked Bella. She was fun and sweet and loyal. He wanted to be friends with her too.

"Sure, Bella," he said. "I can show you the bone that belonged to Lassie. I can tell you more about her. We can be friends like her. Come on, follow me."

He got up from his nap and led Bella to his house. There, on a shelf, was the bone that belonged to Lassie. It was shiny and pretty. It had her name on it. Bella was amazed. She looked at the bone, then at Milo, then at the bone again.

"Wow, Milo," she said. "That is a bone. A very special bone. It belongs to Lassie. She was a famous dog. She was a good friend. Just like you."
