At the end of the visit, the girl had made lots of beautiful creations using what only her imagination and intelligence. She showed them off proudly to her mum and dad, who applauded her work.

The girl smiled and said, "Look what I can do!" Her parents clapped with joy and gave her a big hug.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and run around outside. One day, Lily's mommy told her they needed to hurry and go to the store to buy some apples for a pie.

As they were walking to the store, they saw a big building with lots of people going in and out. Lily asked her mommy what it was and her mommy said it was a university where people go to learn lots of things.

Lily was excited to go to the store and get the apples, but on the way back home, they saw a terrible accident. A car had crashed into a tree and there were people hurt. Lily's mommy tried to help, but it was too late. The bad ending made Lily sad and she hugged her mommy tightly.

Barry was troubled. He had a big book and he wanted to put it in the fire. He found the match and tried to light it. His mom saw what he was doing and got very scared. She said, "No, Barry! The book will burn!" Barry shook his head and said, "No, I won't let it!"

Mom took the book away and put it somewhere safe. Barry was sad, but he knew mom was right. He watched sadly as she took the book away.

The next day, Barry was playing with his friends in the park. Suddenly he saw the book tucked away in a corner. He ran over to get it and found that it was still safe. He laughed when he saw that the book hadn't been burned!

Barry thanked his mom for keeping it safe and promised to never try to burn it again. His mom smiled and said, "That's my good boy!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He had a toy magnet that he loved to play with. The magnet was very strong and could stick to metal things like the fridge.

One day, Timmy was playing with his magnet and he found a brilliant shiny coin on the ground. He picked it up and tried to stick it to the magnet, but it wouldn't yield. Timmy was sad because he wanted the coin to stick to his magnet.

But then, Timmy had an idea! He put the magnet on the ground and held the coin above it. The magnet yielded and pulled the coin up to it. Timmy was so happy that he found a way to make the magnet work with the coin. From then on, he played with his brilliant magnet and shiny coin every day. The end.

Lily and Tom were friends who liked to play outside. One day, they found a big tree with many fruits. They wanted to pick some fruits and eat them.

"Look, Tom, these fruits are red and sweet. Let's get some!" Lily said.

"OK, Lily, but we have to be careful. The tree is very high and the fruits are hard to reach. We need a stick or a ladder," Tom said.

They looked around and saw a long stick leaning on a fence. They ran to get it and brought it to the tree. They took turns to use the stick to poke the fruits and make them fall.

They collected many fruits and put them in a basket. They were very happy and hungry. They decided to sit under the tree and enjoy their fruits. The tree gave them shade and made them cool.

"These fruits are so yummy! I'm glad we found them," Lily said.

"Me too, Lily. They are the best fruits ever. Thank you, tree, for giving us your fruits," Tom said.

They ate and ate until they were full. They still had some fruits left in the basket. They wondered what to do with them.

"Tom, what should we do with these fruits? We can't eat them all. They will spoil if we leave them here," Lily said.

"Lily, I have an idea. Why don't we share them with our friends? They will be happy to have some fruits too. And we can play with them and have more fun," Tom said.

"That's a great idea, Tom. Sharing is caring. Let's go and find our friends and give them some fruits," Lily said.

They picked up the basket and left the tree. They met their friends on the way and gave them some fruits. Their friends were very grateful and excited. They all played together and had a wonderful time.

The moral of the story is: Sharing is caring. It is better to share what you have with others than to keep it for yourself and let it spoil. You will make others happy and have more friends. And you will also be thankful for what nature gives you.

Once upon a time, there was a happy dog named Max. Max loved to walk outside and play with his friends. One day, Max's eye started to hurt and he couldn't see very well. His owner took him to the vet and they gave him some medicine to make his eye feel better.

After a few days, Max's eye was all better and he could see again. He was so happy! Max's owner noticed that he had gained some weight and decided to take him for longer walks to help him get fit again. Max loved going on walks and playing outside with his friends, and he soon became fit and healthy once more.

Max's owner was proud of him for being such a good dog and taking care of himself. Max was happy to be able to see and play outside again. From that day on, Max made sure to take good care of his eye and stay fit by going on walks every day.

Once upon a time, there was a young man named Tony. Tony wanted to find the right girl to marry. So, one day he went to a party and met a young lady named June. They started to talk and soon became friends.

At the end of the party Tony asked if June wanted to get married. She said yes, and they hugged.

Tony and June told their families. Everyone was so excited. On the day they got married, Tony and June were very happy.

Tony and June have been married for a long time now and they have a wife. Together they have a wonderful life.

Once upon a time, there was a little bridge in a big forest. The bridge was very icy because it was winter. Many animals lived in the forest and they liked to play near the bridge.

One day, a small rabbit had a question. He asked his friend, the squirrel, "How can we cross the icy bridge without slipping?" The squirrel thought and thought. Then, he had an idea. "Let's hold hands and be very careful when we walk," he said.

So, the rabbit and the squirrel held hands and crossed the icy bridge together. They were very careful and did not slip. When they reached the other side, they were so happy. Now, they could play in the snow and enjoy the winter day. From that day on, all the animals in the forest helped each other cross the icy bridge.

Once upon a time, there was an island full of special creatures. A little girl called Maria lived on the island with her family.

One day, she noticed a regular man on the beach. He was trying to test the creatures on the island. Maria asked him what he was doing but he wouldn't answer.

The man kept testing the creatures every day. One day, Maria decided to follow him and see what he was doing.

In the evening, she saw the man making a big fire on the beach. He lit the fire and everything turned red and ugly. When Maria tried to put out the fire, it was too late.

The man had tested the creatures on the island and their home was destroyed. Maria was very sad, but there was nothing she could do.

One sunny day, a cheerful boy named Tim went to play outside. He had a big toy box with many toys. Today, he wanted to play with his friends. He took his toy shovel and ran to the park.

At the park, Tim met his friend Sue. Sue had a toy map. "I have a treasure map," she said. "Let's find the treasure!" Tim was excited. They looked at the map and saw a big X in the sandbox.

Tim and Sue went to the sandbox. Tim used his shovel to dig a big hole. They found a small box. "We found the treasure!" they shouted. They opened the box and saw shiny toy coins inside.

Tim and Sue wanted to hide the treasure again. They decided to bury it under the slide. They dug a new hole and put the box inside. Then, they covered it with sand. "Now, we can find it again later!" said Tim.

The two friends played on the slide and swings, happy with their treasure hunt. They knew they would come back to find the treasure again.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a brave boy named Tim. Tim was very strong and loved to help others. One day, he found a belt on the ground. He knew he had to keep it safe until he could find who it belonged to.

Tim walked around the town asking, "Is this your belt?" But no one said it was theirs. Tim did not give up. He knew he had to keep looking. Soon, he met an old man who was sad. The old man said, "I lost my belt. It was very special to me." Tim smiled and showed the belt he found. The old man was very happy and thanked Tim for being so brave and helpful.

The town people saw how Tim helped the old man and they all learned a lesson. They learned that it is important to be brave and keep trying, even when things are hard. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was an old house. One day, a small boy with a big heart came to visit his new home. He knew it was very special and he wanted to explore. So, off he went.

He walked into the living room and saw something strange. On the wall was a mysterious film. He couldn't read the words, but he could feel the film trembling. He gasped - it was alive!

He stepped closer and saw the film shaking. He noticed small creatures running and jumping around on the screen. He laughed and clapped his hands - it was so exciting! He wanted to join in the fun.

Quickly, he stepped closer and tried to touch the film. Suddenly, it stopped trembling and everything was still. He looked around and saw that all the creatures had gone.

But as he was about to leave, something mysterious happened. He heard a little whisper coming from the film and a new creature appeared. They both smiled and the film started to tremble once more.

Sara and Ben are friends. They like to play and sing together. One day, they find a big box in the park. They want to see what is inside.

They open the box and see many clothes. There are hats, coats, dresses, and shoes. Sara and Ben think it is fun to try them on. They put on different clothes and sing songs.

"Look at me, I am a queen!" Sara says. She wears a long dress and a crown. She sings a song about castles and flowers.

"Look at me, I am a clown!" Ben says. He wears a big coat and a funny hat. He sings a song about jokes and balloons.

They laugh and clap for each other. They have a good time.

But then, a fat cat comes out of the box. The cat is angry. It does not like Sara and Ben. It thinks they are taking its clothes. It hisses and scratches at them.

"Meow! Meow! Go away!" the cat says.

Sara and Ben are scared. They run away from the cat. They drop the clothes they are wearing. They leave a strip of clothes behind them.

The cat chases them for a while. Then it stops. It picks up the clothes and goes back to the box. It curls up and sleeps.

Sara and Ben are safe. They hug each other. They are still friends. They do not want to play with the cat's clothes anymore. They go home and sing a song about friendship.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and twirl around in her colorful dress. One day, she went to a party where everyone was dancing. Lily was so happy to join in and dance with her friends.

As the music played, Lily noticed a pretty bow on her friend's hair. It was so colorful and sparkly. Lily asked her friend where she got the bow and her friend said her mommy made it for her.

Lily thought it was the most beautiful bow she had ever seen. She danced and twirled around her friend, admiring the colorful bow. When the party was over, Lily went home and asked her mommy if she could have a colorful bow too. Her mommy smiled and said she would make her one. From that day on, Lily wore her colorful bow whenever she danced and twirled around in her pretty dress.

Once upon a time there was a very busy goose. It would zoom around the park all day long looking for food and singing its tune.

One day, a small three year old toddler saw the goose and became very excited. He asked his mother, "Mommy, can I go outside and play with the goose?" The mother was hesitant, but she said yes.

The toddler ran out of the house and right up to the goose. He said hello and said "how's it going?"

The goose replied, "I'm so busy looking for food and singing my song, but I'm happy to meet you!"

The goose and the toddler exchanged some more words before the mother called him back inside. As the toddler ran back, he shouted "Bye goose! See you soon!"

The goose waved goodbye and said "You take care! Zoom away now!"

And zoom the happy toddler did!

Once upon a time, there lived a chubby bunny. She loved to hop around and collect carrots.

One day, she decided to explore the world beyond her favourite patch of flowers. She hopped into a nation far away, where the rules were different.

The bunny tried to meet new friends, but they sadly ignored her. She realised that they didn't want to be her friend and it made her feel sad.

She decided to go back to her favourite patch of flowers and carry on hopping around. She decided to forget about the nation that ignored her and keep exploring her own world.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable rocket. It was always ready to fly. One day, the rocket's owners wanted to take it on an adventure. They wanted to use it to explore the sky. They all yelled with excitement when they saw that the rocket was ready to blast off.

When the rocket blasted off, it flew higher and higher into space. Everyone was cheering and yelling as it grew farther and farther away. Then, suddenly, the dependable rocket stopped. It looked like it was stranded!

The owners wondered what was wrong. Then, they saw a tiny shoelace wrapped around the rocket. It was causing it to get stuck! Everyone yelled with delight when they saw the little shoelace and knew that the dependable rocket could now be freed.

The owners quickly untied the shoelace and the dependable rocket continued its journey. It soared through the sky and was never stuck again. Everyone was happy that their dependable rocket was ready for more adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very hungry and asked her mom for some food. Her mom gave her a plate of yummy spaghetti. Lily loved spaghetti and ate it all up.

After eating, Lily felt weak and tired. She said to her mom, "Mommy, I feel weak. Can you carry me to bed?" Her mom picked her up and carried her to bed.

Before Lily went to sleep, she looked out the window and saw the moon. She said to her mom, "Look mommy, the moon is shining bright tonight!" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, it is beautiful. Goodnight, my sweet Lily."

Mom and Buzz were baking a cake. Mom broke the eggs and stirred them in the bowl to mix them. Buzz opened the cupboard, took out the flour and added it to the mix.

The mix was looking thicker and Buzz laughed. After all the ingredients were added, the mix in the bowl was ready and bubbling.

Mom opened the oven and carefully put the mix in. After closing the oven, Mom and Buzz waited patiently for the cake to bake.

Meanwhile, Buzz decided to dress up for the occasion. He took out his normal pants and put them on.

Finally, the cake was ready. Mom opened the oven and took it out. She put it on the table and it smelled delicious!

Buzz and Mom gave each other a high five! They had made a delicious cake and Buzz was wearing his normal pants. It was a great day!

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Benny. Benny loved to eat carrots. One day, Benny went to the garden to pick some carrots. But, he accidentally broke his carrot. Benny was sad because he couldn't eat his carrot.

Benny's friend, a wise old owl, saw that Benny was sad. The owl asked Benny what was wrong. Benny told the owl that he broke his carrot and couldn't eat it. The owl told Benny not to worry because he could fix the carrot.

Benny was happy! The owl fixed the carrot and Benny was able to eat it. Benny realized that he was ignorant and didn't know how to fix his carrot. But, he learned that it's okay to ask for help when you need it. From that day on, Benny always asked for help when he needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in his backyard. One day, he found a pebble on the ground. It was small and smooth, and Timmy thought it was very pretty.

Timmy wanted to keep the pebble, so he looked for a way to attach it to something. He found a piece of string and tied it around the pebble. Now he could wear it around his neck like a necklace.

Later that day, Timmy's little sister came outside to play. She saw Timmy's necklace and wanted one too. So Timmy found another pebble for his sister and attached it to a piece of string. She was so happy and thought it was a wonderful idea. Timmy felt proud of himself for coming up with such a great idea.

Suddenly, a terrible storm started brewing in the sky. Timmy and his sister quickly ran inside to stay safe. But Timmy didn't forget about his pebble necklace. He made sure to take it off and keep it safe, so it wouldn't get lost or damaged in the storm.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely mommy and her daughter. They lived in a big house with a garden full of flowers. One day, the mommy made some ice cream for her daughter. The ice cream was so yummy that the daughter ate it all up very quickly. But it was a very hot day and the ice cream started to melt. The daughter didn't mind because she loved the ice cream so much.

Once upon a time there was a fat cat. The cat was very big, but it was also very friendly. Every day, the cat would come out of its house and play with the children in the neighbourhood. The children loved the cat and the cat loved them.

One day, the children asked the cat to come and play in the park. The cat promised to come, and it did. The cat chased the children around the park and the children laughed and smiled.

Later, the children asked the cat to promise to come back and play again tomorrow. The cat said, "Yes, I promise!" So the next day, the cat came back and played with the children again.

The cat and the children played in the park every day after that. The cat would always keep its promise, and the children were always happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She went to a restaurant with her parents. The waiter gave them a menu to choose what they wanted to eat. Lily was excited to try something new.

She ordered a big burger with fries and a milkshake. But after eating, she started to feel dizzy. Her parents noticed and asked if she was okay. Lily said she didn't feel good.

Later, they found out that Lily was allergic to the ingredients in the burger. They had to rush her to the hospital. From that day on, they always checked the menu for any allergens before ordering.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy lived in a house with his mommy and daddy. One day, Timmy and his family went on a trip to the west. They saw lots of big mountains and beautiful sunsets. But one day, the sky turned gloomy and it started to rain. Timmy's mommy and daddy got worried because they didn't know where to go. But then, they saw a sign that said "Shelter". They followed the sign and found a little house where they could stay until the rain stopped. Timmy was happy because he got to play inside with his toys. After a while, the rain stopped and the sun came out again. Timmy and his family continued their trip to the west, but they never forgot the little house that saved them from the rain.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. One day, Timmy and his mommy went on a subway ride. The subway was very big and had lots of people on it.

When they got off the subway, they saw that it was very cold outside. The ground was covered in icy snow and Timmy's nose was getting chilly. Suddenly, Timmy's mommy told him to freeze!

Timmy stopped moving and stood very still. His mommy took a picture of him because he looked so funny. Then they went to get hot chocolate to warm up. Timmy loved the hot chocolate and was happy that he got to freeze like a statue on the icy day.

Once upon a time, there was a little bee named Buzz. Buzz lived in a hive with lots of other bees. One day, Buzz found a very rare flower. It was so pretty, he wanted to take it back to the hive to show his friends.

When Buzz got back to the hive, his friend Buzzy said, "Wow, that flower is so rare! Can I have it?" Buzz thought for a moment and said, "Sure, you can have it. I accept that you like it too."

Buzzy was very happy and took the rare flower to show all the other bees. They all thought it was beautiful and thanked Buzz for sharing it. From that day on, Buzz and Buzzy were the best of friends, always sharing and accepting each other's things.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars. He had a red car, a blue car, and a green car. One day, Timmy took his red car and pushed it really fast. "Look how fast it goes!" he said.

Suddenly, he heard a loud whistle. It was his friend, Billy. "Wow, I'm envious of your car. It's so cool!" Billy said. Timmy smiled and handed him the green car to play with. "Let's race!" Timmy said.

They lined up their cars and counted down. "3, 2, 1, go!" They pushed their cars as fast as they could. Timmy's red car was the fastest and won the race. "I won!" Timmy shouted. Billy clapped and said, "You're so fast! Can I borrow your red car?"

Timmy nodded and handed him the car. They played together happily, sharing their toys and having fun.

Once upon a time there was a man with a case. He was feeling very gloomy one day, so he decided to take a trip. He put his things in the case and lifted it off the ground. He walked for a long time looking for a place to make him feel happy.

When he was almost too tired to go on he saw a sunny meadow full of friendly animals. He was so enthusiastic to get there that he lifted the case with ease and ran to explore the meadow.

The man found so many wonderful things in the meadow. The animals let him pet them, the flowers were colourful and the sun was so bright. The man left the meadow with a smile on his face and the case seemed to be much lighter.

The man arrived home feeling much better. He knew that he could always go back to the meadow whenever he was feeling gloomy. He lifted the case with a happy smile and stored all his things in it, ready for his next adventure.

Lily liked to help her grandma. Grandma had a cane to walk. She was old and slow. Lily was young and fast. She wanted to do many things.

One day, Lily and grandma went to the park. Lily saw a big pond. She saw ducks and fish. She wanted to feed them. She asked grandma for some bread. Grandma gave her some. Lily ran to the pond. She threw the bread to the ducks and fish. They ate it and made noises.

Lily saw a shiny thing in the water. She wanted to get it. She leaned over the pond. She reached for the shiny thing. She fell in the water. She got wet and cold. She cried.

Grandma heard Lily cry. She walked to the pond with her cane. She was worried. She saw Lily in the water. She helped her out. She hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. You are safe. But you are very wet. We need to go home and wash you."

Lily was sorry. She said, "I'm sorry, grandma. I wanted the shiny thing. It was a coin. I wanted to give it to you." Grandma smiled and said, "That was very sweet of you, Lily. But you don't need to give me anything. I love you just the way you are."

They walked home with the cane and the coin. Lily was impatient. She wanted to be dry and warm. She wanted to play with her toys. Grandma was patient. She said, "We will be home soon, Lily. Then we will wash you and change your clothes. And then we will have some cookies and milk. And then we will read a story. How does that sound?" Lily nodded and said, "That sounds good, grandma. I love you." Grandma said, "I love you too, Lily."

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the park with her mommy. She saw a shiny diamond on the ground and picked it up. She showed it to her mommy and said, "Look, mommy! I found a diamond!"

Her mommy said, "Wow, that's a regular diamond. It's not real, but it's still pretty."

Suddenly, Lily's friend Timmy came over and said, "I have a real diamond! It's bigger than yours!" Lily felt sad because Timmy was teasing her.

But then her mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. Your diamond may not be real, but it's still special because you found it. And that's what matters." Lily smiled and felt happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and pick cherries from the tree in her backyard. The cherries were so yummy and red!

One day, Lily's friend came to visit. Her friend's name was Jack. Jack was an ordinary boy, but he always made Lily laugh. They played together and picked cherries from the tree. Jack made silly faces and they both laughed and laughed.

After they were done playing, Lily's mom made them cherry pie. It was so delicious! Lily and Jack ate the whole pie and laughed some more. They had so much fun together and couldn't wait to play again.

One day, two small animals were fighting. They were very angry and wanted to win the fight. One of them grabbed the other and tried to pull it away. Suddenly, the second animal said: "Stop! You have put a label on me and it is hurting." The first animal stopped and looked at the label. It was a very small label, but it was clearly hurting the second animal. The first animal realised that it was wrong and apologised. They both smiled and understood that no labels are needed for a fight. They hugged each other and agreed to be friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big jar. Every day a little girl named Sarah would come to visit the jar. She loved to talk to the jar, telling it stories and secrets.

One day when she came to visit the jar, she was so excited to find something new inside! It was a big red flower. Sarah took it out and smelled its sweet smell. She said, “This is the most beautiful flower ever!”

She put the flower back in the jar, and then she wrapped the jar in a big blanket. She wanted to keep the flower safe and warm. Sarah took the jar home and put it in her bedroom, so she could talk to it everyday.

Now Sarah and the jar were the best of friends. The jar would listen to every story and secret Sarah shared, patiently and without judgement. They were happy together, and it was a big jar of love.

Once there was a girl called Daisy. She was only three years old and was very excited about the world around her. One day, Daisy's mom and dad decided to take her for a walk in the park.

As they walked, Daisy saw something strange. In the sky, a strange cloud of smoke began to appear. Daisy asked her mom, "What is that?"

Her mother replied, "That is a cloud of smoke. It happened because something has become hot and started to burn".

The smoke slowly floated away and made the sky more flexible. Daisy and her parents kept on walking, but Daisy was still very curious about the smoke.

"Why is it that smoke appears when something becomes hot and starts to burn?" Daisy asked.

Her dad smiled and kneeled down to talk to her. He said, "Smoke appears due to something called combustion, it's a process of things becoming hot and starting to burn. It's actually quite fascinating if you think about it."

Daisy listened intently and nodded her head as her dad explained. As they started walking home, Daisy was sure to remember what she had learned and she was very eager to learn more.

One day, a granny and her grandbaby were outside in the backyard. The grandbaby was so excited because granny said they were going to attach something on the swing. Granny had a big tire and she told the grandbaby they were going to attach it.

The grandbaby thought it was crazy but he wanted to help so he held one end of the tire while granny held the other end. Together, they fastened the tire to the swing. When it was done, granny turned to the grandbaby and said, “Let's go for a ride!”

The grandbaby was so happy! He and granny got on the swing and pushed off. They went so high in the sky that it felt like they were flying. They went back and forth and round and round, so fast it felt like they could go on forever. Granny and the grandbaby laughed and laughed as they rode the swing.

Finally, when they were too tired, granny and the grandbaby got off. Granny looked at the grandbaby and said, “That was crazy! I'm glad we attached the tire to the swing. It was so much fun!” The grandbaby agreed and they hugged each other tightly.

Once upon a time, there was a busy monkey. Every day, the monkey would climb up a tall tree to pick the sweetest, yellow bananas. As the monkey ate the delicious bananas the birds in the trees would sing and applaud him. The monkey was so happy that he would jump around and wave his arms to show how proud he was.

One day, the monkey was so busy picking the biggest and best bananas that he didn't notice a tiger lurking nearby. As the tiger crept closer, the birds in the tree called out in alarm and the monkey quickly ran away. The monkey was safe, but he was so scared that his mouth was dry.

The birds cheered and applauded the monkey for being so brave. Feeling proud, the monkey jumped up and down and waved his arms. From then on, the monkey was never too busy to watch out for danger. He knows that his friends in the trees will always be there to applaud him.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Mia and Bob. Mia wanted to do something interesting, so she decided to join a team.

Mia asked Bob if he wanted to be on the team too. Bob was excited and said, “Yes!”

Mia and Bob got ready to join the team. They put on their special clothes, and bowed to the team leader to show their respect. The team leader was so impressed with them.

The team did a lot of interesting activities together, like running, playing tag, and jumping rope. Mia and Bob had so much fun with the team that they could not stop laughing and smiling.

At the end of the day, Mia and Bob bowed to the team leader to say goodbye. It was the most interesting day ever!

Once upon a time there was a little bunny called Bob. Bob was a happy bunny, and he liked to hop around the garden. One day, Bob hopped over to an apple tree. He saw a big, round apple and he was very excited. He started to hop up and down in front of the tree, but then he heard someoone say 'No!'

It was a big, brown bear. Bob was a bit scared, but the bear was very polite. He smiled at Bob and said 'No hopping please. That apple is for me.'

Bob felt sad, but he smiled at the bear and said 'OK'. Then he hopped away, looking for something else to do.

The bear thanked Bob for being so polite. He picked the apple off the tree, gave it a hug, and then ate it!

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to tell jokes, especially funny ones. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends.

As they were playing, Lily told a joke that made everyone laugh. "Why did the chicken cross the playground?" she asked. "I don't know, why?" her friend replied. "To get to the other slide!" Lily said with a giggle.

Suddenly, Lily noticed something strange happening. She started to shrink! "Oh no, I'm shrinking!" she cried. Her friends were worried and asked her what was wrong. "It's okay," Lily said, "it's just a joke. I'm pretending to be small." Everyone laughed and they continued to play together happily.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Hoppy. Hoppy loved to eat squash, but his mom said it was too sharp for him to eat. Hoppy was stubborn and didn't want to listen to his mom.

One day, Hoppy found a big squash in the garden. He decided to take a bite even though it was sharp. It hurt his mouth and he didn't like it. Hoppy realized that his mom was right and he should listen to her.

From that day on, Hoppy listened to his mom and only ate soft foods. He never forgot the time he tried to eat a sharp squash and was glad he learned his lesson.

Once there was a little boy who loved potatoes. Every day he would go to his garden, pick a fresh potato and take it home. One day, he brought home a big sweet potato. He was so excited and he wanted to eat it right away.

He ran up to his room and used his tiny fingers to tear at the potato skin. When he opened it, he saw that it was full of bright orangey-yellow stuff inside. He had never seen anything like it before!

He tasted a spoonful and it was so sweet and delicious. The little boy was so happy that he was jumping up and down with joy. From that day onwards, he would always look for sweet potatoes in his vegetable garden.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Molly. She was brave and ready to try new things. One day, she saw a woman in a beautiful garden filled with flowers and buzzing insects. She wanted to go and talk to her but she didn't know what to say.

Molly took a deep breath and asked the woman: "What is wisdom?" The woman smiled and said: "Wisdom is inside you, Molly. It will help guide you in life!"

Molly was unsure but she was ready to find out more. She asked the woman again: "How do I get wisdom?" The woman said: "The only way to get wisdom is to tear away the things that make it difficult to find it."

Molly thought for a moment and then she understood. She said: "Thank you for your wise words!" The woman smiled and nodded.

Molly left the garden with a sense of new understanding. She was ready to start tearing away what was getting in the way of her wisdom. She was ready to start her new journey.

Once upon a time there was a strong bear who wanted to go on an adventure. It could hear the call of the open road from far away. He wanted to explore what lay beyond his cozy bear cave.

The bear asked his mom if he could go. His mom said he could go, but only if he promised to be very careful. She told him to look both ways before crossing the road and never go too far away.

The bear was happy and excited. He waved goodbye and started walking down the path. Soon he came across a big road. He stopped and remembered his mother's advice. He looked both ways to be sure it was safe.

When he was sure it was okay, he crossed the road. He was so excited to explore! He couldn't believe his mom had permitted him to go on such an amazing adventure.

The bear journeyed further and further away. He marveled at the wonders he saw along the way. He felt so strong and brave, just like his mom had said he could be.

The bear eventually returned home that same day, safe and sound. He was full of wonderful stories to tell his mom, who smiled proudly and hugged him tightly. He was happy and grateful that his mom had allowed him to go on such an amazing adventure.

Anna and Ben are best friends. They like to play in the park and look at the stars. One night, they see a big, bright star in the sky. They wonder what it is.

"Maybe it is a wish star," Anna says. "If we wish hard, it will come true."

"What do you wish for?" Ben asks.

"I wish for a great big hug from you," Anna says.

"I wish for a great big kiss from you," Ben says.

They close their eyes and make their wishes. Then they open their eyes and smile. They hug and kiss each other. They feel happy and warm.

The star twinkles and sends them a wink. It is not a wish star. It is a love star. It is part of the universe, and the universe is full of love. Anna and Ben do not know this, but they feel it in their hearts. They hold hands and watch the star until it is time to go home. They say good night and thank the star for its light. They do not know that the star is thanking them for their love.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her dolls. One day, Lily's mom told her that they were going to visit her grandma. Lily was so excited because she loved her grandma very much.

When they got to her grandma's house, Lily saw a beautiful vase on the table. Her mom told her that it was very fragile and she should be careful around it. Lily promised to be careful and not touch it.

Later that day, Lily's grandma recommended that they all go for a walk in the park. Lily loved going for walks so she turned to her mom and asked if they could go. Her mom agreed and they all went for a lovely walk in the park. When they got back to her grandma's house, Lily was very tired and went straight to bed. She dreamed of all the fun she had that day and couldn't wait to visit her grandma again.

Once there was a big red dog. The dog was very naughty and he loved to steal. He stole so much that people got angry with him. Little did they know, the reason he stole was that he had an itchy nose!

So the dog went around stealing things and hiding them away in his secret place. One day, he found a big red ball. He ran over to it and lifted it up with his mouth. But then he heard someone coming, so he quickly put it back and ran off.

The next day, the dog came back and found something he liked even better. It was a red scarf with red tassels. He grabbed the scarf and ran away. He was so happy to have something beautiful and bright to take with him!

The dog didn't know it, but the people had noticed him stealing. He was very sneaky, but the people were determined to catch him and stop his stealing. So they called the police!

The police tracked the dog down and returned the stolen items. The dog felt sorry for what he had done and never stole again. He found other things to do with his time and he was much happier.

The end.

Once upon a time there lived a kind fairy. She lived in a beautiful house in the middle of the forest. One day, the fairy saw a small onion near her house. She was very happy and said "Welcome, little onion. I am so happy to see you here."

The onion did not respond. But then suddenly it started to grow bigger and bigger. Very soon it was much bigger than the fairy.

The fairy smiled and said: "You are ready to go now little onion!"

The onion was very excited and wanted to explore the world. But before leaving, it turned to the fairy and said: "Thank you for welcoming me in your house. Even though I am small, I now know that I can do great things."

The fairy was moved by the onion's words. She nodded and said " Well done! You are ready to start exploring the world."

The moral of the story is that even small things or people can do great things when they are welcomed, accepted, and encouraged. Kindness can truly make a difference.

Once upon a time, there was a big truck. The truck was red and had big wheels. It could carry lots of things. One day, the truck was empty and needed something to carry. So the driver went to a store to buy some things.

At the store, the driver saw a big box. He wanted to buy it, but it was too big for the truck. So he cut the box into smaller pieces. Then he put the pieces into the truck. The truck was no longer empty!

The driver drove the truck to a house. The people at the house were happy to see the things in the truck. They took the things out of the truck and used them to make something new. The truck was empty again, but it was happy because it helped people. The end.

One day, Bob was playing in his backyard. He was having lots of fun, until he saw a dull envelope stuck in the fence. He ran over and opened it up. Inside were two tickets to a fun zoo! Bob was so excited, he wanted to escape and go to the zoo right away. He said goodbye to his mom, and ran off. He quickly found a taxi and hopped inside. The taxi drove him to the zoo, and Bob was amazed at all the animals he saw. He even got to pet a tiger! Bob had a great day, and it was all thanks to the dull envelope stuck in the fence.

Once there was a boy called Jake. Jake wanted fruit but the fruit was icy! He didn’t know how to use it.

But then Jake had an idea. He put the ice covered fruit in a big bowl and he used a spoon to break it up. He stirred it around and around until it was all smooshy. Then he found some melted ice in the bowl and realised that he could use this too! He added some milk and some sugar, and before long it was yummy.

Jake was very happy with his creation. From then on, every morning he would make icy fruit juice!

Once upon a time, there was a big bear. He was always fearful, but he never ran away. Until one day, he saw something underground. He was so scared, he was ready to disappear! He quickly ran away, never to be seen again.

The bear had been very fearful for a very long time. He was always scared of things hiding in the shadows. But no matter how he tried to be brave, his fearfulness always won.

One day, he saw something very strange underground. He couldn't tell what it was, but it scared him even more! He felt like he had to run away, or he would disappear! So he ran away as fast as he could.

The bear never returned to the same place again. He was still fearful, but he didn't have to run away anymore. He decided to be brave and stay away from the underground. He was happy with the way things were.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to listen to stories, especially ones with brown bears. One day, she asked her mommy to tell her a story about a brown bear.

Mommy said, "Once upon a time, there was a brown bear who wanted to reach the honey on top of the tree. But he was too short to get it."

Lily asked, "What did the brown bear do?"

Mommy replied, "The brown bear asked his friend, a tall giraffe, to help him reach the honey. The giraffe stretched his long neck and the brown bear was able to reach the honey. They both enjoyed the sweet treat together."

Lily smiled and said, "I like stories with brown bears and friends who help each other."

Once upon a time, a dog named Spot went for a walk. He saw a gray cat and wanted to play with her, but she ran away. Spot followed her until he saw a bone on the ground. He wanted to eat it, but his owner did not permit him to. Spot was sad, but he knew his owner loved him and would give him something tasty to eat later. So, he continued his walk and enjoyed the sunshine.

A bald woman was walking through the park with a little girl. They came to a big hole. The woman picked up a shovel, and started to bury something. The little girl was curious, so she asked the woman what she was doing.

"I'm burying something special," the woman said.

"What is it?" asked the little girl.

The woman smiled and said "A secret!"

The woman kept digging the hole until she was done. Then she put something inside and covered it with dirt. She patted it down and said "There! It is all safe now."

The woman and the little girl went on their way. The little girl was very curious, but she knew the woman's secret was safe and sound inside the hole.

Once upon a time there were two little friends, a girl called Jenny and a boy called Ben. They were both playing together in the park when they spotted a flag.

"Look," said Ben. "What is that?"

"I think it's a flag!" said Jenny. "Let's play with it."

So they decided to each take hold of one end and manage to carry it together. They ran around together and had a lot of fun.

The next day, they decided to have a race to see who could carry the flag the fastest. Jenny thought she had won but Ben said it hadn't been fair.

"I didn't have enough time," he said.

"OK," said Jenny. "Let's do it again, but this time we'll play fair and give both of us the same amount of time."

So they agreed and had a good race. And in the end, they were both happy because they had managed to play fair.

The end.

Once there was a girl called Lucy. She liked to watch the aeroplanes fly in the sky. She wanted to fly with them. She watched them everyday, dreaming of flying away.

One day her wish came true. An aeroplane landed in her garden. She was so excited and ran up to the pilot to ask if she could go with him. The pilot had compassion for Lucy and said, "Yes, you can come".

As the aeroplane took off, Lucy felt like she was growing wings. They flew around the world, visiting lots of different countries. The pilot taught her lots of things and showed her how to be kind and compassionate just like him.

When they landed, Lucy thanked the pilot for her wonderful adventure. She had learned so much on her journey and she will always remember it.

The moral of the story is that kindness can take you anywhere!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in her yard. Her yard was big and green with lots of trees and flowers. One day, Lily saw her neighbor's yard. It was very fancy with a big fountain and lots of decorations. Lily wanted her yard to be fancy too.

Lily's mom said, "Lily, it's not important to have a fancy yard. What's important is to have fun and be happy in your own yard." Lily thought about what her mom said and realized that she loved her yard just the way it was. She didn't need fancy things to be happy.

From that day on, Lily played in her yard and had fun with her friends. She saw that being happy and having fun was more important than having a fancy yard. And that was the moral of the story.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat yogurt because it was yummy and healthy. One day, Lily's mommy said to her, "Lily, it's time to take a bath. You will feel clean and jolly after!"

Lily didn't want to take a bath because she was having too much fun playing with her toys. But, her mommy said, "Come on, Lily. It's important to be clean so we can stay healthy. Plus, we can have more fun after you're all clean!"

So, Lily took a bath and her mommy helped her wash her hair and body. After her bath, Lily felt so fresh and clean. Her mommy gave her a big hug and said, "Now let's go have some more yogurt and play together!" Lily smiled and said, "Yay! I love yogurt and playing with you, mommy!"

Once upon a time, there was a van who was very creative. Whenever he saw something he didn't like, he would roar and make a big noise.

One day, he was walking through the park when he saw a big bully picking on a small child. He got so mad that he started to roar really loudly. Everyone in the park heard him and the bully ran away.

The small child was so happy that the van had helped him. He gave him a big hug and thanked him for his kindness.

The van was very proud that he had been able to help the child. He roared with joy and everyone in the park smiled and clapped for him. He was their hero!

The van and the child became best friends and they would always play together in the park. Whenever the van saw something wrong or unfair, he would roar and stand up for what was right.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a lazy cat named Tom. Tom loved to sleep all day and play all night. He had a friend, a little girl named Sue. Sue liked to learn new words every day.

One sunny day, Sue found a big box in her room. She called Tom to help her open it. Tom, though lazy, came to help his friend. Together, they opened the box to reveal a lot of toys and a big book.

Sue was very happy to see the book. She opened it and saw many new words inside. She read the words out loud, and Tom listened. They played with the toys and learned new words all day long. Tom was not lazy that day, and they both had a lot of fun.

Ben is a young boy who likes to look at magazines. He likes the pictures of cars and animals and toys. He wants to have his own magazine, but his mom says they are too expensive. She says he can only look at them in the store.

One day, Ben goes to the store with his mom. He sees a big pile of magazines near the door. He runs to them and picks one up. It has a shiny car on the cover. He wants it very much. He looks at his mom. She is busy talking to a lady. Ben thinks maybe he can take the magazine and put it in his pocket. No one will see him.

But Ben does not know that there is a camera in the store. The camera can see everything. It can see Ben and the magazine and his pocket. There is also a man who works in the store. He can see the camera and what it shows. He sees Ben and the magazine and his pocket. He does not like it when people take things without paying. He walks to Ben and says, "Hey, what are you doing with that magazine?"

Ben feels scared. He knows he did something bad. He drops the magazine and says, "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I just wanted to look at it." The man is angry. He says, "You can't just take things that are not yours. That is stealing. You have to pay for it or put it back." He takes Ben to his mom. He tells her what Ben did. She is very upset. She says, "Ben, how could you do that? That is wrong. You have to say sorry to the man and to me. And you can't have any magazines for a long time."

Ben feels sad. He says sorry to the man and to his mom. He wishes he did not take the magazine. He learns his lesson. He knows that wanting something is not enough. He has to ask and pay and be honest. He hopes his mom will forgive him and love him. He hopes he will find a better way to get a magazine someday.

Once upon a time, there was a grumpy cat named Tom. Tom had a big zipper on his bag. One day, Tom went to the park with his bag. He was going to play with his friends.

At the park, Tom saw his friends. They were all playing together. Tom opened his bag with the big zipper. Inside the bag, he found his toys. He had a ball, a car, and some paints. Tom wanted to play with the paints.

Tom took out the paints and started to mix the colors. He mixed red and blue to make purple. He mixed yellow and blue to make green. Tom was having so much fun mixing the colors. His friends came over to see what he was doing.

Together, they all mixed the colors and painted beautiful pictures. Tom was not grumpy anymore. He was happy to play with his friends and share his paints. The big zipper on his bag helped him keep all his toys safe. And they all played happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Emma. She was three years old and had a bedroom full of toys. This bedroom had many things like a bed, chest of drawers and a wardrobe.

One day, Emma opened the top drawer in the chest of drawers. Inside the drawer was a broken toy, but when she tried to pull it out, it was stuck! Emma tried and tried, but the toy wouldn't yield. As she kept trying to get it out, part of the drawer broke off.

Emma was upset that her drawer was broken, but she tried to think of a solution. Then she had an idea. She took out all the other toys from the drawer and used the pieces to fix the drawer. Eventually, she was able to make the drawer look like it was before and the toy was able to yield!

Emma was happy that she fixed the drawer and was now able to take out the toy. She smiled to herself and went off to play with it. The end.

Tom and Lily were twins who loved to sing. They sang all the time, at home, at school, and in the park. They wanted to be opera singers when they grew up, because they heard that opera was brilliant and beautiful.

One day, their mom took them to see a real opera at a big theater. They were very excited and curious. They wore their best clothes and sat in their seats. The lights went down and the music started.

But when the opera singers came on stage, Tom and Lily were scared. They sang very loud and high, and made funny faces and gestures. They sounded like angry animals or ghosts. Tom and Lily did not like it at all. They wanted to go home.

"Mom, can we leave?" Tom whispered. "This opera is scary and ugly."

"Shh, be quiet," mom said. "This opera is brilliant and wonderful. You have to listen and learn. Maybe you will like it later."

But Tom and Lily did not like it later. They felt bored and frightened. They wished they could sing their own songs, or listen to something else.

At the end of the opera, the singers bowed and the audience clapped. Mom was happy and proud. She said to Tom and Lily, "Did you enjoy the opera? Wasn't it amazing?"

Tom and Lily shook their heads. They said, "No, mom, we did not enjoy the opera. It was not amazing. It was scary and ugly. We like our songs better. Can we go home now?"

Mom was surprised and sad. She said, "But Tom and Lily, you love to sing. You want to be opera singers. How can you not like opera?"

Tom and Lily said, "We love to sing, but we do not love opera. Opera is not for us. We want to sing our own way, and listen to different music. Can we try something else?"

Mom thought for a moment. She said, "Well, I guess you have your own tastes and preferences. I'm sorry you did not like the opera, but I'm glad you tried something new. Maybe you will find another kind of music that you love. There are many kinds of music in the world, and you can sing them all. But you have to be respectful and open-minded. You never know what you might learn or enjoy."

Tom and Lily nodded. They said, "We're sorry, mom. We did not mean to be rude or close-minded. We will try to be respectful and open-minded. But can we go home now?"

Mom smiled. She said, "Yes, we can go home now. But maybe next time, we can try something else. How about jazz, or rock, or folk? There are many kinds of music in the world, and you can sing them all."

Tom and Lily smiled. They said, "OK, mom. We will try something else. Maybe we will like it. But we will always love our songs, too. Can we sing them on the way home?"

Mom said, "Of course, you can. Let's sing together. There are many kinds of music in the world, and you can sing them all."

And they did.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a charming boy named Tim. Tim had a toy sword that he loved to play with. One day, while playing with his sword, he met a new friend named Sam. Sam did not like the sword; he would say, "I hate swords."

Tim and Sam played together every day, but Tim still liked to play with his sword. One day, while they were playing, Sam said, "I have a secret. I will tell you tomorrow." Tim was excited and could not wait to find out the secret.

The next day, Sam told Tim the secret. "I am moving far away," Sam said. Tim was very sad. He asked Sam if he could come with him, but Sam said no. Tim was so sad that he threw his sword away. He never saw Sam or his sword again, and he missed them both very much.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. It was her birthday and she was very excited. Her mommy and daddy cleaned the house and made a cake for her. Lily's friends were coming to her party.

When her friends came, they played games and sang songs. They ate the cake and had fun. But then, Lily's mommy said, "It's time to open your presents!" Lily was so happy. She sat down to open her presents.

When she opened the first present, it was a doll. Lily loved it! But then, she saw another present. It was big and wrapped in shiny paper. Lily's mommy said, "That one is from your grandma." Lily was very curious. She sat down and opened the present. Inside was a beautiful dress! It was the perfect birthday present for Lily. She put on the dress and felt like a princess.

Once upon a time, there was a big garden. In the garden, there were many pretty flowers and yummy fruits. A graceful butterfly lived in the garden too. The butterfly liked to fly around and look at all the colors.

One day, a little boy came to the garden. He saw the butterfly and said, "Hi, butterfly! You are very pretty." The butterfly was happy and said, "Thank you, little boy! I like your garden."

The little boy wanted to play with the butterfly. He tried to grab it, but the butterfly was too fast. The butterfly said, "I am sorry, little boy. I cannot let you grab me. But we can still play in the garden together." The little boy was happy, and they played all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the misty morning. One day, she saw a stubborn bird sitting on a tree branch. She wanted to make the bird fly away, so she started to clap her hands. But the bird didn't move.

Lily clapped louder and louder, but the bird still didn't move. She wondered why the bird was so stubborn. Then, she realized that the bird was just resting and needed some peace and quiet. So, she stopped clapping and watched the bird for a while.

After a few minutes, the bird flew away. Lily was happy that the bird was able to rest and she learned that sometimes it's important to be quiet and patient. From that day on, Lily enjoyed watching the birds and animals without disturbing them with her clapping.

Lily and Ben like to play in the maze. The maze is big and green. It has many paths and walls. Lily and Ben try to find the way out.

"Come on, Ben, this way!" Lily says. She runs to the left. Ben follows her. He likes to run with Lily.

But Lily runs too fast. She does not see the hole. She falls into the hole. She cries. "Ow, ow, ow! Help me, Ben!"

Ben hears Lily. He runs to the hole. He looks down. He sees Lily. She is on the ground. She is not hurt. The ground is soft. It has grass and flowers.

"Lily, are you okay?" Ben asks. He is worried.

"I'm okay, Ben. The ground is soft. But I'm scared. How can I get out?" Lily says. She is sad.

Ben thinks. He has an idea. He finds a rope. The rope is long and strong. He ties one end to a tree. He throws the other end to Lily.

"Lily, grab the rope. I will pull you out," Ben says. He is brave.

Lily grabs the rope. She holds it tight. Ben pulls the rope. He pulls hard. Lily comes out of the hole. She is happy.

"Thank you, Ben. You are my hero," Lily says. She hugs Ben.

"You're welcome, Lily. You are my friend," Ben says. He hugs Lily back.

They smile. They are happy. They play in the maze again. They are careful. They do not fall. They have fun.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a judge. The judge was very spoiled. Every day, he would eat lots of candy and not share with anyone. He loved to shake his big bag of candy and laugh.

One sunny day, a little boy came to the judge. The boy asked, "Can I have some candy, please?" The judge said no and shook the bag of candy in front of the boy. The boy was sad and walked away.

Later that day, the judge found his bag of candy was empty. He had eaten all of it and now there was no more. He felt sad and alone because he had not shared with anyone. The judge learned that being spoiled was not good, but it was too late. The town did not like the judge anymore, and he had no friends.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bunny. The bunny liked to eat carrots and lettuce. One day, the bunny was very hungry and asked his friend, a bird, to feed him. The bird flew to the garden and picked some carrots and lettuce for the bunny. The bunny ate all the food and felt very happy.

After eating, the bunny realized his face was dirty. His friend, the bird, used a cloth to clean the bunny's face. The bunny felt very clean and happy. From that day on, the bunny made sure to always clean his face after eating.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys in Lily's room. Lily has a big rug with many colors on the floor. Ben likes the rug. He thinks it is soft and pretty.

One day, Ben asks Lily, "Can I borrow your rug? I want to make a tent in my room."

Lily says, "No, you cannot borrow my rug. It is mine. I need it for my games."

Ben is sad. He really wants the rug. He thinks of a plan. He waits until Lily goes to the bathroom. Then he grabs the rug and runs out of the door. He is very fast.

Lily comes back and sees that her rug is gone. She is angry. She knows that Ben took it. She runs after him and shouts, "Give me back my rug! You are a bad friend!"

Ben hears Lily and feels sorry. He knows he did a wrong thing. He stops and turns around. He sees Lily's face. She is crying.

He says, "I am sorry, Lily. I was selfish. I should have asked you nicely. Here is your rug. Can we still be friends?"

Lily is still mad, but she is also kind. She says, "Thank you, Ben. I forgive you. But you have to promise me to never take my things without asking again. And you have to help me put the rug back in my room."

Ben nods and says, "I promise, Lily. I will help you. And I will be a good friend."

They hug and walk back to Lily's room. They put the rug on the floor and play with toys. They are happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her ball. One day, she was playing with her ball outside and she accidentally dropped it in a hole.

"Oh no!" cried Lily.

"What happened?" asked her mom.

"I dropped my ball in the hole," replied Lily.

"Don't worry, we'll get it out," said her mom.

They looked for something to help them get the ball out of the hole. They found a powerful magnet and used it to retrieve the ball. Lily was so happy to have her ball back and thanked her mom for helping her.

"Mommy, you're so powerful," said Lily.

"No, I'm not powerful. I just found a way to help you," replied her mom.

From that day on, Lily learned that even when things seem impossible, there's always a way to find a solution.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Rudy and Sally. Rudy loved to be cheerful, while Sally was always sharp. One day, Rudy and Sally went out to play near the river. Suddenly, they noticed that the water was very high and oxygen was very low. They were worried, but Rudy was still cheerful. He encouraged Sally to try and find a way to help.

Sally thought of an idea and ran to get a bucket. She filled it up with the water from the river, and brought it back to the riverbank. Rudy was so happy and said it was a brilliant idea! Together they poured the water back into the river, and the oxygen level began to increase.

It was a huge success, and the two friends cheered. From then on, Rudy and Sally always tried to help out in small ways, making sure that everyone was happy and the oxygen was at a good level.

The end.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Joe and Jane. Joe and Jane were having fun playing together in the sunshine. Suddenly, it began to get very hot and Jane started to fan herself with a big, bright fan. Joe wanted the fan too, and so they had to fight over it.

Joe shouted, “Me first!”

Jane said, “No, me!”

After a while they both got tired of fighting and stopped. Then Joe had an idea - they could both use the fan together! Together they waved the fan in the air and it made them feel cooler and happier. They smiled at each other and went back to playing, thankful for their bright fan.

One day, a little duck named Tim went on an adventurous walk. He loved to splash in the water and play with his friends. The sun was shining and the sky was blue. Tim was very happy.

Tim splashed in a big puddle and laughed. His friends came to play too. They all splashed and had fun. After a while, they were tired and wanted to take a nap.

Tim and his friends found a nice, soft spot under a tree. They took a cozy nap together. When they woke up, they felt refreshed and ready for more splashing fun.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved going to the temple with his mommy and daddy. He was always so proud when he got to wear his nice clothes and sit quietly during the service.

One day, Timmy's family went to the temple and Timmy saw a shiny toy car in the corner. He really wanted it and asked his mom if he could have it. His mom said no and told him that it wasn't important. But Timmy didn't listen.

When his mom and dad weren't looking, Timmy took the toy car and hid it in his pocket. He felt sneaky and excited, but also a little bit guilty. He knew he shouldn't have taken it.

After the service, Timmy's family went to leave the temple. But as they were walking out, the toy car fell out of Timmy's pocket and broke into a million pieces. Timmy's mom and dad were very upset and disappointed in him. They told him that he should always value honesty and that stealing is wrong. Timmy felt very sad and wished he had listened to his mom.

Once there was a generous mouse. He liked to give away bits of cheese to all the other animals in the forest. One day, he saw his reflection in a mirror and he decided to take a bite out of it.

The mouse thought the mirror would taste like delicious cheese, but it tasted very strange! He was confused and decided to take a second bite. Again, the mirror did not taste like cheese at all.

The mouse frowned and he realized he had made a mistake. He looked around for the other animals he had shared his cheese with, but they were gone. He felt embarrassed and thought he would not be so generous in the future.

The mouse put the mirror down and slowly started to walk away. As he left, he looked back and smiled. He was happy to see that the animals had enjoyed the cheese he had shared and he vowed to be generous again in the future.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside and explore. One day, Timmy was walking by a river when he saw a group of ducks swimming in the water. He wanted to play with them, but he didn't know how to swim.

Suddenly, a man walked up to Timmy and said, "Hello, little boy. My name is Mr. Smith. Would you like me to build a bridge across the river so you can play with the ducks?" Timmy was so happy and said, "Yes, please!"

Mr. Smith was very polite and started to build the bridge. Timmy watched him work and was amazed at how quickly he could build it. When the bridge was finished, Timmy ran across it to play with the ducks. He had so much fun and was very grateful to Mr. Smith for building the bridge.

From that day on, Timmy would visit the river every day to play with the ducks. He always remembered how polite Mr. Smith was and how he helped him build the bridge. Timmy knew that he would always be grateful for Mr. Smith's kindness.

Once there was a little boy named John and he loved to write. Every day he would take out a blank paper and his favourite pen. When he was writing, he felt very happy and proud of himself. Soon, he decided he wanted to write a novel!

He worked very hard and kept writing every day. Slowly, he filled up more and more pages with words. He was so excited to finish it and show it to his family!

Finally, it was done and he shared it with them. They were so proud of John and what he had achieved. They all liked the novel and told him he should be very proud of himself.

John, however, was ashamed. He looked down at the pages and found lots of mistakes. He wished he had taken more care when he was writing.

His family told him not to worry and that everyone makes mistakes. They promised to help him correct it and then the novel would be perfect!

John felt much better, and they all worked together to get it finished. Then they could finally share it with the world.

One day, a funny cat named Tim went to a restaurant with his friends. They all sat down and ordered some yummy food. Tim saw a big plate of fish on the table next to him. He thought it would be fun to try and get a taste of that fish.

Tim had a plan. He waited for the right time to slip away from his friends. When they were all busy talking and laughing, Tim quietly left his seat and walked toward the big plate of fish. He was very careful not to be seen.

Just as Tim was about to reach the plate, he slipped on a wet spot on the floor! He fell down and made a loud noise. His friends looked over and saw him on the floor. They all laughed and helped him up. Tim didn't get to taste the fish, but he had a fun time with his friends at the restaurant.

Lila and her mom were in the car. They wanted to go to the zoo. Lila loved the zoo. She wanted to see the wild animals. She hoped to see the lions and the monkeys and the giraffes.

But the car was not moving. There were many cars in front of them and behind them. They were stuck in traffic. Lila was sad. She looked out the window and saw the red lights and the honking horns.

"Mom, why are we not moving?" she asked.

"Because there is too much traffic, honey. Sometimes there are too many cars on the road and they make a big jam. We have to wait until the jam clears," mom said.

"How long do we have to wait?" Lila asked.

"I don't know, honey. Maybe a few minutes, maybe a long time. It depends on how fast the cars can move," mom said.

Lila sighed. She did not like waiting. She wanted to go to the zoo. She hoped the traffic would go away soon. She hoped the zoo would not close before they got there. She hoped the wild animals would not be too tired or too hungry to play with her. She hoped they would have fun at the zoo. She hoped, she hoped, she hoped.

Once upon a time, there was a barber who had never met anyone like him before. He was different in a very special way. Every day he used to strike his clippers and comb his hair.

One day, he heard a little knock at his door. He opened the door and a little girl with big brown eyes was standing there. She said, "I need a haircut, can I come in please?"

The barber smiled and said, "Of course!" He motioned for her to come in and take a seat. He then began to strike his clippers and comb her hair. He was careful to not make it too short.

When he was done, the little girl said, "Thank you! It looks so different!" The barber smiled and said, "You're welcome! Come back anytime!"

The little girl left with a new haircut and the barber felt happy. He liked giving people haircuts and making them look different. He thought it was the best job ever.

George was feeling very happy. He was about to go to his grandmother's house for a visit. On the way, he was singing and humming happily. But then he heard something else. It sounded like someone shouting. It was coming from an old man who was standing on the street. He was scolding a little girl for no reason. George was shocked. He thought it was very rude of the man.

But George was not one to sit back and do nothing. He quickly scribbled something on a piece of paper and put it next to the man. It was a note. On the note George had written in big, bold letters: 'Be polite, be kind'.

The man was embarrassed when he read it. He could not believe a three-year-old could teach him something. He stopped shouting at the little girl, smiled at her and thanked George. The little girl was happy to see the man smile.

George was very pleased with himself. He had put the note in the right place at the right time and taught the man a lesson. He smiled and continued on his way to his grandmother's house.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big bed with an enormous mattress. One day, Lily's friend came to play with her. The friend asked, "Can I jump on your bed?" Lily replied, "Yes, but be careful not to fall off!"

The friend jumped and jumped on the bed until she got tired. Then, she asked Lily, "Can we make a fort with your mattress?" Lily said, "Yes, let's do it!" They took the mattress off the bed and put it on the floor. They stacked some pillows and blankets around it to make a big fort.

Lily's mom came in and asked, "What are you girls doing?" Lily said, "We made a fort with my enormous mattress!" Her mom smiled and said, "That looks like so much fun. Can I join?" The girls happily replied, "Yes, please!" They all crawled inside the fort and giggled and played together. It was the best day ever.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Spot. Spot liked to run and jump and play all day with his best friend, a little boy named Tim. They were always together, and they loved each other very much.

One day, Tim found a big box in his room. It had a lot of dust on it. Tim opened the box and saw a big thing called a "record" inside. Tim's mom told him that the record could play music.

Tim and Spot cleaned the dust off the record and played it on a special machine. The music started to play, and it was so fun! Tim and Spot danced and danced to the happy sounds. They laughed and played until it was time for bed. And as they slept, they knew they would always be loyal friends.

Sam had a big bag of marbles. He liked to play with them and make them roll and shine. He had many colors and shapes of marbles. Some were big and some were small. Some were smooth and some were bumpy.

One day, he went to the park with his mom. He saw a boy who had a very special marble. It was red and blue and had a star inside. Sam thought it was the most powerful marble he had ever seen. He wanted to have it.

"Hi, I'm Sam. What's your name?" he asked the boy.

"I'm Max. Do you like my marble?" the boy said.

"Yes, it's very pretty and powerful. Can I see it?" Sam said.

"Sure, but be careful. It's my favorite marble," Max said. He gave the marble to Sam.

Sam held the marble in his hand. He felt its weight and warmth. He looked at the star and wondered how it got there. He wished he could keep it.

"Can I have your marble?" he asked Max.

"No, you can't. It's mine. Give it back," Max said.

"Please, I'll give you anything. I have many marbles in my bag. You can choose any one you want," Sam said.

"No, I don't want your marbles. I only want my marble. It's the best marble in the world. It's my lucky marble. It makes me happy," Max said.

Sam felt sad. He wanted to make Max happy, but he also wanted the powerful marble. He didn't know what to do. He looked at his mom. She smiled and said:

"Sam, you have to give back the marble to Max. It's his marble, not yours. You can't take something that belongs to someone else. You have to respect his choice. Maybe you can be friends and play together with your marbles. Sharing is more fun than spending."

Sam nodded. He gave back the marble to Max. He said:

"I'm sorry, Max. I didn't mean to be rude. Your marble is very nice, but you can keep it. I have many marbles too. Do you want to play with me?"

Max smiled. He said:

"Thank you, Sam. You are very kind. I'm sorry I was angry. Your marbles are very nice too. Yes, I want to play with you."

Sam and Max became friends. They played with their marbles and had fun. They learned to share and respect each other. They both felt happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in her yard. One day, she saw a tall tree in her yard. She wanted to climb it, but she was too scared.

Her mom came outside and asked, "What's wrong, Lily?" Lily said, "I want to climb the tall tree, but I'm scared." Her mom said, "Don't be scared. I'll help you climb it."

So, Lily and her mom climbed the tall tree together. When they reached the top, Lily said, "I can see everything from up here!" Her mom smiled and said, "I'm glad you're not scared anymore." They both enjoyed the view from the top of the tall tree in their yard.

Once upon a time, there was a little poppy. The poppy was very small, but it was so bright and pretty. Every day, the poppy was in the same place - it kept growing and growing!

One day, two little children were walking by the poppy. They stopped to admire its bright orange petals and took turns taking a few petals from the poppy. Then, they noticed something - the little poppy was still growing no matter how many petals they took away. They were so amazed!

The children kept visiting the poppy everyday and they kept taking a few petals at a time. But the poppy still kept growing and growing. The children were so happy when they saw that nothing could stop its growth.

The little poppy kept growing and growing, until it was much bigger and just as bright as it had been when the two children first found it. From then on, the poppy kept reminding the children that no matter how small it seemed, it could still do amazing things.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy found a shiny laser in the grass. He picked it up and played with it for a while. But the laser made him uncomfortable, so he put it in his pocket and went home.

That night, Timmy had a bad dream. He dreamt that the laser was shooting beams all around his room. He woke up scared and didn't want to go back to sleep. The next day, Timmy decided to return the laser to where he found it. He knew it wasn't his to keep.

When Timmy got back to the field, he saw that his friends were already there. They were playing with a toy spaceship that had a laser on it. Timmy realized that the laser he found belonged to the spaceship. He returned the laser to his friends, who were very happy to have it back. Timmy felt proud that he did the right thing and helped his friends.

Jimmy was running a race. He wanted to be the first one to the end of the race. He had his friend Ella with him. They were both wearing colorful sneakers.

Ella shouted, "Let's race to that blackboard over there!"

Jimmy smiled and said, "Okay, let's go!"

They started running as fast as they could. Jimmy moved his legs faster and faster. Then, he crossed the finish line first.

Ella was very impressed with Jimmy. She said, "You're so impressive, Jimmy. You were the fastest one to finish the race!"

Jimmy beamed with pride. "I did it!" he said. "You were really fast too, Ella!"

Ella smiled back. They both enjoyed the race together.

Sara and Ben were twins. They liked to play in the bath. They had many toys in the water. They had a duck, a boat, a fish and a frog. They made the toys splash and swim.

"Look, Sara, the moon!" Ben said. He pointed to the window. The moon was big and bright. It shone on the water. "The moon is pretty," Sara said.

They wanted to touch the moon. They stood up in the bath. They reached out their hands. But the moon was too far. They could not reach it.

They saw something else in the water. It was small and round. It looked like the moon. But it was not the moon. It was a bubble. A bubble from the soap.

"Look, Sara, a small moon!" Ben said. He tried to catch the bubble. But the bubble popped. It made a sound. "Pop!" Sara laughed. She blew more bubbles. They made more small moons.

They played with the bubbles. They made them splash and pop. They had fun in the bath. They forgot about the big moon. They only saw the small moons.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird. The bird loved to sing and play in the trees. One day, the bird found a delicate note on the ground. It was so pretty and the bird wanted to keep it safe. The bird picked up the note with its beak and flew to its nest.

The bird put the delicate note in its nest and sang a happy song. Suddenly, the wind started to blow and the nest started to turn. The bird was scared and didn't want to lose the delicate note. The bird flapped its wings and tried to keep the nest from turning.

Finally, the wind stopped and the nest was safe. The bird looked at the delicate note and smiled. It was happy to have found something so special. From that day on, the bird sang a new song about the delicate note and how it was saved from turning.

Once upon a time, there was a happy puppy named Max. Max loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Max was very tired and wanted to take a nap. He found a cozy spot under a big tree and closed his eyes.

While Max was sleeping, his friend Molly came to visit him. Molly was very enthusiastic to see Max and gave him a big kiss on the nose. Max woke up and was very happy to see Molly. They played together for a while before Max got tired again and went back to his nap.

When Max woke up, he felt refreshed and ready to play again. He was grateful for his nap and the enthusiastic kiss from his friend Molly. From that day on, Max made sure to take a nap every day so he could have more energy to play with his friends.
